Name: 나루루
Text: 오오, 주변의 신호가 잘 잡힌다루! 관측소를 다 점검해줬구나루!

Name: 학자 나루루
Text: 오오, 주변의 신호가 잘 잡힌다루! 관측소를 다 점검해줬구나루!

Name: 학자 나루루
Text: 정말 고맙다루! 여기 약속한 사례다루!

Name: 학자 나루루
Text: 오오, 주변의 신호가 잘 잡힌다루! 관측소를 다 점검해줬구나루!

Name: 학자 나루루
Text: 정말 고맙다루! 여기 약속한 사례다루!

Name: 나루루
Text: 아, 혹시 이 주변에 있는 관측소를 둘러봐줄 수 있겠냐루? 범람의 여파로 연결이 이상해졌는지 신호가 잘 잡히지 않는다루…
타바나 일행에게 해그늘 숙영지로 가는 길을 안내한 후 남은 범람 몬스터를 처리하기 위해 협곡 안으로 향했다.

Name: 나루루
Text: 나 좀 도와달라루!! 나도모르게 도전관문에 들어와버렸다루!!
휴… 에아의 가호가 있었다루. 모험가가 없었다면 정말 큰일 날뻔했다루. 정말 고맙다루.

Name: 요아르
Text: 그럼… 이런 것도 잠재력으로 볼 수 있을까요?
적응이 빠른 편인가 보죠?

그가 정신을 집중하려는 듯 눈을 찡그리자,
이윽고 푸른 빛이 뿜어졌다 사그라들었다.

대회는 안전하고 고분고분한 사냥감 데리고 하는 거잖습니까.
야생에서의 사냥이 진짜라고요.야생에서의 사냥이 진짜라고요.야생에서의 사냥이 진짜라고요.

Name: 모니카
Text:
너… 배달원은 당장 그만 둬.
능력을 썩히지 않는 것도 가진 자의 의무야.

Name: 부서진 거인의 조각
Text: (구체에 손이 닿자마자 치지직 거리는 소리와 함께 그대로 사라져 버리고 말았다.)

Name: Placeholder text
Text: This is placeholder text.

Name: Aventureira misteriosa
Text: Ei, você está bem?

Name: Aventureira misteriosa
Text: Ainda bem.

Name: Aventureira misteriosa
Text: No instante em que aquele Colossus enorme atacou você, uma luz ofuscante explodiu.

Name: Aventureira misteriosa
Text: Quando recobrei a consciência, o Colossus havia desaparecido e você estava desacordado.

Name: Aventureira misteriosa
Text: Além disso, as ruínas começaram a desabar. Foi um caos completo.

Name: Aventureira misteriosa
Text: O que aconteceu...? Foi tudo um sonho?

Name: Aventureira misteriosa
Text: Mais importante... Como você ativou o Monolith?

Name: Aventureira misteriosa
Text: E como você entrou no Labyrinth? Hã?

Name: Aventureira misteriosa
Text:
Que fascinante. É a primeira vez que ouço algo assim, mas não parece totalmente absurdo.
Afinal, eu mesma passei por parte disso.

Name: Aventureira misteriosa
Text: Ah, é mesmo! Eu sou Rada, sacerdotisa de Enkia. E você?

Name: Rada
Text: [player]... Faz tempo que alguém desperta a curiosidade da grande Rada.

Name: Rada
Text: Tenho a impressão de que ficar por perto vai render boas histórias...

Name: Rada
Text:
Esta é Babylon.
Mas o que trouxe você até <Blue>Forsaken Land</>?

Name: Rada
Text:
Você também está atrás da <Blue>Giant's Tower</>, certo?
A maioria está!

Name: Rada
Text:
Se estiver sem rumo, que tal visitar a Wayfinders Guild?
Eu levo você até lá!

Name: Rada
Text:
Que nada! Você precisa de ajuda, sim!
Venha comigo. É por aqui.

Name: Rada
Text: Há muitos comerciantes de artigos diversos neste bairro.

Name: Rada
Text: Comida, livros, louças, flores... Aqui tem de tudo.

Name: Rada
Text: Eles só trazem o que há de melhor nestas terras desoladas.

Name: Rada
Text:
Até quem vem de fora passa aqui para se abastecer antes de voltar.
Os negócios devem estar indo muito bem, não é?

Name: Rada
Text: Mas a grande atração está bem aqui, é claro.

Name: Rada
Text: Tcharam! Este lugar também é muito popular entre os aventureiros.

Name: Rada
Text: Ela se chama 'Wish-Granting Fountain'.

Name: Rada
Text: Vou jogar uma moeda por você. Faça um pedido.

Name: Rada
Text:
Sou eu, <Orange>Evrin!</>
Adivinhe! Encontrei alguém muito interessante.

Name: Rada
Text:
Vamos, cumprimente!
Esta pessoa é [player].

Name: Evrin
Text: Você nunca chega de mãos vazias, Rada.

Name: Evrin
Text: Sou Evrin, responsável pela Wayfinders Guild.

Name: Rada
Text:
Parece que nosso visitante também está indo para a torre!
Que tal ensinarmos o básico?

Name: Evrin
Text: Afinal, só temos uma vida. É melhor se preparar bem.

Name: Evrin
Text: Toda fortuna vem acompanhada de um risco equivalente, não é, [player]?

Name: Evrin
Text: Visite primeiro a General Store. Eles têm muitos itens úteis.

Name: Evrin
Text: Babylon é um pouco labiríntica, então Rada irá com você.

Name: Rada
Text: Venha comigo! O melhor é ir montado em um <Blue>Rappie</>.

Name: Zariya
Text: Um rosto novo, e acompanhado de Rada...

Name: Zariya
Text: Você está se aventurando em Forsaken Land pela primeira vez, não está?
Após ouvir a história de Rada, Zariya reuniu os suprimentos necessários para a aventura.

Name: Zariya
Text: Até a próxima, aventureiro!

Name: Evrin
Text: Isso deve ajudar você a evitar problemas por algum tempo.

Name: Evrin
Text: O território dentro da barreira é maior do que parece.

Name: Evrin
Text: Por isso, depender apenas de uma <Blue>montaria</> ou de um <Blue>planador</> tem seus limites.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Para viajar com mais facilidade, é melhor usar um <Orange>Warp Conduit</>.
Para registrar...

Name: Rada
Text:
Eu ensino você a registrar!
Há um Warp Anchor bem na praça central!

Name: Evrin
Text: Acho que isso cobre o básico, [player].

Name: Evrin
Text: Já que está em Babylon, pode ser uma boa ideia passar na Merchants Guild...

Name: Rada
Text: Ah, é mesmo! Eu me esqueci completamente de perguntar.

Name: Rada
Text: Por que você está indo para a torre, [player]?

Name: Rada
Text: Os <Orange>Sverd Mercenaries?</> Esse nome me parece familiar.

Name: Evrin
Text: Então você já tem um motivo para visitar a Merchants Guild.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Vá com Rada, [player].
Ela sabe se virar muito bem.

Rada guiou o aventureiro até a Merchants Guild,
onde alguém que parecia ser o líder da guilda os aguardava.

Name: Rada
Text: <Orange>Aman!</> Conheça alguém que despertou meu interesse depois de tanto tempo.

Name: Aman
Text: Novos aventureiros são sempre interessantes.

Name: Aman
Text:
Sou Aman.
O que trouxe você até mim?

Name: Rada
Text: Estou dando a você uma ótima oportunidade de pagar o que me deve...

Name: Rada
Text: A primeira regra de Forsaken Land: retribua tudo o que receber! Você sabe disso, não é?

Name: Aman
Text: ...Já que é você, Rada, vou ouvir. Só desta vez.

Name: Rada
Text:
Meu novo amigo está procurando uma coisa.
Você pode investigar, certo?

Name: Aman
Text: Depende do que seja, mas pode falar.

Name: Aman
Text: ...Nunca ouvi falar deles.

Name: Rada
Text: Achei que você soubesse de tudo, Aman!

Name: Aman
Text: Posso investigar, mas não prometo nada por enquanto.

Name: Rada
Text: Então, que tal irmos falar com <Orange>Ragnar</>?

Name: Aman
Text: Ele lidera um clã famoso em Babylon. Talvez saiba de alguma coisa.

Name: Rada
Text:
O que acha, [player]?
Quer conhecê-lo? Não custa tentar!

Name: Rada
Text: Boa escolha!

Name: Rada
Text:
Venha comigo!
O Polaris Clan Hideout fica logo ali.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Já perdi a conta de quantos amigos você faz por dia.
Quem é desta vez?

Name: Rada
Text:
Um aventureiro que parece atrair confusão por onde passa!
Na verdade, vim porque ele tem uma pergunta.

Name: Rada
Text: Vamos, apresente-se!

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Sou Ragnar, líder do <Orange>Polaris Clan</>.
O que quer perguntar, [player]?

Name: Ragnar
Text:
...Os Sverd Mercenaries?
Já ouvi falar deles. Por que a pergunta?

Name: Polaris Clan Member
Text: <Red>Uma incursão... É uma incursão!</>

Name: Polaris Clan Member
Text:
Uma incursão começou em First Step Village.
É pequena, mas faltam combatentes para contê-la.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Todos os membros do clã presentes, partam imediatamente.
A segurança dos moradores é nossa prioridade.

Name: Polaris Clan Member
Text: Sim, entendido.

Name: Rada
Text:
Eu também vou, junto com [player]!
Meu novo amigo sabe lutar muito bem.

Name: Rada
Text: Em troca, você nos conta o que sabe sobre os Sverd Mercenaries. Combinado?

Name: Rada
Text: [player], sei que está tudo uma confusão, mas pegue isto por enquanto.

Name: Rada
Text:
Depois ensino você a usar.
Vamos para a muralha externa. Depressa!

Name: Rada
Text:
Ufa, foi fácil, não foi?
Fiquei preocupada quando disseram que faltavam combatentes, mas resolvemos isso rapidinho.

Name: Rada
Text:
Só não sei a extensão dos danos.
Parece que bastante coisa foi destruída.

Name: Rada
Text:
Vamos avaliar a situação primeiro?
Precisamos falar com Uzar, o representante da aldeia.

Name: Rada
Text:
Nós nos conhecemos há muito tempo e nos entendemos bem.
Mesmo que ele goste de fazer umas gracinhas às vezes.

Name: Uzar
Text: Ora essa, é mesmo a grande Rada?!

Name: Rada
Text:
Que reação é essa? Até parece que nunca me viu antes.
Você se machucou?

Name: Uzar
Text:
Não esperávamos que algo assim acontecesse tão perto de Babylon.
Fomos pegos completamente desprevenidos.

Name: Rada
Text:
Viemos assim que soubemos.
Cheguei bem a tempo!

Name: Uzar
Text: De fato... Parece que você conquistou o título de <Orange>Divine</> por pura habilidade.

Name: Uzar
Text: Derrubou aqueles monstros terríveis da incursão num piscar de olhos!

Name: Uzar
Text:
Confesso que tinha minhas dúvidas sobre você, Rada,
mas, de agora em diante, vou tratá-la com o maior respeito!

Name: Rada
Text:
Ah, pare de provocar e me conte exatamente o que aconteceu.
É a primeira vez que isso acontece perto de Babylon.

Name: Uzar
Text:
Parecia que uma névoa espessa estava chegando,
e, num instante, aquelas coisas apareceram.

Name: Uzar
Text: Bem no meio da aldeia, ainda por cima!

Name: Rada
Text: Estranho... As incursões sempre são precedidas por um <Red>sinal de alerta</>.

Name: Rada
Text: Preciso falar com Nova imediatamente.

Name: Rada
Text:
[player], pode esperar aqui um instante?
Vou terminar de falar com Ragnar e já volto.

Name: Rada
Text: Uzar, este é meu amigo. Faça companhia para ele!

Name: Uzar
Text: Pode deixar.

Name: Uzar
Text: Adventurer, I'm only asking because Rada isn't here.

Name: Uzar
Text:
Could you help out around the village?
We have no casualties, but we're definitely short-handed.

Name: Uzar
Text: And it wouldn't be right to make someone called Nova run errands, would it.

Name: Uzar
Text: And Rada... well, let's just say she isn't exactly cut out for delicate work.

Name: Uzar
Text:
See that old building across the way?
There are a few children hiding inside.

Name: Uzar
Text: I told them we were playing hide-and-seek to get them to hide there.

Name: Uzar
Text:
Please, talk them into coming back.
I’m counting on you.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(No answer comes from inside.
Are they not hiding in the house?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I should look around. If they're playing hide-and-seek...)</>

Name: Innocent Child
Text: We have to go home?

Name: Innocent Child
Text:
Can't we play just a little longer?
Uncle Uzar told us to wait right here!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Tell a lie, saying that Uzar has prepared some treats for them.)</>

Name: Innocent Child
Text: Really?! Then I'm going back to the village!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Better head back with the children.)</>

Name: Uzar
Text: You’ve brought back all of them.

Name: Uzar
Text:
I’ve raised them to know nothing but joy...
Now, these rascals don’t know a crisis even when they see one.

Name: Uzar
Text:
It looks quite run-down for a village right next to Babylon, doesn't it?
Despite being called First-Step Village,

Name: Uzar
Text:
most adventurers have no interest in a place like this.
They just want to head straight for the wider world.

Name: Uzar
Text: Still, I want to make this a place worth living in.

Name: Uzar
Text: One of my plans for that was the reclamation, but the Incursion broke out.

Name: Uzar
Text:
It would be a great help if you could assist me while I tend to the children.
What do you say?

Name: Uzar
Text: It seems they won't leave my side until I give them some snacks.

Name: Uzar
Text:
Apparently, someone spread words that <Yellow>‘Uncle Uzar is giving out treats!'</>,
haha!

Name: Uzar
Text:
You’re back already.
I believe that’s enough for a sample.

Name: Uzar
Text: Before we start the work in earnest, we need to clear out the beasts first.

Name: Uzar
Text:
They’ll ruin the crops if we leave them be.
You’ll likely find them near the water.

Name: Uzar
Text: Thank you. Now we can finally begin the reclamation.

Name: Uzar
Text:
While you were out dealing with the beasts,
the Divine returned.

Name: Uzar
Text: The Divine is in the inner village, so you should be able to find the way easily.

Name: Rada
Text:
Glad to see you staying out of trouble.
I've already passed the word along to Babylon.

Name: Rada
Text:
Since this is a new type of Incursion,
they're busy trying to come up with some official terminology for it.

Name: Rada
Text: They were using some big words, so I just told them to fill me in later.

Name: Rada
Text: Instead, I brought this person along!

Name: Polaris Clan Member
Text: Oh, uh... hello?

Name: Rada
Text: You were curious about the Sverd Mercenaries, weren't you?

Name: Rada
Text: Turns out Ragnar had already ordered some digging done in the meantime.

Name: Rada
Text:
This one was right in the middle of reading the report,
and I figured you should hear it firsthand.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The clan member's eyes show pure bewilderment.)</>

Name: Rada
Text: Don't worry, I got Ragnar's permission to borrow his guy for a bit.

Name: Polaris Clan Member
Text: So... it seems the Sverd Mercenaries are currently inactive.

Name: Polaris Clan Member
Text: They were last spotted at the Starfall Plateau, but...

Name: Polaris Clan Member
Text: The last reports on Captain Ingel and the other members were from several months ago.

Name: Rada
Text:
The Polaris Clan takes on mercenary work too, don’t they?
And you still don't know anything?

Name: Polaris Clan Member
Text:
N-no. 
I've brought the documents with me, so please give me a moment.

Name: Polaris Clan Member
Text: Here they are. You can check them for yourself.
ItemDesc:
A document handed over by a Polaris Clan member.
I wonder what is written inside?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The documents only contain old records from a long time ago.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Ingel... definitely left a letter telling me to come to the Forsaken Land.)</>

Name: Rada
Text:
You're right.
The Sverd Mercenaries used to be so proactive about cleaning up the <Red>Incursion</>.

Name: Rada
Text:
They've gone completely silent lately.
I wonder if something happened internally?

Name: Rada
Text: I guess we'll have to ask around elsewhere for the rest.

Name: Rada
Text:
Since the mercenaries were mostly focused on handling the Incursion,
maybe it's best to meet <Orange>Xeros</>!

Name: Rada
Text: His nickname is the 'Incursion Specialist.' Quite the name, right?

Name: Rada
Text:
He's so skilled that he's famous even among the Divines.
Not that I've ever actually seen his face, though.

Name: Polaris Clan Member
Text: If you're looking for him... there are reports that he headed east.

Name: Polaris Clan Member
Text:
The nearest outpost from here is the Sunshade Encampment.
Perhaps you should try there?

Name: Rada
Text: Just follow this path straight down!

Name: Rada
Text:
If you run into any trouble, just tell them I sent you, okay?
We're friends, after all!

Name: Weeping Merchant
Text: Who... who are you?

Name: Weeping Merchant
Text: Do you see those boxes stuck in the water?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He points toward the shallows, where a few boxes can be seen.)</>

Name: Weeping Merchant
Text: They're already soaking wet from that freezing water.

Name: Weeping Merchant
Text: The problem is, those boxes are my entire life...

Name: Kamyar
Text: I, Kamyar, have been a respectable peddler for years.

Name: Kamyar
Text:
I was planning to give my wife a wonderful gift.
Today is our wedding anniversary, you see.

Name: Kamyar
Text:
But then, out of nowhere, some <Red>Kuduru</> appeared!
Right before you showed up!

Name: Kamyar
Text:
I ran for my life and didn't even notice I'd dropped my luggage!
As you can see, I'm unharmed, but...

Name: Kamyar
Text:
The bastards must have knocked the boxes over as they swarmed past.
And now the box with the gift is just... sitting there in the water...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Suddenly, ominous-sounding footsteps are heard drawing near.)</>

Name: Kamyar
Text:
Eek! W-watch out!
Behind you! Right behind you, more Kuduru!

Name: Kamyar
Text:
Phew... thank you for saving me.
I had no idea they were still around.

Name: Kamyar
Text:
But really, what am I supposed to do now?
Those are expensive gifts.

Name: Kamyar
Text: …I have a fear of swimming.

Name: Kamyar
Text:
L-look at that! Look how deep the water is!
A person can drown even in water that’s only ankle deep!

Name: Kamyar
Text:
You are my savior! Heavens!
It's not much, but please take this as a token of my gratitude.

Name: Kamyar
Text:
Just a little further ahead is the Sunshade Encampment.
You must take a rest there before you move on.

Name: Kamyar
Text: You swam in that deep water, not to mention the Kuduru. You've been through a lot.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It wasn't even that deep...)</>

Name: Kamyar
Text:
Well then, I'll be heading home now.
Thank you so much!

Name: Person in Charge
Text: Yawn... What brings you here?

Name: Person in Charge
Text:
Yup, that's right.
So, how can I help you?

Name: Person in Charge
Text: I mean, I'm technically in charge of security, but...

Name: Ifril
Text:
At the end of the day, I'm just your average adventurer. Name’s Ifril.
I'd prefer if you kept your questions simple.

Name: Ifril
Text:
Hmm…
I think I might've heard something about someone seeing the Incursion Specialist.

Name: Ifril
Text:
Now, who was it again...?
There are just so many adventurers coming and going.

Name: Ifril
Text: My memory's a bit fuzzy. Why don't you try asking the others?

Name: Ifril
Text:
There's Keyvan, Yasta...
Oh, and Hadi should be taking a break around here too.

Name: Keyvan
Text:
Incursion Specialist?
What’s that? Some kind of profession that only deals with Incursions?

Name: Keyvan
Text: Well then, I guess that makes me an Incursion Specialist, too! Gahaha!

Name: Keyvan
Text: Ah, sorry for laughing! But seriously, I've never heard of him.

Name: Keyvan
Text:
I'm curious who it is, though.
It’d be fun if someone like that showed up around here.

Name: Yasta
Text: Ah—I’ve heard of him.

Name: Yasta
Text: They say he’s drop-dead gorgeous. Like, once you see him, you can never forget his face.

Name: Yasta
Text:
If I’d actually seen him, don’t you think I’d be following him around?
Instead of staying in this boring place!

Name: Yasta
Text:
If you ever run into him, introduce me, okay?
It’s my dream to at least once lay my eyes on a real handsome guy.

Name: Hadi
Text:
I caught a glimpse of his back from a distance once.
He vanished right after stopping the Incursion.

Name: Hadi
Text:
I saw him at the Giant's Garden.
It was a long time ago, so I'm sure he's long gone by now.

Name: Hadi
Text: …If I remember correctly, it was right around the time he first earned that nickname.

Name: Hadi
Text:
Well, maybe it would be faster to wait for the next Incursion.
He might just pop up right in front of you, out of nowhere.

Name: Hadi
Text: He moved so fast... it's still hard to forget.

Name: Ifril
Text: Ah... I think it's coming back to me now.

Name: Ifril
Text: What's with that look?

Name: Ifril
Text:
<Yellow>'You couldn’t be bothered, and now you remember?'</>
—is that what you're thinking?

Name: Ifril
Text: The last person to report on the Incursion Specialist was an adventurer named Tabana.

Name: Ifril
Text:
She’s out on a scout right now, so you'll have to wait a bit to meet her.
The next shift will be here soon anyway.

Name: Ifril
Text:
I've told you everything I know.
We good now?

Name: Keyvan
Text: Oh, no, she’s being prickly again.

Name: Keyvan
Text: Look, could you just let her bluntness slide?

Name: Keyvan
Text: She says everything’s a bother and she doesn't care, but she's actually looking out for everyone.

Name: Keyvan
Text: Despite the attitude, she’s always the first to rush out whenever trouble hits the camp.

Name: Keyvan
Text: Oh, right! If you aren't in a hurry, could you give me a hand?

Name: Keyvan
Text:
All the decent adventurers are currently at the <Blue>Tower</>!
I’ve got no one left to ask!

Name: Keyvan
Text:
My Rappie is terribly afraid of insects.
Ever since a snake bit it, it just freezes up whenever it sees anything similar.

Name: Keyvan
Text: But it seems even worse than usual today.

Name: Keyvan
Text:
Others tell me to just get a new Rappie, but how could I?
We’ve grown too attached.

Name: Keyvan
Text: Thanks. I think the Rappies have finally calmed down thanks to you.

Name: Keyvan
Text:
If you ever need a lift, I'll take you where you need to go.
I'm sure my Rappies will be more than happy to help.

Name: Yasta
Text: Did you know there's a plant that monsters absolutely despise?

Name: Yasta
Text:
It only grows under these totally weird climate conditions—
It’s called a 'water-rich arid zone' or something.

Name: Yasta
Text:
But guess what, there they are, right in front of us!
Those cacti growing along the riverbank!

Name: Yasta
Text: I’ll have to do some research to be sure, but hey, it’s worth a shot, right?

Name: [player]
Text: (Yasta’s eyes are shining with overwhelming intensity.)

Name: Yasta
Text: Don’t tell anyone, but I'm planning to prepare it as a gift.

Name: Yasta
Text:
For the Incursion Specialist of course!
If I give him this, he might actually remember me.

Name: Yasta
Text: I’ll make it up to you once things work out, so... a little help, please?

Name: Yasta
Text: Ugh! What is that smell?!

Name: Yasta
Text:
Are you sure you brought what I asked for?
How can a plant have such a foul stench?

Name: Yasta
Text: If I gave him something like this, I'd leave the worst impression ever...

Name: Yasta
Text:
Oh, by the way, there's an <Blue>Ethereal Sanctum</> near the camp's Warp Anchor.
Could you clear it for me?

Name: Yasta
Text:
All I need is a small fee.
I’ll use that money to buy a gift for the Incursion Specialist! Hehe.

Name: Yasta
Text: It’s one of those special relics found all over the Forsaken Land!

Name: Yasta
Text:
Once you activate it, a virtual space unfolds.
You never know what you'll face until you're inside.

Name: Yasta
Text:
You might fight monsters, solve riddles,
or even have to fly through using a Glider.

Name: Yasta
Text:
Anyway, just be fast! And precise!
Pass the three challenges of the Sanctum.

Name: Yasta
Text:
You can escape even if you skip a challenge or two,
but completing them all will get you way more treasure.

Name: Yasta
Text:
Tempting, isn't it?
It’s what adventurers like us live for.

Name: Yasta
Text:
Climb up the cliff to the right of the Warp Anchor.
You’ll see the entrance to the Ethereal Sanctum there.
So it’s the Ethereal Sanctum Yasta talked about. But finding the Incursion Specialist comes first for now.

Name: Yasta
Text:
So? How was it?
Rookie adventurers usually find it pretty tough.

Name: Yasta
Text:
Then I might still have a chance.
I’ve changed my mind—you keep everything that came out of the treasure chest.

Name: Yasta
Text: I got hurt last time because I lost my footing, but I'm going to try again soon.

Name: Yasta
Text:
A gift means more when it's bought with money you earned yourself.
I'm sure the Incursion Specialist will appreciate my sincerity.

Name: Yasta
Text: It was nice meeting you, friend of the handsome guy!

Name: Hadi
Text: I guess it's my turn now.

Name: Hadi
Text: Still got something on your mind?

Name: Hadi
Text: ...Why? I am not going to ask for any weird favors like Keyvan did.

Name: Hadi
Text:
Besides, it's almost time for me to head out.
I'm switching shifts with Tabana.

Name: Hadi
Text:
Were you waiting for Tabana?
Then you'd better head to the bridge in front of the camp.

Name: Hadi
Text: She should be back by now... though she's running a bit late.

Name: Hadi
Text:
If you have something to say to her, make it quick.
I'll be packing my gear in the meantime.

Name: Nazia
Text:
Thank you, adventurer...
I was on my way back to the camp after the scout, but an Incursion suddenly broke out...

Name: Tabana
Text:
Nazia, save the details for later.
Run to the camp before more monsters show up! Now!

After guiding them toward Sunshade Encampment,
I headed into the gorge to deal with the remaining monsters.

Name: Xeros
Text: ... [player]?

Name: Xeros
Text: I didn't expect to run into you in a place like this.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Seeing as you were in Asientet,
you must have received <Orange>Ingel</>'s letter.

Name: Xeros
Text: My situation is... not much different.

Name: Xeros
Text: He said we, the Svert mercenaries, had been given a new, vital purpose.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Whatever that may be.
He asked if I could stand by him until the very end.

Name: Xeros
Text:
He must have asked you the same thing.
I did not answer right away.

Name: Xeros
Text: Captain vanished without a word, without waiting for our answer.

Name: Xeros
Text: He only said this: <Yellow>'The Sverd Mercenaries have been disbanded.'</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
It’s all so sudden, right?
There has to be another reason.

Name: Xeros
Text: So I… I’ve been chasing the <Red>Incursion</>.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Taking care of the Incursion was our main line of work.
I figured I might run into him eventually.

Name: Xeros
Text: You said you're looking for him too, right?

Name: Xeros
Text: Judging by your movements just now, you still seem a bit stiff.

Name: Xeros
Text: Until you return to your old self, you'd better stick to gathering information.

Name: Xeros
Text: Here, take this.
ItemDesc:
An ancient relic that allows for mutual contact.
It is rare and difficult to find or purchase, so few people possess one.

Name: Xeros
Text:
It’s a <Blue>communicator</>. You can use it to contact others who have the same thing.
I’ll keep searching for the Captain. Use it when the time is right.

Name: Xeros
Text: Bye. I'll be seeing you.

Name: Ifril
Text: Hey! Where have you been—

Name: Ifril
Text:
Wait, you're not leaving, are you? Right now, the wounded...
Hadi, we're running low on water!

Name: Ifril
Text: Those adventurers holed up in the Tower... where are they when we need them?

Name: Ifril
Text: Sigh... sorry. Just forget I said that.

Name: Ifril
Text: And about me being rude earlier—let's just put that aside.

Name: Ifril
Text:
If we don't treat these people now... they won't make it.
Please, I need your help.

Name: Ifril
Text:
Haa... thank you, truly.
I couldn't have saved them all by myself.

Name: Ifril
Text:
They say Incursions broke out randomly all around the camp.
That's how everyone ended up like this...

Name: Ifril
Text:
Multiple Incursions happening at once without any warning... it's unheard of.
It's as if someone timed it perfectly. It's eerie.

Name: Ifril
Text:
I have to stay here and watch over the wounded,
so please—take this news to the Bardad Expedition Garrison.

Name: Ifril
Text: Before any more people get hurt.

Name: Baran
Text: I-if you aren't too busy, could you give me a hand?

Name: Baran
Text:
I'm Baran from the Bardad Expedition.
The thing is... my athletic skills are practically nonexistent...

Name: Baran
Text:
And of all places, the plant I need to gather is right down there, at the bottom of the cliff.
Help me out, and I promise I'll pay you back!

Name: Baran
Text:
Finally, I can take these Evening Primroses back!
Thank you so much, adventurer!

Name: Baran
Text:
Actually... the wind was blowing so hard earlier that... 
all the reports I wrote just blew away.

Name: Baran
Text:
If I go back empty-handed, Olia will literally kill me.
So... could you find my reports for me?

Name: Baran
Text:
You see that cliff on the other side?
This sounds like an excuse, I know, but I also have a phobia of flying.

Name: Baran
Text:
I know I'm being shameless, but can I ask for one more favor?
I’ll p-pay you back no matter what!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I see an updraft ahead. I should head that way.)</>

Name: Baran
Text: You're a lifesaver, adventurer!

Name: Baran
Text: Lastly, please deliver the reports and the Evening Primroses to Olia for me.

Name: Baran
Text:
I, I can’t! Absolutely not!
Please, it has to be you. Promise me you'll do it.

Name: Baran
Text: Olia should be somewhere along the path to the Expedition Base.

Name: Olia
Text:
...That idiot Baran. Now I can't even stay mad at him.
How did he even remember that I like Evening Primroses?

Name: Olia
Text:
Thanks for helping him out.
I'll touch up the reports and submit them to the Expedition Leader myself.

Name: Olia
Text: Judging by how you did all that for Baran, you must be quite the meddler, huh?

Name: Olia
Text:
Don't take it the wrong way.
I'm just saying I'm glad to run into an adventurer like you in the Forsaken Land.

Name: Olia
Text: So, where are you headed?

Name: Olia
Text:
Perfect. You're almost there anyway.
So, how about doing one more good deed on your way?

Name: Olia
Text:
There's a shelter on the way to the garrison.
Just plant this signpost as you head up.

Name: Olia
Text:
This was originally Ushan’s job, but...
Anyway, once the signposts are up, let Ushan know.

Name: Ushan
Text: Thank you. I’ve been having a hard time focusing on work lately.

Name: Ushan
Text: It's been fifteen days since my younger brother went missing on an expedition.

Name: Ushan
Text:
As you can see, the winds here are strong and the terrain is treacherous.
Even signposts are almost useless out here.

Name: Ushan
Text:
I was just about to give up… then I saw you, adventurer.
...So I decided… to try just one more day.

Name: Ushan
Text: Maybe my brother will come back tomorrow...

Name: Ushan
Text:
If you keep heading up, you'll see some ruins.
The Expedition Garrison is right next to them.

Name: Bardad
Text:
I am <Orange>Bardard</>, the leader of this expedition.
What brings you to me?

Name: Bardad
Text:
Lately, <Red>Incursions without any warning signs</> have started to break out.
We're trying our best to find the cause, but we haven't made much progress.

Name: Bardad
Text: In any case, thank you for bringing us the news.

Name: Bardad
Text: I'd like to show my gratitude for your trouble. Is there anything you need?

Name: Bardad
Text:
Hmm, that name doesn't ring a bell.
I'll ask around among the expedition members.

Name: Bardad
Text:
While I check on the mercenaries, could you help me?
I've been preparing a report on these Incursions without warning sings.

Name: Bardad
Text: It’s a request for cooperation from the Asientet Manor, so time is short.

Name: Bardad
Text:
Much appreciated! By any chance, do you have a communicator?
If not, I can lend you one from the expedition.

Name: Bardad
Text:
Perfect! Then I’ll let you know what needs to be done through the device.
First, go register at the Warp Anchor.

Name: Yasar
Text:
Bardard sent you, I see.
I'm Yasar, in charge of the garrison's security.

Name: Yasar
Text: To be honest, our investigation is being delayed by the monsters inside the ruins.

Name: Yasar
Text: We must pass through the ruins to identify the traces of the Incursion.

Name: Yasar
Text: It would be a huge help if you could clear them out for us.
I contacted Bardad to explain the Tesseract Fragment. He suspected a connection to the recent Incursions without a precursor event.

Name: Bardad
Text:
One of the observatories was broken, and outlaws attacked you?
Could it be... the <Red>Shadow Wolves</>?

Name: Bardad
Text:
They operate out in the Barrens.
They roam in packs, living off plunder.

Name: Bardad
Text: Most of the bandits you'll encounter around here are likely part of the <Red>Shadow Wolves</>.

Name: Bardad
Text: They dress in black and supposedly have wolf tattoos.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Their attire matches the outlaws I saw at the observatory.
It's likely they were the Shadow Wolves...)</>

Name: Bardad
Text: That’s what I suspect as well, but…

Name: Bardad
Text:
It’s strange, though.
Even those like the Shadow Wolves never go near the observatories.

Name: Bardad
Text:
I’ll include this in the report.
It doesn't sound like something we can just brush off.

Name: Bardad
Text: But for now, our priority is fixing those parts.

Name: Bardad
Text:
Hmm... it seems we'll need the wisdom of a Divine for this.
Take this and go find <Orange>“Beretta</>.”

Name: Bardad
Text: She should be in the building right next to the Warp Anchor.

Name: Beretta
Text: What do you want?

Name: Beretta
Text:
I'll have him put a whole lot of expensive booze on his tab.
This will take some time to fix, so you’re going to run some errands for me in the meantime.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Before that... what's your name?
You look familiar.

Name: Beretta
Text: [player]... so it's you. I see...

Name: Beretta
Text: Go find me a round plate. About the size of your head.

Name: Beretta
Text: It’s important, so don't you dare break it.

Name: Beretta
Text:
The ruins.
They're right in front of you, so get moving.

Name: Beretta
Text: …Hmm. Another bust.

Name: Beretta
Text:
A Record Disc.
They say these hold information about the Ancients, but I've never seen one that’s intact.
ItemDesc:
A relic found throughout the Forsaken Land.
It contains various records concerning the Ancients.

Name: Beretta
Text: Hopefully, we’ll find something useful later on.

Name: Beretta
Text: The observatory parts are fixed. Take them.

Name: Beretta
Text: And tell Bardard to make sure that booze is top-shelf.

Name: Bardad
Text: Oh, a Divine’s work never disappoints.

Name: Bardad
Text: Now, you take this back to the observatory and—

Name: Bardad
Text: Haha, I’m joking. I do have a conscience.

Name: Bardad
Text: It seems no one knows anything. Sorry about that.

Name: Bardad
Text: Instead, I’ll send you somewhere that might actually have information on them.

Name: Bardad
Text:
You remember the report I wrote at the <Orange>Asientet Manor</>‘s request?
You can be deliver it for me.

Name: Bardad
Text:
And... show them this letter of introduction as well.
They should be able to help you out.

Name: Bardad
Text:
The Manor is located in Babylon.
Just go north from the Warp Anchor in the Central Plaza.

Name: Manor Guard
Text: Halt! This area is off-limits.

Name: Manor Guard
Text: Wait here.

Name: Mueena
Text:
I am Lieutenant <Orange>Muina</>.
I heard you brought a report from Bardard’s Expedition, yes?

Name: Mueena
Text:
Protocol dictates an audience with the Archon, but...
I’ll be stepping in for now due to personal circumstances.

Name: Mueena
Text: Let’s take a look at the report first.

Muina reads through the report about the Incursions with no warning signs, 
and the observatory presumably destroyed by the Shadow Wolves.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Unprecedented Incursions and outlaws crossing the line...
Things are certainly taking a different turn than before.

Name: Mueena
Text: Bardard also seems to think quite highly of you. If there’s something you need, feel free to ask.

Name: Mueena
Text: If it’s within my power, I’ll see what I can do.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Sverd Mercenaries...
I’m aware they were quite active in the Forsaken Land.

Name: Mueena
Text:
…However, they haven't made any notable moves recently.
There's been next to no word of them.

Name: Mueena
Text: I can look into it if you like, but it will take some time.

Name: Mueena
Text:
You certainly know how to win a person over.
I can see why that stubborn old man Bardard took a liking to you.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Normally, handling official affairs would require more verification,
but I’ll trust his word and assign you a task.

Name: Mueena
Text: Deliver these operational orders to Captain <Orange>Nazir</> at the Central Detachment Garrison.
After hearing the location from Muina, you head straight for the garrison.

Name: Nazir
Text: Who in the world are you?

Name: Nazir
Text: Tch... another annoying job dumped on my lap.

Name: Nazir
Text:
Why don't you start by registering at the Warp Anchor?
Do I really have to walk you through every little thing?

Name: Nazir
Text:
At least you aren't slow.
All right, let’s see.

Name: Nazir
Text: From now on, yo must handle whatever that deputy or whatever was blabbering about.

Name: Nazir
Text:
A captain like me can't be bothered with these menial tasks, right?
Besides, it says right here I can work you to the bone.

Name: Nazir
Text:
Let’s see here.
<Yellow>“A transport unit traveling from Babylon to the Asientet Gateway has failed to arrive.”</>

Name: Nazir
Text: <Yellow>“Identify the whereabouts of the transport unit and take appropriate action.”</>

Name: Nazir
Text: …Hymph, too obvious. It’s the doing of those darn monsters or  outlaws.

Name: Nazir
Text:
A transport wagon headed for the gateway would be packed with expensive goods
—relics and whatnot.

Name: Nazir
Text:
Anyway, my unit hasn't received any reports about them.
Regrettably, I’d say.

Name: Nazir
Text: My men don't have time to waste on this nonsense, so go find them yourself.
You report to the Captain that traces of the transport unit were found, but there were no soldiers’ bodies or cargo.

Name: Nazir
Text: I, Is that so?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He looks visibly flustered.)</>

Name: Nazir
Text: We'll take it from here, so I need you to go find some other chores to do.

Name: Nazir
Text: Next up... yeah, this should do.

Name: Nazir
Text: <Yellow>“Outlaws—especially the Shadow Wolves—have become increasingly active lately.”</>

Name: Nazir
Text: <Yellow>“Locate the Wolves’ hideouts and—if possible—wipe them out.”</>

Name: Nazir
Text:
Don’t just stand there!
You should be running until your feet burn.

Name: Nazir
Text: Do I really have to walk you through every little thing?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You frown instead of answering.)</>

Name: Nazir
Text: Just go check around the White-Bone Expanse!

Name: Nazir
Text: ...You're back already?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(When you say you found and eliminated the Shadow Wolves,
the Captain looks flustered once again.)</>

Name: Nazir
Text:
I'm all out of chores for you, so get lost while I'm still being nice.
This is no place for a rookie like you.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Manor folks sure are stingy.
What kind of Detachment Captain is this?

Name: Khoon
Text:
...Does he actually think cleaning up corpses is easier?
This road sees plenty of traffic, don’t you think?

Name: Nazir
Text: I—I have no idea what you're talking about.

Name: Khoon
Text: Well, I guess I have no choice but to step in.

Name: Khoon
Text: Looks like you're done here. Mind if I take this one with me?

Name: Nazir
Text:
...This person is on official business for Asientet.
 My orders are the manor’s orders.

Name: Khoon
Text: Who’s arguing? I’m just borrowing your friend for a bit, so save the speech.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I'll send 'em back in one piece, don't you worry.
Relax—the Adventurers’ Alliance just needs a quick hand, that's all.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Neither of them seems to care about what you think.)</>

Name: Khoon
Text: Well then, shall we get to securing a safe path?

Name: Nazir
Text: What? Are you just ignoring me?

Name: Khoon
Text: By the way, do you carry a communicator?

Name: Khoon
Text: I was going to spare one for you... but you already have something this valuable?

Name: Khoon
Text: If you get a call from a stranger, it’s me. Make sure you answer.

Name: Khoon
Text:
True to your mercenary roots. You’re quite capable, aren’t you?
Speaking of which, I recall you’re searching for the Sverd Mercenaries.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Only Xeros, perhaps?
He's famous—the Incursion Specialist and all.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Still... it is a bit strange when you think about it.
A place like this should have caught wind of them, even through a stray rumor.

Name: Khoon
Text: This… is the gateway to Babylon. Everyone passes through here.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I'll let you know if I hear anything.
After all, a friend of Rada is a friend of mine.

Name: Khoon
Text: That fellow’s been bothering me for a while now.

Name: Khoon
Text: Him. He was bickering with the storage keeper earlier, and look at him now.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Do me a favor and tail him.
Head toward the White-Bone Expanse.

Name: Khoon
Text:
They’ll get suspicious if we both go.
I’ll stay here and keep an eye on this one.

Name: Khoon
Text: Then what should I say this time?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Hmm... how about a hunting contest?
I’ll take this spot, and you head out to the White-Bone Expanse.

Name: Khoon
Text: Leave it to me, friend.

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: Annoying brat. Trying to back out now...

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: Hehe. We'll see. Let’s hear what nonsense he has to spew.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(There are voices not far away… Better stay out of sight.)</>

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: You’re backing out over some lieutenant or whatever?

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text:
You’re the one who fed us the intel on the transport unit.
We lined your pockets. Now do your part.

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text:
Hey, you think we’re a joke?
How else are we supposed to make a living?

Name: Storage Keeper
Text:
B-But if we’re caught, we're doomed!
You think I’m doing this because I want to?

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text:
We played along a few times, and now you’re acting up?
Do the Shadow Wolves look easy to you?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A bloodcurdling scream—and the storage keeper collapses.)</>

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: Nothing more to see here. Move out.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Welcome back, [player].
Lucky for us, they really thought it was a hunting contest.

Name: Khoon
Text: So, find anything useful?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The storage keeper was killed by the Shadow Wolves.
Someone in the detachment leaked information that led to the ambush on the supply unit.)</>

Name: Khoon
Text:
The manor is responsible for maintaining order in the Barrens.
How can they be in league with the Shadow Wolves?

Name: Khoon
Text: I suppose the rumors about the friction between the Archon and the Lieutenant are true.

Name: Khoon
Text: Still, why drag in outlaws like the <Red>Shadow Wolves</>?

Name: Khoon
Text: At least we’re closer to the truth now. Thanks, [player].

Name: Khoon
Text: The folk in Babylon need to hear about this too.

Name: Khoon
Text:
…Guess I have no choice. Don't take what I'm about to say too seriously, [player].
That is, if you want to stay alive.

Name: Khoon
Text: Rumors are everywhere that the Archon and the Lieutenant are at each other’s throats.

Name: Khoon
Text: Word is they’re desperate to find any little excuse to take the other down.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Don’t get caught in the crossfire and bleed for nothing. Just stay out of it.
My friends and I will handle this.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Now, go tell the Detachment Captain that the White-Bone Expanse has been cleared.
I’ll check on a few more things, then head for Babylon.

Name: Nazir
Text:
It seems you have a knack for following orders.
Then I need you to solve another problem.

Name: Nazir
Text: One of my soldiers hasn't returned.

Name: Nazir
Text:
He headed for the ruins near the White-Bone Expanse.
He’s long overdue, and there’s still no sign of him.

Name: Nazir
Text: ...You expect me to dispatch my squad members just to find a single rookie?

Name: Nazir
Text:
This is exactly the kind of grunt work you were sent here for.
Don't just stand there—get moving and find him!

Name: Nazir
Text: ...Wait, you’re back alive? I thought—ah, never mind.

Name: Nazir
Text: So the soldier you were looking for is dead, and the Shadow Wolves showed up...

Name: Nazir
Text: Now is time for our detachment to act.

Name: Nazir
Text:
Right. You’ve fulfilled most of the orders in the mission scroll.
You can go back to Babylon now.

Name: Nazir
Text: Go to the manor and deliver this to the Lieutenant.

Name: Mueena
Text: I received the report.

Name: Mueena
Text:
The Detachment Captain... really never changes.
You’ve worked hard.

Name: Mueena
Text:
I also obtained some news regarding the <Orange>Sverd Mercenaries</> you’ve been looking for.
As for the details, the merchant— wait.

Name: Manor Soldier
Text: Emergency!

Name: Mueena
Text: What is it?

Name: Manor Soldier
Text: Reports of <Red>Incursions</> are coming in from all across the Barrens.

Name: Manor Soldier
Text: They say the observatory gave no response at all.

Name: Mueena
Text:
So these are the incursions with no warning signs.
Can they really happen simultaneously like this?

Name: Mueena
Text: It seems this is not the time to discuss that.

Name: Mueena
Text: One more favor before you go.

Name: Mueena
Text:
We need the help of the Divines.
Deliver this word to the Polaris Clan.

Name: Ragnar
Text: …I don’t recall summoning you. Why are you here?

Name: Ragnar
Text:
You arrived almost too late.
We were just about to depart for our assigned domains.

Name: Rada
Text:
What are you talking about? The timing is perfect.
We can leave the Pilgrim’s Path to our friend here, right?

Name: Khoon
Text: Great idea. You’re pretty good at this, aren’t you?

Name: Ragnar
Text: I am well aware of your feats at First Step Village. However...

Name: Beretta
Text:
This is no time to be picky.
The longer we delay, the more lives we lose.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Very well.

Name: Khoon
Text:
We’ll use that <Blue>communicator</> of yours.
Keep us posted on your progress.

(You check the communication status with Ragnar, Beretta, Rada, and Azran.
The Divines departed for their respective domains.)

Name: Ragnar
Text: As discussed, you are to head to the Pilgrim’s Path.

Name: Ragnar
Text: I will provide updates as the situation unfolds.

Name: Mueena
Text: I’ve heard you aided the Polaris Clan in purging the Incursion.

Name: Mueena
Text: Not in any of the reports so far.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The "Incursion Specialist" has yet to show himself. Strange.)</>

Name: Mueena
Text: At any rate, the manor extends its gratitude once more.

Name: Mueena
Text:
It would be only right to hold a feast for those who helped,
but now is not a good timing.

Name: Mueena
Text: We’ve received word that the Shadow Wolves are massing near Babylon.

Name: Mueena
Text: They likely intend to exploit the chaos caused by the Incursions.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Most of our forces are currently stationed outside Babylon.
We lack the numbers to act immediately.

Name: Mueena
Text: The manor’s safety is one thing, but if the Shadow Wolves target the civilians...

Name: Mueena
Text:
That is reckless.
You could be killed.

Name: Mueena
Text:
I see.
Then I’ll leave it to you.

Name: Shadow Wolf Strike Captain
Text: Move it! Faster!

Name: Shadow Wolf Strike Captain
Text: We don’t have all day to take out Aman and Muina, OK?

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: Over there! A suspicious presence!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Your eyes meet the Shadow Wolves’.)</>

Name: Shadow Wolf Strike Captain
Text:
An adventurer? Perfect.
We’ll warm up on that before we head up.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Thank you for your hard work.
The Shadow Wolves are in retreat, so we can breathe for a moment.

Name: Mueena
Text:
An assassination plot against Aman and myself...
The timing is... impeccable.

Name: Mueena
Text:
We owe you a great deal for this.
Thank you, truly.

Name: Mueena
Text: I would like to let you go now, but the Archon is looking for you.

Name: Mueena
Text:
After hearing the reports on the Incursions and the Shadow Wolves’ raid,
it seems he’s taken an interest in you.

Name: Mueena
Text: To think he’d take notice, when he usually treats adventurers like insects...

Name: Mueena
Text:
He even declined an audience with the Divines, 
yet it’s unsettling that he singled you out like this...

Name: Mueena
Text:
This isn’t a decision to be made lightly.
Who knows what he might do?

Name: Mueena
Text:
You’re quite stubborn.
Then let me give you one piece of advice.

Name: Mueena
Text:
<Orange>Fahad</> is notorious for his cruelty.
Watch your step.

Name: Fahad
Text:
So, you’re the adventurer everyone’s been talking about.
Name’s… [player], right?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You nod.)</>

Name: Fahad
Text: Your name has been coming up quite often everywhere.

Name: Fahad
Text: That is why I summoned you. I wanted to see your face for myself.

Name: Fahad
Text:
Underwhelming tha I expected.
You may leave.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Then why call me?)</>

Name: Mueena
Text: You’ve returned in one piece, I see.

Name: Mueena
Text: I was worried I’d be clearing away a corpse, so this is a relief.

Name: Mueena
Text: Now, go to Aman of the Merchants Guild.

Name: Mueena
Text: He will tell you the information you’ve been seeking.

Name: Mueena
Text: …And tell him about the Shadow Wolves’ assassination plot as well.

Name: Aman
Text:
It's been a while, [player].
I take it Muina sent you, right?
You relay that the Shadow Wolves were plotting to assassinate Aman and Muina.

Name: Aman
Text:
…Hah!
A mere band of outlaws acting this organized?

Name: Aman
Text:
The Shadow Wolves don’t have the spine for a stunt like this.
There’s definitely something more to it.

Name: Aman
Text:
…In any case, thanks for the warning, [player].
Now, I believe it’s time I gave you what you’re looking for.

Name: Aman
Text:
I don’t have the whereabouts of the entire mercenary group, but…
I think you’ll find this information quite useful.

Name: Aman
Text:
There is a man claiming to be a member of the Sverd Mercenaries.
The name is <Orange>“Symon.”</> Ring a bell?

Name: Aman
Text:
My informants in the western Barrens brought me this.
It’d be best if you looked into it yourself.

Name: Aman
Text:
Stop by the <Blue>Magobi Encampment</> and <Blue>Taima Pioneer Village</>.
If things get difficult, you can drop my name.

Name: Aman
Text:
Magobi Encampment is closest to Babylon, so head there first.
Look for Bishan.

Name: Aman
Text:
Before you go, stop by the general store and buy a <Orange>Rejuvenation Potion</>.
He never speaks for free.

Name: Aman
Text:
In the Forsaken Land, there’s no such thing as kindness without a price.
Let’s just say I’m investing in the future.

Name: Zariya
Text:
Oh, we meet again!
What can I do for you today?

Name: Zariya
Text:
Perfect timing!
A fresh batch of <Orange>rejuvenation potions</>, brewed from cactus stems, just came in.
ItemDesc:
A restorative brewed from cactus stems.
But… I’d rather not imagine the taste.

Name: Zariya
Text:
Take it while it's here.
I'll give you a good price.

Name: Presumed Superior
Text: <Red>Halt.</>

Name: Presumed Superior
Text:
We must conduct a search.
It is a safety precaution. Cooperate.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Soldiers approach, quickly checking your belongings before stepping back.)</>

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: Captain <Orange>Jeihan</>! All clear!

Name: Jeihan
Text:
Hmph. A common adventurer.
State your business.

Name: Jeihan
Text: Fill out your information on this paper first.
ItemDesc:
A form handed by Jeyhan.
It requests personal details for entry into Magobi Encampment.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
This is a mandatory procedure for entering the Magobi Encampment.
Permission will be granted only after it's complete.

Name: Jeihan
Text: I see you’ve come from Babylon.

Name: Jeihan
Text: The camp is a mess right now. Don’t cause trouble over one person.

Name: Jeihan
Text: Brief this adventurer on the precautions.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: Yes, Captain!

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: Come this way.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: Magobi Encampment is the last stop before the Giant’s Garden.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: See that narrow pass just ahead?

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text:
It’s infested with monsters. Extremely dangerous.
Any reckless behavior is strictly forbidden.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text:
<Yellow>First, do not make any loud noises.</>
The chances of them hearing you and swarming are high.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: <Yellow>Second, you must not enter without authorization.</>

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: We’ve lost too many lives already.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text:
We lack the forces just to contain the Incursion,
yet bandit raids have spiked, so we are restricting all entry.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text:
This rule applies regardless of nationality or race.
So, follow it for everyone's safety.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: That’s all.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: That concludes the briefing. Move along.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The soldiers stand firm, guarding the way.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Better not rush in. I should look for Symon first.)</>

Name: Bishan
Text:
I saw you snooping around earlier.
That’s not happening anytime soon.

Name: Bishan
Text: We’ve been stuck here waiting for three days ourselves.

Name: Bishan
Text: Sent by Master Aman? And why should I believe that?

Name: Bishan
Text:
Th-this… how did you…
Ahem. W-welcome. I am Bishan.

Name: Bishan
Text:
Just so you know, I’m still in great shape!
Master Aman must have the wrong idea! H-He really does.

Name: Bishan
Text: Symon…? Symon, you say.

Name: Bishan
Text:
Ah! That talkative young fellow.
He stopped by a few days ago.

Name: Bishan
Text: Seemed like he was going around asking questions.

Name: Bishan
Text: My apologies, but with things as they are, I can’t recall much else.

Name: Bishan
Text: Being stuck here has all my nerves on edge, you see.

Name: Jiranna
Text:
They’re blocking us! Blocking us!
We have to get back to the village, quickly!

Name: Jiranna
Text:
Checks are done, Reppies are all here.
Now we just need to head to Aburu Village!

Name: Bishan
Text: Ah, these are the <Orange>Naruru</>. My merchant guild trades with them.

Name: Bishan
Text:
First time seeing a Naruru?
They might look cute, but they never miss a coin.

Name: Bishan
Text:
I was going to head back after seeing them off,
but with things like this, I’m stuck.

Name: Jiranna
Text:
It was so hard to catch <Orange>Azid</>!
Before he runs off again—

Name: Jiranna
Text: Huh?! Azid? Azid!

Name: Jiranna
Text:
He’s gone! Gone! Eeeeek!
Must find him! Must find! Azid!!

Name: Jiranna
Text: We’re all the way down here, and can’t see a thing. Not a thing!

Name: Jiranna
Text:
He didn't sneak into the gorge, did he…?
I told him not to! No!

Name: Jiranna
Text: There are scary things here! Many scary things!

Name: Jiranna
Text: Elder Etura will be so sad if something happens to Azid!

Name: Jiranna
Text: But it’s so hard to find him if he hides like this...

Name: Jiranna
Text: Right! Captain Jeihan!

Name: Jiranna
Text:
He said to tell him if something bad happens.
He’ll help. He will.

Name: Jeihan
Text: What is it?

Name: Jiranna
Text: Captain Human, help! Help me!

Name: Jiranna
Text:
My friend has been missing for a while!
We looked and looked, but he’s nowhere!

Name: Jeihan
Text:
It’s certain…
…that a Naruru may have used the waterways beneath the gorge.

Name: Jeihan
Text: Since this happened within the camp, I bear some responsibility.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
I will grant you an entry permit.
I’ll instruct my soldiers to follow shortly.

Name: Jeihan
Text: Be careful. There are some strange creatures out there.

Name: Jiranna
Text: U-Understood.

Name: Jiranna
Text:
Let’s go! Now!
Good human!

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text:
This is indeed... the Captain’s handwriting.
Entry permit confirmed.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text:
It’s no different from a lawless wasteland in there.
Frequent battles are ahead. Watch your back.

Name: Jiranna
Text: Okay! Leave it to the Naruru from here!

Name: Jiranna
Text:
I’ll sniff out Azid’s scent!
Further in, further in we go!

Name: Jiranna
Text: Azid! I looked for you everywhere!

Name: Jiranna
Text:
Elder <Orange>Etura</> told me to keep a close eye on you.
If you wander off again, I’ll tell him everything!

Name: Azid
Text:
Hmph! Hmph, I say!
Just look at what I found.

Name: Azid
Text:
There’s a statue of Goddess Ea, even in the desert!
Father will be shocked! Shocked when he sees this!

Name: Jiranna
Text: …Goddess Ea doesn’t look like that!

Name: Jiranna
Text:
Anyway, just stay put at the camp!
We have to wait for the others and leave together!

Name: Azid
Text: Why, why don’t you understand me?

Name: Azid
Text: Who cares if my father is the Elder Naruru! He never lets me go out!

Name: Azid
Text: And now he even sends a human, a human to watch me!

Name: Jiranna
Text: Just follow me! Before I tie you to a Reppie’s back!

Name: Azid
Text: Ugh…

Name: Jiranna
Text:
You need a lot more nagging.
<Yellow>For starters—</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Better step away for a moment.)</>

Name: Symon
Text:
Good heavens, look who it is!
I never imagined I’d run into you in the Barrens.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Symon hasn't changed a bit since we last met.)</>

Name: Symon
Text:
It’s been so long since I’ve seen a comrade! 
I don’t even know how to put this feeling into words.

Name: Symon
Text: What brings you all the way out here, eh?

Name: Symon
Text: What? The Captain?

Name: Symon
Text: Just what on earth happened while I was away...?

Name: Symon
Text:
This is going to be a long conversation.
We should meet again, somewhere proper.

Name: Symon
Text:
You’re with those Naruru, aren't you?
Come to the southwest once you’ve finished up here.

Name: Symon
Text: I’ll be waiting for you at the Taima Pioneer Village.

Name: Symon
Text: Hurry up and get over there!

Name: Jiranna
Text: Let’s go, go! You've been lectured enough!

Name: Jiranna
Text:
I’m watching you.
Walk straight, eyes forward!

Name: Jiranna
Text: Thanks for the help, human!

Name: Azid
Text: Hmph. My expedition, ruined... and it's all that human's fault.

Name: Bishan
Text: Good work, everyone. Seems everything was handled well over there.

Name: Bishan
Text:
Now we just have to wait our turn to depart.
If only they'd finish clearing out those bandits sooner...

Name: Urgent Shout
Text:
<Red>E, Emergency!</>
Everyone, evacuate to Babylon!

Name: Urgent Shout
Text: Bandits launched a surprise attack—

Name: Jiranna
Text: Ugly humans are coming up from below—up here!

Name: Urgent Shout
Text:
Captain Jehan, we’re severely outnumbered.
At this rate…!

Name: Jeihan
Text:
They are nothing but untrained rabble!
Do not let their numbers intimidate you! Follow your orders!

Name: Jeihan
Text: You have my thanks. You’ve done well.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
Thanks to you, we avoided a big disaster!
I’ll be sure to report your merits to the Manor.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: Captain! We’ve confirmed the identity of the bandits!

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text:
They bore the mark of the <Red>Shadow Wolves</>.
It seems they took advantage of the chaos caused by the Incursions.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
Their activity cycles are getting shorter.
I see. Prepare the official report for Babylon.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: Yes! Understood!

Name: Jeihan
Text: Your skills are exceptional.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
I’d like to invite you to join my unit,
but I suppose it would be overstepping to ask that of a free adventurer.

Name: Jeihan
Text: Instead, as thanks for your help... I’ll accommodate you as much as I can.

Name: Jeihan
Text: You’ve proven your worth. You are free to pass through here as you wish.

Name: Jeihan
Text: I hope you find the one you’re looking for.

Name: Jiranna
Text: Whoa, you’re a super strong human!

Name: Azid
Text: Even a Stiff-Furred Naruru like me could see that you’re strong. Hmph.

Name: Bishan
Text:
My merchants—and most everyone in this camp—are safe.
All thanks to you.

Name: Jiranna
Text: Since we taught the bad humans a lesson, we can pass through soon, right? Right?

Name: Jiranna
Text: Hey, are you heading off to find that human named Symon?

Name: Jiranna
Text:
Then that Taima! Taima Village!
It’s the closest human village from here.

Name: Jiranna
Text: Can you tell the Narurus over there to come here?

Name: Jiranna
Text: We promised to travel together once the way opened.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Right. Symon said he’d be waiting there.)</>

Name: Jiranna
Text: Thanks! I’ll help you out next time we meet! Really!

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: We meet again. Captain Jeihan has relayed the details.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: Thank you for your assistance.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: You may use this path whenever you wish, adventurer.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: We're still wary of any remnants. We need a bit more time.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text:
The Shadow Wolves are growing in number at an alarming rate.
Safety must come first, after all.

Name: Asientet Soldier
Text: Watch your back out there.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: Thought that was the end of me.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
Hey, you’re an adventurer, right?
One of those who can’t just walk past someone in a bind.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: Please, tell me I’m right.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
You’re heading for Taima Village, aren't you? 
That’s the only reason anyone takes this path.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
I’ll show you a safe route, so just clear these things out for me.
I can’t get any work done with them lurking around.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: I'll be digging this in the meantime.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
Ha! I knew I had an eye for talent.
I knew you looked like a seasoned warrior.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
In our village, everyone pitches in—building houses, gathering food.
No one idles around.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: Today was my turn to fetch resources.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
But they didn’t give me a single battle member.
Do they want me to die out here or what?

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: Anyway, thanks to you, I got everything I need.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
The stone from this area is top-quality. We use it for everything.
Now I just have to haul it all back to the village.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
Ah! Right, I promised to show you the way.
It’s a bit of a trek, so keep up.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
We’re about halfway there.
Let’s take a breather.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: Phew... I should’ve listened to <Orange>Kamiya</> when she told me to build some muscle.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: Yeah, the one who sent me out here alone.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
She’s kind of like the leader of Taima Pioneer Village.
She hates being called "Village Chief," though. Says she’s still too young for that.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: You have business in our village, right?

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
I’ll take you to Kamiya once we get there.
She knows just about everything.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
While I catch my breath, take a look at the view.
The waterfall from here is truly something.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(A small village is visible behind a massive stone wall.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Symon must be waiting for you there.)</>

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
Breathtaking, isn't it?
This view is the only reason I put up with these heavy stones.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: Well, shall we get moving again...?

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: One, two— urgh!

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(It looks like they collapsed while trying to lift the heavy sack.)</>

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: Ah! My back... my back!

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: Urgh... that sharp pain... That definitely tweaked something.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: The village is just a straight shot down this path.

Name: Kamiya
Text: What took you so long? It’s just a few stones.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
Thanks for the "warm" welcome! 
Luckily, I had this person carry them for me.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Oh, a visitor.

Name: Kamiya
Text: My apologies. This one here has the frailest constitution in the entire village.

Name: Troubled Resident
Text: I'm heading to the healer, so you handle the rest!

Name: Troubled Resident
Text:
Thanks for everything.
You can drop the stones there and go about your business.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Welcome. I am <Orange>Kamiya</>, leader of the Taima Pioneer Village.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
What brings you here?
You don’t look like the laborers sent from Babylon.

Name: Kamiya
Text: So, Master Aman told you to head west?

Name: Kamiya
Text:
You met who you were looking for, and agreed to meet again here, I assume.
Who would that be?

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Ah, Symon!
That chatterbox?

Name: Kamiya
Text:
He’s probably out on an errand I gave him.
I suppose he didn't expect you to arrive this soon.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
We take labor in exchange for lodging.
This village is still under heavy development, you see.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
That’s why we never turn away those who wish to stay.
We welcome any pair of hands!

Name: Kamiya
Text:
I sent him somewhere a bit far from the village...
Well, it's hard to explain the location.

Name: Kamiya
Text: I’ll go fetch him myself. Have a look around while you wait.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
The view from the higher ground is particularly grand.
Go up there if you can!

Name: Naruru Who Wants to Hide
Text: Yikes! You scared me! I thought <Orange>Tirashu</> had found me.

Name: Naruru Who Wants to Hide
Text:
Hey, human.
Go away! Go!

Name: Naruru Who Wants to Hide
Text: I have to pretend no one’s here!

Name: Naruru Who Wants to Hide
Text:
Ti-Tirashu is already coming up.
Don’t tell her I’m here! Okay? Got it?

Name: Tirashu
Text: Now where could he have gone...?

Name: Tirashu
Text:
Excuse me, have you seen a Naruru around here?
His name is <Orange>Enju</>.

Name: Tirashu
Text: Hmm... I’m sure I can catch his scent nearby.

Name: Tirashu
Text: Honestly! He and Azid are always causing trouble.

Name: Tirashu
Text: Oh? You and Azid know each other?

Name: Tirashu
Text: He went to the human town up there first.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You relay Jiranna’s message.)</>

Name: Tirashu
Text: Then we can finally head to the Giant’s Garden?!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
I’ve waited so, so long.
The water here tastes bad... and there’s nothing to eat…

Name: Tirashu
Text:
But I’m sure Jiranna had it much worse.
Having to deal with Azid... that Azid!

Name: Tirashu
Text: If you see any other Naruru, tell them Tirashu is looking for them.

Name: Tirashu
Text: Tell them to gather by the water up ahead.

Name: Enju
Text: Waaaaah! Tirashu’s gone, right? Right?

Name: Enju
Text:
Thanks for covering for me.
 I still want to play more, more, more!

Name: Enju
Text: The other <Orange>Stiff-Furs</> are probably off swimming somewhere anyway.

Name: Enju
Text: It’ll take forever for everyone to gather.

Name: Enju
Text:
But once we're all together, I’ll get to see Azid, right?
I’m going to go play with him again.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Explain that the sooner they gather, the sooner he can see Azid.)</>

Name: Enju
Text:
Then we have to get going. Now!
I’ll be the FIRST to go! The first!

Name: Tirashu
Text: If any Naruru are not here yet, speak up now!

Name: Naruru
Text: (Everyone is quiet.)

Name: Tirashu
Text: Good, it seems everyone is ready.

Name: Tirashu
Text: And you, Jiranna’s human friend!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
Thank you for sending Enju back to us so quietly.
If you didn’t, I would have spent hours searching.

Name: Enju
Text: I want to see Azid! Hurry!

Name: Tirashu
Text: One last thing—could you draw the attention of those scary creatures?

Name: Tirashu
Text:
It would hurt a lot if we were attacked right after crossing the water!
Just protect us until then.

Name: Enju
Text: I’m a Bristly-Hair too, but it’s hard to fight when my hair gets wet.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
We’re counting on you!
Until next time.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Found the man… what’s left of him, anyway.

Name: Kamiya
Text: You’ve heard the bandits are scouring this area, haven't you?

Name: Kamiya
Text: As if the Incursions were not trouble enough, the <Red>Shadow Wolf Clan</> showed up.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Think about it
—just how much of a hindrance would they be to Master Aman’s operations?

Name: Kamiya
Text:
I wanted to nip this in the bud, so I sent people out.
To track their movements.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Simon said gathering information was his specialty,
so I asked him to go with one of my men.

Name: Kamiya
Text: But Simon is missing, and the other one…

Name: Kamiya
Text: I need to recover the body… while it’s still in one piece.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
You can handle yourself, right?
We’re leaving now.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
The cuts are too clean.
This was not the work of a beast.

Name: Kamiya
Text: At first, I thought it was the Shadow Wolf Clan…

Name: Kamiya
Text: Take a closer look.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Do you see what I mean?

Name: Kamiya
Text: Losing comrades is something we’re always braced for in the Forsaken Land, but…

Name: Kamiya
Text:
We didn’t do anything that would make us a target.
At least, not this man.

Name: Kamiya
Text: I thought being able to hide from these beasts would be enough.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
…My judgment was flawed.
Especially with the Incursions breaking out everywhere.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Fortunately, there’s only one body, so there’s still hope.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
You should go. Find <Orange>Simon</>.
If luck is on our side, he’s still laying low somewhere.

Name: Unfamiliar Voice
Text: We came up empty at Magobi Encampment, but at least the security here has thinned out.

Name: Another Voice
Text:
The boss was fuming.
Do you have any idea how badly we got chewed out?

Name: Unfamiliar Voice
Text:
<red>This time, West Babylon will be ours.
If we fail, our heads will roll! Got it?</>

Name: Unfamiliar Voice
Text: Wait… what is this smell?

Name: Unfamiliar Voice
Text:
Did one of you dump a corpse out in the open again?
I thought I told you to keep it quiet.

Name: Another Voice
Text: Heh-heh. So green, leaving a trail like this.

Name: Another Voice
Text:
Now, now… let’s see just how badly this one was butchered.
Reeking of blood like this.

Name: Another Voice
Text:
Everyone, up!
Come and see who got carved up so beautifully—

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Better to strike now than be found out. Now!)</>

Name: Unfamiliar Voice
Text: Intruder! Seize the intruder!

Name: Unfamiliar Voice
Text: Heh… look at that dazed face of yours…

Name: Unfamiliar Voice
Text:
Can’t believe your own eyes?
It’s the Wolves’ new weapon…

Name: Unfamiliar Voice
Text: Now, no one can stop us! Kahahaha!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This one’s not breathing.)</>

Name: Kamiya
Text: I heard commotion. What happened?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Explain what just transpired.)</>

Name: Kamiya
Text:
That’s… that’s impossible.
An Incursion triggered without any precursor event?

Name: Kamiya
Text: And what is this <Blue>Tesseract</>?

Name: Kamiya
Text:
How can a human have the power to trigger an Incursion…?
Hah, it’s absurd.

Name: Kamiya
Text: …This is beyond something we can handle on our own.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Given the circumstances, Simon was likely taken by the Wolves.
If he’d met the assassin, there would’ve been two bodies.

Name: Kamiya
Text: I mean, he must be still alive.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Your goal was to meet Simon, wasn't it? Then keep looking!

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Go to Babylon immediately.
Tell Master Aman exactly what you told me.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Babylon will surely dispatch soldiers then.
There’s our chance.

Name: Kamiya
Text: It’ll be easier for you to move once the Wolves are spread thin.

Name: Aman
Text: Wait, aren’t you the one Rada brought in?

Name: Aman
Text: You seem to have an urgent message. What’s happened?

Name: Aman
Text:
…This is grave.
The Shadow Wolf Clan can no longer be dismissed as mere outlaws.

Name: Aman
Text:
I shall call for an emergency meeting with the Divines in Babylon.
Join us at the meeting to give your testimony.

Name: Aman
Text: ...That is the message from Taima.

Name: Rada
Text: This is serious.

Name: Rada
Text: So, you're saying those Incursions without precursor eents were the work of the Wolves?

Name: Aman
Text: We shouldn’t jump to conclusions, but it seems highly likely.

Name: Beretta
Text: The geometric cores found in Incursion areas are called Tesseracts.

Name: Beretta
Text:
But those are too big to carry by hand.
What he used might be a <Blue>replica</>.

Name: Rada
Text:
Hmm, this is getting complicated...
Shall we call it an <Red>Artificial Incursion</>?

Name: Rada
Text: It’ll be less confusing if we distinguish one from the other.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Well, sounds like a plan.
If it's an "Artificial Incursion," we'll know to head out immediately.

Name: Khoon
Text:
So, what’s the move?
For a start, we need to put together a separate search party.

Name: Ragnar
Text: We cannot just stand by and watch this happen.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Many lives have been lost to Incursions already.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
To exploit such a tragedy for their own gain...
regardless of their goal, it is an unforgivable sin.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Summon all forces for immediate deployment.

Name: Ragnar
Text: <Yellow>The total annihilation of the Shadow Wolf Clan and the safe destruction of the recovered Tesseracts.</>

Name: Ragnar
Text: These shall be our primary objectives.

Name: Azran
Text: I will hunt for their hideout.

Name: Azran
Text: They decided to crawl out of their holes, and I’ll make sure to starve them out.

Name: Azran
Text: Every last one of them.

Name: Khoon
Text:
No complaints here.
A task like that is perfect for someone who’s light on their feet, like <Orange>Azran</>.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Then I’ll look into the replica.
It’s a dangerous device that triggers disasters at will.

Name: Rada
Text: I'll put my trust in Azran!

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Then let us prepare for the operation.
We start from Magobi Encampment and expand our search radius.

Name: Ragnar
Text: A word with you, if you will.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
You mentioned that one of the two informants is dead.
And there is still no word from the other?

Name: Ragnar
Text:
It’s likely he’s been detained by the Shadow Wolf Clan.
These scums have no qualms about trafficking humans.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
If you intend to track the Wolves to find him,
I would like you to go with Azran.

Name: Ragnar
Text: In a nutshell, Azran shares a bitter history with them.

Name: Ragnar
Text: I simply ask that you support him, so he does not overextend himself.

Name: Ragnar
Text: You have my gratitude. We shall speak again once the task is done.

Name: Azran
Text: You’re the Adventurer I saw you with the Merchants Guild Master.

Name: Azran
Text: Are you here for me? What is it?

Name: Azran
Text: …Ragnar and his needless meddling, no doubt.

Name: Azran
Text:
I intend to <Red>exterminate</> the Wolves.
If you do not share my goal, stay out of my way and go back.

Name: Azran
Text:
That, I can accept.
Just don’t slow me down.

Name: Azran
Text:
Their primary territory spans the entire western Barrens.
But they wouldn’t have a base that close to Babylon.

Name: Azran
Text: Which means they’re crossing over from the Giant’s Garden.

Name: Azran
Text:
Their lair must be there.
It connects to the great mountain range here.

Name: Azran
Text: However, that is Naruru territory. Gathering information won’t be easy.

Name: Azran
Text: Who? Lead the way, then.

Name: Jiranna
Text: You again! Human, kind human!

Name: Jiranna
Text:
All the Jabar merchants are here now, thanks to you.
Those troublemakers are on a short leash, too!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Azid and Enju seem to having an interesting conversation.)</>

Name: Jiranna
Text:
We’re heading back to Aburu Village soon.
The human captain said he’d clear the path for a bit.

Name: Jiranna
Text: Sure! I’ll do anything I can.

Name: Azran
Text: Have you heard of the Shadow Wolf Clan?

Name: Jiranna
Text: Shadow what? You mean wolves that go “Awooo!”?

Name: Azran
Text: No. I’m talking about bandits who pillage and destroy everything in their path.

Name: Jiranna
Text: Pil-lage? Des-troy?

Name: Azran
Text: I mean, they hurt people. They even kill...

Name: Azran
Text: ...Wait, hold on.

Name: Azran
Text: This should be enough to recognize.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Azran hands over a drawing with a look of resignation.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It resembles... something human. Roughly.)</>

Name: Azran
Text: Have you seen anyone who looks like this?

Name: Jiranna
Text:
Is that... a drawing of a human?
But humans all look the same to me! The same!

Name: Jiranna
Text: Oh! But I did hear that many humans are wandering around! So I did!

Name: Azran
Text: In <Blue>Giant's Garden</>?

Name: Jiranna
Text: Usually, when we trade with humans, we go to them.

Name: Jiranna
Text:
But lately, many, many humans have been coming.
Don't know why, though.

Name: Azran
Text:
They could be the Shadow Wolves.
I must head there and see for myself.

Name: Jiranna
Text:
We can go together!
We know the way, so you won't get lost!

Name: Azran
Text: Very well. I accept your offer.

Name: Jiranna
Text: Great! Let’s go, go!

Name: Jiranna
Text: We’re here already! Let's rest!

Name: Jiranna
Text: Okay. Now, just go straight up this way... and we’re there! Let’s go!

Name: Jiranna
Text:
Wait, who are you humans?
This is <Yellow>Naruru land! Naruru land!</>

Name: Asientet Merchant
Text: Ah, we are traders from Asientet.

Name: Jiranna
Text:
What? Liars!
The road from there just opened up, not before!

Name: Chattering Merchant
Text: We were stuck because of those Shadow Wolves. We barely made it back!

Name: Asientet Merchant
Text: ...Of course, we used it as an opening to move.

Name: Chattering Merchant
Text:
I heard those puppets are running wild!
Wasn't it just a nightmare to deal with?

Name: Chattering Merchant
Text: I was so worried our trade would be cut off! Hahaha!

Name: Jiranna
Text: But we were the fastest! There was no one in front of us!

Name: Asientet Merchant
Text: Ahem. Our Reppies must have been sturdier, I suppose.

Name: Asientet Merchant
Text: We... we have no time to lose. Let’s move, quickly.

Name: Chattering Merchant
Text: Good luck to you all!

Name: Jiranna
Text: Ugh, those humans are gone so fast!

Name: Jiranna
Text:
I am gonna report them to the <Orange>Angry Tail</>.
They’ll be caught in no time!

Name: Azran
Text: Is Aburu Village this way?

Name: Jiranna
Text: Yep! You said you had questions, right?

Name: Jiranna
Text:
<Orange>Sturdy Whiskers</> is very smart!
He’ll have all the answers for sure.

Name: Azran
Text:
[player], leave those men be.
The Shadow Wolves are our priority.

Name: Azran
Text:
…Sturdy Whiskers? 
A chieftain, maybe?

Name: Azran
Text: We must find him at once.

Name: Azran
Text: You’re late.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You’re too early... But better keep that to myself.)</>

Name: Azran
Text: It seems he is out.

Name: Azran
Text: All I know is that the Naruru chieftain lives in the largest structure.

Name: Azran
Text:
And this place at the center of the village fits the description.
We’ll need to ask around.

Name: Azran
Text:
Let’s split up for a moment.
Use the communicator as soon as you find him.

Name: Chilled Naruru
Text: You looking for <Orange>Sturdy Whiskers</>?

Name: Chilled Naruru
Text:
Yawn... I was just taking a nap.
So I didn't see where he went...

Name: Chilled Naruru
Text: But when he’s not in the village, he’s usually over there.

Name: Naruru by the Boat
Text: Heave-ho! A good catch today!

Name: Naruru by the Boat
Text:
Whoa. A human stranger.
Want some fish? The are fresh!

Name: Naruru by the Boat
Text:
He went to the end of the waterway.
So, are you here to see him?

Name: Naruru by the Boat
Text: He went to pray to the Goddess Ea. No one should bother him.

Name: Naruru by the Boat
Text:
He’s been in a bad mood these days, anyway.
So don't disturb him. Just wait, okay?

Name: Azran
Text: Is that the one?

Name: Azran
Text:
He is staring into the distance.
Is he lost in thought?

Name: Azran
Text: I expected him to be fishing or something.

Name: Azran
Text: The Naruru have a religion?

Name: Azran
Text:
That’s unexpected.
If it is their ritual, we must respect it.

Name: Etura
Text:
How dare you startle <Orange>Etura the Sturdy Whiskers</>!
What is a human doing here, human?

Name: Etura
Text:
I don’t have a meeting with a human caravan today.
Leave our village! Leave!

Name: Azran
Text:
We’ve come to ask for your cooperation.
We don’t want to cause trouble.

Name: Azran
Text: I was told you are the most knowledgeable Naruru in the Giant’s Garden.

Name: Azran
Text: We are tracking a band of thieves... I mean, wicked humans.

Name: Etura
Text:
No! You’ll just go around digging up everywhere!
That will only bring more trouble to the Naruru. Yes, it will.

Name: Azran
Text: What do you mean?

Name: Etura
