Text: The little pups haven't returned to the village for days.

Name: Etura
Text:
I don't know where they are or what they’re doing,
But finding the little pups comes first! First!

Name: Etura
Text: If a fight breaks out with the ones you’re looking for...

Name: Etura
Text: the little ones will get scared and hide, or worse, get hurt in the fray!

Name: Etura
Text:
So you stay still. Stay still!
Then will I tell you about the wicked humans.

Name: Azran
Text: ...Little pups?

Name: Azran
Text: We have little time, but even less options.

Name: Azran
Text: Better to follow his lead than to search this vast land on our own.

Name: Azran
Text: ...Very well, Etura. We will do as you say.

Name: Etura
Text: <Yellow>Sturdy Whiskers! It’s Sturdy Whiskers Etura!</>

Name: Azran
Text:
...Fine. Sturdy Whiskers. We will help find your... little pups.
You keep your word after that.

Name: Etura
Text:
I will, human!
We always keep our words!

Name: Etura
Text:
There are Naruru in the village who went looking for the little pups.
Go speak with them!

Name: Azran
Text: [Player], let’s move.

Name: Worried Naruru
Text:
They were such brave little pups, always wandering about.
They used to play at the Sunrise Slope all the time.

Name: Worried Naruru
Text: But they’ve never been gone this long... I’m worried.

Name: Suspicious Naruru
Text:
Suddenly, so many humans appeared!
I remember the little pups being very curious about them.

Name: Suspicious Naruru
Text: Once, I caught some of them following around a human wearing a long, hooded robe.

Name: Suspicious Naruru
Text: He was playing with them in the water, sharing foods with them...

Name: Suspicious Naruru
Text:
But I still had <Red>a bad feeling about that, A bad feeling</>.
I couldn't see his face. Very suspicious.

Name: Azran
Text: It’s hard to recognize under the shadow, but look closely.

Name: Azran
Text:
The grass has been trampled.
And the soil is gouged, as if something pressed down hard.

Name: Azran
Text: These aren't just footprints.

Name: Azran
Text:
Someone was struggling here.
Human or Naruru.

Name: Azran
Text:
Then was it the work of those men we saw at the village?
They didn't look like the Shadow Wolves at all...

Name: Azran
Text: If that charade earlier was a cover for another crime—

Name: Azran
Text: Let’s follow the tracks. Move.

Name: Snickering Voice
Text:
Why is the boss doing what they say?
What use is catching a bunch of otters?

Name: Wheezing Voice
Text:
He must have his reasons.
Besides, we’re having fun here, aren't we? Heheh.

Name: Azran
Text: It’s certain. The Shadow Wolves.

Name: Azran
Text: We strike before they notice us.

Name: Etura
Text:
Back already?
Where are our little pups?

Name: Azran
Text: …The little pups didn't go out to play. They’ve been taken by the Shadow Wolves.

Name: Azran
Text:
By the wicked humans this adventurer and I were tracking.
They’re called the Shadow Wolves.

Name: Etura
Text: <Red>The, the little pups were taken by humans? Taken?</>

Name: Azran
Text: We’re going after those wicked humans now.

Name: Azran
Text:
I will keep my word.
We’ll save the little pups first, then deal with the others.

Name: Etura
Text:
Thank you, human.
We have things to prepare, too. So wait, just wait!

Name: Etura
Text: Our Angry Tail is coming with you!

Name: Etura
Text: The Angry Tail will punish the humans who bullied our little pups!

Name: Azran
Text: Fine. ...Follow us with the Angry Tail.

Name: Etura
Text: Thank you!

Name: Azran
Text:
They know we’ve been tailing them.
They’ve posted guards.

Name: Etura
Text: If we deal with those humans, we find the little pups, right?

Name: Azran
Text:
Given their formation, they must be guarding something.
We’ve come to the right place.

Name: Azran
Text:
Etura.
Once their numbers are thinned out, we’ll move inside.

Name: Azran
Text: That would be faster than all of us going in together. Don't worry.

Name: Azran
Text:
Just make sure none of them get past you.
That is all.

Name: Etura
Text: I understand, I understand! Bring the little pups back, human!

Name: Azran
Text: ...Let’s go.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(There’s nothing here... Let’s look somewhere else.)</>

Name: Azran
Text:
The Naruru are with Etura now.
We should move together from here.

Name: Azran
Text: <Red>Kidnapping, murder, arson, human trafficking...</>

Name: Azran
Text:
Crimes of the Shadow Wolf Clan are almost too numerous to count.
They're the most despicable group of scums in the Forsaken Land.

Name: Azran
Text:
Interrogations are unnecessary.
They've been marked for summary execution, anyway.

Name: Azran
Text:
Besides, this bastard's face...
I haven't forgotten it, not even for a moment.

Name: Azran
Text: ...So this is how revenge feels. How hollow.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Azran's expression is fraught with mixed emotions.)</>

Name: Azran
Text: I was lost in thought. Pretend you didn't see that.

Name: Azran
Text: Let's just gather whatever evidence we can to track the remnants and get out of here.

Name: Azran
Text: This wax seal... It bears the mark of the <Orange>'Paradise Advent Society'</>.

Name: Azran
Text: Why would the leader of the Wolves have a letter from them?

Name: Azran
Text: There shouldn't be any connection between the two.

Name: Azran
Text:
Wait a moment. 
Let me read it.
ItemDesc: [Return to the garden. Supply has been secured.]

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Azran's eyes darted sharply across the letter.)</>

Name: Azran
Text:
Return to the garden.
Supply has been secured...?

Name: Azran
Text: Just a single sentence. I suspect it's some sort of directive...

Name: Azran
Text: It makes even less sense that the sender is the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Azran
Text: They're an organization that provides relief aid all across the Forsaken Land.

Name: Azran
Text:
A paradise where everyone can live in happiness.
It is their doctrine to turn the entire world into such a paradise.

Name: Azran
Text: That's why they go around spreading good deeds.

Name: Azran
Text: I've heard they provide significant aid to Realms hit by the <Red>'Incursion'</>.

Name: Azran
Text: ...Saying it out loud only makes it more baffling.

Name: Azran
Text:
Let's get out of here first.
The Naruru tribe is waiting for us.

Name: Lamasu
Text:
Four... Five... Six!
Everyone is out! Every last one of them!

Name: Lamasu
Text:
All thanks to you.
The children are safe, and hardly any of the Naruru are injured!

Name: Lamasu
Text:
Once we finish treating everyone, we'll head back to the village, the village!
Wait just a moment!

Name: Azran
Text: There aren't any stragglers, are there?

Name: Azran
Text:
We can wrap things up here.
All that's left now is tracking down the remnants.

Name: Azran
Text: The fact that the Paradise Advent Society appears to be backing the Wolves is troubling...

Name: Azran
Text: But we shouldn't jump to any conclusions just yet.

Name: Azran
Text: What kind of shared interest could these two groups possibly have?

Name: Azran
Text:
One is a light that shines on the weak,
while the other feeds on the shadows, just as its name implies.

Name: Azran
Text: But your suspicions are justified.

Name: Azran
Text: The Wolf Clan's other crimes might be tied to them as well.

Name: Azran
Text:
It's best we leave all possibilities open.
I'll head back and begin a follow-up investigation.

Name: Azran
Text:
Since we promised the Naruru tribe their safety,
escort them back to the village.

Name: Etura
Text:
Finally, all the Naruru are gathered.
Now we can hold a festival! A festival!

Name: Etura
Text: <Blue>God Ea</> always watches over the Naruru.

Name: Etura
Text:
So we send our gratitude upward!
I’m sure it will be joyfully received.

Name: Etura
Text: We prepare a grand feast and offer our prayers.

Name: Etura
Text: The prayer is the most, most important part!

Name: Etura
Text: You there, human adventurer.

Name: Etura
Text:
You helped us, so stay and enjoy the festival.
There are so many savory treats!

Name: Lutga
Text: Um-hoo-hoo, um-hoo! Time to show off my skills.

Name: Lutga
Text:
Dough and fish!
With just these two, I can make the best flavor.

Name: Lutga
Text: Dough mixed with the Naruru’s favorite chopped leaves!

Name: Lutga
Text: Just the smell of it will make your mouth water!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Naruru pours the dough into a round bowl and spreads it evenly.)</>

Name: Lutga
Text: Then, we stick in some bite-sized fish...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Strange-looking fish heads are now poking out of the dough!)</>
ItemDesc: A peculiar pie with several fish heads peeking through the crust.

Name: Lutga
Text: Now, we bake it over the fire like this!

Name: Lutga
Text: Ho-ho-hong! A delicious fish pie will be ready soon.

Name: Lutga
Text:
You’re excited, aren't you? Right? 
You can come have a taste when it’s done!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Th-That is not food.)</>

Name: Urkai
Text: I prepared something for the little ones.

Name: Urkai
Text: They must have been so scared, oh, poor things.

Name: Urkai
Text: I must add plenty of ingredients to boost their spirits, plenty!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I hope it’s not another strange dish.)</>

Name: Urkai
Text: I hope this gives them strength, strength!

Name: Urkai
Text: How is it? Like it?

Name: Urkai
Text: I caught the main ingredient myself.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The bowl is filled with finely ground green powder.)</>
ItemDesc:
A fine frying powder made from ground seaweed. 
A favorite specialty ingredient among Naruru chefs.

Name: Urkai
Text: Coat the fish front and back, fry it until it’s crisp, and ta-da!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...I just imagined a fish covered in green batter.)</>

Name: Urkai
Text: This will be a masterpiece that’s good for the health, too! Hah!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You should just clap and run away.)</>

Name: Rada
Text: The air is filled with such savory scents!

Name: Rada
Text: Azran, really. He forgot the most important part.

Name: Rada
Text: A Naruru festival is an event you simply cannot miss!

Name: Rada
Text:
Now, let me see...
You don’t seem to have any major injuries!

Name: Rada
Text: I was going to find you the moment I arrived, but then I heard a festival was starting.

Name: Rada
Text:
I got so caught up looking around that I completely forgot about you.
Is the business with the Shadow Wolves all settled?

Name: Rada
Text: Yeah. It seems he felt bad leaving you behind in a hurry.

Name: Rada
Text: He looks cold, but he’s actually quite the worrier.

Name: Rada
Text: He asked me to check on you, just in case you were hurt.

Name: Rada
Text:
But you are fine, right?
Maybe we should just enjoy the festival before heading back. Heheh.

Name: Rada
Text: A little help for the Naruru, and those hot meals will be ready in no time!

Name: Rada
Text: Mmm—I can't wait!

Name: Isimu
Text:
Humans!
Please, please help me!

Name: Rada
Text: Huh? What’s wrong?

Name: Isimu
Text:
The festival... at this rate...
The festival won't happen because of me!

Name: Rada
Text: Calm down and tell us what happened. We’ll help.

Name: Isimu
Text: I... I was supposed to bring the offering...

Name: Rada
Text: An offering?

Name: Isimu
Text: It’s a precious thing the god Ea made for us...

Name: Isimu
Text: We must, MUST have it for the last part of the festival!

Name: Isimu
Text: So, I took the offering from the deep waters and...

Name: Isimu
Text: When I came ashore, there were so, so many <Red>Kuduru</> there.

Name: Isimu
Text:
I got scared and just ran, ran away.
And I dropped the offering...

Name: Isimu
Text:
The others will be so disappointed if I tell them.
But without the offering, the festival, the festival...!

Name: Rada
Text:
It’s okay!
At least you made it back to the village in one piece, right?

Name: Rada
Text: We’ll help you, so just stay here and rest.

Name: Isimu
Text: What if the Kuduru already took it?

Name: Rada
Text: Then we’ll make them give it back at all costs, so don’t worry.

Name: Rada
Text:
Just tell us where you ran into them.
We’ll go check it out.

Name: Rada
Text: This is the spot on the map...

Name: Rada
Text:
It’s quite far from Aburu Village. 
The Kuduru might be active around here.

Name: Rada
Text: I don’t see them yet, so let’s look for the offering first.

Name: Rada
Text: The Kuduru must have taken it.

Name: Rada
Text: I heard they’re always trying to snatch things from the Naruru.

Name: Rada
Text: Besides, they said the offering was a <Yellow>“very expensive-looking statue,”</> right?

Name: Rada
Text:
They might try to sell it for a fortune
or use it to threaten the Naruru."

Name: Rada
Text:
Let’s find the Kuduru nearby.
They couldn't have gone far.

Name: Rada
Text: Found... it?!

Name: Rada
Text: They did say it would look very expensive. Right?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You pick up a statue that looks exactly like a Naruru.)</>
ItemDesc:
A “very expensive-looking statue” intended as an offering.
Though it bears a striking resemblance to the Naruru.

Name: Rada
Text: Well, it’s a statue, all right.

Name: Rada
Text: But isn't it way too cute to be a sacred offering?!

Name: Rada
Text:
Hmm, there must be a deep meaning to it.
It is a gift from the god Ea, after all.

Name: Rada
Text: Some profound... divine revelation that we just don't get...

Name: Rada
Text:
Let’s just take it for now.
Even if this isn't it, we can always look again!

Name: Isimu
Text:
Th-th-this is it!!
From head to toe... it looks just like us!

Name: Rada
Text: Are you sure this is the right statue?

Name: Isimu
Text:
Such perfect curves...
Only God Ea could shape something so flawless!

Name: Rada
Text: Well, I suppose Naruru are quite round and smooth.

Name: Isimu
Text:
Thank you so, so much!
Now we can finally hold the ritual, the ritual!

Name: Rada
Text:
But… if we hadn’t helped…
…were you going to go alone?

Name: Rada
Text:
There were quite a lot of Kuduru out there.
You could have asked the Stiff-Furred Naruru to go with you.

Name: Isimu
Text: I didn't know they would be wandering this close...

Name: Isimu
Text:
Their territory is usually... further up...
I thought I could make it back quick, quickly...

Name: Rada
Text:
Still, someone could get hurt.
You should tell the others the truth.

Name: Rada
Text:
Oh, are you scared of what the other Narurus might say?
We can tell them for you if that helps!

Name: Isimu
Text: ...No, I-I’ll do it.

Name: Isimu
Text: I'm scared they’ll be disappointed, disappointed in me...

Name: Isimu
Text: But everyone’s safety is the most important thing!

Name: Isimu
Text: I’ll go and tell Etura myself... Yes, I’ll!

Name: Rada
Text: That’s the spirit!

Name: Rada
Text: Besides, the “Stiff-Furred” Naruru are pretty terrifying, aren't they?

Name: Rada
Text: The Kuduru won't stand a chance. Don't you worry.

Name: Isimu
Text: Yeah. You're right!

Name: Rada
Text:
Great! The urgent problem’s solved, right?
Now, let’s go enjoy the festival!

Name: Rada
Text: Phew—I’m stuffed! I really loved the Naruru food.

Name: Rada
Text: I hope the Naruru can keep living in peace like this.

Name: Rada
Text: Then they’ll hold another festival, right?

Name: Rada
Text: Since the Stiff-Furred Naruru remain undiminished, they'll be just fine for a while. Heheh!

Name: Rada
Text:
Think of them as the village watch.
The Naruru who are good at fighting are called the <Orange>Stiff-Furred Naruru</>.

Name: Rada
Text:
Anyway, I can still taste that fish pie!
I could eat it every single day!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You recall those fish heads sticking out...)</>

Name: Rada
Text: They say if you don’t like the festival food, God Ea will punish you severely.

Name: Rada
Text: That’s why the Naruru chefs always prepare their finest masterpieces.

Name: Rada
Text:
It’s just an old legend, but isn't it fun?
My homeland, <Blue>Enkia</>, has a few stories like that, too.

Name: Rada
Text: Like how our ancestors were an ancient race called the “Lagar.”

Name: Rada
Text: Or that beings from beyond this world live among humans.

Name: Rada
Text: There’s no proof at all, so few scholars even bother to study it.

Name: Rada
Text: But still—it’s pretty fun to imagine, isn’t it?

Name: Rada
Text:
Mmm! It’s about time I head back.
I’ve confirmed you’re safe, and I’ve got plenty of my own work to do.

Name: Rada
Text: Call me whenever you need help!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The Naruru probably know this area well.
You should ask the Chieftain about the Paradise Advent Society.)</>

Name: Etura
Text: You’re the savior, savior of the village! You’ve seen the festival, haven’t you?

Name: Etura
Text:
I heard from Isimu!
You found the offering, didn't you?

Name: Etura
Text: If we’d lost them to the Kuduru, God Ea would have been furious!

Name: Etura
Text: <Yellow>You’re the human who helped us twice—the savior of Aburu Village!</>

Name: Etura
Text: The Naruru wish to repay, repay you, too!

Name: Etura
Text: I’ll help with anything!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You ask about the Paradise Advent Society
in words the Naruru can understand.)</>

Name: Etura
Text: Hmm... I’ve seen humans wandering around with that name.

Name: Etura
Text: They were helping other humans and telling stories.

Name: Etura
Text: And they often show up where things go boom! Boom!

Name: Etura
Text: Humans call those Incursions...

Name: Etura
Text: Oh! I’ve also heard someone called the Incursion Specialist! I did!

Name: Etura
Text: Heard things get quiet real fast whenever that human shows up…

Name: Etura
Text:
Incursion Specialist and the Paradise-something, was it?
Both are in the Giant's Garden. They are.

Name: Etura
Text:
Go to the “Cactus Nest” just up ahead. Go.
Many monsters appeared there because of the Incursions.

Name: Etura
Text:
Many Stiff-Furred Narurus are there now.
They must have seen the Paradise humans!

Name: Monas
Text:
Phew…
That was a close one!

Name: Monas
Text:
I’m an ecologist with the Bardad Expedition.
I was out here studying the local wildlife.

Name: Monas
Text: Because true research begins with seeing, hearing, and feeling things firsthand!

Name: Monas
Text:
I approached them to get a specimen.
But those creatures far more violent than I expected!

Name: Monas
Text: No one would have known if I’d died right then and there... *sob*

Name: Monas
Text: How could it be so hard to make a living?

Name: Monas
Text: So, I was wondering... Could you spare a moment of your time?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I need to find Xeros or the Paradise Advent quickly.
What should I do?)</>

Name: Monas
Text:
It won’t be a loss for you!
Oh, right, isn't your destination just beyond here anyway?

Name: Monas
Text:
You look like you’re heading to the Cactus Nest... 
But that place is a restricted outpost. Not just anyone can walk in.

Name: Monas
Text:
Incursions happen so often there that the guard is incredibly tight.
They’ll chase away any stranger on sight!

Name: Monas
Text: But! If I vouch for you, there will be no problem AT ALL.

Name: Monas
Text:
The Naruru there are a bit prickly,
but they surprisingly have a soft spot. It’ll work, trust me.

Name: Monas
Text: Not a bad deal, right?

Name: Monas
Text:
Then I’ll be waiting right here.
Stay safe out there!

Name: Monas
Text:
You’ve brought plenty!
The specimen are in perfect condition… Marvelous!

Name: Monas
Text: Now, now, you look busy. Let's get moving!

Name: Karadu
Text: Halt! I said halt!

Name: Monas
Text: Ah, working hard as always, my friend! Let us through!

Name: Karadu
Text: ...Who is this human? No unfamiliar faces allowed.

Name: Monas
Text: Of course, of course!

Name: Monas
Text:
The rules made by Naruru and humans for our safety!
I was there when they were written, wasn't I?

Name: Monas
Text: But! This is not just a stranger.

Name: Monas
Text:
It’s a kind soul who couldn’t just pass by someone in distress!
Look at this face—warmth tempered by strength!

Name: Karadu
Text: ...Hmm.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You’re impressed by his gift of gab.)</>

Name: Monas
Text: If this person causes any trouble, you can kick me out as well.

Name: Karadu
Text:
You’d better keep that promise.
I’m only letting you two in because of the Bardad humans, you got that!

Name: Monas
Text: Haha, we’re in now!

Name: Monas
Text: Since you’re here for information, you should meet <Orange>“Vahista”</>.

Name: Monas
Text: The Squad Leader knows everything that goes on around here.

Name: Vahista
Text: Oh, so the Naruru actually let you in?

Name: Vahista
Text:
I’m <Orange>Vahista</> dispatched here.
I’m the Squad Leader of the Bardad Expedition.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Oh! Not that I’m interested in learning who you are.
No need to answer.

Name: Vahista
Text: That’s not the kind of information I’m after.

Name: Vahista
Text: The Bardad Expedition is a group of renowned experts.

Name: Vahista
Text: But look at them. They’ve completely given up on exploring.

Name: Vahista
Text:
This place was built as a temporary camp of our expedition,
but now it doubles as a shelter.

Name: Vahista
Text:
My crew and the Naruru are standing guard together,
but there’s a mountain of work besides the Incursions.

Name: Vahista
Text: I’m sorry, but whatever brought you here, we’re in no position to help.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Then how about lending us a hand?
Honestly, we’re desperate—even a cat’s paw would help.

Name: Vahista
Text: Let’s trade favors. What do you say?

Name: Vahista
Text:
The monsters are the biggest headache.
Usually, we can handle them ourselves.

Name: Vahista
Text: But lately, they’ve become far too violent.

Name: Vahista
Text: My crew aren't seasoned adventurers. They’re no match for these things.

Name: Vahista
Text: Could you clear out the back of the nest?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The monster spat something out as it died. Is this some kind of ore?)</>
ItemDesc:
An ore of an unknown form.
It gives off a dangerous vibe, even to a non-expert's eyes.

Name: Vahista
Text: Phew, now we can finally head out to collect some plants. Thanks.

Name: Vahista
Text: Nothing unusual out there?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It seems that Vahista’s eyes widen in disbelief as she looks at the ore you brought.)</>

Name: Vahista
Text: So... you’re saying the monsters swallowed this?
ItemDesc:
This ore even startles Vahista, and he’s a brilliant researcher of the Bardad Expedition.
This is no ordinary stone.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Good thing I recognized it at a glance.
This is <Blue>Etherium</>!

Name: Vahista
Text:
It’s a rare ore…
But to animals, it’s just a rock. Why would they eat it?

Name: Vahista
Text: Unless... someone lured them into eating it.

Name: Vahista
Text: The link between Etherium and monster aggression—requires research.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Anyway, they probably swallowed it because it stood out.
We need to recover every last bit.

Name: Vahista
Text: I’ll send a few of my crew to help, so make sure you scrape up the rest.

Name: Karadu
Text: Sick humans. Over there. There.

Name: Karadu
Text: They ate something strange, then started screaming.

Name: Karadu
Text: They fought one another. Must be very sick humans.

Name: Karadu
Text:
To a Naruru, that's being sick.
Maybe you humans think differently?

Name: Karadu
Text: Not, Not that I trust you or anything!

Name: Karadu
Text:
But God Ea gets angry if we don't help the sick.
That’s the only reason I’m telling you. So let’s go!

Name: Vahista
Text: What happened here? Did you kill them all?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You wave your hand and explain that those people consumed Etherium.)</>

Name: Vahista
Text:
Haha! Relax.
I can tell you only knocked them out to stop the attack.

Name: Monas
Text:
Hmm... It looks like symptoms of poisoning.
There have been studies on plants with similar traits…

Name: Vahista
Text: So, consuming <Blue>Etherium</> drives them into a frenzy?

Name: Vahista
Text:
Hmm... I do have a few theories that come to mind.
Regardless, we need to handle these fallen people first.

Name: Karadu
Text:
These humans.
I’ve seen them on patrol, patrol.

Name: Karadu
Text: They called themselves wolves and pestered us. So we chased them off.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Are they the Shadow Wolves from outside the hideout?)</>

Name: Vahista
Text:
Let’s get them back for treatment.
We need them awake to get any answers.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Wait, they’re in worse shape than expected.
Their breathing is too unstable. At this rate...

Name: Expedition Member
Text: <Red>Squad Leader! Incursion! An Incursion broke out!</>

Name: Vahista
Text: What? Incursion?!

Name: Karadu
Text: You... did very well, human. Very well.

Name: Karadu
Text: Monsters coming out of nowhere... Narurus don’t understand.

Name: Karadu
Text:
I know humans have a name for it, but…
It’s complicated. Too complicated.

Name: Karadu
Text: Maybe the Kuduru did it, or wicked humans did.

Name: Karadu
Text: So, I had no choice but be wary of a stranger like you.

Name: Karadu
Text:
They always pester us and steal God Ea’s gifts.
The worst of the worst!

Name: Karadu
Text: And lately, they appear everywhere, everywhere!

Name: Karadu
Text: I ran from Aburu to the Rappie Ranch just to chase them.

Name: Karadu
Text: Phew... But Vahista, she told me to rest here at the nest.

Name: Karadu
Text:
In return, we fight together.
The Stiff-Furreds are very strong!

Name: Karadu
Text:
Humans in the nest are kind.
Since you helped, you are not a wicked human after—

Name: Animal Whimpering
Text: <Yellow>Kee-eeek! Kee-eek!</>

Name: Karadu
Text:
Wait... That’s a Rappie crying.
Let’s go! Fast!

Name: Karadu
Text: Quiet! Keep crying, and scary beasts will go after you!

Name: Rappie
Text: <Yellow>Kee-eee...</>

Name: Karadu
Text:
I know this Rappie. It’s from the ranch.
But I have no idea how it ended up down here.

Name: Karadu
Text: There’s the big, big ranch with Rappies, not far from here.

Name: Karadu
Text:
Many Naruru and humans are there, too…
It’s very strange no one saw the Rappie slip away.

Name: Karadu
Text:
D-Did that monster or Kuduru show up just now?!
Then we must go now!

Name: Karadu
Text: I will check the nest first, then go to the ranch.

Name: Karadu
Text: Follow the main road. Take this Rappie with you!

Name: Busy-looking Naruru
Text: Another one that ran off scared!

Name: Busy-looking Naruru
Text: Thank you for bringing the Rappie back. Thank you!

Name: Barashu
Text: I am Barashu, the ranch keeper!

Name: Barashu
Text:
Humans keep saying… "Incorsion," was it? Or "Incursion"?
So I guess the Bristly-Hairs went to fix it, too?

Name: Barashu
Text: It was a mess here! A big mess!

Name: Barashu
Text: I thought the wolves from below had come all the way up!

Name: Barashu
Text: Fortunately, it was just an Incor—Incursion.

Name: Barashu
Text: No one got hurt. A great relief, right?

Name: Barashu
Text: At the ranch, there were only humans who came here to see Rappies.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Doesn’t seem to be the Wolves’ doing.
Just in case, I should ask about the Paradise Advent.)</>

Name: Barashu
Text:
...I don’t think I saw them.
Narurus and Rappies were all screaming and running everywhere!

Name: Barashu
Text: A human, Incursion Specialist, did show up out of nowhere to help, but…

Name: Barashu
Text: Yes! He took care of all those scary monsters before leaving.

Name: Barashu
Text:
We are lucky it didn’t get worse…
I’m gonna miss those Rappies that ran away, though.

Name: Barashu
Text:
Listen, Karadu doesn't like humans.
But he sent you, anyway—

Name: Barashu
Text:
It means you must be a great warrior! Right? 
Please, you have to bring my Rappies back!

Name: Barashu
Text: I need to find the Rappies that ran uphill, but the Kuduru might be there.

Name: Barashu
Text: If Narurus like me go there without a Bristly-Hair helping us, we'll be snatched away... Sniff...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Helping them might lead me to Xeros.)</>

Name: Barashu
Text: You'll come. Come with me, right? Then let's hurry!

Name: Barashu
Text: Just as I thought... The place is crawling with monsters.

Name: Barashu
Text: First, I’ll sniff out where the Rappies went.

Name: Barashu
Text: Keep those things away from me while I do!

Name: Barashu
Text: The Rappies nearby are back, back at the ranch!

Name: Barashu
Text:
The rest of them are near the Kuduru.
Please, come with me!

Name: Barashu
Text:
It’s the Kuduru!
I didn't think they’d come this far...!

Name: Barashu
Text: The Bristly-Hairs aren't here yet. Ugh, what do we do?

Name: Kuduru Watcher
Text: <Red>Another weakling Naruru over there, ke-ke!</>

Name: Kuduru Warrior
Text: <Red>Today, we burn this ranch to the ground! This land belongs to the Kuduru!</>

Name: Kuduru Watcher
Text: <Red>The Giant’s Garden will be all ours!</>

Name: Karadu
Text: That’s enough, Kudurus!

Name: Barashu
Text: Whoa! Ka–Karadu?!

Name: Karadu
Text:
This land is a gift from Goddess Ea!
We Naruru fight for it!

Name: Barashu
Text: Thank you, thank you for stopping those Kuduru!

Name: Karadu
Text: Hmph. Those weaklings are no match for me.

Name: Karadu
Text: I am a Bristly-Hair. I do what I must do.

Name: Karadu
Text:
Such wicked plans they had...
Taking this place for themselves? Never.

Name: Barashu
Text: What if they come for the ranch again?

Name: Karadu
Text:
Do not worry!
More Bristly-Hairs are coming to guard this place.

Name: Karadu
Text: I must speak with Sturdy Whiskers about the Kuduru.

Name: Karadu
Text: <Yellow>Bristly-Hairs! Back to the village! Now!</>

Name: Barashu
Text: We should go. Back to the ranch!

Name: Barashu
Text: Thanks to you. All of our Rappies safely returned to the ranch!

Name: Barashu
Text:
They’ll want to thank you.
Talk to the Rappies, go on!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It lets out a low cry. It seems happy.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(As I stroke its mane, it gently rests its forehead against my palm.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Rappie gazes at me for a long time. It looks content.)</>

Name: Peddler
Text: I’ve walked this path many times, and yet those Kuduru just jump out of nowhere... Tsk.

Name: Peddler
Text: And who are you? I’m busy, can't you see?

Name: Peddler
Text:
Wait, are you the master of this ranch? Right?
You all look the same to me, I can never tell you apart.

Name: Barashu
Text:
You are the human from before, yes?
I remember you because you have a big belly!

Name: Peddler
Text:
Ahem! Humph! Such things do not matter in a trade.
What matters is what we give and take.

Name: Peddler
Text: If it wasn't for that <Yellow>Incursion Specialist</>, I would have died alone.

Name: Peddler
Text: Once this deal is done, I’m not coming back here for a long time.

Name: Peddler
Text: What? You know that fellow?

Name: Peddler
Text:
So you want to know where he went.
I did see him just a moment ago.

Name: Peddler
Text: The problem is, I don't have time for idle chatter.

Name: Peddler
Text: This is information about a "person." Naturally, it comes with a price!

Name: Peddler
Text:
I’m a big-name trader around here.
Always busy, because I’m always on the move!

Name: Barashu
Text:
Um... You keep saying you’re busy,
but you should not take the Rappies for now

Name: Peddler
Text:
What?! That’s not what we agreed!
You can’t just change the deal like that!

Name: Barashu
Text: But you, you arrived late, too...

Name: Peddler
Text: That was because of the Kuduru! I’m in a hurry, I tell you!

Name: Peddler
Text: Just bring the Rappies here. That was our deal!

Name: Barashu
Text: But wha, what if the Kuduru are still out there?!

Name: Barashu
Text:
If the Rappies see something scary again, they will run away again!
No, not until they rest enough.

Name: Peddler
Text: Bah! Those cursed Kuduru! Then just get rid of them!

Name: Peddler
Text: Hey, you. You wanted to know where the Incursion Specialist is, right?

Name: Peddler
Text: If you clear out all the Kuduru around here, I’ll let you meet him.

Name: Peddler
Text: Fine, a deal that will cost me dearly, but whatever!

Name: Peddler
Text: Go, hurry! Every second counts!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(No Kuduru in sight…)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(…maybe because the Bristly-Hairs are on patrol?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Incursion occurred just when the Kuduru appeared... Can it be just a coincidence?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(If the Paradise Advent made the Shadow Wolf Clan work for them,
the Kuduru might be working for them as well...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Xeros seems to have left already.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Sverd Mercenaries, Paradise Advent... So many questions.)</>

Name: Suspicious Noise
Text: Snap—Crack!

Name: Kuduru Warrior
Text: Ke-he! What did you step on?!

Name: Kuduru Warrior
Text: If we get caught… Gah! A human!!

Name: Kuduru Watcher
Text: Kill the human first! Then we take the ranch!

Name: Peddler
Text: Back already? Did you really take care of the Kuduru?

Name: Peddler
Text: You didn't just slack off because no one was watching, did you?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Shows the items I brought back.)</>

Name: Peddler
Text:
These are definitely the rags those pests were wearing.
Some of them were still lurking around, after all.

Name: Peddler
Text:
It’s a good thing that they’re gone. And the deal is done.
Now I can take the Rappies, right?

Name: Barashu
Text:
You must take good care of them!
Show them good things, give them tasty food, and let them sleep well!

Name: Peddler
Text:
I said I will!
We don't trade with bad sorts, you know.

Name: Peddler
Text: Dealing with the aftermath is too much trouble.

Name: Peddler
Text:
Now, as for our other deal.
You cleared my path, so I will hold up my end of the bargain.

Name: Peddler
Text: <Yellow>The Incursion Specialist headed toward the Kuduru territory.</>

Name: Peddler
Text: No matter how well he fights, it’s dangerous to go there alone. He’ll stop at the camp first.

Name: Barashu
Text:
<Orange>Sharaf</> is there!
He is the Naruru who watches the Kuduru up close!

Name: Peddler
Text: I heard the Hunters Guild sent someone there, too.

Name: Barashu
Text: That’s right! Naruru and humans are together.

Name: Peddler
Text: It may be because of the Incursion, or the Kuduru... who knows.

Name: Peddler
Text:
Anyway, that Specialist went that way.
I told you everything, so don't come complaining to me later!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I must hurry and catch up to Xeros.)</>

Name: Lively Voice
Text:
I’m telling the truth, <Orange>Sharaf</>.
Have you ever seen me lie? Have you?

Name: Lively Voice
Text: The Kuduru were carrying something strange!

Name: Firm Voice
Text: I won’t believe it until I see it with my own eyes.

Name: Lively Voice
Text:
Ugh, you are so stubborn!
I’m not saying this for my own good, you know!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(There’s commotion inside. What’s going on?)</>

Name: Firm Voice
Text: Stop right there. If you move, I strike.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Best not to make a sudden move.)</>

Name: Lively Voice
Text: Sorry about that, stranger.

Name: Lively Voice
Text:
Sharaf here is just—well—very serious about his job.
Please understand.

Name: Lively Voice
Text:
Oh, their land is behind our camp.
This place is more like... a watchpost.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Blabbering on to a complete stranger...
You should not tell him so much, Mitchell!

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Look at his face. He’s just here to ask for directions.
No need to be so jumpy.

Name: Sharaf
Text: ...If you are an adventurer, just pass through quietly.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Haaa, and there he goes.
So hard to have a proper chat with that one.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Well, shall we introduce ourselves?

Name: Mitchell
Text: I am <Orange>Mitchell</> from the Hunters Guild.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Sharaf is my partner and brother-in-arms.
Both of us are fighting the <Red>Kuduru</>, after all.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Human or Naruru, if we have the same goal, we’re friends! Haha!

Name: Mitchell
Text: The Incursion Specialist! I ran into him just a while ago.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Out in the Barrens.
Right before I was sent here.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He talks about it like it was only a few days ago...)</>

Name: Mitchell
Text: Just a joke, a joke! Don’t look so sour.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Honestly, I saw him just up ahead, but Sharaf chased him away.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Sharaf even had him tailed, saying something smells fishy. 
I’m sure the Incursion Specialist wouldn't cause any trouble, though.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Anyway, Narurus are taking turns tailing him,
so he’s probably getting reports every few hours.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
He won't even tell me. You think he’ll tell you?
Sigh, let me go try one more time.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Come now, don’t just stand out here. Wait inside.

Name: Mitchell
Text: He didn’t say you couldn’t come in, at least.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Doesn’t look like much of a setup here.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(So, is it all Kuduru territory right outside this path?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Seems a bit dangerous spot for a watchpost.)</>

Name: Mitchell
Text: You look like you’re wondering why we’re in a place like this.

Name: Mitchell
Text: If you can stretch your legs and get some sleep, it’s home! Don’t you agree?

Name: Mitchell
Text: Our friend Sharaf... he truly despises humans.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
But hey, we’ve spent quite a time together.
I tried to pull at his heartstrings a bit, but...

Name: Mitchell
Text:
he says it’s "Top Secret."
Told me he’d kick me out too if I kept talking nonsense.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
But we can't give up just yet!
If we keep pushing, he’s bound to reconsider.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Well, maybe if you lend a hand with some work, he might change his mind?

Name: Mitchell
Text: This camp is an easy target for the Kuduru to raid.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
When their numbers grow,
the Narurus and our Hunters Guild go out to clear them.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
But we’re short on hands because of the <Red>Incursion</>...
In the mean time, the Kuduru have multiplied fast.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
We got to help each other out, right?
I think it wouldn’t be a bad idea to get on his good side.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
A fellow like Sharaf might be prickly at first,
but once he’s on your side, he’d give you his very soul.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Better than asking for information empty-handed.)</>

Name: Mitchell
Text: Alright, that’s a deal then. You catch on quick. I like that.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
I should head out for today's hunt as well.
See you later, stranger.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Back already?
You’re even better than I thought!

Name: Mitchell
Text: Hmm...

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Oh! It’s nothing.
Just thinking about how to break the news to Sharaf.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Let's see how he reacts to this!

Name: Sharaf
Text:
I told you to pass through quietly.
Why have you returned?

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Well, this adventurer just thinned out the scouts.
You can tell just by taking a quick look out there.

Name: Sharaf
Text: I didn’t ask for it…

Name: Mitchell
Text: But this fellow did it for the camp! That’s the point…

Name: Mitchell
Text: Remember that Incursion Specialist you turned away?

Name: Mitchell
Text: Other places would <Yellow>beg for his help</>, welcoming him with open arms!

Name: Mitchell
Text:
He would have cut the Kuduru numbers in half.
I told you we should have let him be, even for a moment!

Name: Sharaf
Text:
...There are things only a Naruru can sense.
He had a dangerous scent.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Is that your animal instinct? I didn't smell a thing.

Name: Sharaf
Text: It does not matter if you understand or not.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
This adventurer does not carry the same scent…
But he is still human. I must stay on guard.

Name: Mitchell
Text: What about the Hunters Guild members here? I’m a human, too!

Name: Sharaf
Text: I only tolerate them because of the promise I made to Elder Etura!

Name: Sharaf
Text: Whatever you are planning, do not try anything foolish.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I tell him I’ll leave as soon as he tells me where the Incursion Specialist went.)</>

Name: Sharaf
Text: I won’t tell you that.

Name: Mitchell
Text: If you’re right, wouldn't it be better to tell this fellow where he went and be done with it?

Name: Sharaf
Text: ...No matter. The answer is no.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Haaa! You are impossible!
Let’s step back for a moment, stranger.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Right, back to the hunt!

Name: Mitchell
Text:
This time, we’ll wipe them out—every last Kuduru.
He won’t be able to ignore us then.

Name: Mitchell
Text: The Naruru leader and the Hunters Guild agreed on one thing.

Name: Mitchell
Text: <Yellow>Share this land, and fight the Kuduru together.</>

Name: Mitchell
Text: As long as we’re helping the Naruru, there’s always a way in!

Name: Mitchell
Text: We just have to prove you’re not a threat.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Look, he hasn't forced you out yet.
He just needs time to assess you.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Unless you prove yourself with actions, he’ll keep suspecting you.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Remember I mentioned the Narurus watching the Incursion Specialist?

Name: Mitchell
Text:
They’ll be back for their shift change soon.
I’ll go see if they have any useful information.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Don’t go anywhere... stay close by, will you?
We shouldn't miss each other.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Kuduru numbers have thinned out noticeably.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Mitchell is late, though.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Did we miss each other? Maybe he's back at the camp.)</>

Name: Familiar Voice
Text: <Yellow>Is that you? I'm not seeing things, am I?</>

Name: Khoon
Text:
It’s been a while.
So, you’ve been hanging around here?

Name: Khoon
Text: No wonder I never ran into you back in Babylon.

Name: Khoon
Text: Nothing much to tell, really.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The Guild came looking for me to drag me back again,
so I just... ran as far as I could.

Name: Khoon
Text: I hate sitting behind a desk and pushing papers.

Name: Khoon
Text: A hunter should be out here, enjoying the wild!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Anyway, I was just killing time when I spotted you.
You’re waiting for someone, right?

Name: Khoon
Text: <Orange>Xeros</>? Now that I think about it, I can barely remember his face.

Name: Khoon
Text: The Divines in Babylon kept asking him to stop by, but he never showed—not once!

Name: Khoon
Text: Maybe he smashed his communicator? He never answers it, anyway.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Oh! This is perfect. I was getting bored anyway.
Mind if I tag along?

Name: Khoon
Text:
The Hunters Guild sends people to this post all the time.
I’ll just tell them I’m here to lend a hand.

Name: Khoon
Text: Well then, let’s go hunt down Xeros!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Once I find him, I’ll bring him right here.
Just you wait!

Name: Tyuri
Text: Mitchell? I thought he went out with you.

Name: Tyuri
Text: He was sent here in a hurry, so I don't know much about him either.

Name: Tyuri
Text: …I’m not even sure if he is a Guild member.

Name: Tyuri
Text: We do work in shifts, but I’ve never seen him before.

Name: Tyuri
Text:
I only met him once I got here.
I just figured he was the type who couldn't stay still.

Name: Tyuri
Text:
Anyway, it’s hard enough just looking after myself. I’d rather not worry about him.
Ask someone else.

Name: Baragur
Text: That loud, loud human?

Name: Baragur
Text:
I don’t know. He’s always moving here and there.
I’ve never seen him stay still, never!

Name: Baragur
Text:
Going to the Captain is no good, no.
Wait until he calms down—

Name: Baragur
Text: Ouch... It hurts! It hurts!

Name: Baragur
Text:
I got hurt fighting the Kuduru...
But I ran out of medicine. I couldn't treat the wound.

Name: Baragur
Text:
Um, can you bring me some herbs?
Just pick some from under that big tree over there.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Why are you doing all this?
Wasn’t it enough to wipe out nearly every Kuduru in sight?

Name: Sharaf
Text: Are you trying to say you’re not a bad person? Is that it?

Name: Sharaf
Text: <Yellow>Defending this land of Ea is a task for the Naruru.</>

Name: Sharaf
Text:
We do not need your help...
Even Mitchell never went this far.

Name: Sharaf
Text: How should I know?

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Mitchell never listens to a word I say.
He already let you in without telling me.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
I’ll be sure to take it up with the Hunters Guild,
and tell them to never send that human back here again...

Name: Urgent Voice
Text: <Red>In—Incursion! It’s an emergency!</>

Name: Urgent Voice
Text: We need—Gah!

Name: Sharaf
Text:
An Incursion?!
Now of all times...

Name: Sharaf
Text: If I head out, there’s no one to protect the wounded—

Name: Sharaf
Text: …Sigh.

Name: Sharaf
Text: Fine. I will not refuse.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
For a moment… Just for a moment... Hold them off outside.
Do not let those monsters in!

Name: Sharaf
Text: I will handle things here. Go, now!

Name: Xeros
Text: Ah. I didn’t expect to run into you here.

Name: Khoon
Text: Xeros... What have you done?!

Name: Khoon
Text:
And this person was from the Hunters Guild.
You’d better explain yourself, Incursion Specialist.

Name: Xeros
Text: <Yellow>I simply executed the culprit on the spot.</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
<Blue>This man activated an object similar to a Tesseract.</>
Immediately after, an Incursion broke out at the spot.

Name: Khoon
Text: What? Then... it might be the same kind the Wolves were using!

Name: Khoon
Text: Why would someone from the Hunters Guild do such a thing...?

Name: Xeros
Text: Whether this is an imitation Tesseract or not doesn't matter.

Name: Xeros
Text:
His actions put everyone in danger.
I moved to prevent further harm.

Name: Xeros
Text: Do you need more explanation?

Name: Khoon
Text: ...Hah. Can't really argue with that.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Also, look closely.
See if he really is from the <Orange>Hunters Guild</>.

Name: Khoon
Text: Wait...

Name: Khoon
Text: It’s… a disguise?

Name: Xeros
Text:
If he hid his identity to trigger an Incursion, it all makes sense.
We’ve found a lead.

Name: Khoon
Text:
How am I going to explain this to Babylon?
What do you think, [player]?

Name: Xeros
Text: Do you find this horrific? What’s with that look on your face?

Name: Xeros
Text:
You’ve gone soft while I was gone.
It isn’t like you at all.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Something feels off...)</>

Name: Xeros
Text: Don’t want to talk about the past? Fine, it doesn't matter.

Name: Xeros
Text: So, did you come all this way because of me?

Name: Khoon
Text:
If you two need to talk, go ahead.
I'll handle the mess here somehow.

Name: Khoon
Text: Whoever he was, he was acting as a guild member.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I’ll head to Babylon as soon as I’m done here.
Contact me immediately if things get dangerous.

Name: Khoon
Text: Got it, [player]?

Name: Xeros
Text: Let’s move.

Name: Xeros
Text: I bet you don’t want to chat in front of a corpse.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Glance at Mitchell.)</>

Name: Xeros
Text: This way.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Did you try reaching me on the communicator?
It breaks down so often that I usually cut the power.

Name: Xeros
Text: …I should have known.

Name: Xeros
Text: Speak. If you’ve chased me this far, it must be important.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Explain what happened at the Shadow Wolves' den.)</>

Name: Xeros
Text: So the Wolves were behind the artificial Incursions in the Barrens...

Name: Xeros
Text: And you suspect the <Orange>Paradise Advent Society</> is backing them.

Name: Xeros
Text:
It’s as I suspected.
I never believed those Wolves had the strength to trigger such chaos alone.

Name: Xeros
Text: I’ve been looking into who was pulling their strings, and that’s how I learned about that group.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Simon... his last words were about Xeros...)</>

Name: Xeros
Text: You’re deep in thought.

Name: Xeros
Text:
What did you want to ask?
It’s time to get to the point.

Name: Xeros
Text: ...That is unfortunate.

Name: Xeros
Text:
When the Captain vanished, Simon was away on a mission.
He wouldn't have heard a single thing about what happened.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Like me, he must have been searching for the mercenaries 
until he finally stumbled upon the Wolves’ den.

Name: Xeros
Text: I’ve been around here tracking the mastermind behind the Incursions.

Name: Xeros
Text:
But my actions
prompted the Wolves to target the "Incursion Specialist"...

Name: Xeros
Text: In the end, Simon was captured in my place.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Xeros rubs his face with his hands and lets out a long sigh.)</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
Hah... My fault.
I should have been more careful.

Name: Xeros
Text: For his sake, we must find the Captain.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Listen closely.
<Yellow>The Captain made contact with the Paradise Advent Society.</>

Name: Xeros
Text: Yes. After he said that, the communicator went dead.

Name: Xeros
Text:
That was all.
He only mentioned that he made contact.

Name: Xeros
Text:
That’s why I’ve been hunting the Paradise Advent.
So far, they are likely the last ones to have seen him.

Name: Xeros
Text:
You’re looking for the Captain too, aren't you?
Better then. Will you come with me?

Name: Xeros
Text:
Once we find out where the Captain is, we will move immediately.
No matter where it leads.

Name: Xeros
Text: Follow me. I have a hunch.

Name: Xeros
Text: Doesn't look like much to you either, does it?

Name: Xeros
Text:
The Paradise Advent Society members used this and vanished in an instant.
I figured it was some kind of warp anchor.

Name: Xeros
Text:
I don’t know where they went,
but it's clear this thing holds massive energy.

Name: Xeros
Text: I tried to activate it myself... but couldn’t.

Name: Xeros
Text: Maybe I’m missing something.

Name: Xeros
Text: Why don't you give it a try?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Wait...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Ugh, my head... it hurts...)</>

Name: Xeros
Text: [player], snap out of it!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The splitting pain seems to be fading.)</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
Are you all right?
You suddenly collapsed. I thought that was the end for you.

Name: Xeros
Text:
I was careless. I shouldn't have put you at risk
with an unknown device.

Name: Xeros
Text:
I let my focus on the Captain cloud my judgment.
My mistake.

Name: Xeros
Text: Tell me.

Name: Xeros
Text: …Looks like it was quite a shock.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Based on what you said, it’s likely a travel device.
A voice calling you to the Tower…

Name: Xeros
Text: We need to figure out how to make it work.

Name: Xeros
Text:
A device this powerful is likely to be reserved for
high-ranking members of the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Xeros
Text: Like the ones that the Captain encountered.

Name: Xeros
Text: I’ll look into whether we can use this to reach the <Blue>Tower</>.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Past the Kuduru territory, there’s a brewery.
Go there and rest up first. We’ll talk later.

Name: Sharaf
Text: Is the conversation over?

Name: Sharaf
Text: You didn’t return even after the outside went quiet, so..

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Neither the Naruru nor the human hunters knew where you were.
I had to come and see for myself.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Just as I said.
I am the Bristly-Hair guarding this place.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
I was worried that you may have been hurt by those monsters...
Definitely not.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
You had a heavy talk with the Incursion Specialist, right?
I was waiting for you to finish the talk.

Name: Sharaf
Text: Are you close with that human?

Name: Sharaf
Text: A dangerous… dangerous scent still lingers on him.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Not as foul as the Kuduru, of course.
This scent belongs only to him.

Name: Sharaf
Text: Then it must be fine. Just forget what I said.

Name: Sharaf
Text: You are strong. Maybe there is nothing to worry about.

Name: Sharaf
Text: It was a short time, but thank you for your help.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Make sure you treat your wounds.
Goodbye.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Is that you, [player]?
I thought you’d still be out in the Barrens.

Name: Beretta
Text: To think we’d run into each other in a place like this.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Beretta looks much more relaxed than when I last saw her.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
This is the Sunset Brewery.
You didn’t know?

Name: Beretta
Text:
Spirits sold from Giant’s Garden to the Scything Barrens...
most of them are brewed right here.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Besides, this is the only brewery with a permit to sell in Babylon.
It means they went through a strict quality control process.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(There’s a faint glimmer of excitement in her eyes.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Of course, I’m here because I just can’t stop thinking of the drink here—

Name: Beretta
Text:
Hah, listen to me.
Anyway, what brings you all the way out here?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Briefly explain the situation.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Hmm…

Name: Beretta
Text:
Sounds like you might have experienced some kind of mental interference.
I’d have to examine the device itself to know more.

Name: Beretta
Text: It could be… some sort of artifact left behind by the Ancients.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Well, it's likely not the kind of relic I’m looking for.
If it were, I would have found it by now.

Name: Naruru’s Shout
Text:
<Yellow>My friend is finally here!</>
<Yellow>I have never waited for someone this long!</>

Name: Beretta
Text: ...Ishinu?

Name: Ishinu
Text: Beretta, who is your human companion?

Name: Ishinu
Text: We can’t have customers at this hour.

Name: Beretta
Text: Just someone I know. Not a customer for the brewery.

Name: Ishinu
Text: Then... then that means you can help me!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
I’ve laid them down over there.
Can you take a look at them?

Name: Beretta
Text:
What? Laid who down?
Is there a sick Naruru?

Name: Ishinu
Text:
My pupils—my apprentices!
They snuck out for some fun and came back in a terrible state!

Name: Ishinu
Text: They say strange things... and sometimes they see things.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I’m not a doctor.
I only know some basic first aid.

Name: Ishinu
Text: But we’ve spent so many hours over these drinks!

Name: Ishinu
Text: I’m a Naruru. I don’t know anything about sick humans!

Name: Beretta
Text: Sigh... I came for a drink and ended up with this.

Name: Beretta
Text: Ishinu, if I do this, you’d better give me the best you’ve got.

Name: Beretta
Text: Do we have a deal?

Name: Ishinu
Text: Of course! I’ll give you something no one has ever tasted before!

Name: Beretta
Text: You’re probably the only Naruru who’d ask a regular for a favor like this.

Name: Beretta
Text:
[player], follow me.
A bit of moving around will be good for your recovery anyway.

Name: Tristan
Text: Hehe... my brew is the best...

Name: Tristan
Text: Better than the Master’s... hic... much better...

Name: Beretta
Text: What is he talking about? Is he dreaming?

Name: Joris
Text: More... give me... yeah... give me that...!

Name: Joris
Text: <Red>I said give me more! I’m losing my mind here!</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
It looks like some kind of withdrawal.
They might have taken some dangerous drug.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Hey, say something.
Tell me where it hurts.

Name: Beretta
Text: They look like they are sleeping, but their breathing is shallow, and pulses too faint.

Name: Beretta
Text: If we leave them like this, the brewery is going to have corpses to clean up.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I’ll have to try the basics first.
There are some good herbs behind the brewery.

Name: Beretta
Text: Not the big flowers. Bring the ones with the tiny flowers.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Don’t let their flashy appearance distract you.
Just find the right ones.

Name: Beretta
Text: ...Actually, never mind.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I’m coming along.
I’m not sure I can trust your eyes to tell them apart.

Name: Beretta
Text:
You've improved a lot since last time.
How is such progress possible in so little time?

Name: Beretta
Text: That’s… beyond any ordinary human's potential.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I want you to work with me once we're done here.
I need to take a closer look at you.

Name: Beretta
Text: First, let's fix Ishinu’s apprentices.

Name: Beretta
Text: Grind the herbs and mix them with this potion.

Name: Beretta
Text: It’s a standard recipe for treating addiction.

Name: Beretta
Text:
You're like an open book.
Wondering how I know this?

Name: Beretta
Text: <Yellow>I’m not like ordinary humans.</>

Name: Beretta
Text: What you call 'expert knowledge' is a mere trifle to me.

Name: Beretta
Text:
It’s a waste to even call this 'knowledge.'
Humans really are clueless.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Keep working.
I need to get that drink from Ishinu.

Name: Beretta
Text: Done?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(They aren't moving. Did something go wrong?)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Hey, don't look so scared.
Their bodies are just detoxing.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Fortunately, the medicine worked for all three.
They just need a few days of rest.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Ishinu! Bring out the drink.
I’ve made sure they’ll wake up in a few hours.

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Actually, it's not just them... 
Over there… More sick ones are over there!

Name: Beretta
Text:
What? Why'd you keep them separate?
Doesn't matter. We have plenty of medicine anyway, so lead the way.

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Those ones are different.
They talk and walk... but they don't listen!

Name: Ishinu
Text: They're supposed to rest when I say 'rest,' and eat when I say 'eat'…

Name: Beretta
Text: Don't you think you're pushing your apprentices a bit too hard?

Name: Ishinu
Text: But... they promised... when they first came to learn brewing…

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Look, look over there!
They won't sleep, only brew more liquor.

Name: Ishinu
Text: I tried to stop them, but they almost hit me!

Name: Beretta
Text:
You should've told me that sooner!
It means the addiction has turned into aggression.

Name: Beretta
Text: The symptoms are severe... I need to see for myself.

Name: Ishinu
Text:
<Red>Stop, stop!</>
If you go closer, they'll attack you too!

Name: Beretta
Text: Your apprentices... they’ve completely lost it.

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Now that I see, their eyes look strange too...
How can we wake them up?

Name: Ishinu
Text: If this keeps up... the brewery will be a disaster.

Name: Ishinu
Text:
We won't finish the liquor by the deadline...
and our business will go under. It’ll be total ruin!

Name: Beretta
Text:
...We can't let that happen.
<Yellow>That must never happen.</>

Name: Beretta
Text: <Yellow>Brewing must never stop. Not ever.</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Do you know what works best for humans in that state?

Name: Beretta
Text: A little shock and awe.

Name: Beretta
Text:
If they're going to attack blindly, we have to push back.
Let’s wear them out first, then treat them.

Name: Beretta
Text: Hmm. Now those eyes finally look human again.

Name: Beretta
Text:
You've interrupted my hobby.
Start talking while I still ask nicely.

Name: Denny
Text: Ugh... P-please, have mercy...!

Name: Beretta
Text: What did you idiots swallow behind Ishinu’s back?

Name: Denny
Text: Sob, sob... It hurts, it hurts so much...

Name: Denny
Text: I-I’ll talk! I’ll tell you everything!!

Name: Beretta
Text: Spit it out.

Name: Denny
Text: W-we just went out for a stroll because the training was so hard!

Name: Denny
Text:
Master never tolerates mistakes...
We just wanted to clear our heads for a bit...

Name: Ishinu
Text: No, I didn’t!

Name: Denny
Text: We ran away to a shelter near the Ancient Tree and someone gave us some candies, saying they’re good for your body…

Name: Denny
Text: They were quite sweet, so we all enjoyed them...

Name: Denny
Text: B-but then, at some point, we couldn't stop thinking about them!

Name: Beretta
Text:
And eating them turned you into this?
Auditory hallucinations, visions, and the urge to hit anyone in sight?

Name: Denny
Text: Wh-what?! I mean... yes...

Name: Beretta
Text:
Doesn't sound like a candy to me.
Did the person who gave them to you say anything else?

Name: Denny
Text: They did mention something about... Aetherium…

Name: Denny
Text:
Oh! I have one left in my pocket.
H-here, this is it...

Name: Beretta
Text: Giving out this filth and calling it 'candy.' Unbelievable.
ItemDesc:
Candy made from finely crushed Aetherium powder.
Despite its appearance, it has a sweet and highly addictive flavor.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Ishinu, take this.
It should be enough for those apprentices groaning on the floor.

Name: Ishinu
Text: Are they badly hurt? Will they be able to get up?

Name: Beretta
Text:
It’s because they ate something 'delicious' behind your back.
Some human was handing them out, apparently.

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Those fools can't even brew liquor with proper flavor...
How dare they sneak out and swallow such trash!

Name: Beretta
Text:
Something near the brewery is luring your apprentices away.
I’ll deal with it.

Name: Beretta
Text: <Yellow>I’ll make sure they don't even dream of anything other than liquor.</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Come to think of it... [player], didn't you say you came here to recover?

Name: Beretta
Text: If it’s too much for you, I can go alone.

Name: Beretta
Text: Well, I didn't expect it to be a challenge for you.

Name: Beretta
Text: Aetherium is a type of ore. We don’t know much about it yet.<Blue></>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Making candy out of ores? Of course it doesn’t end well.
You saw it yourself—those withdrawal symptoms.

Name: Beretta
Text: If that stuff spreads, how many humans do you think will remain unaffected?

Name: Beretta
Text:
Then the brewery would be paralyzed again.
I don't want that.

Name: Beretta
Text: The shelter near the Ancient Tree is close by. Let's go finish off the source of this mess.

Name: Beretta
Text: Hold on. Stop for a second.

Name: Beretta
Text: Since when did those guys start loitering around here?

Name: Beretta
Text:
…Giant’s Garden is a Naruru territory.
There are barely any humans settled here to begin with.

Name: Beretta
Text: Is there any reason for them to be active in a place like this?

Name: Beretta
Text:
We should see what they're up to.
Let’s follow them quietly.

Name: Beretta
Text: You're too close. We’re going to get caught.

Name: Beretta
Text: Be more discrete.

Name: Beretta
Text: Watch your step. Don't make a sound.

Name: Beretta
Text: It’s the same Etherium candy Ishinu’s apprentice showed us.
ItemDesc:
Candy made from finely crushed Aetherium powder.
Despite its appearance, it has a sweet and highly addictive flavor.

Name: Beretta
Text:
If we leave it like this, wild animals will eat it.
Then they’ll end up just like those apprentices.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Something similar happened near the Cactus Nest.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
I came here to clear my head while relic hunting,
but I never expected to run into them here, too.

Name: Beretta
Text: This means they don't care if it's an animal or a human.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Stirring up chaos with such vile methods...
All of that to hide their little scheme.

Name: Beretta
Text:
They have the same symptoms as the apprentices.
Good thing we have medicine left.

Name: Beretta
Text: We should assume there are more people like this at the shelter.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Those bastards were acting so bold, weren’t they?
I expected them to be camped out right by the stalls.

Name: Beretta
Text: But all I see are the usual Naruru and humans.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Well, there’s only one way.
Let's ask around about where the Paradise Advent went.

Name: Yasra
Text:
The Paradise Advent Society?
Another adventurer asked me the same thing not too long ago.

Name: Yasra
Text:
He was as tall as a beanpole and so handsome.
I still remember his face clearly.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(An adventurer tracking the Paradise Advent Society? It must be...)</>

Name: Yasra
Text:
They’re a real piece of work, those guys.
You wouldn't believe how many people have joined them already.

Name: Yasra
Text: We've had charity groups for the hungry and poor before.

Name: Yasra
Text:
But they go even further—they even provide places to sleep.
And they give out gifts that supposedly only come from paradise.

Name: Yasra
Text:
Sparkly candies. Yeah, those candies.
Everyone says they're delicious.

Name: Yasra
Text: They say it gives you a burst of energy, and you can go days without eating.

Name: Yasra
Text:
Thanks to that, my food isn’t selling at all.
They're ruining my business!

Name: Navid
Text:
They're always causing such a racket, shouting about paradise being nigh.
They don't seem like ordinary religious types to me.

Name: Navid
Text:
Eyes all bloodshot, walking strange...
And then, people like that just vanish into thin air.

Name: Navid
Text:
Some folks who used to frequent here are gone now.
There used to be five or six more merchants besides me.

Name: Navid
Text: I asked the Paradise Advent, but I got no answer except that they 'have gone to the paradise’.

Name: Navid
Text:
I heard there’s a place where followers live together.
I just hope they're doing alright there.

Name: Navid
Text:
Things are getting creepy around here. I’m packing up and leaving.
You should be careful too.

Name: Beretta
Text: Found anything?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Report what I heard from the merchants.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: When did they start resorting to such crude methods?

Name: Beretta
Text: First, they hand out Aetherium candies to relieve hunger.

Name: Beretta
Text: Those who eat them become addicted and start following the Paradise Advent around, right?

Name: Beretta
Text: Then, even those who weren't interested start to believe what they say, and the society gains more following as a result.

Name: Beretta
Text: They must have singled out addicts with severe symptoms and locked them away.

Name: Beretta
Text: They were probabily sold off in human trafficking, or they actually went to the 'Paradise.'

Name: Beretta
Text: In the end... I was right.

Name: Beretta
Text: The <Red>Paradise Advent Society</>. I bore witness to all their filth, even after I left.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Ah, forget what I just said. For now, at least.
I’ll explain everything once I'm certain.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Beretta seems to know a lot about the Paradise Advent.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: You said there's a place nearby where the followers gather, right?

Name: Beretta
Text:
Let's head behind the shelter.
I heard they move around like they're on a tour.

Name: Beretta
Text: They'll show up over there soon.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: How many sins have you committed in the days past?

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: Our failures! They are pushing this planet toward destruction!

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
The Incursion shall cleanse this world…
and judge the fools stained by evil.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: The Paradise Advent Society will lead you to a path without pain.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
You only need to follow us.
For in the end, Paradise shall come...!

Name: Beretta
Text: Ah, so you are involved in the Incursion as well?

Name: Beretta
Text:
I thought you were being too quiet.
Is this what you've been plotting in the shadows?

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: Who dares interrupt this sacred hour of prayer...!

Name: Beretta
Text: Where are you taking these people? What’s the plan?

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
These people have been chosen.
They have earned the right to welcome the new era—

Name: Beretta
Text:
I asked why you need human bodies!
Have you finally started human experimentation?!

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
B, brothers and sisters! Do not be alarmed!
This heretic does not believe in Paradise and—

Name: Beretta
Text:
If you have a shred of reason left to judge for yourself, run.
Run now.

Name: Beretta
Text: <Red>The Paradise Advent Society is a lie!</>

Name: Bound Paradise Follower
Text: Ugh... This is a sacred place... How dare you...!

Name: Beretta
Text: I tied him up after you beat him within an inch of his life.

Name: Bound Paradise Follower
Text: Sinners are not... welcome in Paradise...

Name: Beretta
Text:
If you want to reach that Paradise so bad, answer me straight.
If you don't cooperate, I’ll toss you right in the middle the Incursion.

Name: Bound Paradise Follower
Text: H-heek!

Name: Beretta
Text: Where are you keeping the people you ruined with Aetherium?

Name: Bound Paradise Follower
Text: A... at the main base on the Highlands...

Name: Beretta
Text: Don't expect me to believe you’re dragging people all the way there.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Actually, I could just feed you to the wild beasts.
Do you want to go straight to the Paradise right now? Hmm?

Name: Bound Paradise Follower
Text:
W-we opened a secret path on the other side!
Just a little further inside...

Name: Beretta
Text:
Now you’re talking.
Let's go, [player].

Name: Bound Paradise Follower
Text:
Wait!
This wasn't the deal— P-please, let me go!

Name: Beretta
Text:
This cave used to be infested with bats.
No one ever bothered to come here.

Name: Beretta
Text:
They’ve cleaned it up and set up a nice little hideout, haven't they?
It would be rude not to drop in after all that hard work.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
Hear me, you who are weary from hunger.
We shall begin today’s ritual.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
The final gift this land bestows upon us!
The ultimate Aetherium is here.

Name: Fanatic Follower
Text: Ah! The fruit of Paradise!

Name: Fanatic Follower
Text: Oh Prophet! Grant us your grace!

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
Paradise is fair to all.
It reaches out to those who repent.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
Behold these two wailing souls.
They have been granted one final chance to clear their sins!

Name: Fanatic Follower
Text: Ah, merciful Paradise.

Name: Fanatic Follower
Text: Repent! Worship!

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
However, at this hour...
Only a single Aetherium has been bestowed upon us.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
These two followers will now be put to the test.
For miracles will happen to those who yearn for them most.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: You, my believers, will choose the one whose heart is more desperate!

Name: Gasping Addict
Text: <Red>Hhh... Hhh... Aetheri... um...</>

Name: Desperate Addict
Text: <Red>Give... Ugh, grrr! Grrrgh!</>

Name: Fanatic Follower
Text: Paradise! Do whatever it takes to reach Paradise!

Name: Fanatic Follower
Text: Prove your worth!

Name: Fanatic Follower
Text: Paradise! Aetherium! Paradise! Aetherium!

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: Heretics on such a joyous day? Ah! What a tragedy!

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: We shall resume our hour of blessing as soon as those intruders are dealt with.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: The blood we shed today shall lead us to a new world...!

Name: Beretta
Text:
What is this? An arena?
They’re all completely insane.

Name: Beretta
Text: That prophet who ran away earlier is inciting the others.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Sigh... I prefer to avoid killing if I can.
Focus on taking down the followers charging at us.

Name: Beretta
Text: The medicine might still work on those with milder symptoms.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: The advent of Paradise... cannot be stopped...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The prophet must be a top brass. I'll ask where Ingel is...)</>

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: How could I remember... the name of a mere human? Heh, heh…

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
So you're interested in the Tower...
Then all the more reason to join us! Cough…

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
No, no...
Paradise is reserved only for the chosen ones.

Name: Beretta
Text: Paradise, Paradise. Aren't you tired of that word yet?

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: Gasp... Urgh!

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: Under our great mission, those who are not chosen... are nothing but puppets…

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: <red>Everything shall be laid beneath the Tower...</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Good work.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I’ve gathered the people who seem somewhat sane at the entrance.
I'll take them back once they've recovered a bit.

Name: Beretta
Text:
By the way, the thing that the prophet said at the end…
Doesn't it bother you?

Name: Beretta
Text: <Yellow>Everything shall be laid beneath the Tower.</>

Name: Beretta
Text: They’re definitely planning something with that Tower.

Name: Beretta
Text: Hah, I bet everything they did here was just a distraction.

Name: Beretta
Text: The Paradise Advent Society has been hunting for a certain <Blue>relic</> for a long time.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I thought it was just a metaphor for their efforts to spread their faith.
Until just now.

Name: Beretta
Text: But if their plan is to create 'Paradise' using the power of the Tower...

Name: Beretta
Text: Sigh. Anyway, let’s deal with what we can for now.

Name: Beretta
Text:
There aren't any manors in the Giant's Garden, right?
I might have to contact Babylon.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Those bastards must be roaming all over the Forsaken Land.
This could be happening anywhere.

Name: Beretta
Text: …My goal is to stop them.

Name: Beretta
Text: Hunting for ancient artifacts was part of that plan.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Now that I've confirmed their activities, I need to rethink my strategy.
Let's start by searching this place.

Name: Beretta
Text:
They wouldn't build a hideout this size for nothing.
There must be something useful here.

Name: Beretta
Text: Ha, so they really do have it.

Name: Beretta
Text:
This is what the Paradise Advent treats as their <Blue>Scripture</>.
They say the doctrines of Paradise are written inside.

Name: Beretta
Text: Why would they leave something this important here instead of their main base?

Name: Beretta
Text:
It’s also strange that a member as high-ranking as a 'Prophet' was sent all the way out here.
Have they decided to scatter their key information?

Name: Beretta
Text:
I need to get back and decipher this immediately.
Let’s get these people out of here and head back to the Barrens.

Name: Adeline
Text: Oh... I thought I was going to die in the cage...!

Name: Leo
Text:
Thank you, thank you so much... 
You two saved our lives…

Name: Beretta
Text:
Wait. Did you not eat those candies?
You aren't showing any symptoms of addiction.

Name: Adeline
Text: W-well, I had one or two... but I lost consciousness almost immediately.

Name: Adeline
Text: We came from the Pulsing Ridge for a quick visit to meet the merchants here.

Name: Adeline
Text:
We ran into Paradise Advent Society members during our stay.
They gave us those candies, saying they will help us gain strength.

Name: Leo
Text: We were out looking for food anyway, so we accepted them without much suspicion…

Name: Leo
Text:
The moment I thought they tasted sweet, I was overcome with sleep.
When I woke up, I was already locked away.

Name: Leo
Text: Back then, we didn't see people who had changed like those fanatics.

Name: Beretta
Text: But, the timeline doesn't match.

Name: Beretta
Text: Ah, I mean the ones you ate might have been early test batches.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Come to think of it, it’s strange. So many people went missing…
…then how come no one noticed? Where are you from?

Name: Adeline
Text: We are from the Hesperia settlement.

Name: Leo
Text: It’s a small place south of the Pulsing Ridge.

Name: Beretta
Text: ...The Paradise Advent Society’s scheme is so transparent it’s sickening.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Let’s get out of here first.
This place reeks of those bastards.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Listen, everyone.
Something urgent came up, so I can’t take you home myself.

Name: Adeline
Text: You've done more than enough by saving us!

Name: Beretta
Text:
Instead, we'll guide you to the path leading back to the hills.
Not me, but my friend here.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(All the survivors’ eyes are fixed on me.)</>

Name: Adeline
Text: Once we reach that path, we’ll be home in no time!

Name: Leo
Text:
That’s right. Our village has guards, remember?
I'm sure they're out looking for us near the border.

Name: Adeline
Text: Thank you, thank you so much!

Name: Leo
Text: I really don't know how we can ever repay you…

Name: Beretta
Text:
Don't worry about it.
Just don't go grabbing anything just because you’re hungry next time.

Name: Beretta
Text: Head back to the Ancient Tree Shelter first. Rest up before you move on.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I know you want to go home,
but you can't walk on an empty stomach.

Name: Leo
Text: Actually, I was getting incredibly hungry.

Name: Adeline
Text: It's true... we haven't swallowed a single thing the whole time we were trapped there.

Name: Beretta
Text:
[player], make sure these people get a decent meal.
Tell them to put it on my tab.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I'm heading out first.
I’ll stop by the brewery and fill them in, so you take care of things here.

Name: Yasra
Text: Goodness, who are all these people?

Name: Yasra
Text: They’re covered in scrapes and bruises. They look like they were held captive somewhere.

Name: Yasra
Text: Of course, I’ll do it for her!

Name: Yasra
Text:
She buys liquor from me all the time.
She’s such a big spender!

Name: Yasra
Text: Oh, right! Remember when you asked me about the Paradise Advent?

Name: Yasra
Text:
I told you I saw a handsome adventurer asking the same thing.
He just passed by a moment ago!

Name: Yasra
Text: He was practically glowing. It was like he had a halo!

Name: Yasra
Text: Hard to miss someone like that... Oh, wait! There he is.

Name: Xeros
Text: You weren't at the brewery, so I came looking… And found this.

Name: Xeros
Text:
More scratches and bruises, I see.
At least your limbs still move.

Name: Xeros
Text: Where have you been?

Name: Xeros
Text: You paid a visit to their hideout?

Name: Xeros
Text:
…And <Yellow>they mentioned the Tower</>…
It seems the Paradise Advent Society is deeper into this than we thought.

Name: Xeros
Text: If so, their leaders are likely stationed at the Tower.

Name: Xeros
Text: Our next destination is decided. The Giant’s Tower.

Name: Xeros
Text:
I am concerned about your condition, though.
Those symptoms from before—any sign of them returning?

Name: Xeros
Text:
If you say so… I’ll take your word for it.
Just don’t push yourself.

Name: Xeros
Text: I’ve been looking into that unidentified device from the Aether Ruins.

Name: Xeros
Text:
An organization called the <orange>Liberator of Knowledge</> helped me.
They said it’s an ancient relic.

Name: Xeros
Text:
That device is indeed a key to the Tower.
Apparently, some adventurers use it quite often.

Name: Xeros
Text:
We’ll get the specifics once we arrive.
They’ll explain the rest.

Name: Mysterious Figure
Text: I’ve been expecting you.

Name: Xeros
Text: This is my comrade I told you about.

Name: Mysterious Figure
Text:
Ah, the one who activated ‘Uncertainty Module No. 3.’
It’s an honor to meet you.

Name: Hekima
Text: I am the Fifth Liberator, <Orange>Hekima</>.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Oh… my apologies.
It is a jargon used among the Liberators.

Name: Hekima
Text:
When we refer to ancient artifacts, 
we try to use the language of that era as much as possible.

Name: Hekima
Text:
It’s quite different from our current nomenclature.
To put it simply, this is a <Blue>Phase Shift Device</>.

Name: Hekima
Text:
A tool that transports the user to a specific location.
Though, it does require a massive amount of power.
ItemDesc:
An ancient artifact provided by the Liberator of Knowledge.
It teleports the owner to places with matching Aether wavelengths.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Of course, you’ve already made contact with it!
So, there’s no need to worry.

Name: Hekima
Text: It means you already meet the ‘eligibility requirements’ to be the owner of this ancient relic.

Name: Xeros
Text:
…Requirements, huh?
So, how do we get to the Tower?

Name: Hekima
