Text:
A warp anchor must be fixed to a specific location where Aether flows,
but this one can be modified for portable use.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Reactivating the remnants of ancient civilizations
is a skill unique to us Liberators.

Name: Hekima
Text: I can modify it for you right away, if you wish.

Name: Xeros
Text: Name your price.

Name: Hekima
Text: I require neither honor nor gold.

Name: Xeros
Text: Truly? Sounds like a losing bargain for you.

Name: Hekima
Text: Simply bring back any ‘information’ you find within the Tower. That will suffice.

Name: Xeros
Text: …Time is short. I accept.

Name: Xeros
Text:
[player], it’s best you go ahead.
Find any Paradise Advent Society presence there.

Name: Xeros
Text: I’ll follow as soon as I secure a transport device of my own.

Name: Hekima
Text: One moment, please.

Hekima chants an unknown incantation and hands over the device,
which is now glowing blue and shrunk in size.

Name: Hekima
Text:
It seems you have many questions.
I’ll give you all the time you need when you return.

Name: Hekima
Text: I, too, am curious to see just how ‘eligible’ you truly are.

Name: Hekima
Text: Now, activate the device.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is this… the inside of the Giant’s Tower?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Too vast for a building interior.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(More people here than I expected…)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Where are Paradise Advent Society members?)</>

Name: Peppie
Text:
I’m <Orange>Peppie</> from the Explorers Guild.
I gather bits and pieces of info here in the Giant’s Tower.

Name: Peppie
Text:
I had a hunch today.
Is this really your first time inside the Tower?

Name: Peppie
Text:
Wow, you really are clueless, aren't you?
Looks like you need a few pointers!

Name: Peppie
Text: As you can see from the outside, the Tower is made of many floors.

Name: Peppie
Text:
Only rookies fight over gold and treasure.
The real deal… is the upper floors where not just anyone can go.

Name: Peppie
Text:
Aren't you curious what’s up there?
Ancient records, terrifying monsters—what have you.

Name: Peppie
Text:
I couldn’t resist my own curiosity, so here I am.
Of course, I have to do what the Guild tells me…

Name: Peppie
Text:
Anyway, I’ve been in and out of here for quite a while.
It means I have so much experience that you can't even dream of catching up!

Name: Peppie
Text: So, you can imagine how much a fledgling adventurer stands out to me.

Name: Peppie
Text: Especially someone like you, showing up completely unprepared!

Name: Peppie
Text:
Luckily for you, it goes against my good nature
to leave newcomers alone and helpless.

Name: Peppie
Text:
Now, tell me your goal.
I’ll help you out before you throw your life away for nothing.

Name: Peppie
Text: The Paradise Advent Society… Are they like, all the rage in the outside world these days?

Name: Peppie
Text: Sorry, I practically live in this Tower, so I’m a bit out of the loop with the latest news.

Name: Peppie
Text:
But don’t worry!
I can always connect you with someone who knows.

Name: Peppie
Text:
That one over there, and that one over there. 
They’ve been here even longer than I have, so go ask them.

Name: Oscar
Text:
Whoa! You startled me.
Was I being too loud? My bad!

Name: Oscar
Text:
I’m just so happy to be back alive.
It wasn’t easy—I really thought I was a goner this time.

Name: Oscar
Text:
Look at those wide eyes. Aha!
First time in the Tower, I see?

Name: Oscar
Text:
You know the drill—adventurers here love to tear each other apart.
Stay sharp, friend.

Name: Oscar
Text: Anyway, what brings you to me? Spit it out.

Name: Oscar
Text: Whoa, now that’s a name I haven’t heard in a while.

Name: Oscar
Text:
I remember them—they spread that weird faith.
The did the same here in the Tower.

Name: Oscar
Text:
It’s been quite a while since they vanished from the lower floors.
<Yellow>If they didn't head outside, they must have moved up.</>

Name: Oscar
Text: That guy over there knows the ropes better than I do.

Name: Oscar
Text: He looks gloomy, but he’ll talk. Go see for yourself.

Name: Eirik
Text: State your business.

Name: Eirik
Text: Better for you to turn back while you’re still on the lower floors.

Name: Eirik
Text: Judging by the look, any advice would be wasted on you.

Name: Eirik
Text: Fine. Then find the <Blue>Queen’s Explorer</>.

Name: Eirik
Text:
Whether you pass the trial they give or dispose of them,
you just need to gain access to access other floors.

Name: Eirik
Text:
It may sound contradictory, but…
The Tower is open to all, yet restricted to most.

Name: Eirik
Text:
It lures people in with riches,
but its true intent remains a mystery.

Name: Eirik
Text:
Most don’t care. 
They remain on the lower floors, enjoying their wealth and power.

Name: Eirik
Text: But if you must climb the Tower toward your goal, there is only one way.

Name: Eirik
Text:
Think carefully before you move.
You’re nothing but prey in this state.

Name: Eirik
Text: I wouldn't be surprised if you are gutted by another adventurer even before meeting the Explorer.

Name: Eirik
Text: Go back outside. Bring a companion.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Moving alone is dangerous, according to them.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Might be better to return with Xeros.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(…Wait. Something’s on the floor over there.)</>

Name: Scribbled Note
Text: <Red>[Moving to the Observation Floor per the High Master's orders.]</>
ItemDesc:
A note containing a single, brief line: “Moving to the Observation Floor per the High Master's orders.”
The frantic handwriting suggests urgency.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The High Master? And what exactly is the Observation Floor?)</>

Name: Peppie
Text:
Got the answers you were looking for?
If not, I know someone you might want to meet.

Name: Peppie
Text: Hey, what’s that in your hand?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Peppie reads the note, a puzzled look forming on her face.)</>

Name: Peppie
Text: The word ‘Observation Floor’ is the only part I understand,

Name: Peppie
Text:
even with all the information I’ve gathered all this time.
I’ll need some time to dig into this.

Name: Peppie
Text: Wait, wait! You aren't thinking of heading there blind, are you?

Name: Peppie
Text:
If you go like that, you’ll be lucky to last a single day.
Go back and bring your friend.

Name: Peppie
Text:
Or hire a mercenary!
You’ve got to stay safe until you find the Paradise Advent Society!

Name: Peppie
Text:
Come back once you’re better prepared.
I’ll figure out what this note means by then.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It’s true I rushed into the Tower without a plan.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(With all these warnings, I should head back and regroup.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Did I make it back?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It feels like I’ve been sent back to where I was before entering the Tower…)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: [player], are you awake?

Name: Rada
Text: There’s a place I want you to go.

Name: Rada
Text: <Blue>The Trial Gate!</>

Name: Rada
Text:
They found one near the Taima Pioneer Village,
and I figured you can handle it better than me.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(All the way to the Barrens?
Rada’s eyes widen as I give her a look that says "Why me?")</>

Name: Rada
Text:
…Isn’t it obvious?
No one is as entertaining as you are!

Name: Rada
Text: Looks like it has to be one person at a time.

Name: Rada
Text:
Honestly, I’m the one missing out here.
I’m missing out on all the fun!

Name: Rada
Text:
Hehe, my heart is already racing.
So, head to the Warp Anchor right now, [player]. Please?

Name: Rada
Text:
Don't forget to buy some <Orange>HP Potions</> from the General Merchant first!
If you go unprepared, you’re in for a world of hurt.

Name: Rada
Text:
I’ve been counting the hours waiting for you, [player]!
Tell me what happened, right now!
Avoiding Rada’s overwhelming, sparkling gaze, I explained what happened in the Pioneer Village—how monsters seemed to be guarding the Trial Gate.

Name: Rada
Text:
Hmm, so that’s what happened?
You really are an interesting one.

Name: Rada
Text:
Come to think of it, the Trial Gate is the <Blue>Trial of Atrahasis</>.
It wouldn't be right if it were easy to get into.

Name: Rada
Text:
Maybe I should’ve gone with you after all.
Who else but you would have an experience like that?

Name: Rada
Text:
<Orange>The Architect of the Tower.</>
It’s one of the old legends that roam the forsaken land.

Name: Rada
Text:
Some say Atrahasis was a Great Sage from a fallen empire.
Believe it or not.

Name: Rada
Text: But still, isn't it quite forgiving for a trial?

Name: Rada
Text: It gives out rewards just for passing—and a lot of them, too!

Name: Rada
Text: Many people speculate it is where the entrance to the Tower is hidden, but...

Name: Rada
Text:
Speaking for myself,
it’s all about the loot and the thrill of the unknown.

Name: Rada
Text:
That’s why I recommended it, and I’m sorry I missed out.
But hey, that’s not the only Trial Gate!

Name: Rada
Text:
On that note,
[player], I hope you’ll visit the Trial Gates often. Do it for me, please?

Name: Rada
Text: Great! We’re definitely going together next time, okay?

Name: Riona
Text:
Hello.
I’m <Orange>Riona</> from the Wayfinders Guild.

Name: Riona
Text:
You’re the adventurer, right?
Just as Rada described.

Name: Riona
Text:
…Wait, did she not explain anything to you?
Oh, Rada… so irresponsible, as always.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Uzhar warned me that Rada can be quite careless.
Now I understand what it means.)</>

Name: Riona
Text: Sigh… I suppose I have no choice.

Name: Riona
Text: <Yellow>The Wayfinders Guild regularly verifies known methods for becoming more powerful.</>

Name: Riona
Text: We aim to stop adventurers from losing their lives over mere rumors while trying to conquer the Tower.

Name: Riona
Text:
But recently, we received a report that sounds just… absurd.
Would you like to see for yourself?
ItemName:
The Center of Rumors
The Brunt of Controversy
ItemDesc:
A shortcut is still a way! As long as you get stronger.
Collect the armaments of the Kuduru and pray at the Ancient Ruins.
Then, you shall face the Great Trial.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Looks like someone’s playing a trick…)</>

Name: Riona
Text:
Looks suspicious, doesn't it?
My request is simple: confirm if this report is true.

Name: Riona
Text:
I know it’s frustrating, but we don't need to make unnecessary noise.
Please keep this quiet and confidential.

Name: Riona
Text: Vague? Just do as you're told!

Name: Riona
Text: Now, hurry along to the Kuduru territory.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This seems to be the place for the ritual.)</>
(As the ritual concludes, the roars of the Kuduru echo through the air.)

Name: Riona
Text:
How was it, adventurer?
Was it actually true? Or just another hollow rumor?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Riona smirks as I show her what I retrieved from the Kuduru.)</>

Name: Riona
Text:
With that crude handwriting and childish content, I was certain it was a lie.
I guess I was wrong.

Name: Riona
Text: Hehe, Rada was right—you really do bring back interesting results.

Name: Riona
Text:
I’ll contact you personally next time.
May I have your communicator for a moment?

Name: Riona
Text:
I hope this was a memorable experience for you.
Until next time, adventurer.

Name: Riona
Text:
Hehe, you really are reliable.
Arriving so quickly.

Name: Riona
Text:
I’ve found an interesting <Blue>relic</>.
Care to take a look?
ItemDesc: A dagger with an unusual shape. It looks familiar.

Name: Riona
Text: They say it was found in the Tower. I called you to see if you recognized it.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Queen’s Explorer comes to mind, but I’ll pretend I have no clue to avoid trouble.)</>

Name: Riona
Text:
Sigh... I brought this thinking you might know something. What a shame.
I suppose I should just return it to the Explorers Guild…

Name: Riona
Text:
...Not!
Why would I have called you if I were going to do that?

Name: Riona
Text:
<Yellow>In Enkia, we have a saying.</>
<Yellow>Every riddle has its destined solver.</>

Name: Riona
Text:
I’ve heard an intriguing story from a reliable source…
…that I can’t name right now.

Name: Riona
Text: For instance... that you are called the <Orange>Chosen One</>.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Chosen One? Could it be the Liberator of Knowledge?
Didn’t know they know Riona too...)</>

Name: Riona
Text:
I heard the manifestation of your Gudua factor is quite exceptional.
I’m curious to see what kind of experience you’ll have.

Name: Riona
Text:
Hehe, interested now, are we?
Very well. I’ll keep it brief.
ItemDesc:
An ancient relic from the Giant’s Tower.
No idea what it is. I should hear more.

Name: Riona
Text:
This relic guides its user to the <Blue>“Labyrinth”</>.
However, apparently, not everyone makes it there.

Name: Riona
Text:
Some adventurers can’t remember where they went,
while others avoid talking about what they saw.

Name: Riona
Text: The good news is that everyone has returned in one piece!

Name: Riona
Text:
At least let me finish before you judge, adventurer.
Of course, there are risks to your life.

Name: Riona
Text:
But everyone who returned from the Labyrinth became stronger than before.
The gain far outweights the risk they take.

Name: Riona
Text: You look like someone who needs a chance to get stronger… am I wrong?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I need to get stronger to stop Xeros and prevent the Tower from collapsing.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I nod for an answer, and Riona hands me the relic.)</>

Name: Riona
Text: The relic only responds in <Blue>specific locations</>.

Name: Riona
Text: We don’t know where the Labyrinth will open, so it’s best to check them all.

Name: Riona
Text:
Start with the Aether Ruins in the Pulsing Ridge.
If that’s not it, I’ll give you the next location.

Name: Riona
Text:
I’m afraid I can’t do that, adventurer.
I have my own position to consider.

Name: Riona
Text: I’ll send you the most likely spots one by one, so keep your device on.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I placed the relic, but nothing happened.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Tried again, but there’s still no change.)</>

I explained the situation to Riona via the communicator,
and she told me to head to the temporary shelter in the Barrens.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This engraved wall should do.)</>

A blinding light erupted from the relic.
As my vision cleared, I found myself in the Labyrinth.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The girl at the gate...?
But she died back then. How...?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Something’s wrong. I’ll follow her.)</>

The girl was gone once I stepped inside. 
Instead, a Colossus appeared with a deafening roar.
Where the Colossus fell, the relic I used to enter the Labyrinth lay on the ground.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What now…?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Better try using it again. It might work.)</>
Using the relic, I escaped the labyrinth as if by magic.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The relic vanished without a trace. What should I tell her?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(First, I need to tell Riona what happened.)</>

Name: Riona
Text:
Hehe, I’m already excited to hear your story.
Go on, tell me everything.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Explain what happened in the Labyrinth and how the relic vanished.)</>

Name: Riona
Text:
I see.
Thanks to you, I’m starting to see a pattern.

Name: Riona
Text: <Yellow>Word is, anyone who enters the Labyrinth using this relic meets a certain girl.</>

Name: Riona
Text: Did you happen to see this <Orange>girl</> as well?
ItemDesc:
The girl I first met in the Forsaken Land.
I don’t think I’ll ever forget her after this.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Nod and confirm that I did.)</>

Name: Riona
Text: And… you believed this girl was dead.

Name: Riona
Text:
How intriguing.
Every single one of the Chosen Ones gave me that same answer.

Name: Riona
Text:
Theories vary on who she is,
but all of them mention a certain being.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(…Could she mean Saikarad?)</>

Name: Riona
Text: Don’t worry, I won't ask who it is.

Name: Riona
Text:
And don't fret over the relic.
We’ll find another.

Name: Riona
Text: I’m pleased to see how much stronger you’ve become since we first met.

Name: Riona
Text: Thank you for sharing another extraordinary experience with me, adventurer.

Name: Riona
Text: So… if you've come looking for me, I assume there's something you want, right?

Name: Riona
Text: Hehe, I was actually just about to contact you. Perfect timing.

Name: Riona
Text:
There just so happens to be a place I need you to go.
I've somehow ended up in a bit of debt.

Name: Riona
Text: You remember this, right?
ItemDesc:
The dagger left behind where the Queen's Explorer once stood.
I've seen it a few times before.

Name: Riona
Text: I borrowed a few more from the Liberators of Knowledge, and they got completely smashed!

Name: Riona
Text: It's awkward to compensate them through the guild, but we can't just pretend it never happened either.

Name: Riona
Text: In this situation, a mercenary... no, an adventurer like yourself would be perfect.

Name: Riona
Text:
Since Rada also mentioned that you seem quite close with the Liberators,
there's no need to look for anyone else, right?

Name: [player]
Text: (She's not giving you any room to back out.)

Name: Riona
Text: You have nothing to lose by hearing me out, right?

Name: Riona
Text:
Then head over to the Reconnaissance Outpost.
Weifel, a member of the Liberators of Knowledge, will be waiting for you.

Name: Riona
Text: Oh, and don't be surprised—Weifel is an ancient object.

Name: Grumbling ancient object
Text:
Do you have any idea how long I've been waiting for you?
If only Riona hadn't said you the Chosen Candidate!

Name: Weifel
Text: Anyway, you should be grateful that the great Weifel is gracing you with my name!

Name: [player]
Text: (Now that’s one opinionated ancient object.)

Name: Weifel
Text:
Ugh... A professor who doesn't even listen to a single word I say!
And Riona daring to haggle with me!

Name: [player]
Text: (You calm the grumbling Weifel down.)

Name: Weifel
Text:
You're a human who's actually easy to talk to.
Right, have you heard of the Angbar Arena by any chance?

Name: Weifel
Text: Oh... So you've actually been there?

Name: [player]
Text: (You tell him about your exploits in the Angbar Arena.)

Name: Weifel
Text:
Tch, whatever. You're much more impressive than I thought.
Then I suppose I don't need to explain it to you.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Here, take this and go find Zisen in the Thunderfall Ridges!
You just need to cross three bridges. Simple, right?
ItemDesc: An ancient object that can store scattered Aether nearby.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Oh, and don't go right.
Because the Thunderfall Ridges are on the left.

Name: Weifel
Text: Keep following that path I told you, and you'll see a large tree near the crossroad in front of the ruins.

Name: Weifel
Text: You'll find the professor, I mean Zisen, there!

Name: [player]
Text: (When you complain that you need more information for directions, Weifel adds that he almost forgot something important.)

Name: Weifel
Text:
Aether Entanglement!
You'll see them on the way to the Thunderfall Ridges!

Name: Weifel
Text: Gather them while you're at it and give them to the professor, human!

Name: Weifel
Text:
Oh... That's surprising in more ways than one.
You've walked a rather difficult path, haven't you?

Name: Weifel
Text:
I'd love to explain the arena to you specifically, but...
...now doesn't seem to be the time.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Here, take this and go find Zisen in the Thunderfall Ridges!
You just need to cross three bridges. Simple, right?
ItemDesc: An ancient object that can store scattered Aether nearby.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Oh, and don't go right.
Because the Thunderfall Ridges are on the left.

Name: Weifel
Text: Keep following that path I told you, and you'll see a large tree near the crossroad in front of the ruins.

Name: Weifel
Text: You'll find the professor, I mean Zisen, there!

Name: [player]
Text: (When you complain that you need more information for directions, Weifel adds that he almost forgot something important.)

Name: Weifel
Text:
Aether Entanglement!
You'll see them on the way to the Thunderfall Ridges!

Name: Weifel
Text: Gather them while you're at it and give them to the professor, human!

Name: [player]
Text:
(The person standing next to the large tree near the crossroad in front of the ruins...
…must be Zisen.)

Name: Zisen
Text:
It's an honor to m-meet you. C-Chosen Candidate.
I-I am Zisen.

Name: Zisen
Text: I'd like to introduce myself properly, but the s-situation isn't great.

Name: Zisen
Text: You r-received the Aether Collector from Weifel, right?

Name: Zisen
Text: Daidalkur has e-escaped from the Angbar Arena.

Name: [player]
Text: (You stare at Zisen in disbelief as if to say, “What the heck are you talking about?”)

Name: Zisen
Text: I-I had the exact same reaction as you u-until I saw it for myself.

Name: Zisen
Text: A-As you know, the Liberators are mostly scholars like m-me...

Name: Zisen
Text: We can't just order the Divine around, so we had to a-ask Riona for a f-favor.

Name: Zisen
Text: *sigh* Weifel is at it again...

Name: [player]
Text: (These two really never change.)

Name: Zisen
Text: F-First, we need to remove the entanglement with the Aether Collector.

Name: Zisen
Text: Then i-its power will weaken.

Name: [player]
Text: (You tell him you saw Aether Entanglements on the way and gathered them on your way here.)

Name: Zisen
Text:
This... i-it doesn't seem like an ordinary one.
Seeing how far the Aether splashed...

Name: Zisen
Text:
I think you need to g-go to it quickly.
It should be in the collapsed r-ruins up there.

Name: Zisen
Text: I will t-take care of the remaining entanglements, so please h-hurry up and go!
Zisen and Weifel, who appeared a moment later, finished cleaning up the scattered Aether around them.

Name: Zisen
Text: Th-Thanks to you, I was able to c-clean up the Aether scattered nearby.

Name: Weifel
Text: The great Weifel has also come all the way here. Aren't you glad?!

Name: Zisen
Text: It seems the power s-sealing the arena was i-interfered with by s-something.

Name: Weifel
Text: The great Angbargidea Household wouldn't make a mistake like this! Of course not!

Name: Zisen
Text: As you know, a-arenas are sometimes set up in places where the Aether flow is relatively stable, like the Ancient Ruins.

Name: Zisen
Text: As soon as I figure out the cause, I'll t-tell Riona.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Oho... You look a bit different, Chosen Candidate.
I didn't expect you to actually solve this.

Name: Zisen
Text: *sigh* Why do I fail every time I try to teach him manners...?

Name: [player]
Text: (It seems there are many reasons, but let's not bring them up.)

Name: Zisen
Text:
I'm sorry.
I apologize for Weifel being so rude every time.

Name: Zisen
Text: I l-look forward to seeing you a-again soon.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Where have you been?
You weren't answering your communicator. I've been looking everywhere.

Name: Beretta
Text: Don't give me that look. As if you're surprised to see me.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Hate to break it to you, but I’m the only one here.
Stop looking around and say something.

Name: Beretta
Text: No. I just told you.

Name: Beretta
Text: I’ve been circling this area looking for you, and I haven't seen a soul.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Then you appeared, ripping through space.
Did you use a phase shifter or something?

Name: Beretta
Text: Ah, the <Blue>Giant’s Tower</>.

Name: Beretta
Text:
You're an adventurer, so I suppose it’s only natural. 
Still, I’m curious.

Name: Beretta
Text: What were you doing there?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Explain that I was searching for someone with Xeros
and that the Paradise Advent Society holds a clue.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
...I figured as much.
No wonder you dropped everything and went there.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Let’s move.
We should finish what we started.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Those humans we rescued.
You left them behind while talking to Xeros, didn't you?

Name: Beretta
Text:
I can’t be bothered, either.
I couldn't care less what happens to such frail creatures.

Name: Beretta
Text: <Yellow>But a promise is a promise.</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Besides, you can't reach Xeros anyway.
Let's take a walk. Conserve your strength until you see him again.

Name: Beretta
Text:
You seem to be in a precarious state.
I’ll keep an eye on your condition while we escort them.

Name: Beretta
Text:
It looks like the Tower left a mark on you.
Just so you're aware.

Name: Leo
Text: We meet again, our lifesavers!

Name: Adeline
Text:
Oh, didn't know you were still here!
We've been getting good rest, all thanks to you.

Name: Adeline
Text:
We were a bit worried when you vanished so suddenly,
but we knew you’d be back.

Name: Beretta
Text: See? Everyone was waiting just for you.

Name: Beretta
Text: You should always keep your word.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(But Beretta was the one who offered the escort...)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
You folks said home was just past here, right?
Frantia, was it?

Name: Beretta
Text:
I’ve got a moment, so I’ll tag along.
More guards equals safer travel.

Name: Leo
Text: Thank you, thank you so much…

Name: Adeline
Text: We’d never say no to that!

Name: Beretta
Text: Let’s get going.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Wait... I knew something was bugging me.
Take this and pay what we owe.

Name: Beretta
Text: I told you to use my name to get what you needed from the merchants.

Name: Beretta
Text:
The debt must be piling up by now.
Go clear it, quickly.

Name: Yasra
Text:
Straight from the brewery!
Cheapest prices around!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Make my presence known.)</>

Name: Yasra
Text: Oh? You’re the handsome adventurer…

Name: Yasra
Text:
Wait, no. Jst a regular adventurer.
Good to see you again! Alone today?

Name: Yasra
Text: Ah, the tab under that drunken scholar's name.

Name: Yasra
Text:
I'd love to help, but I can't afford to do charity.
Glad you're paying it back on time.

Name: Yasra
Text: Stay safe, and come back with your handsome friend soon!

Name: Panicked Resident
Text:
<Red>Oh no... F-fire…</>
Everything’s going up in smoke!

Name: Adeline
Text: Wait, what happened here? How did this start?

Name: Leo
Text:
Put out the flames first, and then talk.
These wagons belong to the whole village—and we only have a few left!

Name: Panicked Resident
Text: Sorry to ask when we’ve just met, but can you lend a hand?

Name: Panicked Resident
Text:
The fire might spread to the village at this rate.
Please!

Name: Beretta
Text: I’m not in the mood for casualties.

Name: Beretta
Text: This is simple enough for you. Help them.

Name: Panicked Resident
Text: Sigh... It’s finally under control.

Name: Leo
Text: What happened here? Please tell us.

Name: Panicked Resident
Text: It was that damn <Red>Ironblood Brigade</>.

Name: Panicked Resident
Text:
We were headed down from the Giant's Garden,
when they jumped us from the right path.

Name: Panicked Resident
Text: Luckily, the militia is chasing them down, but... sigh.

Name: Adeline
Text: Those bastards... How dare they harass our village!

Name: Beretta
Text:
You know this area borders the Kingdom of Frantia, right?
Some call it the Pulsing Ridge.

Name: Beretta
Text: Anyway, they’re likely just some armed bandits operating around here.

Name: Panicked Resident
Text: Not 'likely'—that’s exactly who they are!

Name: Panicked Resident
Text: A bunch of vile, petty, and vicious crooks.

Name: Leo
Text: …And human trafficking is their major financial source.

Name: Panicked Resident
Text:
When you two vanished, we feared they had taken you...
I’m so glad you’re back.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Whew. Can we save the touching reunion for when we arrive?
I’m not fond of breathing in all this smoke.

Name: Panicked Resident
Text:
Good point.
The village chief must be worried sick.

Name: Panicked Resident
Text: It’s just ahead. Let’s head down.

I helped the villagers clear the remaining fire
and followed the path to Hesperia Village.

Name: Xavyer
Text: ...I cannot tell you how relieved I am that everyone is safe.

Name: Xavyer
Text: As the representative of the <Orange>Hesperia settlement</>, I offer my deepest thanks.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
I must stay alert for this <Red>Paradise Advent</>.
Do you have any more information about them?

Name: Beretta
Text: I'm not familiar with these lands either.

Name: Beretta
Text:
More importantly, what’s wrong with these people?
Everyone is injured, and they look half-starved.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Your wounds seem to heal in a heartbeat.
Is it different for every human?

Name: Beretta
Text: Go take a closer look yourself.

Name: Beretta
Text: See? I told you. I’m starting to wonder if you’re even the same species.

Name: Beretta
Text: Why haven't these injuries been treated yet?

Name: Xavyer
Text:
This village was cobbled together by wanderers...
Supplies, food—nothing comes easy here.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
We must fend off the Kiguru
while staying alert for those Ironblood Brigade.

Name: Beretta
Text: Sigh. I’ll help you out this once.

Name: Beretta
Text: [Player], I’ll need you to go out and find some useful materials.

Name: Beretta
Text: There’s a wide field near the village entrance.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Just bring back whatever you find.
I’ll stay here and check their symptoms.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Th-thank you.
We were in a bind since no one here has any medical knowledge...

Name: Beretta
Text:
Don't thank me. I'm just doing this for my samples.
Besides, the adventurer is the one doing the hard work.

Name: Beretta
Text: Well? You heard me. Get moving.

Name: Beretta
Text: You brought back what you could, at least. Hand it over.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Even monster carcasses can be medicine if you know the way.
Not that a simpleton like you would have the faintest clue.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Beretta crafts the medicine without hesitation.
Is there anything she hasn't mastered?)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: These people have injuries in every place imaginable.

Name: Beretta
Text:
The more I look, the more humans confuse me.
Just like your own unstable condition.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Ooh... Such remarkable skill.
But... are these ingredients really safe?

Name: Xavyer
Text: I saw the adventurer carrying an antenna earlier—

Name: Urgent Shout
Text:
<Yellow>Master Xavyer!</>
<Yellow>Someone—someone’s dead!</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Sounds like there’s a trouble waiting to happen.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
...Haha, don't mind him.
That boy’s hobby is playing pranks on people.

Name: Beretta
Text: If you say so.

Name: Beretta
Text: Anyway, we got them here, [Player]. Our job is done.

Name: Beretta
Text: I’m concerned about your condition, but it’s not like you’ll collapse right this moment.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Stay here if you want.
It’s not like you can reach Xeros right now anyway.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Just take it easy until we meet again.
If I hear anything about Xeros, I’ll let you know.

Name: Beretta
Text: Well, I’m off.

Name: Urgent Shout
Text: <Yellow>I’m serious this time! Master Xavyer!</>

Name: Remy
Text:
Grandpa! Grandpa!
I’m... I’m telling the truth!

Name: Xavyer
Text:
<Red>Someone’s dead</>…?
I must have misheard you.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Tell me this is another one of your pranks.
Do that, and I'll let it slide.

Name: Remy
Text:
But he said I must tell you!
I didn't see it myself, but... it’s real!

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Don't lie to me.
Our militia is out on patrol. How could such a thing... such a thing...

Name: Xavyer
Text:
I knew those scoundrels were crawling all over the hills,
but to dare touch a resident of Hesperia!

Name: Remy
Text: He... he told me to bring you there immediately...

Name: Xavyer
Text: Sigh... I won't believe it until I see it with my own eyes. Lead the way.

Name: Gerald
Text: Looks like it happened less than a few hours ago...

Name: Xavyer
Text: This adventurer is helping us. Continue.

Name: Gerald
Text:
He was struck by a sharp blade,
and bled to death.

Name: Gerald
Text: Sigh... I am sorry, Master Xavyer.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Are there... any other victims?

Name: Gerald
Text:
Three people went out around the estimated time of death.
We haven't found any of them yet.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Hmm... You and your men just returned from chasing those who set fire on the carts.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Let the next group take over for now.
If you go out exhausted, we'll only lose more precious lives.

Name: Gerald
Text: Understood.

Name: Xavyer
Text: I’m sorry to ask, but will you help us with this?

Name: Xavyer
Text: As you’ve seen, we have no real soldiers to spare...

Name: Xavyer
Text: All we have is a small militia and a few scouts, just regular folks protecting each other.

Name: Gerald
Text: The losses we’ve suffered are beyond words.

Name: Gerald
Text:
There’s more than enough evidence that the Ironblood Brigade is behind this,
but... we lack the strength to fight back.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
They've committed the unforgivable.
Selling people for gold...

Name: Xavyer
Text: And to target our own—the residents of Hesperia!

Name: Xavyer
Text: I won't let a single one of them go unpunished.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Not until the bells of vengeance...
ring throughout Hesperia.

Name: Remy
Text: That's our militia's lookout point!

Name: Remy
Text: We can't let them destroy the bridge!

Name: Remy
Text: Huff... puff... Oh, I'm out of breath...

Name: Remy
Text: I ran all the way here... from the village! Whew!

Name: Remy
Text: Master Xavyer said he’s bringing everyone—even the ones who aren't in the militia.

Name: Remy
Text: All the grown-ups are getting ready to move out.

Name: Remy
Text:
I said I’d fight too, but they said kids aren't allowed.
They told me my job is to stay back and keep watch.

Name: Remy
Text:
I’m the fastest one in this village.
I play pranks all the time, but I’ve never been caught!

Name: Remy
Text:
Even if the Brigade shows up, I'm sure I can outrun them.
But now I can't even go scouting alone if the grown-ups aren't around.

Name: Remy
Text: I want my revenge, too.

Name: Remy
Text:
Mom and dad...
They might have been taken by the <Red>Ironblood Brigade</>!

Name: Remy
Text:
Master Xavyer told me they just got lost in the woods and...
and ran into a bear, but…

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Pat the child's shoulder. Tell him that getting hurt would only make his parents sad.)</>

Name: Remy
Text: ...Fine. I’m going home.

Name: Remy
Text:
The grown-ups are on their way here.
You should head down too, Adventurer.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
You’ve cleared the bridge.
That child made it back to the village safely, too.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Thank you. Now we can move forward with the plan.

Name: Xavyer
Text: <Yellow>We must stop their manhunt.</>

Name: Xavyer
Text:
There are traps laid out there.
Too crude for wild beasts, but enough to immobilize a grown man.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
The villagers and I think so, too.
It matches the timing of the Brigade' arrival.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
It’s pure evil...
Even now, they must be setting more of them.

Name: Xavyer
Text: We must go and clear them all out!

Name: Kidnapped Resident
Text: Thank you for saving me... Sob, hic...

Name: Xavyer
Text:
I’m just glad you’re safe.
Are you hurt anywhere?

Name: Kidnapped Resident
Text: I was almost sold off as a slave... Sigh.

Name: Kidnapped Resident
Text:
They kept shouting about how much we were worth, and which noble house to send us to!
They were talking on and on…

Name: Xavyer
Text: What about the others? Were there more victims beside you?

Name: Kidnapped Resident
Text:
I don't think so.
I heard them say we were the <Red>first shipment</>.

Name: Kidnapped Resident
Text: They said the client had certain... requirements.

Name: Kidnapped Resident
Text:
They mentioned <Yellow>they needed a few more to fill the order</>.
To think we were sold as goods...

Name: Xavyer
Text: Did they say where they were going or where they came from?

Name: Xavyer
Text: Their base, perhaps? Or a meeting place?

Name: Kidnapped Resident
Text:
They mentioned they <Yellow>“headed down”</> this way, but I don't remember much else.
Why do you ask?

Name: Xavyer
Text:
We must hunt them down to the end!
Only then will our village truly be at peace.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Have you forgotten how much we’ve suffered because of them?

Name: Xavyer
Text:
More of our people were killed by the Brigade
than by the hardships of our wandering years.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
The militia, the training...
All of it was because of those scoundrels!

Name: Kidnapped Resident
Text:
You're right.
But you aren't thinking of going yourself—

Name: Xavyer
Text:
The militia will be here soon.
They'll escort you back, so get some rest.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
We should hurry, Adventurer.
Tell me when you are ready.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Now, let’s move.

Name: Xavyer
Text: …Time is short. I’ll explain as we go.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Follow me.

Name: Calm Scout
Text: Master Xavier! It’s been a while.

Name: Serene Scout
Text: What brings you all the way out here?

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Seeing your faces... I think I understand now.
Why this tragedy happened...

Name: Xavyer
Text: Urgh! Damn blood pressure—

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Explain the situation for Xavyer as he clutches the back of his neck.)</>

Name: Calm Scout
Text: To be honest, we are stretched thin.

Name: Calm Scout
Text:
We were focusing our defense on the <Red>Kiguru</>,
so we had to shift our forces away from this path.

Name: Serene Scout
Text: It seems the Ironblood Brigade slipped through while our guard was down.

Name: Calm Scout
Text: We are sorry... This is all our fault.

Name: Serene Scout
Text: Ugh... How can we ever face the victims and their families...

Name: Xavyer
Text: No, don’t blame yourselves.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
The Kiguru raids have been frequent lately.
We all know what this land is like.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
No one said this was your fault.
Just fulfill your duties, like you have done so far!

Name: Calm Scout
Text: ...Yes, sir!

Name: Serene Scout
Text: Understood, sir!

Name: Xavyer
Text:
It’s difficult times, and we have the Kiguru to deal with…
I must go to the outpost and ask.

Name: Xavyer
Text: The barricade has been smashed.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
There must have been a fierce battle here.
Usually, the Kiguru don't venture this far down.

Name: Xavyer
Text: I should at least do some quick repairs.

Name: Xavyer
Text: That should hold for now.

Name: Xavyer
Text: The commotion nearby is relentless.

Name: Xavyer
Text: We must move.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
The situation is graver than I thought.
First, these monsters—

Name: Panicked Scout’s Shout
Text: <Yellow>Do not fall back!</>

Name: Xavyer
Text:
The front of the outpost is no longer safe!
Please, help the scouts!
We watched the Kiguru flee and quietly cleared the area.

Name: Xavyer
Text: <Orange>Alayn</>, I'm glad you're safe.

Name: Alayn
Text: Master Xavyer! You’ve come all the way here in person?

Name: Xavyer
Text: Don't worry. I’ve made it this far safely, thanks to this adventurer.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Since when did this post become a war base?
It was meant to be a makeshift lookout post.

Name: Alayn
Text: It’s the <Red>Kigurus</>, as you can see.

Name: Alayn
Text:
They’re rushing down the mountain like they're being hunted.
They’re terrified, yet more aggressive than ever...

Name: Xavyer
Text: Why didn't you report this sooner?

Name: Xavyer
Text:
No, never mind.
We wouldn't have had enough men to send anyway.

Name: Alayn
Text:
What do you mean?
We have the militia back at the village.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(As Alayn hears about the murder, his face seems to turn grim…)</>

Name: Alayn
Text: So those rumors were true... They finally did it!

Name: Xavyer
Text: Rumors? What are you talking about?

Name: Alayn
Text: That Frantia and the Ironblood Brigade—

Name: Shouts from Outside
Text: <Yellow>Look! They are coming down again?</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Something seems to be moving from the Hallowed Mountain.)</>

Name: Alayn
Text:
Something’s not right.
They’re constantly moving up and down the slopes.

Name: Alayn
Text:
Our supplies are running low...
I don't know how much longer we can hold out.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
This is dire.
Since when did the Kiguru begin to leave the Hallowed Mountain?

Name: Alayn
Text: …I have no excuse.

Name: Xavyer
Text: We must act before they move.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Adventurer, will you aid us?

Name: Alayn
Text: Thank you!

Name: Alayn
Text: And Master Xavyer, please, go back to the outpost.

Name: Alayn
Text:
We’re out of medicine here.
It would be a disaster if you are wounded.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Cease your fretting!
I can find a place to rest on my own.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Sigh... I suppose I should at least pretend to rest.
I’ll wait in the outpost. I leave the rest to you.

Name: Alayn
Text: Is that all?

Name: Alayn
Text:
At least they aren't completely broken.
Small mercies, I suppose...

Name: Alayn
Text: Master Xavyer spends a fortune for the scouts.

Name: Alayn
Text:
We should be more frugal for the sake of the village, if nothing else.
I don't know why the Kigurus are acting up like this.

Name: Alayn
Text: Oh, please put the ones in good condition back into the crate!

Name: Alayn
Text: Now, what was I saying... Ah, I remember.

Name: Alayn
Text:
There is a <Orange>gate</> to the southwest of the Hallowed Mountain.
It sits right on the border of Frantia...

Name: Alayn
Text: Sometimes we pick up some news from Frantia.

Name: Alayn
Text: Their scouts are always roaming around, after all.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Frantia...
What do they have to do with the Ironblood Brigade?

Name: Alayn
Text:
They say Frantia is pulling the strings.
The Brigade has become Frantia's attack dogs.

Name: Alayn
Text:
If those thugs want to come down here,
they have to pass through the Frantia Gate.

Name: Xavyer
Text: So, you’re saying <Red>Frantia is turning a blind eye</>…

Name: Xavyer
Text: Cough! Cough!

Name: Xavyer
Text: <Yellow>Anyway, I must demand an explanation from Frantia at once.</>

Name: Alayn
Text: But we should wait until we have solid proof-

Name: Xavyer
Text:
More people may lose their life!
How can I just sit here and do nothing?

Name: Alayn
Text: …Please, think of your health!

Name: Alayn
Text:
Even with the adventurer's help,
you'll only be a burden in this state.

Name: Alayn
Text: You can’t even hold a blade.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
I am only going to ask a few questions.
What’s with this needless fretting?

Name: Xavyer
Text: Do you think I can't handle a simple slope?

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Our journey ends here.
I am grateful for your help.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Is that the Frantia Gate?
I should look for Xavyer around here.)</>

Name: Xavyer
Text: ...You followed me all this way?

Name: Xavyer
Text: Enough. I won't change my mind, so turn back.

Name: Alayn
Text: Don't you see how much the scouts are worried?

Name: Alayn
Text: What happens to the village if something happens to you?

Name: Xavyer
Text: The scouts and the defense force are there. What is there to worry about?

Name: Alayn
Text: No, that’s not what I meant…

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This argument won't end anytime soon... I should give them a moment.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Still no word from Xeros.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It’d be better if at least one of us stays put…)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I just got back from the Tower. I'll wait a bit longer.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Ugh! Is this another vision?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Deep breath... Focus. I need to get back.)</>

Name: Alayn
Text: Fine! If you won't budge, let’s try this.

Name: Alayn
Text:
The gate isn't far from here,
but we don't know what might happen on the way...

Name: Alayn
Text: Prove to me that you have the strength to run back to this outpost in an emergency!

Name: Alayn
Text:
Prove it, and I'll let you go.
It’s this, or nothing. That’s my final word.

Name: Xavyer
Text: ...I was slaying monsters before you were even born.

Name: Alayn
Text: Then we’ll use the adventurer as our benchmark.

Name: Alayn
Text: There are still some supplies and weapons we couldn't recover.

Name: Alayn
Text: If you find them all before the adventurer finishes clearing the Kigurus, I'll admit defeat.

Name: Alayn
Text:
Master Xavyer, you have to do at least half of what this adventurer does...
No! Half of that half!

Name: Xavyer
Text: You do think so little of me, Alayn.

Name: Alayn
Text: I’m being very generous here, humph!

Name: Xavyer
Text: You thought I was too old for this, didn't you?

Name: Xavyer
Text: I’ve gathered everything nearby. It’s time for you to give up.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Maybe I should have tried harder.)</>

Name: Alayn
Text: Fine. You would’ve found a way to go anyway.

Name: Alayn
Text: Sneaking past us, or following the waterways at night...

Name: Alayn
Text: Sigh. Adventurer... Please, take care of him for me.

Name: Alayn
Text:
He talks big about his glory days,
but things are different now.

Name: Alayn
Text: Cross this bridge and head through the Adamant Ascent, and you'll reach the <Blue>Frantia Gate</>.

Name: Alayn
Text: Just ask what you need and come straight back. Do you hear me?

Name: Xavyer
Text:
You worry too much.
We'll be back soon, so keep the outpost in order.

Name: Xavyer
Text: It's a long way to the gate.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
My legs still work, so don't worry.
I'll pick up the pace.

Name: Didier
Text: What is it? Who are you people?

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Frantian uniforms.
Are you with the <Orange>Border Guard</>?

Name: Didier
Text:
You tell me who you are first.
Though you look like nothing more than drifters loitering near the Hallowed Mountain.

Name: Xavyer
Text: ...Is that how you speak to those who helped clear the Incursion?

Name: Didier
Text: That’s your business—no, your meddling.

Name: Didier
Text:
Did we ask for help?
You just picked off a few stragglers after it was already over.

Name: Didier
Text:
If you're done talking, go home.
This is a dangerous ‘Operation Area.’

Name: Xavyer
Text: If you are indeed a soldier of Frantia, I have one question.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Is it true that you are doing nothing to stop the Ironblood Brigade?

Name: Didier
Text: Huh? What is this man talking about?

Name: Didier
Text:
Stopping them? How should I know?
Maybe my Captain does.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Then can you take me to this Captain of yours?

Name: Didier
Text:
Well, why should I?
I'm busy enough as it is.

Name: Didier
Text: Well, if I finish my mission early, I might feel a bit more generous.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Lead the way.

Name: Didier
Text: Didn't you hear me? I'm busy.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
I mean, to your next operation area.
I will help you complete your mission.

Name: Didier
Text:
Ha, haha! What an enthusiastic old man.
Fine, then follow me.

Name: Xavyer
Text: This is far from pleasant, but I can bear with it.

Name: Xavyer
Text: <Yellow>For the sake of Hesperia... I will do anything.</>

Name: Xavyer
Text: Sigh... Let us move.

Name: Xavyer
Text: What is it we must do here?

Name: Didier
Text:
What do you think?
We need to thin them out so they don't block the path.

Name: Didier
Text: It's an extermination. Make sure you do a clean job.

Name: Didier
Text:
Must have cost you a fortune, eh?
I mean, that mercenary.

Name: Didier
Text: Looks like a warrior who's seen a fair share of fights.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Don’t say that.
The adventurer is helping us out of pure kindness.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Pay him no mind.
He is only looking for a fight.

Name: Didier
Text:
Well... I’ll have plenty of time to watch.
The mission isn't over yet.

Name: Xavyer
Text: There is more?

Name: Didier
Text: You really are desperate, aren't you?

Name: Didier
Text:
I can't file a report until the mission is fully complete.
The Captain is a busy man.

Name: Didier
Text: I can’t bear to see him before then! That's how it is.

Name: Didier
Text: Now, the next spot is in front of the gate. Don't mess it up.

Name: Xavyer
Text: ...We won’t.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
I am sorry for taking up so much of your time.
If this offends you, I will find another way.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Thank you once again. I’m counting on you.

Name: Didier
Text: The objective of this mission is to <Yellow>“maintain proper balance</>.”

Name: Didier
Text: To control the bee population, we must thin out their numbers, shouldn't we?

Name: Didier
Text:
I mean, you need to clear the hives as well.
I thought you would figure that out yourself.

Name: Didier
Text: Only then will we see the end of this mission.

Name: Xavyer
Text: It's a relief the bees didn't swarm us for touching their hives.

Name: Xavyer
Text: I believe we can tell him we're finished now...

Name: Xavyer
Text:
If he tries to treat us like errand boys again, I will not have it.
I've wasted enough time.

Name: Xavyer
Text: If we wait in the front, the Captain is bound to show up eventually.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
We could always ask another soldier instead of him.
Don’t you think so?

Name: Xavyer
Text: Let’s go speak with him first.

Name: Didier
Text: I saw you two running around.

Name: Didier
Text:
I suppose you’ve earned a tiny bit of credit.
I'll put your names in the report.

Name: Didier
Text: And you, mercenary.

Name: Didier
Text:
Which outfit are you with?
You’ve got some decent moves.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I do not answer, paying no heed to his curiosity.)</>

Name: Xavyer
Text: Take us to the Captain as promised.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
I trust you won’t tarnish your country’s name by going back on your word.
We are right at the threshold. Stop stalling.

Name: Didier
Text: Quite a lot of pride you've got there.

Name: Didier
Text: A mission report must be filed swiftly.

Name: Didier
Text: Since the job is done, I'm headed back to the gate.

Name: Didier
Text:
You wanted to see the Captain?
Fine. Let's move before I change my mind.

Name: Solider on Guard Duty
Text: Is it time for the next shift already?

Name: Didier
Text:
Still half-asleep, are you?
It's nowhere near a time for that.

Name: Solider on Guard Duty
Text: Huh? Ah, it's just you, Didier.

Name: Solider on Guard Duty
Text:
Were you not sent on a field mission? What are you doing here?
And who are these people behind you?

Name: Didier
Text:
They’re with me, so no need for an inspection.
Just let them in for a moment.

Name: Didier
Text: Where is the Captain?

Name: Solider on Guard Duty
Text: <Orange>Captain Leonard</>? He’s not here.

Name: Solider on Guard Duty
Text:
He went inland on an official business.
No idea when he'll be back.

Name: Solider on Guard Duty
Text: I can’t exactly file an emergency report just because you brought two outsiders.

Name: Didier
Text:
Looks like you’ll have to wait.
I can't escort you across the border.

Name: Xavyer
Text: More waiting?!

Name: Didier
Text: Since you've been so helpful, I’ll put in a good word for you once he returns.

Name: Didier
Text:
Of course, if he kicks you out after hearing it, that's on you.
Understood?

Name: Didier
Text: Stay put and try not to cause trouble.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
...This place seems to be flourishing,
doesn’t it?

Name: Xavyer
Text:
It’s hard to believe we live on the same land.
I’m sure they get support from their capital, but still...

Name: Xavyer
Text:
To have all this much food piled up like this.
How is this possible?

Name: Xavyer
Text: The people of Hesperia struggle just to find their next meal.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Not just meals.
It’s a daily struggle just to survive.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Even a small portion of what they have would last us for days...

Name: Didier
Text:
What? Interested in the Guard now?
You've certainly looked around thoroughly.

Name: Didier
Text:
Our supplies from the capital are more than plenty.
Why not volunteer for the Guard yourself?

Name: Didier
Text: What a waste. You could do so much more than just chasing coin.

Name: Didier
Text: But then again, you might change your mind after seeing our other facilities.

Name: Didier
Text: For instance... do you see that training golem over there?

Name: Didier
Text:
It’s impossible to break with ordinary strength.
A true testament to Frantia’s superior technology.

Name: Didier
Text: Of course, if you could actually break it, I’d eat my words.

Name: Didier
Text:
But a mercenary is just a mercenary.
I may have spoken highly of you, but that’s all you are, isn't it?

Name: Xavyer
Text: Don't fall for such a shallow provocation, adventurer.

Name: Xavyer
Text: He’s just playing tricks because the Captain hasn't arrived despite all his big talk.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
If that is what you wish...
Just don't overdo it.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Why are you silent now?
You're the one who kept provoking...

Name: Didier
Text:
Even the Guard could barely leave a scratch...
To think you’d completely demolish a modified golem...

Name: Didier
Text: A-Ahem.

Name: Didier
Text:
The Captain is on his way.
Wait here a moment.

Name: Didier
Text: He has finally entered the gate.

Name: Didier
Text:
He said he’ll see you.
Get going, quickly.

Name: Leonard
Text: I heard you were looking for the commanding officer. What is it?

Name: Xavyer
Text: I come from Hesperia, a village southeast of the ridge.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
The <Red>Ironblood Brigade</> is roaming the entire region, “hunting” people.
What exactly are you doing about it?

Name: Xavyer
Text: I have never once seen your men lift a finger to stop them.

Name: Leonard
Text: Our priority is to carry out the missions handed down from our superiors.

Name: Leonard
Text:
Unless the Ironblood Brigade takes hostile action against us,
we cannot deploy our soldiers.

Name: Xavyer
Text: So the rumors were true after all.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
I heard <Yellow>Frantia was covering for the Ironblood Brigade</>.
You're all in this together.

Name: Leonard
Text: <Red>Do you intend to insult us with such baseless slander?</>

Name: Leonard
Text:
We are merely following directives from above to take no special action.
Nothing more, nothing less.

Name: Leonard
Text: If they harm Frantia, new orders will be issued—

Name: Xavyer
Text:
<Yellow>The soldiers here don't know anything.</>
<Yellow>They just do as they’re told.</>

Name: Xavyer
Text: <Yellow>But it means your superiors are letting them roam free on purpose!</>

Name: Xavyer
Text: Do you have any idea how many people are left unprotected, including those in Hesperia?

Name: Leonard
Text: If we are finished here, I suggest you leave.

Name: Xavyer
Text: What?!

Name: Xavyer
Text: Why, you... you dense, ignorant fools!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I’m worried about Xavyer’s blood pressure...)</>

Name: Leonard
Text: It would be troublesome if someone were to lose consciousness in front of the gate.

Name: Leonard
Text: There are no protocol for dealing with outsiders, not to mention our own people—

Name: Xavyer
Text: Stop. I’m sick of hearing about your protocols, directives, and superiors.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Your message is clear that you won't do a thing.
Go back to your 'great missions' then!

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Adventurer, it seems we must handle this ourselves.
Let's plan our next move elsewhere.

Name: Leonard
Text: North is dangerous. You'd best take the long way around.

Name: Xavyer
Text: ...My sincerest thanks! Hah!

Name: Xavyer
Text:
If you hadn't been with me,
I might have struck that garrison captain myself.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
No, perhaps I would have collapsed from sheer rage first.
Thank you for looking out for me.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
Since it's come to this...
Our only choice is to find where the Ironblood Brigade is ourselves.

Name: Xavyer
Text: Then we’ll mobilize the defense force and the scouts...

Name: Xavyer
Text: Huff... puff...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You tell him he looks like he needs to rest immediately.)</>

Name: Xavyer
Text: I can hold on... I have to... The villagers...

Name: Xavyer
Text: Whew... huff... Then please, just handle the scouting for me.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
I'm sorry for leaning on you...
I'll wait for word at the outpost.

Name: Alayn
Text: …Master Xavyer didn't catch on, did he?

Name: Alayn
Text:
I'm glad I cleared the path back to the outpost.
I made sure to remove any immediate threats on the way.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Alayn and the other scouts from the outpost watch you with anxious eyes.)</>

Name: Alayn
Text:
I'm sorry for following you in secret.
I was just too worried about Xavyer...

Name: Alayn
Text:
It's NOT because I don't trust you, adventurer.
Really!

Name: Alayn
Text: I’ll take that stubborn old man back safely now, so you can count on me.

Name: Alayn
Text:
It seems things didn't go so well with the Frantians,
right?

Name: Alayn
Text: I figured as much, so I’ve prepared a new backup plan!

Name: Alayn
Text:
I heard those Ironblood Brigade thugs set traps, right?
I was so furious when I heard that.

Name: Alayn
Text:
So we brought some of our own.
Let them get a taste of their own medicine too.

Name: Alayn
Text: Our next task is to expand our surveillance network!

Name: Alayn
Text: We’re going to advance up to this hill to monitor a much larger area.

Name: Alayn
Text:
Want to come up and see for yourself?
I’ve already done most of the prep work, so there isn't much for you to do.

Name: Alayn
Text: I’m going to set up makeshift tents over here and there.

Name: Alayn
Text:
From the outpost, our view was blocked by the Hallowed Mountain,
but here, the sightline is perfectly clear.

Name: Alayn
Text: Well, it's not like this is Frantian territory...

Name: Alayn
Text:
The <Blue>Forsaken Land</> doesn’t really belong to anyone, right?
We’re just putting them to good use.

Name: Alayn
Text: Hmm, this should be enough.

Name: Alayn
Text:
All that’s left is the center of the hill...
But I’ve already decided what to do with that spot.

Name: Alayn
Text: We’re going to use it as a training ground.

Name: Alayn
Text: The Hesperia Defense Force and the scouts are all itching for a fight.

Name: Alayn
Text: We can't afford to slack off, even in a new scouting area.

Name: Alayn
Text: Since we're on the subject, would you like to join us, adventurer?

Name: Alayn
Text: <Yellow>Everyone, gather 'round! The adventurer is going to show us how it's done!</>
You show off your skills while clearing out nearby monsters with the scouts.

Name: Alayn
Text:
That was a huge help.
Now, we should prepare a separate plan for man-to-man combat—

Name: Rough Voice
Text: <Red>Hey! What do you think you’re doing here!</>

Name: Alayn
Text: Who's there?!

Name: Alayn
Text: That expression is terrifying…

Name: Alayn
Text:
But the scouts can't just ignore a situation like this!
I'll go check who it is.

Name: A Furious Person
Text: The noise is unbearable.

Name: A Furious Person
Text:
What on earth are you doing here!
There's a limit to your meddling.

Name: Alayn
Text:
Wait... did you climb up the cliff?
Your, uh, physical strength must be incredible.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(That look says, “What’s with all the fuss?”)</>

Name: A Furious Person
Text: This is the mission area of the <Orange>“Knights of the Frostwind.”</>

Name: Lena
Text: And I am Grand Master <Orange>Lena</>.

Name: Alayn
Text:
What? Knights?
What kind of knights would be here—

Name: Lena
Text:
If this noise continues, I will have no choice but to disperse your group.
I ask for your full cooperation.

Name: Alayn
Text: …W-What?

Name: Alayn
Text: Um, we’re the Hesperia Scouts.

Name: Alayn
Text: And this is the adventurer helping us.

Name: Alayn
Text:
We’re sorry if we disturbed you, but...
we have our reasons.

Name: Alayn
Text: We’re here to make the Ironblood Brigade pay for what they’ve done!

Name: Lena
Text: The Ironblood Brigade... you say?

Name: Alayn
Text:
Yes! Those villains!
Why else would we come all the way out here?

Name: Lena
Text:
We should head down and talk.
High ground increases the risk of enemy exposure.
Alayn explained the damage caused by the Ironblood Brigade.

Name: Lena
Text: It’s not much different from what we’ve identified.

Name: Lena
Text:
<Yellow>They kidnap people at random and trade them like goods.</>
<Yellow>They’ll stop at nothing to get what they’re after.</>

Name: Lena
Text: They call it <Red>“Human Hunting”</> and feel not a shred of guilt...

Name: Lena
Text: I understand why you're taking action.

Name: Lena
Text:
However, I cannot recommend crossing this point.
It’s more than ordinary people can handle.

Name: Alayn
Text:
We can do it too.
We’ll do anything for revenge!

Name: Lena
Text: If you insist on being stubborn, I’ll have to subdue you for a moment—

Name: Alayn
Text: Honestly! I know we don’t stand a chance against them in man-to-man combat.

Name: Alayn
Text: That’s why we at least set traps along the paths!

Name: Lena
Text:
Anti-personnel traps, you mean.
We’ve found a few of them ourselves.

Name: Lena
Text: And what effect do those have on your operations?

Name: Alayn
Text:
If they get caught, we’ll squeeze every bit of information out of them.
Then we’ll come up with a new strategy!

Name: Lena
Text: You’re naive.

Name: Lena
Text: Those vile criminals won't open their mouths just from a bit of torture.

Name: Lena
Text:
Besides, if you don't check the traps immediately, they’ll find a way to escape.
You can't stay here forever.

Name: Alayn
Text: Well... that’s true, but...

Name: Lena
Text: Will you follow me for a moment?

Name: Alayn
Text: Wow, it really was located right under that hill.

Name: Alayn
Text:
If you can climb that rock wall so easily...
You must be incredibly skilled.

Name: Lena
Text: I could easily handle several Hesperia scouts at once.

Name: Lena
Text: I’ve spent years repeating training and actual combats.

Name: Alayn
Text: Ahem... So, your point is…?

Name: Lena
Text: Since I’ve helped you, I’d like to be compensated fairly in return.

Name: Alayn
Text: What? We never asked you to do that—

Name: Lena
Text:
What I want is for you to return to your village.
Do not try to fight them.

Name: Alayn
Text: Hesperia will hunt them until the very end.

Name: Lena
Text: ...If you persist, I will block this area off to stop you.

Name: Alayn
Text:
How can you be so unreasonable?!
Frantians are all the same.

Name: Alayn
Text:
You pretend to care while stopping us from doing anything,
and the Gate Guard says they don't know anything because they're just following orders.

Name: Alayn
Text: If you're going to be like this, just withdraw everyone from the Forsaken Land!

Name: Lena
Text:
Wait, just a moment.
What did you say about the Gate Guard?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain everything that happened at the Frantia Gate.)</>

Name: Lena
Text: ...I apologize on their behalf.

Name: Alayn
Text: N-No... It's not like you're the one who needs to apologize.

Name: Lena
Text:
It is not wrong for soldiers to follow military orders.
However, there are <Yellow>principles that any human being should rightfully follow</>.

Name: Lena
Text: For instance, <Yellow>the will to use one's strength for the weak</>.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Lena's eyes seem to hold something more than just justice.)</>

Name: Lena
Text: The Knights of the Frostwind are a group of those who were exiled for trying to uphold those very principles.

Name: Lena
Text:
That is why the Gate Guard’s attitude is even more disappointing.
They surely must know the situation.

Name: Lena
Text:
The scandals between Frantia’s high-ranking officials and the Ironblood Brigade are widely known.
They they seem to have no sense of shame...?

Name: Lena
Text:
Now I know what must be done.
Everyone, will you listen to the operation I have in mind?

Name: Alayn
Text: Well... I suppose.

Name: Lena
Text: This way, please.

Name: Alayn
Text: If it's just <Yellow>“Scouts, you should go home</>,” I'm not interested.

Name: Lena
Text:
Judging by your resolve…
You will likely stay regardless of my warning.

Name: Lena
Text: In that case, cooperation would be the better option.

Name: Alayn
Text: Cooperation?

Name: Lena
Text:
I have given up any hope that the Gate Guard will step in.
There is no longer any reason to wait.

Name: Lena
Text: We have already identified the Ironblood Brigade’s stronghold.

Name: Lena
Text:
Once our forces are assembled, we will strike the enemy camp.
We will wipe out the Brigade for good.

Name: Lena
Text: On the honor of our Knights.

Name: Alayn
Text:
You should’ve said that from the start!
So, what's the plan for our scouts?

Name: Lena
Text: I need you to strictly monitor this side path and the trail leading to the Hallowed Mountain.

Name: Lena
Text:
Some will try to flee to plot their next move.
Capture them, but keep them alive.

Name: Alayn
Text: …We can certainly handle that!

Name: Lena
Text: Then I shall leave the rear in Hesperia's hands.

Name: Lena
Text: Adventurer, what will you do?

Name: Alayn
Text:
This person wiped out an entire Kiguru tribe alone.
This skill won't fall behind the Knights at all, you know.

Name: Lena
Text: Then, I’ll leave our rear in your capable hands.

Name: Alayn
Text:
Let's do this!
Adventurer, you have to come back alive, okay?

Name: Lena
Text: I will explain the infiltration operation.

Name: Lena
Text: Do you want to know why we haven’t acted until now?

Name: Lena
Text: Geographically, this location is extremely vulnerable.

Name: Lena
Text: We must deal with the Kiguru and local beasts while blockading the Ironblood Brigade.

Name: Lena
Text:
It would have been easier if the Gate Guard had helped,
but that would have spread their forces thin, wouldn't it?

Name: Lena
Text:
If their border defenses weakened,
it would bring danger to our homeland.

Name: Lena
Text:
That is why we chose to hold this pass for now.
It’s why we haven't been able to wipe out the Brigade yet.

Name: Lena
Text: It is only after the situation has worsened that we are forced to change our tactics.

Name: Lena
Text:
Now, it is time to discuss the operation.
I’ll explain using the map.

Name: Lena
Text:
The Ironblood Brigade is stationed…
…in the old city ruins on the Hill of Grief.
ItemDesc:
A sketch of worn buildings and narrow paths atop the Hill of Grief.
It looks like it was drawn firsthand from the Hallowed Obsidian Mountain.

Name: Lena
Text:
They store everything they’ve seized through their illegal activities there.
The victims are also dragged to that place.

Name: Lena
Text: Fortunately, no other exits have been identified besides the main gate.

Name: Lena
Text:
To find an escape route, they would have to pass through the Hallowed Mountain.
Though, I intend to give them no time for that.

Name: Lena
Text: Before we set out, I must see what you're capable of.

Name: Lena
Text:
This is to determine your role in the operation.
Please wait in the center of the camp.

Name: Lena
Text: Give it your all!

Name: Lena
Text: You possess exceptional talent in many areas.

Name: Lena
Text:
Your prowess has been proven.
Now, I must determine how to best utilize your specific combat tendencies.

Name: Lena
Text: I have a brief task to gauge your compatibility for this operation.

Name: Lena
Text:
Protect your allies and wipe out the enemy.
I will be watching your movements.

Name: Lena
Text: It seems we’ve finished here.

Name: Lena
Text: Thanks to your swift work, the knights are gathering at the rally point.

Name: Lena
Text:
The threat in this area has diminished,
but the possibility of the <Red>Kiguru</> descending from the Hallowed Mountain remains.

Name: Lena
Text: Wouldn't it be wise to take minimum precautions along their path?

Name: Lena
Text:
Take this <Blue>Aether Detonator</>.
It was crafted in Frantia.

Name: Lena
Text:
Lethal explosives are already buried beneath the ground.
This detonator will serve as the trigger.

Name: Lena
Text: It is designed to activate automatically when it detects simultaneous biological movement.

Name: Lena
Text: Take it and place it in a suitable spot,

Name: Lena
Text: then rejoin the main force.

Name: Lena
Text: Knights of the Frostwind!

Name: Lena
Text:
We know better than anyone.
Countless sacrifices have been caused by the Ironblood Brigade.

Name: Lena
Text: Shall we stand by and watch these hills fall into chaos?

Name: Lena
Text: Condemn the wicked! Uoooooh!

Name: Lena
Text: Will you forsake your chivalry, or will you stand with the weak?

Name: Knights of the Frostwind
Text: Give us your orders!

Name: Lena
Text: <Yellow>Those without honor!</>

Name: Knights of the Frostwind
Text: <Yellow>Shall not draw his sword!</>

Name: Lena
Text: Move out!

Name: Lena
Text:
Most of the knights are engaged in local skirmishes.
Only you and I are left for this task.

Name: Lena
Text: As soon as you are ready—

Name: A Distant Explosion
Text: <Red>KABOOM!</>

Name: Lena
Text: ...It seems the Aether Detonator activated right on time.

Name: Lena
Text: Something has clearly happened at the Hallowed Obsidian Mountain. We must finish this now.

Name: Lena
Text: We’ll break through!

Name: Ironblood Brigade Leader
Text: <Red>So you're the one who trashed my beautiful “marketplace?”</>

Name: Ironblood Brigade Leader
Text: <Red>I'll take that head of yours and sell it as a trophy!</>

Name: Ironblood Brigade Leader
Text:
<Red>I, the leader, will carve your body into little pieces myself.
So look forward to it!</>

As the subordinates retreated upon hearing their leader's scream,
Lena quickly entered the inner castle.

Name: Lena
Text: How did things go?

Name: Lena
Text:
The rest are likely hiding inside the buildings.
We should pursue them immediately, but... *sigh.*

Name: Lena
Text: The Knights have taken heavy casualties. This is a difficult situation.

Name: Lena
Text: For now, I'll gather those who can still move—

Name: Kiguru Warrior
Text: <Red>Grrr... Graaaaaagh!</>

Name: Lena
Text:
The Kiguru are swarming this way.
And they’re acting even stranger than usual.

Name: Lena
Text: Adventurer, can you buy us a little more time?

Name: Lena
Text: I’m leaving the ones here in your hands.

Name: Lena
Text:
You don't need to take them all out.
Just retreat the moment I give the signal.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You made it out of the Hill of Grief...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Kiguru charging in all at once was an unexpected variable.)</>

Name: Lena
Text: ...I’m glad to see you’re safe.

Name: Lena
Text:
As you can see, the Knights have mostly retreated.
Those severely wounded have been moved back to the camp.

Name: Lena
Text: How much do you know about The Kiguru?

Name: Lena
Text: Despite their massive size, they aren't very intelligent.

Name: Lena
Text:
They’ll hesitate in front of high barricades,
or step right onto traps and explosives placed in the open.

Name: Lena
Text:
That doesn't mean they're cowards.
They simply break through whatever is in their way.

Name: Lena
Text:
But did you see that look in their eyes—the fear…?
I told you they were acting strange.

Name: Lena
Text: The Kiguru we just saw were like small animals fleeing in terror.

Name: Lena
Text: The Hallowed Obsidian Mountain is their territory. No predators should be stronger than them here.

Name: Lena
Text:
...We must settle this situation first, regardless.
Please, help with the first aid.

Name: Frantia Scout
Text: Which one of you is Grand Master Lena?!

Name: Lena
Text: If you want answers, state your affiliation first.

Name: Frantia Scout
Text: I... I’m from the Frantia Gate Guard!

Name: Lena
Text: Those who've done nothing... What do they want now?

Name: Lena
Text: I am the Grand Master you’ve been looking for. Be brief.

Name: Frantia Scout
Text:
W-What was that massive explosion over here?
The Captain ordered me to find out...

Name: Lena
Text: No need to know. It’s outside your jurisdiction.

Name: Frantia Scout
Text: W-what?!

Name: Lena
Text:
Go back and tell him exactly that.
Tell them to keep waiting for orders from their superiors as they always do.

Name: Lena
Text: Begone!

Name: Frantia Scout
Text: M-My apologies!

Name: Lena
Text: I wonder if they will ever show a shred of chivalry by their own will.

Name: Lena
Text: I’ve lost all hope for them.

Name: Lena
Text:
But seeing the garrison snooping around,
that explosion must have been impossible to ignore.

Name: Lena
Text: I must organize a search party immediately.

Name: Lena
Text: ...Thank you for stepping forward.

Name: Lena
Text:
I’ll deliver the news to Hesperia myself.
I’ll let them know you are safe as well, adventurer.

Name: Fallen Kiguru
Text: Grrgh... Graaa... Grrrgh...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It can’t even move, let alone attack.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(There are no visible wounds... What happened to it?)</>

Name: Fallen Kiguru
Text: Geekk! Grrrgh…

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The symptoms resemble Etherium poisoning)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(If Etherium exists here as well…)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Paradise Advent used food supplies to spread Etherium before...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You should check around the supplies.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(We dealt with the Paradise Revival cult spreading Etherium…)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(If the poisoning worsens, they’ll lose their minds and attack people.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Better thin them out now.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It seems it has finally stopped breathing.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You must take action to ensure Hesperia and the Knights aren't harmed.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>The Kiguru... they all fled. It couldn’t be that they were too stared, right?)</>

Name: Xeros
Text: I hope I didn't interfere in your fight for no reason.

Name: Xeros
Text:
That one was using dangerous magic.
I acted before I could think.

Name: Xeros
Text:
That’s a relief.
I didn't expect to you to cross into the hills.

Name: Xeros
Text: It seems we both have a lot to discuss.

Name: Xeros
Text: It would be wise to eliminate any variables early.

Name: Xeros
Text:
That magic was unlike anything I've ever seen.
It certainly wasn't modern.

Name: Xeros
Text:
If such a being attacks again...
It will surely interfere with our plans.

Name: Xeros
Text:
He vanished using teleportation, so it will take time to track him.
We might also need to find a mage to help us.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Still, once we find them, it should be over quickly.
They didn't seem strong enough to handle both of us.

Name: Xeros
Text: But it will delay our search for the Captain.

Name: Xeros
Text: What should we do? I’ll follow your lead.

Name: Xeros
Text: Understood. Let’s make the plan over there.

Name: Xeros
Text:
You couldn’t find the Paradise Advent in the tower,
because they’ve already moved outside.

Name: Xeros
Text: They were spotted at the <Blue>Starfall Plateau</>.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Reports say they <Yellow>vanished with a man who looked like a mercenary</>.
As if they used a transport artifact.

Name: Xeros
Text:
I also saw them teleporting in the Aether Ruins too.
I’d say the evidence is solid.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Come to think of it, after you left for the tower,
the Liberator of Knowledge added something.

Name: Xeros
Text: <Yellow>That device isn't omnipotent.</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
It can only transport users to areas…
…with matching Aether wavelengths.

Name: Xeros
Text:
So, it won't take you to unknown places…
…like the Paradise Advent’s Hideout.

Name: Xeros
Text:
We’ll have to search the plateau ourselves.
Let's head east toward the ridge.

Name: Xeros
Text: ...Are you talking about that mage from before?

Name: Xeros
Text: If so, I’ll bring information.

Name: Xeros
Text:
If that man is an ancient magic wielder,
the Liberator of Knowledge must have made contact.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Wait for me at the plateau entrance.
I'll catch up soon.

Name: Beretta
Text: Finding you? Too easy.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Don’t play dumb. You cause trouble everywhere you go.
One quick question and your name pops right up.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Besides that, you’re... different from other humans.
That’s why you leave a trace sometimes.

Name: Beretta
Text: I can track you through the Aether in the air or the Leylines.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Anyway, I didn't come here to chat.
About what I found in the desert and the garden—

Name: Beretta
Text:
Wait. What happened to your body?
You look like a total wreck.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You feel Beretta’s intent stare...)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Did you get a new hobby of tearing yourself apart?
You have severe internal injuries. Get it?

Name: Beretta
Text: I’m not even a doctor. Why do I have to keep seeing you like this?

Name: Beretta
Text:
Fine. What's the point of talking?
It’s not like you’d listen.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Hesperia seemed fine on my way here.
What’s your next move?

Name: Beretta
Text: Good luck making it that far in your condition.

Name: Beretta
Text:
This won’t do. I need to make sure you can still function.
Go fight like you usually do.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Your limbs are fine, at least.
Even if your insides are still twisted.

Name: Beretta
Text: Hmm, this will be a long talk.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Better to sit down for the results, right?
Let’s head into the training center.

Name: Sarabi
Text: Access denied. Access denied.

Name: Sarabi
Text: The Rappie Training Ground is no place for sipping tea and gossiping!

Name: Beretta
Text:
You let all those other people in.
Why not us?

Name: Sarabi
Text: Those humans bought tickets! Tickets!

Name: Sarabi
Text: <Red>No freebies! You buy tickets if you want in!</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Talk about being picky.

Name: Sarabi
Text:
Pay the fee! A fair price!
Naruru has to eat, too!

Name: Beretta
Text:
Typical Naruru, always sharp about profit.
Fine, go get them fast.

Name: Ticket Vendor
Text: Here you go. Two tickets.
ItemDesc:
A small ticket for the Rappie Training Ground. It features a hand-drawn sketch of a Rappie. 
It looks like it was made with painstaking effort.

Name: Ticket Vendor
Text: I can tell by your face you only came to buy this because talking was too much trouble!

Name: Ticket Vendor
Text: Sarabi has the spirit of a merchant. A real merchant.

Name: Ticket Vendor
Text:
She doesn’t even charge much,
but loves to play the part of a big-shot trader.

Name: Ticket Vendor
Text: Honestly, the profit from these barely feeds a single Rappie.

Name: Ticket Vendor
Text: I’d appreciate, appreciate it if you just played along.

Name: Sarabi
Text: Mm, good, good! Tickets confirmed!

Name: Sarabi
Text: You two can stay in our training grounds now.

Name: Beretta
Text: The brewery wasn't this stingy.

Name: Sarabi
Text:
They sell lots of ale! They’re rich!
We are not!

Name: Beretta
Text: Times are tough, then?

Name: Sarabi
Text: Not many guests train their Rappie!

Name: Sarabi
Text:
Rappies are born fast, smart, and kind.
Ranch training is usually enough.

Name: Sarabi
Text: But! We can make them faster! Smarter!

Name: Sarabi
Text: That is what we do here.

Name: Sarabi
Text:
Now, your Rappie, Rappie.
Leave them to us!

Name: Sarabi
Text: You bought tickets! Of course!

Name: Sarabi
Text: Now show us how you ride your Rappie!

Name: Beretta
Text: You seem excited.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Curious about your score?
You seem to have taken good care of that Rappie.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Seeing how passionate they are,
I feel like my own checkup was a bit lazy.

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Yellow>I need new data for a re-examination.</>
Give it your all this time.

Name: Beretta
Text: Impressive results.

Name: Beretta
Text: Both you and your Rappie are top-tier.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Especially your limbs—they actually improve the more you use them.
Resilience alone doesn't explain it.

Name: Beretta
