Text: Maybe I should just keep you by my side and study you properly.

Name: Beretta
Text: Even the Naruru trainers were surprised that your Rappie was way above average.

Name: Beretta
Text: ...So, do you even know the way to the plateau?

Name: Beretta
Text: There are plenty of mercenaries at the training grounds. Ask them at least something before you leave.

Name: Beretta
Text: It’s such a secluded place. Even as a Divine, I know almost nothing about it.

Name: Wandering Mercenary
Text:
<Blue>Starfall Plateau</>?
Haven't heard that name in a while.

Name: Wandering Mercenary
Text: It’s a barren wasteland. No one comes or goes there.

Name: Wandering Mercenary
Text:
Only the locals barely survive there. 
Outsiders? They shouldn’t dare enter. They just freeze to death.

Name: Wandering Mercenary
Text: It’s been years since I heard of anyone heading that way.

Name: Wandering Mercenary
Text: Mercenaries don't even take contracts for that area.

Name: Beretta
Text: So, it's cold enough that they always have to clear away frozen-to-death corpses. Got it.

Name: Beretta
Text: Do you know anything about the terrain or the factions there?

Name: Wandering Mercenary
Text:
It’s Stormkel’s front yard, so there must be a garrison.
That’s all I know.

Name: Wandering Mercenary
Text:
For the kind of inside story you’re asking for,
wouldn’t someone high up—like an <Orange>Archon</>—know?

Name: Wandering Mercenary
Text: They’re the ones sent to watch over that Forsaken Land.

Name: Beretta
Text: The mercenary is right. We’d better head to Babylon.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Stormkel’s Archon...
I don't remember a thing about them.

Name: Beretta
Text: I only saw them once at some event I was forced to attend.

Name: Beretta
Text: Wait. Hear me out before you go.

Name: Beretta
Text: Remember what I’ve been researching?

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Yellow>The record disc you brought from the Barrens.</>
<Yellow>And the Prophet’s book of revelations.</>

Name: Beretta
Text: They both contain info on the <Blue>“Giant’s Tower.”</> That’s what I’ve been looking for.

Name: Beretta
Text: <Yellow>I have to “shut down” that tower, no matter what.</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
It’s been here in <Blue>Elsetia</> since ancient times.
Holding great power beyond measure.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Ordinary people go there just to make a coin.
But what if someone tried to “use” the tower itself?

Name: Beretta
Text: Exactly—you pinpointed what the Paradise Advent wants.

Name: Beretta
Text: They’ve run thousands of experiments to claim the tower as their own.

Name: Beretta
Text:
And they used “humans” as the ingredients.
That’s why they gather so many followers.

Name: Beretta
Text: I told you before. <Yellow>I’m going to stop the Paradise Advent</>.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I need your help.
No one is better suited for this than you—in more ways than one.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Even if our goals differ,
we can still work together for now.

Name: Beretta
Text: Just listen and then decide—

Name: Beretta
Text: Did you just hear that? There was an explosion from the Hallowed Mountain.

Name: Beretta
Text:
What? You should’ve told me if you met an <Red>Apostle</>!
We can’t let him get away. Hurry, follow me.

Name: Beretta
Text: No wonder you looked strangely familiar.

Name: Beretta
Text: You're <Orange>Archon “Lorraine”</> from Frantia, right?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
To think a Divine of Babylon would recognize me.
I'm honored.

Name: Beretta
Text: Enough with the unimpressive nickname.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Should an Archon really be out here?
Without a single guard?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I was a knight decades ago.
I can still protect myself.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
A report came in about the Kiguru.
Apparently, some have gone feral.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
The gate garrison is outside my jurisdiction,
so I had to drag this old body out for an inspection.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She looks perfectly spry...)</>

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Their numbers have grown quite a bit.
I was just busy thinning them out.

Name: Beretta
Text: I guess we took care of the ones that escaped.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Ah, I found them eating these strange stones, so I brought them with me.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Ever seen anything like this?

Name: Lorraine
Text: It has a nice flavor, like it’s made from ripe fruit.

Name: Lorraine
Text: You could easily trick someone into thinking it’s candy.

Name: Beretta
Text: ...This.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
That look tells me you have an idea.
Share what you can.

Name: Beretta
Text:
It’ll take a while to explain properly.
This isn't just about the Kiguru.

Name: Beretta
Text:
And I’m not sure..
…if I can spare the time.

Name: Beretta
Text:
We’re busy gathering information…
…on the Paradise Advent and the plateau.

Name: Lorraine
Text: I can help with the latter.

Name: Lorraine
Text: It’s a secluded area. Even Babylon’s famous figures wouldn’t know much.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Not even a single report reaches me, an Archon of a neighboring country.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Go to the <Orange>Stormkel Manor</> in Babylon.
I’ll write you a formal request for cooperation.

Name: Lorraine
Text: I’m sure an audience with Divine Beretta will settle the rest.

Name: Beretta
Text: Hah... What’s so special about being Divine?

Name: Lorraine
Text: We’re simply exchanging what we need, are we not? Haha.

Name: Beretta
Text: [Player], let’s talk privately.

Name: Beretta
Text: Looks like you’ll get the information you wanted.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I’ll deal with the Archon.
Just finish your business as fast as possible and come back.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Seems you’re done looking for Xeros,
but you said you still “have things to do.”

Name: Beretta
Text: I can't wait forever.

Name: Beretta
Text:
What they want is to take this world into their hands.
A simple, primal desire.

Name: Beretta
Text: Yet, they act like an ordinary religious group on the surface.

Name: Beretta
Text:
If we go public and wait for people’s opinions,
it’ll take months. By then, it’ll be too late.

Name: Beretta
Text: So, I’m going to break the tool they need to achieve their goal.

Name: Beretta
Text: Exactly. I’m going to neutralize the tower.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I can’t do it alone.
That’s why I’m asking you.

Name: Beretta
Text: Think it over and give me an answer when you get back.

Name: Stormkel Soldier
Text: What brings you here?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You ask for directions to the Stormkel Manor.)</>

Name: Stormkel Soldier
Text: It’s northeast of Babylon’s center.

Name: Stormkel Soldier
Text:
Head up toward the Asientet Manor,
turn right, and go straight in.

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text: Are you here to see the Archon?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You hand over Lorraine’s personally handwritten letter.)</>

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text:
I’ll pass the message along,
but the Archon is extremely busy...

Name: Shouting
Text: <Red>Huh? Hey! We’re out of booze!</>

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text: ...Could you pretend you didn't hear that?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What is going on in there?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Shouts are coming from inside, and it’s hard to follow.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Nothing good will come from going in now.)</>

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text: G-Given the situation, the Archon is... heavily occupied with official business.

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text:
Most foreign Archons or Divines…
…only communicate with us in writing...

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text:
Y-Yes.
Of course, it’s a different story if they visit in person—

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A Divine with strong influence over the Stormkel Manor... I should find Ragnar.)</>

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text: Um... Adventurer?

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text: S-Should I add your name to the audience request list for now?

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text: T-Then I’ll return Archon Lorraine’s handwritten letter to you.

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text: Please have a safe trip back.

Name: Ragnar
Text: It’s been a while. What can I do for you?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Xeros said the Paradise Advent Society took a man who looked like a mercenary
from the Starfall Plateau.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(There is a possibility that that is where their headquarter is.
I must find out.)</>

Tell them about the evidence of the whereabouts of Ingel 
and ask for the Stormkel Manor’s help.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Starfall Plateau is infamous for being one of the harshest regions in the Forsaken Land.

Name: Ragnar
Text: So harsh that only the people from Stormkel can survive there.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
People usually pay little attention to the area.
The Paradise Advent Society seems to have chose that place as their hideout.

Name: Ragnar
Text: I wonder where they are hiding.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
It’s a great strategy to gather intel through the Stormkel Manor.
Although they won’t welcome you empty-handed.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
And don’t even expect official paperwork.
It will take at least a month.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
I don’t know about the Archons… But Eric might help me.
Go ahead to the manor for now.

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text:
You’re the adventurer from before!
Oh, if you want to put your name on the audience request list…

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text:
…The Divine?
Please… Please wait a moment.

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text:
Since the Archon has finished all the scheduled audiences,
the lieutenant will meet with you.

Name: Stormkel Manor Guard
Text: Please head inside, Adventurer.

Name: Stormkel Manor Lieutenant
Text: Are you the one that Ragnar mentioned?

Name: Stormkel Manor Lieutenant
Text: Pleasure to meet you.[player]

Name: Eric
Text:
I am <Orange>Eric</>.
I serve my father, the Archon.

Name: Eric
Text: I was informed of your reasons for coming here by Ragnar…

Name: Eric
Text: But I don’t know if my answer will suffice.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He is taking his time for sure.)</>

Name: Eric
Text: A report came from Verzard Outpost that Paradise Advent Society members have been spotted there.

Name: Eric
Text:
Although it is uncertain if there were mercenaries.
There are way so many mercenary groups and clans, anyway.

Name: Eric
Text: And as you already know, you can find Paradise Advent Society believers anywhere.

Name: Eric
Text:
Our soldiers spotted them while dealing with the Incursion.
Incursions occur quite often near the outpost.

Name: Eric
Text:
I’m not sure.
Incursions occur quite often these days…

Name: Eric
Text:
And they are busy training new recruits at this time of year.
It’s a miracle I’m getting weekly reports.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I don’t have enough evidence to continue with the investigation.)</>

Name: Eric
Text: If you’re that curious, seeing it for yourself might be an option…

Name: Eric
Text:
As it’s an outpost, they do not let just anyone enter.
…They are going to watch you even closely if you’re there to investigate.

Name: Eric
Text:
Mmm… but Ragnar holds you in high regard.
So I will help you this time.

Name: Eric
Text:
This is a recommendation letter affixed with the Archon’s seal.
Take this to <Orange>Commander Marten</>.
ItemDesc: A recommendation letter with the Stormkel Archon’s seal.

Name: Eric
Text:
Of course, this is far too generous a favor.
Don’t turn away when I ask you to repay the favor.

Name: Eric
Text:
Please inform Ragnar as well,
that Stormkel Manor has helped you this much…

Name: Ragnar
Text: Welcome.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Haha, he must have a bit more strict than usual.
He means well, so don’t take it to heart.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
He is just on edge
taking care of things on behalf of his father.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(When I nod my head to show him I understand,
Ragnar puts on a serious expression.)</>

Name: Ragnar
Text: I can finally give you the answer I couldn’t when we first met.

Name: Ragnar
Text: I hope you find Ingel this time.

Name: Ragnar
Text: If anything happens and you need help, just let me know.

Name: Marten
Text: Who are you?

Name: Marten
Text: Mmm… So that’s why you came here.

Name: Marten
Text: I am <Orange>Marten</>, the Commander of the Verzard Outpost.

Name: Marten
Text: I hope we won’t have any trouble between us.

Name: Marten
Text:
I don’t care about your investigation on the Paradise Advent Society or whatever,
I hope that doesn’t get in the way of the recruits’ training.

Name: Marten
Text:
… How about helping us with the training?
It’ll look more natural when you look for intel.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It looks like he has other intentions, but I have no other choice to accept.)</>

Name: Marten
Text:
You catch on quick.
Please take care of the monsters at the snowfield entrance.

Name: Marten
Text: Most of the new recruits run away in fear when they see monsters.

Name: Marten
Text:
I want to court-martial them if I could,
but it is true that more monsters have been appearing recently…

Name: Marten
Text: And you, do you have a radio?

Name: Marten
Text: Great, I’ll keep in touch.
After parting ways with Marten, I arrived at the snowfield entrance to find the soldiers he mentioned.

Name: Trembling Recruit
Text: H-Help!

Name: Trembling Recruit
Text: T-Those monsters took my axe!

Name: Trembling Recruit
Text:
I’m going to get demerits for losing my weapon,
then I’m going to fail my recruit test, and…

Name: Trembling Recruit
Text: Thank you. Thank you so much…!

Name: Cheerful Recruit
Text: You saved my life.

Name: Cheerful Recruit
Text:
I don’t know how to repay you…
Is there anything you need?

Name: Cheerful Recruit
Text: I happen to be from a wealthy family.

Name: Cheerful Recruit
Text:
Paradise Advent Society… I think I heard it from my superior officers!
Just a moment.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The new recruit drew something on the floor with a stick.
It looks exactly like the Paradise Advent Society.)</>
ItemDesc:
A drawing made by a new recruit with a stick.
The hood and tired look confirms that the person’s from the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Cheerful Recruit
Text: Incursions occur frequently near the outpost.

Name: Cheerful Recruit
Text:
They don’t even listen when I tell them to go somewhere else because it’s dangerous.
It’s really strange.

Name: Cheerful Recruit
Text:
Mmm… There might have been some kind of a sign,
or not…

Name: Cheerful Recruit
Text:
Phew, paying attention to all these details…
I’m going to fail the recruit test.

Name: Cheerful Recruit
Text:
But if you happen to see them,
please tell them to be careful.

Name: Marten
Text: Good work, [player].

Name: Marten
Text: Has there been any progress in the investigation?

Name: Marten
Text:
Then how about going to the Geyser Field?
Incursions occur often there as well.

Name: Marten
Text: I’m not finished, [player].

Name: Marten
Text:
It just so happens, we have business there as well.
Could you go there in our place while you conduct your investigation?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I wonder what was on the recommendation letter for them to hold me down like this…)</>

Name: Marten
Text: This recruit test is extremely important.

Name: Marten
Text:
Troop recruitment.
We are in a pinch with the current surge of deserters.

Name: Marten
Text: There’s a limit to how much we can make up for it with new recruits…

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(If deserters join the Paradise Advent Society…
I can’t even imagine the horror.)</>

Name: Marten
Text: But we have to try our best.

Name: Marten
Text: The Verzard Outpost connects the Forsaken Land to Stormkel.

Name: Marten
Text: As a commander, I can’t just leave a strategic outpost undefended.

Name: Marten
Text: Please gather equipment materials for the recruit test from the Geyser Field.

Name: Marten
Text: I need monster hides and bones.

Name: Marten
Text:
Great work.
Did you find what you were looking for?

Name: Marten
Text: Are these traces of the Incursion?

Name: Marten
Text:
The soldiers tell me that believers of the Paradise Advent Society
were spotted where the incursions occured.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Did they cause the Incursion just like at the Giant’s Garden…?
I should investigate further.)</>

Name: Marten
Text:
Do they not fear monsters…?
They sure are strange.

Name: Marten
Text: There’s one final location I’d like you to visit.

Name: Marten
Text:
Black Pillar Cliffs.
Incursions occur whenever we try to train recruits.

Name: Marten
Text: Isn’t it the perfect place to find what you’re looking for?

Name: Marten
Text:
Let me ask you for a favor since you’re going anyway.
Bring back some weapons from the supply storage.

Name: Marten
Text:
The new recruits often lose their weapons.
Even with the demerits.

Name: Marten
Text:
If they go in empty-handed and die…
Phew, the loss in manpower would be critical.

Name: Marten
Text:
Please deliver some weapons when you go there to investigate.
You’ll be doing recruits a great favor.

Name: Supply Storehouse Soldier
Text: These are weapons for new recruits.

Name: Supply Storehouse Soldier
Text: You just have to take it to the place marked on the map.
ItemDesc: The location to place the equipment for the new recruits is marked.

Text: After checking the location marked on the map, I headed there right away.

Name: Deserter
Text: Thank you for your help.

Name: Deserter
Text: We would have been done for if not for you, Adventurer.

Name: Deserter
Text: I was a soldier.

Name: Deserter
Text: …Not anymore, though.
A deserter who thought I came to capture him ambushed me.
After subduing the attacking deserter, I explained everything.

Name: Deserter
Text: I don’t have any plans on returning to the outpost.

Name: Deserter
Text:
…Won’t you pretend you didn’t see me?
I beg of you.

Name: Deserter
Text: Ever since the new commander came, the outpost changed.

Name: Deserter
Text: Despite the difficult tasks, it used to be a pleasant place to be.

Name: Deserter
Text:
…Isn’t it obvious?
<Yellow>Transporting relics to the capital</>.

Name: Deserter
Text:
The Stormkel blacksmiths’ real mission…
It’s not crafting or repairing equipment for adventurers.

Name: Deserter
Text:
They <Yellow>replicate and smuggle relics.</>
Te blacksmiths also collect relics discarded on paper.

Name: Deserter
Text:
And they are delivered by
the soldiers at the outpost.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Could they be connected to Babylon’s Blacksmiths Guild?)</>

Name: Deserter
Text:
Many soldiers died during the transportation.
So many are after the relics…

Name: Deserter
Text: But Marten thinks that’s natural.

Name: Deserter
Text:
In fact, he says that it is an honorable task,
and sends more new recruits out to die.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is this why he is so focused on training new recruits?)</>

Name: Deserter
Text: Do you have any idea how many people are after relics?

Name: Deserter
Text:
I can’t live on like this.
I’m going to join <Orange>Astrid</>.

Name: Deserter
Text:
I’ll explain everything later.
For now, please take out the monsters nearby.

Name: Deserter
Text: Thank you so much, adventurer!

Name: Deserter
Text: Can I ask for one more favor?

Name: Deserter
Text:
Take this to <Orange>Schulmann</> at the hot springs.
He’s done so much for me.
ItemDesc:
A dagger with a Naruru carved on the handle.
It’s a present for Schulmann.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A solemn name for a dagger…)</>

Name: Deserter
Text:
This is a Naruru.
He’s rough, but quite fun to be around.

Name: Deserter
Text:
Please take this to him.
May luck be on your side, Adventurer!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I couldn’t even ask about the Paradise Advent Society.
Maybe I should ask Schulmann.)</>

Name: Schulmann
Text: <Yellow>Are you a deserter too?</>

Name: Schulmann
Text:
That’s good to hear.
Phew, so many people die while deserting.

Name: Schulmann
Text: Everyone is headed that way.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
Oh, Astrid.
From the way people talk, she’s practically a god.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
Whoever comes, it would be better then Martel…
I can’t keep cleaning up these bodies.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
I’ve seen her a few times.
But I don’t know where she went.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
I don’t see very well, you see.
My apologies.

Name: Karl
Text: I heard from Commander Marten.

Name: Karl
Text: I am <Orange>Karl</>, the field commander in charge of the outpost.

Name: Karl
Text: You’re chasing the Paradise Advent Society, right?

Name: Karl
Text: As you can see, the outpost has a sweeping view of the area thanks to its location.

Name: Karl
Text: We are able to see all kinds of people come and go.

Name: Karl
Text:
This is the duty log.
There was something about the Paradise Advent Society.
ItemDesc:
△ ○, XXXX 

- 00:15
 : Three people, who seemed to be believers of the Paradise Advent Society, moved to the stronghold under Lord Astrid’s management 

- 01:50
 : A transport convoy headed toward the Stormkel Gate

- 03:10
 : Incursion occurred
 ※ We’re on standby, as the Incursion is near Lord Astrid’s stronghold
 The stronghold is expected to handle it
 ※ Need to check the route of the transport convoy, which is expected to move at 4 pm

- 03:20
 : End of the Incursion confirmed
 ※ Lord Astrid’s soldiers seem to have taken care of it

- 03:30
 : Confirmed someone who looks to be a believer of the Paradise Advent Society leaving with soldiers from the stronghold under Lord Astrid’s command

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Are the Paradise Advent Society and Astrid working together?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I should find out more about Astrid.)</>

Name: Karl
Text: Is there anything else you want to know?

Name: Karl
Text: Lord Astrid is one of the greatest warriors of Stormkel.

Name: Karl
Text:
She is <Orange>the only sister of High Chieftain Norman</>.
She is staying at the stronghold just ahead.

Name: Karl
Text:
It’s also a place where
soldiers travelling to the Stormkel Gate rest.

Name: Karl
Text:
As you can see, Incursions occur frequently here.
I think the believers of the Paradise Advent Society were also trying to keep away from danger.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Does he not know the truth? He is quite friendly towards the Paradise Advent Society.)</>

Name: Karl
Text: Mmm… If you’re worried, head to the stronghold yourself.

Name: Karl
Text: I will send one of our soldiers with you.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Nothing seems out of place.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(But it’s still worth investigating, so let’s take a look around.)</>

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text: What’s this?
ItemDesc: Stormkel soldiers’ footprints and unknown footprints are jumbled together.

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text: These are from our soldiers… But I’ve never seen these before.

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text: Aren’t these tracks of that Paradise Advent Society you were talking about?

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text: …I see. Let’s go in deeper.
When the outpost soldier approached, Astrid’s soldiers suddenly started attacking.

Name: Karl
Text:
The soldiers suddenly started attacking?
I can’t believe it.

Name: Karl
Text: On top of that, even Quinta…

Name: Karl
Text: …We have to assess the situation properly.

Name: Karl
Text: I need more evidence to file a report to the outpost.

Name: Karl
Text:
Could you please investigate
what’s going on in Lord Astrid’s stronghold?

Name: Karl
Text: This is the map of the stronghold interior.

Name: Karl
Text: The commander’s barrack is in the deepest area.

Name: Karl
Text: That’s where Lord Astrid is staying.

Name: Karl
Text: You have to move in secret, so don’t even think about going there.

Name: Karl
Text: Commander Marten values physical evidence.

Name: Karl
Text: Please find something that I can show him.
To find the evidence Karl mentioned, I headed to Astrid’s stronghold.

Name: Nervous Voice
Text:
That’s right.
Lord Astrid was supposed to be the High Chieftain.

Name: Calm Voice
Text: It’s time for us to move.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: That’s right.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: Lord Astrid is more fitted to be the High Chieftain, not Norman.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: We will help Stormkel stand proper and tall.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text: Even more so if that will lead you to paradise.

Name: Calm Voice
Text:
Thank you…
I’m counting on you guys.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
We will not disappoint you.
Helping people like you is also the duty of the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
If it can contribute to accomplishing this great ideal,
the honor will be hours.

Name: Paradise Advent Prophet
Text:
Just make sure to get the relics and weapons.
The more the merrier.

Name: Karl
Text: I’ve been expecting you.
ItemDesc: A secret letter carried by Astrid’s soldier.

Name: Karl
Text:
…So it’s true that Lord Astrid made a deal with 
the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Karl
Text: I will report this to Commander Marten.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I should also inform this to Ragnar.)</>

When I informed Ragnar that Astrid has joined forces with the Paradise Advent Society,
he asked me to meet him at the outpost.

Name: Karl
Text: Since I can’t leave my post, please deliver this secret letter to Commander Marten.

Name: Marten
Text: I will send a messenger to deliver the secret letter to the Stormkel Gate.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Astrid would do no such thing.
You should know this by now.

Name: Marten
Text: <Red>How can you say that with such concrete evidence right in front of you?!</>

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Give me some time.
I will try to persuade Astrid.

Name: Marten
Text:
I am aware of your relationship with Astrid,
but this is a <Red>treason</>. <Red>Treason</>!

Name: Ragnar
Text:
That’s why I’m taking matters into my own hands.
Astrid is someone who charges head on.

Name: Ragnar
Text: You remember the time she was competing to become the High Chieftain, don’t you?

Name: Ragnar
Text: She also acknowledged Norman as the High Chieftain!

Name: Marten
Text:
How are you going to explain the soldier talking with the Paradise Advent Society?
And what about the secret letter?

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Commander Marten.
Checking whether this is actually her choice comes first.

Name: Marten
Text: Then you are going to have to bring undisputable evidence.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Why?

Name: Marten
Text: Since this has already been reported to the capital!

Name: Ragnar
Text: Then at least buy some time until I come back…

Name: Marten
Text: Ragnar!

Name: Ragnar
Text: <Yellow>This is the first and last favor I will ask of you.</>

Name: Ragnar
Text:
[player], please head to the outpost first.
I will follow you soon.

Name: Karl
Text:
Since I’ve heard everything,
I will wait for further orders.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Thank you, Karl…

Name: Ragnar
Text: I will head to the stronghold with my friend here.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Let’s split up and investigate.
Look into the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
I’ll look into the soldiers.
Let’s keep in touch on the communicator.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Great work, [player].

Name: Ragnar
Text: How did the investigation on the Paradise Advent Society go?

Name: Ragnar
Text:
They sure have their hands in everything.
Just like the Shadow Wolf Clan…

Name: Ragnar
Text: I found out a few things myself.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Astrid’s soldiers have already made up their minds.
It was no use trying to persuade them.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
And it looks like they’ve been preparing this for quite some time.
They even got the Paradise Advent Society involved.

Name: Ragnar
Text: [player], Astrid will soon return to her position.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Let’s take care of this before the traitor comes back.
Wouldn’t that give us enough time to protest?

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Start by burning the weapon crates in the fortress.
Neutralizing them comes first.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Then leave a mark on the crates containing relics,
so that the outpost guards can retrieve them.

Name: Ragnar
Text: And kill every soldier in the way.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
They are violators of military law.
Only death awaits them.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The confidence that never left their face has given way to a heavy expression.)</>

Name: Ragnar
Text:
I’ll deal with the officers.
...There are things I need to hear from them anyway.
A Tesseract thrown by a soldier activated, triggering an Incursion.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Be ready, Astrid will appear soon.

When Astrid, also known as the god of war, appeared,
the air suddenly froze.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
I’ll take this part.
You take the left.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Let me remind you that they are rebels…
Use lethal force if you’re in danger.

Name: Injured Adventurer
Text: Thank you for your help, adventurer.

Name: Injured Adventurer
Text: I was able to reach Vagrant's Repose thanks to you.

Name: Recovered Adventurer
Text: You’re curious about the Vagrant's Repose?

Name: Recovered Adventurer
Text: I’ve only heard of this place, so it’s my first time going there too.

Name: Recovered Adventurer
Text: Just go down there.

Name: Recovered Adventurer
Text: Thank you for your kind words, but I’m waiting for someone.

Name: Xeros
Text: Did the Paradise Advent Society follow us all this way?

Name: Xeros
Text:
They look exhausted…
What happened?

Name: Xeros
Text: <Yellow>You came because many believers have appeared near the Incursion recently,</>

Name: Xeros
Text: <Yellow>only to find they were conspiring a rebellion with someone named Astrid</>?

Name: Xeros
Text: It seems they don’t mind being reckless.

Name: Xeros
Text: It must’ve been hard. You really got dragged into quite the mess, [player].

Name: Xeros
Text: I figured out Paradise Advent Society’s objective.

Name: Xeros
Text:
<Red>To conquer Elsetia with the power of the tower…</>
They say it’s the only way to paradise.

Name: Xeros
Text: That’s why they are looking for the <Orange>Chosen One</>.

Name: Xeros
Text:
That’s right, like you and me.
Although we can’t be for certain…

Name: Xeros
Text: First, see if you can gather any useful information from the people around here.

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
Adventurer…?
You look strong.

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
I also wanted to be strong…
Strong enough to join the Polaris Clan.

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
They said I have to eat this!
Eat this!
ItemDesc: It’s a Contaminated Aetherium Candy we saw in the Giant’s Garden.

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text: Who cares.

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
It wouldn’t work.
I was a fool for falling for the con.

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text: Get lost! Get out of my sight!

Name: Apathetic Scholar
Text:
I haven’t seen you around.
What’s your purpose for coming here?

Name: Apathetic Scholar
Text:
Hmm...
I think I’ve been here before, or maybe not.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The people here are really uncooperative.)</>

Name: Apathetic Scholar
Text: All kinds of people come and go.

Name: Apathetic Scholar
Text: That includes those whose lives are a mess, or who fail at everything they try.

Name: Apathetic Scholar
Text:
Oh, now I remember.
They weren’t bad people.

Name: Apathetic Scholar
Text:
They shared bread and water with others.
I think he also shared something that was great for recovery… What was it again?

Name: Apathetic Scholar
Text:
Oh. That’s right, candy!
He gave me candy. Etherium Candy!

Name: Apathetic Scholar
Text: Although I didn’t eat it because I don’t like sweets.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(They're pulling the exact same stunt they did in the Giant's Garden…)</>

Name: Paradise-Devoted Resident
Text: Do you also want to go to the paradise?

Name: Paradise-Devoted Resident
Text: Oh… How can I ever forget their kindness?

Name: Paradise-Devoted Resident
Text:
Although they came and went like the wind,
it’s a memory I cannot forget.

Name: Paradise-Devoted Resident
Text:
Chosen One!
The great one who will lead our flawed selves to paradise…

Name: Paradise-Devoted Resident
Text: How dare you run your mouth?!

Name: Paradise-Devoted Resident
Text: It can only be proven by the Gudua factor…!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Have they been completely brainwashed…? Let’s get going.)</>

Name: Xeros
Text: How was it? Did you get some useful information?

Name: Xeros
Text: I found this.
ItemDesc: This is a shield belonging to the missing Sverd Mercenary Commander Ingel.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It can’t be…)</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
It’s the commander’s shield.
It was mixed up in the garbage.

Name: Xeros
Text:
After he made contact with the Paradise Advent Society…
Could this be why we never heard from him again...?

Name: Xeros
Text: Not yet.

Name: Xeros
Text:
I guess we won’t be able to move undetected anymore.
We must secure their cooperation.

Name: Xeros
Text: We need your help, [player].

Name: Xeros
Text:
I heard there is someone who takes care of this seemingly chaotic place.
See her over there?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A middle-aged woman with a calm impression…)</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
I tried to talk to her to gather some intel,
but I was couldn’t do it well by myself.

Name: Xeros
Text: I think you might have better luck, so I wanted to ask you for a favor…

Name: Xeros
Text: Then I will continue looking for traces of the Commander.

Name: Resident with a Calm Impression
Text: What brings you here?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let’s avoid asking about the Paradise Advent Society right away.)</>

Name: Resident with a Calm Impression
Text: Oh… Are you talking about Vagrant's Repose?

Name: Resident with a Calm Impression
Text:
You don’t look like someone who would come looking for this place…
You and the other young man that came before.

Name: Resident with a Calm Impression
Text:
Let’s hear your name first.
I am <Orange>Helena</>.

Name: Helena
Text: [player]… I see.

Name: Helena
Text:
I take care of everyone here.
Each one has their own story.

Name: Helena
Text:
A mercenary who almost died trying to climb the tower.
A soldier abandoned after being critically wounded…

Name: Helena
Text:
The Paradise Advent Society often comes and provides food.
They also take some people who became believers.

Name: Xeros
Text: I see you were talking to my friend.

Name: Helena
Text: What are you doing here…?

Name: Xeros
Text:
I apologize once again for being rude earlier.
I was in a hurry because I wanted to find my missing companion…

Name: Helena
Text:
It’s fine…
You’re just here because you’re looking for someone.

Name: Helena
Text:
I’m the one who should apologize for being overly sensitive.
There’s just so many people who get abandoned here…

Name: Xeros
Text:
No.
I should’ve thought more before I acted.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Is there anything we can help you with by any chance?
We've noticed plenty of places that could use an extra hand.

Name: Helena
Text: Oh! That would be great.

Name: Helena
Text:
Could you please go to the Sere-Moss Heights?
The monsters are quite troublesome.

Name: Xeros
Text:
I still have a few things to discuss with him,
so it would be great if you could go instead, [player].

Name: Helena
Text: Thank you, indeed.

Name: Helena
Text: Could I ask for one more favor?

Name: Helena
Text:
There are so many sick people.
I was hoping you could gather some medicinal herbs.

Name: Helena
Text: Mijil herbs, peppermint… should be enough.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Where did Xeros go now?)</>

Name: Helena
Text: Oh, that young man is running an errand for me.

Name: Helena
Text: Do not worry.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I’ve seen this handwriting somewhere… Could this be Libi’s…?)</>
ItemDesc:
I realized only after coming here…
…what I’ve been doing until now.

The tower isn’t what’s important to us.
The tower is just an illusion.

What our blades should be pointing at is…

Name: Helena
Text: Thanks for rushing over!

Name: Helena
Text: There is something I can’t do on my own.

Name: Helena
Text:
Even though I know I can’t save everyone,
I keep repeating this foolish cycle.

Name: Helena
Text: <Red>I… I buried dead bodies every day!</>

Name: Helena
Text:
How much longer would the sick survive?
Even healthy people are starving to death.

Name: Helena
Text:
You see, the Paradis Advent Society…
We were grateful to them.

Name: Helena
Text: At least they eased our hunger, if only for a little while...

Name: Helena
Text:
We! We cannot betray them!
No, we won’t!

Name: Helena
Text: This place where all the abandoned people draw their last breath… is our paradise.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(They are emotionally attached to the Paradise Advent Society.
Even if I tell them about their evil deeds now…)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Looks like we're not getting the intel we need this time, either.)</>

Name: Helena
Text:
I’ll turn a blind eye for you and Xeros,
so please leave this place at once.

Name: Xeros
Text: Good to see you’re back in one piece.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A familiar face among the captured people—Libi.)</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
Don’t think of letting her go.
She’s not the <Orange>Libi</> you know.

Name: Xeros
Text:
It is just as you see it.
It’s the unfortunate result of a good deed.

Name: Xeros
Text:
It wouldn’t have been enough with only Helena’s power.
That's why she turned a blind eye to the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Not even the addicts were able to do anything.
Seeing as how they’ve gathered everyone in a place like this.
ItemDesc: It is filled with records written by Libi.

Name: Xeros
Text:
This is Libi’s…
But she's so heavily addicted. I doubt we can even talk to her.

Name: Xeros
Text:
She’s our only lead we have left… I’ll leave it up to you.
I’ll look after the addicts here.

The frenzied addicts lunged forward, only to fall by Xeros’s blade.
Libi’s corpse was lying at his feet.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You’re filled with resentment toward Xeros for ruthlessly killing the addicts.)</>

Name: Xeros
Text: Did you find love for mankind while we haven’t seen each other?

Name: Xeros
Text:
We are mercenaries.
We believe <Yellow>sacrifices are unavoidable for the greater good</>.

Name: Xeros
Text:
You clearly don’t know what becomes of the Ethereum addicts.
Why do you think they are tied up?

Name: Xeros
Text:
When you get addicted to Ethereum, you slowly lose sanity,
until there is nothing left of who you are.

Name: Xeros
Text: The only thing remaining is the craving for Ethereum.

Name: Xeros
Text: Do you know what those who briefly regain their sanity always say?

Name: Xeros
Text: <Yellow>They beg to be killed. They’d rather die than live like this.</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
Are you calling me, the one who put them out of their misery,
a <Red>murderer</>?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You can’t agree with him. Death isn’t the only salvation.)</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
After coming back to her senses for a moment,
Libi ran toward my blade.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Even while she was in pain…
She told me about the <Red>Paradise Advent Society’s Sanctuary</>.

Name: Xeros
Text:
<Yellow>…She said the captain had been taken there.</>
Are you planning to let her sacrifice go to waste[player]?

Name: Xeros
Text: The one you need to fight isn’t me, it’s the <Red>“Paradise Advent Society.”</>

Name: Xeros
Text: Without sacrifice, there is no justice.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It seems Xeros isn’t going to change his mind…
How can I convince him?)</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
If you’re still trying to convince me, come to the Stormkel Gates.
I won’t wait for long.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Let’s return to Helena first…
You must find out what happened to the addicts.)</>

Name: Helena
Text:
··· ···
Did you come to blame me?

Name: Helena
Text:
That’s right. I asked Xeros, the young man!
To kill them all!

Name: Helena
Text: No! He refused until the end!

Name: Helena
Text:
But not even the Paradise Advent Society was able to get rid of them!
They’d be better off dead!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(So the reason Xeros drew his sword...
was for those who had been abandoned by everyone.)</>

Name: Helena
Text: Peace… That’s right, I wanted to gift them peace!

Name: Helena
Text: I showed mercy as the lord of the sanctuary!

Name: Helena
Text:
··· ···
I knew you’d despise me.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You stare at Helena silently.
After hanging her head for a brief moment, she clenches her fist.)</>

Name: Helena
Text:
Fine…
Burying corpses is my job after all.

Name: Helena
Text: Go and get some relics for me.

Name: Helena
Text: Do you see that tree?

Name: Helena
Text:
"It started with hanging people's belongings,
or their dog tags, to remember those who passed before us.

Name: Helena
Text: So that their kin would be able to find them.

Name: Helena
Text: Even though it was faster to hang them rather than to take them.

Name: Helena
Text: I’m going to hold the funeral with the villagers.

Name: Helena
Text: Leave the rest to me.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You organized their belongings.)</>
ItemDesc: Belongings of those who sought Vagrant's Repose.

Name: Helena
Text: Excellent work.

Name: Helena
Text:
Oh, this is…
<Orange>Gilbert</>’s rocket.
ItemDesc: Gilbert’s rocket found in the Vagrant's Repose.

Name: Helena
Text: Eventually, he couldn’t overcome the Ethereum addiction…

Name: Helena
Text: Can I ask for one last favor?

Name: Helena
Text: Please hang these on the tree.

Name: Helena
Text: And… Deliver Gilbert’s rocket to <Orange>Vahista</>.

Name: Helena
Text: You just have to go to the expedition encampment located near the Serpent's Path Ruins.
After organizing the keepsakes, you head to the expedition encampment Helena mentioned.

Name: Vahista
Text: I never imagined that I would meet you here…

Name: Vahista
Text: It’s so great to see you again, [player]!

Name: Vahista
Text: You have something for me? What is it?
ItemDesc: Gilbert’s rocket found in the Vagrant's Repose.

Name: Vahista
Text: Th-This is Gilbert’s…

Name: Vahista
Text: How did you get this?

Name: Vahista
Text:
I won’t cry.
That’s what Gilbert would want.

Name: Vahista
Text:
But I can’t help but think, what if I stopped him just once?
He was my fiance after all.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Why did her fiance get addicted to Ethereum…?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(There is no way Vahista wouldn’t have known the dangers of Ethereum.)</>

Name: Vahista
Text:
He was a geologist.
He tasted everything the earth had to offer and recorded them.

Name: Vahista
Text: As you know, there isn’t much to eat in the barrens or snowfields.

Name: Vahista
Text: Rather than starving to death, He wanted to find a way for people to survive on dirt or ores.

Name: Vahista
Text: That’s how he found Ethereum candy…

Name: Vahista
Text:
We thought it was the perfect solution for surviving in a place like this.
Only if you eat just the right amount.

Name: Vahista
Text: He was thrilled about some new discovery when he was coming and going from the sanctuary…

Name: Vahista
Text:
You see, [player], I…
I want to fulfill Gilbert’s dream.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Of course.
I still have the culinary research!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Vahista hold back the tears and force a smile.)</>

Name: Vahista
Text: It just so happens that I came up with a new recipe.

Name: Vahista
Text:
I want to cook it for Gilbert…
Could you gather the ingredients for me?

Name: Vahista
Text: Capture Sergals from near the Serpent's Path Ruins.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Oh! I need some herbs too.
Just an armful should do.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Thank you for helping me.
Please wait a moment.

Name: Vahista
Text: There! It smells delicious.
ItemDesc: A dish made according to Vahista’s new recipe.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Gilbert was a gourmet who valued flavor.
Thank you so much, [player].

Name: Vahista
Text: [player], could you please take this to the Serpent's Path Ruins?

Name: Vahista
Text: It was where I often met Gilbert.

Name: Vahista
Text: That was the only place we could secretly meet behind the expedition’s back.

Name: Vahista
Text:
It feels like yesterday when we hid inside the ruins and shared stories,
but it’s already in the past.

Name: Vahista
Text:
I’m sorry…
I can’t stop talking.

Name: Vahista
Text:
I want to go too,
but I’m just not ready…

Name: Vahista
Text:
No… No!
Actually, I can’t go to the ruins or the sanctuary.

Name: Vahista
Text:
I don’t want to accept it.
He said he will be back after ten days! He promised me.

Name: Vahista
Text:
I’m sorry…
People die in the Forsaken Land all the time. It’s no big deal.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The smile disappears from Vahisata’s face.
It looks like she can no longer hide her sadness.)</>

Name: Vahista
Text:
Wait…
Go on ahead without me so that I can gather myself, [player].

Name: Vahista
Text: Please… As a friend.

Name: Vahista
Text:
··· ···
Gilbert!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Vahista fell to her knees clutching the letter and the ring.)</>
ItemDesc:
My beloved Vahista.

I write this letter with love and respect.
I still remember the day when fate brought us together after the start of the expedition,
and the conversations we shared.

We devoted ourselves to research which everyone else took lightly.
We even pitied those scholars who buried themselves in the forgotten past,
like the tower, Ancient Empire, Gudua, and relics.

We were furious because though time flows forward with us, they chose to walk only backward.

I loved how you also cared for those…
…who simply wanted to make a living.

I also admired how you didn’t take the life before you for granted,
and you never chased greatness alone.

And I loved that…
…you seemed to loved everyone in this world.

I want to make the world you love better and happier.

So Vahista.
Would you marry me?

- With love, Gilbert, who wishes to protect your beautiful smile forever.-

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Vahista wiped away her tears bravely, wearing the ring.)</>

Name: Vahista
Text: I wanted to invite you to the wedding party…

Name: Vahista
Text: But it was great to be able to talk to you about Gilbert.

Name: Vahista
Text: It feels like he’s alive somehow, doesn’t it?

Name: Vahista
Text:
I made up my mind…
I will dedicate this book to Gilbert.

Name: Vahista
Text: In his name and mine, we shall banish the hunger of this desolate land.

Name: Vahista
Text: I can’t lose sight of the part of myself Gilbert loved.

Name: Vahista
Text:
[player], only the last recipe remains.
This page… Could you help me finish it?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let’s help Vahista, who is trying to overcome her sadness.)</>

Name: Vahista
Text:
Thank you.
This time, I need bats.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Welcome back!
Great timing.

Name: Vahista
Text: Now all that's left is to coat the meat and fry it in oil...

Name: Vahista
Text: Done! Juicy fried bats!

Name: Vahista
Text: Now, take this and go to Stormkel Gate.
ItemDesc: A cookbook completed by Bahista, along with a freshly prepared fried dish.

Name: Vahista
Text: The expedition alone can't support the sanctuary.

Name: Vahista
Text:
The outpost is filled with soldiers, so they have no interest in something like this,
but it might be different at the gate.

Name: Vahista
Text:
I’m going to go and see Gilbert…
[player], thanks for cheering me up.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Don’t worry about me and get to the gate.
The future of the sanctuary lies with you.

Name: Injured Official
Text:
I guess it wasn’t my turn to die!
I am in your debt, adventurer!

Name: Injured Official
Text:
They should’ve given this kind of work to a new recruit.
Why ask a desk jockey like me and cause all this trouble…?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I rescued him, and all he does is complain.)</>

Name: Gale
Text:
Sorry, let me introduce myself.
My name is <Orange>Gale</>.

Name: Gale
Text:
I’m an administrator at Stormkel Gate.
I’m still at the bottom of the command chain, though.

Name: Gale
Text:
That’s what I’m saying! 
This is all because of that darn Paradise Advent Society, but…

Name: Gale
Text: Since every day is a state of war, even an administrator like me has to come prepared with an axe.

Name: Gale
Text:
Why? Well, it’s obvious, isn’t it?
Astrid was involved too—oh, wait.

Name: Gale
Text:
Please forget what you just heard.
Ugh, me and my big mouth!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Must be talking about that rebellion.
Is it still not resolved?)</>

Name: Gale
Text:
*sigh.* Just go on your way, adventurer.
I have to get back to work too.

Name: Gale
Text:
...But you're not actually leaving, right?
I mean, look at me—an administrator, swinging an axe out here…

Name: Gale
Text: Ten years on the job, so I can tell where someone's heading just by looking at their face.

Name: Gale
Text: Your eyes are glued to the gate, aren't they?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(If I keep listening, I’ll get dragged into this.)</>

Name: Gale
Text:
So, here's what I'm thinking.
If you just help me out, you can score some points with the <Orange>Gate Captain</>.

Name: Gale
Text: Lately, they aren't letting just anyone through the gate.

Name: Gale
Text: Even the soldiers at the outpost need a permit to get inside.

Name: Gale
Text:
I knew it!
It must be fate, so how about taking care of the monsters nearby?

Name: Gale
Text: I can't find a darn thing because of them.

Name: Gale
Text: Oh, look what we have here.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Gale fiddles with the Tesseract fragment.)</>

Name: Gale
Text: I heard they had a rough time at the outpost because of this too...

Name: Gale
Text: Have you ever heard of an <Red>Anomalous Incursion</>?

Name: Gale
Text: It’s an Incursion that triggers without warning. It's been causing havoc lately.

Name: Gale
Text: From what I know, similar things have been happening in other places too.

Name: Gale
Text: Since Incursions are so common around here, we just brushed it off as no big deal...

Name: Gale
Text: But now that we're trying to set up defenses, we realize we know next to nothing.

Name: Gale
Text:
··· ···
Wow, I’m hurt.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Seems they call Artificial Incursions “Anomalous Incursions” here. But why is he hurt? I literally just told him what I know...)</>

Name: Gale
Text: I mean, for something this big, shouldn't they share information and handle it on a national level?

Name: Gale
Text:
Perfect! Mercenaries like you should be spreading these kinds of news,
taking care of it, and making money out of it!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You stared at Gale, speechless.)</>

Name: Gale
Text: …What? You really think I'd ask you to work for nothing?

Name: Gale
Text: Come on, just humor me this once and do one more, all right?

Name: Gale
Text: Come to think of it, almost every Incursion near the gate was artificial.

Name: Gale
Text: Paradise Advent Society shows up, an Incursion triggers, and Tesseract fragments are left rolling around...

Name: Gale
Text: But seriously, <Yellow>a human triggering an Incursion? That sounds completely absurd.</>

Name: Gale
Text:
I’m not saying this because I don't know the facts.
It just makes no sense to me.

Name: Gale
Text: We only recently found out it was Paradise Advent Society's work.

Name: Gale
Text: A soldier saw it when he went to check on a transport wagon.

Name: Gale
Text:
He saw a cultist throw a <Blue>Tesseract,</>
and wondered what kind of crazy stunt they were pulling.

Name: Gale
Text: Just as he thought it was about to hit someone, the Incursion suddenly broke out.

Name: Gale
Text:
...Well, he survived. For about a week.
An Incursion unfolded right in front of his nose, so surviving that long was already good enough.

Name: Gale
Text: By the time he dragged himself to the gate, he was already half-dead.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Paradise Advent Society is acting openly now…
They must be up to something.)</>

Name: Gale
Text: All right, so here's what you need to do.

Name: Gale
Text: Go find some Tesseract fragments and anything else that looks like it belongs to Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Gale
Text:
But I have a report to write.
Hurry back before my hands freeze off!

Name: Gale
Text: I knew you wouldn't come back empty-handed!

Name: Gale
Text: Here are the report and a temporary permit.
ItemDesc: A report written by Gale, alongside a rather sketchy-looking temporary permit.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...This permit looks incredibly sketchy.)</>

Name: Gale
Text: Hey now! It’s issued by an administrator. What’s there to doubt?

Name: Gale
Text: Besides, this seal was crafted by a master artisan from Stormkell.
ItemDesc:
A seal crafted by a master artisan from Stormkell.
Only the registered owner can use it.

Name: Gale
Text:
If you’re not the registered owner, it won’t even work.
Meaning, I’m the only one who can stamp this for you.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You’re not happy about it, but you nod reluctantly to show that you understand.)</>

Name: Gale
Text: And once you reach the gate, please ask them to send three or four soldiers over here.

Name: Gale
Text: The Gate Captain will surely allow it once you hand over this much evidence.

Name: Gale
Text: Oh, and make sure to emphasize that I almost died!

Name: Gate Soldier
Text: No entry without a permit.

Name: Gate Soldier
Text:
So, it’s Administrator Gale’s seal.
You may pass.

Name: Gate Soldier
Text: Do you have business with the Gate Captain?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You show Gale’s report, the shattered Tesseract fragments,
and the robe of the Paradise Advent Society cultist.)</>

Name: Gate Soldier
Text:
Ah, I'll direct you right away.
The Gate Captain is on the raised platform inside.

Name: Gate Captain of Stormkel
Text: Who goes there?

Name: Gate Captain of Stormkel
Text:
So Gale owes you a favor.
I'll dispatch the soldiers immediately.

Name: Gerda
Text:
With the report and the Tesseract specimen you delivered,
our engineers should have plenty to study.

Name: Gerda
Text:
Excuse my late introduction.
I am <Orange>Gerda</>, Gate Captain of Stormkel.

Name: Gerda
Text: Thank you for your hard work on our behalf.

Name: Gerda
Text: You look like a mercenary. Do you take requests?

Name: Gerda
Text:
This works out well.
We're short-handed as it is.

Name: Gerda
Text: Ha. A mere mercenary dares make demands?

Name: Gerda
Text:
You’re an interesting one.
Let’s hear it.
You hand over Vahista’s book and food, explaining that the Vagrant's Repose needs help.

Name: Gerda
Text: Why should I waste my time on those fools?

Name: Gerda
Text:
We barely have enough time to punish the traitors…
…who deceived the great Astrid and tarnished that noble honor.

Name: Gerda
Text: It’s ridiculous. Even our administrators are armed to take Paradise Advent Society heads.

Name: Gerda
Text: Never in the history of Stormkel have we been so disgraced.

Name: Gerda
Text:
If the outpost had dealt with Paradise Advent Society from the start..
none of this would have happened.

Name: Gerda
Text: Even Ragnar, who stepped in to mediate, was severely injured.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(So that's why Ragnar hasn't been in touch all this time...)</>

Name: Gerda
Text:
If we can't prove Astrid's innocence,
Stormkel warriors will end up shedding each other's blood.

Name: Gerda
Text: My goal is to put an end to this pointless turmoil.

Name: Gerda
Text: Either take the job, or get lost.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(If I turn down the job, investigating Paradise Advent Society will be impossible.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(…I must earn his trust first to help Vagrant's Repose.)</>

Name: Gerda
Text:
All right.
Then head to the Hoarfrost Snowfield Crossroads and wipe out <Red>Paradise Advent Society</>.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A doctrine book. Let's see what it says.)</>
ItemDesc:
Getting all the way here from the Barrens was so, so hard.
But they said if I just make it to the Sanctuary, my wishes will come true.
The Prophet promised to handle all the scary, painful things.

But still...
If I help out with the work, maybe I can get more Etherium candies?
It's for purifying the world, after all.

Just a few more nights, and I'll be in the Sanctuary.
I just have to get past those terrifying Stormkell warriors.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let's see what's written on the note.)</>
ItemDesc:
Our great Prophet has been brutally slaughtered.
Even though we gave them everything...

The moment they sided with Astrid, they blamed we manipulated them all along. They didn’t just betray the Prophet who promised them paradise—they pinned all their crimes on our fellow believers.

Selling us out just to save their own skins...

Now, we’re forced to use even the Tesseract just to survive and reach the Sanctuary. To think something meant for purifying the world is being wasted in a place like this…

Please, stay safe.
I pray we meet again in the Sanctuary.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Now I get it.
Stormkel is terrified of a civil war.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(That's why they're shifting the blame onto the Paradise Advent Society.)</>

Name: Gerda
Text: Quite the skilled one, aren't you?

Name: Gerda
Text:
So?
Am I supposed to pity them for dying a miserable death?

Name: Gerda
Text:
Dead or alive, they hold no value.
A single life of our fallen is worth more than all of them combined!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(No point in wasting any more words.)</>

Name: Gerda
Text: A mere mercenary has no business interfering in—

Name: Gerda
Text:
…Fine, a promise is a promise.
Even if they're a bunch who could drop dead any second.

Name: Gerda
Text:
Vahista?
To test the safety of the recipe this person made, go gather the ingredients first.

Name: Gerda
Text: We are busy enough with Tesseract research and dealing with Paradise Advent Society as it is.

Name: Gerda
Text:
If you bring the ingredients, I'll at least have it cooked.
Go quickly before I change my mind.

Name: Gerda
Text: You brought back more than I expected.

Name: Gerda
Text:
Go down to the supply depot below.
Just hand them over to the administrator.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
The Gate Captain told me about it.
May I check the quality of the ingredients?

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
Let's see what we can whip up with these…
Ah, a tangy monster meat stew!

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: Leave the cooking to us.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
And if you don't mind, could you help us make some emergency potions?
We’re stretched desperate here.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
Thank you so much!
The medicinal herbs are up there.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: You can just gather them and put them in all at once.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: The emergency potions are ready, and the food seems almost done...

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: We'll take care of delivering them to the Repose.

Name: [player]
Text: (Could this be what Xeros discovered?)

Name: Flustered Girl
Text: Could I ask you for a favor?

Name: Once-Faithful Girl
Text:
I’m quitting. Going to Paradise, I mean.
I’m just so tired now.

Name: Once-Faithful Girl
Text:
So many qualifications all the time. Eat your Etherium candy,
Trigger an Incursion…

Name: Once-Faithful Girl
Text:
I'm not going to live much longer anyway.
Before I die, I just want to do whatever I want, to my heart's content.

Name: Once-Faithful Girl
Text:
No need to look so serious.
I’ve already lived long enough for someone like me.

Name: Once-Faithful Girl
Text:
Please take this to the Sanctuary for me.
It belonged to me and my late father.
ItemDesc: An emblem featuring a palm-shaped ornament intricately carved with the symbol of Paradise Advent Society.

Text:
The item the girl gave was an emblem engraved with Paradise Advent Society's Mark.
To fulfill her request, I asked for the location of the Sanctuary,
but she didn’t seem to know exactly where it was.

Name: Once-Faithful Girl
Text:
The Prophet said it’s a token to enter paradise.
I guess it’s up to you whether you believe it or not.

Name: Once-Faithful Girl
Text: But my father believed in it, so that's why I'm asking you.

Name: Once-Faithful Girl
Text:
Oh, by the way, there are followers all over the place back there.
They're probably looking for me.

Name: Once-Faithful Girl
Text:
Could you buy me some time? Even a brief moment will do.
I'll run as far as I can.

Name: Once-Faithful Girl
Text:
If you see them toss that cube, run for your life!
It’ll trigger an Incursion!

Name: Celine
Text: Oh, right! My name is Celine.

Name: Celine
Text: If we ever meet again, please tell me if paradise really exists in the Sanctuary.

Name: Xeros
Text: You’ve had a rough journey making it here.

Name: Xeros
Text: Tell me what happened along the way.
You tell Xeros everything—from what you witnessed at the Repose to the encounter at the gate.

Name: Xeros
Text:
I never meant for you to find out. Yet, here we are.
So, have you changed your mind now?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I still believe there must have been another way.
But his actions weren't entirely groundless either...)</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
There is no choice that satisfies everyone.
Some sacrifices are inevitable.

Name: Xeros
Text:
<Yellow>Every life is precious, we shouldn't kill blindly…</>
Are you trying to preach those soft morals to me?

Name: Xeros
Text:
This brings back memories.
You said something similar back when we were in the mercenary company…

Name: Xeros
Text:
I wanted the bird to suffer no longer.
So, I decided to end its misery myself.

Name: Xeros
Text:
But you wanted the bird to live, even if it was just for one more day.
Even if it could never fly again.

Name: Xeros
Text: We spent the whole day talking about what would make the bird truly happy.

Name: Xeros
Text:
Do you remember what we decided back then?
We agreed to <Yellow>turn on the Commander who brought us to this, and make him pay the price</>.

Name: Xeros
Text: [player], you deluded people with the word “paradise”.…

Name: Xeros
Text: and made even the Commander vanish without a trace—you want to root them out, don't you?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You nod firmly.
No more people should suffer because of them.)</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
It seems our enemy has finally become clear.
I’ve discovered something as well.

Name: Xeros
Text: They say a special ritual is required to enter their sanctuary, the <Blue>“Silver Shadow Temple.”</>

Name: Xeros
Text: Let's gather the materials from the monsters and the cultists.

Name: Xeros
Text: Still got your old skills, I see, [player].

Name: Xeros
Text:
Let's head above the Respite.
Hurry.
Xeros and you perform the ritual together.

Name: Xeros
Text: It's a success.

Name: Xeros
Text: The path inside won't be easy.

Name: Xeros
Text: I’ll handle the left side, so you clear out the right.

Name: Xeros
Text: It's been a long time since we fought side by side like this.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You smile at the memory of the old days, and Xeros smiles along.)</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
Now, let's split up and search for the Captain.
Oh, and check your communicator first.

Name: Xeros
Text:
All right.
Stay safe, [player]

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You place the token down to fulfill Celine’s request.)</>
ItemDesc: An emblem featuring a palm-shaped ornament intricately carved with the symbol of Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Yngel
Text: I formed this mercenary company waiting solely for this day.

Name: Yngel
Text:
<Yellow>Since all of you are my sword and shield,
you are more than worthy to rule the world.</>

Name: Yngel
Text: Every time the Gudua Factor manifested, my heart pounded so fiercely...

Name: Yngel
Text:
I want to conquer the tower right now, and give you the Forgotten Land—
no, all of Elsetia!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What on earth is he talking about...?)</>

Name: Xeros
Text: Triggering artificial Incursions to draw people's attention away from the tower...

Name: Xeros
Text: And inciting conflicts and rebellions to cause chaos both inside and outside the Forgotten Land.

Name: Yngel
Text:
That is the role of Paradise Advent Society.
At least on the surface.

Name: Yngel
Text: Just as Xeros said, the true purpose of Paradise Advent Society lies elsewhere.

Name: Yngel
Text: <Yellow>To rule this world righteously using the power of the tower.</>

Name: Yngel
Text:
An opportunity to completely reshape the world is right before our eyes,
so why should we take the long way around?

Name: Yngel
Text:
You must have felt it too.
How utterly unjust this world is.

Name: Yngel
Text: That is why I made you come to the Forgotten Land

Name: Yngel
Text: —to force you to witness this horror firsthand.

Name: Yngel
Text:
You both endured well.
In truth, you exceeded my expectations.

Name: Yngel
Text: It has been the most rewarding thing I’ve done as the Chief.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I’m puzzled... Captain Ingel is actually the Chief of Paradise Advent Society?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(And even our journey to this point was all part of his plan..)</>

Name: Yngel
Text:
I know the pain you must have felt all too well.
Simon, Mitchell, Libi...

Name: Yngel
Text:
But <Yellow>great deeds require sacrifice.</>
I only hope it helped you grow.

Name: Unknown Being
Text: No time for pleasantries.

Name: Unknown Being
Text:
If you can stop what your friend is trying to do...
Interested?

Name: Unknown Being
Text: Ha, disbelief is written all over your face, standing right in front of the <Orange>Warden of the Tower.</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Warden of the Tower?)</>

Name: Unknown Being
Text:
Even the giants built the tower to survive.
—pouring in every ounce of their technology.

Name: Unknown Being
Text:
Yet you're the ones who couldn't even use it properly, aren't you?
So blind, yet so arrogant.

Name: Unknown Being
Text:
Let me make one thing clear:
if the tower collapses, a few lives won't be the only cost.

Name: Unknown Being
Text: ...An entire star could vanish.

Name: Unknown Being
Text:
Are you afraid?
Well, what a shame.

Name: Unknown Being
Text: The tower has already begun to crumble, all because of your friend, <Orange>Xeros</>.

Name: Unknown Being
Text:
There is a way, though.
I can stop it for a little while.

Name: Unknown Being
Text:
But don't breathe a sigh of relief just yet.
This is a first for me too, so I have no idea how it will turn out.

Name: Saikarad
Text: I am <Orange>“Saikarad.”</>

Name: Saikarad
Text:
I'll summon you again when the time comes.
...It won't take long.

Name: Rada
Text:
You don't look too good.
Did something happen?

Name: Rada
Text: ...I heard you went to look for Ingel. Don't tell me...?

Name: Rada
Text:
I’d press you for answers right this second,
but that wouldn't be right, would it?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You stare at Rada with a serious expression.)</>

Name: Rada
Text: N-No scary faces allowed!

Name: Rada
Text:
Then let's go together, [player].
I had some business to attend to as well.

Name: Rada
Text: I'm serious!

Name: Rada
Text:
Oh, there's a warp anchor right there!
We can just take that, right?

Name: Rada
Text:
Look! Our friend here has something to say!
Should we call <Orange>Azran</> and <Orange>Koon</> too?

Name: Ragnar
Text: I think we can decide after we hear what this is about first.

Name: Beretta
Text: Right. It’s not like they’d come immediately anyway.
You relay what happened at the Sanctuary of Paradise Advent Society, and what Saikarad had said.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
I don't even know what to say.
I can't bring myself to believe it.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Destroying the “tower”… I never even imagined such a thing.
What do you plan to do?

Name: Beretta
Text:
Persuade him?
Don't tell me you think that'll work.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
We must not be swayed by personal ties.
Too many lives are on the line here.

Name: Rada
Text:
I'm against it.
There must have been some kind of misunderstanding.

Name: Rada
Text:
We were in the same mercenary company.
Shouldn't we give him a little more time to think?

Name: Ragnar
Text:
…You have a point.
But haven't we already seen what Paradise Advent Society has done?

Name: Beretta
Text:
…I'll look into the <Blue>Tower</> and <Orange>Saikarad</> myself.
I should have kept in touch...

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Come to think of it, this whole thing was tied to Paradise Advent Society,
yet there was no word from Beretta.)</>

Name: Ragnar
Text: I don't see any clear way out of this right now.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
But one thing is for sure:
The <Red>Paradise Advent Society</> won't come out of this unscathed either.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
With their leader dead, anything can happen.
Dismantling them completely while we're at it—

Name: Beretta
Text: It's entirely possible. If anything, it's a great opportunity.

Name: Rada
Text: So, we've more or less decided what to do, right?

Name: Ragnar
Text: As long as Azran and Koon agree.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
[player], thank you for telling us all this.
It couldn't have been an easy choice.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
We'll do our best to make sure you won't regret your choice.
As a <Orange>Divine</>, I give you my word.

Ragnar hastily made his departure to report the situation.
Beretta and Rada exchanged glances,
and nodded as if agreeing on something...

Name: Rada
Text: Leaving already? Don’t rush into this.

Name: Rada
Text:
Ragnar will contact the other two.
We should wait and decide together.

Name: Rada
Text: Look, I get it. You want to find Xeros right now.

Name: Rada
Text:
But your Aether is a complete mess.
You really think you can fight in that condition?

Name: Beretta
Text:
You came back from the tower like this last time, too.
Back when we ran into each other at the Giant’s Garden, remember?

Name: Beretta
Text: I told you then—the tower left its mark on you.

Name: Beretta
Text:
It’s like the place is calling out to your very soul…
The Warden of the Tower must have done something to you back then.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Why else would you end up like this every single time you set foot inside?
Your entire Aetherial flow is shattered.

Name: Beretta
Text:
You fought Xeros, and then an Apostle right after!
Anyone else would've broken down already.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Divines are way tougher than humans, but even our kind would’ve collapsed.
Just be glad your limbs are still attached and rest.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Yeah, perks of a good bloodline.
Now focus on recovering.

Name: Rada
Text:
I'm with Beretta on this.
It's okay to stop and breathe sometimes, you know?

Name: Rada
Text: They say a deep sleep does wonders.

Name: Rada
Text: We're in this together now, so let us take care of it!

Name: [player]
Text:
(Xeros took heavy damage too.
Should be quiet until he regathers his strength.)

Name: [player]
Text: (Rada and Beretta are right. I need to rest for now.)

Name: [player]
Text:
(But I still don't get what the Warden meant.
Summon me when the time comes? What if it's too late?)
ItemDesc:
The artifact obtained from Hekima before entering the Giant’s Tower.
It allows teleportation inside the Tower.
The price was information on the Tower.

Name: [player]
Text:
(...I need to see him again.
Should I try the phase shift device?)

Name: [player]
Text: (First, I should go somewhere out of the Divines' sight.)

Name: [player]
Text: (Nothing... Is the Warden's place blocked?

Name: [player]
Text: (That area did feel different from the usual hunting grounds.)

Name: [player]
Text: (Maybe it requires a “clearance?”)

Name: Hekima
Text: If there is a problem, show it to me, Chosen One.

Name: [player]
Text: (A Liberator of Knowledge?)

Name: Hekima
Text:
I saw you working on the phase shifting device...
Is something wrong?

Name: Hekima
Text: If it’s malfunctioning, I will fix it for you once we're done talking.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Right now, I am here for the 'information'.
That was our promise when I handed it over to you.

Name: Hekima
Text: You've been to the Tower multiple times by now. What did you witness inside?

Name: Hekima
Text:
That artifact won't get you there.
The deepest parts of the Tower are protected by a powerful barrier.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Just as you need permission to move between floors,
hidden spaces have their own protective systems.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Especially if it’s where the Warden resides...
You would need an artifact worthy of such a place.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Regrettably, with the knowledge we possess—
it is difficult to give you a clear answer.

Name: Familiar Voice
Text:
What are you doing? I told you to rest!
What's your business with a Liberator of Knowledge in a place like this?

Behind me, Beretta was approaching with an annoyed look on her face.
I felt the urge to run,
but her sheer fury kept me rooted to the spot.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I don't mean to nag, but you're a patient.
Should I use magic to tie your feet down? Hmm?

Name: Hekima
Text:
Greetings, Divine Beretta.
It has been a while.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Oh, is this the first time since we signed the treaty?
You’re still busy poking your nose into everything.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Thank you for the treaty.
Our Liberators can now travel anywhere with ease.

Name: Beretta
Text: We pushed for it because I knew we’d need your information eventually.

Name: Beretta
Text:
You claim to maintain neutrality for the sake of 'everyone', right?
Then at least you won't let this world go down the path of destruction.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Ah, actually, this works out perfectly.
It’s time for the Liberators to give us some information, so cooperate.

Name: Hekima
Text:
You mentioned you need to reach the Warden...
Is it related to that? I would like to hear the details.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Well, do you have time?
Most of it is guesswork, so I'm not sure I can explain it easily.

Name: Hekima
Text: In that case, would you mind reviewing this record first?

Name: Hekima
Text: It is a reconstruction of past events that the Chosen One has uncovered firsthand.
ItemDesc:
[Confirmed Findings]
- Humanity from an outer world known as the 'Castle' built the Tower on Elsetia.
- They used the Tower to rule as the world’s sovereign power and began all-out colonization.
- For reasons unknown, an individual named 'Amartu' altered the purpose of the Tower.
- All functions were shifted from colony control to a deadly weapon.
- Concerned by this, an official intentionally left a record as 'Gudua',
  accessible only by those with matching power.
- However, since an internal issue occurred within the Tower, its primary functions have remained dormant.

[Matters for Investigation]
- Is the 'Power of Gudua' really a higher concept than Elsetia's 'Aether'?

Name: Beretta
Text:
Everything checks out. It aligns perfectly with what I know.
I’ll provide sone notes for that last item.
ItemDesc:
[Confirmed Findings]
- Humanity from an outer world known as the 'Castle' built the Tower on Elsetia.
- They used the Tower to rule as the world’s sovereign power and began all-out colonization.
- For reasons unknown, an individual named 'Amartu' altered the purpose of the Tower.
- All functions were shifted from colony control to a deadly weapon.
- Concerned by this, an official intentionally left a record as 'Gudua',
  accessible only by those with matching power.
- However, since an internal issue occurred within the Tower, its primary functions have remained dormant.

[Matters for Investigation]
- Is the 'Power of Gudua' really a higher concept than Elsetia's 'Aether'?
> Merely a difference in manifestation; the essence remains the same.
> Elsetian: Converts natural Aether into their own.
> Gudua: Channels and unleashes Aether from within.

Name: Beretta
Text:
There is a shortage of natural Aether on their world.
That’s why they spent ages studying their own bodies.

Name: Beretta
Text:
In the end, they learned to wield power refined to its absolute limit,
and they named it the 'Gudua factor'.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Ah, don't bother remembering that silly name.
It's just a term coined because they were drunk on their own power.

Name: Hekima
Text:
The fact that there is no fundamental difference explains
why they failed to completely conquer this world.

Name: Hekima
Text: Because even in that era, there must have been Elsetians who fought back against them.

Name: Beretta
Text:
The amount of Aether people are born with varies,
but as long as you use it well, it doesn't matter.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Yet those fools used it to divide themselves into classes.
A truly backward mindset.

Name: Hekima
Text: From our perspective as pursuers of technology, those people seemed exceptional.

Name: Hekima
Text:
But surprisingly, they weren't much different from us.
So that's how the Liberators were able to uncover their secrets.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Do you see my point?
No matter what Xeros does, he's just human.

Name: Beretta
Text:
He has his limits, so we have plenty of time.
We just need to figure out our countermeasure in the meantime.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Alright then. Head over to the Hunters Guild and bring Koon.
He's not answering his communicator at all.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Ugh, no wonder I felt like my communicator was whining.
Did you come all this way because I didn't answer?

Name: Khoon
Text:
My bad! The Guild Master was giving me a piece of his mind.
He told me to go to the Hunter's Village to look into something, whew.

Name: [player]
Text:
(I recounted the exact same story I told the Divines.
Koon stared back at me, his eyes wavering in disbelief.)

Name: Khoon
Text:
Xeros, that traitor.
He was acting strange ever since the Giant's Garden.

Name: Khoon
Text:
So that's why he... cut down Mitchell without a second thought.
We were all dancing to his tune.

Name: Khoon
Text: He really took us for a ride.

Name: Khoon
Text:
So, what are we supposed to do now?
Hold a meeting or something?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Count me in for something like this.
Let's get moving.

Name: Rada
Text:
Ragnar said he’d look for Azran,
and Beretta couldn't wait any longer for you two, so she left first.

Name: Khoon
Text:
What? But this is incredibly urgent!
That bad guy could march in here any second, right?

Name: Rada
Text:
Xeros must have taken heavy damage from the fight, too.
Even with a few priests on him, he won't recover that easily.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Hmm, I guess that’s a relief.
So where did Beretta go?

Name: Rada
Text:
She said she has a lot to discuss with the Liberator of Knowledge!
And she told me to give you this.
ItemDesc:
A key revealed by the 'Prophecy' revered by the Paradise Advent Society.
It was finally uncovered at the edge of the Ridges, after tracking through numerous Aether entanglements.

It doesn’t look like a typical key, 
but its shape suggests it can be inserted into something.

Name: Rada
Text:
She said it’s useless to her right now.
She gave me a letter to hand over too... Hold on a second!

Name: Rada
Text:
Here it is.
Oh, and she insisted you read it, so open it quick!
ItemDesc:
I'm leaving this because I know you'll chase Xeros no matter what.
Who could stop you anyway if you’re determined to go after him?
Just don't let me find you as a corpse.

Keep the 'key' for now.
It wouldn't work no matter what I did.
Didn't you say the Warden told you to wait until the time is right?
It’s probably related to that.

The Liberator guesses that the connection to the artifact was severed because the Warden used the Tower's power to save you.
I think that makes sense.
The Tower’s main functions were already ruined, so they must be even worse now.

Anyway, don't go picking a fight in your current condition. Let's find the Warden instead.
We just need to fix up the Tower before Xeros makes his move, right?
That’s infinitely better than you dying.
We'll look for a way to contact the Warden, so just wait a bit.
Since you found Koon, you can warm up by going on a hunt with him.

Remember, you're our biggest asset right now.
The fate of Elsetia rests on you.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Calm before the storm, was it?
Whatever they call it, that’s exactly how it feels right now.

Name: Rada
Text:
Keep your head down until we contact you.
Like I said earlier, your body is really unstable right now.

Name: Khoon
Text:
