Then I’ll just stick close and keep an eye on you.
We’ll get you healed up somewhere nice and quiet.

Name: Khoon
Text: We can look for a way to meet the Warden while we're at it.

Name: Rada
Text: Huh? How are you going to do that?

Name: Khoon
Text:
There’s a hunter who only chases after Tower artifacts.
I'm going to ask if that guy knows anything.

Name: Khoon
Text: I was planning to head that way on the Guild Master’s orders anyway.

Name: Rada
Text:
So you're heading to the Twisted Elysium?
Safe travels! I'll be helping out our other friends.

Name: Khoon
Text: No time like the present. Let’s get moving.

Name: Khoon
Text:
It's your first time, right? The nearest warp anchor is at the Stragglers' Camp.
See you there.

Name: Khoon
Text: If you head straight east from here, you’ll find the Hunter's Border Outpost.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Sometimes monsters break out from the snowfields toward Elysium.
It's a temporary shelter built to take them down before things get out of hand.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The monsters around here are exceptionally vicious.
They cross over without fear, even with dragons living on the other side!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Haha! Just kidding.
There’s no such thing as dragons these days.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Instead, there’s a terrain that just looks like the “dragons” recorded in ancient books.
People just gossip about it like it’s a myth.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The path leading to Elysium has a fitting name too.
They call it the Dragon’s Breath.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Alright, let's go! 
Seeing it once is worth a thousand words.

Name: Khoon
Text:
As expected, not a single familiar face.
I know they aren't the type to stay put for long, but still...

Name: Khoon
Text:
Even supplies are lying around everywhere.
If the Guild Master saw this, he'd nag us for a whole week.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The name of the person in charge should be on the front of the sack.
I need to see who did this.

Name: Khoon
Text: I'll remind them they’ll be kicked out the day the Guild Master catches them.

Name: Timid Voice
Text: I, I brought those here... Was I not supposed to do that…?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Huh? Who do you report to?
I don't think we’ve ever met.

Name: Paran
Text: I'm Paran… And I’m... a hunter.

Name: Khoon
Text:
There’s no one by that name in the Hunters Guild.
Oh, I guess you just prefer working alone.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Anyway, it's nice to meet a fellow hunter.
Why did you bring the supplies here?

Name: Khoon
Text: The people from the Hunter's Village usually keep this place stocked.

Name: Paran
Text:
From the village? Oh...
I think they all headed down south toward Elysium recently.

Name: Paran
Text:
So this place was being neglected...
I just wanted to help out if I could.

Name: Paran
Text:
I'm so sorry! I shouldn't have overstepped…
I'll clean the place right now!

Name: Khoon
Text:
No, no, if anything, our guild should be the one apologizing.
You had good intentions, so no need to be scared.

Name: Khoon
Text: By any chance, did a hunter named Auren also head south?

Name: Paran
Text:
No... I, I don't think I know anyone by that name.
I only started working as a hunter recently…

Name: Paran
Text:
B, but I do know a hunter named Ranon!
She helped me out with a lot of things around here.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Perfect. Where is Ranon?
She and Auren are archenemies, so she knows everything about her.

Name: Khoon
Text:
We can just go ask her where Auren is.
Right, [Player]?

Name: Paran
Text:
She went out to a nearby hunting ground…
I can... lead the way to where she is.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Hey there! Long time no see, Ranon.
Still chasing only after the coins?

Name: Ranon
Text:
You show up after all this time just to mess with me?
How did you even find me?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Our fellow hunter Paran here led the way.
Be nice to her. She seems like a thoughtful person.

Name: Paran
Text:
Oh, you don't have to say that... Really, I'm fine!
I’ve received far more help from Ranon.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Quit making things hard for someone shy and get to the point.
Is the Guild Master finally tearing everything down this time?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Tell me where Auren is.
I have something to ask her, and I don't have time to search around.

Name: Ranon
Text: Ha! If you want something from a hunter, prove your skills first.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Bring back a heavier catch than mine!
Only then will we start bargaining.

Name: Khoon
Text:
You're going to regret saying that.
You have no idea how skilled the adventurer next to me is.

Name: Paran
Text:
So... you three are going hunting now, right?
I'll head back to the outpost then.

Name: Paran
Text: Good luck...!

Name: Ranon
Text:
Is that it? I thought you’d be better than before.
You talked big, but this is pretty modest.

Name: Ranon
Text: If your pulling your punch because your new friend is here, I'm disappointed.

Name: Khoon
Text:
What are you talking about? This adventurer doesn't even bother picking up all the loot.
This one empties the bag so many times just because it gets too heavy.

Name: Khoon
Text:
My hunting skills are top-notch, sure,
but even I'm no match.

Name: Khoon
Text: If you don't believe me, why don't we try your specialty—bounty hunting?

Name: Ranon
Text: What’s with the cheap taunt? Fine, challenge accepted.

Name: Ranon
Text: Follow me. The wanted monsters are over that way.

Name: Khoon
Text: These monsters are way more vicious than the last bunch.

Name: Khoon
Text:
By the way, are you going to pay out the bounty?
I'm asking because we're going to take down dozens.

Name: Ranon
Text: The bounties are paid by the Hunters Guild, obviously!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Yikes, do you really think Lady Kian would hand over gold for this?
You’ll have to pay it out of your own pocket.

Name: Ranon
Text:
You're all talk, so you must be plotting something.
I'm going one-on-one against the adventurer you brought.

Name: Ranon
Text: I won't have the two of you pulling any fast ones.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Koon, stay back and be the judge.
Do it fairly, on your honor as a member of the Hunters Guild.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Heh, you better get your gold ready.
Your loss is already written in stone.

Name: [player]
Text: (All done already.)

Name: [player]
Text: (To get a solid lead, maybe I should target some other preys too.)

Name: Paran
Text: Eek! No, go away…!

Name: [player]
Text: (Is that from the edge of the hunting ground? It sounds like Paran’s voice...)

Name: Paran
Text: Thank you... It's quiet around here now, thanks to you.

Name: Paran
Text:
Oh, that's right! I'm sorry if I interrupted your hunt.
I made so much noise...

Name: Paran
Text: I was looking for supplies the outpost and the village needed...

Name: Paran
Text:
I sprained my ankle a bit and was resting for a moment,
but then those beasts swarmed me out of nowhere. I panicked...

Name: Paran
Text:
The descendants of the fallen kingdom of 'Tan' live in the Elysium.
And I am one of them...

Name: Paran
Text:
Even though we live scattered all over the place,
I just want everyone to enjoy a peaceful life here...

Name: Paran
Text:
I believe even the small things matter.
So whenever I have time, I gather food and supplies.

Name: Paran
Text:
I-It’s really nothing special...
But thank you for the compliment.

Name: Paran
Text:
I know you're busy, so I'll head back to the Hunter's Village now...
If you ever come by, please look for me.

Name: Paran
Text: There are many dark forests in the Elysium... Please be careful…!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Didn't you wrap that up way too fast?
Looks like she's only just finishing up over there.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(I wrapped up AND helped Paran, but Ranon hasn’t come back yet.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Heh, this round is definitely my win.)</>

Name: Khoon
Text:
You should’ve held back a little.
Ranon’s gonna throw a fit, crying it was rigged.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Let's just leave her be.
Perfect time for us to just laze around, haha.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Oh, right. Got a letter from Beretta.
About reaching the depths of the tower—looks like she found a clue.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Says we should stay put until she's absolutely sure.
Apparently, she doesn't trust a bunch of troublemakers running around.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Please. We’re seasoned pros. She worries too much.
I mean, look at us! How carefree is this?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Anyway, let’s just enjoy the peace while it lasts.
It's not every day we get to hang out with a bounty hunter.

Right as I was about to say more about Beretta’s message,
Ranon approached, eyes wide with shock.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Huh... You finished before me?
Guess you’re used to fighting hordes.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Anyone can see you lost by a landslide.
Just accept the verdict.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Urgh, fine... I lost this time.
But this isn't all there is to bounty hunting.

Name: Ranon
Text:
To claim a bounty, you need proof.
Usually the hide or the bones.

Name: Ranon
Text:
But you're a bit too reckless with your power, aren't you?
You won't have an intact corpse left to harvest at that rate.

Name: Khoon
Text:
What, another match?
You're the 'Gambler,' remember? Dragging this out isn't like you.

Name: Khoon
Text:
All this bounty talk is just an excuse.
You just want to hang out with us.

Name: Khoon
Text: My bad! I really should've visited the Elysium more often.

Name: Khoon
Text:
But alas, the Divines' burden on my shoulders is just so terribly heavy.
You understand, right, old friend?

Name: Ranon
Text:
W-what are you talking about? I never said I was lonely!
Hunting is a solitary path, hmph.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Just take this!
I'll let you pick our next target.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Whatever you choose won't be easy.
You'll have to fight carefully to keep the spoils intact.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Fine by me. Had my eyes on them anyway.
May the best hunter win!

Name: Khoon
Text: What about my prey? Am I just the judge again?

Name: Ranon
Text:
Go to the outpost and grab something to carry the spoils.
Because I’m going to clear the whole place out.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Urgh!
Fine, but if you lose again, you’re finally telling us where Auren is. Deal?

Name: Ranon
Text:
Haha, you'd better cheer for your friend instead.
I'm not holding back this time!
After getting the location from Koon, I headed toward the edge of the outpost.

Name: Khoon
Text: Alright, I'll count the spoils as dictated by the Hunters Guild Trophy Protocol.

Name: Ranon
Text: Keep it fair, judge.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Trust me, I never play around when it comes to hunting.
Now, contenders, give me a moment.

Koon inspected the trophies with a sharp, discerning gaze.
After a brief silence, he tilted his head, utterly confused.

Name: Khoon
Text:
…No, I definitely counted right.
I might talk light, but I'm not stupid.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I know how to count.
But we’re short by one…

Name: Ranon
Text:
Hahaha! Don't look so down, it was a done deal from the start.
I do this for a living—no way I'd lose to an adventurer.

Name: Khoon
Text: I should’ve taught you a trick or two… what a shame.

Name: Ranon
Text:
That makes us even, then.
I can count on a rematch, right?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Rematch? Forget that, we're moving on soon.
We came here to find Auren!

Name: Ranon
Text:
Don't cut me off! I said next time.
Besides, you've got to give the beasts time to pack up again.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Fine, Auren is over at the Hunter's Village.
I'm only telling you because you actually beat me once.

Name: Khoon
Text: Now that's more like it. That's the Gambler Ranon we know.

Name: Khoon
Text:
But Auren didn't head south?
I heard some hunters were making their way down there.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Said she couldn't leave her brother behind, so she’s staying put.
It’s not like they need extra blades down there anyway.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Word is, more people have been vanishing lately.
So they went to help with the search.

Name: Ranon
Text:
And who tracks better than a hunter? They'll crack the trail in no time.
Go on ahead and find Auren.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Got it. But if things take a turn, send word.
I'm practically on vacation anyway.

Name: Ranon
Text: Heh, next time we meet, we settle the score for good.

Name: Khoon
Text: Paran! You're back in the village!

Name: Paran
Text:
Y-yes...!
Thanks to you, everything went smoothly…

Name: Khoon
Text:
Are supplies running low here too?
If so, I can talk to Lady Kian—I mean, the Guild Master.

Name: Paran
Text:
O-oh, please don't.
It's nothing the townsfolk can't handle...

Name: Khoon
Text: Understood. Just don't overdo it.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Phew! Now, let’s flush Auren out.
I know just the trick.

Name: Khoon
Text:
No need for that. ㅉe just shout at the top of our lungs right here.
Ah, ah! Ahem.

Name: Khoon
Text: Treasure Hunter Auren! Hear the summons of the Hunters Guild!

Name: Paran
Text: I-I'll go ask a local kid who knows this place well...

Name: Paran
Text:
He's the darling of the village…
I'm sure he's close with Auren, too...

Name: Khoon
Text:
Really? Well, I’d appreciate that!
I’m… I'm counting on you...

Name: Khoon
Text:
Argh! This shouldn't be this embarrassing!
Auren usually plays along with jokes like this!

Name: Khoon
Text:
I naturally thought she'd be wandering the village square,
just idling her time away!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Ahem, well, Paran here is helping us out, so we should do something too.
Why don't we check the notice board for local news? Haha!

Name: Paran
Text: Don't go too far… I'll be right back!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Ugh… even the notice board looks completely chaotic.
Spending all my time in Babylon, I had no idea the Elysium was this hectic.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The south, that lower lands we've been talking about?
That place is called the 'Forgotten Crest.'

Name: Khoon
Text: A lot of the children of Tan live there… Never heard of them?

Name: Khoon
Text: The area north of the Pulsing Ridge is known to be the Karadia territory, right?

Name: Khoon
Text:
The kingdom of Tan fell a long time ago, too.
It’s been well over a century.

Name: Khoon
Text:
They say my grandfather’s grandfather was from there.
So I must have a tiny bit of that blood in me, too.

Name: Khoon
Text: When I was a kid, adults used to tell me not to forget the kingdom of Tan.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The elders back then grew up hearing the same thing,
so they just passed it down to me.

Name: Khoon
Text:
But now that I’m all grown up,
there’s barely any time to sit around revisiting old memories.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Well… as long as we're living fine here, that's what matters.
The present is always what's most important anyway, right?

Name: Village Kid
Text: Waaah… Sis… hngh…

Name: Khoon
Text: Oh! Look, a kid over there. Looks ready to cry.

Name: Village Kid
Text: Waaah! Strangers! Sister said don't follow them! Waaah!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Whoa, hey! Don't cry!
You can’t cry like that the moment you see me. It makes me look like the bad guy!

Name: Khoon
Text:
I'm Koon from the Hunters Guild! You've heard of me, right?
I'm not some bad guy who makes kids cry. Wipe those tears, come on.

Name: Village Kid
Text: Are you… Koon…? hic

Name: Khoon
Text: That's right! Koon, the great hunter and Divine!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Stopping Incursions, clearing out monsters!
I'm a seriously cool guy, I tell you.

Name: Village Kid
Text:
I… I've heard your name before!
The priests said you're an important person.

Name: Khoon
Text: Yeah, go on and tell me why you were crying.

Name: Village Kid
Text:
Right… and, Sis… Sis said… sniff!
She said it was a treasure hunt and told me to wait…

Name: Village Kid
Text:
She said she was going to the hunting grounds, but she's still not back!
I'm hungry and sleepy… Waaah!

Name: Khoon
Text:
We'll tell your sister to hurry on back!
Just wait a tiny bit, and poof! She'll pop right up.

Name: Khoon
Text:
[player], can you go look for her?
I'll try to soothe him, and get him something to eat.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Before the kid starts crying again, hurry!
Just ask anyone!

Name: Paran
Text:
Oh, so you found Mucha…
He wasn't at home, so I was looking around for him.

Name: Paran
Text:
Ah… Mucha is the boy's name.
He's the boy I mentioned… the one who might know Auren.

Name: Paran
Text:
I haven't really opened up to the other villagers yet…
But Mucha and I became a-a little close.

Name: Paran
Text:
As you can see, I'm quite shy…
Oh, it’s not that the villagers shun me or anything!

Name: Paran
Text: Um…! Should we ask Mucha where Auren is…?

Name: Paran
Text:
I heard she’s excellent at hiding…
Mucha brags about his sister a lot, you see. Ahem.

Name: Paran
Text:
How about using some hay?
He told me his sister's Rappie eats a whole lot.

Name: Paran
Text:
If we catch the Rappie running wild after catching the scent,
his sister will definitely show herself to stop it...

Name: Paran
Text: I gathered that hay myself, so take as much as you need.

Name: Paran
Text:
She might be in the western hunting grounds.
She often goes for walks there...

Name: Paran
Text: While you’re away, I'll take Mucha back home. Please be careful.
Watching the Rappie take the bait, I head toward the voice.

Name: Mucha's Older Sister
Text:
Was it you?
Why did you scatter hay all over the hunting grounds!

Name: Mucha's Older Sister
Text: My Rappie suddenly bolted, giving me a fright.

Name: Mucha's Older Sister
Text:
Oh, that kid. He really can't get enough of me, can he?
Guess he just loves his big sis that much!

Name: Mucha's Older Sister
Text:
Well, I suppose it’s time to head back to the village.
Shame, though. I really wanted to bring him a treasure this time.

Name: Auren
Text:
Right, I forgot to introduce myself.
I'm Auren the Treasure Hunter. I seek out rare and unusual treasures.

Name: [player]
Text: (This is Auren? Talk about luck.)

Name: Auren
Text:
I was actually looking for a treasure buried here until just now.
Mucha told me an old story about it.

Name: Auren
Text: Apparently, some 'faded glory' is buried west of the Twisted Elysium?

Name: Auren
Text:
Isn't it adorable how he believes the legend is real?
Makes me want to protect his innocence.

Name: Auren
Text:
Probably just a tall tale the elders told him. 
But Mucha would be thrilled if we actually found something!

Name: Auren
Text: Hehe, since he’s waiting so anxiously, I should wind things down here.

Name: Auren
Text:
I'm going to put up markers where I've already searched.
That way, I won't get confused next time.

Name: Auren
Text: If you help me out, we can get this done in a flash. Let's finish quick.

Name: Auren
Text: Whoa! Don't know where you came from, but you're lightning fast!

Name: Auren
Text:
Since you helped me, I'll grant you a favor.
As long as it doesn't keep Mucha waiting too long!

Name: Auren
Text:
The Tower? You mean the Giant’s Tower?
If that's what you're after, you can just go in and grab one yourself.

Name: Auren
Text:
Everyone’s diving into the Tower these days,
hoping to score some artifacts and make quick gold.

Name: Auren
Text: Ah… I see. You’re looking for the real deal.

Name: Auren
Text:
How did you even know I only handle rare curiosities anyway?
You're looking at the absolute leading authority in this field.

Name: Auren
Text:
Well, maybe not as much as the Appraisers Guild, but close enough.
My point is, I'm at the very top of the trade.

Name: Auren
Text:
But what you're after must be an artifact among artifacts.
I've never even heard of such a thing.

Name: Auren
Text:
Hmm, if you insist, your best bet is…
Rumors, legends, or fairy tales. That sort of thing.

Name: Auren
Text:
Most people just let it go in one ear and out the other,
but when you have no clues, you gotta grasp at straws.

Name: Auren
Text:
Luckily, Mucha knows a ton of strange stories.
I'll take you to my place, let’s go ask him.

Name: Auren
Text: Huh? Look at that. We have guests.

Name: Auren
Text:
Mucha! You've got company!
Come on out!

Name: Paran
Text: M-Mucha just fell asleep…

Name: Auren
Text:
Right! I remember you. You watch our boy from time to time.
Thought you looked familiar.

Name: Auren
Text:
And next to you is the great and renowned Divine Koon.
Wait, did you bring this adventurer here?

Name: Khoon
Text: Had no idea Mucha’s big sister was you… Talk about a small world.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The kid cried his eyes out, but finally ate something and went to sleep.
By the way… Auren, since when did you have a little brother?

Name: Auren
Text:
Met him in the lower lands. The poor thing was all alone, so I brought him in.
Lost his parents in some accident, from what I gather.

Name: Paran
Text:
It's… pretty common around here…
I was an orphan too…

Name: Khoon
Text:
True. Krea doesn't count the Cave Owls as their own, after all.
Hard for the Manor to step in and help.

Name: Auren
Text: It’s what the children of Tan call themselves.

Name: Auren
Text:
Tan was famous for being a nation of hunters.
Renowned hunters would get majestic titles like 'the Eagle.'

Name: Auren
Text: But Cave Owls are a bit different.

Name: Auren
Text:
Even with wings, they can barely fly.
Instead, they pour all their strength into digging burrows to protect their chicks.

Name: Auren
Text:
Probably a name dubbed by ancestors who despaired over their plight.
It's hard enough to make a living now, but it must have been worse back then.

Name: Auren
Text: They barely escaped Krea with their lives.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Whew… enough with the gloomy talk.
Auren, you heard the gist of our situation from this adventurer, right?

Name: Khoon
Text:
We need help from someone who hunts only Tower artifacts.
Know anything?

Name: Auren
Text:
I was actually planning to ask Mucha myself.
But, you know, feels wrong to wake a sleeping kid.

Name: Paran
Text: U-Um… would you mind reading this?

Name: Paran
Text: It's a fairy tale I wrote, based on the stories Mucha told me…
ItemName: A Fairy Tale Born from Mucha's Stories
ItemDesc:
… …

The hero blew his horn to summon the hawk, the bear, and the tiger.
The hawk was his eyes, the bear his shield, and the tiger his claws.

Ten times did the sun and moon rise and set.
The wounded dragon fled, taking the horn with it.

They drove the dragon from the forest, dancing with joy.

When the long darkness lifts, the dawn shall break.
The age of hunters is nigh, the age of hunters is nigh.

Name: Paran
Text:
It's about an artifact called the 'Horn of Dawn.'
They say it was once the crown jewel of Tan…

Name: Paran
Text:
His eyes sparkled so bright whenever he told this story…
So I wanted to give this to him once he learned to read.

Name: Khoon
Text: Sounds like this Horn of Dawn could command wild beasts…

Name: Auren
Text:
Hmm. Is it even possible to force a creature's will like that?
Besides, how do you take down a dragon with just three animals?

Name: Paran
Text: Except for that last verse, I wrote it down exactly as Mucha told it…

Name: Auren
Text:
That kid picks up the strangest things.
Well, should we assume it’s real for now?

Name: Auren
Text:
If a horn really had that kind of power…
it must have come straight out of the Tower.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Yeah, I'm with you on that.
Most things that defy common sense are tied to the Tower.

Name: Auren
Text:
Who knows?
Maybe we can use it to command the Tower monsters and find a hidden chamber.

Name: Auren
Text:
Let’s give it a shot, even if it's a long shot.
I have a feeling this is going to be fun.

Name: Khoon
Text: Alright, why don't you two head out first?

Name: Khoon
Text:
I've got orders from the Guild Master.
I should look into some things around the village.

Name: Auren
Text:
I need to head inside and check on Mucha.
You and Paran can go together.

Name: Auren
Text:
Oh, there should be a dragon hunter around here.
He’s obsessed with the beasts, so talk to him if you see him.

Name: Auren
Text: Maybe he knows which dragon hid that horn. Hehe!

Name: Paran
Text:
I think I'm ready to move on.
Shall we head up that way…?

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Pretty high up. Too dangerous to climb directly.)</>

Name: Paran
Text: It's slippery here! Watch your step…

Name: Paran
Text: Whoa… I almost fell right here…

Name: Paran
Text:
Did I scare you?
Y-you didn't strain yourself coming up here, did you?

Name: Paran
Text:
I'm sorry…
But you know how precious things are always tucked away out of sight, right?

Name: Paran
Text:
S-so I was looking down to find a blind spot,
but suddenly my head started to throb like crazy…

Name: Paran
Text:
I thought I was a goner for a second… but thanks to you, I'm safe!
Thank you so, so much…

Name: Sharp Voice
Text:
Hey, up there! What do you think you're doing? It’s dangerous!
Get down from there. Now!

Name: Paran
Text: I-I'm so sorry! I’ll be right down! I'm so sorry!

Name: Sharp-Looking Man
Text:
Well, haven’t seen these kids around here.
You’re not even hunters. You can’t just climb up there like that!

Name: Sharp-Looking Man
Text:
If you’d fallen from there, I would be cleaning a corpse right now.
Are you brave, or just plain stupid?

Name: Sharp-Looking Man
Text:
Hmm… A dragon, is it?
Bold talk for a couple of greenhorns!

Name: Sharp-Looking Man
Text:
Fine.
Pass my test, and I just might help you.

Name: Paran
Text: W-What? Just like that…?

Name: Karam
Text: I swear on my honor as Karam, the Dragon Hunter.

Name: Karam
Text: To face a dragon, you need steel in your bones.

Name: Karam
Text:
See those beasts across the way? Take them down.
I'll be watching throughout, so don't you dare hold back.

Name: Karam
Text:
You've got the basics, at least.
This is the bare minimum if you want to hunt dragons.

Name: Karam
Text: Now, tell me—which dragon are you trying to hunt?

Name: Paran
Text:
We're searching for an artifact a dragon took…
The Horn of Dawn…

Name: Karam
Text: Ha… Haha! Is that so?

Name: Karam
Text:
No matter.
It doesn't change the fact that you must face a dragon.

Name: Karam
Text:
Dragons are notoriously obsessed with treasures.
They won't hand things over willingly.

Name: Karam
Text:
Which means you have to take it by force.
As a dragon hunter, I shall come with you!

Name: Karam
Text:
Hidden away in its lair, of course.
We best gear up properly before we head out.

Name: Paran
Text: Shouldn't we… talk to Koon first?

Name: Paran
Text:
I won't be of any help in the hunt anyway—
so I thought it best to head to the Lake of Spirits…

Name: Paran
Text:
Y-You know… just to pray…
that everyone makes it back safely…

Name: Karam
Text:
Hmph. Knowing your own weakness is important in itself.
Keep out of harm's way.

Name: Karam
Text: Let’s head back to Hunter's Village. We've got a lot of preparation to do.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(He said he'd look around, so he must be asking the villagers.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Not over here…)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Not over there either.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Hmph… With his looks, I thought he'd be easy to spot.
Did he go inside somewhere?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(I'll check the alleys first, then wait.
Best not to cross paths.)</>

Name: Karam
Text:
You should check the outskirts.
I'll scour this area one more time.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(…Footsteps. Let's wait here a moment.)</>

Name: Welcoming Voice
Text:
Hunter Koon! I knew you'd return!
We feared you would stay in Babylon forever. What a relief.

Name: Khoon
Text: Come now! It's just a casual visit.

Name: Joyful Voice
Text: So you finally accepted our cause?

Name: Joyful Voice
Text:
We sent so many letters to Kian…
I am deeply moved that you have made this decision.

Name: Welcoming Voice
Text:
Everything is in place.
If you could just say that you haven't forgotten the restoration of Than…

Name: Khoon
Text:
Enough.
How many times must I tell you?

Name: Khoon
Text: Give up on those hollow dreams, and let us build a safe home instead!

Name: [player]
Text: (This might take a while… Better not get involved.)

Name: Karam
Text: Where’s Koon? Haven't found him yet?

Name: [player]
Text: (I told Karam what I heard in the alley, and he doesn’t seem surprised.)

Name: Karam
Text:
…Still as popular as ever.
Though I doubt it's for any good.

Name: Karam
Text: Those people… they want to rebuild the Kingdom of Than.

Name: Karam
Text:
They call themselves the 'Ashen Crows.'
I've seen them pull this nonsense before.

Name: Karam
Text:
Koon is a Divine, and a powerful symbol.
He's perfect for their little crusade.

Name: Karam
Text:
They'll have him pinned down there for a while.
Let's head out on our own.

Name: Karam
Text: We’ll head straight east. The Evil Dragon's lair is supposed to be there.

Name: Karam
Text:
We'll both get what we want there.
I take down the dragon, and you get your treasure.

Name: Karam
Text:
By all accounts, pure dragons are long extinct.
Only their lesser kins remain today.

Name: Karam
Text:
But no one's properly explored that lair yet—
the entrance was only found recently.

Name: Karam
Text: Isn't that worth a gamble?

Name: Karam
Text:
My blade is itching for a fight.
Let's move.
After checking the carcass of the beast he thought was the Evil Dragon, Karam could not hide his disappointment.

Name: Karam
Text: Ha! I thought the lead was solid. Can't believe I got played like this.

Name: Karam
Text: The rumors about this place only started floating around recently.

Name: Karam
Text:
I heard it from the Ashen Crows.
Those people you saw around Koon.

Name: Karam
Text: They must have mistaken this place for a dragon's den.

Name: Karam
Text:
They say dragons existed back when Tan was whole.
This place must have triggered their imagination.

Name: Karam
Text:
Well, what can we do?
No use confronting them now.

Name: Karam
Text:
I need another hunt to burn off this energy.
You go ahead and keep searching around here.

Name: Karam
Text:
But first, we best clear the area.
Those alerted by our presence will be closing in.

Name: Karam
Text:
Tsk. Look at that miserable face.
I didn’t expect to find a treasure in a dreary place like this anyway.

Name: Karam
Text: Why not cross over along this path instead?

Name: Karam
Text:
It looks sketchy, sure…
but don't you feel a strange, mystical vibe?

Name: Karam
Text:
My ‘dragon hunt’ may have ended in failure—
But at least one of us should walk away with something.

Name: Karam
Text: Let's at least see this hunt through.

Name: Karam
Text:
We're at the right place.
The old dragon territory stretches up here.

Name: Karam
Text: Wherever there are traces, it's worth a look, isn't it?

Name: Karam
Text: We've come up empty so far, but the real hunt starts now.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Phew, finally caught up.
Didn't think Kian's errand would take this long.

Name: Khoon
Text: And who might this be… Wait, oh!

Name: Karam
Text:
Karam, the Dragon Hunter.
And you're Koon, the Hunters Guild's golden boy.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Ah, right. It's coming back to me now.
What was it you said to me at the last hunting festival?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Something about releasing a giant lizard if there were no dragons?
Complaining that you were bored out of your mind.

Name: Karam
Text:
You should hold the next festival in the Elysium instead.
The monsters in the Barrens are terribly boring.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Take your complaints to the Guild Master.
I'm a member in name only. I’m barely on the roster.

Name: Khoon
Text: So, did you find the Horn of Dawn?

Name: Khoon
Text:
I didn't sense any Aether on my way here either.
I guess an artifact is an artifact, after all.

Name: Karam
Text:
Auren would love this kind of talk…
Did he have anything to say?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Actually, I ran into him before coming here.
He told me to look for the Bardad Expedition if all else fails.

Name: Khoon
Text: They set up a forward waypoint here to investigate debris from the Tower.

Name: Karam
Text:
Expedition? Just cut straight through the Deepwood.
The woods are crawling with trouble lately, so watch your back.

Name: Khoon
Text:
With our skills, a gloomy forest path is nothing.
Anyway, thanks for the tip. We're off!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Look, those people—
If they are still people…

Name: Khoon
Text:
They look completely out of their minds.
Flailing their limbs, and walking all weird.

Name: Khoon
Text:
They are dumbfounded, just staring into space.
They don’t seem to hear me, even when I yell at them to run.

Name: Khoon
Text:
No way. The Paradise Advent Society couldn't have shown up already.
It hasn't been that long since you dealt them a major blow.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Besides, using the same tactic again…?
They wouldn’t be that stupid.

Name: Khoon
Text: Anyway, it looks dangerous. Let’s clear this area first.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I just took a closer look.
Brace yourself for this…

Name: Khoon
Text:
They're corpses.
Real, walking corpses!

Name: Khoon
Text: Our eyes met for a second, and they just lunged at me.

Name: Khoon
Text:
They almost took a chunk out of me.
They're way more aggressive than average monsters.

Name: Khoon
Text:
If you don’t do something, villagers like the Cave Owls will be in danger.
Let’s make sure they don’t wander around.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Ha… I don't even know what to make of this.
I'm completely speechless.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The presence trails off to the west.
Let's follow the path and see where it leads.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Feels like the time of day changed all of a sudden, huh?
Don't worry, the sun barely reaches this place anyway.

Name: Khoon
Text:
There are so many towering trees here.
They used to call it the Darkwood.

Name: Khoon
Text:
So this is what they mean by 'ominous.’
We should've done proper research before heading out.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Now I'm certain.
Something is definitely brewing in here.

Name: Khoon
Text:
How can I be so sure?
I feel something ominous behind me, like a sting…

Name: Khoon
Text:
It's the exact same feeling as those corpses outside.
There could be way more of them gathered here.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Follow me along this path.
Watch your step. It's hard to see ahead.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I know I haven't been home in years,
but I never thought this would happen.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Just so you know,
The people of Tan are taught never to disturb the rest of the dead.

Name: Khoon
Text:
We have rituals to honor the deceased,
but never to raise them.

Name: Khoon
Text:
So the Cave Owls can’t be behind this.
And Hunter's Village seemed peaceful enough.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Now, look at this altar.
There’s hardly a scratch on it, right?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Whew, that was a close call.
Who knew touching that thing would make the dead pop out?

Name: Khoon
Text: Are you hurt anywhere?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Phew. Anyway, this altar looks like it was built recently.
Chances are, we're the first to discover it.

Name: Khoon
Text:
WHo could have..
Who could have done something so vile?

Name: Khoon
Text:
To commit such a crime in the Elysium…
They'll pay dearly for this.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Can you clear out this area for now?
I'll try to contact Babylon.

Name: [player]
Text:
(That altar over there looks similar, too…
I should check it out after clearing the monsters.)

Name: Frightened Man
Text:
A-Are they all gone?
A bunch of corpses popped out of nowhere…

Name: Frightened Man
Text:
I just came out for a quick hunt.
Why does this have to happen to me… Urgh…

Name: Frightened Man
Text:
They kept lunging at me like crazy. I couldn't even draw my bow.
One of them looked exactly like my neighbor…

Name: Frightened Man
Text: Anyway, thank you for saving… Argh!

Name: Frightened Man
Text: You're right… I should head to the encampment nearby..

Name: Frightened Man
Text:
But you bought me some time,
and I’ve managed to get my strength back a little.

Name: [player]
Text:
(That must be the same encampment Koon mentioned.
I should head there, too.)

Name: Frightened Man
Text: Let's move. You should probably get some rest yourself, Adventurer.

Name: Khoon
Text: Was there someone else there besides us?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Maybe because the foul presence was too thick…
I couldn't sense anyone else but your Aether.

Name: Frightened Man
Text:
Hunter Koon! I never thought I’d run into you here!
I told you to come find me if you ever came by this place.

Name: Khoon
Text: What? I’m sorry, but I haven’t seen you before…

Name: Nuul
Text:
It’s Nuul! Nuul!
I thought you’d at least remember my name by now, haha!

Name: Nuul
Text:
I wrote you a letter offering my absolute loyalty,
since you are the last descendant to rebuild Tan.

Name: Khoon
Text: Haha… Well, I’m a bit too popular to read every single letter, you see.

Name: Nuul
Text:
That’s quite all right.
You became a Divine, so of course you’d be busy, right?

Name: Nuul
Text:
I figured as much!
That's why I always carry my letter right here with me.
ItemDesc:
The dawn air feels exceptionally cold this season.

It speaks for the grief of Tan’s remaining children.
Please lead us beyond the rising sun.

We have the troops, the supplies, and the cause.
The only thing missing is you—our symbol.
Become our leader, and let us reclaim our brilliant glory.

The land of our ancestors stolen by Krea,
the fertile lands we rightfully deserve—
we shall take them back with our own hands!

Never forget your place as the last royal bloodline.
It is your duty to rebuild Tan!

... ...

Name: Khoon
Text: …So it was you. You sent those letters…

Name: Khoon
Text:
I’m pretty sure I replied to the first few.
I wrote I have no interest, and never to send them again.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I don't care if my ancestor's ancestors were royalty.
What does that have to do with me?

Name: Nuul
Text:
Blood is thicker than anything.
Are you saying you’ll turn your back on us?

Name: Khoon
Text:
[player], hang out for a second.
I need to go have a word with this man.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(That man… he seemed so thrilled to see Koon.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Does he see Koon as some kind of hero?
To write him so many letters…)</>

Seeing Koon brought the man right back to life.
I watched Nuul closely, but he doesn't seem dangerous.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Maybe I'm just overthinking
because of everything that happened lately.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(They should be about done by now. Let's head back.)</>

Name: Nuul
Text: Of all people, you shouldn't be saying that.

Name: Nuul
Text:
We’ve even prepared an artifact to serve our great cause.
With that, everyone will follow us!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Sigh… You just don't listen.
Why are you bringing up something from over a century ago—

Name: Encampment Sentry's Shout
Text:
Emergency! Emergency!
Monster activity in the west!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Phew, let's drop this for now.
Clearing the monsters comes first.

Name: Khoon
Text:
What are you doing? Staring at my face like that.
Come on, let's go take them down!

Name: Khoon
Text: Sorry, but it's best if you head to the Bardad Expedition first.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I’ll finish up the altar investigation,
so go find that Horn of Dawn.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I need to give him a reality check.
I’ll tell him to let go of a fallen kingdom.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Follow the path west.
You'll reach the forward waypoint soon.

Name: Chedar
Text: I'm Chedar, the technical advisor for the Bardad Expedition.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I was sent here to investigate the debris from the Tower.
Guess I'm the one in charge around here.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Outsiders need permission to enter.
I'll ask the questions, you just answer.

Name: [player]
Text:
(I answered Chedar’s question one by one.
Chedar's eyes were gradually filled with disbelief.)

Name: Chedar
Text:
Wait, you’re that legendary adventurer?!
What brings you all the way out to a corner like this?

Name: Chedar
Text: I've heard about you a few times from Captain Bardad.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Said you won over the Divines and even the Adventurers Alliance…
Everyone's trying to recruit you, right?

Name: Chedar
Text:
I doubt someone like you need my help,
but I'm listening. Go on.

Name: Chedar
Text: I figured it wasn't some ordinary request… I knew it.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I actually read a record about that artifact.
I definitely put it away somewhere safe… but, uh…

Name: Chedar
Text:
It might take some time to find.
I can't remember where it went, so I'll have to rummage through the storage.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Of course, I can't just give it to you for free.
Do something for me first.

Name: Chedar
Text: I want the area behind the forward waypoint 'completely cleared'.

Name: Chedar
Text:
There are too many monsters out there. It's so distracting!
I can't focus on my research.

Name: Chedar
Text: Whew! Perfect timing.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I found the record in a deep corner of the storage.
Ugh, look at the dust… You'll need to brush it off before reading.

Name: Chedar
Text:
This was written even before this waypoint was established.
Quite old, right?

Name: Chedar
Text:
Ten years have passed since then,
so this journal is definitely getting up there in age.
ItemDesc:
… …

Civilian supplies discovered near the excavation site.
Sent to the expedition office for storage after taking a rubbing.

"The following notes were taken to assess the relevance to the debris.

- Tableware: Low Relevance
Total of fifteen items confirmed, including kettles and plates.
Mostly items used by commoners.
Shapes have been barely preserved thanks to the durability of the material.

- Diary with a bookmark: Moderate Relevance
Found far from the site.
Appears to have been knocked away by an impact.
Appears to have belonged to a man earning his living through farming and hunting.
The name 'Horn of Dawn' is frequently mentioned.

... ...

Name: Chedar
Text: All of this happened after the debris orbiting the Tower fell.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Accelerated by its immense weight,
it plummeted deep into the ground.

Name: Chedar
Text:
They’ve moved on.
Their homes, their farmlands… everything was gone.

Name: Chedar
Text:
The excavation records you're reading…
Everything about what they’ve left here is written here.

Name: Chedar
Text:
There should be something about the ‘Horn of Dawn’ at the bottom.
It is actually mentioned on most of the days written on the diary.

Name: Chedar
Text:
On some days it was described as if they had seen it,
and it was deified and praised on other days.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I found out that it was actually Tan’s treasure.
I heard it from a Cave Owl that I got closed to.

Name: Chedar
Text: Only a few of them know about it.

Name: Chedar
Text:
If you’re planning on really getting to the bottom of it, maybe I can introduce you to him.
He is usually around here at this time of day.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I needed to see him anyway, so it all works out.
Let’s head south together.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Give it to me, Vedat!
Why do you keep bringing this old thing when there are perfectly fine ones.

Name: Chedar
Text: I told you to leave it because it’s going to take time to fix it!

Name: Vedat
Text:
I’m used to this old detector.
The new ones are too big! I keep dropping it.

Name: Chedar
Text:
We’re already short of hands as it is. I can’t have you acting like this.
Just quit if you don’t want to work!

Name: Vedat
Text:
It’s not my fault everyone was sent to the barrens…
It’s not my fault they think the ruins over there are more important, either.

Name: Chedar
Text:
That’s why I made you a new one.
Use the tools crafted by me, a tech expert!

Name: Chedar
Text: Finish it quick and easy, and move onto tasks.

Name: Vedat
Text: They say there is no future for those who forget the old…

Name: Chedar
Text:
You better take care of today’s task when I’m being nice.
Don’t forget that I am the one in charge here, understand?

Name: Vedat
Text:
Sigh… This is an abuse of power…
Fine! I’ll go!

Name: Chedar
Text: I’m sorry for stopping in the middle when I’m the one who asked you to come along.

Name: Chedar
Text:
There is a project I’m working on,
so I have to measure the Aether concentration at the same time every day.

Name: Chedar
Text: Please cover him! I beg you.

Name: Chedar
Text:
How was the result?
I’ve been observing for about two weeks, so I should come to a conclusion soon.

Name: Vedat
Text:
The increase in pollution levels has become clearer.
I was hoping it will return to the normal range, but it keeps getting worse…

Name: Vedat
Text:
On top of that, monsters have become quite violent.
It’s probably due to Aether getting murkier…

Name: Chedar
Text:
You told me Aether was similar to water,
that it is clean by nature.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I’m an engineer, so I don’t know much about those things.
Should we call and ask a Liberator of Knowledge?

Name: Vedat
Text:
It’s rare to see Aether getting murky all on its own.
It must have been effected by something…

Name: Vedat
Text:
We should keep searching for the exact cause.
It’s such a hassle… But I guess we have no other choice…

Name: Chedar
Text: So, I should check out the ‘Lake of Spirits’, right?

Name: Chedar
Text:
One task for me, and one task for you! It’s fair.
I’ll see you later.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Hmm, I don’t see anyone today.
This hole place feels creepy.

Name: Chedar
Text:
We have go a little further to reach the Lake of Spirits,
but I usually see people nearby.

Name: Chedar
Text:
One moment, please.
I want to take a measurement here, just in case.

Name: Chedar
Text:
You see those tall trees over there, right?
I’ve set up a few experiment deveices last time.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Would you fetch those for me?
I want to compare the results.

Name: Chedar
Text:
…I should increase the activation frequency next time.
Only weak monsters are stimulated at this intensity.

Name: Chedar
Text:
But it’s still related to the current situation.
The response scael is larger than expected.

Name: Chedar
Text: Oh, please disregard what you just heard.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I was trying to connect the results with my personal research,
but nothing is certain.

Name: Chedar
Text: First, we have to go through here… But something feels off, doesn’t it?

Name: Chedar
Text:
They look like they’re ready to charge at us.
Please take care of the ones blocking our path.

Name: Trembling Resident
Text:
Watch out, all of you!
At this rate, we’re all going to… Gasp!

Name: Chedar
Text:
Calm down!
Where are the others?

Name: Trembling Resident
Text: There are people who couldn’t get out of the lake…

Name: Chedar
Text: We’ll buy you some time, so get out of here.

Name: Chedar
Text:
If you don’t have the strength to make it back to the village,
go to the Expedition Waypoints! Hurry!

Name: Trembling Resident
Text: Eek… Gasp… I-I’m scared…

Name: Chedar
Text:
I’ll evacuate the people.
Hurry up and get to the lake!

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(I’m sure I’ve seen him at the Hallowed Obsidian Mountain…)</>

Name: Vaster
Text: Ugh! Such a… cheap… trick…

Name: Valbas
Text: Be a good boy and sit tight and behave.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Don’t complicate things.
Don’t you know what “rest” means?

Name: Valbas
Text:
Oh, haven’t seen you in a while.
We’ve definitely met before.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Sorry for all this commotion.
They sometimes run wild without their master's permission.

When the mage clenched his fist as if choking it,
the fiend, whom he called Baystera, growled and struggled.

Name: Valbas
Text:
It’s all quiet now, right?
I love how I can make it do whatever I want with this leash.

Name: Paran
Text:
H-Hey, you!
Why are you causing all this commotion?!

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Paran?! What brought Paran here?! It’s dangerous)</>

Name: Paran
Text:
This is a p-precious habitat for the cave owls…
You need to leave, immediately.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Some great adventurer ruined my home.
My precious home in the snowfield is gone.

Name: Valbas
Text:
I only came to my retreat to recover a bit.
It’s not like you own this place anyway.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Thanks for remembering me, I guess?
I thought you would forget someone like me thanks to Xeros.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Well thanks to you, our whole house is basically gone.
Where do you expect me to sleep and rest?

Name: Paran
Text: But y, your dog attacked us out of nowhere!

Name: Valbas
Text:
Right, sorry about that.
It has a huge appetite so it keeps running away from home.

Name: Valbas
Text:
I’ll get rid of this one for now.
It came to feed on some Aether.

Name: Valbas
Text: If you don’t believe me, take a look at the Aether entanglement behind you.

Name: Paran
Text:
I’ll go… with you…!
Since we don’t know what those villains are planning…

Name: Valbas
Text:
See! You’re always there when things get interesting.
Sometimes, you’re like a protagonist of a novel.

Name: Valbas
Text:
I’m not going to fight you.
It’s much more fun to observe.

Name: Valbas
Text:
It was quite amusing, watching that whole “world conquest” circus.
To think a high master would just drop dead.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Even though it looks like Xeros took over the position,
that is no reason for me to remain in the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Just like I said… I’m going to do whatever I want.
Working under someone is not my cup of tea.

Name: Vaster
Text: You… ugh… traitor!

Name: Valbas
Text:
I played along because you brought the experiment materials I needed…
But no one is there to provide such convenience anymore.

Name: Valbas
Text:
I’ll come find you again soon.
Just the two of us, somewhere private, for a little chat.

Name: Paran
Text: I-I can’t let any harm get to him!

Name: Valbas
Text:
Are you going to protect the princess? Haha.
I really love your petty sense of justice.

Name: Valbas
Text:
That’s right, I should take the dog back to its owner.
Well, I’m off.

Name: Paran
Text: I-I’m sorry, I jumped in so suddenly…

Name: Paran
Text:
I was just trying to stop him at all costs.
I can’t have anyone else get hurt…

Name: Paran
Text:
It would be great if I could fight back.
But blocking with my body was the first thing that came to mind…

Name: Paran
Text: I’ll take these people to the expedition waypoint.

Name: Paran
Text:
A-And, Adventurer.
It looks like you could also use some rest…

Name: Paran
Text:
You’ve just fought such a fierce battle.
Make sure to get some proper treatment…!

Name: Chedar
Text:
Phew! You also came back safely.
Now the role call is finished.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Seven injured, two deceased, none missing.
If I didn’t know better, I would’ve thought you guys have been hit by an Incursion.

Name: Chedar
Text: The people told me you faced a maniac.

Name: Chedar
Text:
There was a reason something was wrong with the Lake of Spirits.
I’m sure he did something very fishy.

Name: Chedar
Text:
The person I was supposed to meet was also there.
Fortunately, he wasn’t injured that badly.

Name: Chedar
Text: He wanted to return to the village as soon as possible, and I couldn’t keep him around for long.

Name: Chedar
Text:
But he looked quite happy to hear your name.
Do you know Paran?

Name: Chedar
Text: He’s staying in the Nameless Village, so you could probably meet him there.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Sigh! I take care of the injured.
I’ll make sure they get home safely, so don’t worry.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I'll have to step back from my duties with the expedition for a while…
But we've always been undermanned anyway.

Name: Chedar
Text: Oh, and someone was looking for you.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I was wondering why a Divine would come here.
But I can’t believe you guys knew each other… Hurry up and get to the entrance.

Name: Khoon
Text: I heard from the captain—something massive went down at the Lake of Spirits, right?

Name: Khoon
Text:
I should have hurried.
I’m sorry you had to carry that burden alone.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Nuul was much more stubborn than I thought.
I thought I was talking to a wall!

Name: Khoon
Text: On top of that, I don’t know how but Ashen Crows caught wind of it somehow and started gathering… Phew.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Even though royal blood flows in me,
I don’t even know what my grandfather looks like.

Name: Khoon
Text: How do you expect me to take responsibility for what my grandfather’s grandfather went through?

Name: Khoon
Text:
If I don’t take full responsibility,
it would be like just pushing everyone over the cliff.

Name: Khoon
Text:
They even want to reclaim the Tan Kingdom territory!
How is that different from going to war with Krea?!

Name: Khoon
Text:
We don’t even know when the Paradise Advent Society will show up… Phew!
I couldn’t get through to him, so I just bolted out.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Let’s just investigate the rest of the objects.
Let’s head to the lower floors of the waypoint.

Name: Khoon
Text:
If we want to find an entry point into the tower,
we should at least search near there, don’t you think?

Name: Khoon
Text: They were no joke. Maybe because it’s part of the tower.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Unlike the Aether you can feel from people and nature,
it seems to hold a rather unique property.

Name: Khoon
Text:
This had been circling around the tower.
Then I think there should be some kind of connection.

Name: Khoon
Text:
It couldn’t have done that on its own, right?
I’m certain there is a force drawing them toward each other.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Ugh, I should have studied more.
My mind goes blank trying to explain it technically.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Oh, the object you got from Beretta!
You still have it, right?

Name: Khoon
Text:
We’re near the tower. Let me see it.
It might react to the Aether flowing from this place.

Name: Khoon
Text:
There’s been no real use for it until now anyway.
If my guess is wrong… well… so be it!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Let’s just try it.
We have nothing to lose.

Name: [player]
Text: (Ugh… Where am I…?)

Name: [player]
Text:
(Wait… I've been here before.
…I remember talking to someone here.)

Name: Faint Voice
Text: …Come over here…

Name: Warden of the Tower
Text:
Time is short… I’ll get straight to the point.
The Aether that’s being supplied right now isn't enough.

Name: Warden of the Tower
Text:
I was going to call you sooner,
but it’s difficult to even maintain this form.

Name: Warden of the Tower
Text:
At this rate, I won’t be able to ready myself…
before he gets here.

Name: Warden of the Tower
Text:
He knows too much.
He'll find a weakness and eventually bring the tower down…

Name: Warden of the Tower
Text: We have to at least restore the tower’s functions to at least stop it from collapsing.

Name: Warden of the Tower
Text:
If we want to do that, we have to claim the ‘Core’ that was transported out.
And… only you can complete the task…

Name: Warden of the Tower
Text:
Initially, there were five of them,
but four have already slipped out...

Name: Warden of the Tower
Text:
The one closest to your location is in the south.
Head south… before it relocates…

Name: Warden of the Tower
Text: I’m at my limits… If you find the core… come find me again with the ‘Key’…

Name: Khoon
Text: Ah! You scared me! You suddenly disappeared then suddenly reappeared!

Name: Khoon
Text:
There was no Warp Anchor, so I was wondering where you went.
Did that object cause it?

Name: [player]
Text: (I told Koon about the conversation with the Warden, and he couldn’t keep his mouth shut.)

Name: Khoon
Text: So… He sent you on an errand to find the Core, right?

Name: Khoon
Text: The Tower and the Warden must be in quite a pinch, turning to an outsider for help.

Name: Khoon
Text:
No matter how powerful Xeros is,
I don’t think the Tower will fall with a few strikes…

Name: Khoon
Text: But it’s for world peace, so let’s do as we were told.

Name: Khoon
Text:
He said it was in the south, so let’s head down there.
We are great at sensing Aether, so there shouldn’t be any issues.

Name: Khoon
Text:
But first, get some rest!
You look like you need it.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I’ll visit some of the injured people at the lake.
I also have to ask Babylon for some supplies.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Come out when you feel better.
Just don’t touch the key, alright?

I wonder if Koon really saw right through my condition.
My stomach was churning so badly, I had no choice but to rest up.
Is this because I went looking for the Warden?

Name: Chedar
Text:
I heard from the others about what just happened.
You were warped somewhere when you got close to the floating debris, right?

Name: Chedar
Text:
I so wish I was there to see that!
Even if I ask you to stay here, you would decline, right?

Name: Chedar
Text:
Actually, it hasn’t been long since I started the research.
I want to make as much progress as I can.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Some sort of barrier spell had been cast on it until now,
so no one could lay a finger on the floating debris.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Even the Appraisers Guild had to eventually wrap up and leave.
Our expedition team was the only one that held out.

Name: Chedar
Text:
We set up a waypoint and spent years just staring at it...
Then, out of nowhere, the barrier suddenly dissolved!

Name: Chedar
Text:
I don't know how it happened,
but we should take this chance to finish what we came for, right?

Name: Chedar
Text:
Phew, but taking care of the injured should be our priority.
Meanwhile, you can also take care of your business.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I’ll let you go for now, but please find your way back later.
Our waypoint desperately needs anyone who can actually work...

Name: Khoon
Text:
I heard from the Cave Owl
that the Lake of Spirits possesses all kinds of effects.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Drinking the lake water cleanses toxin,
and washing in it rejuvenates your skin.

Name: Khoon
Text:
They say even looking at it washes away your fatigue.
The way they talk about it, you would think that it cures even incurable diseases.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The elders want me to take you to the lake…
Hoping that you will absorb the good energy and get better soon.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Now! Go and take a breath.
You really do need some rest.

Name: Khoon
Text:
It's true that Aether is thick around here.
So the rumors weren't exaggerated after all. Haha.

Name: Khoon
Text: The healing methods of the Battle Priests begins with handling Aethers.

Name: Khoon
Text:
You lack the knowledge, yet you seem to understand it. Instinct, maybe? 
Well, we can at least take a breather.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Oh! And they said thanks for saving them from that lunatic.
They told me not to forget to tell you.

Name: Khoon
Text: I can’t believe the influence of the Paradise Advent Society still lingers… Phew.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I have to let the other Divines know as soon as possible.
I will also ask the Manors of each nation for cooperation.

Name: Khoon
Text: The Core that the warden asked to retrieve.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Even though he asked us to go south to get it,
that doesn’t mean it’s at in Elysium.

Name: Khoon
Text:
We might have to keep heading south
and end up crossing the Asientet Gate.

Name: Khoon
Text: Then we have to make sure the Manors don’t stop us.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Then let’s go hunting!
It needs to eat some treats to keep up its speed.

Name: Khoon
Text: Once, the Archon joined our guild’s hunting tournament.

Name: Khoon
Text:
He said he used to be quite powerful in his youth and his skills were truly amazing.
I also stayed and watched for a while.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I brought my messenger hawk along to let it stretch its wings…
But I think it fell in love with the Archon there at first sight.

Name: Khoon
Text:
It used to fly around me,
but it cried so much whenever Lorraine showed up…

Name: Khoon
Text:
Phew, anyway.
If you want it to run errands, you have to give it a lot of food.

Name: Khoon
Text: Since it hates anything ordinary, we need to get even more and a wider variety than this.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Perfect! I think this should be enough to convince it.
It’s such a picky eater. It’s always a hassle.

Name: Khoon
Text: But I should make sure it’s cooked since I can’t give it anything rotten.

Name: Khoon
Text: There is a great place to start a fire over a hill. Follow me!

Name: Khoon
Text: Go a little further to the east, and there should be a hill with a great view.

Name: Khoon
Text: It’s a familiar place to the hunters from the Elysium.

Name: Khoon
Text:
It’s the perfect place to release a hawk or an eagle.
Also, it is a good place to watch if the bird is going the right way.

Name: Khoon
Text: It’s a bit steep, but it should be fine for you. Don’t worry.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Thunderwings doesn’t like the cold.
I should have it get going before it gets dark.

Name: A Quiet Noise
Text: Rustle!

Name: Khoon
Text: Huh? Who’s there?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Phew, are you hurt?
It happened so fast, I couldn’t protect you properly.

Name: Khoon
Text:
There was a strange altar deep inside the forest.
Corpses started appearing nearby.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Even though this place is adjacent to the Red Mist Forest,
it’s a far stretch to assume that such altar exists in every forest.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I told the other hunters about the altars,
but I don’t think that’s going to be enough.

Name: Khoon
Text:
We should head to the Red Mist Forest.
Another altar might be there.

Name: Khoon
Text: [player], can we reclaim the core a bit later?

Name: Khoon
Text:
I’m not saying we should stop!
I just want to investigate this at the same time.

Name: Khoon
Text:
We were already headed to the southern part of Elysium, right?
The Red Mist Forest is roughly in the same direction.

Name: Khoon
Text: Thank you, let’s take a break and get going again.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Shall we get moving?
We have to find both the core and the altar as soon as possible.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Let’s send Thunderwings to the Archon first,
then head straight down below.

Name: Khoon
Text: It’s just a quick trip to the “Nameless Village” on a Glider.

Name: Khoon
Text:
That's where you'll find the most Cave Owls in the Elysium.
You know, the descendants of the Tahn Kingdom.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I heard more of them have gone missing lately… We should go ask around.
Who knows, maybe it has something to do with those walking corpses…

Name: Khoon
Text: …Let's go. Just head up the eastern path.

Name: Khoon
Text: Look at that! I knew it’d play mind games.

Name: Khoon
Text:
It usually rests on this perch at this hour.
But the moment it senses me, it flies far away on purpose.

Name: Khoon
Text:
It still won't accept me as its master!
And here I thought we settled who's in charge ages ago.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I'm serious!
Ugh, this bird is completely ruining my reputation… *sigh.*

Name: Khoon
Text: Anyway, if we want it to come down, we need the smell of blood.

Name: Khoon
Text:
It’s what I do when food won't lure it in.
It absolutely hates watching me hunt alone.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Thinks it’s a true hunter itself! What a ridiculous creature.
Let's move. It'll come down on its own once it knows what’s going on.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Heh, it worked.
Thunderwings is flying lower.

Name: Khoon
Text: See? I told you I'm the boss! Hahaha!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Yeah, once it fully lands on the perch.
Let's see how close it is.

Looking up, Thunderwings had descended right above Koon's head,
glaring down with a distinctly irritated look…

Name: [player]
Text:
(It's nice to see it enjoying the food…
…after all that trouble.)
Thunderwings gave its head a sharp shake, then looked at Koon.

Koon gently stroked his hunting hawk's head,
scooped it up with care, and tossed it back into the sky.

Name: Khoon
Text: Well, it looks like it's heading northwest.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Seems it's flying straight to Archon Lorraine.
Always makes things hard once in a while only to do it right later.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Still, Thunderwings has never failed a mission. Not once.
We should get the Archon's reply soon enough.

Name: Khoon
Text: We just need to head to the Nameless Village and do what we have to do.

Name: Khoon
Text:
All right, see that perfect launch spot over there?
Check your mount one last time.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Oh, and make sure you don't land right in the middle of the village.
I got in big trouble for that last time.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The locals there are a bit faint-hearted.
A few of them actually fainted from the shock.

Name: Khoon
Text: Anyway, I’m taking off first. Follow me right behind!

Name: Khoon
Text: Something’s wrong. It was never like this around the Nameless Village.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The Cave Owls worked so hard to build their home here.
They chose this high ground because of the monsters.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Let’s cull their numbers first.
The villagers can't handle this on their own.

Name: Cave Owl A (Female Villager)
Text:
You’re the ones who… dropped out of the sky … right?
Thank you for your help.

Name: Cave Owl A (Female Villager)
Text:
I swear, their numbers were growing already,
but after the hunters are gone, they're becoming even more rampant.

Name: Khoon
Text: About those missing people… Is that because of the monsters too?

Name: Cave Owl A (Female Villager)
Text:
Come to think of it, it all happened around the same time…
Wait, no… Missing? Was there anyone missing?

Name: Khoon
Text:
I might have been a bit too forward.
Let me ask again.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Are there any missing people?
We can help with the search, so take your time and tell us.

Name: Cave Owl A (Female Villager)
Text: No, no, nothing is wrong in our village.

Name: Cave Owl A (Female Villager)
Text:
We are simply people carrying on the will of Tahn.
No one goes missing here. Nothing like that ever happens…

Name: Khoon
Text:
…I see.
You must be shaken up by the monsters, so please get some rest.

Name: Cave Owl B (Male Villager)
Text:
Outsiders, huh?
Go back before you run into trouble.

Name: Cave Owl B (Male Villager)
Text: We braved these harsh mountains to finally carve out a place to live, and yet…

Name: Cave Owl B (Male Villager)
Text: Day after day, it's monsters, corpses… *sigh.* It never ends.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Did you just say you saw corpses here too?!
Please, tell me more!

Name: Cave Owl B (Male Villager)
Text:
The dead moving with no mind of their own…
If that isn't… a living corpse… then what, what else…?

Name: Cave Owl B (Male Villager)
Text:
What… what was it… what did I say?
Wait, what did I just say?

Name: Khoon
Text: Yeah. Let's just let him go quietly.

Name: Khoon
Text:
You seem exhausted.
Go on home and get some rest.

Name: Cave Owl B (Male Villager)
Text:
Anyway, you two stay safe out there.
It’s best to stay in the village until the hunters get back.

Name: Khoon
Text: So, food and water weren't the cause after all.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I ran into a hunter who came down from above.
He said he ate here several times and was completely fine.

Name: Khoon
Text:
He found it incredibly strange too.
We need to go ask him more about this.

Name: Dispatched Hunter (Male)
Text:
So, this must be your partner?
Stick together no matter what! This is no place to wander alone.

Name: Dispatched Hunter (Male)
Text:
The Undead strike without warning,
so don't get overconfident. And always stay alert.

Name: Khoon
Text: The Undead… Do you mean walking corpses?

Name: Dispatched Hunter (Male)
Text:
Yes! It’s a vile, wicked art.
You won’t find many records of it these days.

Name: Dispatched Hunter (Male)
Text:
I thought that dark practice died out when we fell to Krea…
I'm an old man, and even I have never seen it until now.

Name: Khoon
Text: A wicked art? You mean it's actually magic?

Name: Dispatched Hunter (Male)
Text:
It was practiced in the shadows, long before the fall of Tahn.
An atrocious magic that reanimates the dead…

Name: Dispatched Hunter (Male)
Text: Someone used that wicked art to raise an “Army of the Undead.”

Name: Dispatched Hunter (Male)
Text:
Mindless husks following orders…
Nothing more than rotting flesh with a human face!

Name: Khoon
Text: …I have never heard of an Army of the Undead.

Name: Dispatched Hunter (Male)
Text:
I was only a boy myself back then.
I thought it was just a fairy tale to scare some sense into naughty children.

Name: Khoon
Text:
We can't just take our time investigating this anymore.
We need to hurry before there are more victims.

Name: Dispatched Hunter (Male)
Text:
Take a look at this.
It’s our plan for the dispatched hunters.

Name: Dispatched Hunter (Male)
Text: We wish you can help out where we can’t.

Name: Khoon
Text: We can take care of the last item.

Name: [player]
Text: (Koon explains to the hunter what he had witnessed deep within the forest.)

Name: [player]
Text:
(Even the seasoned elder’s gaze sharpens,
and shakes his head at the word “altar.”)

Name: Khoon
Text:
I’ll look around the area as we move toward the Red Mist Forest.
There might be an altar there as well.

Name: Dispatched Hunter (Male)
Text: I'll trust your judgment as a Divine.

Name: Dispatched Hunter (Male)
Text:
Besides, hunters don't herd together.
Let's each do our part.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Look at these jars placed here.
Why would anyone need them in a place crawling with monsters?

Name: Khoon
Text:
But they aren't for creating corpses, either.
The Aether feels entirely different.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Exactly. We have the altar as clear proof.
Let’s connect this to the villagers’ condition.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The foul energy coming from these jars…
…might be why they can’t speak properly.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Once we get them back to normal,
let’s ask them again about the Undead and the disappearance cases.

Name: Khoon
Text:
We should take a jar, just in case.
If they're a medium, they may be useful somehow.

Name: Khoon
Text:
We must check every monster-infested site nearby.
There's no way they only set this up here.

Name: Khoon
Text: Those behind these dark schemes always cast a wide, shallow net.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Let's split up, like we did before.
I'll go first, so follow right behind!

Name: Khoon
Text:
I recovered several more jars.
They look identical to the one we discovered earlier, and the energy feels similar

Name: Khoon
Text:
We should stop by the village before heading east.
Some might be hidden inside somewhere.

Name: Khoon
Text:
What if the jars are affecting the residents...?
And that's why they're acting strange?

Name: Khoon
Text: All right. Let's split up and ask around.

Name: Cave Owl B (Male Villager)
Text:
Planning on staying here for a while?
Sorry for the lack of hospitality.

Name: Cave Owl B (Male Villager)
Text: We used up all our emergency supplies fighting off the monsters.

Name: Cave Owl B (Male Villager)
Text: What? What about the jar—ugh!

Name: Cave Owl B (Male Villager)
Text:
Ah… Argh! My head… it hurts….
Get that thing away from me!

Name: [player]
Text: (It's probably best to leave quickly.)

Name: Cave Owl A (Female Villager)
Text: Is there something else you need from me?

Name: Cave Owl A (Female Villager)
Text:
That’s a pretty jar…!
I received something similar as a gift… Yes, a gift…

Name: Cave Owl A (Female Villager)
Text:
Ugh! Everything… is spinning all of a sudden…
When… Who gave it to me? Ugh…

Name: Cave Owl A (Female Villager)
Text:
I’m sorry, I must go home…
I feel so dizzy right now… Ooh…

Name: [player]
Text: (Koon was right.)

Name: [player]
Text: (Even if their minds clear up, they are still worried about the monsters.)

Name: [player]
Text:
(Gaining their trust is always useful.
It might lead to a clue about the Horn of Dawn.)

Name: [player]
Text: (Better to clear the eastern area before heading back.)

Name: Man on the Ground (Naraf)
Text: It's dangerous here… Agh… Run… quickly…

Name: Man on the Ground (Naraf)
Text: Don't worry about me… Just get to… a safe place…

Name: Man on the Ground (Naraf)
Text: I can't protect you… while fighting them off…

With some effort, I helped the man to his feet.
After a moment of hesitation, he drank the recovery potion I offered,
and he introduced himself as Naraf, a priest of this land.

Name: Naraf
Text:
I am a priest of the “Baekryeong” clan.
We've lived here since the days of the old Tahn Kingdom.

Name: Naraf
Text:
But a family crest means little in the Forsaken Land.
Out here, I am just another Cave Owl.

Name: Naraf
Text:
My fellow priests and I….
…have been working to purify this area.

Name: Naraf
Text: Right now, we need to destroy some strange jars.

Name: Naraf
Text: Forgive me. You saved my life, and I have nothing to give you right now.

Name: [player]
Text: (I wondered why he was out here alone… It seems he's just trying to help.)

Name: [player]
Text: (You’d explain that you’ve been clearing out the jars and monsters too.)

Name: Naraf
Text: Really? Then we can share the same goal.

Name: Naraf
Text:
But let’s talk more in detail later.
The Undead could swarm us at any moment.

Name: Naraf
Text: Destroy any jars in sight.

Name: Naraf
Text:
They're inscribed with a disruption ward.
It came from Tahn.

Name: Naraf
Text:
It's a form of mind magic,
banned ages ago.

Name: Naraf
Text: It allows the caster to cloud the victim's mind at will.

Name: Naraf
Text:
The required ingredients are one thing,
but the victim doesn't even realize they've been hexed—

Name: Naraf
Text:
Curse it… The Undead are coming!
This way, quickly!

Name: Naraf
Text: Thank you for accepting what may have been an unreasonable request.

Name: Naraf
Text:
I should've explained how dangerous it was in detail…
I feel like I've dragged you into this against your will.

Name: Naraf
Text:
…Let's head to the Nameless Village.
I'll tell you everything I know.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I just finished up here too.
I was about to contact you, and here you are just in time!

Name: Khoon
Text: By the way, who’s that beside you?

Name: Naraf
Text:
I am Naraf, a priest of the Baekryeong clan.
It is an honor to meet you, Koon.

Name: Naraf
Text:
There is hardly a Cave Owl out here who doesn't know of you.
No need to look so surprised.

Name: Naraf
Text:
I assume you're here because of the Undead?
It seems we can join forces in one way or another.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Oh, haha, right. I like how quickly you get to the point.
And yes, we're hunting the ones behind them.

Name: Khoon
Text:
You came here with my friend.
Does it mean we can speak openly?

Name: Naraf
Text: Yes, let us get straight to it.

Name: [player]
Text: (Koon and Naraf may talk for a while.)

Name: [player]
Text:
(Naraf said the Ashen Crows have revealed their true colors…
Does he mean the ones we met in the deep forest?)

Name: [player]
Text:
(There were Ashen Crows in the Hunters' Village too.
I thought they were just ordinary folk clinging to old glory…)

Name: [player]
Text:
(If the Ashen Crows are behind the Undead…
it means the children of Tahn are killing their own.)

Name: Naraf
Text:
…So, that's all.
Is there anything you want to ask?

Name: Khoon
Text: So, that “preparation” the Ashen Crows kept talking about…

Name: Khoon
Text:
They're slaughtering their own kind to build an army from their corpses, right?
And they call that restoring Tahn!

Name: Naraf
Text: Until recently, the Undead were only spotted deep within the mountains and woods.

Name: Naraf
Text:
And as you said, Koon, it was always near the altars.
We focused all our efforts on stopping them there.

Name: Naraf
Text: Lately, though, they aren't even trying to hide their tracks.

Name: Naraf
Text:
They went from merely recruiting people into the Ashen Crows…
…to straight-up kidnapping them.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Hold on… They’re originally Cave Owls too, aren't they?
They're just ordinary people.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Even with the magic on those jars and all,
they shouldn't have the power to raise the Undead.

Name: Naraf
Text:
There are those practicing forbidden rites.
They are the main throng of the Ashen Crows.

Name: Naraf
Text: If we take them out, no one will go missing at least.

Name: Khoon
Text:
We need to keep the villagers safe most of all.
We'll go hunt them down right away.

Name: Naraf
Text:
They have made the “Citadel of Valor” their stronghold.
It lies on the high ground west of the village.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Don’t follow us.
Don't push yourself, and get those wounds looked at.

Name: Naraf
Text:
…Forgive me. I should have finished this no matter what.
I'm sorry to leave this on your shoulders.

Name: Khoon
Text:
No need to worry about us.
We’re a duo that never lost a fight.

Name: Khoon
Text:
So that's why you've been pestering me.
I didn't even know you existed.

Name: Khoon
Text: You want to drag me into this nightmare?

Name: Khoon
Text: Wake up. You can't rebuild Tahn like this!

Name: Nuul
Text:
It hurts to hear you say that.
You are the last bloodline of the royal house.

Name: Nuul
Text: You ought to be our only cause and symbol!

Name: Nuul
Text:
What good is that hollow title of Divine?
It's just a leash, making you an official errand runner.

Name: Nuul
Text: So that’s why I—the Ashen Crows—will make you a king.

Name: Nuul
Text:
We will crush Krea, the empire that stole everything from us,
and reclaim our glory!

Name: Nuul
Text: With an army of the Undead, the world will kneel before us! Hahahaha!

Name: Khoon
Text:
…You're utterly insane.
And you are delusional!

Name: Khoon
Text:
We can barely hold back the Incursions,
and you want to start a war with a major empire?

Name: Khoon
Text:
You slaughtered your own people.
You denied them their peace. You dishonored them.

Name: Khoon
Text:
You abandoned your heritage,
yet claim this is for the children of Tahn… Ha.

Name: Nuul
Text:
Still resisting… Fine.
You will understand in the end.

Name: Nuul
Text:
Today, I’ll show you firsthand
just what our army is capable of.

Name: Khoon
Text: Agh… It's poison! Don't breathe it in!

Name: Khoon
Text: Watch out!

Name: Beretta
Text:
You look a mess! I told you to stay out of trouble.
What exactly did you do to end up half-dead?

Name: Khoon
Text: I almost died… Actually, maybe I did die for a second….

Name: Beretta
Text:
Stop exaggerating.
A Divine groaning over a scratch.

Name: Beretta
Text: What? You rushed in without thinking again, didn't you?

Name: Khoon
Text: It's not that bad… Seriously, I'm fine.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I sent you to look after the patient,
not to get yourself hurt too!

Name: Beretta
Text: Look, [player] is naturally tough, so they’ll recover on his own. But…

Name: Beretta
Text:
Koon, anyone else would’ve passed out from the pain by now.
Stop fighting it and just lie down.

Name: Khoon
Text: No, I can’t. I have to hunt down Paran and the Ashen Crows!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Wait, Nuul clearly said he had an artifact.
It can't be the Horn of Dawn, right?

Name: Beretta
Text:
Speaking of artifacts.
You two sent a letter to Archon Lorraine, didn't you?

Name: Beretta
Text:
She repeated several times that I had to deliver this reply.
And in person.

Name: Beretta
Text:
But I know you. Once you read this, you'll only get more reckless..
Why should I give it to you?

Name: Khoon
Text: Beretta! You know we don't have time to bicker like this.

Name: Beretta
Text: I also know this isn't something you two can handle alone.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Give me one good reason why I should let a half-dead man rush into danger.
Convince me, and I'll look the other way.

Name: [player]
Text:
(That's Lorraine's handwriting.
She must have been busy and asked Beretta to reply.)

Name: [player]
Text: (If this is true, they're using the Horn of Dawn to control the dead.)

Name: [player]
Text:
(But a corpse is an organic body.
(No matter how powerful the Tower is… it can't…)

Name: Beretta
Text:
If you're done reading, get over here.
Koon's still being stubborn after hearing everything.

Name: Beretta
Text: Our goal was to find a way to contact the Tower's Warden.

Name: Beretta
Text:
And you already achieved that with the “Key,” didn’t you?
Meeting the Paradise Advent Society was a surprise, though.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Then you should've come back to discuss the next move.
Not slumping around with internal injuries like this.

Name: Beretta
Text:
So, you completely trust him?
You’re just going to do whatever he says?

Name: Beretta
Text:
Your goals line up when it comes to stopping Xeros.
But that doesn't mean you have to follow his every word.

Name: Beretta
Text: And putting people in harm's way is definitely out of the question.

Name: Khoon
Text: You're right. You always say the right thing…
