Name: Khoon
Text:
But this is different.
I'm the one who has to step in.

Name: Khoon
Text: Sure, the Horn might be exactly what the Warden was looking for! I see that.

Name: Khoon
Text:
But innocent people are being sacrificed.
If you saw what they went through, you wouldn't just be worrying about me.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I never told you to ignore it!
I'm telling you to assess the situation first.

Name: Beretta
Text:
If you move like this, the venom will only spread faster.
By then, not even Radha can cure you.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Besides, this isn't some common toxin.
It'll take ages just to find a cure. Can you even hold out until then?

Name: Khoon
Text:
…I'll do whatever it takes to do so.
If I'm going to collapse, it'll be after everything is done.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Ha. Humans.
So fragile, yet always trying to save someone.

Name: Beretta
Text:
[player], do you know anyone in this village?
An apothecary, a priest, anyone.

Name: [player]
Text:
(You tell Beretta about Naraf, a priest of the Baekryeong Clan,
and she gestures for you to lead the way.)

Name: Beretta
Text:
Lead the way, then.
A toxin from a descendant of Tahn needs an antidoe from a descendant of Tahn.

Name: Naraf
Text:
You're back, Adventurer.
I've been feeling guilty for leaving you to go alone.

Name: Naraf
Text: While you were away, I tended to the villagers.

Name: Naraf
Text: Have you had any success regarding the Ashen Crows?

Name: Beretta
Text:
So that's how it is. Tell me how to cure him right now.
I've done all I can as far as first aid goes.

Name: Naraf
Text: …Koon has been afflicted by a deadly toxin.

Name: Naraf
Text: Both the poison and the antidote are known only to the Baekryeong Clan.

Name: Naraf
Text:
I can give him temporary treatment,
but it’ll only slow down its progress.

Name: Naraf
Text:
Luckily, our manor is not far from here.
Let me guide you there.

Name: Naraf
Text:
Don't worry about this place. I'll check on them regularly.
It's naturally our duty.

Name: Naraf
Text:
The spell broke the moment that jars, the magical catalyst, was shattered.
But it leaves behind a brutal headache.

Name: Beretta
Text:
What do you mean, mind magic?
That stuff was banned ages ago!

Name: Beretta
Text: I sent you out to rest, and look at the mess you're digging into… *sigh*

Name: Beretta
Text:
Go and bring the proper antidote first.
We will do what we can to patch up Koon for now.

Name: Beretta
Text:
So you’re a priest from the Baekryeong Clan, right?
Now, why don't you tell me more about this magic?

Name: Sol
Text:
I am Sol, a priest of the Baekryeong Clan,
responsible for the safety of this manor.

Name: Sol
Text:
Now that you know who I am, it is only proper you introduce yourself as well.
Answer me. Don’t waste any more time.

Name: Sol
Text: Naraf? She went to check on the area. How did you meet her?

Name: Sol
Text:
I don't believe it.
You're telling me that child saved the leader of the Ashen Crows…?

Name: Sol
Text:
The very fiend who drove our clan into exile?
Someone who doesn't even deserve to be called a descendant of Tahn?

Name: Sol
Text:
…Fine. So you need an antidote.
Since Naraf sent you, I'll trust you're not an enemy.

Name: Sol
Text:
That toxin was crafted to mimic a parasite that destroys its host.
The victim lives without suspecting a thing. By the time they realize it's there, it's too late.

Name: Sol
Text:
Once the poison completely consumes the heart,
they feel something is wrong with their body.

Name: Sol
Text:
But how fast it spreads depends entirely on how much you move.
And most hunters… well, they rarely sit still.

Name: Sol
Text:
To brew the cure, we must infuse it with Baekryeong magic for hours.
And of course, we need the basic ingredients as well.

Name: Sol
Text:
But too many have fallen victim to that poison recently.
We barely have enough supplies for our own people.

Name: Sol
Text:
I need to head outside the manor to gather the materials.
While I do, I want you to fend off the monsters.

Name: Sol
Text:
We are heading southwest.
It'll be faster to find what we need there.

Name: Sol
Text: A successor goes through grueling training that would break most adults.

Name: Sol
Text:
To properly master mind magic,
the caster needs unbreakable willpower.

Name: Sol
Text: Fasting, confinement, meditation… that's only the beginning.

Name: Sol
Text:
They trap you in an illusion of being completely alone,
facing a horde of monsters for days.

Name: Sol
Text:
If you die in that illusion, you are immediately brought back.
Over and over, you feel the agony of taking your last breath.

Name: Sol
Text: Left all alone, consumed by the terror of not knowing when death will strike next.

Name: Sol
Text:
We believed only those who conquered that fear were fit to lead.
It was a tradition from before the fall of Tahn.

Name: Sol
Text: But it was only after Paran was gone that we finally woke up.

Name: Sol
Text:
We were foolish adults robbing a child of their future.
That child always told us how hard it was, begging us to stop.

Name: Sol
Text:
Everyone prays for Paran's return,
But we will never put that weight on her again.

Name: Sol
Text: If she would just stop wandering the wilds and stay here, I'd ask for nothing more.

Name: Sol
Text:
…Let's move on to the next zone.
We're still short on ingredients for the antidote.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Naraf treated me,
and Beretta nagged me, so I'm completely fine now!

Name: Khoon
Text:
I don't think I even need that antidote.
I could jump into a fight right this second.

Name: Sol
Text:
So it was you who needed the antidote.
Koon, the Divine of the Forsaken Land.

Name: Sol
Text:
What Naraf gave you won't last long.
You’d better wait here.

Name: Khoon
Text:
With the Ashen Crows running amok,
how can we waste time here?

Name: Sol
Text:
No matter how strong you are,
you can't fight through the Baekryeong's deadliest toxin.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I don't hold the title of "Divine" for nothing.
I can hold my own longer than you think.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Instead of worrying about my safety,
you should be figuring out how to explain these events

Name: Sol
Text: …What is that supposed to mean?

Name: Khoon
Text:
The entire Elysium is in chaos because of the Undead.
Yet, this place remains perfectly calm.

Name: Khoon
Text: You have the luxury to brew an antidote for me and long for someone who left.

Name: Khoon
Text:
That priest, Naraf, has an outstanding sense of responsibility.
She seems to think this entire disaster was her own fault.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Which means the Baekryeong Clan is either deeply tied to the Undead…
or they know exactly what's going on.

Name: Sol
Text:
They say you live like a wanderer, but you're sharper than you look.
This is going to be a long talk.

Name: Sol
Text:
Adventurer, go disrupt the Aether entanglement over there.
It's the food the Undead crave the most.

Name: Sol
Text: While you do that, I'll be proving our innocence to the Divine here.

Name: Khoon
Text:
You brought back quite a lot. We could brew enough for you, too.
Of course, I’m still perfectly fine… ugh!

Name: Khoon
Text:
As you can see… I’m totally… bursting with energy, right?
They said it takes days to brew, so we just have to finish everything before then!

Name: Sol
Text:
It is true that some of our priests sided with the Ashen Crows.
The Baekryeong Clan will take full responsibility till the end.

Name: Sol
Text:
If Paran saved Nuul and they're working together…
We pushed that child to the edge. That is on us.

Name: Sol
Text:
The jars putting a fog in the minds of the Cave Owls—
The traitors within our clan are responsible for those.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Save the self-pity for later.
No group can be perfectly controlled.

Name: Sol
Text:
A long time ago… the army of the Undead that ravaged Tahn.
That was also the work of a rogue who broke away from Baekryeong.

Name: Sol
Text: As punishment for that crime, the Kingdom of Tahn slaughtered the entire clan.

Name: Sol
Text:
The survivors settled here,
swearing to serve the descendants of Tahn.

Name: Sol
Text: So, it is only right that we take action this time as well.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The real culprit is someone else, though… urgh.
It's just time to let your actions speak for you.

Name: Sol
Text:
From what I’ve gathered,
Paran is likely controlling the undead.

Name: Sol
Text:
Just because it was banned doesn't mean the magic was forgotten.
With Paran's skills, she is more than capable of casting it.

Name: Khoon
Text:
We need to find her first…
Do you have any idea where she might be?

Name: Sol
Text:
If you go deep into the valley, you will see a training ground.
She has been sighted there several times, so head that way.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Wow, they train in a place like this?
Even the toughest adults would freeze up and run.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Could it have been beautiful once?
Because right now, it literally reeks of death.

Name: Khoon
Text: The entire southwest area of Elysium used to be their land.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Looks like they recently moved their base,
probably because of the Ashen Crows.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Since traitors emerged from within the household,
they must have lost their main territory first.

Name: Khoon
Text: They said she comes here sometimes. Should we make some noise?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Dig up dirt, smash some pottery…
just anything to get noticed.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Will this do?
This doesn't even qualify as a warmup.

Name: Khoon
Text: Boring! The monsters here don't live up to the vibe at all.

Name: Khoon
Text: Hey, should we go stir up trouble over there?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Who do you take me for? I'm Koon, the hunter among hunters.
Everyone calls me the "Divine."

Name: Khoon
Text:
Besides, it looks like we're alone out here.
We need to search over there for Paran… ugh.

Name: Khoon
Text: Like I said… let's move while I can still…stand!

Name: Naraf
Text:
Just as she said..
She said you two wouldn't sit still.

Name: Naraf
Text:
I know Priest Sol is mixing the antidote,
but you need to take it easy until then.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Phew, Beretta is way too suspicious.
Does she think I'm a walking bomb or something?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Anyway, it looks like you heard what we're up against.
We need to find Paran as soon as possible.

Name: Naraf
Text:
There's no telling what state she is in.
Yet, she keeps coming back here.

Name: Naraf
Text:
This place was also used for memorial rites.
It's a sacred tradition for the descendants of Tahn.

Name: Naraf
Text:
As the successor, Paran knew that well.
She always cared about honoring the Undead.

Name: Khoon
Text:
And that's how she discovered mind magic?
All records must have been purged. How did she find out?

Name: Naraf
Text: …She must have learned it from the cowards lurking in our ranks.

Name: Naraf
Text: Besides, it’s not a complicated spell. You don’t need records to learn it.

Name: Naraf
Text:
Dead bodies and a massive amount of Aether.
That's all it takes to cast it.

Name: Khoon
Text:
The Ashen Crows supplied the bodies,
and the Aether must have come from outside.

Name: Khoon
Text:
They didn't just show up at the Lake of Spirits for no reason.
That place is dense with Aether, too.

Name: Naraf
Text:
The key is forcing the Aether into the dead,
forcing them to move again.

Name: Khoon
Text: …A magic completely devoid of ethics.

Name: Naraf
Text: Please, save Paran… and the victims.

Name: Naraf
Text:
We'll check the other side.
If anything changes, fire a flare to let us know.

Name: Khoon
Text:
If I remember correctly,
we just need to pass two main paths to reach the southernmost edge.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Haha… Maybe I should've listened to Beretta.
I'm starting to feel a bit sore all over.

Name: Khoon
Text:
It's not like Paran is an assassin… She totally played the part of a rookie hunter, right?
How was I supposed to know she'd throw a poisoned blade out of nowhere?

Name: Khoon
Text:
No, I'm seeing this through myself.
That's the only way to stop another group like the Ashen Crows from appearing.

Name: Khoon
Text: Besides… we came here to find the “Horn of Dawn.”

Name: Khoon
Text:
This is a mission for just the two of us.
I'm not leaving you to finish it alone.

Name: Khoon
Text: The monsters around here are basically the walking dead, too.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Do you really think Nuul would only use people for his army?
If he runs short, he'd gladly throw monster corpses in the mix.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Let's clear them all out.
We shouldn't leave anything that could become a future threat.

Name: Naraf
Text:
I still haven't found any real leads.
But there's something else we have to address first.

Name: Naraf
Text:
We can't leave Koon like this.
I can practically feel death looming over him.

Name: Naraf
Text:
You know his nature better than I do.
He’ll never listen to any advice to rest and recover.

Name: Naraf
Text:
I treated him, but it didn't remove the poison.
It only bought him some time until he can take the real antidote.

Name: Naraf
Text:
The potion Priest Sol is brewing—
that's the only thing that can save him.

Name: Naraf
Text:
Pushing himself like this…
It will ruin everything I've done for him.

Name: Naraf
Text:
So, please, just get him to rest.
Don't let him get hurt or out of breath.

Name: Naraf
Text:
Watch him so he doesn't do anything reckless.
Unless you want to speed up your friend's death.

Name: Naraf
Text: Meanwhile, I'll go get help, whether it's Priest Sol or someone else.

Name: Naraf
Text: Then, he won't have any excuse to refuse when we tell him to leave the rest to others.

Name: Naraf
Text:
Don't listen to him if he claims this whole thing is his fault—
just take him and go back yourself.

Name: Khoon
Text: Phew! How did it go on your end? I wiped them all out.

Name: [player]
Text:
(You tell him that you saw someone near the cliff,
suggesting a search since it might be Nuul's gang.)

Name: Khoon
Text:
Searching? Now that’s my specialty.
A hunter’s instinct never fails, no matter where we are.

Name: Khoon
Text:
Hey… I’m not about to collapse just yet, so stop worrying.
Besides, I know these woods better than you do.

(You ask him to keep watch while you check the area.
Koon laughed heartily, calling it teamwork, and headed off.)

Name: [player]
Text:
(You wonder how long he'll buy this cheap trick.
For now, you just need to pretend you’re sticking to the plan.)

Name: Khoon
Text:
[player], there's nothing out here!
Did they move already?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Wait, I just saw something behind you.
Is that… Paran?

Name: Paran
Text:
Leave while you still can…
I don't know how much longer I can stay in my right mind.

Name: Khoon
Text: Are you working with Nuul… and the Baekryeong traitors?

Name: Khoon
Text:
Stop this now.
If you help us drive them out…

Name: Paran
Text: That won't erase what I’ve done…

Name: Paran
Text:
I never knew it would come to this…
but following Nuul was my choice.

Name: Paran
Text:
I was the one who handed him the Horn of Dawn…
He intends to bring back those dark days…

Name: Paran
Text:
There’s nothing you can do… but run.
Just leave the Elysium…

Name: Khoon
Text: We can still stop this! If you only choose to… gh! Cough!

Name: Naraf
Text:
I knew he would rush in the first chance he got.
I'm glad I came straight here.

Name: Sol
Text: I gave him the antidote, but it will take time for it to kick in.

Name: Naraf
Text:
Nuul's men tracked us down.
The three of us will have to take them on.

Name: Sol
Text: Koon! If you’re going to collapse, get out of the way!

Name: Paran
Text:
Stay out of Nuul's way.
He was the one who took me in. I won't forgive anyone who hurts him.

Name: Paran
Text: Keep following me, and I'll kill you all.

Name: Naraf
Text:
They’re right on our heels.
Deal with them first, get her later!

Name: Sol
Text:
He’s still breathing.
We need to get him to the Repose and purge the toxin from his body.

Name: Sol
Text:
With him unconscious, his Aether flow is turning erratic.
Even with the antidote, he's not out of the woods yet.

Name: Naraf
Text: Let's head back to the Repose. There is no time to waste.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Our idiot friend is resting safely over there.
Looks like you managed to feed him the antidote before I arrived.

Name: Beretta
Text:
*sigh…* I had a bad feeling about this, so I came to check.
Of course you two went off to play heroes.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I knew he’d end up like this.
Honestly, I'm not even surprised anymore.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I've told Radha to meet us at the Nameless Village.
We’ll move Koon there once his breathing stabilizes.

Name: Beretta
Text:
The people here are skilled in mending the mind,
but they are different from the priests we usually deal with.

Name: Beretta
Text:
From here on out, Radha has to take over.
This requires pouring in Aether to heal him.

Name: Beretta
Text: It's my fault for putting two go-getters like you together.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Just read this note and cool your head.
Let me figure out what's going on first.

Name: Beretta
Text:
You remember that letter you got from Archon Lorraine?
I’ve already discussed it with the Liberator.

Name: Beretta
Text:
The Tower has five core facilities.
Each needs its own power source to function.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Everything points to one thing.
The power source is the "Cores" the Warden wanted.

Name: Beretta
Text: He said we need the Cores to restore the Tower.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Those facilities are not movable.
That means the Cores to run them must be out there.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I won't nag you about this anymore.
Just call me if things get ugly.

Name: Beretta
Text:
We need to fix the Tower first.
That's the only way to safely neutralize it.

Name: Beretta
Text:
My goal hasn't changed.
So bring back the Horn of Dawn.

Name: Beretta
Text: Don't worry about Koon. Radha and I will get him back on his feet.

Name: Beretta
Text: Once you find the Core, take it straight to the Warden.

Name: Beretta
Text:
We need to clear this mess so those command-driven corpses stop moving.
That whole army of the Undead will finally vanish.

Name: Sol
Text:
The Ashen Crows are raising the Undead again.
People are dying everywhere.

Name: Sol
Text: They’ve became desperate now that we showed up at the Sorrow's Manor.

Name: Sol
Text: We priests of Baekryeong have to put all our focus on guarding the Cave Owls.

Name: Sol
Text:
So, I’m leaving Nuul and his men to you.
I’m sorry we can't do more.

Name: Sol
Text:
The Undead are marching here from the Sorrow's Manor.
Whoever is controlling them must be there too.

Name: Sol
Text:
Go deeper from where you met Paran.
Once you're there, you'll see our clan's old sanctuary.

Name: [player]
Text: (It’s getting hard to breathe… Is this the scent of death?)

Name: [player]
Text: (I feel that toxic mist too. Just like back at the Citadel of Valor.)

Name: [player]
Text: (To break through all this, I can’t let them ambush us from behind.)

Name: [player]
Text: (Let's clear them out as much as possible before entering.)

Name: Man in Agony
Text: How could he… I’m an Ashen Crow, too… Ugh…

Name: Man in Agony
Text: A-Are you also a descendant of Tahn…? Run, right now…

Name: Man in Agony
Text:
Nuul has gone insane…
He's going to kill us all… both Owls and Crows…

Name: Man in Agony
Text: In the end… he’ll turn everyone… into the army of the Undead… cough

Name: [player]
Text: (…Killing his own people? He's completely lost it.)

Name: Valbas
Text:
A necessary sacrifice for the greater good…
This "villain" is a bit cliché, isn't he?

Name: [player]
Text: (Valbas…?)

Name: Valbas
Text: Don't look at me like that… I told you I'd be back.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Vaster is locked up tight in the doghouse.
Now, no more distractions, right?

Name: Valbas
Text:
Humans and their love for nicknames.
It’s nothing but a spare part for the Tower.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Well, some little kid was praying to the lake,
so I gave her a little gift.

Name: [player]
Text: (A little kid? Does he mean Paran when she was young?)

Name: Valbas
Text:
I let her live. Looked like she’d put on a good show someday, if nothing else.
She had the makings of a strong one.

Name: Valbas
Text:
I told her to go to the Giant’s Tower when she grows up,
and play with the Horn.

Name: Valbas
Text: But I never told her to hand it over to some "bad guy."

Name: Valbas
Text:
The lake belongs to me anyway…
It's one of my favorite resting spots.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Hey, I told you! You're the most interesting thing around right now.
Why would I lie to someone I want to play with?

Name: Valbas
Text:
The locals here messing around with corpses…
they came up with that trick all on their own.

Name: Valbas
Text:
*sigh…* You really don't want to entertain me right now, do you?
And I came all this way to impress you. What a waste.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Fine… I'll get out of your hair.
But once you're done here, you have to play with me.

Name: [player]
Text: (They’re still churning out troops here.)

Name: [player]
Text:
(…Has Paran completely lost his sense of self?
Standing right next to that monster.)

Name: [player]
Text:
(If I take down Nuul, she might come to her senses.
I need to save whomever I can.)

Name: Nuul
Text:
Paran, is this why you were sneaking outside?
To lay down baits?

Name: Nuul
Text:
I don’t know how you managed to draw that adventurer in…
but for once, I’ll be generous.

Name: Nuul
Text:
With skills like that, they're better off “reanimated.”
A perfect addition to our army of the dead!

Name: Nuul
Text: It’s been years since I took you in—just a little runaway from Baekryeong.

Name: Nuul
Text:
And today, you’ve finally proven your worth.
Just keep doing exactly as I say.

Name: Paran
Text: I exist… only for the glory of Tahn…

Name: [player]
Text: (Looks like the Horn of Dawn has taken hold of her.)

Name: Nuul
Text: Bwahahahahaha!

Name: Khoon
Text: Not on my watch!

Name: Khoon
Text:
Am I… still… in one piece…?
Glad I made it in time…

Name: Khoon
Text: I slipped past them, but… don't worry… phew.

Name: Khoon
Text:
I left a note… they’ll definitely come looking for me.
I can hold out until then.

Name: Khoon
Text: If I pass out again, Radha's going to kill me… ugh.

Name: Khoon
Text: Anyway, I’m fine… just grab the horn, the horn. Go.

Name: Khoon
Text: Groan… pant… gasp…

Name: Beretta
Text: Darn it! It’s because of that object.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Take it to the Warden, now!
We've got Koon.

Name: [player]
Text: (Take out the key. It will take me back to the Tower.)

Name: [player]
Text: (I just hope the Warden is still there.)

Name: Warden of the Tower (Saikarad)
Text: You’re here. I’ve been waiting.

Name: Warden of the Tower (Saikarad)
Text:
Any later and you wouldn't have found me.
I’m barely keeping this form together.

Name: Warden of the Tower (Saikarad)
Text:
It’s broken… Human magic has been layered over the protocol.
There are signs of an overload, too.

Name: Warden of the Tower (Saikarad)
Text:
It won't function in this state.
Someone must have treated it like a toy.

Name: Warden of the Tower (Saikarad)
Text:
To restore the Tower's core facilities, the Core must be intact.
I'll have to fix this first.

Name: Warden of the Tower (Saikarad)
Text:
Go find another Core while I do.
And try not to return here unless you have to.

Name: Warden of the Tower (Saikarad)
Text:
Opening paths with that "key"…
…consumes a vast amount of Aether.

Name: Warden of the Tower (Saikarad)
Text:
My illusion will fade soon.
Once you find the second Core… come back then.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Looks like you delivered it in one piece.
We just got back from securing the Manor ourselves.

Name: Beretta
Text:
It took every single priest of Baekryeong to finally bring things under control.
So, what did the Warden say?

Name: Beretta
Text: Everything we guessed was right all along.

Name: Beretta
Text:
A structure that massive…
…is bound to have its own facilities.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Plus, the Warden isn't looking too good either.
At least Xeros is staying quiet for now.

Name: Rada
Text:
The Baekryeong Clan is hovering over him, nursing him.
Don't worry, he hasn't lost consciousness like last time.

Name: Rada
Text: He just pushed his limits and crashed hard.

Name: Rada
Text:
I was shocked when I heard that!
He actually fought before the antidote even kicked in?

Name: Rada
Text: On top of that, he bolted the second I finished patchin' him up!

Name: Rada
Text:
I barely got him back on his feet… Unbelievable.
Koon owes you a whole lifetime of gratitude.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Why don't you get some rest?
You weren't even in good shape before you set out.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Whether we keep meeting the Warden's demands…
let's discuss that at the Divine Council first.

Name: Rada
Text:
Beretta and I will finish things up here.
Stop overthinking and just rest.

Name: Afshan
Text: Wh-what should I do? The <Red>Kuduru Tribe</> br-broke the fence.

Name: Afshan
Text: To fix the fence, I need to go to the farmland Daria tends and grab some wood...

Name: Afshan
Text:
I-I can't move because of the m-monsters.
S-so, adventurer, please go instead.

Name: Daria
Text: Afshan sure makes strangers do all sorts of things.

Name: Daria
Text:
The wood is in that building over there.
Take it quickly before he starts crying in terror.

Name: Afshan
Text:
Thanks for the help.
I should take this chance to tell Uzar I want to do something else.

Name: Daria
Text:
Ugh, so loud.
There isn't a single day Afshan doesn't scream.

Name: Daria
Text:
Hey, adventurer. Do me a favor.
Take care of some of the <Red>Kudurus</> nearby.

Name: Daria
Text: If you don't take them out quickly, I'm going to go deaf.

Name: Daria
Text:
Thanks, seriously.
This should finally quiet Afshan down.

Name: Hadi
Text: There's a decent way to make some coin off archaeologists. Wanna hear it?

Name: Hadi
Text: They say monster fluids help with deciphering ancient records.

Name: Hadi
Text: It's apparently used as an ingredient for a reagent applied to stone tablets, but it's hard to come by.

Name: Hadi
Text: They pay quite well if you bring them some, so why not give it a try?

Name: Hadi
Text:
Of course, whatever you gather this time goes straight to me.
I have to get paid for the intel, right?

Name: Hadi
Text: Let's see... Oh, you've gathered quite a haul.

Name: Hadi
Text: It's one of the few good ways to make money in the wasteland, so keep it in mind.

Name: Yasta
Text:
The treasures from the <Blue>Ethereal Sanctum</> just aren't enough.
I can't buy a gift that would truly turn heads with just this.

Name: Yasta
Text:
Because I want to be rich, obviously.
I'm telling you, I need to make a good impression on the Incursion Fixer.

Name: Yasta
Text:
D-don't look at me like that!
I'll share some with you, too.

Name: Yasta
Text:
Come on, hurry up and bring me the flowers blooming near the rocks!
That's the most crucial part.

Name: Yasta
Text: You brought some really fresh ones, didn't you?

Name: Yasta
Text: Wait right here. I'll whip it up in no time!

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(An indescribable taste. Why would someone...)</>

Name: Yasta
Text:
Huh? What's wrong with your face?
Does it taste bad?

Name: Yasta
Text: Good medicine is always bitter to the taste!

Name: Erfan
Text:
I am Erfan, an archaeologist.
The monsters are hindering my research, which puts me in quite a bind.

Name: Erfan
Text:
I need to visit the nearby ruins to make rubbings of the <Blue>Talim Reliefs</>,
But as a scholar, I'm completely hopeless when it comes to combat.

Name: Erfan
Text: So, I would gladly reward you if you could make the rubbings in my stead.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(You ask if he uses the reagent made from monster fluids.)</>

Name: Erfan
Text: Hmm? I've never heard of such a thing...

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Did Hadi trick me? Oh no... to lose my side hustle like this.)</>

Name: Erfan
Text: Shall we take a look together? Let's see what records the ancients left behind.

Name: Erfan
Text: ...Hmm, perhaps it's better left unknown.

Name: Erfan
Text:
It seems a bit undercooked. 
...I'll leave it at that.

Name: Gilbert
Text: You're a mercenary, right? "I need a job" is written all over your face.

Name: Gilbert
Text: I'm <Orange>Gilbert</>, a scholar of the Bardad Expedition.

Name: Gilbert
Text:
My friend and I traveled all the way from Frantia to conduct some special research.
Interested? I bet you are.

Name: Gilbert
Text:
I'll make sure the pay is worth your while.
So could you fetch me some Golem byproducts?

Name: Gilbert
Text: Freshly hunted ones, preferably.

Name: Gilbert
Text: You can find Golems if you head out through the ruins.

Name: Gilbert
Text: You already got them? You've got some serious skills.

Name: Gilbert
Text:
Haha, broaden your horizons.
In cooking, the seasoning is just as important as the ingredients.

Name: Gilbert
Text: Grinding Golem byproducts and mixing them with herbs creates a special spice unlike any other in the world.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(...That's literally just stone dust.)</>

Name: Gilbert
Text:
You know, you'd make a perfect companion for my gastronomic research.
I should let <Orange>Bahista</> know.

Name: Gilbert
Text:
The friend I mentioned earlier.
It's rare, but we just click and our research goals align perfectly.

Name: Gilbert
Text:
Ah, we're actually co-authoring a book on gastronomy right now.
I'll be sure to show it to you when it's done.

Name: Sarvin
Text:
Ouch, my stomach... I am Sarvin, a botanist.
I have a favor to ask of you, adventurer.

Name: Sarvin
Text:
Please pick and bring some flowers with petal tips that look like shriveled noodles.
It's called a Snakegourd.
ItemDesc:
A plant with an extreme bitterness that induces nausea.
They are usually green, but some toxic variants…
…feature a purple hue, so handle with care.

Name: Sarvin
Text: Since it's purple, it should be easy to spot.

Name: Sarvin
Text:
Once you go inside the ruins, you'll find a passage leading outside.
Just head through there.

Name: Sarvin
Text:
Great work, adventurer.
Now then, time for a little taste test.

Name: Sarvin
Text: Ghk, cough... It's been a while since I felt this nauseous.

Name: Sarvin
Text: This is even worse than those pickled starfish flowers I ate three years ago!

Name: Sarvin
Text: Anyway, thanks. You were a huge help.

Name: Bahar
Text:
I'm so, so thirsty...
Hey, adventurer. Hear me out if you aren't busy.

Name: Bahar
Text: The thing is, we've been drawing muddy water from over there to drink.

Name: Bahar
Text:
Of course not! We filter it first, obviously.
Anyway, we have some pre-filtered water over there.

Name: Bahar
Text: Unlike the Detachment Captain, I actually have a conscience.

Name: Bahar
Text:
So if you can just clear out the monsters nearby,
I'll go fetch the water buckets later.

Name: Bahar
Text: Hah... I really wish our new recruits were more like you.

Name: Bahar
Text: Thanks, adventurer.

Name: Leyla
Text: You there, you've got the look of a mercenary. I need you to do something for me.

Name: Leyla
Text:
You know... people like Bahista from the Bardad Expedition?
I do trade with folks like that.

Name: Leyla
Text: But the demand is so high right now that I just can't keep up.

Name: Leyla
Text: Straight to the point, huh? This is why I love mercenaries.

Name: Leyla
Text:
I'm Leyla.
I deal in monster byproducts. And you?

Name: Leyla
Text:
A pleasure, [player].
I'm already swamped trying to secure stock, but some troublemakers are getting in the way.

Name: Leyla
Text:
Have you heard of the <Red>Shadow Wolves</>?
I'll pay you handsomely, so go and clear them out for me.

Name: Leyla
Text:
Phew, that's a weight off my shoulders.
It'd be a disaster if my booming business went under. I'll be counting on you next time, too.

Name: Iruna
Text: I saw you sparring with <Orange>Koon</>... You must be pretty good, huh?

Name: Iruna
Text:
...What do you mean? Koon doesn't usually give anyone the time of day.
You don’t know how lucky you are.

Name: Iruna
Text:
Hah... I need to become a hunter that Koon acknowledges, too...
At this rate, I'm a failure as a hunter.

Name: Iruna
Text:
But if I can complete this, things will change, right?
That's why I need you to do something for me.

Name: Iruna
Text: Please bring me some <Red>monster... monster blood</>!

Name: Iruna
Text: Back already? I’m impressed.

Name: Iruna
Text: Perfect! I can make a trap with this.

Name: Iruna
Text:
Koon is going to be so surprised when I give this to him, right?
Hah... It’ll be trouble if Koon falls for me because of this.

Name: Iruna
Text: Thanks, anyway! If things work out with Koon, I'll owe it all to you!

Name: Leyla
Text:
Hey, don't look away.
Where do you think you're going?

Name: Leyla
Text: I love how quick you catch on.

Name: Leyla
Text:
I need you to head to the White-Bone Expanse.
I need to show you what my business is truly all about this time, don't I?

Name: Leyla
Text:
The <Orange>Hunters’ Guild</> requested research material for bowstaves.
Monster horns are perfect for that.

Name: Leyla
Text:
You exceeded my expectations again.
Why don't we just become business partners while we're at it?

Name: Leyla
Text:
...Playing hard to get, are we?
Let me know if you change your mind. I'll pretend I didn't hear that.

Name: Jeihan
Text: The Valley of Beasts connects to the <Blue>Giant's Garden</>, so there's a lot of foot traffic.

Name: Jeihan
Text: We need to clear the roads to ensure everyone travels safely.

Name: Jeihan
Text: Given the current situation, it'd be a huge help if you pitched in.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
Good work.
Thanks to you handling the roads, I can finally breathe easy.

Name: Helene
Text:
You're an Adventurer, right?
I can't handle this alone. Mind giving me a hand? I'll pay up!

Name: Helene
Text: I came all the way out here for my thesis, but with all these monsters and outlaws, I can't even get inside!

Name: Helene
Text: If I don't submit it this time, I'm going to face disciplinary action!

Name: Helene
Text:
Really? I'm counting on you, okay?
By the way, do you happen to have a <Blue>Communicator</>?

Name: Helene
Text:
Perfect!
It was totally worth blowing my entire fortune on this!

Name: Helene
Text: Registration complete! I'll ping you with this from time to time.

Name: Helene
Text: Head into the Valley of Beasts and clear out the monsters near the ruins.

Name: Helene
Text:
Great job!
Now then, shall we inspect our piping hot relics?
ItemDesc:
A fragment of a ruin excavated from the Giant's Corridor.
Ancient languages are engraved upon it.

Name: Helene
Text: This... it's different from the <Blue>Talim Script</> we know.

Name: Helene
Text: Hmm, maybe the hypothesis that only a single ancient empire existed is completely wrong.

Name: Helene
Text: ...What's your name, adventurer?

Name: Helene
Text: I'll make sure to include your name in my thesis.

Name: Helene
Text:
I have a feeling that this fragment you found...
I believe this will be our key to uncover the secrets of a new era.

Name: Jeihan
Text: Things aren't looking good in the Gorge of Perdition either.

Name: Jeihan
Text: The monsters from around the Taima Oasis have migrated north, and their numbers have grown.

Name: Jeihan
Text: I'd appreciate it if you could lend a hand there as well.

Name: Kanber
Text: I am <Orange>Kanber</>, the dispatcher from the Wayfinders Guild.

Name: Kanber
Text: My job is to give out <Blue>red flares</> to adventurers.

Name: Kanber
Text: Red flares used to signal your location in an emergency.

Name: Kanber
Text: We usually hand them out to adventurers heading into dangerous areas like the Gorge of Perdition.

Name: Kanber
Text:
I thought I saw a distress signal a moment ago,
But Jeihan and the others looked so busy...

Name: Kanber
Text:
I believe the distress signal came from...
near the waterfall deep within the Gorge of Perdition.

Name: Kanber
Text: ...Your kindness will surely be rewarded, Adventurer.

Name: Lost Adventurer
Text: Phew... Thank you. I thought I was a goner.

Name: Lost Adventurer
Text: I should've gotten my sword repaired before heading out. I was too lazy, and this is what I get.

Name: Lost Adventurer
Text: Please, just help me get back to the encampment.

Name: Kanber
Text: Thank you for your help.

Name: Bishan
Text:
Come see me for a moment.
I need a favor.

Name: Bishan
Text:
I'm feeling frail, so I need to brew some medicine.
But I'm in no shape to do it myself.

Name: Bishan
Text: If you collect the materials for me, I'll share some with you.

Name: Bishan
Text:
Nonsense! When an elder offers you something, you accept it.
Now, hurry to the Gorge of Perdition and gather the ingredients.

Name: Bishan
Text: Let's see... I just need some monster eyeballs and wings.

Name: Bishan
Text: You truly are as skilled as Jeihan said.

Name: Bishan
Text: I'll take these straight to Yasta and ask him to brew the medicine.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Yasta...? Did his stamina potion business actually take off?)</>

Name: Bishan
Text: I-I don't plan on keeping it all to myself, don't worry!

Name: Kamiya
Text: I plan to use the other side for farmland, but the monsters just won't thin out.

Name: Kamiya
Text: As you remember, we agreed your labor would cover your lodging, right?

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Please clear out the monsters on the opposite side.
We'll call it even after that.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
I knew <Orange>Aman</> could be trusted!
He's an excellent judge of character.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Stick around a bit longer.
We need someone like you.

Name: Davin
Text: Exploitation of labor... No, extortion... Wait, no. Plundering...

Name: Davin
Text:
Yeah, plunder!
Adventurer, I… I plunder your labor!

Name: Davin
Text:
Ugh, this hangover...
Head over to the other side right now and scoop up some soil.

Name: Davin
Text:
Preferably from near the trees.
Two handful should be enough.

Name: Davin
Text:
...Huh? You made it back alive.
You brought what I asked, right?

Name: Davin
Text:
Soil quality is better than in the First Step Village.
Aman picked a good spot.

Name: Davin
Text:
<Yellow>Where’s that handy... Yeah, I'm talking to you!</>
Get over here.

Name: Davin
Text:
Hic... Ugh, this stuff's strong, but man, it's good.
Those Narurus sure are talented.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(If it's that good, he could at least share instead of hogging it all.)</>

Name: Davin
Text:
You can stare all you want, but I'm not sharing.
This is the only reason I came all the way out here...

Name: Davin
Text:
That damn geezer. Getting all stingy over a single bottle of booze...
Ugh… It’d feel so good to pluck his beard clean off that face.

Name: Davin
Text:
Anyway... You!
I need you to make another trip to the other side.

Name: Davin
Text: Bring me a specimen of a Starfish Flower.

Name: Davin
Text: Make sure it's intact... I just need the root.

Name: Davin
Text:
You back?
Ugh... I can't believe I'm stuck with doing something I barely know...

Name: Davin
Text:
This confirms it.
Here... No, the land over there is perfect for farmland.

Name: Davin
Text:
The roots are emitting <Blue>Aether</>.
Just like the soil you brought earlier...
ItemDesc:
Yellow light drifts around the roots like spores.
...Is it safe to touch?

Name: Davin
Text:
The quantity of Aether is not significant,
but it’s enough for cultivating plants.

Name: Davin
Text: Burp. Go share the news with Kamiya.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Davin, finally...!

Name: Kamiya
Text: Hehe, I know your help played a huge part in this.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Oh, Aman will be thrilled to hear this news...!

Name: Kamiya
Text: We should take this chance to speed up the clearing operation.

Name: Kamiya
Text: You're certainly better than your average worker.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
I feel like we're overworking you, but you know, dire circumstances.
That's just the reality of our situation here.

Name: Kamiya
Text: <Orange>Captain Shayad</> actually needs some help right now. You should go meet him.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Just head straight up toward the Crimson Shimmer Wastes.

Name: Shayad
Text: Are you the one Kamiya sent?

Name: Shayad
Text: The monsters will swarm us soon.

Name: Shayad
Text: We'll talk details after we take care of them.

Name: Shayad
Text: Now we can finally catch our breath.

Name: Shayad
Text: Thanks to you, we safely averted a crisis.

Name: Shayad
Text: Apologies for the late introduction. I'm Shayad.

Name: Shayad
Text: I've been assisting Kamiya by clearing out the monsters in the area.

Name: Shayad
Text: Some merchants passing through the gateway head to the pioneer village instead of Babylon.

Name: Shayad
Text:
It's a settlement being developed by the Merchants Guild,
And its proximity to the gateway makes for easy travel.

Name: Shayad
Text: However, the monsters have been acting strange, almost as if a <Blue>Frenzy</> is imminent.

Name: Shayad
Text: As you saw earlier, it's becoming too much for us to handle alone...

Name: Shayad
Text:
Please, help us clear out the monsters in this area one more time.
I'm counting on you.

Name: Shayad
Text:
Myself, Kamiya, the pioneer village...
We are all deeply in your debt.

Name: Shayad
Text: Thank you so much.

Name: Shayad
Text:
...You could say I'm being a bit nosy,
But I just can't turn a blind eye to things like this.

Name: Shayad
Text: If you head straight up toward the gateway, you'll find a quarry.

Name: Shayad
Text:
Even with monsters prowling nearby,
they need to process materials for the Manor.

Name: Shayad
Text: ...Ah, I knew you wouldn't dismiss our call for help.

Name: Shayad
Text: Head to the quarry first and speak with the foreman there, Alborz.

Name: Alborz
Text: How are we supposed to get any work done in these conditions?!

Name: Alborz
Text: ...Did Shayad send you?

Name: Alborz
Text: So he wasn't just spouting empty promises when he said he'd help!

Name: Alborz
Text:
Your timing is impeccable!
We've been having trouble dealing with these monsters.

Name: Alborz
Text:
The bastards at the Manor just keep demanding faster delivery.
They don’t give a damn about what we're dealing with.

Name: Alborz
Text: <Red>...We've already had to haul away four corpses this week alone.</>

Name: Alborz
Text: Please, wipe out monsters around the quarry.

Name: Alborz
Text: At this rate, all the stonemasons will end up dead before they even set foot in the quarry.

Name: Alborz
Text: Thank you so much.

Name: Alborz
Text: I, Alborz, always repay my debt.

Name: Alborz
Text:
Pass a message to Shayad for me.
<Yellow>Tell him if he ever needs a favor, he should come find me.</>

Name: Shayad
Text: Alborz really said that?

Name: Shayad
Text: Phew, that's great news. We were actually running short on materials.

Name: Shayad
Text:
This is all thanks to you, Adventurer.
Please report this directly to Kamiya.

Name: Shayad
Text: ...She'll be absolutely thrilled.

Name: Kamiya
Text: We've secured Alborz's help? Excellent!

Name: Kamiya
Text:
If we just buy the entire quarry while we're at it...
Ah, I'll worry about that later...

Name: Kamiya
Text:
I owe you yet again.
...I almost feel bad for working you to the bone.

Name: Kamiya
Text: You'll be rewarded, of course, and I'll even engrave your name on the foundation of the new building.

Name: Kamiya
Text: ...Thank you so much.

Name: Mueena
Text:
It's been a while.
I assume you know why I came looking for you.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Ever since the royal messenger's visit not long ago,
the Archon's behavior has changed noticeably.

Name: Mueena
Text:
He stopped his drinking and hosting banquets.
It's a welcome change, but his absences... are questionable.

Name: Mueena
Text: We tried, but they all returned as corpses.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(...She just called me here to do the dirty work.)</>

Name: Mueena
Text:
Go find Aman.
He will tell you what to do.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(You see Aman and Azran together.)</>

Name: Aman
Text:
The adjutant mentioned sending someone. I figured it'd be you.
Things are going much smoother than expected.

Name: Aman
Text:
Since the Divine is here as well, I'll get straight to the point.
The Legation's cash flow is looking suspicious.

Name: Azran
Text:
It seems someone is lining their own pockets.
And you need hard evidence.

Name: Azran
Text:
Leave it to me.
The <Orange>“Head of the Adventurers Guild”</> can't exactly get involved in this.

Name: Aman
Text:
...Fair enough. No need to make enemies of the Legation.
Just make sure to keep me updated as the situation unfolds.

Name: Aman
Text: Some of the Legation's funds are being funneled through the Merchants Guild.

Name: Aman
Text:
[player], drop by Zariya at the General Store.
There's something you need to pick up.

Name: Zariya
Text: What brings you here today?

Name: Zariya
Text: Hehe, Aman must have really taken a liking to you.

Name: Zariya
Text:
See that pile of carpets on the display?
What you're looking for is over there. Take it.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(That person on the path to the canyon... has to be Quaista.)</>

Name: Quaista
Text:
Young Master Azran sent me.
You remember me, right? I am <Orange>Quaista</>.

Name: Quaista
Text:
The Avengers' journey is also nearing its end.
It’s reassuring to have you work with us, adventurer.

Name: Quaista
Text: I heard you found something at the Merchants Guild. Shall we take a look?

Name: Quaista
Text:
It looks blank, doesn't it?
But it's actually a cipher that uses a classic technique.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Hmm... I'll need some materials to reveal the text.
I have a favor to ask.

Name: Quaista
Text: Please gather some monster fluids from Whirlwind Gorge.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(This place feels more untouched than you expected. You should proceed carefully.)</>

Name: Quaista
Text:
Perfect timing.
I'll begin the restoration right away.

Name: Quaista
Text: Let's see what it says...
ItemDesc: The day the Yellow Snake ■■ and the ■■ ■ is not far off.

Name: Quaista
Text:
<Yellow>“Yellow Snake”</> refers to Archon Fahad, and here... hmm...
Oh my, the rest is hidden using a much cleverer method.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Quaista pondered for a moment, then looked as if she remembered something.)</>

Name: Quaista
Text: It's not entirely impossible.

Name: Quaista
Text:
I once infiltrated the Bardad Expedition.
I made a few friends while I was there.

Name: Quaista
Text: First, let's come up with a good excuse.

Name: Quaista
Text:
There's a botanist named <Orange>Sarvin</> at the camp.
Ask him this, and you'll pique his interest.

Name: Quaista
Text: <Yellow>“What plant contains a poison that turns transparent over time?”</>should be the question.

Name: Quaista
Text:
There are two techniques used in this cipher.
One of them was solved with the monster fluids you brought.

Name: Quaista
Text:
But since the Yellow Snake is mentioned,
I suppose we should prepare for something more tricky.

Name: Quaista
Text:
The Yellow Snake Household was treated as expendable on the frontier,
but they became royal confidants overnight.

Name: Quaista
Text: Right after Young Master Azran's household fell apart, no less.

She explained that the “Yellow Snake” Household led by Fahad is well-versed in poisons.
She added that the White Lion Household's likely collapsed without even mounting a counterattack…
…due to spies planting poison beforehand.

Name: Quaista
Text: Rumor has it they even ingest diluted deadly poisons to build up resistance.

Name: Quaista
Text:
So it's entirely plausible they'd use poison to write their ciphers.
It would be second nature to them.

Name: Sarvin
Text:
Oh, adventurer.
What brings you here?

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(When you ask about plants that can cause discoloration,
Sarvin's face lights up.)</>

Name: Sarvin
Text: There are quite a few, actually. Hold on a moment.

Name: Sarvin
Text:
If it's common in the wasteland, it must cause a phototoxic reaction.
Castor oil would be perfect!

Name: Sarvin
Text:
Look beneath the cliffs in Whirlwind Gorge.
You'll find it growing sparsely in the shaded areas.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Phew, you took so long I thought something happened to you.
Let's have a look.

Name: Quaista
Text:
<Yellow>"The day the Yellow Snake finishes shedding and becomes a wolf is not far off."</>
It sounds like a major turning point is approaching.

Name: Quaista
Text: Let's report this to Azran first.

When I contacted Azran via communicator and relayed the decoded message,
he told me to monitor the area around the Bardad Expedition.

Name: Quaista
Text:
I'd prefer to wait for the right moment and take them all out at once, but...
They'll likely try to move as quietly as possible, too.

Name: Quaista
Text:
If you go undercover as a normal expedition member,
it should be enough to fool them for a little while, shouldn't it?

Name: Quaista
Text: Defeat the monsters in the Valley of Oblivion and set up some guideposts.

Name: Quaista
Text:
The biologists are apparently preparing to survey the area.
I'll leave it to you then.

Name: Quaista
Text:
That should be enough.
You must look the part of a rookie by now. Let's move on to the next step.

Name: Quaista
Text: Shall we try coaxing some information from the expedition members?

Name: Quaista
Text:
People love explaining things to newcomers, after all.
We're going to exploit that.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Go meet <Orange>Lilian</> at the expedition camp.
She's a bit of an airhead.

Name: Quaista
Text:
She's brilliant in her own field, but-
she doesn't have a clue about how the real world works.

Name: Quaista
Text:
You’re a rookie, right?
Just pretend you're eager to learn everything.

Name: Lilian
Text:
I haven't seen you around.
What can I do for you?

Name: Lilian
Text:
Perfect timing.
I need something done, but I can't do it myself.

Name: Lilian
Text:
I'm a scholar, as you can plainly see.
I'm here to do research, not to run errands for the Legation.

Name: Lilian
Text:
Can you believe they want me to plant flowers in this wasteland?
They claim there's water, so it should be fine.

Name: Lilian
Text:
But it's swarming with monsters out there!
It’s practically a death sentence! Why should I risk my own life?

After calming Lilian down, you take the seedlings.
First, let’s should head to the Valley of Oblivion and plant them.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Now that I’ve come this far, I’ll just make it look like I tried. It’ll work, right?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Hmm, why is there a carriage in a deserted place like this?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Someone might be around. You should take a closer look.)</>

Name: Quaista
Text:
Find anything near Lilian?
Well, more importantly, there’s news from the Young Master.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(You tell her about the carriage and the orders found in the Valley of Oblivion.)</>

Name: Quaista
Text:
It's strange that they'd leave a trail behind like that.
Azran also detected movement from the <Red>Shadow Wolf Clan</>.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Why the sudden change in tactics?
Haa... I need to look into this.

Name: Quaista
Text:
You should keep acting like you don't know anything.
Don't let on to Lilian, either.

Name: Lilian
Text:
Are you back?
Was the soil decent enough to plant anything?

Name: Lilian
Text:
Figured as much.
*sigh...* This is exactly why ignorant people are useless.

Name: Lilian
Text: I don’t want to send you off just like that, so how about you do one more thing for me?

Name: Lilian
Text: How was it down there? Pretty dangerous with all those monsters, huh?

Name: Lilian
Text:
*sigh* I just don't understand it.
Why are they making scholars like us do something like this?

Name: Lilian
Text: Go back to the Valley of Oblivion and find a carriage.

Name: Lilian
Text:
The Legation told us to look for a missing carriage.
So we're all searching our assigned zones.

Name: Lilian
Text: Why did I end up getting stuck with the Valley of Oblivion...?

Name: Lilian
Text:
I'm counting on you.
If it's too much for one person, ask Quaista for help.

Name: Lilian
Text: Oh, and report straight to the Expedition Captain once you finish the investigation about the carriage.

Name: Lilian
Text:
No need to double the trip. 
They're the ones paying the reward, anyway.

Name: Quaista
Text: I've been waiting for you, adventurer.

Name: Quaista
Text:
About the carriage you found earlier.
It looks like a caravan affiliated with the Merchants Guild.

Name: Quaista
Text:
They were transporting Etherium recently,
but they haven't returned yet.

Name: Quaista
Text: They're usually incredibly punctual, but there's been no word from them at all.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Hmm, <Orange>“Light of the North Sea”</> is a fairly large caravan.
Even criminals tend to avoid targeting them.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Even the Shadow Wolf Clan would struggle to handle the fallout...
Could you check if they left any other traces?

Name: Quaista
Text:
Phew, it’s about time! I was about to go nuts waiting for you.
Did you find anything?

After saying that the cargo held stones instead of Etherium,
you tell her about the letter you found near the bloodstains.

Name: Quaista
Text:
They didn't clean up a single trace of evidence.
Ha, to think the White Lion was taken down by scum like this.

Name: Quaista
Text:
That letter will serve as great <Yellow>“evidence,”</> so hang onto it.
It will definitely come in handy.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Oh, tell Captain <Orange>Bardad</> that you found the carriage.
It's about time to drop the rookie act anyway.

Name: Bardad
Text:
It's been a while.
What brings you all the way here?

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(When you say you happened to find the carriage while taking care of something,
Bardad's expression brightens.)</>

Name: Bardad
Text:
Good work.
Looks like I owe you again.

Name: Bardad
Text: The Asientet Legation has been swamping us with requests lately.

Name: Bardad
Text:
They know full well this expedition is mostly made up of scholars.
So, I have no idea why they keep demanding things like this...

Name: Bardad
Text:
Do me a favor and put in a good word with Adjutant <Orange>Muina</>.
At this rate, every expedition member will run away.

Name: Mueena
Text:
You arrived just as I was about to reach out.
Let's hear how much progress you've made.

Name: Mueena
Text:
The Archon conveniently happens to be out,
so we can talk freely.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You report that the Shadow Wolf Clan appears to have allied with Archon Fahad to stage a comeback.)</>

Name: Mueena
Text: Oho, is this the hard evidence?
ItemDesc: It's a letter meant for the Merchants Guild from the Light of the North Sea.

Name: Mueena
Text: Etherium meant as tribute to the king was stolen, yet the Archon does nothing…

Name: Mueena
Text:
It's such a blatant dereliction of duty, it almost feels too easy.
Anything else?

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(You remember the note you entrusted to Quaista,
but you should report the Bardad Expedition's situation first.)</>

Name: Mueena
Text:
Hmm... I didn't issue those orders.
It seems the Archon acted entirely on his own.

Name: Mueena
Text:
He's definitely plotting something.
I'll discuss the “Star of the North Sea” caravan with Aman.

Name: Mueena
Text: Head to Thundercrest and rendezvous with someone named <Orange>Lamine</>.

Name: Mueena
Text: You'll understand once you get there.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Why is he keeping it a secret? You should discreetly feel him out.)</>

Name: Mueena
Text:
You've grown quite resourceful.
But the time isn't right yet.

Name: Mueena
Text: Let's catch up again soon.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
So you're the collaborator the Young Master mentioned?
I would've been so disappointed if Quaista had shown up.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(When you ask about Azran, Lamine seems to hesitate for a moment.)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
He probably won't even have the time to meet you in person.
He's busy <yellow>herding wolves</>.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Hmph... I'd happily devour them right now.
Why is he telling me to wait for orders?

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(If he's hunting the Shadow Wolves, he must know about Fahad too...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(When you ask if there was anything else, Lamine's eyes widen.)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
He said he’ll stuff that “Yellow Snake” so full…
…it won’t even be able to crawl along the ground.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
And once it’s so bloated it can't even breathe...
Pop! It’ll just explode! Hahaha!

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(So Azran wants to observe Fahad a little longer.</>
<yellow>At least until he has concrete, direct evidence...)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Anyway, is that enough of an explanation?
Let's get to work on what the Young Master ordered.

Name: Ramynn
Text: First, we'll clear out the monsters in Arcal's Territory.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
It'll probably bore you to tears.
But the goal is to blend in.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
The <Orange>Hunters Guild</> runs this place.
This should give us a good enough excuse to approach them.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
All they care about is hunting anyway.
If you're good at killing monsters, they’ll think you’re a “good person.”

Name: Ramynn
Text:
What do I mean?
It means if someone happens to go missing, they won't suspect us.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
There's a <Red>wolf</> hiding out as a Hunters Guild member.
I was going to eat him, but the Young Master told me to wait.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
I know exactly where my prey is. How much longer do I have to wait?
I get hungry really easily.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(I can't let him kill the tracking target like last time...</>
<yellow>I should convince him to let me handle the surveillance.)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Hmm, I guess you are our collaborator.
I'll let you have a little taste.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
But! If he tries to run, you have to take him out immediately.
Do we have a deal?

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Find <Orange>Hafez</> in Arcal's Territory.
He'll be out there, pretending to hunt monsters.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
The weirdly shaped rocks might throw you off,
but I'm sure you'll find him.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Call me immediately if the prey’s scent turns foul.
I've got other things to take care of.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
...I don't want to disappoint the Young Master.
So don't mess this up, alright?

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Where could Hafez be? 
I'll check around the rocks ahead.)</>

Name: Gruff Voice
Text: Nothing but a bunch of amateurs.

Name: Nervous Voice
Text:
S-Sorry!
I'll do my best to officially become a member of the Shadow Wolf Clan-

Name: Gruff Voice
Text:
Didn't I tell you to watch your mouth?
We are the Archon's Royal Guard. Royal Guard. Get it?

Name: Nervous Voice
Text: Y-Yes, sir! Understood!

Name: Gruff Voice
Text: Tsk, parading around under the name of some lowly bandit group...

Name: Gruff Voice
Text:
Are you blind?
Can't you see we've already claimed this spot?

Name: Gruff Voice
Text: Oho, you’ve got a good eye, don’t you?

Name: Gruff Voice
Text:
I am Hafez.
As you can see, I'm a hunter.

Name: Hafez
Text: The pathetic one beside me is Taban, my disciple.

Name: Taban
Text: H-Hello there! I-I'm Taban!

Name: Hafez
Text:
We don’t accept just anyone.
If you think you're good enough, prove it.

Name: Hafez
Text:
What?
Where did you crawl out from?

Name: Hafez
Text:
Hold on.
I've got superiors too, so I need their permission first.

Name: Hafez
Text:
Consider yourself lucky.
It's rare for anyone to get an audience with the boss this fast.

Name: Hafez
Text:
There are ruins over there.
The boss should be there.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(He's accepting me just like that? This is way too easy... I'll play along for now.)</>

Name: Hafez
Text: Ha, I like your bold attitude.

Name: Hafez
Text:
Then don't just stand there and do nothing. Get going.
You wouldn't want to keep the boss waiting.

You pretend to check your gear while contacting Lamine.
He replies that he'd join you shortly.

Name: Shadow Wolf Strike Captain
Text: Haa, we finally get commissioned and our job is to play dress-up as bandits.

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: It is a covert operation, after all.

Name: Shadow Wolf Strike Captain
Text:
What's the point of training these outlaw scumbags anyway?
They're just going to fall back into their old habits and screw everything up.

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: Hmm... It definitely doesn't justify stealing the tribute money.

Name: Shadow Wolf Strike Captain
Text: I guess it doesn't matter since they'll just pin the blame on the Wolf Clan if things go south, but...

Name: Shadow Wolf Strike Captain
Text:
*sigh* I really don't understand what the Archon is thinking...
And when do we report in?

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: What should we do with the new guy when he gets here?

Name: Shadow Wolf Strike Captain
Text: What do you think? We kill him.

Name: Shadow Wolf Strike Captain
Text:
He sided with the White Lion and killed the Wolf Clan Leader.
There's no way he’ll be on our side.

I tried to keep a few of them alive for questioning,
but Lamine ambushed them, and they all died.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Hmm... It'll be a problem if they go down this easily.
I did "try" to keep them alive, you know.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Lamine caused trouble again... I should look around for anything useful.)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
All right! If I find something, the Young Master will understand, right?
If I can just find the evidence... I won't even need a witness, yeah.

Name: Ramynn
Text: How does it look? Find anything useful?

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(You say that you found the stolen Etherium,
and a letter bearing the Legation's seal.)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Let's take a look.
Maybe it has the location of their next prey.
ItemDesc:
1. Procurement of Etherium for funding secured
 : The Light of the Northern Sea was attacked, but the Merchants Guild remains inactive.
 : They don't seem to have noticed yet, so the pioneer village is the next target.

2. Azran
 : Frequently appears around the Archon recently.
 : Intentionally orchestrating encounters with the Shadow Wolves to cause confusion.

3 Personnel Recruitment
 : Recruiting useful personnel for the Shadow Wolves through Hafez.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Hmm... Pretty interesting, huh?
I'll deliver this to the Young Master myself.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
As for Hafez... don't worry about him for now.
The <Orange>Avengers</> will take care of it.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Are you going to wait for me to clean this up?
Quaista will nag me if he finds out.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
That we're bragging everywhere about colluding it together...
That’s not very assassin-like... blah blah blah!

Name: Ramynn
Text:
I saw the Naruru tribe over at Thundercrest, and they were furious.
Treat it as a break and go check it out! That should time out perfectly.

Name: Troubled Naruru
Text:
Eek, hoo-man! Bad hooman!
You're a bad, bad hooman too!

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(You make it clear that you’re not a bad person to the Naruru.)</>

Name: Troubled Naruru
Text:
Then why, why are you here!
If you take my stuff, you die and I live!
Only after soothing it for a long while did the Naruru believe you.

Name: Marmie
Text:
I, <Orange>Marmie!</>
You... I'll trust, trust you just this once!

Name: Marmie
Text: Then wait! Marmie, calm down... gotta calm down first.

Name: Marmie
Text:
My friend Fluffy-Hair, told me something.
How to get rich, rich!

Name: Marmie
Text: Said I just need to give candies, candies to the dark, black wolves.

Name: Marmie
Text:
Made of Ethe-rioom!
Useless to us, but the wolves need 'em.
ItemDesc:
Candy made from finely crushed Aetherium powder.
Despite its appearance, it has a sweet and highly addictive flavor.

Name: Marmie
Text:
So I'm collecting them to become like Fluffy-Hair.
Gotta collect lots, lots.

You slowly explain that the Shadow Wolves…
…had kidnapped the baby Naruru from Aburu Village.

Name: Marmie
Text: ...Revenge, revenge comes before getting rich.

Name: Marmie
Text:
Very, very bad guys!
I'll teach them a lesson, for real!

Name: Marmie
Text: Bring me poop, poop... and monster teeth, teeth!

Name: Marmie
Text: Don't be surprised, no, no!

Name: Marmie
Text:
Take this, this.
There's a bad merchant, merchant you're looking for at Thundercrest.
ItemDesc:
A candy created by Marmie's hands.
Unless you look closely, it's hard to tell apart from…
…the candies distributed by the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Marmie
Text:
Give it to <Orange>Zaven- Zaven</>!
And bring me the reward, reward too!

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Is the cleanup done? Let's meet Lamine before going to Zaven.)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Did you meet the Naruru tribe?
Huh? What's this now?

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(After explaining it's the Etherium candy the Naruru collected,
you say you'll sell it to Zaven.)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Hmm... Those wolf pups are fearless.
Roaming around everywhere, huh?

Name: Ramynn
Text: I was just about ready to go meet the Young Master. What should we do with this?

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(When you carefully mention it's “fake Etherium candy,”
a smile spreads across Lamine's face.)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Aha? This is that precious, precious Etherium candy?
Even the <Orange>Asientet Archon</> would have a hard time getting this!

Name: Ramynn
Text:
How resourceful is the merchant dealing with such things?
<Yellow>I. Am. Very curious! Go meet him right now!</>

Name: Zaven
Text:
What.
I don't talk unless it makes money, so get lost.

Name: Zaven
Text:
Aha, you brought <Red>that</>?
You managed to get it. That good for a beast.

Name: Zaven
Text: Let's see the goods first.
ItemDesc:
A candy created by Marmie's hands.
Unless you look closely, it's hard to tell apart from…
…the candies distributed by the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Zaven
Text:
Hmm, this is what I was looking for.
Don't worry about the reward, I'll pay generously.

Name: Zaven
Text:
A higher-up will be using it, so of course.
Get on my good side, and getting connections with the Legation will be a breeze.

Name: Zaven
Text:
Even the Archon can't get this without me, got it?
Hahaha! You'd better stay on my good side.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(To think Fahad was collecting Etherium candy... What a shock.)</>

Name: Zaven
Text:
Ah, could you get some monster pelts from the Shrieking Vale?
It won't hurt to cooperate.

Name: Zaven
Text: Today's my lucky day.

Name: Zaven
Text:
I should sell this to the Hunters Guild.
I do business with higher-ups, but I can't rely solely on them.

Name: Zaven
Text:
What else is there to do in the barrens?
Farming is hard, and I don't want to resort to thievery...

Name: Zaven
Text:
I have to do whatever makes money.
The head of the household can't let their family members starve, right?

Name: Zaven
Text:
So if you're going to nag, get lost.
I'm not as great a merchant as I bragged to be.

Name: Zaven
Text:
H-hey! I didn't mean what I said earlier.
Kicking you out after receiving help... I was too harsh.

Name: Zaven
Text:
Struggling to make a living makes a person anxious.
So try to understand.

Name: Zaven
Text:
Well... I should keep my word too.
I can put in a good word for you at the Legation as a decent worker.

Name: Zaven
Text:
Before that, I have one last favor to ask.
Could you fetch some water from down there?

Name: Zaven
Text:
I'll purify it and sell it.
It's not like there are only a few people coming through.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Let's observe the situation.)</>

Name: Ashientet Manor Soldier
Text:
It is what I was looking for.
Etherium ore is good, but we need <Blue>Etherium candy</> just as much.

Name: Ashientet Manor Soldier
Text:
Hmm... It'd be great if you could get at least twice this amount.
You can do it, right, Zaven?

Name: Zaven
Text:
O-of course.
I will get it somehow.

Name: Ashientet Manor Soldier
Text:
I'll give you half in advance as a down payment.
Use this to sweet-talk the hunters around here.
After you check Zaven parting ways with the Asientet Legation soldier, you approach him.

Name: Zaven
Text:
I-I didn't expect to run into you here.
The officials l-looked busy, so I couldn't even bring it up.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(You quietly listen to his excuse.)</>

Name: Zaven
Text: Anyway, even all the hunters here combined wouldn't measure up to you.

Name: Zaven
Text:
So, could you help me out one more time?
Hmm? If things go well this time, I'll definitely introduce you.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Now the merchant is the desperate one.
Should I play hard to get?)</>

Name: Zaven
Text:
Ha... A friend of yours is more than welcome.
Think it over and let me know.

Name: Ramynn
Text: You look like you have something to say, right?

As you explain about the “fake Etherium candy deal,”
Lamine giggles quietly.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Now it's time to meet the Young Master.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Zaven, was it? I'll take care of that merchant myself.
You head to Babylon and proceed with the next plan.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Just go near the Warp Conduit in the plaza.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
I want to return too, but...
I was told to come back after reflecting on my actions since I caused a lot of trouble.
ItemDesc: It contains detailed information on the investigation so far.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
So deliver this in my stead.
See you again soon, then.

Name: Mueena
Text:
No need to be surprised.
We're in the same boat, aren't we?

Name: Mueena
Text: If Arman makes a move, the entire Babylon Guild would be in danger.

Name: Azran
Text:
I decided it would be better for me to step up, since I hold a personal grudge against Fahad.
Arman agreed too.

Name: Azran
Text:
So I deliberately made myself visible.
If their attention is on me-

Name: Mueena
Text: They won't notice the Sublime Avengers, nor my movements.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Thanks to your hard work, we've gathered quite a bit of evidence,
and we've already sent word to the royal household of Asientet.

Name: Azran
Text:
What was your intention in bringing <Orange>“Arhan Shah”</> into this?
You should know very well that the Yellow Snake and the royal household are accomplices.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Let's just say our interests aligned temporarily.
After all, there are no eternal enemies or allies.

While Azran distracted Fahad,
Muina asks you to gather evidence with the Sublime Avengers.

Name: Mueena
Text: I apologize for making you wander the barrens without knowing why.

Name: Mueena
Text:
But poor acting would never work on our enemy.
To deceive your enemies, you must first deceive your allies.

Name: Mueena
Text:
This was an operation even the Divine also agreed to.
Thanks to that, we've tightened our grip on Fahad's throat, so it's a success.

Name: Azran
Text:
...We had to be cautious for the final stage.
I hope you understand.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(It leaves a bitter taste in your mouth, but you quietly nod.)</>

Name: Azran
Text:
Take this, and rejoin Lamine.
You can hear the rest from him.
ItemDesc: It is sealed with wax, so you cannot check its contents.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Did you meet the Young Master?

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Then you must know everything by now!
How was it? Am I a good actor?

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Hey, why are you acting so petty?
We had a good time hunting wolves together.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
He wasn't exactly sticking closely with the Yellow Snake.
Since he wasn't deeply involved, I just tossed him somewhere.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(“I gave him a few fake candies as a parting gift? Good job, right?”Lamin adds.</>
<yellow>You’re not sure whether to laugh or get angry.)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Ah, didn't the Young Master give you something for me?
That's the operation plan! Hand it over quickly.

Name: Ramynn
Text: ...I don't like it.
ItemDesc:
Lamine, the relic heading to the gate was stolen.
Check the Whirling Barrows and the Thunderbird's Nest first.

Discuss this matter with Orha at Thundercrest as well.
Orha is the lieutenant's person, so you don't need to doubt him.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Why is an outsider meddling in our business?
The Avengers alone are enough. And we have you.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(You explain that Azran and Muina are cooperating,
but Lamine just shakes his head.)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
You handle <Orange>Orha</>.
I'll move on my own.

Name: Orha
Text:
It's [player], right?
Muina contacted me.

Name: Orha
Text:
I was just worrying about what to do with this,
so that's a relief.

Name: Orha
Text: But it seems one person is missing...

Name: Orha
Text:
Yes, that one!
I had my eye on him because his swordsmanship seemed extraordinary.
Orha goes on and on about Lamine for quite some time.

Name: Orha
Text:
Now, shall we talk business?
Huh? You're not already tired, are you?

Name: Orha
Text:
Shall we start with the Whirling Barrows first?
Ah, I almost forgot to connect the communicator...!

Name: Orha
Text: Then I'll leave it to you, [player]?

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(There seems to be a light shimmering on the water.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Let's check the other side too.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Hmm, seems like another wild goose chase.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(We can't investigate like this without a single clue.
I should talk to Orha again.)</>

Name: Orha
Text:
You found nothing?
Hmm... That's strange.

Name: Orha
Text:
Muina clearly said to check the Whirling Barrows and the Thunderbird's Nest,
either one of the two...

Name: Orha
Text:
I only know it looks like a round disc.
Heard they transported it in something like a wooden box...

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(If it looks like a round disc, could it be a Record Disc...?)</>

Name: Orha
Text:
Of course, I also said I needed more information.
But Muina said this was all she had.

Name: Orha
Text:
Well, it can't be helped then.
I'll have to think of another way.

Name: Orha
Text: Let's make a fake relic.

Name: Orha
Text: If it was a relic bound for the gate, it must have been a tribute.

Name: Orha
Text:
Robbing that basically means they risked their lives.
It means money matters more than survival.

Name: Orha
Text: Now then, let's make the relic first and spread a rumor.

Name: Orha
Text:
Hmm... we need to make it look plausible,
so gather some monster pelts and stones first.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(This cliff is the perfect height to lure them in.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Let's ride the updraft up the cliff.)</>

As you place the relic on the cliff and hide, a Legation soldier appears.
He carefully inspects the area and soon heads down below the cliff.

After the soldier completely disappears from view, you contact Orha,
and receive a reply to lie in ambush on the path to the Thunderbird's Nest.

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text:
I found a crate, see?
Given its location and its considerable weight, it seemed like a relic.

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: Really? I was just itching for some action.

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: Thievery is only hard the first time. Turns out it's nothing once you try it.

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: Wonder how much the Archon will pay for this relic.

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: He should pay well since we Legation soldiers are playing bandits to steal it!

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text: ...Hah, is that a rat over there?

Name: Orha
Text: Huh? You weren’t supposed to come alone.

When you say that you ran into Fahad's subordinates and had no choice but to take care of them,
Orha lets out a long sigh.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
What could I do when the prey appeared right before my eyes?
Their end was predetermined anyway.

Name: Orha
Text:
It’s because of the evidence!
Hah... I thought all I had to do was keep Lamine tied down.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Don't butt in so arrogantly.
We will take our revenge with our own hands.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Collaborator, don't mind this and let's go quickly.
I can just get new evidence.

Name: Ramynn
Text: They don't have to be alive to serve as evidence, right?

Name: Orha
Text: Hah... What should I tell Muina, seriously.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Orha? That guy talks too much.
Muina this, Muina that, until the very end.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
He said he had to report urgently because of me or something. 
So I told him to scramble off to Babylon.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
I'm just going to stick with the Young Master.
I can't stay here any longer.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
You're taking that Orha or whatever with you, right?
Then I'll prepare to return...

Name: Orha
Text: Did you finish talking with Lamine?

Name: Orha
Text: I talked to Muina as well, and she said it doesn't matter that you killed them.

Name: Orha
Text:
If they were disguising themselves as the Shadow Wolves,
then they were already fully Fahad’s people.

Name: Orha
Text: It makes me feel pathetic for even thinking of capturing and persuading them.

Name: Orha
Text:
Phew, need to get a grip again.
Since I can't disappoint Muina.

Name: Orha
Text:
For now, I should start with the backlog of work.
I am officially affiliated with the Hunters Guild, after all.

Name: Orha
Text: You know that monsters are used for food and crafting gear, right?

Name: Orha
Text: Head straight up and you'll find the Thunderbird's nest. Hunt everything you see.

Name: Orha
Text: Better to have too much than too little, right?

Name: Orha
Text: Thanks to you, that's one problem solved.

Name: Orha
Text:
This is the last one.
Actually, you could say it's the most important one.

Name: Orha
Text: Please find a suitable place to set up camp.

Name: Orha
Text:
But what else can we do?
We need a camp.

Name: Orha
Text:
Since we have to build one, we might as well set it up on a cliff and just fly there.
Huh...? I think this could work.

Name: Orha
Text: [player], please find a cliff that's easy to fly to and from.

Name: Orha
Text: I'll need to check it myself, so set up a flag so I can spot it easily.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(That spot is too high and the slope is too steep.</>
<yellow>Let's look for a better place to fly to.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(With that height, I could just climb the cliff even if I fall while flying.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(It's spacious enough, and high enough that monsters can't easily climb up.</>
<yellow>Let's tell Orha about this place.)</>

Name: Orha
Text: Did you find a good spot?

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(As you explain the cliff's location,</>
<yellow>Orha's face lights up.)</>

Name: Orha
Text: First, I need to report to Muina.

Name: Orha
Text: I hope the next time we meet, we'll be in a situation where we can talk openly!

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(What exactly are Muina and Azran plotting?</>
<yellow>It's frustrating being kept in the dark.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(I wonder how things are going...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(The Gate of Lament isn't far. Let's hurry.)</>

Name: Nasser
Text:
Good to see you again.
Isn't it great to have more people to work with, <Orange>Chahim?</>

Name: Chahim
Text: You seem to be taking this situation too lightly.

Name: Nasser
Text: You won't last long in the Forsaken Lands if you let every little thing get to you.

Name: Chahim
Text: Adjutant Muina is helping Azran.

Name: Nasser
Text: We've finished reporting about the relics and tribute money that Fahad embezzled.

Name: Nasser
Text:
His punishment has more or less been decided, too.
But the Royal Household has to save face, right?

Name: Nasser
Text: They need to maintain the Legation's influence without alienating the guilds, so...

Name: Chahim
Text: They plan to write it off as the rogue actions of <Red>Fahad</> alone.

Name: Chahim
Text: That way, the Yellow Snake Household will naturally be eliminated as well.

Name: Nasser
Text:
You make it sound like a free favor,
but the Divine got something out of this too, so we're just doing our part.

Name: Nasser
Text: Originally, we were supposed to use the refugees of Karadia as leverage...

Name: Nasser
Text:
<Yellow>In exchange for dealing with Fahad quietly,
we asked them to restore the honor of the “White Lion” Household.</>

Name: [player]
