Text: <yellow>(So this is why Azran and Muina joined forces.)</>

Name: Nasser
Text:
Well, it's not like the Archon is going to be executed tomorrow, right?
Let's take care of our own business first.

After saying that Fahad would be removed from his position as Archon,
the two begin telling you about a series of disappearances in Taima Pioneer Village.
The only thing the missing people had in common was that they all visited the “Gate of Lament.”

Name: Nasser
Text: So we've been trying to figure out if there's anything suspicious near the Gate of Lament.

Name: Nasser
Text: Clear out the monsters in the Red Rock Garden so we can speed up our investigation.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Are there really this many monsters?
I heard it wasn't this bad before. Highly suspicious.

Name: Nasser
Text: Now that the monsters are dealt with, let's check the blind spots.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Take a look around the more secluded areas.
Miners usually rest in places like that.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Just don't wander off too far.
It looks like incursions occur pretty often in this place, too.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(The shade under the cliff makes it look like a good place to rest.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(It looks like a nice spot to rest before heading to the village.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(This looks like a good spot to catch your breath while climbing the hill. Take your time and look around.)</>

Name: Nasser
Text: Find anything?

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(You tell them you found Etherium Candy, then explain its dangers.)</>
ItemDesc:
Candy made from finely crushed Aetherium powder.
Despite its appearance, it has a sweet and highly addictive flavor.

Name: Nasser
Text:
This stuff is still circulating...?
This was rarely seen in the Wasteland. Who could be distributing it?

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(You mention seeing Legation soldiers trading Etherium Candy at Thundercrest.)</>

Name: Nasser
Text:
Hah... Just how low is Fahad willing to stoop?
Does he even know what he's hoarding?

Name: Nasser
Text: The Guild should just buy it at a premium and destroy it all.

Name: Nasser
Text: With that amount, there's no way the foreman didn't know...

Name: Nasser
Text:
[player], could you go talk to the foreman?
He's always acting a bit stiff around us.

Name: Nasser
Text: Just go to Zabin and pretend you're a mercenary looking for work.

Name: Zabin
Text: I'm busy, so just get straight to the point.

Name: Zabin
Text:
...Tsk, you proud of being so scrawny?
Just go down there and eat some candy or something.

You decline Zabin's offer, then explain the side effects of Etherium Candy.
He falls silent for a moment before speaking up, looking aggrieved.

Name: Zabin
Text: The Archon who's been squeezing us dry handed it out as a reward, so I just took it.

Name: Zabin
Text:
<Yellow>When your superiors give you something, you just take it.</>
<Yellow>How am I supposed to tell if it's good or bad?</>

Name: Zabin
Text: If I could afford to be picky, would I be swinging a pickaxe here?

Name: Zabin
Text: Yeah, I told the overworked, exhausted miners to eat it.

Name: Zabin
Text:
But it's not my fault they went missing!
One or two people dropping dead in a place like this is nothing new.

Name: Zabin
Text: If you want to convince me, bring me a better alternative!

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Is hunting the only way to improve this harsh environment?</>
<yellow>Let's take care of the miners' concerns first.)</>

Name: Zabin
Text: Wh-What is this?!

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(You show him the monster pelts and byproducts, suggesting he sell them to the Merchants Guild and Hunters Guild.)</>

Name: Zabin
Text:
H-Hah, but this is only a one-time thing!
This won't even be enough to keep the miners here fed.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(He's not easily swayed.</>
<yellow>You should update Nasser on the situation first.)</>

Name: Nasser
Text: The foreman was throwing a fit. Looks like things aren’t going well?

Name: Nasser
Text:
Haha, is it my turn to step in?
I'll try to talk him around. Just wait a moment.

Name: Nasser
Text: The old man is sick and just wants to leave this place.

Name: Nasser
Text:
He's already having a hard time, and you come along telling him to do this, 
and that. It must've been exhausting.

Name: Nasser
Text:
So, here's the deal.
<Yellow>The Merchants Guild will buy this place, and the miners will be sent to the Pioneer Village.</>

Name: Nasser
Text:
Fahad probably couldn't care less about this place anyway.
If anything, this works out for the best.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Hmm... You don't agree?
Don't just frown, use your words.

Name: Chahim
Text:
How can you trust someone like him?
What if something goes wrong in the Pioneer Village?

Name: Chahim
Text:
Betrayal never ends with a one-time act.
They'll just be bolder the second time.

Name: Nasser
Text:
It isn’t the foreman I trust.
I'm trusting the Divine and you <Orange>“Avengers.”</>

Name: Nasser
Text: If you can't even handle Fahad after everything we've done...

Name: Chahim
Text:
That won't happen.
The Avenger's blade is aimed straight at the Yellow Snake's throat.

Name: Nasser
Text:
I'll take that as a yes. Let's get ready to send the miners off safely.
You'll help, right, [player]?

Name: Nasser
Text: All right, let's set up some signposts first so the miners can travel safely.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Let's start from the Gate of Lament.
They say it's especially easy to get lost around there.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(There seems to be something in the bushes.</>
<yellow>Let's go closer.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(There seems to be something between the rocks.</>
<yellow>Let's go closer.)</>

Name: Nasser
Text: Did you get the signposts set up?

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(You nod, then tell them about the corpses you found while placing the signposts.)</>

Name: Nasser
Text: I feel like there might be more...

Name: Nasser
Text:
Leave this to me.
Muina needs to hear about this, too.

Name: Chahim
Text:
I received a message from Azran.
He's relaying his message through me to keep you out of danger, so please don't be offended.

Name: Chahim
Text: The message is for you to come to Babylon as soon as you hear this.

Name: Chahim
Text: He said you'd know the place. It's where you met with Adjutant Muina before.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(He must mean the market area currently under expansion.</>
<yellow>You nod to show you understand.)</>

Name: Chahim
Text:
...We've finally reached the end of our revenge.
I'm counting on you until the very end.

Name: Azran
Text:
Come in, [player].
I've been waiting for you.

Name: Azran
Text: This is a compilation of the evidence you've gathered with the Avengers so far.
ItemDesc:
Evidence compiled by Azran.
It contains details about Fahad embezzling relics and tribute money, and smuggling Etherium Candy.

Name: Azran
Text:
It details Fahad embezzling relics and tribute money,
as well as his smuggling of Etherium Candy.

Name: Azran
Text:
I've already delivered the rest of the evidence.
Just take this to Adjutant Muina.

Name: Azran
Text:
It's to ensure the paperwork looks clean for the administrative process.
We need someone who wouldn't arouse suspicion walking in and out of the Legation.

Name: Azran
Text: Someone with no known grudge against the Archon...

Name: Azran
Text:
If they were to report everything that happened in the Wasteland...
The fallout would be beyond imagination.

Name: Azran
Text: The one who always treated adventurers like bugs will be ousted by an adventurer.

Name: Azran
Text: Shedding blood is our job as Avengers.

Name: Azran
Text:
I'll contact you again soon.
Next time, I'll reach out to you directly.

Name: Mueena
Text:
It has been a while.
What brings you here?

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(As you hand over the petition detailing Fahad's atrocities,</>
<yellow>a smile spread across Muina's face as she reads it.)</>

Name: Mueena
Text:
[player], I have officially filed this petition…
…under the name of Muina of the Asientet Legation.

Name: Mueena
Text: The authenticity of this letter will be judged by the Asientet Royal Household and the Legation.
ItemDesc:
The petition delivered by an adventurer.
It details Fahad's numerous misdeeds.

Name: Mueena
Text:
The accused is <Red>Archon Fahad</>, I see.
I recognize the gravity of this matter and will make it our top priority.

Name: Mueena
Text:
His authority as Archon will be revoked until this case is closed.
So, you can return with peace of mind.

Name: Mueena
Text: Ah, I almost forgot something important.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Etherium Candy seems highly dangerous,
so I must ask you to stop by the Gate of Lament.

Name: Mueena
Text: We can't afford any more casualties while we verify the facts.

Name: Chahim
Text: This is the first time waiting for a target has felt so long.

Name: Chahim
Text: Azran has gone to prepare for the Yellow Snake's counterattack.

Name: Chahim
Text:
We must also prepare for an armed clash.
Did you know the Yellow Snake faction is proficient with poison?

Name: Chahim
Text:
I've finally figured out their recipe.
It's the exact poison they spread through the White Lion Household long ago...!

Name: Chahim
Text:
They've heavily favored using it to eliminate political opponents ever since.
It's highly likely they'll use the same tactic this time.

Name: Chahim
Text:
Now that we know the ingredients, an antidote will be quick to make.
I plan to make both at the same time.

Name: Chahim
Text:
Please head to the Red Plains.
I need monster spinal fluid, teeth, and some Trichosanthes.

Name: Chahim
Text:
This should be enough.
Please wait a moment.

Name: Chahim
Text:
It's done.
Now... it's the Yellow Snake's turn to destroy themselves.
ItemDesc: A poison crafted from a recipe known only to the Yellow Snake Household.

Name: Chahim
Text: Now that we have the poison, we need to test it...

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Surely not on a person, right...?</>
<yellow>You give him a bewildered look, but Chahim just shrugs.)</>

Name: Chahim
Text:
...Of course we're going to test it on monsters.
Don't look at me like that.

Name: Chahim
Text: Let's find somewhere nearby and observe the monsters’ reactions.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(...Strange.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(I sprayed the poison, but there's no reaction at all.</>
<yellow>Was this never going to be enough?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Let's head over to that rock.</>
<yellow>There are a lot of monsters gathered nearby, so it might be different this time.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(I tried again, but it's the same. In fact, they seem even more active...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(It could be dangerous, so let's take them out.)</>

Name: Chahim
Text:
How was it?
I didn't get great results on my end.

Name: Chahim
Text: Hah, but it doesn’t seem right to use it on a person...

Name: Nasser
Text:
Then I'll just buy it.
I just thought of someone who might need this.

Name: Chahim
Text: ...Do you even know what this is?

Name: Nasser
Text:
My eyes and ears are everywhere.
So are you going to sell it or not?

Name: Chahim
Text:
This was made for a far greater purpose, so give it up.
It's not something meant for merchants to handle.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Stop playing hard to get.
Let me know if you ever change your mind.

Name: Azran
Text: They've gathered even more forces than before.

Name: Azran
Text:
I apologize for summoning you so suddenly.
But time was of the essence.

Name: Azran
Text:
Fahad escaped right before the Legation could arrest him.
...Quaista chased after him but got trapped inside the Wolf Clan's den.

Name: Azran
Text:
Muina's people are moving them to the infirmary now.
The Legation soldiers were poisoned and are in critical condition.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Come to think of it, someone from Muina's side was always there when we met an Avenger.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Like Orha, and Nasser...)</>

Name: Azran
Text: ...We need to find Quaista, fast.

Name: Quaista
Text:
This... This is a trap...!
The Yellow Snake's troops... are targeting you, Young Master!

Name: Quaista
Text:
We'd be lucky if it were just the Wolf Clan.
These guys are on par with a regular army...!

Name: Quaista
Text:
I never should have come here in the first place...
If anything happens to you, Young Master, our White Lion Household will-

Name: Azran
Text:
I don't want to lose any more of my people.
So focus on us getting out of here alive!

Name: Quaista
Text:
Is it really okay for an assassin to fight on the front lines? Haha...
Plus, look at me. I'm basically dead weight.

Name: Azran
Text: Our reliable ally is standing right next to us, aren't they?

You take out the poison Chahim made and show it to Azran.
He thinks for a moment but eventually shakes his head.

Name: Azran
Text: No. I won't use this.

Name: Azran
Text:
I refuse to stoop to his level.
The White Lion does things the White Lion way.

Name: Azran
Text:
Let's get you patched up first.
Quaista, if things go south, get out of here. Even if you have to leave me.

Name: Quaista
Text:
...I'll make sure that doesn't happen.
Let's scavenge around the supply pile first.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Phew. Let’s go.
I can still swing a sword, at least.

Name: Azran
Text: Fahad is nowhere to be seen.

Name: Quaista
Text:
That can't be!
I may be injured, but I know what I heard and saw.

Name: Quaista
Text: I distinctly heard someone shout that the Yellow Snake was here...

Name: Azran
Text:
It works out perfectly. I get to end him myself.
Quaista, take it easy and follow close behind.

Name: Mueena
Text:
It's not time yet.
I have a use for Fahad's corpse.

Name: Azran
Text: …You know well I've been waiting for this exact moment.

Name: Mueena
Text:
The petition couldn't possibly cover everything.
We should dig until there's nothing left to uncover.

Name: Azran
Text:
Haa... You'll have to hand him back to me once the investigation is over.
By the way, how did you know we'd be here?

Name: Mueena
Text:
Thanks to the friend watching Quaista's back.
Lilian from the Expedition Camp, remember?

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Quaista looks back and forth between you and Muina with a dumbfounded expression.</>
<yellow>I didn't know about this either...)</>

Name: Mueena
Text: I'll leave the cleanup to the Divine and the Avengers.

Name: Mueena
Text: [player], you follow me.

Name: Mueena
Text: Nasser said you have the “Yellow Snake's” poison, is that true?

Name: Mueena
Text: Hand it over. I have an urgent use for it.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(You firmly refuse, but you give in eventually. You have no choice but to hand it over to Muina.)</>
ItemDesc: A poison crafted from a recipe known only to the Yellow Snake Household.

Name: Mueena
Text: Within a few days, rumors will spread that Fahad committed suicide by taking poison.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Blinded by his greed to become Archon,
he annihilated the White Lion Household under charges of treason—

Name: Mueena
Text:
and while embezzling tribute money meant for the Royal Household,
he was even accused by an adventurer.

Name: Mueena
Text:
He tarnished the Royal Household's honor,
and paid for it with his life. That sort of predictable story.

Name: Mueena
Text: When that happens, it'll only be a matter of time before the Royal Household restores the “White Lion” Household.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Good question.
I will be taking over as the new <Orange>“Archon of Asientet.”</>

Name: Mueena
Text: Just as promised, I'll be in a position to lend you my strength whenever you need it.

Smiling quietly, Muina says she would summon you to the Legation in the near future,
before returning to Babylon.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(I guess it's safe to say that's a weight off my shoulders...</>
<Yellow>And for Azran and the noble Avengers, too...)</>

Name: Zakirum
Text: It should be me. It has to be.

Name: Zakirum
Text: I’ve run more errands for <Orange>Sturdy Whiskers Etura</> than any other Naruru!

Name: Sagur
Text: No, no.

Name: Sagur
Text:
The best fisher is the most useful Naruru.
Therefore, I am the next Sturdy Whiskers!

Name: Zidara
Text: Sturdy Whiskers must listen to all villagers, whether happy or sad.

Name: Zidara
Text: I know everything that happens in this village, everything!

Name: Zakirum
Text: Human! Tell me what you think.

Name: Sagur
Text: Which Naruru should become Sturdy-Beard?

Name: Zidara
Text: Answer the question! Answer!

Name: Narurus who want to become Sturdy-Beard
Text: <Yellow>!!!</>

Name: Zakirum
Text: That's, that's right!

Name: Sagur
Text: The smartest Naruru will be the next Sturdy-Beard!

Name: Zidara
Text: Then that riddle, that riddle is perfect!

Name: Zidara
Text: Across the water, there are strange, strange boxes.

Name: Zidara
Text: No one knows what they are for or how to use them, so everyone calls them a riddle.

Name: Sagur
Text: The Naruru who figures out what those boxes are for is the smartest Naruru!

Name: Sagur
Text: It's perfect for the test to become the next Sturdy-Beard, perfect!

Name: Zakirum
Text: Understood, understood!
There were countless chests there, but I managed to find the one with a special symbol.

Name: Narurus who want to become Sturdy-Beard
Narurus who want to become Sturdy-Beard
Text: <Yellow>The smartest Naruru!</>

Name: Zakirum
Text: A human, a human solved the riddle!

Name: Zidara
Text: Just as we said earlier, you're the candidate for the next <Orange>Sturdy-Beard</>!

Name: Sagur
Text:
Of course, another test awaits you.
Pass the test, and you'll become a Sturdy-Beard Naruru!

Name: Sagur
Text: If you aren't a Naruru, you can't be Sturdy-Beard? You can't?

Name: Zidara
Text: Who knows about that?

Name: Zakirum
Text:
Smart Naruru! Let's go find Sturdy-Beard Etura!
Everyone, follow me!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Narurus runs off, leaving a cloud of dust.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I should get going now.)</>

Name: Lutga
Text: It's that human from the festival!

Name: Lutga
Text: Did you come visit our village again?

Name: Lutga
Text:
Perfect timing!
We have plenty of food left over.

Name: Lutga
Text: If you don't mind, please move these baskets over there, over there!

Name: Lutga
Text: We need to feed our other animal friends, not just the Naruru tribe.

Name: Lutga
Text: <Blue>Goddess Ea</> won't get angry if we share with everyone.

Name: Lutga
Text: They aren't leftovers from last time, they're new! Freshly made, so don't worry.

Name: Urkai
Text: I've prepared this much food, too.

Name: Urkai
Text: There are two large rest areas behind the village. You can just leave them there.

Name: Urkai
Text: At night, at night, our animal friends will sneak out for a taste.

Name: Urkai
Text: They might not come out if a human is around, so just drop them off and come back!

Name: Urkai
Text: We'll keep making more food in the meantime.

Name: Lutga
Text: Thanks for your hard work, human.

Name: Lutga
Text:
If you ever want some pie, come find me anytime. I'll bake you more!
Mmhuhu!

Name: Lamasu
Text: Ah, you! You're the human who saved the children!

Name: Lamasu
Text: The <Orange>Bristly-Hairs</> were so, so busy that it almost turned into a huge disaster.

Name: Lamasu
Text:
As the captain, I just moved on without a word.
It's a bit late, but thank you, thanks!

Name: Lamasu
Text: <Yellow>From now on, you are an honorary Bristly-Hair!</>

Name: Lamasu
Text:
We are sharing the glory bestowed by <Blue>Goddess Ea</> with you.
Because you protected the Narurus.

Name: Lamasu
Text:
From now on, you must never forget that you are a Bristly-Hair.
Got it?

Name: Lamasu
Text: Good! Jere’s the first mission, mission for our new member!

Name: Lamasu
Text:
The others are all out on a patrol.
So we don’t have enough Narurus to protect the village. You know that, right?

Name: Lamasu
Text:
Go and scout Sunrise Slope up ahead.
And if you spot any monsters, take them out!

Name: Lamasu
Text: If you understand, move out!

Name: Lamasu
Text: Impressive work, just like an honorary member should be.

Name: Lamasu
Text:
This time, I need you to scout even further out.
It won't be too hard, right?

Name: Lamasu
Text: The safety of the village is up to you! You! So don't slack off!

Name: Lamasu
Text: To think you completed the second mission, too.

Name: Lamasu
Text:
It seems Goddess Ea is watching over you.
You fight just as well as any Bristly-Hair!

Name: Lamasu
Text: You're incredibly strong!

Name: Lamasu
Text: Good job! Since you're an honorary member, I'll give you a short break.

Name: Lamasu
Text: Come see me again when you're ready for your next mission.

Name: Lamasu
Text: You're back, honorary member!

Name: Lamasu
Text: Let's begin the third mission.

Name: Lamasu
Text: A lot of gears we use came from humans.

Name: Lamasu
Text: Because there are things we absolutely, absolutely need but too hard for Narurus to make.

Name: Lamasu
Text: The hard and sharp things we use to fight the <Red>Kuduru Tribe</>.

Name: Lamasu
Text:
But Jiranna, the merchant guild leader...
said that humans are fighting a whole lot right now, too!

Name: Lamasu
Text:
That is why they couldn't bring the hard and sharp things.
So what we have right now is all we've got.

Name: Lamasu
Text: Ah, humans call it equipment.

Name: Lamasu
Text:
Anyway, if all of this breaks, we won't be able to fight the Kuduru Tribe...
...or the Inusion... I mean, <Red>Incursion</> either!

Name: Lamasu
Text: So we have to find more from somewhere.

Name: Lamasu
Text: That is your mission!

Name: Lamasu
Text: How, how? Are you going to trade with other humans?

Name: Lamasu
Text: You... Honorary member...

Name: Lamasu
Text: God Ea has blessed you with brains, too!

Name: Lamasu
Text:
I really like that idea.
Let's go with your plan!

Name: Lamasu
Text: This is way too big for us to use.

Name: Lamasu
Text: Still, if we chop it into smaller pieces, we might be able to carry it.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It seems disassembling it and handing it over will work.)</>

Name: Lamasu
Text: Honorary member, could you help us cut it?

Name: Lamasu
Text: Do you have a way?
You dismantle the gathered materials and hand them over to Ramasu.

Name: Lamasu
Text:
They’ve become much smaller.
At this size, the Narurus can definitely use them.

Name: Lamasu
Text: You've completed this mission splendidly, too!

Name: Lamasu
Text:
I'd love to give you more missions, but you're only an honorary member, right?
The real Bristly-Hairs will handle the rest.

Name: Lamasu
Text:
Still, you'll always be welcome here.
Strong and smart human!

Name: Vahista
Text: We meet again, Adventurer.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Who are you here to see?
If it's someone from the <Orange>Bardad Expedition</>, I can point you in the right direction.

Name: Vahista
Text: Let's cut the budget here this time...

Name: Vahista
Text: I'm just trying to figure out how to squeeze out enough coin to pay their research stipends.

Name: Vahista
Text:
That's what I'm currently agonizing over.
Ah, will I have to cut the food budget again?

Name: Vahista
Text:
People like us who research and analyze things don't usually make much money.
I'm not sure how it is for the main unit, though.

Name: Vahista
Text: It just means we have to cover our own living and operating expenses.

Name: Vahista
Text: Speaking of which, could you lend me a hand if you have some time?

Name: Vahista
Text:
Do you see those cactuses right there?
They're one of our main sources of income.

Name: Vahista
Text:
They are a different breed from desert cactuses, so they have unique medicinal properties.
That's why they sell so well as medical ingredients.

Name: Vahista
Text: I'd appreciate it if you could harvest some while I sort out this ledger.

Name: Vahista
Text:
You harvested them so carefully.
I didn't even ask for research-grade samples.

Name: Vahista
Text: We could definitely sell these as top-grade!

Name: Vahista
Text: Hehe, thanks.

Name: Vahista
Text: Now, should I slowly get back to my actual job?

Name: Vahista
Text:
Why are you looking at me like that?
I, Bahista, can be quite competent when it counts.

Name: Vahista
Text: This time, I'm aiming to manage both our research progress and the Cactus Nest finances all at once.

Name: Vahista
Text: Have you seen that large stream near Aburu Village?

Name: Vahista
Text:
The Narurus call that place <Blue>'Ea's Navel'</>.
You can tell right away that it overflows with mystical aura.

Name: Vahista
Text: By the way, have you noticed the Narurus often carry pretty pebbles around?

Name: Vahista
Text:
The funny thing is, they picked those stones up from Ea's Navel.
They have colors you don't see very often.

Name: Vahista
Text: Stones like that aren't found on normal land.

Name: Vahista
Text: That means Ea's Navel is well worth researching!

Name: Vahista
Text:
Besides, who knows?
If we sell them to jewelers, could we make a fortune?

Name: Vahista
Text:
Then we can finally focus on our research without worrying about finances.
Well, isn't this a brilliant plan?

Name: Vahista
Text:
You look bored. Are you bored?
Yeah, you have the look of someone who's completely bored.

Name: Vahista
Text: Don't dawdle, let's get going!

Name: Vahista
Text: From here on out, this is Ea's Navel.

Name: Vahista
Text: It looks dangerous, but there's a bridge, so we just have to walk carefully.

Name: Vahista
Text: Well, it’s quite large. I think it’d be best to set up camp and look around slowly.

Name: Vahista
Text: Shall we find a decent spot?

Name: Vahista
Text: Wow, my thirst for knowledge is boiling over for the first time in ages.

Name: Vahista
Text: To think I've just been counting coins all this time, with a place like this right on the Cactus Nest's doorstep.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Doesn't it feel like a waste to sell them?
This place is absolutely brimming with specimens!

Name: Vahista
Text:
We still don't even know if they have any market value.
I think I'll hold onto these.

Name: Vahista
Text:
Yes, this is exactly what I wanted!
Something to reignite the passion I lost while struggling to keep this expedition afloat.

Name: Vahista
Text: You are my stone of Fate!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The expedition is likely to remain poor after all...)</>

Name: Vahista
Text:
I should hurry back and pack my bags!
I'm heading back first!

Name: Monas
Text: Adventurer?

Name: Monas
Text:
I thought my eyes were deceiving me.
You must still have business at the Cactus Nest!

Name: Monas
Text: Thanks to your help last time, my research has made quite a bit of progress.

Name: Monas
Text: Though it came to a dead halt the moment I needed new specimens.

Name: Monas
Text:
They told me all I had to do was research!
Who would have thought my life would be on the line like this?

Name: Monas
Text:
When the Naruru tribe isn't standing guard,
I'm too scared to even step outside.

Name: Monas
Text: I can't help but tremble in fear every single day! Sob...!

Name: Monas
Text:
<Yellow>You're the only one I can count on, Adventurer!</>
To extend a helping hand to me once again...

Name: Monas
Text: Do you see the grasslands just up ahead?

Name: Monas
Text:
We must fight our way through the monsters there to investigate.
Please, just keep them from harming me.

Name: Monas
Text: I leave my safety in your capable hands, then.

Name: Monas
Text: Today was the most peaceful day I've had since arriving here.

Name: Monas
Text: I wish you could be here every day, Adventurer... Truly.

Name: Monas
Text: It may be trivial, a truly small amount, but...

Name: Monas
Text:
I'd like to share a portion of my precious research funds with you!
On the condition that you help me again next time, alright?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He seems to be lost in thought. Maybe I should wait.)</>

Name: Zuabu
Text: Fishing... Fishing is an exercise in patience...

Name: Zuabu
Text:
And keeping absolutely quiet...
<Yellow>Stay still... stay very still...</>

Name: Zuabu
Text: Because you, a human... decided to speak, all the fish swam away...

Name: Zuabu
Text: But this, too, must be the will of Goddess Ea.

Name: Zuabu
Text: It is time to prepare for the day I return to Ea.

Name: Zuabu
Text:
How one born as a Naruru returns to the river...
Whether I have been a shameful Naruru...

Name: Zuabu
Text: I catch fish while thinking... thinking about such things.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He seems to be a philosophical Naruru.)</>

Name: Zuabu
Text:
I haven't caught any fish, but...
Goddess Ea has sent you as a fishing friend... a friend.

Name: Zuabu
Text: If you want to fish as well, try finding some bait first.

Name: Zuabu
Text: Turn over some stones and you will see small earthworms... earthworms.

Name: Zuabu
Text: That is enough... that is plenty.

Name: Zuabu
Text: There is a better fishing spot than this... Follow me.

Name: Zuabu
Text: Just cross this stream and head to the rock straight ahead.

Name: Zuabu
Text: It is a bit deep, but even a human should easily be able to swim across.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Zuabu seems to have arrived already. I should follow before it's too late.)</>

Name: Zuabu
Text: I will lend you my fish trap... the fish trap I've been using.

Name: Zuabu
Text:
A novice angler would be better off using this.
It will help you catch at least one or two.

Name: Zuabu
Text: Let's take a look inside the fish trap.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The fish trap is brimming with fish!)</>

Name: Zuabu
Text:
Human, you did great... great for a beginner.
I wonder what you were thinking about while you fished.

Name: Zuabu
Text:
Hmm... The God Ea might say that is for the best.
Having too many worries keeps you awake at night.

Name: Zuabu
Text: Now, since we are fishing friends, please accept this gift.

Name: Zuabu
Text: If you return to where we first met, there will be a small cave... a cave.

Name: Zuabu
Text:
A human I met before gave it to me, but I have no use for it.
You should take it.

Name: Zuabu
Text: I am going back to fishing...

Name: Barashu
Text: What should I do... Our <Blue>Rappies</> are refusing to listen to us right now!

Name: Barashu
Text:
Among wild Rappies, some become timid after a severe injury,
while others are naturally easily frightened.

Name: Barashu
Text:
Those who struggle to fit into the herd...
Our job is to bring them in and take care of them.

Name: Barashu
Text:
However, there's one Rappie that lashes out even as an adult
.because of the painful memories from its  time in the herd.

Name: Barashu
Text: It takes its anger out on the others, making it incredibly dangerous!

Name: Barashu
Text:
We don’t know what to do, neither me nor the breeders.
So, I'm afraid I won't be able to give you a tour of the ranch!

Name: Barashu
Text: Really?!

Name: Barashu
Text: To calm a Rappie down, you have to give it a stern scolding!

Name: Barashu
Text: It may be acting aggressively now, but it's naturally quite timid.

Name: Barashu
Text:
You just need to show it that you are a <Yellow>brave human</>, Adventurer!
I'm counting on you!

Name: Barashu
Text: I knew I could count on you, Adventurer.

Name: Barashu
Text: Thank you, Adventurer!

Name: Barashu
Text: At our ranch, there's a tradition we uphold before sending a Rappie away.

Name: Barashu
Text: We give the Rappie a necklace made from an Abaru's webbed feet.

Name: Barashu
Text:
<Yellow>It's a gift for the Rappies, our oldest friends,
and the apostles of Goddess Ea.</>

Name: Barashu
Text: It's a symbol meant to encourage them to survive tenaciously to the end...

Name: Barashu
Text:
...I'm being a bit overly sentimental, aren't I?
But it's never easy to let them go after you cared for them so much.

Name: Barashu
Text: I should hurry up and make it before I get too emotional.

Name: Barashu
Text:
Please head to the Water Mist Grasslands and gather plenty of materials for me. 
I'm counting on you!

Name: Barashu
Text: Thank you, Adventurer!

Name: Zamamark
Text: Sigh...

Name: Zamamark
Text: What... what should I do? Can I really keep going like this?

Name: Zamamark
Text: To appear right before my eyes at a time like this... You must be the one.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
The one who can give it to me straight!
That has to be you.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
I am Zamamark.
The Naruru destined to inherit this ranch.

Name: Zamamark
Text: The entire future of this ranch depends on me!

Name: Zamamark
Text:
That's why I am so full of worries... worries.
Because at this rate, the ranch will go out of business.

Name: Zamamark
Text: Rappies are incredibly sturdy and live for a long time.

Name: Zamamark
Text: So once someone makes a Rappie friend, they rarely have a reason to visit the ranch again.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
Which means... our customer base is shrinking, right?
The ranch will eventually be completely forgotten.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
But that absolutely doesn't mean I want the Rappies to get hurt!
Because we truly love our Rappies.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
But it's also true that our livelihood is in trouble.
<Yellow>I came up with an idea while praying... praying to Ea.</>

Name: Zamamark
Text:
And that is... the <Blue>'Ranch Experience'</>.
If word spreads that it's fun, new customers will come flocking!

Name: Zamamark
Text:
Do you want to be the first to try it out?
You can tell me how much fun you have!

Name: Zamamark
Text: I'm ready for whatever feedback you give me.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
Don't hold back, give it a go.
Because to move forward, we have to fix our mistakes!

Name: Zamamark
Text: Then I suppose I'll need to add something else.

Name: Zamamark
Text: I need to do some thinking... thinking, so wait just a moment!

Name: Zamamark
Text:
We can try extending the time spent playing with the Rappies.
After all, this is a <Blue>'Rappie Ranch'</>.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
If you feed them and take them on walks,
it will create a really... really great memory! Right?

Name: Zamamark
Text:
If you treat them kindly, the Rappies will be happy to follow you.
Our little ones are very docile, you see.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
You can use the hay in front of the ranch for their feed.
I'm counting on you!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Rappie let out a soft, satisfied cry.)</>

Name: Zamamark
Text: It feels like you've bonded with the Rappies, doesn't it?

Name: Zamamark
Text:
If the customers follow along up to this point...
They'll be completely captivated by the ranch's charm! Hehe!

Name: Zamamark
Text:
Everything is going well.
We are almost finished.

Name: Zamamark
Text: <Yellow>The grand finale of the Ranch Experience is…!</>

Name: Zamamark
Text: We must include Rappie-back ride!

Name: Zamamark
Text:
With this, even Ea will be... will be pleased with me.
Right? You're dying to try it, aren't you?

Name: Zamamark
Text: I wonder what it will feel like for the customers to ride Rappies around the ranch.

Name: Zamamark
Text: Go take a Rappie for a spin and come back!

Name: Zamamark
Text: Was the path too narrow? Were there too many obstacles?

Name: Zamamark
Text: There was nothing like that, right? I tried my best to clear them away.

Name: Zamamark
Text: If it looks fine to a human, then it's fine!

Name: Zamamark
Text:
After all, most of the customers who visit the ranch are humans.
Your feedback was incredibly important!

Name: Zamamark
Text:
I guess I have nothing to worry about anymore.
We'll proceed as it is, hehe!

Name: Zamamark
Text:
Thanks for your help.
It's not much, but at least... at least take this.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
For us Naruru, giving and receiving...
must be done properly for us to feel at ease.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
I'm going to go talk to the breeder Naruru.
See you next time!

Name: Baragur
Text: You are still here... here.

Name: Baragur
Text: If you have no business left, you'd better leave quickly.

Name: Baragur
Text: <Red>The mood is so cold that I can't rest comfortably...</>

Name: Baragur
Text:
It has always been quiet around here.
Since we have to keep an eye on the Kuduru tribe.

Name: Baragur
Text: Still, it never felt like such a piercing wind was blowing through...

Name: Baragur
Text:
Because <Orange>Sharaf</> is feeling so down...
The other Naruru and humans are just walking on eggshells around Sharaf... Sharaf.

Name: Baragur
Text: Still, I have to do what needs to be done...

Name: Baragur
Text: We call the large tree with wide-spread branches the <Blue>'Cradle Tree'</>.

Name: Baragur
Text:
That tree's sap... sap is very good for wounds.
We used it all up during the recent battle, though...

Name: Baragur
Text:
The trees inside the Waypoints must have been stripped bare already.
You'll have to look outside... outside the base.

Name: Baragur
Text: I will be waiting.

Name: Baragur
Text: Thanks for bringing so much! Thank you!

Name: Baragur
Text:
Physical wounds can be healed by applying medicine, but...
I'm worried about Sharaf.

Name: Baragur
Text:
A human named <Orange>Mitchell</>... was caught an Incursion and...
Sharaf has not been himself ever since that happened.

Name: Baragur
Text: Is Sharaf sad because Mitchell was the first human he ever trusted?

Name: Baragur
Text:
I heard something terrible happened to him when he was young.
That’s why he hates humans—He hates them so much.

Name: Baragur
Text: He even tried to turn away the Hunters Guild...

Name: Baragur
Text:
But Sturdy Whiskers said it was for everyone’s safety,
so he had no choice but to let him stay.

Name: Baragur
Text:
But that human hunted Kuduru and tended to the sick.
He talked a lot, but he was a good human.

Name: Baragur
Text:
In the end, Sharaf stopped pushing Mitchell away.
They even joked and laughed together.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He caused the Incursion, and they say he was a good man?)</>

Name: Baragur
Text: Anyway, he has returned to the embrace of Goddess Ea.

Name: Baragur
Text: <Yellow>I just hope Sharaf finds his strength again...</>

Name: Sharaf
Text:
...So, it’s you.
Is there still business left for you here?

Name: Sharaf
Text: There is no reason not to be.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
I survived, so I must do my job.
We never know when the remaining Kuduru will strike again.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Xeros said Mitchell caused the Incursion.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(No need to tell Sharaf the truth.)</>

Name: Sharaf
Text:
The rest of us must work harder now.
There are fewer of us now, after all.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I should comfort him.)</>

Name: Sharaf
Text:
When you first arrived...
If only I had told you where the <Orange>Incursion Specialist</> was right away,

Name: Sharaf
Text: Mitchell wouldn't have gone around trying to help you.

Name: Sharaf
Text: Then maybe... he wouldn't have died in the Incursion.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
<Yellow>I made a bad call.
All because I couldn't let go of my hatred for humans.</>

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Still... it is only right that I guide him
on his journey to Goddess Ea.

Name: Sharaf
Text: With you, of course... since you were there in his final moments.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Sharaf lets out a heavy sigh before speaking again.)</>

Name: Sharaf
Text: We Naruru mourn in a different way than humans.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
We need an object that the deceased used to carry before death.
Something not broken.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
The Hunters Guild already cremated his body,
so we must look elsewhere.

Name: Sharaf
Text: Come to think of it, Mitchell lost something every time he went hunting.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
The Kuduru might still have it.
They have a habit of hiding what they steal.

Name: Sharaf
Text: He was loud, and clumsy...

Name: Sharaf
Text:
But he was a fine hunter.
The best among those who came from the Guild.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
This should be enough.
Let us move.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
When a Naruru sends a friend to Goddess Ea,
we go to <Blue>Ea's Navel</>.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
We offer prayers while letting flowers float down the stream.
We pray for Ea to embrace them.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Since Mitchell wasn't a Naruru,
we will send his belongings to Ea so the goddess might recognize him.

Name: Sharaf
Text: You’ve found the item. Now we just need the flowers.

Name: Sharaf
Text: Let's head to the place where his spirit rests.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The hill is steeper than I thought. Better watch my step.)</>

Name: Sharaf
Text: <Yellow>I prayed that Ea would accept Mitchell.</>

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Thanks to you, I could be brave.
Thank you.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
When I was a Naruru pup,
a wicked human took me away.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
I was beaten every day, starving...
sold from place to place and worked like a slave.

Name: Sharaf
Text: I barely managed to escape and return to Aburu Village.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
That is why I came to loathe humans.
I even urged Sturdy Whiskers to drive them all out.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
I’ve seen many humans here calling themselves hunters...
but they all seemed to have hidden motives.

Name: Sharaf
Text: It was Mitchell who changed my mind.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
He was truly a good man.
Though I will never see him again.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
I suppose you are not a bad person either,
because Mitchell chose to help you.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
<Yellow>...Please, let me be alone for a moment,
so I may honor my friend's passing.</>

Name: Amelie
Text: Hello! A new face!

Name: Amelie
Text:
I'm Amelie from the Hunters Guild. I was assigned here for this quarter.
Just here to fill the headcount.

Name: Amelie
Text: I heard someone named <Orange>Mitchell</> passed away.

Name: Amelie
Text:
Apparently, he had quite a reputation here.
But that’s all I know! I’m only here because they told me to come.

Name: Amelie
Text:
Our guild is mostly like that, you know?
No need for small talk as long as you can hunt.

Name: Amelie
Text:
Still! I like this place.
It stays faithful to the first virtue of hunting.

Name: Amelie
Text:
Positioning!
No matter what you're hunting, you've got to find the right spot.

Name: Amelie
Text:
Heh, what's with that look?
If you don’t believe me, let’s settle this with a duel.

Name: Amelie
Text: There's no way an adventurer who fights as <Red>recklessly</> as you can out-hunt me.

Name: Amelie
Text: Alright, let’s start with those Kuduru.

Name: Amelie
Text:
Time’s up! I win, by a hair.
I got five more than you.

Name: Amelie
Text: There was no way you'd beat me. Everyone knows my name.

Name: Amelie
Text: I’m already quite famous! I just need more time to build my reputation.

Name: Amelie
Text: Once word gets out, I’ll be taking a seat among the Hunters Guild leaders. Just you watch.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She's all talk.)</>

Name: Amelie
Text: Anyway, I win! Hahaha!

Name: Amelie
Text:
Don't look so down.
Maybe your talent lies elsewhere.

Name: Amelie
Text: Like <Blue>treasure hunting</>, for instance.

Name: Amelie
Text: I’ve made quite a fortune in that field myself.

Name: Amelie
Text: Ever heard of <Orange>Amelie the Treasure Hunter</>?

Name: Amelie
Text: I’ve hidden a few gold coins just for fun.

Name: Amelie
Text:
If you find them all, I’ll admit you’re the real deal.
Take a good look around higher grounds of the ruins!

Name: Amelie
Text: Y-you found them all?

Name: Amelie
Text: I hid them where no ordinary person could reach...

Name: Amelie
Text:
Uh. You… a mere adventurer, bringing back treasures
that even I, the greatest hunter, couldn't retrieve... Impossible!

Name: Amelie
Text: What kind of trick did you use?

Name: Amelie
Text:
Wipe that smirk off your face!
You still can't... can't even touch the great Amelie.

Name: Amelie
Text: Next time we meet, it’ll be a real hunt. Hmph!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Should I really brew this?
It’ll make people feel good, very good… that’s for sure...

Name: Ishinu
Text: Do you enjoy spirits, human?

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Hehe... This is a gift from Ea—a perfect chance!
Human, there’s something I need you to fetch!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Go to the Garden of Twilight and gather some ingredients.
Make sure they match the ones drawn here.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The drawings show such ghastly ingredients...</>
<Yellow>I wonder if he’s actually brewing poison.)</>

Name: Ishinu
Text:
I’m going to <Yellow>brew the ultimate drink of bliss!</>
Now, hurry along! Off you go!

Name: Ishinu
Text: Back already? That was fast.

Name: Ishinu
Text:
You’d make a fine worker. Yes, you would!
Do you want to be my apprentice?

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Hmm, I see.
Since Beretta is busy, I guess her friends are too!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Just a moment, human.
Once I add these, it’s finished! <Yellow>The drink of happiness! The nectar of joy!</>

I take a sip, and suddenly, the world is overflowing with love.
I feel like Ishinu’s apprentices would truly understand this feeling.

Name: Denny
Text: D-drunken confessions are absolutely the worst kind!<Red></>

Name: Denny
Text: If I knew you were this kind of person, I never would've asked for your help...

Name: Denny
Text: Get out of my sight, this instant!

Name: Denny
Text:
My love, this precious love,
Is reserved for him.

Name: Tristan
Text: Sigh, Master’s at it again...

Name: Tristan
Text: Look, I'm married. I have three kids.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I haven't even said anything yet...)</>

Name: Tristan
Text: Stop wandering around and go back to Master.

Name: Tristan
Text: …Who knows? Maybe Master will accept your love.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I guess my opinion doesn't matter here.)</>

Name: Ishinu
Text: Oh! It’s a success! A total success!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
I can’t return your feelings,
but this proves the brew works perfectly!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Ahem. Here! Drink this.
It’ll cool that heated head of yours.

I drank what Ishinu gave me, and the memories of my actions came flooding back.
Did I really just go on a confession spree?!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
I—I didn’t do it on purpose! Not at all!
I had no idea you’d get that... carried away!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
I just wanted to make some m-money with the new brew.
You're sober now, so we’re even, right? Right!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
I’ll tell my apprentices to keep their mouths shut... So we’re good, yeah?!
I'll—I'll see you next time! Next time!

Name: Ishinu
Text: Those humans... Do they even want to brew?

Name: Ishinu
Text:
I mean, the humans who came here begging to be my apprentices.
You and Beretta had to fix it.

Name: Ishinu
Text: I mean, that <Blue>candy</> or something…

Name: Ishinu
Text:
That’s right! They sneaked those treats behind my back.
And now? Now they say they’re leaving the brewery!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
The same ones who begged for me to take them in!
<Yellow>They promised to brew the finest, best spirits!</>

Name: Ishinu
Text:
What those three made was just bitter water.
They know nothing about real spirits! Nothing!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
If they tell people I taught them…
it will run my reputation!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
I won't let them leave.
Not until they make a proper drink.

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Bring my apprentices to me!
I’ll be waiting in my scariest, my fiercest pose!

Name: Ishinu
Text: You stubborn human apprentices!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
How dare you try to leave!
You are ungrateful! Very, very ungrateful!

Name: Tristan
Text: But... no matter how much we brew, we just don't get any better!

Name: Joris
Text:
Every batch we make tastes nothing like yours, Master.
It drove us mad!

Name: Denny
Text: I... I have no talent. I admit it now.

Name: Ishinu
Text: What do you expect to achieve with that attitude?!

Name: Ishinu
Text: You were better when you were dazed by those candies!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
<Red>Fine! I’m done with you lot! I’m done!</>
You want to go? Then go!

Name: Ishinu
Text: If you stay, you’ll just make another mess anyway.

Name: Apprentices
Text: R... really?

Name: Ishinu
Text: Make the best drink you can—all by yourselves.

Name: Tristan
Text: You mean... just the three of us?

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Yes. If it actually tastes good…
You can leave. I won't stop you!

Name: Joris
Text:
This is our chance!
If it's good, we can even sell it back home!

Name: Denny
Text: Right... We might be able to pull off two things at once...

Name: Tristan
Text: Then let’s start planning, quickly!

Name: Ishinu
Text: Well, at least they’re putting their heads together.

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Thanks for cleaning the garden.
Here, take this—take it!

Name: Tristan
Text:
We’ve decided to brew something... special.
A spirit that this brewery has never seen before!

Name: Tristan
Text: That is why we need an objective opinion from an outsider.

Name: Tristan
Text: So... would you mind helping us just a little?

Name: Tristan
Text: Before we create a masterpiece, we must start with the basics.

Name: Tristan
Text:
The bitter flavor of our brew comes from a crop called <Orange>Baba</>.
Those plants in the field right there.

Name: Tristan
Text:
Only the ones untouched by pests can be used in the liquor.
It’s all about quality control.

Name: Tristan
Text:
Curious about the process?
Then please, help us harvest the Baba first!

Name: Joris
Text: We need one more ingredient.

Name: Joris
Text:
It is used to mask the odor that comes during the Baba's fermentation.
Neutralized insect venom is perfect for the job.

Name: Joris
Text:
It was such a headache to learn that method.
Master would smack my back every single day with those tiny hands of his.

Name: Joris
Text: I could never forget it even if I tried!

Name: Joris
Text: Anyway, if you bring the ingredient to me, I’ll handle the preparation myself.

Name: Joris
Text: You’ve brought exactly what we needed. Thank you.

Name: Denny
Text: This is... it.

Name: Denny
Text:
We’ve used everything in the brewery...
We know we need something different, something unique, but…

Name: Denny
Text: Ah.. I don’t know what else to add.

Name: Denny
Text:
Those merchants... they have food from the outside world.
Please, find something that will make our brew taste good.

Name: Denny
Text:
But Master can’t know about it.
Don’t buy them all at once. Just... one at a time. Slowly.

Name: Denny
Text:
Picked up some ingredients from the general merchant.
Hopefully Ishinu didn't look this way...

Name: Tristan
Text: Perfect! Ingredients handpicked by an outsider.

Name: Joris
Text: This will be a flavor like no other. A true original!

Name: Denny
Text: I’m shaking... Will this really work?

The three apprentices added the final ingredient and finished the brew.
What will this drink taste like...?

Name: Ishinu
Text:
You’re not going anywhere!
Is this it? Is this the best you can do?

Name: Tristan
Text: But... we used only the finest things!

Name: Ishinu
Text: This drink tastes like greed, not joy.

Name: Ishinu
Text: The customers! The customers! Did you even care if they’d like it?

Name: Denny
Text: Gasp...

Name: Joris
Text: If it tastes good, they’ll like it... won't they?

Name: Ishinu
Text:
No, no!
Why do they drink? What do they think when they drinkl?

Name: Ishinu
Text: You have to imagine those things while brewing!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
You’re still amateurs.
<Yellow>So you stay! Stay as my apprentices!</>

Name: Ishinu
Text: And you, Adventurer!

Name: Ishinu
Text: I saw you helping them behind my back.

Name: Ishinu
Text: You filled their heads with dreams, so take responsibility! Yes, you must!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
If I had scolded them sooner,
they'd be working on my orders by now!

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Because you helped them waste time...
my workers—my workers were just playing around!

Name: Ishinu
Text: So you have to pay for that loss!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Narurus seem to be quite strict when it comes to profit and loss...)</>

Name: Ishinu
Text: Understand? Then buy <Yellow>the most expensive—the priciest brew</> in our brewery!

Name: Ishinu
Text: Be grateful I’m letting you off this easy.
I spent all my coin on a top-shelf liquor...

Name: Ishinu
Text: Hmm! You bought the right one.

Name: Ishinu
Text:
It’s full of good things.
Drink only a little at a time. It’ll help you recover.

Name: Ishinu
Text:
Now, I must go teach these apprentices what real spirits taste like.
Safe travels, human!

Name: Fleur
Text: Step right up! <Blue>Gliders</> are on sale now!

Name: Fleur
Text:
If you miss this chance, you’ll have to wait until the next shipment.
Get them while they're in stock!

Name: Fleur
Text:
Customer? Hello?
If you’re not buying, please move along.

Name: Fleur
Text: Ah, so you haven't heard of <Blue>Flower-Flight</>! Everyone’s talking about it around here.

Name: Fleur
Text: You fly high above the tall flowers and collect those beautiful glowing clusters.

Name: Fleur
Text:
You have to ride the trend to make big gold!
That’s exactly why I’m selling these.

Name: Fleur
Text: ...Now, I just need to sell them all, and fast.

Name: Fleur
Text: I've stocked up on so many of these mounts, but I haven't even paid for them yet.

Name: Fleur
Text:
I need to sell anything—even the small ones—to get that money...
If you’re not too busy, lend me a hand.

Name: Fleur
Text: I’ll make it worth your while, of course.

Name: Fleur
Text: I just need to choose the good parts and sell them as base materials.

Name: Fleur
Text:
You brought so many! I think I can raise the money now.
Phew, what a relief.

Name: Fleur
Text: Now, it’s time to focus on the Glider business!

Name: Fleur
Text:
I’m going to promote 'Flower-Flight' to visitors myself.
I’m just trying to figure out which part I should emphasize to really sell it.

Name: Fleur
Text: Why don’t you try it out and tell me what you think?

Name: Fleur
Text: You’re quite something!

Name: Fleur
Text: I caught a glimpse—your movements were so clean!

Name: Fleur
Text:
The route seems fine, so the business potential is there...
Which part should I highlight?

Name: Fleur
Text: Hmm... a great catchphrase!

Name: Fleur
Text: <Yellow>"Lead the latest trend" or "If you want a thrilling sense of freedom"…</>

Name: Fleur
Text: Alright, let’s leave it at that and move on.

Name: Fleur
Text: I think Flower-Flight has its limits as it is now.

Name: Fleur
Text:
Everyone loves a bit of excitement, right?
We need to develop a new, more stimulating route!

Name: Fleur
Text:
More people will try it,
and I'll sell heaps of mounts!

Name: Fleur
Text:
I actually have a place in mind.
Shall we go?

Name: [player]
Text: Just as she said, the height is perfect for Flower Flight.

Name: Fleur
Text: You look like you're disappointed it ended so soon.

Name: Fleur
Text: It’ll be even more exciting for visitors, don’t you think?

Name: Fleur
Text: Some might not make it to the end, or stumble mid-air.

Name: Fleur
Text: As they keep flying, the device may break some day.

Name: Fleur
Text: Once they start thinking about getting a new one, they’ll be back at my door.

Name: Fleur
Text: But don’t worry! I’m no rogue selling faulty trinkets.

Name: Fleur
Text: Here, you’ve been a great help. Take this as a token of my thanks.

Name: Fleur
Text: Come find me again once the new route is ready!

Name: Atessa
Text: You there. You have a nose for gold... A mercenary, I take it?

Name: Atessa
Text:
I'm Atessa.
An information broker who’ll do anything for the right price.

Name: Atessa
Text:
I’ll pay you well,
so go fetch me some monster byproducts.

Name: Atessa
Text: Those Hunters Guild bastards requested something so tedious.

Name: Atessa
Text:
Bring me some hides and teeth.
You can find them in the Woodland of Elder Gods.

Name: Atessa
Text:
Ah! Almost forgot the most important part.
Try not to ruin the goods. I need them in top shape.

Name: Atessa
Text: Not bad at all.

Name: Atessa
Text:
I need these for garments, so they must be scathe-free.
I’ll be able to fetch a high price for these.

Name: Atessa
Text: Let’s do one more job!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She doesn’t seem to take "no" for an answer.)</>

Name: Atessa
Text:
The pay was good, wasn't it?
This next job will be even better.

Name: Atessa
Text:
…I can't give you the client’s name,
but I need a robe from the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Atessa
Text:
How should I know?
I just get paid. Why ask questions?

Name: Atessa
Text:
Now, quit idling and get moving.
You’ll find the cultists over by Nameless Heights.

Name: Atessa
Text:
What? A note with my name on it?
Let me see that.
ItemDesc:
…There is no such thing as paradise, nowhere in this world.
So please, never follow strangers,
and never eat anything just because it looks interesting...

I still remember the first time I held you in my arms, Atessa.

If I could only return to that moment,
I... I would never have brought you to the Forsaken Land.
Even if my hands had been frozen and my body had been weighted down by hunger,
I would have stayed by your side in a small tent by the oasis...

Text: Artessa reads the note. Tears fall as she whispers, "Mother..."

Name: Atessa
Text:
I was separated from my mother as soon as we reached the Forsaken Land.
She just... vanished one day.

Name: Atessa
Text: I became an information broker just to find her.

Name: Atessa
Text:
All these years, and not a trace...
To think she’s joined the Paradise Advent.

Name: Atessa
Text:
Anyway, thank you.
...At last, I can say my final goodbye.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The peaceful Giant's Garden... The quiet Aburu Village...)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Something feels off.
Wherever the Naruru Tribe live is usually bright and lively.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Surely baby Narurus should be roaming around this small hill too—)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Huh? I think I see someone's head.)</>

Name: Hidden Naruru
Text: You! Why are you looking this way?!

Name: Azid
Text:
Gah, aack! Enju's gonna catch me at this rate!
Come here, hurry up!

Name: Azid
Text:
Stand right here next to me and hide!
I'm in the middle of some really, really important training right now.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Will hiding like this even work? Anyone could probably see us...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He says he's training, so let's just play along for now.)</>

Name: Azid
Text:
Shh, hold your breath.
You really, really can't make a sound.

Name: Azid
Text: Enju is looking for me.

Name: Azid
Text: In human words, it's that... that... that thing!

Name: Azid
Text:
Stealth? Anyway, that's what I'm training for.
A cool <Orange>“Hero”</> needs to know how to do this, too.

Name: Azid
Text:
You're an Honorary Member too, right?
Then you have to do as I say.

Name: Azid
Text:
Of course! Since I became a Bristly, Bristly-Hair first.
You have to watch me and learn.

Name: Azid
Text:
Ah, why am I chattering?
Don't talk to me! I told you we have to be quiet!

Name: Enju
Text: Hehe... Found you, Azid!

Name: Azid
Text: Ack! I got caught because of you!

Name: Enju
Text: What's the point of hiding? I can hear you two whispering loud and clear.

Name: Azid
Text:
It's because of this human!
I was staying really, really still...

Name: Azid
Text: Anyway! Just like when Jiranna comes looking for me, everyone keeps getting in my way.

Name: Enju
Text: But we're in the middle of training... is it okay for a human to know?

Name: Azid
Text:
What if... what if they go to Captain Lamassu and tell him?
We'll get in big trouble for not doing our mission!

Name: Azid
Text:
Tch, it can't be helped.
Human! You should join the <Yellow>“Softbean Adventurer Squad”</> too!

Name: Azid
Text:
You found out our secret... our big secret.
Do you think we'll just let you go and blab about it somewhere else?

Name: Azid
Text: You... become a <Yellow>companion of the Hero</>!

Name: Enju
Text:
The <Orange>Softbean Adventurer Squad</> is me, Azid, and Sagkala.
Three Naruru!

Name: Enju
Text: We formed an incredible adventure group made to meet God Ea in person!

Name: Enju
Text:
And, and!
Azid wants to become a hero and be chosen by Ea!

Name: Azid
Text: Ahem, I'm going to be that legendary hero.

Name: Azid
Text:
Once upon a time, there was a brave Bristly-Hair.
They say Ea gave him the power to protect the Naruru Tribe.

Name: Azid
Text:
They said that Bristly-Hair always showed <Yellow>courage, wisdom, and perseverance</>.
So I'm going to take a test, a test too.

Name: Azid
Text: You understand me, right? Then follow me, human.

Name: Azid
Text:
With you watching me right by my side,
I'll pass the hero's test, too!

Name: Azid
Text:
The first test will be in the rocky field the humans abandoned.
Softbean! Charge!

Name: Azid
Text: I will glide, glide and show God Ea my courage.

Name: Azid
Text:
You've never heard of it either, have you?
About a gliding Naruru.

Name: Azid
Text:
But if I do something no Naruru has ever done before!
That's exactly what courage is.

Name: Enju
Text: Narurus can fly too! We can fly!

Name: Azid
Text:
You try it first.
The youngest member should always go first.

Name: Enju
Text: The youngest Bristly, Bristly-Hair has to go see if it's dangerous!

Name: Azid
Text:
Over there—up there!
If you're a Bristly-Hair, you should be able to manage that much!

Name: Azid
Text:
Don't... don't even think about running away.
I'll follow you to make sure you do it properly.

Name: Enju
Text: I'll wait, wait for you where you land!
Azid started climbing to a high place with the adventurer.

Name: Azid
Text:
Hmph, there probably isn't a Naruru who has climbed higher than me, right?!
I can do this much because I'm the best Bristly-Hair.

Name: Azid
Text: Why are you just standing there? You need to keep climbing.

Name: Azid
Text: Because humans are taller and lankier than Narurus!

Name: Azid
Text:
So of course you shouldn't fly from the same spot.
You have to go up higher and show me how it's done.

Name: Azid
Text:
It's super easy for a human here anyway.
Ah, stop dawdling and hurry up!

Name: Azid
Text: I've decided to glide from here! Ahem.

Name: Azid
Text:
It felt a bit shaky back there earlier.
And there seemed to be a lot of obstacles.

Name: Azid
Text: Basically, it wasn't a good spot for flying super coolly!

Name: Azid
Text:
O-Of course I took that into consideration too!
I already talked it over with Enju and decided.

Name: Azid
Text: Whaat? Why are you looking at me like that...

Name: Azid
Text:
Go do some combat training over there while I take my test!
And don't look over here. Got it?!

Name: Enju
Text: While Azid is thinking, thinking really hard, there's something we have to do!

Name: Enju
Text:
Look... he's a hero candidate, but...
Doesn't his belly look a little chubby, chubby?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Now that Enju mentions it, his belly does stick out a bit...)</>

Name: Enju
Text:
Human-made Gliders aren't meant for the Naruru Tribe, so...
It won't be able to handle Azid's weight...

Name: Enju
Text:
He's definitely going to fall halfway!
What if our hero candidate gets really, really hurt?!

Name: Enju
Text:
Let's make it sturdier, sturdier and give it to him.
If we move quickly, we can give it to him before he starts.

Name: Enju
Text:
Yeah! Let’s do as you say.
I'll go gather what you told me, too.

Name: Enju
Text:
Done, it's done!
This ought to hold even Azid's belly fat, right?

Name: Enju
Text:
That's a relief! Azid hasn't left yet.
I guess he needs to steel his resolve a little more.

Name: Enju
Text: He'll be embarrassed... so don't say anything and just give it to him.

Name: Azid
Text:
W-What is this.
When did I ask you to bring me something like this?!

Name: Azid
Text: There's no way a Naruru could be heavier than a human, a human!

Name: Azid
Text:
I'm going to take the hero's test, so I was saving up stamina in advance!
My b-belly isn't sticking out.

Name: Azid
Text:
I'll use it, then... Hmph.
A great hero accepts the sincerity of his companions, after all.

Name: Azid
Text: Go! I'm going to take the test now.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Looks like he's about to depart now, right?)</>

Name: Azid
Text: H-Here I gooo!!!

Azid unfurled his new Glider and soared magnificently into the sky.
It seemed to be cruising well despite his belly-heavy physique, but...
He eventually lost speed and was forced to perform a breakfall.

Name: Azid
Text:
Heh... Hehe!!!
Pretty impressive, wasn't it?!

Name: Azid
Text:
Actually, I didn't even need your demonstration.
Because I nailed my first flight!

Name: Azid
Text:
Ea will compliment me, right?!
I need to go talk to Enju right away!

Name: Azid
Text: Did you see, did you see?! I passed the test of courage!

Name: Azid
Text:
Even though I rolled a little at the end!
Anyway, I did fly here, didn't I?

Name: Enju
Text:
Maybe something has changed.
Don't you think Ea might have bestowed a blessing upon me?

Name: Enju
Text: Like, overflowing with more power than before... like, getting faster and stuff!

Name: Enju
Text:
<Yellow>If Ea acknowledges you,
they say the Hero’s Spirit, Spirit awakens.</>

Name: Azid
Text:
I don't know yet.
I took the test properly, but...

Name: Enju
Text: What if Ea doesn't consider this <Yellow>“courage?”</>

Name: Azid
Text:
Then I just have to show my courage again.
A hero candidate doesn't give up in a place like this!

Name: Azid
Text: We're going to defeat a guy who is super sturdy and never gets hurt.

Name: Enju
Text: Good idea. That’s a good idea.

Name: Enju
Text: Follow the low hill you see back there and just walk a little, a little bit.

Name: Enju
Text:
Then the terrifying opponent you mentioned will appear!
I scoped it all out earlier.

Name: Azid
Text:
<Yellow>Honorary Bristly-Hair</>, you come along too.
Keep watch over the surroundings while I take my test!

Name: Azid
Text:
Phew, I guess I picked an opponent too strong for someone who isn't even a hero yet...
What if Ea thinks I'm reckless?

Name: Azid
Text: But I can't think of anything else.

Name: Azid
Text: Fine, a hero needs to listen to his companions carefully.

Name: Enju
Text:
Here, look here.
The humans are hurt!

Name: Azid
Text:
A-Are you guys okay? Are you all right?
Does it hurt badly…? You can't even move...

Name: Azid
Text: What can we do? Just say the word, and we'll help.

Name: Biran
Text: ...Ah, it hurts... It hurts so much...

Name: Irandot
Text: Water... I'm thirsty... Ugh...

Name: Azid
Text: What do... what do humans do when they're hurt?

Name: Azid
Text:
Y-You're a human too, so tell me.
Something the Softbean Adventurer Squad can do right now!

Name: Enju
Text:
There are more humans in the Cactus Nest!
We'll go there and try to get some medicine, medicine.

Name: Monas
Text: Oh! Look who it is.

Name: Monas
Text:
It's been a while, adventurer.
Do you have business around here?

Name: Monas
Text:
I always carry that much on me!
I owe you one, so I'll give it to you free of charge.
ItemName: Medicinal liquor that looks like a disinfectant
ItemDesc:
Medicine received from Monas of the Bardad Expedition.
It seems to be in a liquor bottle... but they say this kind of thing is effective.
Pour enough of it over a wound, and it looks like just about every germ will be washed away.

Name: Monas
Text: By the way... who got hurt?

Name: Monas
Text:
Oh my, you seem to be in quite a hurry.
If you ever need our help, just let us know!

Name: Azid
Text: Phew... At least we've gotten both of them some water...

Name: Azid
Text:
This is the medicine, right? I know how to use this.
I saw it clearly in the human village.

Name: Enju
Text: Human village? Where?

Name: Azid
Text: The place Jiranna, Jiranna had taken me.

Name: Azid
Text:
They went around fighting a lot like Bristly-Hairs there!
There were a lot of humans coming back hurt too.

Name: Enju
Text:
I remember too! I remember now.
I was at the Taima Oasis back then, right?

Name: Biran
Text: Ugh... Someone please...

Name: Azid
Text:
S-So, I'll take care of things here!
You two go see if there's anyone else who's hurt.

Name: Enju
Text: I found something strange... look at this, this.

Name: Enju
Text:
Do humans bleed red blood too, by any chance?
Naruru blood doesn't smell like this!

Name: Enju
Text: If it's not a Naruru, a human, a human must have shed it.

Name: Enju
Text:
I'm going to sniff every nook and cranny.
You stop those bad, bad guys from getting in my way!

Name: Enju
Text:
There was a tiny path here!
And I can smell that blood again here!

Name: Enju
Text: Yeah, yeah! Let's go in quickly!

Name: Enju
Text:
Are they all hurt?
They're lying down, so they must be, right...?

Name: Enju
Text:
They'll only get worse if we leave them here!
We have to take them to the village, village so they can get some good rest.

Name: Enju
Text:
I'm going to go tell Captain Lamassu right now!
Then the other Bristly-Hairs will come to help.

Name: Enju
Text:
You can use that medicine from earlier too, right?
Keep these humans safe while I'm gone!

Name: Azid
Text: Enju... gasp... told me to come this way, so here I am!

Name: Azid
Text:
I ran as fast as I could like a true hero!
There really are a ton of hurt humans.

Name: Azid
Text:
You know that thing...
Boom! It explodes and goes around hitting anyone.

Name: Azid
Text: I... I-Incur? You mean the <Red>Incursion</>!

Name: Azid
Text:
They said the humans outside ran away because of that. 
They must have all come here because they were scared.

Name: Azid
Text:
But the <Orange>Softbean Adventurer Squad</> will help, help them!
We're going to defeat those smelly monsters coming over there!

Name: Azid
Text: Excellent! We defeated the villain! We beat the bad guy!

Name: Azid
Text:
You... aren't half bad for a late-bloomer Softbean!
I can trust you to watch my back!

Name: Azid
Text: I gave you a compliment, so now you owe me a favor.

Name: Azid
Text:
You need to cover for us when we report to <Orange>Captain Lamassu</>.
You know what I mean, right?

Name: Azid
Text:
Since Enju went to get the other Bristly-Hairs...
We have to explain how we ended up finding the humans!

Name: Azid
Text:
You can't tell them I came all the way out here for the trial.
You have to keep it an absolute secret.

Name: Azid
Text:
W-We can already smell the Naruru!
Just stay quiet until they ask...

Name: Lamasu
Text:
Azid, you.
Where did you go instead of patrolling?!

Name: Azid
Text: I just went a little further, further. That's all...

Name: Lamasu
Text: You'd better tell the truth. A Bristly-Hair does not lie.

Name: Azid
Text:
I-I'm telling the truth!
I was just... doing some training on the way.

Name: Lamasu
Text: Training? Trai-ning?

Name: Enju
Text: Glide training! A flying Naruru!

Name: Azid
Text: Hey, hey! Enju!

Name: Enju
Text: Gasp...

Name: Lamasu
Text:
Again? Really?!
You were out playing hero, weren't you?

Name: Lamasu
Text: It's a suuuper old tale, so no one even believes it, you know? That one?

Name: Azid
Text:
If I say it's true, it's true.
Not even the captain can tell me otherwise!

Name: Lamasu
Text: A Bristly-Hair should prioritize their mission!

Name: Enju
Text: <Red>You two are fighting! That's what God Ea hates the most!</>

Name: Lamasu
Text: I'm letting you off the hook because the honorary human member spoke up for you, Azid.

Name: Lamasu
Text:
Just this once.
If you do it again, I'll tell Etura everything!

Name: Azid
Text: ...Hmph!

Name: Lamasu
Text:
Go back to your where you were.
But this time, focus on the mission, no training.

Name: Lamasu
Text:
You didn't follow the patrol route!
The Bristly-Hair who was supposed to go there went somewhere else.

Name: Lamasu
Text: Go patrol properly, or else...

Name: Azid
Text: I'm going, I'm going! I said I'm going.

Name: Irandot
Text:
Y-You're the one who saved us...
Thank you so much!

Name: Biran
Text:
When I came to my senses, I was already in Aburu Village.
All my injuries were fully treated, too...

Name: Biran
Text:
That's right!
The folks from Cactus Nest used some good medicine on us as well.

Name: Irandot
Text:
*sigh...* We were caught in the Incursion that broke out in the Barrens...
We lost our families, friends, and our homes.

Name: Irandot
Text:
We wandered aimlessly until we drifted into the Giant's Garden...
We were staying in the Forsaken Mine temporarily.

Name: Irandot
Text:
I thought we were finally going to die because of the Incursion.
I never imagined the Naruru would save us.

Name: Biran
Text: If the patrol squad here hadn't come to rescue us... Phew!

Name: Biran
Text: Since we survived, we're going to try and start a new life.

Name: Biran
Text:
We plan to return to the Barrens with the Bardad Expedition.
We'll be able to earn our keep no matter what work we do!

Name: Biran
Text: Ah, and I remember you were with those folks... right?

Name: Biran
Text: Please tell them I'll never forget this for the rest of my life, and that I'm incredibly grateful.

Name: Biran
Text: I was amazed by their unhesitating courage to save people of another race!

Name: Irandot
Text:
I was going to tell them myself, but it looks like they're having a serious conversation...
I felt a bit awkward interrupting.

Name: Irandot
Text: I'm counting on you, adventurer.

Name: Azid
Text:
Did you see Captain Lamassu's eyes? His eyes? He totally doesn't believe us...
We need to stall him a little longer..

Name: Enju
Text: If we don't start the next mission right away, they'll come after us!

Name: Azid
Text: Tsk... Then we have to go to the Rappie Ranch.

Name: Azid
Text:
Hey, rookie. Where have you been?
You should be following right behind this hero.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(As you pass along Biran and Irandot's compliments,
Azid's lips twitch into a smirk.)</>

Name: Azid
Text:
I told you, there's no Naruru as great as me.
Stuff like that is just like the Trial of Courage!

Name: Azid
Text: Uwoooah! I can do anything!

Name: Enju
Text:
Both the Bristly-Hair missions and the Hero's Trials!
Both! I can do both!

Name: Azid
Text: <Yellow>Let's goooo! Softbean Adventurer Squad!!!</>

Name: Azid
Text: It's so very peaceful, probably because this hero has arrived!

Name: Enju
Text: The Kuduru Tribe is quiet too! The Incursion is quiet too!

Name: Azid
Text:
But as the Softbean Adventurer Squad,
we must sense even unseen dangers.

Name: Azid
Text:
We'll be working on our Bristly-Hair mission,
So you, our youngest Softbean, go find <Orange>“Sagkala.”</>

Name: Enju
Text: He's also part of the Softbean Adventurer Squad! He knows a lot, he's smart!

Name: Enju
Text:
Sagkala is friends with Zamamark,
so you just have to ask Zamamark!

Name: Zamamark
Text: Judging by the noise, they'll be swarming down to the ranch soon.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
If this happens, we'll have to send all the ranch guests away. Away again!
Do you know how much money that is?!

Name: Zamamark
Text: Why is there such a prime spot for a turf war near the ranch? Phew...

Name: Zamamark
Text: Yeah! That's what you guys always say.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
Since God Ea must have given everything a purpose,
we can't really tell you not to do it, but...

Name: Zamamark
Text:
Every time humans fight each other, it gets incredibly noisy!
You go around smashing and hitting things, right?

Name: Zamamark
Text: The bad guys living nearby end up coming down this way.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
The Rappies run away, and the guests who came to see them get startled.
And our business gets ruined!

Name: Zamamark
Text: <Orange>Sagkala</> said he'd try to do something about it, but...

Name: Zamamark
Text:
There's a huge valley above the place where they fight for turf.
He said he was going to block the guys coming down from there.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
He loves Rappies an unbelievable amount.
He promised he'd definitely protect them.

Name: Zamamark
Text: If you want to talk to Sagkala, head up to the valley. The valley!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It should be around here... Where could Sagkala be?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Naruru are shorter than humans, so he wouldn't be up somewhere high, right?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Unless he's an eccentric Naruru like Azid...)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Ah... he is in the same Softbean Adventurer Squad.</>
<Yellow>That Naruru must definitely be Sagkala.)</>

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Don't interfere, human.
If you plan on fighting here too, I'll cut you down in a single-

Name: Sagkala
Text: Sniff... Sniff, sniff...!

Name: Sagkala
Text: Why do you smell like a Naruru? Like a Naruru?

Name: Sagkala
Text:
This is Zamamark, and this is Azid.
You even have Enju's scent on you.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Did Azid find some weakness of yours?
Our adventure party is not an easy or pushover group.

Name: Sagkala
Text: Do you know what kind of mindset you need to be chosen by God Ea—

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Oops! I almost forgot something important.
Go and tell Azid.

Name: Sagkala
Text: That I won't do any Softbean stuff until the Rappie Ranch is safe.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
I made a promise to Zamamark too,
and I also really, really love Rappies.

Name: Sagkala
Text: I can't just stand and do nothing while the kids get hurt!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Good, that's a proper Softbean attitude!
Then... we'll start by clearing this place out completely!

Name: Sagkala
Text: I've thinned their numbers, but it's not enough to stop them from rushing out.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
We have to teach them that they shouldn't leave this area!
I should try using the <Yellow>“Sluggish Powder.”</>

Name: Sagkala
Text: This is something I made after giving it a lot of thought.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Once the powder gets into their nose, their arms, legs,
eyes, and even nose won't move properly.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
They won’t return to normal until the next day.
How about it? Sounds terrifying just hearing about it, right?

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Go and sprinkle it thoroughly on the path leading out of here.
Be careful not to accidentally inhale it yourself.

Name: Sagkala
Text: I feel a bit relieved now.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
They won't lose their minds and charge into the ranch for a while!
I should share some with Zamamark too.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
I'll be sprinkling powder in other places too,
so bring Azid and Enju here.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
I need to hear what kind of trouble…
they got themselves into to get here so late.

Name: Azid
Text: Where's Sagkala? Why did you come back alone?!

Name: Azid
Text:
Don't tell me you failed to finish what I asked you to do.
As a Softbean, you should be able to handle that much.

Name: Enju
Text: If we follow you, will we see Sagkala? Actually get to see him?

Name: Azid
Text:
Bossing people around is exactly his style.
Seems like you're not lying.

Name: Azid
Text: Excellent! Lead the way, human.

Name: Azid
Text: It's Sagkala! Sagkala!

Name: Enju
Text:
Finally, the <Orange>Softbean Adventurer Squad</> are all gathered!
We are now one! One!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Azid, youuu.
You slacker! You skipped your Bristly-Hair patrol again, didn't you?

Name: Sagkala
Text: Enju! How could you join him when you're a Bristly-Hair too?

Name: Sagkala
Text:
God Ea would also hate a hero who neglects their duties.
You two are as thick-headed as the Kuduru Tribe.

Name: Azid
Text: That’s pretty harsh when we haven't seen each other in so long!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
He's right!
You guys have definitely lost the Softbean mindset.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
<Yellow>“Oath Beneath the Ash Tree.”</>
Let's go do that again.

Name: Enju
Text: The one we did when we were little? Back in Aburu Village?

Name: Sagkala
Text: At this rate, both the hero and their companions will incur God Ea's wrath.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
We have to pray before taking the trials properly.
Otherwise, we'll be punished!

Name: Azid
Text: ...Th-Then, even before becoming a hero—

Name: Enju
Text:
God Ea will abandon us forever.
Th-Then we won't be Naruru anymore...

Name: Azid
Text: W-What should we do? Tell us, Sagkala!

Name: Azid
Text: Then, then... we just have to make our oath again, right?

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Do our Bristly-Hair missions properly again,
and promise not to be greedy just for the hero's trials.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
We need to set our minds straight.
Only then can we be called true heroes.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
There is a decent tree here,
but the foul energy here is overwhelming.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Even if we perform the oath ritual again,
