God Ea probably won't accept it.

Name: Azid
Text: Leave it to me and the youngest Softbean! We'll sweep it all away!

Name: Azid
Text:
Sagkala, Enju.
Make this place look pretty, just like before!

Name: Enju
Text:
Me, Azid, and Sagkala.
The three of us made a promise when we were little Naruru.

Name: Enju
Text: Back then, we gathered under the Ash tree growing in Aburu Village!

Name: Enju
Text:
Now that tree has grown very, very old,
and has returned to the embrace of God Ea.

Name: Enju
Text: So, like Sagkala said, I think this place will do.

Name: Enju
Text: We're going to place a Naruru statue nearby.

Name: Enju
Text:
<Yellow>"God Ea, please look over here!"</>it means.
I'll give you one, so just place it over there.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
The smell has subsided a lot.
Let's begin the oath ritual now.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
The Honeygrass tree is also a child with pure energy.
It'll help unite our hearts into one.

Name: Azid
Text: Got it! Let's hurry up and get under the tree!

Name: Azid
Text:
Did our hearts, our hearts reach him?
I hope God Ea likes it.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
The ritual wasn't performed properly.
He probably didn't even glance this way.

Name: Enju
Text:
Why? Why?!
We even placed the statue properly!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
But the foul energy keeps rising.
Just getting rid of the smell isn't enough.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(As you suggest the monsters may be the cause, Sagkala nods.)</>

Name: Sagkala
Text:
You're right.
This isn't the kind of energy that trees, grass, or the earth have.

Name: Azid
Text: Hehe... Looks like it's time for this Bristly-Hair Hero to step in again!

Name: Azid
Text:
This time, I'll truly show off my skills.
I will defeat them all!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
No, this won't do.
The musty smell still hasn't faded.

Name: Sagkala
Text: Even if we perform the oath ritual here again, God Ea will be displeased.

Name: Enju
Text: Then? Then, what about the Honeygrass tree?

Name: Sagkala
Text:
We just have to find a tree holding purer energy.
The type of tree isn't what's important.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
This Ash tree already seems to be struggling…
…to drive away the bad smell anyway.

Name: Azid
Text: Where is the bad smell coming from?

Name: Sagkala
Text: It’s not this place.

Name: Sagkala
Text: It coming from over there! It's coming from deep within the valley.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Azid! Go and ask <Orange>Sharaf</>.
Enju and I will look around the valley.

Name: Sagkala
Text: Human Softbean, keep an eye on Azid so he doesn't wander off.

Name: Azid
Text: I told you I won't do that anymore!

Name: Sharaf
Text:
What is it, troublemaker Azid?
And you brought a human adventurer with you.

Name: Azid
Text:
Sharaf, Sharaf!
You patrol the valley up above, right, Sharaf?

Name: Azid
Text: Sagkala says there's a foul smell coming from deep within.

Name: Sharaf
Text: ...What kind of trouble are you planning to cause by asking that?

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Azid, I really can't trust you.
If you're playing a prank—

Name: Sharaf
Text:
What are you meddling in this time... Whatever.
I'll say this once, so don't forget it.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
There is an ancient cradle tree there.
It has served the role of keeping the valley clean.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
However, something has affected it recently...
It's drying up and withering away.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
I tried to find out the reason,
but dealing with the Incursion and the Kuduru Tribe is more urgent.

Name: Azid
Text:
So, because the cradle tree is sick...
And that's why the whole valley has gone wrong?

Name: Azid
Text:
That's a difficult job for a Bristly-Hair to handle.
This is a job for the Softbean Adventurer Squad!

Name: Sharaf
Text: Adventurer, please guide Azid well.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Also... I've seen humans in long robes coming and going.
Just thought you should know.

Name: Enju
Text: Azid and the youngest Softbean are back! We're back!

Name: Sagkala
Text: What did Sharaf say?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You relay the story you heard from Sharaf.)</>

Name: Sagkala
Text: We were right!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Because of the bad smell,
God Ea didn't accept the ritual.

Name: Azid
Text:
Then let's restore the valley.
We'll clean it up until it smells good again!

Name: Sagkala
Text: We have to find out why the cradle tree is sick first.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Even if we clean everything up, if the tree stays sick... 
It'll just get dirty again.

Name: Enju
Text: That stone—that rock—looked weird to me from the start!

Name: Enju
Text:
It's neither red nor yellow.
The more I look at it, the weirder I feel.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Hmm... Enju's hunches are right once in a while.
Let's try it your way.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
It's true that the stone gives off a musty smell.
But, I don't think this is enough to make the tree sick...

Name: Sagkala
Text: Sniff, sniff, sniff... My nose tickles!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
The Naruru have a better sense of smell than humans.
Ugh... My nose keeps twitching, it's so annoying! It's annoying!

Name: Sagkala
Text: A-Achoo!!!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Ah... This really won't do.
I'll go get some medicine, so wait here.

Name: Enju
Text:
There are a lot of stones here too.
I reach out, and reach out, but it's no use!

Name: Enju
Text:
Even if I try to sniff them, they're just barely out of range...
I'd like you to take a look!

Name: Azid
Text:
We'll be looking elsewhere,
so if anything looks suspicious, come tell us right away.

Name: Azid
Text:
You came back in one piece.
The truth is, that rock can't do anything! Right?!

Name: Azid
Text:
It can't even move and just stays there,
so it only gives off a smell.

Name: Enju
Text:
No, that shouldn't be it.
When I get a feeling like this, I'm usually right...

Name: Azid
Text: You're saying this really is a bad stone, and that's why the valley is like this?

Name: Azid
Text:
Then it should have been stuck in the cradle tree,
or else it should have been in the water!

Name: Azid
Text:
Look! It's right there next to the waterfall.
A red stone, a yellow stone—

Name: Azid
Text: Huh?!

Name: Enju
Text: It's real! It really is!

Name: Enju
Text:
That's a discovery worthy of a hero!
Could this be the clever Trial of Wisdom?

Name: Azid
Text:
I think you're right, Enju.
Since the Trial of Wisdom comes right after the Trial of Courage!

Name: Azid
Text: Ahem, ahem! Ah, Sagkala did tell us to take this seriously.

Name: Azid
Text:
A-anyway! We can't overlook anything, even if it's just a little strange.
We never know when Ea might be watching us.

Name: Azid
Text:
Human, leave the water to us Naruru.
You just need to keep everyone else away.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
I see you didn't cause any trouble while I was gone.
I ran all the way here because I was worried. I'm so exhausted!

Name: Azid
Text:
Enju and I made a massive discovery! Mwahaha!
We were so busy we didn't even realize you were gone.

Name: Sagkala
Text: A massive discovery? What did you guys find?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Azid and Enju excitedly explained the ore next to the waterfall.)</>

Name: Sagkala
Text: So... you're saying that's the Trial of Wisdom?

Name: Azid
Text:
Ending up in this valley was all God Ea's will, too.
He's guiding us.

Name: Enju
Text: Azid is gonna be a hero, hero!

Name: Sagkala
Text: Human, do you think this is the Trial of Wisdom too?

Name: Sagkala
Text:
All right, if the three of you agree, I'm on board.
We promised to do everything together, remember?

Name: Sagkala
Text: Yeah, because we're the Softbean Adventure Squad!

Name: Azid
Text:
Sagkala! I-I'm so touched!
You really are the smartest Softbean ever!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
D-don't flatter me!
We shouldn't keep Ea waiting any longer.

Name: Sagkala
Text: Let's come up with a plan based on your discovery.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
First, let's assume those rocks are affecting the waterfall.
And all the creatures living in the valley drink this water.

Name: Enju
Text: If they drink tainted water! Their tummies will ache, and their heads will throb!

Name: Sagkala
Text: Ultimately, we have to purify the waterfall.

Name: Azid
Text:
The Cradle Tree Sharaf mentioned drinks this water too.
So if it's been withering, it all makes sense!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
We have some preparations to make.
You guys keep guard so nobody else approaches the waterfall.

Name: Sagkala
Text: That's right! Make sure to take your medicine so your noses don't sting.

Name: Azid
Text: Leave it to us!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Phew, all done.
This is “Fluffy Powder.”

Name: Sagkala
Text: You sprinkle it on tainted water. We use it a lot in Aburu Village, too.

Name: Sagkala
Text: Once the water is purified, the foul energy handing over the valley should fade.

Name: Azid
Text: We can perform the ritual here again!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(To think the water’s polluted enough to need purification...</>
<Yellow>The Naruru are sensitive to water, so they must be right.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The Paradise Advent Society is suspicious, but they've gone into hiding.</>
<Yellow>I shouldn't make them anxious by bringing it up unnecessarily.)</>

Name: Enju
Text:
We'll take the trial, and make our oath.
I think God Ea will smile upon us!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
I'll dissolve the Fluffy Powder into the water.
You guys go ahead with the oath ritual.

One by one, everyone closed their eyes,
and solemnly vowed in the name of God Ea to face the trial in earnest.
Just then, a gentle breeze blew past, tickling their noses.

The waterfall looked the same on the surface,
but the gloomy energy lingering in the valley had dissipated.

Name: Enju
Text:
Azid! Azid!
Do you feel anything this time?

Name: Enju
Text:
We just tackled the Trial of Courage however we wanted, but!
This time, we had Sagkala with us!

Name: Azid
Text:
...Nooope.
I guess this wasn't it, either.

Name: Azid
Text: Maybe Ea expects something even greater?

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Don't get disappointed just yet.
We might need to finish all the trials first.

Name: Azid
Text:
Yeah, we can't let this get us down.
I even put up with the awful stench of this place.

Name: Azid
Text: There's nothing I can't handle! Mwahaha!

Name: Sagkala
Text: Really? Do you think you can endure something even worse than this?

Name: Azid
Text: My nose is known as the absolute toughest among all the Naruru!

Name: Sagkala
Text: Then come with me to the Sunset Brewery.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
If you don't pass out there...
Ea might just acknowledge your perseverance.

Name: Enju
Text: I'm coming! I wanna go, too!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Enju, I have another mission for you.
You need to head back to Aburu Village.

Name: Sagkala
Text: It's about time Captain Lamassu started looking for you guys.

Name: Enju
Text:
I'll tell him we're patrolling a wider area!
It's not a lie, so it's perfectly fine.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
I'll come pick you up when I find an opening.
We're sticking together until the very end.

Name: Soft-Bean Adventurers
Text: Soft-softy! Soft-Beans!

Name: Brewery Worker
Text:
Aaargh! Please get me out of this wicked brewery!
This is pure labor exploitation... Tsk.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
The brewery is what feeds the Naruru.
You shouldn't be complaining like that!

Name: Elodie
Text:
Ugh... To think that I, Elodie the heavy drinker, would face defeat here.
I've never known such humiliation.

Name: Sagkala
Text: The only Naruru worth challenging to a drinking contest at the brewery would be <Orange>Ishinu</>.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Human... Did you drink with Ishinu, by any chance?
How are you even alive?!

Name: Elodie
Text:
I heard the liquor brewed by the Naruru is incredibly delicious...
As a drinking enthusiast, I felt it was only proper to visit.

Name: Elodie
Text:
But they refused to sell unless I placed a bulk order.
Honestly, how greedy can they be!

Name: Elodie
Text: So I challenged the brewmaster to a drinking contest.

Name: Azid
Text: You lost, didn't you? You must be working here because you lost!

Name: Azid
Text:
You actually thought you could outdrink Ishinu?
You're such a fool, a real fool.

Name: Elodie
Text: Hah... Does it make any sense to make me work off the cost of the drinks I had that day?

Name: Elodie
Text:
I had no idea they were so expensive in the first place!
This is a total rip-off, a brand-new kind of scam...

Name: Sagkala
Text:
All right, laborer.
Tell us where the Baba that's currently fermenting is.

Name: Azid
Text: Why the Baba? What do you need it for?

Name: Sagkala
Text:
They say the Baba used in the liquor has the absolute worst smell.
You won't be able to stand it if you aren't a Naruru.

Name: Azid
Text:
Oho! So this is a test for our noses.
If we can endure it, we'll prove our perseverance!

Name: Elodie
Text:
...I'm not sure what you're trying to pull, though.
The fermenting batch is right in front of you.

Name: Elodie
Text: Honestly, you'd be better off leaving it alone—

Name: Azid
Text: Allriiiight! Charging in!

Name: Elodie
Text:
They only started drying this yesterday.
The surface moisture must just be evaporating now.

Name: Elodie
Text:
It can't be used for liquor yet.
It will definitely smell, though.

Name: Azid
Text:
No wonder the smell was bearable.
You can't knock me out with just this!

Name: Azid
Text:
Where's the stronger stuff?
Show me the most terrifying thing in the brewery!

Name: Elodie
Text:
The batch in the middle of fermentation is in that pot over there.
Don't get too close. Just look from a distance.

Name: Elodie
Text:
What an impatient bunch of Naruru.
Yeah, diving right in, nose-first.

Name: Elodie
Text: Doesn't the Naruru's sense of smell completely dwarf a human's?

Name: Elodie
Text:
Baba takes on alcoholic properties from the moment it starts fermenting.
Since they inhaled so much of it, of course they got drunk.

Name: Elodie
Text:
Normally, it goes through a refinement process after fermentation.
That's how Baba becomes safe for consumption.

Name: Elodie
Text:
It's essentially like eating it raw...
No wonder they're out cold with a hangover.

Name: Elodie
Text:
Head to the garden behind the brewery and dig up some tree roots.
I'll use them to brew a hangover remedy.

Name: Elodie
Text:
They say there's a special... well, traditional method here.
Hah, I barely woke up myself after drinking it.

Name: Elodie
Text: The effect is guaranteed, so just bring me the roots.

Name: Elodie
Text: You picked out some thick, sturdy ones.

Name: Elodie
Text:
Making the remedy takes a few extra ingredients.
Go keep an eye on your friends for a bit.

Name: Elodie
Text:
It'll take some time since it has to be boiled thoroughly in clean water.
Help me out in the meantime.

Name: Elodie
Text:
Naruru should help their own kind.
Please, get me out of the clutches of these Naruru!

Name: Elodie
Text:
You heard me earlier.
I'm paying off my drink tab with hard labor.

Name: Elodie
Text: Which means I can escape the moment I get some money!

Name: Elodie
Text:
It's not like I committed a crime or anything...
Why am I paying what feels like bail money? Ha.

Name: Elodie
Text:
The roots you dug up only came from the entrance to the garden.
If you head northeast, you'll reach the deepest area.

Name: Elodie
Text:
Animal mutants live out there,
and their droppings actually fetch a high price.

Name: Elodie
Text:
They claim it's the culmination of evolution or something.
You can barely tell if they're monsters or animals, but they're highly valued.

Name: Elodie
Text:
The Ancient Tree Bower.
You'll find quite a few merchants gathered there.

Name: Elodie
Text:
A fellow named Navid handles various medicinal herbs.
Track him down and make a trade on my behalf.

Name: Elodie
Text: I'll make sure to look after these Naruru while you're gone.

Name: Navid
Text: Are you looking for anything specific?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(When you mention trading for droppings,</>
<Yellow>the merchant's eyes widen and begin to gleam.)</>

Name: Navid
Text:
That's a medicinal ingredient I can't keep in stock!
If you can bring me some, I can throw in a lot extra.

Name: Navid
Text: Whenever I tell gatherers they have to source it from mutants, they get spooked.

Name: Navid
Text:
And even if I try to ask adventurers,
they just pretend not to hear me, claiming the Giant's Tower is better for making money.

Name: Navid
Text:
Just bring me a few for starters,
so I can judge whether the quality holds up.

Name: Navid
Text:
Judging by the smell and color, it'll be tough to get full price for this.
Herbalists' eyes are just as sharp as an appraiser's.

Name: Navid
Text:
Since medicinal ingredients are ultimately meant to save lives,
I want to make sure I'm selling the good stuff.

Name: Navid
Text: It seems they haven't been very active lately.

Name: Navid
Text:
A healthy gut is key to producing high-quality droppings, isn't it?
Let's give them a little exercise.

Name: Navid
Text: Now this is exactly what I'm looking for!

Name: Navid
Text:
Monsters or not, if they walk on this earth, they're not so different from us.
I'm glad the plan worked out.

Name: Navid
Text:
As promised, I'll compensate you generously for your haul.
Let's do business again sometime.

Name: Elodie
Text: <Yellow>Hehe... Hehehe... Money... Money!!!</>

Name: Elodie
Text: I can finally escape this wretched brewery!

Name: Elodie
Text:
I took care of everything before you arrived.
They'll wake up soon and come to their senses soon enough.

Name: Elodie
Text:
I'm off to settle my debt with Ishinu.
Let's hope our paths don't cross again.

Name: Azid
Text: Ugh... My head! My head!

Name: Sagkala
Text: Note to self... Never directly inhale fermenting Baba...

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Azid, this isn't the Trial of Perseverance.
You passed out before you could even try to endure it...

Name: Azid
Text: The Naruru have the toughest noses, so I really thought enduring this was the test.

Name: Azid
Text:
Hey, what do you think?
What does perseverance mean to humans?

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Hmm... If a hero is someone who keeps fighting to protect the Naruru...
Then that might be the true meaning of the Trial of Perseverance.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
The hero chosen by Ea...
...is <Yellow>a Naruru who always protects the Naruru tribe</>, remember?!

Name: Azid
Text: That's right... The legendary hero Naruru stopped every single danger that threatened us!

Name: Azid
Text:
You keep fighting until you can’t stand anymore.
That's the real Trial of Perseverance.

Name: Azid
Text:
No matter what tries to scare us...
A hero endures until the very end...

Name: Azid
Text: Even if winged freaks lunge at us, we endure!

Name: Sagkala
Text: That's the first time you've actually looked cool, Azid.

Name: Azid
Text:
You know winged creatures live around here, right?!
I'm going to go prove my perseverance.

Name: Azid
Text: No one can stop a Softbean!

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Does everyone's nose, nose hurt?
Why do sky creatures have to live in a place like this?

Name: Sagkala
Text: They smell worse than Baba... Ugh.

Name: Sagkala
Text: Humans really know how to use terrible-tasting things as medicine...

Name: Azid
Text: I can put up with the smell! I can put up with it, but!

Name: Azid
Text:
My nose stings so much it's actually getting in the way of fighting them!
We might just have to hold our breath.

Name: Sagkala
Text: I'll go get some more of that powder I gave you guys in the valley.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
I'm out of ingredients, so I'll need to head to Aburu Village to make more.
I can bring Enju along, too.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Be careful! Don't get hurt!
You too, Azid. And you too, youngest Softbean.

Name: Azid
Text: Sniff! It's an awful smell, but I'll overcome it!

Name: Azid
Text:
We have to keep fighting until Sagkala gets back.
God Ea will be watching us!

Name: Azid
Text:
It's just the two of us... but I'll pretend we're all fighting together.
<Yellow>I can do this!</>

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Just how many sky creatures did you fight? Your nose is red.
This should be more than enough to pass the trial.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
By any chance... did Ea grant you power while I was away?
A lot of time has passed...

Name: Azid
Text:
I guess this isn't it.
I thought we proved our perseverance to protect the Naruru...

Name: Azid
Text:
<Yellow>Courage, Wisdom, Perseverance!</>
I really thought we had passed them all.

Name: Enju
Text: Could… Could the legend have been wrong?

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Let's offer a prayer instead.
If the Hero's Trials are false, God Ea will surely let us know.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Ea's Navel!
They say all the Sturdy-Beards offered their prayers there.

Name: Sagkala
Text: Let's do the exact same thing.

Name: Azid
Text: I'll gather all our earnest feelings and try talking to Ea.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
They said if Ea hears our prayer, a stream of water will appear!
I heard it straight from the previous Sturdy-Beard, so it's a sure thing!

Name: Azid
Text:
Phew, phew.
I'm a little nervous... I'm starting now, okay?

Name: Sagkala
Text: ...Keep your voice down.

Name: Enju
Text: The water stream... There's no water stream. I can't see a thing...

Name: Azid
Text:
Is Ea... not watching over the Softbean Adventure Squad?
So all those Hero's Trials we took...

Name: Azid
Text: <Yellow>What about the chosen hero? Is there no hero at all?!</>

Name: Sagkala
Text:
Azid, don't get mad!
It's okay because you gave it your absolute best.

Name: Azid
Text: No, no! I said I'm going to be the hero!

Name: Azid
Text:
I'm going to go ask my dad.
He's the smartest Naruru in the village!

Name: Sagkala
Text: You, you! You're going to tell <Orange>Sturdy-Beard</>?

Name: Enju
Text:
Azid is walking right into a scolding...
I'm going to tell him you botched the Bristly-Hair mission, and everything else!

Name: Azid
Text:
I don't care! I don't care!
Don't try to stop me!

Name: Etura
Text:
So you're admitting with your own mouth that you were just playing around.
You little! You little rascal!

Name: Azid
Text: But Dad, wouldn't it be great if I became a hero?!

Name: Etura
Text: Legends are just legends.

Name: Etura
Text:
God Ea is far too busy protecting Elsetia.
Even without a hero, we must take care of ourselves.

Name: Etura
Text: Just focus on stopping the Kuduru Tribe!

Name: Azid
Text: If I became a hero... I could protect the entire Naruru tribe...

Name: Etura
Text:
That's enough! You are not to leave the village.
You're staying right here until I say otherwise.

Name: Azid
Text: That's so unfair! It's not fair that Sturdy-Beard gets to do whatever he wants!

Name: Etura
Text:
This is a punishment from your father, a punishment.
You're no longer a baby Naruru; you need to do your job properly!

Name: Azid
Text: Sniffle... Waaah! Etura is so mean!

Name: Azid
Text: He told me... to just stay put, right here in Aburu Village.

Name: Sagkala
Text: See, I told you not to say anything to Sturdy-Beard.

Name: Azid
Text:
The chosen hero really is just a legend...
And the Hero's Trials were just us goofing off...

Name: Enju
Text: Aziiid...

Name: Sagkala
Text:
A hero candidate shouldn't be moping around like this.
You're the one who brought me, Enju, and the youngest human together! Right?

Name: Sagkala
Text: We just need to figure out if the legend is actually true or not.

Name: Sagkala
Text:
We promised to do everything together.
Did you forget our promise?

Name: Azid
Text: <Yellow>The Softbean Adventurer Squad isn't finished yet!</>

Name: Enju
Text:
Ea's hero wasn't born a hero, either.
He got hurt and fell down... Over and over again.

Name: Azid
Text:
Yeah! We'll just start over from the beginning!
We'll protect the Naruru ourselves!

Name: Soft-Bean Adventurers
Text: <Yellow>Squishy-squish! Softbeans!</>
Bursting with spirit, the Softbean Adventurer Squad firmly renewed their resolve.

They decided to lay low until Azid's grounding order was lifted.
Though no one knew when Sturdy-Beard would actually let them out.
...If a new Softbean joins us, does that mean I won't be the youngest anymore?

Name: Quentin
Text:
Oh, hello there.
I finally get to meet the one who saved Hesperia!

Name: Quentin
Text: I am <Orange>Quentin, leader of the Hesperia Mountain Club</>.

Name: Quentin
Text:
I've been dying to meet the savior of our village.
I knew you'd be a perfect fit for our Mountain Club!

Name: Quentin
Text:
Tending the fields, clearing the wasteland...
All pioneering work requires solid stamina.

Name: Quentin
Text: And there's nothing better than mountain climbing to build stamina.

Name: Quentin
Text:
<Yellow>"Even the adventurer who saved Hesperia climbs mountains regularly!"</>
What a perfect way to promote the club!

Name: Quentin
Text: Come on, let's head up together!

Name: Quentin
Text:
The trail needs a tiny, little bit of cleaning up, but...
That surely won't be enough to stop you.

Name: Quentin
Text: Oops! I almost forgot our chant.

Name: Quentin
Text:
Our Mountain Club shouts this chant to boost morale.
Repeat after me, clearly, word for word.

Name: Quentin
Text: <Yellow>"Stamina! Equals Pioneering Power!"</>

Name: Quentin
Text: Great! Let's start by cleaning up the mountain trail!

Name: Quentin
Text: Whew- You're a true paragon of the Mountain Club!

Name: Quentin
Text:
Since you've successfully completed your first activity as a member...
It's only natural we celebrate!

Name: Quentin
Text: <Yellow>"Stamina! Equals Pioneering Power!"</>

Name: Quentin
Text: The cleaning is done, but we have some minor repairs to do.

Name: Quentin
Text:
Seeing how the signposts we installed have been ripped out,
it's obvious the <Red>Ironblood Brigade</> deliberately tampered with them.

Name: Quentin
Text:
To kidnap people who get lost in the forest!
Ugh, it makes me shudder just thinking about it...

Name: Quentin
Text:
Members!
Let's restore our mountain trail together!

Name: Quentin
Text: We'll ask our new member to handle two of them.

Name: Quentin
Text: One at the fork just ahead, and another a short walk toward the Village.

Name: Quentin
Text:
Just set up one signpost at each spot, for a total of two!
I'll provide you with the markers.

Name: Quentin
Text: Great, excellent work.

Name: Quentin
Text:
While we wait for the members who went to set them up elsewhere,
let's take a short break-

Name: Tindra
Text: We’re in big trouble! Huff, huff...

Name: Quentin
Text: Tindra, what's going on!

Name: Tindra
Text: Limariya has disappeared!

Name: Tindra
Text:
She went deep into the trail,
but she won't answer no matter how much I call for her.

Name: Tindra
Text: You don't think something bad happened to her, do you? *sob...*

Name: Quentin
Text:
Please calm down.
She is usually quite timid.

Name: Quentin
Text:
She joined us to overcome that fear,
but you can’t gain courage overnight.

Name: Quentin
Text: She's probably hiding somewhere, startled by the growing number of monsters.

Name: Quentin
Text: Adventurer, would you please bring Limariya back?

Name: Quentin
Text:
Just in case, I'll go check on the other members.
I'll leave it to you!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Where could Limariya be? Let's search the area.)</>

Name: Limariya
Text:
Thank you...
I was so scared...

Name: Limariya
Text: I thought I was trapped in the forest for sure... Phew...

Name: Limariya
Text: If you hadn't come to save me, I would've stayed hidden here forever...

Name: Limariya
Text:
I'm so embarrassed.
I joined the Mountain Club so I wouldn't be like this...

Name: Limariya
Text: I'll gather my courage and head back on my own...!
Limariya sprang up and energetically ran off toward Quentin.

Name: Quentin
Text: Limariya! You must stick close to the others.

Name: Limariya
Text: Ah, understood... I guess I let my guard down since I've been here a few times...

Name: Quentin
Text:
My, my! Cheer up.
You can't fall behind already.

Name: Quentin
Text: <Yellow>You can take one more step! You still have strength left!</>

Name: Quentin
Text:
Members, you know we're only halfway there, right?
You can't get exhausted.

Name: Quentin
Text: <Yellow>Stamina equals?</>

Name: Mountain Club Members
Text: <Yellow>Pioneering Power!</>

Name: Quentin
Text: Our Mountain Club activities! They're all for the development of Hesperia!

Name: Quentin
Text:
We mustn't stop working even while climbing.
Let's each move to our activity zones!

Name: Quentin
Text: Our mountain trail is extremely rugged despite the gentle slope.

Name: Quentin
Text:
But we can gather daily necessities along the way.
Look, isn't there an abundance of firewood?

Name: Quentin
Text:
Hmm... Since the area becomes dangerous during logging,
we should set up “Keep Out” signs.

Name: Quentin
Text:
Just like when you set up the signposts,
install one at the fork ahead.

Name: Quentin
Text:
As for firewood,
gather enough to last for about a month.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(So as long as it burns, it counts as firewood.
Hesperians sure are enterprising.)</>

Name: Quentin
Text: Oh my, new member!

Name: Quentin
Text: Don't tell me you gathered this directly from monsters, did you?

Name: Quentin
Text:
I'm very grateful for your hard work, but...
I meant “real trees” planted in the ground, ahem.

Name: Quentin
Text:
What you brought is too corroded to use.
Let's try again with healthy, non-moving trees.

Name: Quentin
Text:
Member, you can still do more.
This too is part of improving your stamina!

Name: Quentin
Text:
Seeing you answer, you clearly still have some energy left.
Let's gather just three more bundles!

Name: Quentin
Text:
I knew you could do it.
Simple enough for the village’s savior, right?

Name: Quentin
Text: Our next activity is fishing!

Name: Quentin
Text:
I mean the monsters prowling on the land.
Their scales are quite tough.

Name: Quentin
Text: Unlike edible fish, they are stiff and plentiful, making them extremely useful.

Name: Quentin
Text:
I let you know in advance this time,
so no need for repeats.

Name: Quentin
Text:
You finished that in a flash.
That should last us a while.

Name: Quentin
Text: Our new member should be fully warmed up now, so shall we head up?

Name: Quentin
Text: Please tell the others to gather here.

Name: Quentin
Text: Great job, new member.

Name: Quentin
Text:
It looks like everyone is here, but since we had that incident with Member Limariya, 
I will do a headcount.

Name: Quentin
Text: We'll set off as soon as I'm done checking.

Name: Quentin
Text: You're all gathered, members!

Name: Quentin
Text:
Now it's time to head toward the summit.
No stragglers, right?

Name: Quentin
Text:
We have a new member, so don't get too far ahead,
and since space is limited, please clear the destination point right away.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is there more to climb on this hill?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(And what do they mean by the destination being narrow...?)</>

Name: Quentin
Text:
Let's go, adventurer!
Take it slow—it’s your first time.

Name: Quentin
Text:
Do you see the cliff with the waterfall to the east?
That’s your destination!

Name: Quentin
Text:
Now, wipe that frown off your face-
<Yellow>Stamina equals?</>

Name: Mountain Club Members
Text: <Yellow>Pioneering Power!</>

Name: Quentin
Text: How is it, member! Bearable, right?

Name: Quentin
Text:
It's a bit embarrassing to even call this place a mountain.
It's just a small mound, so it shouldn't be too tough for you.

Name: Quentin
Text: The real reason we climb mountains regularly is... for reconnaissance.

Name: Quentin
Text:
The Hallowed Mountain isn't very visible,
but the <Blue>Frantia Gate</> is in plain sight.

Name: Quentin
Text:
However, the Reconnaissance Squad is handling the Hallowed Mountain, so no worries there.
We have to do what we can!

Name: Quentin
Text:
Now, has everyone rested?
The others have already arrived up there.

Name: Quentin
Text:
Since it's your first time, you can head to the “beginner” destination.
Take a deep breath in, exhale slowly, and climb up.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(To think this is for beginners... It's higher than you think. You decide to climb carefully.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You can see quite far into the distance, but it's hard to make out faces.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Frantia side has set up good defenses even in the Forsaken Land.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It would be nice if they helped Hesperia...)</>

Name: Quentin
Text:
I'd like to hear your thoughts on the climb, member.
It wasn't too exhausting of a journey, was it?

Name: Quentin
Text: I am very satisfied because I now have something to talk about.

Name: Quentin
Text:
Thanks to your influence, more people will take up mountaineering!
Stronger stamina, stronger village!

Name: Quentin
Text: <Yellow>Stamina equals?!</>

Name: Quentin
Text:
Hehe! You’re already one of us now.
Good, very good!

Name: Quentin
Text:
Please do visit the Mountaineering Club again.
Safe travels!

Name: Nina
Text:
I'm sorry, traveler, but we're taking a break right now.
We’re out of ingredients and need more-

Name: Nina
Text:
Oh my, oh my goodness!
You're the adventurer who's been helping our village, right?

Name: Nina
Text:
It's fascinating to see you up close.
Wow, it's my first time talking to a celebrity!

Name: Nina
Text:
Say, are you hungry by any chance?
I'll make you some stew using today's freshly harvested potatoes.

Name: Nina
Text:
The ingredients? We can just go get more.
There's a field we villagers cultivate together.

Name: Nina
Text:
All you have to do is enjoy the meal and leave a note in the guestbook, adventurer!
Easy, right?

Name: Nina
Text:
We've been getting a lot more outsiders in Hesperia lately, haven't we?
So, I'm thinking of opening the restaurant in the evenings as well.

Name: Nina
Text:
I usually opened at dawn and closed before noon.
Since I have to work the fields in the afternoon.

Name: Nina
Text: But if I don't make some extra coin now, when will I, right?

Name: Nina
Text:
I've even come up with a new dish for the evening menu...
I was just wondering how I'd promote it.

Name: Nina
Text: A single note from you saying <Yellow>"I had a delicious meal"</> would solve everything. Hehe!

Name: Nina
Text:
I'm not asking you to do it for free, of course.
All honest work deserves fair pay.

Name: Nina
Text:
Now then, please bring the meat I'll need for the dish.
I have to make it before you can taste it, right? Hehe.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...A restaurant where the patron has to fetch their own ingredients. What a bizarre experience.)</>

Name: Nina
Text: Make sure it's fresh meat! You got that?!

Name: Nina
Text:
This dish is for <Orange>Gerald</>, I mean, wait no...
I made it with the members of the Defense Force in mind.

Name: Nina
Text:
The quality is quite good.
You're quite skilled at this sort of thing as well, adventurer.

Name: Nina
Text:
I got a bit eager and inconvenienced my own patron, but...
Still, I'm glad I trusted you with this!

Name: Nina
Text: It's food we put in our mouths, so it requires a careful touch.

Name: Nina
Text: What they sell there is… honestly…

Name: Nina
Text:
…a little hard to trust.
If humans eat it, humans should supply it.

Name: Nina
Text:
I only saw the Naruru for the first time after I settling here,
and just as I'd heard, they really focus on profit.

Name: Nina
Text: It makes me wonder if they're stocking low-quality goods just to turn a quick profit.

Name: Nina
Text:
No, well, I'm not trying to slander them or anything!
I'm just saying we always need to keep the risks in mind.

Name: Nina
Text:
In Hesperia, every person matters.
It'd be a disaster if anyone ate something bad and fell ill.

Name: Nina
Text: Just in case, could you sneak a peek and see if the food they're selling over there is safe?

Name: Nina
Text: I'll finish up the dish in the meantime.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(All the goods on sale seem  flawless.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Isn't Nina worrying a bit too much?
Being wary of other races isn't necessarily a bad thing, but...)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The people here live a harsh life every day,
so they do need someone who pays attention to details.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Now that I'm done looking around, let’s buy a couple of cheap items and head back.)</>

Name: Kishirashu
Text: All done? You saw everything? The Naruru only sell the best!

Name: Kishirashu
Text:
You can buy anything.
Humans must also know of the gifts bestowed by the god Ea.

Name: Kishirashu
Text:
We have goods brought from Aburu Village,
and things traded with the humans of the wasteland.

Name: Kishirashu
Text: We never lie when we trade. Not ever.

Name: Kishirashu
Text:
We must never, never do anything God Ea dislikes.
<Yellow>You'll get in big trouble for messing with food!</>

Name: Kishirashu
Text:
You're a good human!
Thank you, thank you for trusting the Naruru.

Name: Kishirashu
Text:
Come buy from us often, often from now on.
Take this to celebrate our first trade.
ItemDesc:
An ingredient received as a token of trust from Kishirashu in Hesperia.
It feels strangely familiar like déjà vu, yet carries a richer aroma than before.
It seems like it would enhance the flavor of any dish you add it to.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain what happened at the general store and taste Nina's cooking.)</>

Name: Nina
Text:
Is that so? Their business skills are certainly impressive.
Giving away freebies like this, too...

Name: Nina
Text: May I take a look at it?

Name: Nina
Text: As I thought... something touched by animal paws is a bit... well, as a chef, I worry about hygiene.

Name: Nina
Text:
It's not like I'm trying to discriminate.
It's just a personal belief.

Name: Nina
Text: Anyway, how does it taste?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It tastes very healthy, but it's not that bad.)</>

Name: Nina
Text: This is my newly developed signature dish... the meat is very tender, isn't it?

Name: Nina
Text: I prefer bringing out the natural flavor of ingredients rather than using spices.

Name: Nina
Text: If you approve of the taste-

Name: Nina
Text: I've decided. I'm going to serve this as my evening special!

Name: Nina
Text:
If I serve it alongside drinks, it could attract new customers, right?
Then this restaurant will be full of life again.

Name: Nina
Text:
Mhm- I need to start cooking right away.
But this time, I'm short on base ingredients.

Name: Nina
Text:
I just need you to dig up a few from the field you visited earlier...
Please help me out just one more time!

Name: Nina
Text:
Buying from the Naruru general merchant is...
Well, I'll think about it later.

Name: Nina
Text: Ta-da! I made a big batch with what you gathered.

Name: Nina
Text:
Since the locals will be my main customers,
I should get their opinions, right?

Name: Nina
Text:
Please go around and ask what they think of the dish!
Hehe, I'm so excited.

Name: Kishirashu
Text:
That's a very delicious, delicious smell.
I can feel the chef's dedication in this.

Name: Kishirashu
Text:
A dish filled, filled to the brim with clean and well-grown ingredients.
Who made this?

Name: Kishirashu
Text:
Nina! So it was the human chef.
It's perfect for Naruru taste—very good. Tell her it's delicious.

Name: Kishirashu
Text: But humans might say it's too bland or mild, don’t you think?

Name: Kishirashu
Text: In that case, she can just use the powder I gave you.

Name: Kishirashu
Text:
The chefs in Aburu Village made it for their human customers.
If she adds that, everyone will praise, praise it as the best.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Kishirashu licks the bowl clean... You should return to Nina.)</>

Name: Nina
Text:
The other residents didn't say it was tasty...
The Naruru from the general store said it was good?

Name: Nina
Text: Hmm, I feel a bit strange about that.

Name: Nina
Text:
I also offered tastings to the others,
but they said it tasted too healthy.

Name: Nina
Text:
Is that why business has been so slow all this time...?
Maybe I really just don't have a talent for cooking...

Name: Nina
Text: Those were my thoughts, so I never expected to hear such compliments.

Name: Nina
Text: Well... um... maybe they just said that to get on my good side so I'll buy their ingredients?

Name: Nina
Text:
I should try harder.
I-I'll try adding the powder too... and readjust the seasoning... and, uh...

Name: Nina
Text: By any chance, do you know <Orange>Gerald</> from the Defense Force?

Name: Nina
Text:
He's a regular at my restaurant, but I haven't seen him lately and I'm a bit worried.
I hope nothing bad has happened to him...

Name: Nina
Text: He's probably just busy dealing with the <Red>Ironblood Brigade</>, right?

Name: Nina
Text:
Truth be told, this new dish...
I wanted him to be the first one to taste it...

Name: Nina
Text:
Thank you, adventurer!
I'll go ask the village representative just in case.

Name: Gerald
Text:
What brings you here?
Did you happen to receive an extermination request?

Name: Gerald
Text: The Defense Force is out on patrol right now, so you don't have to worry too much-

Name: Defense Force Member's Shout
Text: Gerald! They've appeared again!

Name: Gerald
Text: My apologies, but this is an urgent matter. I must take my leave.

Name: Gerald
Text: Thank you. Then I'll trust you to watch my back.

Name: Energetic Defense Force Member
Text: What a relief! Your skills are amazing, as expected.

Name: Cheerful Defense Force Member
Text:
I wish every day was like today.
Please stay in Hesperia for good, adventurer!

Name: Gerald
Text:
Everyone, please calm yourselves.
And don't put so much pressure on the village's savior.

Name: Gerald
Text:
Thanks to you, we were able to finish an operation that would've taken days.
Thank you once again.

Name: Gerald
Text:
It seems they were backed into a corner,
so they changed their tactics and ambushed us, catching us off guard...

Name: Energetic Defense Force Member
Text: We survived thanks to the first-aid kits we bought from Kishirashu.

Name: Cheerful Defense Force Member
Text:
The Naruru tribe might be small in number,
but they really do sell top-quality goods, you know?

Name: Cheerful Defense Force Member
Text:
They're on good terms with the merchant guild in Babylon, too.
I've already become a regular.

Name: Energetic Defense Force Member
Text: Whew, can we return to the village now?

Name: Energetic Defense Force Member
Text: I've been up for days. I really want to wash up!

Name: Cheerful Defense Force Member
Text:
And I want to have a proper meal, too.
We're completely out of rations.

Name: Gerald
Text:
There are still stragglers left.
Their strike captain fled mid-battle, so we must finish this first.

Name: Gerald
Text: I have some rations left. I’ll share them with everyone.

Name: Cheerful Defense Force Member
Text: But what about you, Captain Gerald?

Name: Cheerful Defense Force Member
Text: Oh? Who’s this?

Name: Nina
Text: Guardians, thank you for your hard work!

Name: Nina
Text:
I bet you’re all hungry too… right?
You can't fight on an empty stomach—you might get hurt!

Name: Nina
Text: I brought some lunch boxes. Eat up and find your strength.

Name: Gerald
Text: What about the tavern? Why come to such a dangerous place?

Name: Nina
Text: I couldn't help it! I was worried about my favorite regular.

Name: Nina
Text:
You haven't shown your face in ages!
My tavern might go under if you keep this up...

Name: Nina
Text: So, you’d better take responsibility!

Name: Energetic Defense Force Member
Text: Ooohh… Is this what I think it is?

Name: Cheerful Defense Force Member
Text:
Oh, no. I’d rather not know.
I’ll just enjoy the food, shall I?

Name: Gerald
Text:
Ahem. This tastes... excellent.
The flavor just keeps lingering.

Name: Energetic Defense Force Member
Text: Truly! I can't remember the last time I ate something this good.

Name: Cheerful Defense Force Member
Text: Come to think of it, Captain’s been keeping this tavern all to himself!

Name: Nina
Text: Adventurer, Naruru’s powder really works!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Nina whispers excitedly under her breath.)</>

Name: Gerald
Text:
I know this must’ve taken a lot of effort.
Thank you for looking after us.

Name: Cheerful Defense Force Member
Text:
All right, stomachs are full! Let's give it one last push!
Let's finish the job quickly and rotate shifts.

Name: Cheerful Defense Force Member
Text: Let’s go! Move out!

Name: Gerald
Text: Nina, it’s not safe here. Please, head back and wait for us.

Name: Nina
Text:
Oh, all right.
But you must come back soon!

Name: Gerald
Text: Oh, you still haven’t gone back?

Name: Nina
Text:
I couldn’t. I was too worried to just leave all of you here.
B, But you could suddenly get hurt or something…

Name: Nina
Text: Then someone would need to run word back to the village...

Name: Nina
Text: By the way, everyone was so fast out there! It was amazing to watch.

Name: Energetic Defense Force Member
Text: Thanks to the lunchbox! It was packed with nutrients and energy!

Name: Energetic Defense Force Member
Text: I could taste the... "love" in every bite. Hehe.

Name: Cheerful Defense Force Member
Text:
*sigh* Why am I the only one without a sweetheart?
At this rate, I’ll end up getting attached to the Ironblood Brigade.

Name: Gerald
Text: Ahem. It’s not like that.

Name: Gerald
Text:
Well, since we’re all here, let’s head back together.
You deserve a rest as well, adventurer.

Name: Nina
Text: Good idea. I have someone to thank, so I’d better hurry.

Name: Nina
Text:
See you at the tavern later.
I’ll have a grand feast waiting for you…

Name: Thierry
Text: Sigh. Those <Red>Kiguru</> are causing trouble again today.

Name: Thierry
Text: As the supply officer, I don’t know how to resolve this situation.

Name: Thierry
Text:
I keep things within reach because we use them often.
Moving them inside every time would be bothersome...

Name: Thierry
Text:
Those creatures aren't even bright.
Why do they always have to take the supply crates?

Name: Thierry
Text:
I’m testing a few theories.
First, we need to move them somewhere less obvious.

Name: Thierry
Text:
The Kiguru are tall, so we’ll need to stack these somewhere high.
Shall we grab the crates first?

Name: Thierry
Text: No need. Just set them down here in the corner.

Name: Thierry
Text:
Now, we start the experiment.
Will the Kiguru be interested in these boxes or not?

Name: Thierry
Text: Look, they're heading down in swarms. Let's take the Glider and go now.

Name: Thierry
Text:
Oh, wait! Be careful not to break anything when putting them down.
If Captain <Orange>Alayn</> finds out, he’ll nag my ear out...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The battle was more chaotic than I expected. I didn't even have a chance to look at the hill...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You’d better head back to the outpost and check the situation.)</>

Name: Thierry
Text: Argh! They wrecked the supplies again!

Name: Thierry
Text: I think their goal… is just to destroy anything humans find valuable.

Name: Thierry
Text:
They’re smarter than they look.
It doesn't even matter where we stack the crates.

Name: Thierry
Text:
In that case, there's no point in hiding them!
We just have to keep them out!

Name: Thierry
Text:
The real problem is this outpost. It’s wide open—
It’s practically an invitation to attack. We need to fix this.

Name: Thierry
Text: Just look around this place.

Name: Thierry
Text:
I know this outpost used to be an abandoned house, but... 
Honestly, I doubt if it’s any good for defense.

Name: Thierry
Text: There is absolutely nothing here.

Name: Thierry
Text:
This narrow stream isn't much of a defensive terrain,
but the path is perfect for an uphill charge!

Name: Thierry
Text:
No wonder the Kiguru keep slipping in through the back.
We need to at least take some basic measures here.

Name: Thierry
Text: I’ll have to set up a barricade at least.

Name: Thierry
Text:
We don't have any lumber in stock,
so we'll have to go get some fresh wood.

Name: Thierry
Text:
We should leave the trees nearby to block their line of sight.
It’s better to pick ones further away.

Name: Thierry
Text: Whoa, you brought plenty!

Name: Thierry
Text: I’m so glad you’re helping me.

Name: Thierry
Text: I’ve been breaking a sweat just trying to chase off those supply thieves.

Name: Thierry
Text:
A barricade will stop them from just waltzing in.
Let’s get to it.

Name: Thierry
Text:
That should do it.
It’ll block any direct frontal assaults.

Name: Thierry
Text: Remember that hypothesis I mentioned earlier?

Name: Thierry
Text:
I think they believe stealing what’s important to us…
…gives them an advantage.

Name: Thierry
Text: If that's the case... we'll just make some decoy supply crates!

Name: Thierry
Text: Open and close them constantly.

Name: Thierry
Text: We'll put things in, take them out... and keep glancing around to see who's watching.

Name: Thierry
Text:
With their tiny brains, they'll think, "That's the one!"
It’s a solid plan, right?

Name: Thierry
Text: Hehe, hehehe... How dare they eye our supplies!

Name: Thierry
Text:
From now on, our supplies are nothing but rocks. Rocks!
Hold them tight and carry them like they're precious.

Name: Thierry
Text:
Now we’re all set.
Let’s see what they do with our new <Yellow>“supplies</>.”

Name: Thierry
Text: Just act like you're in the middle of a chaotic battle, just like before.

Name: Thierry
Text:
I already told the scouts in advance.
Those idiots will come for the crates without a second thought.

Name: Thierry
Text:
They fell for it exactly as planned!
You should have seen them struggling to carry crates full of rocks...

Name: Thierry
Text:
They were so heavy they could only take a few.
This trick should work for a while.

Name: Thierry
Text: Thanks for the help. Take this—it’s a small token of my gratitude.

Name: Josephine
Text: Oh dear... What am I going to do?

Name: Josephine
Text:
Excuse me, adventurer!
If you have a moment, are you interested in some high-paying temporary work?

Name: Josephine
Text:
I supply medicine around here.
Not your average healing tonic—it’s something a bit more... confidential.

Name: Josephine
Text:
It’s called the “<Blue>Bittersweet Elixir.”</>
It gives a temporary boost to one's physical abilities...

Name: Josephine
Text:
Anyway, I have a loyal client.
That client alone accounts for half of my sales…

Name: Josephine
Text:
But I’m out of ingredients, so I can't brew a single batch.
My client is a stickler for deadlines. If I'm late, I might lose the contract entirely.

Name: Josephine
Text: Please get me some honey. I'll make sure you're well compensated.

Name: Josephine
Text: Not this one!!

Name: Josephine
Text:
Ugh, this honey is highly toxic. Refining it will take too long...
I'll never meet the deadline then.

Name: Josephine
Text: Don't tell me you took this directly from the hornets, did you?

Name: Josephine
Text: *sigh…* Typical adventurers... Always leading with their muscles.

Name: Josephine
Text:
No, I don't have time for this!
Please, just get me the honey from the hives this time.

Name: Josephine
Text:
Even those terrifying hornets build their hives with pure, harmless honey.
They even calculate the temperature and humidity perfectly.

Name: Josephine
Text: That’s why it can be used for medicine.

Name: Josephine
Text: Got all that? Now hurry!

Name: Josephine
Text:
You got the right ones.
I need to brew this and deliver it immediately.

Name: Josephine
Text: Didier has such a short temper... Ahem.

Name: Josephine
Text:
Just... forget you heard that name.
Stay here while I go collect the payment.

Name: Josephine
Text: …Wait, what is that smell?!

Name: Josephine
Text:
You’re practically dripping with the scent of honey!
Didn't you even bother to check yourself?

Name: Josephine
Text:
A whole swarm of bees will follow that scent right here!
They must be furious after you messed with their hive!

Name: Josephine
Text:
Go clean up your own mess so I don't get dragged into this.
I'll make the medicine and get your money in the meantime.

Name: Josephine
Text: Thanks to you, I saved my biggest contract.

Name: Josephine
Text:
Still, I don't get why someone from the Gate Guard…
…likes this stuff so much.

Name: Josephine
Text:
Medicine that grants explosive power always has side effects.
Yet, keep keeps asking for it.

Name: Josephine
Text: It's bad for you in the long run. Don't take it unless you have to.

Name: Josephine
Text:
Here's your pay.
Safe travels.

Name: Ophelia
Text: Oh! You’re the adventurer Captain <Orange>Lena</> took a liking to!

Name: Ophelia
Text:
Nice to meet you. I’ve been wanting to chat.
I look forward to working with you!

Name: Ophelia
Text:
I’m Ophelia, a new recruit.
I handle various tasks in the Operations Command.

Name: Ophelia
Text:
Hehe... I'm in charge of rear duties, but that’s okay.
Our Captain Lena is just so cool.

Name: Ophelia
Text: All the knights sent to battle are all top-tier back in the capital.

Name: Ophelia
Text:
She was appointed a captain among great talents.
It proves her combat skills are extraordinary.

Name: Ophelia
Text: If only I could fight by her side..

Name: Ophelia
Text:
She put me here because she figured I had a knack for using my head.
So, I’ve never fought alongside her.

Name: Ophelia
Text: Phew, I better finish this work and get to physical training.

Name: Ophelia
Text:
Hey, you can read maps, right?
What secret do you think this one’s hiding?

Name: Ophelia
Text:
<Yellow>Deciphering codes is my specialty.</>
If I wrap this up quickly, the Captain will be pleased, right?

Name: Ophelia
Text: Oh, right. If you’re staying here, you should help me with my individual training.

Name: Ophelia
Text:
Since Lena has her eye on you,
I’m sure I have something to learn from you.

Name: Ophelia
Text: Now, let’s take a look at this map.

Name: Ophelia
Text:
Hmm, let’s see.
These marks northeast of Hesperia are a bit different from the Brigade’s cipher...

Name: Ophelia
Text:
Where did I put the character reference table?
Hmm, this means "coast," and that one is "magic"...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She seems completely absorbed in the deciphering. You decide to wait a moment.)</>

Name: Ophelia
Text:
Great! All done.
Simple. It wasn't much.

Name: Ophelia
Text: The Captain has already seen through a scheme of this level.

Name: Ophelia
Text:
I just need to organize these records, and then—training time!
If I beat you, the Captain will finally see me in a new light, right?

Name: Ophelia
Text:
Hehe! Oh, could you tell Sophie she doesn't need to stand on standby?
Just tell her the cipher was nothing important. She’ll know what it means.

Name: Ophelia
Text:
See that cliff over there with the ruins?
Head up that way.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(That's a long way up. But I have my ways.)</>

Name: Sophie
Text: You... the Captain's ally...

Name: Sophie
Text: This is a training ground. If the Captain didn't send you... go down.

Name: Sophie
Text: I can't believe she used someone the Captain trusts for a mere errand.

Name: Sophie
Text:
The other knights were praising you...
Tell me... what is your secret?

Name: Sophie
Text: I want to be useful to the Captain, too...

Name: Sophie
Text:
The Assault Unit... don't go to the front with her.
I want to stand on the same battlefield as her.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(They both seem to worship Captain Lena.)</>

Name: Sophie
Text:
<Yellow>Gliding is my specialty.</>
Watch my form... Tell me how I can better impress the Captain.

Name: Sophie
Text:
I’ll go first.
Let's talk on the other side…

Sophie spread her Glider wide and soared across.
She traced a perfect arc through the ai—her movements seamless and precise.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It’s further than you thought. Fly over to that hill on the other side.)</>

Name: Sophie
Text: How was it...? Do you think the Captain will compliment you?

Name: Sophie
Text: I have to prove myself here if I want her to take me to the Vanguard Unit later...

Name: Sophie
Text:
My glide... must be perfect...
I can't afford a single mistake...!

Name: Sophie
Text:
I see...
I see... Then I should focus even harder... on my sword training…

Name: Sophie
Text:
You... care to spar with me...?
I think I could learn something from it...

Name: Ophelia
Text:
<Red>No way!</>
This person already made a promise to me first!

Name: Ophelia
Text: Don't be so sneaky! You can’t just cut in like that.

Name: Sophie
Text: ...So, Ophelia’s here.

Name: Ophelia
Text: You’re doing sword training with me first!

Name: Ophelia
Text:
Sophie’s in the Assault Unit, so she gets plenty of real combat.
As someone in the rear, my need is clearly more urgent!

Name: Sophie
Text: But... you had private training... back in the capital...

Name: Ophelia
Text: Well, it’s obviously not enough for Captain Lena!

Name: Sophie
Text: She put you in the rear... because you’re too impulsive...

Name: Sophie
Text:
At this rate, you'll never deploy with the Captain...
You'd be the first to die...

Name: Ophelia
Text: Then you must be stuck here because you’re too slow!

Name: Ophelia
Text:
<Orange>The Knights of the Frostwind</> have a grave responsibility.
How do you expect to get anything done talking that slowly?

Name: Sophie
Text: My talking... isn't a problem... in a fight...!

Name: Ophelia
Text: Let’s settle this today. Let's see who truly deserves to stand by Captain Lena's side!

Name: Sophie
Text: A predictable challenge...

Name: Ophelia
Text: Whoever brings back more loot from the hills wins!

Name: Sophie
Text: You be the judge... Keep it fair.

Name: Ophelia
Text: As soon as this person is ready, we start the moment we cross the bridge, okay?

(Once they see you’re was ready, 
the two deploy their Gliders and soar toward the hills.)

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(There’s no stopping their competitive spirits.
I’d better make sure they accept the result like true knights.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Neither of them seems very experienced in combat. I’ll keep an eye on them and lend a hand if needed.)</>

Name: Ophelia
Text: What! The count is the same!

Name: Sophie
Text:
When did you get twenty-five...?
Don’t lie to me.

Name: Ophelia
Text:
Even an apprentice is a knight.
Don't you know the oath? <Yellow>“A knight never tells a lie.”</>

Name: Sophie
Text:
Who said I forgot?
We read the oath together at the induction ceremony...

Name: Ophelia
Text: Ugh, this will never end.

Name: Ophelia
Text:
You watched us fight, didn't you?
<Yellow>You be the judge.</>

Name: Ophelia
Text:
Come on, speak up.
<Yellow>Which of us fought better?</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(To be honest, I didn't see a thing...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(They must have been fighting in the corners. Neither of them was in my line of sight.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(How do I talk my way out of this?)</>

Name: Sophie
Text: That’s because... you fight without watching your back...

Name: Ophelia
Text: It’s not a problem if I crush every enemy in front of me!
<Red>Beep— Beep-beep! Beep-beep!</>

Name: Ophelia
Text: Did you just hear that?

Name: Sophie
Text: ...It’s coming from the detonator.

Name: Ophelia
Text:
But we haven't even linked it to the signal flare yet.
Is it malfunctioning?

Name: Sophie
Text: We should... check it out.

Name: Ophelia
Text:
We can't have monsters stepping on the detonator while we investigate.
Go thin out their numbers for us.

Name: Ophelia
Text: Pretty please?

Name: Sophie
Text:
...You’re not Master Jean. You don't know anything.
It’s a relief that was just a low-power alert.

Name: Sophie
Text: How can you be so confident... reaching for a bomb so recklessly...?

Name: Ophelia
Text: I decipher codes. You think I can't tell one wire from another?

Name: Sophie
Text: Now I see... why the Captain hasn't promoted you to a full knight yet.

Name: Ophelia
Text: Listen to you! As if you aren't an apprentice too!

Name: Sophie
Text: Move... I’m going to see the Captain.

Name: Ophelia
Text:
To report that you dealt with the detonator?
I see right through you!

Name: Ophelia
Text: Not a chance! I’m going first!

Name: Jesper
Text:
Y-you there.
Do you happen to be... a mercenary?

Name: Jesper
Text:
No, it doesn't matter.
If you know how to fight, please, you must help me.

Name: Jesper
Text:
My daughter was taken by the Ironblood Brigade... *sob.*
I can't face them alone, can I…?

Name: Jesper
Text: No one has come out of there for the last several days... She has to be alive.

Name: Jesper
Text: I have to get her out before they do something... God, please... my daughter.

Name: Jesper
Text: Th-Thank you! Thank you so much!

Name: Jesper
Text: You've heard the rumors. How those Ironblood monsters treat people like... like <Red>“goods.”</>

Name: Jesper
Text: They must have some kind of records—orders, or a plan.

Name: Jesper
Text: I need to know where they're keeping her. Please, help me find them!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Did they erase the marking on the wagon on purpose? You should take a closer look.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Found it. This is the wagon used to transport the “goods.”)</>
ItemName: Secret Letter from a Low-ranking Brigade Member
ItemDesc:
- Special Request: Use drugs specifically for this batch.
- Keep them in the corner opposite the entrance to prevent any scent from leaking.
- Stand by until further orders.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This looks bad. You need to report this immediately.)</>

Name: Jesper
Text:
Did you find something?!
Show me!

Name: Jesper
Text: So this is why their infamy reached all the way to Stormkel...

Name: Jesper
Text:
I know the general location now. I'm going there now.
Don't try to stop me!

Name: Jesper
Text: It's right there! I saw other people tied up.

Name: Jesper
Text: We need to take out the sentries and search the place immediately.
We successfully escaped the traffickers' hideout, evading our pursuers…

Name: Jesper
Text:
If I hadn't found my child...
I might have done something terrible.

Name: Jesper
Text: We were attacked on our way to Hesperia.

Name: Jesper
Text:
Those bastards kept shouting that they had no use for <Red>“oversized goods.”</>
Then, they threw me into the river.

Name: Jesper
Text:
At first... I blamed myself…
I thought I should’ve drowned than to survive alone.

Name: Jesper
Text: But then the child waiting for me came to mind.

Name: Jesper
Text: What a relief we could reunite like this.

Name: Jesper
Text:
Please, take this. It’s not much, but it’s all I have.
Thank you again.

Name: Jean
Text:
Everything is a mess.
I can't get any proper statistics at this rate.

Name: Jean
Text:
You there.
The Captain seems to trust you. Do an errand for me.

Name: Jean
Text: It’s not for free, so don’t give me that look.

Name: Jean
Text: Go clear the area around the <Blue>“Frantia Beacons”</> planted on the Hallowed Mountain.

Name: Jean
Text:
Something debris must be stuck in them after that recent blast...
I’m picking up interference.

Name: Jean
Text: Bring back any that are in bad shape.

Name: Jean
Text: I see you came back empty-handed. I guess none of them were broken.

Name: Jean
Text:
The signal is back to normal.
We can leave the current ones where they are.

Name: Jean
Text: I’m the only <Orange>Magitech Expert</> in the Knights of the Frostwind.

Name: Jean
Text:
I was formerly a renowned magitech engineer back in the capital.
Though now I spend my days dealing with these muscle-bound idiots.

Name: Jean
Text: My job is to help them focus on the battle right in front of them.

Name: Jean
Text:
That’s why I planted those beacons everywhere.
I handle what they can't solve with brute force.

Name: Jean
Text: Remember the explosion at the <Blue>Hallowed Obsidian Mountain</>?

Name: Jean
Text:
Some high-ranking officials back home were running illegal experiments in the Forsaken Land.
I find records of it quite often.

Name: Jean
Text:
People now see the Kiguru Tribe as a hostile race,
but history says they weren't always like that.

Name: Jean
Text: <Yellow>Humans might be the reason they turned hostile.</>

Name: Jean
Text:
Part of why I stay here is…
…to collect evidence of things like that.

Name: Jean
Text: Cleaning up dirty political messes is an old man's duty…

Name: Jean
Text:
You don't need the details.
It'll only leave a bitter taste in your mouth.

Name: Jean
Text:
*sigh.* I should plant more beacons.
Put one at the entrance and another at the exit of the Hallowed Mountain.

Name: Jean
Text:
I need to check if they're working well,
so go play with the Kiguru Tribe for a bit.

Name: Jean
Text: The signals pick up clearly when those things are stomping around.

Name: Jean
Text:
Good work.
The new beacons are running perfectly.

Name: Jean
Text: This would be easier if the Gate Guard actually did their patrols.

Name: Jean
Text:
Have you ever talked to them?
They’re even more stubborn than I am.

Name: Jean
Text: Protecting the gate from the Kiguru should be excuse enough to watch this place, right?

Name: Jean
Text: Yet they just stay hunkered down right in front of the gate. Tsk.

Name: Jean
Text:
They follow orders well, so I suppose they're good soldiers.
But I doubt that actually translates to protecting the weak.

Name: Jean
Text: This time, I need you to really pick a fight with the Kiguru.

Name: Jean
Text: I can lure them so they charge toward the gate.

Name: Jean
Text:
It’s only temporary…
But if we use an <Blue>Aether Detonator</>, we can draw their attention there.

Name: Jean
Text:
<Yellow>Don't worry about what comes after.
As long as we both keep our mouths shut, no one will know.</>

Name: Jean
Text: Thank you, hee hee.

Name: Jean
Text: I’m just an old man waiting for my end. I need at least this much fun.

Name: Jean
Text:
The guards will be busy soon.
Consider it my surprise gift to their boring lives.

Name: Jean
Text:
Leave quietly, like nothing happened.
No matter what kind of blast you hear, don't look back.

Name: Parnayia
Text: Skybound…!

Name: Parnayia
Text: There are so many Rappies here, but I can’t see you anywhere…

Name: Parnayia
Text:
I miss you so much.
I can’t bring myself to do anything.…

Name: Parnayia
Text: …I was mourning a friend who left me recently.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
I thought we’d be together forever,
but fate took them in an instant.

Name: Parnayia
Text: <Yellow>Skybound was the nickname of my first and last Rappie.</>

Name: Parnayia
Text:
I cant stop thinking about my little Rappie…
I’ve let everything go... I’m just letting the days slip by.

Name: Parnayia
Text: …Perhaps you’re right.

Name: Parnayia
Text: If I stay busy, maybe I can stop thinking about Skybound.

Name: Parnayia
Text: All right. There’s plenty of prey out here, so I'll try to get moving.

Name: Parnayia
Text: It doesn’t seem to be helping much…

Name: Parnayia
Text: Being here only reminds me of training with Skybound.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
Rappies are naturally timid.
That’s why the trainers at the training ground send them out here.

Name: Parnayia
Text: They need to learn how to overcome their fear…

Name: Parnayia
Text: Maybe…*sigh*

Name: Parnayia
Text:
Then I’ll push myself harder.
Until I’m completely exhausted…

Name: Parnayia
Text: …My Skybound was shy even after finishing the training course.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
When I first came to adopt a Rappie…
…he was hiding behind all the others.

Name: Parnayia
Text: But those tiny, gentle eyes were just so lovely.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
The trainer was worried, but I chose him anyway.
We went on so many adventures together.

Name: Parnayia
Text: Over the years, I became quite skilled.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
But then, I let my guard down at the Giant’s Tower.
An enemy targeted my back, and Skybound…

Name: Parnayia
Text: Skybound took the hit for me… *sob.*

Name: Parnayia
Text:
Can you even imagine…
…how much pain he was in?

Name: Parnayia
Text:
I don’t know how many days have passed since Skybound left.
Maybe not days. Maybe even longer.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
But what’s the point of counting days?
I don’t even have the confidence to live on my own.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
Just leave me be.
I have no money anyway, so I’ll starve to death soon enough.

Name: Parnayia
Text: …You’re quite kind.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
Since you’ve listened to my story this far…
I’ll take your advice just once.

Name: Parnayia
Text: All right, go on.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You told Parnayia’s story to the caretaker at the training camp.)</>

Name: Tilmun
Text: It’s a typical <Blue>“Rappie Loss Syndrome.”</>

Name: Tilmun
Text:
I’ve seen many Narurus and humans hurting like you.
We trainers hurt the same way. It’s really hurts.

Name: Parnayia
Text: Rappy Loss Syndrome…?

Name: Tilmun
Text:
It’s because you cared for them so much.
It’s not a bad thing, so just accept it.

Name: Parnayia
Text: But… even if you say that…

Name: Tilmun
Text: Do you think your Rappie would like seeing you like this?

Name: Tilmun
Text:
Your Rappie would be sighing over and over!
Thinking, "That human still hasn’t pulled themselves together!"

Name: Parnayia
Text: I never thought of it that way.

Name: Tilmun
Text: Your Rappie would’ve wanted you to be happy until the very end.

Name: Tilmun
Text:
Then you should show them that!
If you’re talking about dying, your Rappie can’t rest in peace.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(That’s some intense shock therapy.)</>

Name: Tilmun
Text: Go on, get some fresh air!

Name: Tilmun
Text:
I’ll let you borrow a Rappie from the ranch.
Ride like you used to with your own.

Name: Tilmun
Text: Quickly, now! Go!

Name: Parnayia
Text: All right… stop pushing!

After hesitating, Parnayia looked at the waiting Rappie,
then bolted forward as if she had made up her mind.

Name: Parnayia
Text: That was the first time I’ve ridden a Rappie since Skybound left.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
I feel like I’m cheating…
Is that a strange way to put it? Haha…

Name: Parnayia
Text: It makes me wonder if Skybound was watching.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
I’ve been acting so pathetic…
Maybe he looked away because he didn't want to see me like that.

Name: Parnayia
Text: Because Skybound wanted me to keep living.

Name: Parnayia
Text: I should go back and talk more with the trainer.

Name: Tilmun
Text: Human, you finally understand your Rappie’s heart.

Name: Tilmun
Text:
Never forget Skybound’s sacrifice, sacrifice.
Live to the end, and keep memories with Skybound.

Name: Parnayia
Text: …Yes, I’ll do that.

Name: Tilmun
Text: We have a special <Blue>Farewell Ritual</> at the ranch. Want to try it?

Name: Parnayia
Text: A farewell ritual?

Name: Tilmun
Text:
It’s for the Rappies who returned…
…to the arms of the goddess Ea.

Name: Parnayia
Text: Come to think of it… I couldn’t even gave Skybound a proper funeral.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
I want to do that farewell ritual.
I’ll definitely do it!

Name: Tilmun
Text:
Then you’ll need a horn and some flowers.
Make sure they’re in good condition.

Name: Tilmun
Text:
There’s a watermill humans use…
The flowers blooming in front of it have the most beautiful colors.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
Is there a connection between the two?
A horn and flowers…

Name: Tilmun
Text:
You weave the flowers into a crown and place it on the Rappie’s head.
Skybound isn’t here, but doing it in your mind is enough.

Name: Parnayia
Text: You mean a flower crown.

Name: Tilmun
Text:
And grind the horn into a fine powder.
Then, let it flow toward God Ea.

Name: Tilmun
Text: Yes. It’s a gift, asking her to take good care of them.

Name: Tilmun
Text:
Once you have everything, come to the broken bridge outside the ranch.
We’ll say our goodbyes, goodbyes there.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
I understand… It doesn’t sound too hard.
I’ll go find them.

Name: Tilmun
Text: Go to the edge of the fence and let the powder scatter slowly.

Name: Tilmun
Text:
The wind will carry it to God Ea.
Then, offer your prayer.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The scattering powder drifts into the wind, rising high into the sky.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It will surely reach the realm where God Ea is…)</>
Parnayia stood on the bridge with a calm expression.

She couldn’t lift her head for a long time.
When she finally returned, she was rubbing her tear-stained eyes.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
Thank you both…
Thanks to you, I can keep Skybound in my heart forever.

Name: Parnayia
Text: <Yellow>I’ll be with Skybound, always.</>

Name: Tilmun
Text: There are others at the ranch suffering from the same loss syndrome.

Name: Tilmun
Text:
Go back and talk to them.
It’ll help put your mind at ease.

Name: Parnayia
Text:
I should do that.
I want to recover quickly and show everyone I’m doing well!

Name: Tilmun
Text: Let’s head back to the ranch together.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Good to see a familiar face.
Where have you been all this time? What have you been up to?

Name: Lorraine
Text: Since you're so favored by the divines, I'm sure you've been busy.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It's gotten so hard to run into you these days.
It pays to have someone like you around.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Hmm, how many days a year do I even spend at the legation?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
An Archon should survey the field themselves.
Just reading documents handed over by adjutants won't change a thing.

Name: Lorraine
Text: The “Pulsing Ridge” isn't Frantian territory.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
But each nation agreed to assign Archons…
…to oversee the zones bordering our nations.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I haven't had the time due to the Incursion,
but now I plan to see everything with my own eyes.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
You probably know the ridge better than I do, right?
Help me with this survey, and I'll reward you handsomely.

Name: Lorraine
Text: This is where the largest settlement is, isn't it?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
There must be a reason people chose this place…
…instead of the Frantia Gate.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I have a hunch, but I should hear it firsthand.
Go and hear what the locals have to say.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I'll scout the center of the village,
so you cover the outskirts.

Name: Grumbling Resident
Text: I settled here because I was tired of wandering.

Name: Grumbling Resident
Text:
But the Ironblood Brigade never stops crawling out,
and the Kiguru Tribe keeps on stealing our things.

Name: Grumbling Resident
Text:
At least Hesperia formed its own Defense Guard,
and even sends out scouting parties, which gives us some peace of mind.

Name: Grumbling Resident
Text:
As for the Frantia Gate... Ugh.
I don't even want to talk about it.

Name: Reminiscing Old Man
Text: I like it here. The people are honest and hardworking.

Name: Reminiscing Old Man
Text:
I used to scrape by near the gate because I missed my hometown.
But people there were hard-hearted.

Name: Reminiscing Old Man
Text:
It's not like the soldiers were doing much to protect us, either.
Wooden dummies would've done a better job.

Name: Reminiscing Old Man
Text:
What good is looking polished on the outside?
The <Orange>Knights of the Northern Wind</> are doing all the dirty work anyway.

Name: Opportunistic Resident
Text: What's there to worry about?

Name: Opportunistic Resident
Text:
Where people gather, money follows.
This place will only keep growing.

Name: Opportunistic Resident
Text: It will lead to plenty of chances to strike it rich.

Name: Opportunistic Resident
Text:
Honestly, the only decent Waypoints in the ridge are…
…here and the Frantia Gate, right?

Name: Opportunistic Resident
Text:
The other side is just full of gloomy soldiers.
They also charge hefty taxes under the guise of protection.

Name: Opportunistic Resident
Text:
It's nothing more than a military base.
What kind of business can you run there?

Name: Opportunistic Resident
Text:
Even the merchants who set up shop there—
have already cut backdoor deals, you know?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You've heard plenty of opinions... Time to organize them.)</>
ItemDesc:
- Investigation Topic: Reasons for settling in Hesperia
- Response 1: Public security and safety
- Response 2: Overall atmosphere
- Response 3: Favorable commercial district, low taxes

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This report looks presentable enough to submit to a high-ranking official.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You should explain the rest to Lorraine in person.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(We split up here... Where did she go?)</>

Name: Lorraine
Text: The Defense Guard won't lock you up for making a little noise.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I've already cleared it with Xavier, the village representative.
Let's comb the area and identify any vulnerabilities.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Before that, did you find out what I asked you?

Name: Lorraine
Text: ...Hmm.

Name: Lorraine
Text: We can look into our doubts about the Frantia Gate later.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Right now, stabilizing Hesperia has to be the top priority.
Only then can the residents continue to build it up.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
If these external threats keep up,
we'll just be bleeding resources.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Look down the cliff.

Name: Lorraine
Text: It might look like a sheer drop... but it can't protect the village.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
If someone invents decent climbing gear,
even an ordinary adventurers could scale it.

Name: Lorraine
Text: So imagine how easy it'd be for monsters with long, sturdy claws.

Name: Lorraine
Text: They just aren't smart enough to think about finding the path yet.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Until we have the means to put up fences or walls,
thinning out the nearby monster population is our best bet.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I'll need to discuss this with <Orange>Xavier</>.
For now, clear out as many as you can.

Name: Lorraine
Text: It seems they lack the resources to even build proper defense infrastructure.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It requires enclosing not just the village, but the forest below as well...
That's going to be a massive undertaking.

Name: Lorraine
Text: And fending off the <Red>Kiguru Tribe and the Brigade</> at the same time is impossible.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Since Hesperia's population is steadily growing,
he suggested it would be better to reinforce the scout patrols.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I can lean on the homeland to secure more supplies.
Assuming Hesperia holds out until then.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Since the supplies are for people of unclear nationality,
red tape and legalities will undoubtedly get in the way.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
So folks like you and me just have to roll up our sleeves and do it ourselves.
That's the most reliable method, isn't it?

Name: Lorraine
Text: By the way, this place hardly lives up to its name.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
With a name like Thunderfall,
you'd expect lightning to be crashing down.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It implies a deafening roar occurs frequently here...
I need to find out what's causing it.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It could be the booming sound of monsters, 
so try provoking them to see how they react.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Isn't the terrain peculiar?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
This must be one of the lowest points in the ridge.
Even though it's wedged between Hesperia and the Hallowed Mountain,

Name: Lorraine
Text: the earth here looks like it was completely gouged out.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It's highly unlikely this formed naturally.
Humans, or something equally intelligent, must have had a hand in it.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Seeing how you're focusing on the local boss,
I take it the normal monsters didn't give you much to work with?

Name: Lorraine
Text: I suppose the noise from the Thunderbirds could pass for thunderclaps now.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
But the name “Thunderfall Falls” is much older than that.
Records date back to around the time the barrier was built.

Name: Lorraine
Text: What could possibly make a sound loud like a thunderclap?

Name: Lorraine
Text: Right, there was that explosion near the Hallowed Obsidian Mountain recently.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
If the flow of Aether was disturbed, we can't just ignore it.
I'll have my adjutants gather some data.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Let's assume there was an explosion and look again.
Meet me at the end of the waterway.
