Name: Lorraine
Text: Kiddo, are you out here all by yourself?

Name: Corin
Text:
I'm not a kiddo!
I'm <Orange>Corin</> of the Bardad Expedition.

Name: Corin
Text:
I can use magic too, so don't underestimate me!
I made it all the way out here by myself.

Name: Corin
Text: I’m just… small for my age…

Name: Lorraine
Text: My mistake. I apologize.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Still, it's dangerous to be wandering around without an escort.
There's a swarm of monsters right behind you.

Name: Corin
Text:
You want me to walk away from a structure like this?
For a geologist, this place is a treasure trove!

Name: Corin
Text: It's surrounded by highlands, yet this spot looks like it's been bitten off.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
This adventurer and I are investigating the exact same thing.
Perhaps we could share our findings.

Name: Lorraine
Text: I'm quite curious about the source of those thunderclaps.

Name: Corin
Text:
You're much politer than the people who looked down on me, saying it was dangerous.
Well, you seem reasonable. I accept.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
You go scout the perimeter.
Keep an eye out for anything unusual.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Why is there a bridge here? The water doesn’t look deep.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Maybe I'll find out once I cross it. Let's go.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You see an old structure through the brush on the other side.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Ancient ruins? Maybe it’s an Imperial design.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It's crumbling and half-buried in dirt. Hard to identify.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Huh? What's a notebook doing in a place like this...?)</>
ItemDesc:
The pages are bloated from water damage,
and most of the writing has washed away.
It needs professional restoration.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You should bring this to the Archon.)</>

Name: Lorraine
Text: I thought it was an unfinished bridge, but was it meant for this cave?

Name: Corin
Text: The entrance gives it away.

Name: Corin
Text:
With these stairs and lanterns,
it's clearly a man-made cave.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It just looks like a shallow stream to us,
but to some others, it might feel like raging rapids.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
That bridge was built specifically to lead people into this cave.
It all makes sense now.

Name: Corin
Text: Hm? What's that in your hand?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Who knows?
That battered old thing could be a relic from a bygone era.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It's so ruined I can't read a single word.
And restoring it'll take time.

Name: Corin
Text:
Here, hand it over.
I can take it to the Bardad Expedition Garrison.

Name: Corin
Text:
We actually have an appraiser there right now.
They've been bored lately, so they'll probably dive right in.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Would you mind? I appreciate you taking it off our hands.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Thanks to you, we also learned that these explosions are an ongoing issue.
No wonder... I thought this area was unusually low.

Name: Corin
Text: Well, this is just basic knowledge for me.

Name: Corin
Text:
The garrison is full of meatheads... Ugh.
Anyway, leave it to me.

Name: Corin
Text:
The Bardad Expedition Garrison is in the northeast part of the ridge.
It’s just opposite the Maelstrom Strand.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
You aren't going into the cave?
I'd think a geologist would find it fascinating.

Name: Corin
Text:
It's time for my shift change with another member.
Personal research is important... but duty calls.

Name: Corin
Text:
I'll be stationed in the ridge for quite a while,
so I can just come back on my day off.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Understood.
I'll head there once we wrap up our investigation here.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Judging by that foul stench, nobody lives here.
It's likely become a den for monsters.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Still, it's odd for it to smell this bad.
Maybe the air inside isn't circulating?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Standing here overthinking it won't help.
We need to get in there and make some noise to flush them out.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
They'll instinctively retreat toward the outside.
If we watch which way they run, we can pinpoint the exit.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Looks like they have no intention of leaving the cave after all.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Given how chaotic this monster cluster is,
it's surprising they aren't fighting amongst themselves for territory.

Name: Lorraine
Text: That means they've learned it's safer inside than out... Hmm.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I'm going to need to assemble a proper investigation team.
This could be caused by an Aether entanglement or Leyline interference.

Name: Lorraine
Text: For now, let's just record what we can see.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Push deeper inside slowly and look around.
I'll re-examine the entrance.

Name: Lorraine
Text: If you run into trouble, call for me immediately.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I may have retired long ago,
but I still have enough fight left in me to save an adventurer! Hahaha.

Name: Lorraine
Text: There are pickaxe and shovel marks at the entrance.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Seeing that a natural cave had formed inside,
they must have carved out a space wide enough for people to pass through.

Name: Lorraine
Text: It seems refugees used this as a hideout before moving on to a new place.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Or perhaps they were chased out.
Given that their supplies were left behind, it's likely the latter.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Well, it was built so long ago it's hard to tell when.
This cave is actually in relatively decent shape.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I doubt it's hundreds of years old.
It was probably in use until Hesperia was founded.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Well... I suppose some adventurers might actually find it their style.
That is, if they enjoy camping out with monsters.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I've slept among corpses before,
but never beside monsters.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Heh, I'm just joking.
Who knows what could happen.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Shall we wrap up our little cave tour and head out?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Ah, but we should do one last sweep first.
I feel much better when the groundwork is properly laid.

Name: Lorraine
Text: I'm talking about our legation's investigation team.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
For a team that claims to brave hazardous areas, they're awfully flimsy.
As their superior, I ought to help them out a bit.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Clear out a few more, then head out.
I'll meet you outside.

Name: Lorraine
Text: There's one more place with “Thunderfall” in its name.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
The flatlands between the Adamant Ascent and Thunderfall Falls.
The place the gate guards have entirely given up on.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Let's go see what secrets are hiding there.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It’s further away than you expected, but this seems to be the right place.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Lorraine is examining something near that building in the distance.)</>

Name: Lorraine
Text:
This is leveled perfectly and smoothly carved.
No need to overthink this one.

Name: Lorraine
Text: They flattened this area specifically to build something massive.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Unfinished flooring, half-built walls, and pillars...
And someone who looks like the site supervisor—

Name: Lorraine
Text: Wait, who is that?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Judging by their clothes, they aren't an adventurer.
I need to tell them to back away. It's dangerous.

Name: Irpan
Text:
You're here to tell me to leave, aren't you?
Well, I, <Orange>Irfan</>, refuse to go.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Ha. You catch on quick.
Care to explain why?

Name: Irpan
Text:
Some of my seeds haven't germinated yet.
I'm not leaving until I see them bloom.

Name: Irpan
Text: This is a matter of pride for a botanist...

Name: Irpan
Text:
Even without Aether accelerators! If you pour enough heart into it!
Flowers can bloom anywhere!

Name: Irpan
Text: Not wildflowers like these!

Name: Irpan
Text:
I planted them here, there, and over there too.
Do you know how much effort that took?

Name: Irpan
Text: Go and look for yourself if you don't believe me!

Name: Irpan
Text: See? Do you see how much care I've put into this?

Name: Irpan
Text:
I planted seedlings brought straight from Enkia.
They're special beauties that shimmer in seven colors.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Enkia has entirely different soil.
A strain that grows there will have a tough time surviving here.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Enkia's lands have a dense concentration of Aether. 
As a result, anything living there has a high Aether affinity.

Name: Lorraine
Text: That's why so many renowned combat priests hail from Enkia.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
And plants are no exception.
Those seven-colored flowers he planted are probably similar.

Name: Irpan
Text:
It is true they require a lot of Aether.
It’s to the point you'd need to hire an adventurer to funnel energy into them.

Name: Irpan
Text:
But I believe in their will to survive.
I won't abandon my research just because it's difficult.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I understand your thirst for knowledge, but you're putting me in a tough spot.
Are you with the Bardad Expedition, by any chance?

Name: Irpan
Text: Yes, I am... but the Captain gave me permission for this!

Name: Lorraine
Text: I am <Orange>Archon Lorraine of the Frantia Legation</>.

Name: Irpan
Text: A-An Archon...?

Name: Lorraine
Text: I don't really want to pull rank and kick you out.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
But I have a duty to keep everyone here safe.
Which means I can't just let you wander around alone.

Name: Lorraine
Text: So, how about we make a deal? What do you say?

Name: Irpan
Text: A deal? With me?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
You provide me with information about the Thunderfall Ridges.
Does that sound fair?

Name: Irpan
Text:
You could have asked for a lot more.
Is that really all?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Since I'm the one telling you to leave,
the information I'm asking for should be limited to this area, too.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I'm currently surveying the entire ridge.
I have to see it with my own eyes to properly map it out in my head.

Name: Irpan
Text: Even so, you came out here to do the surveying yourself?

Name: Lorraine
Text: The most foolish commanders are the ones who give orders based entirely on paperwork.

Name: Lorraine
Text: The Forsaken Land is always stained with blood.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
If I want to minimize casualties caused by my decisions,
I need to have a proper grasp of the battlefield.

Name: Irpan
Text: I see... that makes a lot of sense.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
You've probably been in and out of this place more than I have,
so getting your advice will definitely speed up my schedule.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Consider it a win for both of us.

Name: Irpan
Text: Hmm, well, what I do know is that this area was originally a temple site.

Name: Lorraine
Text: A temple? A temple, you say.

Name: Irpan
Text: Before I go into detail... do you mind if I finish my work first?

Name: Irpan
Text:
I need to clear out the monsters so they don't trample the seedlings,
and I also need to drive away the foul energy.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
My investigator here will help you out with that.
They were just starting to get bored anyway.

Name: Irpan
Text: The Archon is currently measuring the Aether levels.

Name: Irpan
Text:
She mentioned it's her first time actually seeing a temple.
It seems like she wants to inspect it thoroughly while she has the chance.

Name: Irpan
Text:
Frantia doesn’t worship gods.
With magitech so advanced there, it's even more natural.

Name: Irpan
Text:
Honestly, I only read about it in an archaeologist's records myself.
It might not even be a temple, really.

Name: Irpan
Text:
The scholar specifically emphasized the locations of these buildings...
I found that part a bit strange, too.

Name: Irpan
Text:
They must have had a reason to pray to the gods here.
They wouldn't have built temples just because they had resources lying around.

Name: Irpan
Text:
If it were built out of deep faith, wouldn't they have built it somewhere more sacred,
and in a better location?

Name: Irpan
Text: Why start construction in such a dangerous place…?

Name: Irpan
Text:
Well, it's definitely an interesting topic, but...
We should finish up the rest of the work.

Name: Irpan
Text:
This magic device contains a substance that monsters avoid.
Please place it over where the seedlings are planted.

Name: Irpan
Text: Thanks to your help, I think we can actually expect some flowers to bloom this time.

Name: Irpan
Text:
The Archon is looking for you.
Let's meet again if the opportunity arises.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Whether it was left unfinished or destroyed later on...
I wonder if I'd feel differently had I seen it completed.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Its design holds a lot more intent than you might think at first glance.
Since that intent is unclear, its true purpose remains a mystery to me.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
The temples seem clustered around the gates, but...
If you look at the bigger picture, they're actually facing the barrier.

Name: Lorraine
Text: They're lined up like a belt... wrapping right around it.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
But temples aren't built to protect barriers.
As far as I know, their main purpose is for prayer.

Name: Lorraine
Text: A situation where people sought gods despite having such an impenetrable wall... hmm.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Right, there must have been people who couldn't make it inside.
Even at the very moment the barrier was being built.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
<Yellow>"They sought the gods to escape the monsters of the tower."</>
That's a very plausible theory.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
You've brought up a perspective I hadn't considered.
Since I don't believe in gods, I never would have thought of it that way.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Rather than just objective facts about this place,
I should focus on recording the various opinions people have about it.

Name: Lorraine
Text: I was planning to just measure the Aether levels and move on to the next area, but...

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Haha, just how wildly have you been fighting?
The monsters are charging at us in a total frenzy.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I'll try taking the measurements again, so buy me a little time.
The device went dead and wasn't working properly.

Name: Lorraine
Text: No use. It can't even pick up the faintest reading—it's completely broken.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
There's no one in the Gate's defense force who can fix something like this.
I guess we'll have to go find <Orange>“Jean</>.”

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It's a very delicate piece of equipment, so getting a replacement right away won't be easy.
It's best to leave the repairs to an expert.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Jean is currently working with the Knights of the Northern Wind.
Let's head over to the Encampment on Adamant Ascent.

Name: Jean
Text: You show up after all this time and just demand that I upgrade this thing?

Name: Lorraine
Text: I just came to the best Magitech Engineer I know.

Name: Jean
Text:
Hah... what a stubborn piece of work.
That awful personality of yours only gets worse with age.

Name: Jean
Text: Anyway, what happened to your lieutenants? Why did you bring an adventurer here?

Name: Lorraine
Text: I sent two back to the homeland, and the other is at the Stormkel Legation.

Name: Jean
Text: You sound awfully proud to be bragging about planting spies.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Where do you think the Frantia Legation gets all its intelligence?
It's all thanks to my lieutenants working day and night.

Name: Jean
Text:
Tsk, Now I know why I had a bad dream last night.
It was an omen that I'd get dragged into something bothersome.

Name: Jean
Text: Fixing it isn't hard, but I can't get to it right away.

Name: Jean
Text:
I already have a commission.
I'll only have time to fix your gadget once that's done.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I can wait.
I'm officially on vacation right now, so no one will come looking for me anyway.

Name: Jean
Text:
Then I want payment upfront.
I'm going to borrow this adventurer of yours for a bit.

Name: Jean
Text: You'll be waiting a lot longer if this old man has to do everything himself.

Name: Jean
Text:
If you want to be freed from Lorraine anytime soon, you'd better help me out.
I won't make you do anything too difficult.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I don't mind, so go right ahead.
I'd be more than happy to catch up with some old comrades in the meantime.

Name: Jean
Text:
The destination is the Rappie Training Ground.
Let's get a move on.

Name: Jean
Text:
Did you say you wanted a way to detect monster movements quickly?
I brought along something I have that does exactly that.
ItemDesc:
A magic device that Jean personally upgraded and supplied to the Knights of the Northern Wind.
It detects the flow of Aether and sends a signal to the user.
It's difficult to use from too far away.

Name: Jean
Text: Humans do generally use it to detect intruders.

Name: Hammu
Text: How... how do you use it? Tell me!

Name: Jean
Text:
First, you set up the signal device where the monsters are.
Then, you just keep an eye on the connected terminal.

Name: Jean
Text:
See this slow blinking light here?
The more dangerous the situation, the faster it flashes.

Name: Hammu
Text: Hmm... do I have to keep staring at it the whole time? Continue?

Name: Jean
Text:
It also lets out a loud beep at the same time.
You'll be able to hear it all the way from here to the other end of the ranch.

Name: Hammu
Text:
No, no!
The Rappies will get scared if they hear the sound!

Name: Hammu
Text: Can you... can you change it to smell instead?

Name: Jean
Text: It's not impossible, but it's going to require a lot more preparation.

Name: Jean
Text:
You'll need to regularly bring me a substance…
…with a scent only the Naruru Tribe can detect.

Name: Hammu
Text: I'll be fine! As long as the Rappies can stay safe! I'll do anything!

Name: Jean
Text:
First, we need to find a good spot to set it up.
Go on ahead and clear the area so so nothing interrupts us.

Name: Jean
Text:
Just head to the ridges north of the ranch.
I'll head straight down to the lower area, so meet me there when you're finished.

Name: Jean
Text:
There's an awful lot of junk lying around the area that touches the citadel.
Perfect for monsters to smash apart.

Name: Jean
Text:
The fragments fly off and often end up lodged right in the signal device.
If we aren't careful where we install it, it'll break in no time.

Name: Jean
Text:
Make sure you guard me well while I look for a safe spot.
Unlike Lorraine, I don't have the strength to fight.

Name: Jean
Text:
Good work.
You hold your own much better than I expected.

Name: Jean
Text: Now it's time to modify the terminal that receives the signal.

Name: Jean
Text:
Condensing a scent-producing substance,
and converting it into magic-device fluid requires some highly advanced skills.

Name: Jean
Text:
Not that I can't do it, of course.
In fact, I'm one of the few who can.

Name: Jean
Text:
Go find our client—the Naruru—and tell him to hand over whatever he's prepared.
He should have the scent he was asking for.

Name: Jean
Text: I'll be resting back at the ranch for a bit.

Name: Hammu
Text:
I found a smell while you were gone!
Here, it's right here.

Name: Hammu
Text:
This smells really prickly to the Naruru,
but the Rappies can't smell it at all! Not even a little bit!

Name: Hammu
Text: That way, we'll know right away when the bad guys are running around.

Name: Hammu
Text:
Delicious smells would only confuse them anyway.
This is perfect! Absolutely perfect!
ItemDesc:
A beautiful flower known to be a type of poisonous weed.
It can be used as a medicine if mixed in the proper dosage.
It seems to make a Naruru's nose tingle whenever they smell it.

Name: Hammu
Text: I packed a whole box full of it, so take this to Jean!

Name: Jean
Text:
I was just thinking about heading over there myself.
You arrived right on time.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain about the flowers Hammu gave you.)</>

Name: Jean
Text: Hmm... That Naruru was quite knowledgeable.

Name: Jean
Text:
The Purple Snakegourd has quite a few uses.
As long as only a small amount is ingested, detoxifying isn't too difficult.

Name: Jean
Text:
I knew it had no effect on the Naruru Tribe or the Rappies...
But it seems their sense of smell reacts differently to it.

Name: Jean
Text:
A prickly smell, eh?
If he wants a clear notification, I suppose I should oblige.

Name: Jean
Text:
I'll take care of the rest from here.
I can't exactly leave the prototype work to you, too.

Name: Jean
Text:
The tools I need are back at the Knights' Encampment, so I'll be heading back now.
You can just send Lorraine over here; she's probably just idling about anyway.

When you explain to your client, the Naruru named Hammu, that it will take some time,
he allows you to take a look around the Rappie Training Ground.
When you eventually return to the Training Ground entrance, Lorraine is waiting for you.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Are you completely finished with the Naruru Tribe's commission?
Jean returned to the Encampment looking quite satisfied.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
He was even mumbling to himself about hiring you as his assistant.
I hurried over here because I was afraid of losing my capable investigator.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Now, it's time to investigate the territory of the <Blue>old kingdom of Qaradia</>.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
We need to see if it's suitable as a home for migrants or refugees.
I need to evaluate its overall livability.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Just west of the Rappie Training Ground, there's a bridge that connects to that old citadel.
Let's head over there first.

Name: Lorraine
Text: In all this vast land, Hesperia is the only proper place to live, right?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It's my duty to make this area livable.
We need to keep expanding homes for those without power.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
This whole area once belonged to Qaradia.
Even the ruins beyond the bridge and the Ironblood Brigade's current hideout.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
When their kingdom was destroyed in the war,
the subjects fled down to this far edge of the land and barely survived in hiding.

Name: Lorraine
Text: But it wasn't long before they lost their homes to criminals and monsters.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
We can easily clear them out, of course,
but rebuilding all the collapsed structures is going to cost an absolute fortune.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I'm going to need to get an estimate on it.
If you see any monsters along the way, rough them up and drive them off.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(There are so many of them that a full-scale subjugation might be necessary.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Should I head back?...)</>

Name: Unfamiliar Voice
Text: H-Hey, is anyone out there? Please, help me!

Name: Bastian
Text:
Phew, I can finally catch my breath.
I am a historian by the name of <Orange>Bastian</>.

Name: Bastian
Text:
I came here after hearing a rumor that Qaradian artifacts were hidden in the area...
But I ended up completely isolated like this.

Name: Bastian
Text:
The colleagues I came with turned back, complaining there were too many monsters.
I stayed behind to see if there was anything I could do...

Name: Bastian
Text:
But now I'm completely out of food and water,
and the monsters keep chasing me, almost as if they've memorized my scent...

Name: Bastian
Text: I thought I was a goner for sure, but then you showed up, adventurer!

Name: Bastian
Text: Please help me grab just a few of my things before we leave... Please.

Name: Bastian
Text:
I left everything that looked worth researching on the bridge.
Please recover only those.

Name: Bastian
Text:
You just need to check the bridge connecting the buildings.
You should be able to spot them pretty easily.

Name: Bastian
Text:
I don't know what the architectural style of the Qaradia Kingdom was like,
but I can't tell any of these buildings apart at all.

Name: Bastian
Text:
They all just have blue roofs and pale walls.
It's the perfect place to get completely lost.

Name: Bastian
Text: So I figured it'd be much better to leave them somewhere easy to spot.

Name: Bastian
Text:
If I got attacked by monsters while wandering around, not sure whether I left them in this house or that one, it would the end.
After going to all the trouble to find those artifacts in the first place!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What incredible professionalism.)</>

Name: Bastian
Text:
For now, I'll just wait here quietly.
I feel like I'd just be a liability if I tagged along with you.

Name: [player]
Text: (The bridge between the buildings... This must be the bridge Bastian was talking about.)

Name: [player]
Text: (You should quickly retrieve the artifacts before the monsters get in the way.)
You carefully bring down the artifacts placed on the bridge.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(There are some in that building over there, too. Let's retrieve them just like we did before.)</>

Name: Bastian
Text:
That's amazing!
You definitely don't seem like an ordinary mercenary...

Name: Bastian
Text: I can sense a tremendous aura from you, just based on the fact that you came out here alone.

Name: Bastian
Text: It's such a shame. If I had enough research funds, I would have happily hired you for another request.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Thanks to you, I can finally get out of this place.
I just hope the monsters don't follow us...

Name: Bastian
Text:
I'm going to try and slip out towards the western outskirts.
Please escort me just until we get there.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
The number of monsters has noticeably decreased.
I assume my capable investigator went a little wild?

Name: Bastian
Text:
Adventurer! Adventurer!
Please explain the situation to this person!

Name: Bastian
Text: I'm not a thief, and I'm certainly not a lackey for the Ironblood Brigade!

Name: Lorraine
Text: I caught him because he was sneaking around suspiciously, like a sewer rat.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I didn't realize he was someone you actually knew...
What exactly happened?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain Bastian's situation to her.)</>

Name: Bastian
Text:
It's the truth. Please believe me!
I am merely a wandering historian!

Name: Bastian
Text: *sigh* If I get dragged off to the Legation, I'll lose precious research time...

Name: Lorraine
Text:
A historian, you say? Haha, I was just messing with you.
You really shouldn't wander around a place like this all alone.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I want to take you somewhere safe,
but I can't just move out without giving my companion a heads up first.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Were the two of you investigating this area together?
No wonder you both seemed far from ordinary.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Could I accompany you somehow?
There are still so many places left to explore.

Name: Lorraine
Text: It's good that you're full of passion... but there's a condition.

Name: Bastian
Text: A condition?

Name: Lorraine
Text: Let's head up first. We're done here.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
You said you were a historian, right?
You seem to know a lot about the Qaradia Kingdom.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I'm curious about the historical facts and the cause-and-effect behind these ruins.
It would be even better if you had your own interpretations or perspectives.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
In exchange for helping with the excavation, give me that information.
You can keep all the artifacts, too.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Only a fool would decline such an opportunity.
I accept... your offer!

Name: Bastian
Text:
It looks like the commission has been extended.
You just need to cover me until the investigation is complete.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I'll take a look around inside as well.
I suspect there might be differences from the eastern zone.

Name: Bastian
Text:
The yield isn't as much as I'd hoped.
The <Red>Ironblood Brigade</> hasn't already looted everything, have they...?

Name: Bastian
Text:
Bandits only go after gold coins or weapons anyway.
They wouldn't recognize things of high historical value.

Name: Bastian
Text: Hmm, ahem... It might just be because I got lost.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Honestly, it felt like I was walking in circles.
I'll pull myself together and take another look.

Name: Bastian
Text:
I thought I might be revisiting places I'd already investigated,
So I went ahead and marked every door.

Name: Bastian
Text:
This time, instead of walking in circles,
I was able to focus and search every nook and cranny.

Name: Bastian
Text:
And so I found a few samples in excellent condition!
It's a huge relief that my superiors won't confiscate them.

Name: Bastian
Text: If I were with the Bardad Expedition or the Appraisers Guild, of course—

Name: Bastian
Text: Huh? That look on your face. You really didn't know.

Name: Bastian
Text:
There's no benefit to being affiliated with an organization.
Other groups always try to buy the ownership rights, too.

Name: Bastian
Text: I, too, had a headache over that issue back in Frantia.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Whenever I felt like I was on the verge of a discovery, it was taken away,
and when I acquired things myself, the higher-ups just took them.

Name: Bastian
Text:
I was in a tough spot because of other tangled issues as well,
so I just made up my mind and quit.

Name: Bastian
Text: I'm unaffiliated and travel alone now, but it's much more comfortable.

Name: Bastian
Text: I used to work at a research institute in the Frantia Kingdom.

Name: Bastian
Text:
I was leaving the lab after finishing my work as usual.
Someone had dropped a document in the hallway.

Name: Bastian
Text: I simply picked it up and reported it as lost property to the affiliated knight order...

Name: Bastian
Text:
And they cornered me, asking if I had stolen it!
I never expected the knight order to act like that.

Name: Bastian
Text:
It's in the past, but it still baffles me.
Phew... That's enough of that. Let's go see the Archon.

Name: Lorraine
Text: I believe I gave you plenty of time. Did you find all the artifacts?

Name: Bastian
Text:
With this much, I don't think I'll be able to leave the lab for half a month.
I'm so excited I want to head back immediately, haha.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Where are you staying right now?
If we're heading in the same direction, I'll take you there.

Name: Bastian
Text:
I'm staying at a waypoint for the Bardad Expedition Encampment.
It's right in front of Maelstrom Strand.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Are you planning to head that way?
I'll put in a good word so you can stay comfortably.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I'd appreciate that.
I was taking a lap around Pulsing Ridge anyway.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
That should be my final destination.
What does the Investigator think?

Name: Bastian
Text:
It's perfect since we'll have time to talk with the Archon on the way.
I'll tell you everything I know.
Guided by Bastian, we arrived at the waypoint for the Bardad Expedition Encampment.

Name: Bastian
Text: There really isn't anyone you could call a manager here.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Nominally, the expedition's Deputy Commander is in charge,
But I haven't met them once.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Everyone just does their own research, and occasionally we eat together.
We also look after each other if someone gets hurt.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Simple, right?
There are no rules other than not causing harm to one another.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I understand.
It seems to be a gathering place for free-spirited youths.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It was nice to hear your stories on the way here.
Sounds like you were working under some truly rotten bastards, huh?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
That doesn't mean everyone who works for the kingdom is bad, though.
Most are good-hearted and always worry about the subjects.

Name: Bastian
Text: You're right... I was just unlucky to get caught up with power-hungry fools.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
That's exactly why I volunteered to be an Archon.
Because no one sees someone posted to the border as a threat.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Shouldn't we nip those who could ruin the country in the bud?
We need to slowly tighten the noose.

Name: Bastian
Text:
I-Is it really okay for you to say these things to me?
I'm nothing but a mere scholar...

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It's fine. I intend to make you one of mine.
I'm very fond of passionate and sharp-minded people.

Name: Bastian
Text:
...As long as you meet my conditions.
I'm ready to dig up every inch of the ridge.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Haha! We should talk over some warm tea.
Investigator, you should go greet the others.

Name: Irpan
Text: We meet again. Thank you for last time.

Name: Irpan
Text:
The prismatic flower hasn't bloomed yet,
but we'll get results if we wait a little longer.

Name: Irpan
Text:
It will successfully grow naturally even without injecting Aether.
Because it's a species overflowing with vitality.

Name: Irpan
Text: I'm conducting a similar experiment on this beach.

Name: Irpan
Text:
They’re growing so well this time that...
I've even formed a hypothesis that they might cover the entire beach.

Name: Irpan
Text:
Absorbing salt to take root...
This is a topic that could cause a huge sensation in the academic world.

Name: Irpan
Text:
However, the problem is that the monsters eat up the flowers.
So the experiment progress has been slow.

Name: Irpan
Text:
If you help me again this time, I'll prepare a reward.
I'm counting on you, Investigator.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>...Is it because no one lives here? This coast gives off a strange vibe.</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>First, let's look for the monsters Irfan mentioned.</>

Name: Irpan
Text:
The assistant chosen by the Archon really is something else.
To think you flawlessly completed such a small commission.

Name: Irpan
Text:
If you're looking for another commission,
try speaking to Corin, who is playing by the water.

Name: Irpan
Text: He’s been at it for days. I'm worried he might doze off and fall into the water.

Name: Corin
Text:
If you also came here to say there's nothing here,
and that it's a waste of time, then go away.

Name: Corin
Text:
The seawater is being sucked in somewhere.
There must be a sunken area...

Name: Corin
Text: I'm telling you, there's an artificial trench not far from here!

Name: Corin
Text:
Haa, I'm sorry.
I've been staying up all night observing this anomaly.

Name: Corin
Text:
You might not be able to see it on the surface,
but the current wasn't originally this fast.

Name: Corin
Text:
Besides, the sea level is gradually dropping.
That means the seawater is draining somewhere far away.

Name: Corin
Text:
Whirlpools are forming here and there...
Things like this don't happen naturally.

Name: Corin
Text: This is what I've recorded. Please give it a read.
ItemDesc:
1 An explosion occurred under the sea.
2 A concave pit created due to the impact of #1.
 * Probably not as deep as a trench.
3 Intermittent whirlpools sighted while observing changes in the ocean current.
4 Continuous drop in sea level.
5 Increase in monster population along the beach.

Name: Corin
Text: Ugh... I really can't do this anymore. I'm at my limit.

Name: Corin
Text:
I'm going to get some shut-eye for a moment, so... 
Could you check on a few of the rowboats?

Name: Corin
Text: I marked the height to track how much water is draining.

Name: Corin
Text: Just compare them and let me know... Yaaawn...

Name: Corin
Text: When you're done... come back to the base and wake me up...

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The water level looks lower than the mark painted earlier.
(He did say the water was slowly draining out.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(At first glance, it sounds like a conspiracy theory about the Frantia Kingdom...
Is this something worth reporting to Archon Lorraine?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It would be best to talk to Corin again first...)</>
<Yellow>(It'll be hard for him to reach a clear conclusion when he's falling asleep.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It's better to give him some time to get a good sleep.
Let's warm up in the meantime.)</>

Name: Corin
Text:
I just woke up, but...
Phew, I don't feel rested at all.

Name: Corin
Text: How were the results? I just hope there haven't been any changes.

Name: Corin
Text:
This is no longer something I can just observe and drop on my own.
It's been following the same trend for months.

Name: Corin
Text: First, I should notify the Bardad Commander and the Frantia Legation.

Name: Corin
Text: Archon Lorraine is here? Where?

Name: Corin
Text:
That person was <Orange>Lorraine</>?!
Oh no, I didn't even know, and I acted like that back then...

Name: Corin
Text:
I'll go tell her about this incident right away!
Thank you for your help.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Lorraine seems popular wherever she goes.
Does she have a good reputation as an Archon?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I wonder if Bastian is done talking... Let's go find him.)</>

Name: Bastian
Text:
My meeting with Lorraine went well.
Thankfully, she said she would sponsor me.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Since joining the Legation would expose me to various dangers,
we decided to avoid anything that would make myself a target.

Name: Bastian
Text:
I was moved by her attentiveness...
I feel like I've finally met a truly wonderful adult!

Name: Bastian
Text:
Besides, she also told me to work you to the bone, Investigator.
Do you happen to have some time?

Name: Bastian
Text: I'm trying to examine the Aether reaction of the artifact I acquired this time.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Depending on the results, the direction of the value assessment will change.
You just need to infuse it once, adventurer.

Name: Bastian
Text: How is it? Do you feel anything from the artifact?

Name: Bastian
Text:
Then this must not be an object.
I'll assume it's an everyday item.

Name: Bastian
Text:
There are <Yellow>forty-five</> left now.
You can just keep going like you did just now.

Name: Bastian
Text:
That's too many, isn't it?
I can't keep making you waste Aether, adventurer.

Name: Bastian
Text: In this case, we can simply extract Aether from nature!

Name: Bastian
Text:
It's a method that takes quite a long time,
But waiting is a given for a scholar.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Aether dwells within any organism.
The same goes for monsters.

Name: Bastian
Text: Shall we try to obtain Aether from monsters in a “natural” way?

Name: Bastian
Text:
For the record... hunting by predators isn't a bad thing at all.
You don't need to feel uncomfortable about it.

Name: Bastian
Text: The Aether must have scattered into the air and ground from your previous work.

Name: Bastian
Text:
As time passes, a condensation point will form,
and we just need to observe the artifact's reaction at that point.

Name: Bastian
Text:
We'll have to wait at least four days.
Of course, I don't plan on asking for your help until then!

Name: Bastian
Text:
I heard from Lorraine.
There's a renowned Magitech Engineer in the Knights of the Biting Wind!

Name: Bastian
Text:
She said we could just request magic tools from him.
She even provided her handwritten signature on an official document.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Jean is going to be annoyed again...)</>

Name: Bastian
Text:
I've organized everything we need into a list...
Could you deliver this?

Name: Bastian
Text: The Archon said he's quite shy around strangers...

Name: Bastian
Text: Thank you! I'll be sorting the artifacts in the meantime.

Name: Jean
Text:
Why did you come looking for this old man again?
Hah! No doubt this is Lorraine's plan.

Name: Jean
Text:
Given her background as a knight, she's got good stamina for her age.
Where is she wandering off to that she keeps making you run errands?

Name: Jean
Text:
Whatever, just hand over what you're holding.
You'll pester me until I do it anyway.

Name: Jean
Text: Hmm... It's not a particularly difficult request.

Name: Jean
Text: I'll make a tool that can temporarily anchor the Aether.

Name: Jean
Text:
The principle is the same as a warp conduit.
It'll lose its function after one use, but that's the limit.

Name: Jean
Text: Aether is the power of the stars.

Name: Jean
Text:
No matter how much Magitech advances,
we just can't control nature itself.

Name: Jean
Text:
I'll head up there as soon as the tool is complete.
Just make sure to clear the installation site properly.

Name: Jean
Text:
I thought the Archon was taking a rare outing...
Is she doing a lap around the ridge or something?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Exceptional talent is meant to be shared with those around you.
Contribute a bit to making this a better place to live.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Besides, protecting the weak is chivalry, isn't it?
You're part of the knight order, so you must follow that.

Name: Jean
Text:
You sure have a smooth way with words.
Spoken truly like an Archon of the Legation.

Name: Jean
Text:
Poor me.
This is why you should choose your friends wisely.

Name: Jean
Text:
Phew... You cleared the ground like I asked, right?
Deliver it to the guy who asked for it.

Name: Jean
Text: I enclosed the manual, so tell him to make sure he reads it.

Name: Bastian
Text: Ooh! You're saying this can anchor the Aether for a moment?

Name: Bastian
Text:
To think Magitech has advanced this much... is amazing.
I want to try it right away! Let's head to Flay-Stone Reef!
The magic tool Jean crafted sparkled as smoke billowed.

As a white haze scattered around,
the Aether started to feel denser.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Even I, a non-adventurer, can sense a strong aura!
I need to start the experiment right away.

Name: Bastian
Text:
Thank you for your help.
Please tell Lorraine that everything is proceeding without any issues.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Is that so? I'm glad it worked out well.
It seems most of the urgent matters here have been resolved, too.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
You've worked hard, Investigator.
Thanks to you, I was able to travel around and properly examine things.

Name: Jean
Text:
Catching the Archon's eye... You're going to suffer continuously.
You should learn how to politely turn things down.

Name: Jean
Text: Because she never leaves capable people alone.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I have no intention of doing that, so don't be scared.
Because it's obvious you're someone who will achieve greater things in the future.

Name: Jean
Text:
On that point, we agree.
Let this person roam free like they are now.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Haha! That's for sure.
Since you're a precious guest of the Frantia Legation, I'll stop working you so hard.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Call me whenever you need help!
I wish you luck on your journey ahead.

Name: Katrina
Text:
I am Katrina.
The Drill Instructor of the <Blue>Verzard Outpost</>.

Name: Katrina
Text: I heard you assisted Commander Marten with the new recruits...

Name: Katrina
Text:
It's definitely not nothing!
Do you have any idea how hard it is to train a decent recruit these days?

Name: Katrina
Text:
You see...
<Red>I absolutely despise it when soldiers run away after I've painstakingly trained them.</>

Name: Katrina
Text: ...And that includes watching them die in vain.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Carefully suggest she speak with the Commander about it.)</>

Name: Katrina
Text: You don't actually think he'd listen to reason, do you?

Name: Katrina
Text: <Yellow>Between trying to convince a stubborn superior and just taking matters into my own hands, which do you think is better?</>

Name: Katrina
Text: I knew an Adventurer like you would understand.

Name: Katrina
Text:
In that case, there's an issue the recruits have been struggling with.
Could you lend a hand?

Name: Katrina
Text:
Please thin out the monsters near the entrance.
They've been hurting rookies.

Name: Katrina
Text:
Thanks to you, we have one less thing to worry about, Adventurer.
The recruits will be grateful as well.

Name: Katrina
Text: It'd be a shame to part ways after just one favor.

Name: Katrina
Text:
In Stormkell, when someone helps you twice,
we call them <Orange>comrade</>.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I never heard anything like that, even from Ragnar...?
Give her a skeptical look.)</>

Name: Katrina
Text:
I'd like to call you my comrade, Adventurer.
Please hear me out before you decide.

Name: Katrina
Text:
Truth is, I'm rewriting the 'Recruit Training Manual'.
And I could really use an outsider's perspective.

Name: Katrina
Text:
I've been stationed here for a decade...
At this point, everything feels pretty much the same.

Name: Katrina
Text:
So, I was wondering if you could take a look around the outpost,
And find something that might actually catch the recruits' interest?

After saying yes, I opened the training manual.
It contained information on the training grounds, standard-issue gear, and the quartermaster.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let's look around the training grounds first.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I should suggest add something about the observatory to give them a better understanding of the base.)</>

Name: Quartermaster
Text: Yawn. Who the hell are you?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Introduce myself and explain the situation.)</>

Name: Quartermaster
Text:
So you've been helping out Katrina!
She might seem strict, but she deeply cares for others.

Name: Per
Text:
The name's Per.
I handle the supplies for the outpost.

Name: Per
Text:
The geyser keeps things relatively warm around here,
But it gets freezing the closer you get to the gate.

Name: Per
Text: If you are looking for something to give to new recruits, good <Blue>winter gears</> are definitely the way to go.

Name: Per
Text:
Oh, I know!
I'll whip up a quick prototype for you to show Katrina.

Name: Per
Text:
As for the materials... the beasts near the entrance will do just fine!
You just hunt 'em down, and I'll handle the rest.

Name: Per
Text:
Haha, good work!
Give me just a second.

Name: Per
Text:
There, what do you think?
Looks toasty right off the bat, doesn't it?
ItemDesc: These gloves look so cozy I almost want a pair for myself.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(They look a bit like bear paws, but they do seem warm.)</>

Name: Per
Text:
Hand these over to Katrina.
I'm certain she'll love them!

Name: Katrina
Text: Did you finish reviewing the manual?

Name: Katrina
Text:
I'm curious to hear your thoughts.
I'm already looking forward to your feedback.

After mentioning what I wanted included in the training manual,
I handed over the gloves made by the quartermaster.

Name: Katrina
Text: Having an outsider's perspective certainly makes the content richer.

Name: Katrina
Text:
I'll finish it up and hand it out to the new recruits.
I should also put in a request in advance to have the gloves crafted.

Name: Exhausted Carpenter
Text:
Ugh, my aching bones.
You're not just going to leave, right? Right?

Name: Finn
Text:
Just call me Finn.
Adventurer, do you see that pile of firewood over there?

Name: Finn
Text: I hauled every last piece with these scrawny arms of mine!

Name: Finn
Text:
But instead of letting me rest, they expect me to repair the bridge, too.
<Yellow>Who's going to take responsibility if I work myself to death?!</>

Name: Finn
Text:
You'll help me? Really?
You're way better than those stuck-up soldiers.

Name: Finn
Text: Please grab some firewood from over there and stick them into damaged spots.

Name: Finn
Text:
Thank you, Adventurer.
Actually, I have one more favor to ask.

Name: Finn
Text: Do you happen to have any <Blue>artistic inspiration</>?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I sculpted a Naruru statue once.
The Artisan Guildmaster gave me some harsh feedback...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I think he said, "This is just a lump of rock!"...)</>

Name: Finn
Text: <Yellow>Oh, so this is your inspiration at work, Adventurer?!</>

Name: Finn
Text:
In an emergency, it could even be used for self-defense.
I can't believe you made something so handy!
ItemDesc: I put more effort into it this time.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(But it's supposed to be a Naruru...)</>

Name: Finn
Text:
You know how skilled Stormkell artisans are, right?
I'll take it upon myself to mass-produce these.

Name: Startled Man
Text:
Gah! Wh-who goes there?!
What are you doing all the way out here?

Name: Startled Man
Text: D-don't tell me you're here for the <Blue>legend</> too...?

Name: Startled Man
Text:
You're the first person I've met who hasn't heard of it.
Where are you from?

Name: Tory
Text:
I see.
I'm <Orange>Tory</>. I serve as a cook here.

Name: Tory
Text:
I've been rejected so many times, but I really want my confession to work this time.
That's why I came all the way out here.

Name: Tory
Text: I'm so desperate, I'm actually clinging to some silly legend.

Name: Tory
Text:
<Yellow>Shout the name of your beloved,
fly to the other side, and your love will come true!</>

Name: Tory
Text: They say the louder you shout, the better it works.

Name: Tory
Text:
I can't really tell if I can fly that far.
Could you test it out for me, Mercenary? Please!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(When I waved from the other side, Tory shouted back, asking me to take care of the monsters.)</>

Name: Tory
Text:
No one in their right mind would refuse.
That's for sure.

Name: Tory
Text: Ah... Th-that's...

Name: Tory
Text: ...But you have to promise to keep it a secret.

Name: Tory
Text: The truth is, I've had a crush on the Drill Instructor for a long time.

Name: Tory
Text:
Her unwavering resolve, the way she looks after every single recruit...
Not to mention her incredible strength... How could I not fall for her?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(By Drill Instructor, does he mean Katrina?
He said it's a secret, so I should play dumb.)</>

Name: Tory
Text: Anyway... I'll be sure to let you know if the confession goes well.

Name: Suspicious Soldier
Text:
You're a mercenary, right?
Don't ask how I know. It's written all over your face.

Name: Kari
Text:
Call me Kari.
You should at least know the name of your client.

Name: Kari
Text: A fun one. Way better than whatever the Commander makes you do.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I nodded, figuring I might as well hear her out.)</>

Name: Kari
Text:
Glad to see you're not a total stiff.
Then just follow these instructions. It shouldn't be too hard.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I unfolded the note from Kari.)</>
ItemDesc:
1. Head outside the base.
2. Meet up with Ulf.
3. Scout out a good campsite in the Geyser Field.
4. Report to Ulf.

Name: Kari
Text:
Piece of cake, right?
What do you say? Are you up for it?

Name: Kari
Text:
Ulf is waiting outside the base.
He's a quiet guy with gray hair.

Name: Kari
Text:
Just drop my name and he'll know why you're there.
If he plays dumb, just <Yellow>dance</> in front of him.

Name: Kari
Text:
He won't be able to help himself; he'll start dancing too.
Then he'll get all embarrassed and blurt out, <Yellow>'Did Kari send you...?'</>

Name: Kari
Text:
You said you'd give it a shot.
You're not backing out now, are you?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I nodded, remembering the golden rule: 'A mercenary always finishes the job.')</>

Name: Kari
Text:
I was starting to get disappointed!
Don't scare me like that. Now hurry up and go.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Is that Ulf standing over there?
Judging by the hair, it's gotta be him...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(No way around it. Time to dance.)</>

Name: Ulf
Text:
Many apologies, Mercenary.
But I had to be absolutely sure.

Name: Ulf
Text:
...Kari's got plenty of drive, but she can be a bit careless.
Well, it doesn't matter. Let's move on.

Name: Ulf
Text:
I need you to investigate the nearby geysers.
I checked out a few spots myself, but I'm still on the fence.

Name: Ulf
Text: I need to know if the water is warm enough, how the monsters are behaving, and if there's a good place to rest...

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(This spot is a dud.
Way too close to the base for a campsite.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This spot is definitely much better.)</>

Name: Ulf
Text:
You're back.
Did you find a decent spot to make camp?
I told Ulf about the last geyser I investigated.

Name: Ulf
Text:
Thank you.
I need to hurry back and pack with Kari.

Name: Ulf
Text:
You could say we're eloping.
If we stay here, it's only a matter of time before we end up dead.

Name: Ulf
Text: <Yellow>To the Commander, recruits are nothing more than meat shields.</>

Name: Ulf
Text:
Kari came all this way just to be with me.
I have to keep her safe, especially since we're getting married.

Name: Ulf
Text: If our paths cross again, I promise to repay this debt.

Name: Jovial Blacksmith
Text: Hey you, over here.

Name: Yunu
Text:
I'm Yunu.
The youngest and most talented blacksmith in the entire base.

Name: Yunu
Text:
Have you ever heard of the <Blue>Ethereal Sanctum</>?
Ever been there?

Name: Yunu
Text:
Heh, I had a feeling we'd get along.
Then I need you to track down the Ethereal Sanctum for me.

Name: Yunu
Text: I've got plans to make something absolutely incredible.

Name: [player]
Text: This has to be the Ethereal Sanctum Yunu was talking about. Better head back and tell him.

Name: Yunu
Text: Oh, back already? Where is the location?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I gave him the location of the Ethereal Sanctum.)</>

Name: Yunu
Text:
You have no idea how long I've waited for this day.
Whoops, no time to celebrate yet.

Name: Yunu
Text:
I need your help with a little side hustle.
Head to the Geyser Field and bring me back some monster hides.

Name: Yunu
Text:
Thank you so much!
Now, let's get down to business and brew this love potion.

Name: Yunu
Text:
It's called a <Blue>Record Disc</>, you've heard of it, right?
Those big, round, plate-looking things.
ItemDesc: It's an artifact filled with ancient records.

Name: Yunu
Text: I snagged one from the Ethereal Sanctum while you were out there working for me.

Name: Yunu
Text:
I figured it would just be another artifact blueprint,
but it actually had the recipe for a love potion!

Name: Yunu
Text:
So obviously, I had to make it immediately.
Huh? Now that I think about it, I never caught your name.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He'll probably just rope me into more chores if I tell him, so I'll pass.)</>

Name: Yunu
Text:
That's a shame.
But I won't give up until I figure it out!

Name: Ninda
Text:
Hu-man!
Listen to Ninda, hurry up!

Name: Ninda
Text: I, Ninda, am worried about the future of the hot springs. So worried.

Name: Ninda
Text:
Are you a Northerner, you Northerner?
So cold-hearted, heart like a block of ice?

Name: Ninda
Text:
Humangs like money, lots and lots of money.
<Yellow>They say you'll do anything, anything for money!</>

Name: Ninda
Text:
You were gonna do it anyway! Why did you play so hard to get!
You're mean, so mean.

Name: Ninda
Text:
Humang! Go get some water, water.
See the bubbling, steaming spot over there?

Name: Ninda
Text: Put it, put it in here! Got it, Hu-man!

Name: Ninda
Text:
You're back, back!
<Yellow>Give it! Give it all to me!</>
After gulping down all the water I brought, Ninda asked for a moment to think.

Name: Ninda
Text:
Hmm, hmm...
I smell it, I smell it... <Yellow>I smell money!</>

Name: Ninda
Text: I've decided, this is the one!

Name: Ninda
Text:
<Yellow>A secret recipe passed down from my granny's granny, and her granny's granny!
I show it to you!</>

Name: Ninda
Text:
It opens, opens up your nose and soothes, soothes your throat!
Look at the bubbles, bubbles! Here, drink up!
ItemDesc:
A special drink made with 
Ninda's granny's granny's granny's granny's secret recipe.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(No point asking if she's joking...)</>

Name: Ninda
Text: H-human! Are you doubting, doubting my granny's, granny's secret recipe?!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It won't kill me, right...?
It's probably just water, so here goes nothing.)</>
To think that water can become such strong liquor... Ishinu at Sunset Brewery would probably be anxious.

Name: Ninda
Text:
How is it? Amazing, isn't it?
Take one, take one! As a thanks!

Name: Ninda
Text:
Hu-mang! One more, one more job!
On the hon-ore, the hon-ore of <Orange>Fluffy-Hair</>!

Name: Ninda
Text:
Ho… Ho-nore! Yeah! That, that’s a thing!
If you're like Schulmann over there, it's <Red>ruin, all ruin</>!

Name: Ninda
Text:
I worked hard, hard to build this!
<Yellow>Customers must come! Lots, lots of them!</>

Name: Ninda
Text:
See?
Must be safe, safe here!
ItemDesc:
A flyer hand-drawn by Ninda.
Might actually be quite proud of it.

Name: Ninda
Text:
Then we must punish those bad, bad guys first, right?
Go, Hu-mang!

Name: Ninda
Text:
Good, very good!
I'll make a special, special dish too!

Name: Ninda
Text: Go out and get grass! Pretty colored ones, all the pretty ones!

Name: Ninda
Text:
But I had an idea, an idea just now!
I, Ninda, will definitely, definitely make a special dish!

Name: Ninda
Text:
<Yellow>Just you wait!</> 
I, Ninda, will make something you've never seen before!

Name: Ninda
Text:
I’ll sell it with a secret, secret drink!
I'm the best Fluffy-Hair, the best!
ItemName: A Special Pie Topped with Flowers
ItemDesc:
Familiar-looking pie.
A taste better left forgotten comes to mind.

Name: Ninda
Text: I'll make this hot spring a total success! Success!

Name: Schulmann
Text: I saw Ninda giving you a hard time.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
If it had been possible, I wouldn’t be here.
I have to do what he told me to.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
I told him I couldn't see well.
Then he suggested putting up lights!

Name: Schulmann
Text:
But I'm no <Orange>Angry Tail</>.
How am I supposed to steal shiny things from monsters?

Name: Schulmann
Text: I'll end up returning to Ea just listening to him nagging.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>Ninda love for this hot spring is real.
Fine, one last time.)</>

Name: Schulmann
Text:
...You actually brought them?
Ninda didn't threaten you, did he?

Name: Schulmann
Text: Honestly, I didn't think you'd help.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
People here are restless and busy.
Many soldiers run away, many recruits die...

Name: Schulmann
Text:
…Thanks, anyway.
Stop by for a soak next time.

Name: Karl
Text: Supply shipments to the outpost have been thinning out lately.

Name: Karl
Text:
The duty logs blame the monsters,
but I find that hard to believe.

Name: Karl
Text:
More than a few soldiers are heading to see Astrid,
and I doubt they’d go to her empty-handed...

Name: Karl
Text: It would be best if you checked the <Blue>Gray Forest</>.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Kuduru had a history of taking Naruru’s offerings to the Giant’s Garden.)</>

Name: Karl
Text:
To think it was actually the monsters...
I almost misjudged Astrid.

Name: Karl
Text: I’ll report this to the outpost as well.

Name: Penya
Text: I'm Penya, a field medic.

Name: Penya
Text: I haven't been at this post long, but as you can see... the air is a bit thick here.

Name: Penya
Text: The expedition leader is overly cautious and hates it when things get complicated...

Name: Penya
Text:
But those things don't matter to me.
My job is saving lives, after all.

Name: Penya
Text: Have you ever seen anything like this?
ItemDesc:
Candy made from finely crushed Aetherium powder.
Despite its appearance, it has a sweet and highly addictive flavor.

Text:
Explain what happened at the Giant’s Garden,
mentioning the Aetherium candy given out by the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Penya
Text: This is more than just a rumor, then.

Name: Penya
Text: There have been frequent reports of the <Red>Paradise Advent Society presence</> in the Gray Forest...

Name: Penya
Text:
I can’t have them causing trouble there.
Please go see what they're up to.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Much cleaner than where the Kuduru were.
There are building materials and supplies here...)</>

Name: Penya
Text: How was it? Did you find anything?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Reports that the Paradise Advent Society wasn’t there, but supplies and Aetherium candy were found.)</>

Name: Penya
Text:
…Hmm, it seems you’ll have to meet him.
I didn't want things to come to this.

Name: Penya
Text: Neither Karl nor Marten will move without solid evidence.

Name: Penya
Text:
Caution is good.
<Yellow>But do you think that helps in a place like this? In the Forsaken Land?</>

Name: Penya
Text: While the superiors hesitate, it’s the trainees and recruits who die....

Name: Penya
Text: …Running into the Paradise Advent Society is no different.

Name: Penya
Text:
I don’t know who they are, but they came here all the way to this wasteland.
It suggests they're up to no good.

Name: Penya
Text:
I'll give you the details over the communicator.
Too many eyes here.

Name: Penya
Text: First, go to the Gray Forest and gather more <Blue>Aetherium candy</>.

I informed Penya that enough candy was collected,
who told me meet Luke near Astrid Stronghold.)

Name: Jovial-Looking Man
Text: So Penya was telling the truth about sending a useful mercenary.

Name: Luke
Text:
The name's Luke.
Penya and I are secretly investigating the Etherium candy.

Name: Luke
Text:
Because you recognized the candy.
And I heard you warned Penya about it.

Name: Luke
Text: Actions speak louder than just claiming to be trustworthy.

Name: Luke
Text:
Honestly, I don't care if you talk,
as long as we get rid of that candy.

Name: Luke
Text:
So, you in?
I’d understand if you don’t want in.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I was already tracking the Paradise Advent Society. This could be a good opportunity.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Luke's face brightened when I said I’d help.)</>

Name: Luke
Text:
...My thanks. I truly appreciate it.
If you don't mind, can I have your name?

Name: Luke
Text: A pleasure, [player].

Name: Luke
Text:
Let’s register your communicator before you go.
You never know what might happen.

Name: Luke
Text:
First…
Head to Astrid’s Stronghold. See if they’re keeping any Aetherium candy there.

Name: Luke
Text: ...And if you find any, bring back as much as possible.

Name: Luke
Text:
Good to see you’re back in one piece.
How’s it looking inside?

Report that while the supply crates were empty,
some soldiers were carrying the candy themselves.

Name: Luke
Text:
Hmm...
So, they aren't hoarding it in there.

Name: Luke
Text:
It’s hard to believe, especially after seeing the state of the Gray Forest.
Something’s fishy.

Name: Luke
Text:
They wouldn't just leave it where others can see it.
There must be a blind spot somewhere.

Name: Luke
Text: [player], do you happen to have a Glider with you?

Name: Luke
Text: I’ve got an idea. Care to hear it?

Luke suggested scouting the stronghold from the air,
sharing the situation over the communicator.

Name: Luke
Text:
Don’t worry too much.
We’ve got an insider to help you out.

Name: Luke
Text:
Name’s Zed.
A bit of an oddball, but his heart’s in the right place.

Name: Luke
Text:
Just tell him you’re working with me and Penya.
And, uh... he talks to himself a lot. Don’t let it alarm you too much.

Name: Zed
Text:
G-gah!
Who... who is it?!

Name: Zed
Text: Ah... the blessings of ties! Stronger than blood itself!

Name: Zed
Text: <Yellow>Now that I’ve accepted this grand mission, I must become a hero for everyone!</>

Name: Zed
Text: Sigh... the life of a double agent... deceiving oneself and hurting all!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Make a face that says, Get to the point.)</>

Name: Zed
Text:
Yes, yes. The <Blue>Atherium candies</> are over there.
Hidden in two different spots!

Name: Zed
Text:
I gathered every single one with my own hands!
Usually, I would carry them out with honor myself, but...!

Name: Zed
Text:
Since there’s no one here to handle such a dangerous task,
I will leave the escape to you.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I might lose my mind if I stayed longer.
Better just take the candy and leave. Fast.)</>

Name: Zed
Text: It's quite a distance. You'd better fly there.

I told Luke that the candy has been recovered.
He asked me to return it to his location.

Name: Luke
Text:
Good work, [player].
Now we can speed up the disposal.

Name: Luke
Text:
Hey, [player].
So... what do you think? Doesn't it look better than the outpost?

Name: Luke
Text: Tsk... materials, weapons, supplies. They're incredibly well-equipped.

Name: Luke
Text:
Marten could learn a thing or two here...
Anyway, I need you to do one more job with Zed.

Name: Luke
Text: I'm sure he has everything ready by now.

Name: Zed
Text: Oh, we meet again?

Name: Zed
Text:
As expected... you are but a lamb
who could not not forget my brilliant professional sense.

Name: Zed
Text: Basking in such luxury, the outpost hasn't crossed my mind even once.

Name: Zed
Text:
All that remains is the hunger of the recruits, who were once my brothers-in-arms.
I only feel the heavy responsibility to feed them...!

Name: Zed
Text: Ha! And so, I found a way. A peaceful way of <Blue>sharing</>.

Name: Zed
Text:
Look!
These supplies are screaming for someone to take them!

Name: Zed
Text:
Whatever do you mean...?
This is 'self-directed acceptance of sharing'.

Name: Zed
Text:
Sigh... let me teach you.
<Yellow>This is what justice and exclusivity look like.</>

Name: Zed
Text: See? Good things should always be shared.

Name: Zed
Text: <Yellow>Hehe. Righteous acts must remain hidden from the world.</>

Name: Zed
Text: Please don't tell Luke that I was the one behind this.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...What is he talking about? I'm the one who stole them.)</>

Name: Luke
Text: Haha. Looking at your face, I don't even need to ask what happened.

Name: Luke
Text:
Truly, well done, [player].
You’ll be a real hero to those recruits.

Name: Helena
Text: Would you do me a favor?

Name: Helena
Text:
As you can see, many here are unwell.
It’s a struggle just to keep them warm.

Name: Helena
Text:
We’ve been using branches to cover the tents,
but we’re running short.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Ask about using leather or fur.)</>

Name: Helena
Text: Most are patients with weak stomachs, so they can't bear the scent of hide.

Name: Helena
Text: There are plenty of trees outside. Please gather some branches and leaves for us.

Name: Helena
Text:
This should be enough.
If you don't mind, help me cover the tents with these.

Name: Helena
Text:
Thank you.
You've truly put my mind at ease.

Name: Apathetic Scholar
Text:
We meet again.
Sigh... I suppose I should tell you my name now.

Name: Yvette
Text:
It’s Yvette.
I’ve always been a gloomy soul, but it’s only gotten worse here.

Name: Yvette
Text:
Every time I start my research, someone dies.
Every time I check the records, someone falls ill...

Name: Yvette
Text: Look at you. Even your face looks darker than when we first met.

Name: Yvette
Text:
Sigh... Since I'm not much for sweets,
Helena suggested I <Yellow>get moving instead</>.

Name: Yvette
Text:
You seem to be in the same boat.
Shall we at least give it a try?
Before there was time to refuse, Yvette pulled me into a dance.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Maybe she was a bright person after all.
She looks more energetic than before.)</>

Name: Yvette
Text:
That was better than I expected.
Perhaps doing things together is better than being alone...

Name: Yvette
Text: I should try this with the others as well.

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
Hey, adventurer!
Word on the street is you're pretty tough.

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
Let’s see what you’re made of.
I want to see how you persuaded that stubborn old soul.

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
How did you know?
But... hunting is the only way to prove your strength!

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
You really are a strange one.
I can't exactly challenge you to a duel here, can I?

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
This place is already packed with patients!
So stop talking and go hunt some monsters outside.

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text: O, Of course, I'm coming too!

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
What are you talking about?
<Yellow>Weren't you supposed to be some righteous adventurer?!</>

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
You really are a strange one.
I can't exactly challenge you to a duel here, can I?

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
This place is already packed with patients!
So stop talking and go hunt some monsters outside.

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text: O, Of course, I'm coming too!

Name: Poisoned Adventurer
Text:
W-What...?
You sneaky... slipping out while I was still getting ready?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He probably never intended to go, but I'll keep that to myself.)</>

Name: Sorik
Text: I, Sorik, shall await our next true match!

Name: Piriz
Text:
Hello, adventurer. I'm Piriz.
You're friends with Vahista, right?

Name: Piriz
Text: As you can see, <Orange>Vahista</> isn't in any condition to be doing much.

Name: Piriz
Text: She puts on a brave face, but she’s probably rotting away on the inside...

Name: Piriz
Text:
But! Someone has to step up.
We can't all just sit around and mope.

Name: Piriz
Text: We set up camp in such a remote spot that it’s beyond freezing.

Name: Piriz
Text: I grew up in Enkia, so coming here makes me feel like I’m turning into an icicle.

Name: Piriz
Text: Ugh, before I freeze to death, I need more firewood and monster hides.

Name: Piriz
Text:
Whoa... you're a lifesaver.
I wish you could stay here forever!

Name: Piriz
Text: Vahista strangely only picks research projects that get zero funding.

Name: Piriz
Text:
We're right next to the ruins but can't even use them.
So, I’ve decided to change direction.

Name: Piriz
Text: While Vahista walks the path of a gourmet, I want to walk the <Blue>path of entertainment</>.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Give a confused look as Piriz reveals a set of blueprints.)</>

Name: Piriz
Text:
Those ruins over there...
don't they look like the perfect spot for an obstacle course?

Name: Piriz
Text: Everything is ready, but I haven't had a chance to do a test run.

Name: Piriz
Text: If you don't mind, please give it a try and tell me what you think!

Name: Piriz
Text: How was it? Pretty fun, right?

Name: Piriz
Text:
I'm so glad!
The nearby village is just as gloomy. I really needed a breath of fresh air.

Name: Piriz
Text: Since you say it's fun, I should give it a try myself.

Name: Umun
Text:
Ugh, disappointed... so disappointed!
<Yellow>Hu-mang is a liar, a liar!</> Umun was tricked!

Name: Umun
Text: Great discovery, they said. They recruited explorers.

Name: Umun
Text: I raised my hand because I want to be a <Orange>Shiny-Head</>, a Shiny-Head protecting the world!

Name: Umun
Text:
F, forget I said that!
Hu-man isn't supposed to know yet. Promised, promised Kima.

Name: Umun
Text:
But no one cares about those ruins.
<Orange>Gilbert</> always went, went there with me.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Explain as clearly as possible that Gilbert has passed away.)</>

Name: Umun
Text:
··· ···
He was a true, true explorer.

Name: Umun
Text:
Said he would <Yellow>stand at the peak, the peak of gastronomy</>.
Together, together with Captain Vahista.

Name: Umun
Text:
...Must walk my own path, but lending a helping paw
is also what a Shiny-Head must do.

Name: Umun
Text:
I want to give the Captain a gift.
Find ingredients that I need for the path of gourmet.

Name: Umun
Text:
Don't tell him I gave it, never ever!
<Yellow>Promise, it's a promise!</>

Name: Vahista
Text:
··· ···?
What is all this?

Name: Vahista
Text:
With almost no combat personnel, gathering ingredients has always been a struggle.
I'm in your debt again.

Name: Vahista
Text: …Thank you, [player].

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Vahista looks happy.
I should let Umun know.)</>

Name: Umun
Text: How was it? Did the Captain like it?

Name: Umun
Text:
This brings me closer, even closer to being a Shiny-Head, right?
Thanks, Hu-man!

Name: Desperate Voice
Text: <Yellow>Mercenary! Mer-ce-na-ry!</>

Name: Desperate Voice
Text:
Really?
I doubt you'll feel that way once you hear the situation.

Name: Desperate Voice
Text:
A mess would be better.
At least I could make an excuse for that.

Name: Desperate Voice
Text:
I'm Las.
Gale’s peer and an administrator.

Name: Las
Text:
Sigh... but the thing is,
I lost his <Blue>seal</>.

Name: Las
Text: <Yellow> That damn Tesseract! If only it wasn't for that...!</>

Name: Las
Text:
…Do you have any idea how important that seal is?
Without it, a permit is just a scrap of paper.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Come to think of it, my own permit... was made with Gale's seal.)</>

Name: Las
Text: What if it falls into the hands of the Paradise Advent?

Name: Las
Text: Could you take responsibility if the owner of the seal dies an unjust death?!

Name: Las
Text:
You wouldn't say that if you knew the Gate Captain.
Oh, two perfectly fine administrators are about to die!

Las begged desperately, pointing out a few likely locations.
He made sure to add that I must find it before things get worse.

Name: Las
Text:
If you succeed, I'll issue you a <Blue>Formal Permit</>.
Please, I’m counting on you, okay?

Name: Las
Text:
I knew I could count on you!
I suppose I should keep my promise, too.

Name: Las
Text: Here is your Formal Permit.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Complains that it looks exactly like the temporary permit.)</>

Name: Las
Text:
You shouldn't judge things by their look.
This one has been specially processed.

Name: Las
Text: Since I'm already indebted—well, I might as well throw away my shame too.

Name: Las
Text:
I can't just sit idly until the soldiers arrive.
I've been an administrator for ten years, after all.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Weren't you just saying you’re in big trouble because you lost the seal...?)</>

Name: Las
Text:
Many people get stranded here.
Even the <Blue>Red Flares</> from the Wayfinders Guild are useless...

Name: Las
Text: Everything is white as far as the eye can see. It's easy to keep circling the same spot.

Name: Las
Text: So after much thought, I decided to deploy carrier pigeons.

Name: Las
Text:
You think so too, don't you, Mercenary?
But I’m an administrator, so physical labor isn't really my strong suit...

Name: Las
Text:
This kind of work is best left to someone like you, mercenary.
I’m no different from a new recruit.

Name: Las
Text:
Please, be a lifesaver and help us out.
Incursions also happen frequently around there.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This place should do.)</>

Name: Las
Text: *sigh* I wonder when our soldiers will ever pick up that kind of expertise...

Name: Las
Text:
You should give our scouts a lesson sometime!
I'll make sure to secure your payment from the Gate Commander in advance.

Name: Gerda
Text: If you still have business here, could you do me a favor?

Name: Gerda
Text:
As you can see, most of the people here are administrative staff—
highly valued even in Stormkel.

Name: Gerda
Text:
But with the Incursions and the Paradise Advent Society appearing,
our valuable human resources have been put in danger.

Name: Gerda
Text: So, with the help of the craftsmen, we made a <Blue>Self-Defense Device</>.

Name: Gerda
Text: I'd like you to test it out before we distribute it...

Name: Gerda
Text: What do you say? I'll pay you handsomely.

Name: Gerda
Text:
Take a look at this.
<Yellow>And keep in mind that its safety isn't guaranteed yet.</>
ItemDesc:
※ This artifact takes effect immediately upon installation.
※ An area with a clear line of sight is better than a blind spot.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Should I install it here?)</>
ItemDesc:
The artifact given by Gerda.
You should install it as instructed in the user manual.

Name: Gerda
Text:
You made it back alive...?
Don't tell me the sample didn't work.

When Gerda gives you a puzzled look,
you say that monsters swarmed in after installing the self-defense device.

Name: Gerda
Text: Oh, so it works perfectly.

Name: Gerda
Text:
It's a trap meant to lure monsters.
It's for mercenaries like you or soldiers who have outlived their usefulness.

Name: Gerda
Text: Hah, I don't understand why a mere mercenary is giving me that look.

Name: Gerda
Text: Thanks to you, we've confirmed that it works. Now we just need to distribute them.

Name: Gerda
Text: Do you have a better idea?

Name: Gerda
Text:
These are people who have only held paper and pens their entire lives.
Do you think they could use a weapon if we just handed them one?

Name: Gerda
Text:
This isn't an outpost.
We are administrative staff, first and foremost.

Name: Gerda
Text:
<Yellow>Stop meddling and just do as you're told.
You’re only a mercenary. Act like one.</>

Name: Gerda
Text:
Now, hurry to the forge, get the items from the craftsmen,
and distribute them to the administrators.

Name: Blacksmith
Text:
Welcome.
Looks like this one turned out to be useful.

Name: Blacksmith
Text: The bookworms here have wrists so fragile they can't even lift an axe.

Name: Blacksmith
Text:
No wonder they asked me to make something like this.
Well, I can't blame them. A lot of people have died already.

Name: Blacksmith
Text: Anyway, pack these up and take them to the supply depot.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: What is this?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain that it's a self-defense artifact that temporarily attracts the attention of monsters.)</>

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
Ah... so they finally finished it.
I understand where they're coming from, but...

The Supply Depot Administrator explained what had happened so far.
Just as the outposts are always short on recruits, the gate is short on administrators.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: Every single administrator is precious right now, so the Gate Commander's hands are tied.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
Some of them are fearless like Gale,
but most are in the same boat as me.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: Of course, there will be those who die unjustly because of this.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
But if choosing to come here as a volunteer becomes a death sentence in itself,
wouldn't that be a problem too?

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: <Yellow>In the end, what matters is how the tool is used.</>

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: ...I knew you would understand.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
We'll take care of placing them somewhere safe,
so please just clear out the monsters nearby.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
I owe you once again.
I will report this to the Gate Commander.

Name: Blacksmith
Text:
You're a mercenary, right? 
You've look like a decent person. You look like the type who can't ignore someone in need.

Name: Haken
Text:
Come to think of it, I didn't even get to introduce myself earlier.
I'm Haken.

Name: Haken
Text: Haha, don't worry, I won't ask for anything strange.

Name: Haken
Text:
I have a daughter, you see.
A child her age ought to be running free, but she can't go outside.

Name: Haken
Text:
You think I don't know that?
With the Incursions, the Paradise Advent Society, and monsters...

Name: Haken
Text: Even an adult like me feels cooped up sometimes, so imagine how a child feels.

Name: Haken
Text:
Actually, um... we used to play hide-and-seek outside whenever we had time.
But things have been pretty chaotic lately.

Name: Haken
Text:
Could you find someplace safe for us, even if it's just nearby?
It'd be even better if you could clear out the monsters, too.

Name: Haken
Text:
Oh, and could you place this somewhere that looks suitable?
It's my daughter's favorite thing.
ItemDesc:
A snowman Haken personally crafted for his daughter. 
I hope it doesn't melt while I'm carrying it...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This looks like a suitable spot.)</>

Name: Haken
Text:
Oh, you returned safely! 
Did you find a good spot to go?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain where you placed the snowman.)</>

Name: Haken
Text: Thank you. I'll finally be able to spend some quality time with my daughter.

Name: Viana
Text:
I'm Viana.
You look like a capable mercenary. Can you take a request?

Name: Viana
Text:
I need a book.
One containing the doctrines of the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Viana
Text:
Because I'm curious.
What is it that makes them follow him with such blind faith?

Name: Viana
Text:
