Even if I wanted to ask them directly,
the only ones who make it inside the gate are corpses.

Name: Viana
Text:
I have no intention of becoming a believer.
I'm literally just curious, so I'd appreciate it if you could get one for me.

Name: Viana
Text:
I'll pay you well enough.
You're a mercenary. You can do whatever you want.

Name: Viana
Text:
Oh, you got it?
Let's see what nonsense they're spouting.
ItemName: Scripture of the Paradise Advent Society
ItemDesc: A book carried by the believers containing the doctrines of the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Viana
Text:
These guys are truly wicked.
It's written in a way that people have no choice but to fall for it, isn't it?

Name: Viana
Text:
To exploit their hope that the place they escape to is a paradise...
And targeting the weak, at that.

Name: Viana
Text:
I don't know how much you know,
but not everyone who comes here is like you.

Name: Viana
Text:
Some ran away because life was too hard,
and some are criminals trying to start a new life.

Name: Viana
Text:
Well, some never change, though...
Anyway, I'll hold onto this.

Name: Viana
Text:
I'll make flyers refuting it point by point,
and hand them out to the people.

Name: Harald
Text:
I am Harald.
I'm guarding the Crossroads Shelter under the Gate Commander's orders.

Name: Harald
Text: I was just short on hands, so I'd appreciate your help.

Name: Harald
Text:
Are you good at keeping secrets?
If not, this might be a problem.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You explain that you’re a mercenary who will be leaving soon anyway,
sp there's no need to worry too much.)</>

Name: Harald
Text:
That's good.
This needs to be handled quietly, you see.

Harald said he wanted to test a medicine made by a medic… 
…on Paradise Advent Society believers

Name: Harald
Text:
As a soldier, I cannot abandon my duty.
Especially considering what the <Red>Paradise Advent Society</> is doing.

Name: Harald
Text:
The gate has lost too many people so far,
and the outpost isn't what it used to be.

Name: Harald
Text:
It's not like I don't know.
That's exactly why I hate pointing my sword at fellow Stormkel people.

Name: Harald
Text:
...I don't know where you're from,
but we grew up in a place where every single person is precious.

Name: Harald
Text: The reason most are raised as warriors is because Stormkel is just as harsh as it is here.

Name: Harald
Text: Our ancestors took up weapons to survive and hunted to forget hunger.

Name: Harald
Text:
No matter what anyone says, we... no, I...
Even if our compatriots have become believers of the Paradise Advent Society...

Name: Harald
Text:
I cannot hurt them.
Because I wield my weapon to protect them.

Name: Harald
Text: I've rambled on for too long.

Name: Harald
Text:
Try using this on the believers and let me know.
Just subdue them and make them drink it.
ItemDesc:
A new medicine made by the medic.
Its efficacy needs to be verified.

Name: Harald
Text: Welcome. Judging by your expression, it seems the medicine worked.

Name: Harald
Text:
I'm glad your hard work finally paid off.
Excellent work.

Name: Harald
Text:
While you're here, go meet the medic who made it.
It seems she’ll need your assistance.

Name: Medic
Text:
I've been wanting to meet the mercenary who helped test the new drug.
So it was you?

Name: Karis
Text:
Nice to meet you, I'm Karis.
I'm assisting Harald find ways to avoid killing if possible.

Name: Karis
Text:
You could call it an occupational habit.
I prefer saving lives over burning corpses.

Name: Karis
Text:
Well, saving them doesn't mean they'll join our side or abandon their faith,
but I do it anyway.

Name: Karis
Text:
Their lives must be so wretched to dream of a paradise that doesn't even exist.
They're to be pitied, really.

Name: Karis
Text:
Anyway, I need ingredients to make the medicine,
so please gather as much as you can.

Name: Karis
Text:
Monster blood and herbs...
Oh right, make sure the herbs you bring are <Yellow>yellow</>.

Name: Karis
Text:
They won't be easy to find, but they're the most important part.
I'm counting on you!

Name: Karis
Text:
I didn't expect you back so soon...
You certainly live up to your reputation.

Name: Karis
Text:
I can brew a substantial amount with this.
Though I’m pretty sure it’ll run out soon.

Name: Karis
Text:
I'll run a few more tests with Harald later, then send a batch to the gateway.
Let's just hope it works...

Name: Karis
Text:
Of course.
We're <Yellow>partners</> who made this together, after all.

Name: Agani
Text:
Are you a human heading to the sanctuary?
Then you must take this, take this! Agani sells!

Name: Agani
Text:
You need it for vows... no, no, for making wishes!
<Yellow>I'll give you a discount! Buy it! Just buy it!</>
ItemDesc:
It's the statue you saw in the Giant's Garden.
You didn't expect to see it being sold here.

Name: Agani
Text:
What are you saying!
Even the Para-dice... Para-dyes... Paradise cultists buy this!

Name: Agani
Text:
It's the best, best-selling item in the haven!
It's the pride, pride of the Flufftails!

When I mentioned the god Ea to help Agani understand,
he suddenly said he needed to change his inventory and asked for help.

Name: Agani
Text:
When I return to the god Ea, Ea, I can't be embarrassed.
I really, really have to sell this.

Name: Agani
Text:
It'll be big trouble, real big trouble, if I tarnish the <Orange>Flufftail</> name.
I'm going to get in trouble with Ninda.

Name: Agani
Text:
So I'm gonna draw, draw pictures and sell them instead.
You can be my assistant, assistant!

Name: Agani
Text:
If you go ahead and beat up every single <Red>bad guy</>...
I'll draw, draw the pictures!

Name: Agani
Text:
I'll give the first piece to you, as a special treat!
It's super, super rare.

Name: Agani
Text: I'm giving this to you for nothing. Only I would be this generous.
ItemDesc: I have no idea what this drawing is supposed to be, but it's a gift, so I should probably keep it as a memento.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(No matter how many times I look at it, I don’t think anyone would ever buy this...
You should suggest selling something else.)</>

Name: Agani
Text:
No! Flufftails never compro... com-promise on their wares!
<Yellow>This will be a mas-terpiece!</>

Name: Schulmann
Text:
So glad you are here.
I have a job for you.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
My nephew has disappeared.
I raised him with such care, and he left me just a single letter.

Name: Schulmann
Text: He used to be a Bristly-Hair, but I still worry about him a lot.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Schulmann looks grim. He must be really worried.)</>

Name: Schulmann
Text:
As you know, it's too dangerous here.
There are so many desertions and deaths.

Name: Schulmann
Text: So he might try to come home any time.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
We need to keep danger out for when he does.
Take care of the bad guys in the Black Rock Plateau for me.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
Thank you. That's one less thing to worry about.
I think I'll lose less fur thanks to you.

Name: Schulmann
Text: From now on, you can use the Naruru Hot Springs whenever you want.

Name: Ninda
Text:
Schulmann!
Such useless worries, way too many worries.

Name: Ninda
Text: A Naruru with a plump, glossy tail must have very, very big dreams!

Name: Ninda
Text: Because that's who Nisir, Nisir is!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(So Schulmann's nephew is named Nisir.)</>

Name: Ninda
Text: You're the hoo-man, human, who does anything for money, right?

Name: Ninda
Text:
Good, that's the spirit!
Go to the Black, Black Rock Plateau and bring me some monster hides, hides!

Name: Ninda
Text:
Hoo-mans are so skilled, very skilled indeed!
Now it's my turn, the great Ninda's turn!
Ninda worked the monster hides at the speed of light to craft a notebook.
ItemDesc:
A notebook made for Nisir.
It bears the delicate touch of Fluffy-Hair.

Name: Ninda
Text:
This is a gift, a gift for <Orange>Nisir</>!
You, you deliver it, human!

Name: Ninda
Text: You must keep it a secret, a secret! Hoo-man!

Name: Ninda
Text:
He's at the Obsidian, Obsidian Encampment.
Go to the Giant's Refuge, Refuge.

Name: Ninda
Text: Not a word, word to Schulmann.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I didn't expect to see an encampment in a place like this...)</>

Name: Nisir
Text: Explain the who, when, where, what, how, and why!

Name: Nisir
Text:
The Naruru in charge is asking you.
Can't a human even answer that?
I explain that I’ve come to the Obsidian Encampment to deliver a notebook at Ninda's request.

Name: Nisir
Text:
Phew, I'm just too popular.
Anyway, I'll take it.

Name: Nisir
Text:
Ugh, my aunt worries too much.
Who does she think an <Blue>Angry Tail</> is?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(When I asked why an Angry Tail was here instead of Aburu Village,
Nisir shrugged.)</>

Name: Nisir
Text:
The work <Blue>Sturdy Whiskers</> give me is no fun at all.
That's why Agid left, I mean, ran away.

Name: Nisir
Text:
So I also decided to... what was it again...
The Northern, Northern hoo-mans...

Name: Nisir
Text:
Right, desert!
I'm going to be a Deserter Tail who explores, explores new places.

Name: Nisir
Text: But the humans here are pretty lame.

Name: Nisir
Text:
So you, human, <Yellow>Deserter Tail No. 2</>... 
I want to see if you have what it takes to be No. 2.

Name: Nisir
Text: Clear out the monsters nearby. Show me what you've got!

Name: Nisir
Text:
You pack quite a punch.
You've earned the title of No. 2!

Name: Nisir
Text: From now on, I'll call you Deserter Tail No. 2!

Name: Nisir
Text:
Deserter Tail No. 2.
Do you see that puddle up ahead?

Name: Nisir
Text:
No. 2. You talk too much.
Your captain is speaking, so listen up.

Name: Nisir
Text:
That puddle is filthy.
Drinking that will give you serious trouble.

Name: Nisir
Text:
But there is a way!
Ea knows everything!

Name: Nisir
Text: Just throw that grass into the puddle!

Name: Nisir
Text: And then just place the monster's tooth, tooth next to it, and you're done!

Name: Nisir
Text: Wipe that silly look, look off your face and get to it, No. 2!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Do I really have to do this?)</>

Name: Nisir
Text:
How is it, No. 2?
Ea's special trick!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It didn't actually do anything, but I don't want to repeat that, so I'll just play along.)</>

Name: Nisir
Text:
Hehe, good to see you following orders!
There should be more hoo-mans like you!

Name: Nisir
Text: No. 2. Do you know those guys?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I explain that they are Astrid's soldiers.)</>

Name: Nisir
Text:
They stink, they stink.
My deserter, deserter friends were nice.

Name: Nisir
Text: Hey, No. 2. Pretend you're hunting monsters and keep an eye on those stinkers.

Name: Nisir
Text:
I've worked really hard to look after this encampment.
I can't let the stinkers take it away!

Name: Nisir
Text:
Go, No. 2!
Teach them a lesson!

Name: Stubborn Rebel
Text: No one here can stop the God of War, as you well know.

Name: Unmotivated Rebel
Text:
The chieftain could bribe Ragnar.
Same goes for the Archon.

Name: Stubborn Rebel
Text:
To the chieftain, Ragnar is just another target to keep in check.
He doesn't want him coming back.

Name: Unmotivated Rebel
Text:
So where exactly is Astrid?
Why hasn't she even shown her face!

Name: Stubborn Rebel
Text: Will you shut up? Did you forget what we're supposed to do?

Name: Unmotivated Rebel
Text:
...Taking over an encampment for a commander whose whereabouts are entirely unknown?
You do it. Count me out.

Name: Nisir
Text:
You're back, No. 2!
What are the stinkers doing?
I tell him that Astrid's soldiers seem to be targeting the encampment.

Name: Nisir
Text: Tch, I had a feeling... No. 1 was right after all.

Name: Nisir
Text:
Now, I'll give you a new mission!
No. 2, go meet No. 1!

Name: Nisir
Text: No. 1’s right over there by that tree, so hop to it!

Name: Ragne
Text: No. 1... Ah, no, I'm Ragne.

Name: Ragne
Text:
Didn't Nisir tell you?
Ah... right, he's not really the type to explain things.

Name: Ragne
Text: I'm Ragne, a medic from the outpost, and a soon-to-be deserter.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Desertion seems to be a common theme at the outpost.
I should introduce myself first and hear her out.)</>

Name: Ragne
Text:
I've seen so many recruits die or become crippled,
It's become hard to keep my sanity.

Name: Ragne
Text:
Still, things have been much better since I was stationed here.
Good enough to even make friends with a Naruru.

Name: Ragne
Text: Thanks to that, I could finally resume my suspended research.

Name: Ragne
Text:
Now, let me ask you a question.
What is health, [player]?

Name: Ragne
Text: A strong body? A clear mind? Quick recovery?

Name: Ragne
Text: It's all about maintaining your body and mind in their prime for as long as possible.

Name: Ragne
Text:
<Yellow>Losing health slowly.</>
That's the kind of life I strive for.

Name: Ragne
Text: To achieve that, you must start by moving your body.

Name: Ragne
Text: Now, please fetch me some monster blood and Starfish Flowers. Go on!

Name: Ragne
Text: Nothing like moving around to make you feel lighter?

Name: Ragne
Text: I'm actually planning to brew something with those ingredients.

Name: Ragne
Text:
As long as it yields good results, I’m okay with it.
Just a second, please.

Name: Ragne
Text:
The Medic's Signature Rejuvenation Potion is complete!
Rather than going for a temporary boost, I focused on overall constitution improvement.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She looks like she's going to make me drink it. I should politely decline right now.)</>

Name: Ragne
Text: [player], what do you think is keeping this encampment from improving?

Name: Ragne
Text: I say it’s the looming anxiety caused by <Red>Astrid</>'s soldiers.

Name: Ragne
Text:
...Unless the relationship between the Stormkell High Chieftain and Astrid improves,
this situation will likely continue, right?

Name: Ragne
Text: But if things stay this way, my goal of 'losing health slowly' will go down the drain...

Name: Ragne
Text: [player], what did you say your profession was?

Name: Ragne
Text: I heard mercenaries will do anything for a commission. Is that true?

Name: Ragne
Text: Please, for the sake of my mental health, take care of Astrid's soldiers.

Name: Ragne
Text: I'm not asking you to kill them. Just scare them off.

Name: Ragne
Text:
Phew, that takes a load off my mind.
Being on edge all day long... it's really exhausting.

Name: Ragne
Text:
Actually, there's one more thing bothering me. Will you listen?
Since we're No. 1 and No. 2...

Name: Ragne
Text: There is a bridge up ahead.

Name: Ragne
Text:
It's a place deserters always cross when heading to Astrid's stronghold.
Please go there.

Name: Ragne
Text: ...Because there might be someone else out there like me.

Name: Ragne
Text: Most people seek out Astrid with unwavering conviction, but,

Name: Ragne
Text: There might be some who simply want to escape the Outpost, like I did.

Name: Ragne
Text: I'm only here now because Nisir convinced me...

Name: Ragne
Text:
Phew, sorry for rambling.
There’s something I’m supposed to do, but now I have someone to deputize!

Name: Timid Voice
Text:
I was supposed to head toward the coast...
But I’m cursed with this blasted fear of the deep sea.

Name: Timid Voice
Text:
I just don't feel drawn to Astrid...
And there was the incident with the <Red>Paradise Advent Society</>.

Name: Timid Voice
Text: But defecting to Frantia isn't appealing either...

Just as I headed to the bridge to convince the voice's owner,
Astrid's soldiers surrounded her.

Name: Greta
Text:
Thank you. You saved my life.
I am <Orange>Greta</>.

Name: Greta
Text:
Why else would someone from the outpost be out here?
I was trying to leave, obviously.

Name: Greta
Text: I'm a researcher, yet they tell me to leave just because of budget cuts. Does that make any sense?

Name: Greta
Text: I know my society lacks influence, but this is just wrong.

Name: Greta
Text: I thought Astrid would be different... I'm disappointed.

After managing to calm Greta down, I persuaded her
to go talk to Nisir at the Obsidian Encampment.

Name: Nisir
Text:
Oh, No. 2.
Have you brought No. 3 already?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I had to take a qualification test, but she gets to be No. 3 right away?)</>

Name: Nisir
Text:
Sniff, sniff, she smells very... very smart.
Our encampment needs a smart, smart brain too!

Name: Nisir
Text:
As a reward, No. 2, I'll give you a break!
You have permission to leave the encampment!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I feel a bit dazed.
I suppose I should go say hi to No. 1... I mean, Ragne.)</>

Name: Ragne
Text: Thanks to you, we have a new family member. Thank you.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I told her I appreciated her help, albeit briefly, and said my goodbyes.)</>

Name: Ragne
Text: I hope you'll bring another new family member next time we meet...

Name: Ragne
Text: You're practically on a recruitment mission now.

Name: Ragne
Text:
There are many decent people at the Outpost, you know?
Let's see, <Orange>Tori</>... You should meet Tori first.

Name: Ragne
Text: He should be near the entrance to the Geyser Field.

Name: Ragne
Text:
There's no one as nice and well-connected as him,
I really hope he deserts this time around.

Name: Ragne
Text: I'm counting on you!

Name: Tory
Text:
A warm heart that never says no.
Mercenary, that's who you are to me.

Name: Tory
Text:
I'll give you ten seconds.
Tell me quickly before I change my mind!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I told him that the Obsidian Encampment was looking for new family members.
When I mentioned Ragne, his face lit up.)</>

Name: Tory
Text: Hmm... I need to ponder this very deeply before making my decision.

Name: Tory
Text: So, it's my turn now, right?

Name: Tory
Text: I'm supposed to deliver a letter, but I just can't bring myself to go all the way out there.

Name: Tory
Text: I mean, I'm a cook, so why are they making me do a scout's job?

Name: Tory
Text: I've told them countless times that my calling lies solely in the kitchen, honestly.

Name: Tory
Text: Look at me, do I look like a soldier to you?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I'm not entirely convinced, but whatever.)</>

Name: Tory
Text:
So, consider this saving a life, and
please take this to <Orange>Elbi</> on the Frozen Shore.
ItemDesc: It feels like I shouldn't ask what's inside.

Name: Tory
Text: You just need to head toward the Ancient Ruins.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is that the person? Let's get closer.)</>

Name: Elbi
Text:
Are you the one the commander sent?
You aren't dressed like you're from the outpost. Who are you? Are you Tori?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Tell her you're not Tori, but a mercenary tasked with delivering a letter for him.)</>

Name: Elbi
Text: Letter? Give it here.

Elbi inspected the letter with a critical eye.
Then she muttered a short curse and frowned at me.

Name: Elbi
Text:
Hah, a so-called commander sends something like this through a mercenary?
How utterly pathetic.

Name: Elbi
Text: I have work to do first, so let's see what you're capable of.

Name: Elbi
Text:
Not bad at all.
You might even be better than some half-baked elites.

Name: Elbi
Text:
Since you've come all this way, how about helping me?
I can promise you better pay than the commander.

Name: Elbi
Text:
You don't seem entirely brainless.
Good. From now on, you are a temporary assistant for the <Orange>Springwater Raven Society</>.

Name: Elbi
Text:
It's like an <Yellow>institution that studies ancient artifacts</>.
For an organization founded in Stormkell, we have active exchanges with other countries.

Name: Elbi
Text:
It's best you don't pry any further.
You only have one life to live, right?

Name: Elbi
Text: Enough with the explanation. Start by mining the minerals nearby.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It's just mining, so why am I so tired?)</>

Name: Elbi
Text:
Hah... The blue light is so beautiful it's blinding.
Good job, temporary assistant.

As I handed the minerals to Elbi, my body went limp and my eyes fluttered shut.
By the time I opened my eyes, Elbi had already administered first aid.

Name: Elbi
Text: I didn't think this medicine would work...

Name: Elbi
Text:
It's used for Aetherium addicts.
It works on people who still have some sanity left.

Name: Elbi
Text: We had to mass-produce this because of the Paradise Advent Society. It was a nightmare...

Name: Elbi
Text: Anyway, I'm glad you're awake, temporary assistant.

Name: Elbi
Text: Go tell <Orange>Kasper</> what just happened.

Name: Elbi
Text:
He's a scholar who was dispatched with me.
You can meet him if you head up there.

Name: Elbi
Text: The Shrill-Whistle Coast is his research area.

Name: Elbi
Text:
Don't worry about me and go.
My constitution makes me highly resistant to addiction.

Name: Elbi
Text: Oh, and give this to Kasper, too.
ItemDesc: A report by Elbi from the Springwater Raven Society.

Name: Kasper
Text:
Greetings.
I am Kasper from the Springwater Raven Society.

Name: Kasper
Text: What brings you to my research area?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(After handing over Elbi's document, I explained why I was here.)</>

Name: Kasper
Text: Aha, you must be Specimen NE914.

Name: Kasper
Text:
Haha, there's no need to worry.
I won't be dissecting or running experiments on you while you're alive.

Name: Kasper
Text:
Of course, considering we study ancient artifacts through an ecological lens,
I understand why you might be a bit apprehensive.

Name: Kasper
Text:
First, I need to prove a few hypotheses.
Could you collect some of the seawater you see ahead?

Name: Kasper
Text:
Thank you for your hard work.
Shall we proceed with the experiment?
Before long, a blue flash bursts from the mineral.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Unlike before, I don't feel dizzy or weak.)</>

Name: Kasper
Text: How was it, Specimen NE914?

Name: Kasper
Text:
That's a relief.
This mineral is going to be extremely useful.

Name: Kasper
Text: Have you heard of a <Blue>Visual Recording Device</>?

Name: Kasper
Text: You are more learned than I thought, Specimen NE914.

Name: Kasper
Text:
Most people simply see it as a record archive, but
With a few tweaks to its contents...

Name: Kasper
Text: it can also be used as an Aether Detonator.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I recall the Knights of the Biting Wind using one in the Pulsing Ridge.)</>

Name: Kasper
Text:
Now then, off you go to collect some monster blood.
The fun part comes after that.

Name: Kasper
Text:
What a pity, Specimen NE914.
But it doesn't matter if you don't know.

Name: Kasper
Text: Because you'll have to do as I say anyway.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Should I not have pretended to be ignorant? Should I tell him I actually know?)</>

Name: Kasper
Text:
Now then, off you go to collect some monster blood.
The fun part comes after that.

Name: Kasper
Text:
I believe the Visual Recording Device doesn't just capture moments,
but also recreates them.
ItemDesc: An intact Visual Recording Device.

Name: Kasper
Text: Elbi considers temporarily disrupting the fabric of time and space as 'magic'.

Name: Kasper
Text:
But magic is, in fact, just advanced science.
Ancient artifacts are the proof of that.

Name: Kasper
Text: I want to create an artifact that doesn't exist in this world.

Name: Kasper
Text: One that can even encompass the realm Elbi calls magic.

Name: Kasper
Text: Therefore, Specimen NE914, there is one last thing I need you to do.

Name: Kasper
Text:
Take this to the Crossroads Shelter and meet <Orange>Karis</>,
Then request the production of a preservative solution.
ItemDesc: A production request for preservative solution, sent from Kasper of the Springwater Raven Society.

Text:
Kasper's explanation was mostly filled with academic jargons, making it hard to understand.
However, it was clear that the preservative solution was an essential ingredient.

Name: Kasper
Text: I believe I’ve said enough.

Name: Kasper
Text: The freshness of the ingredients is paramount for the preservative solution, so you must go immediately.

Name: Kasper
Text: Karis is a medic, so you should be able to spot her right away.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I need to head over there and meet Karis.)</>

Name: Karis
Text:
I'm Karis, a medic assigned to the Gate.
You look like a mercenary. What brings you here?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I handed her the preservative formula from Kasper and explained the situation.)</>

Name: Karis
Text: He's doing so well, my worries seem pointless.

Name: Karis
Text: Well, he was always a smart kid, so I guess it's to be expected.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(When I stare at her with a bewildered expression, Karis laughs awkwardly.)</>

Name: Karis
Text:
He's my younger brother, Kasper.
Anyway, I need more ingredients to make what he asked for.

Name: Karis
Text:
I know you're busy, but please go to the Blizzard's Breath Plain
and gather monster hearts for me.

Name: Karis
Text: You make quick work of things.

Name: Karis
Text:
Hmm... I'll handle this.
I should go there myself, so I can see my brother for the first time in a while.

Name: Karis
Text: In exchange, please do me one favor.

Name: Karis
Text: You know there's a Paradise Advent Society Sanctum nearby, right?

Name: Karis
Text: There's someone hiding from the believers in the Blizzard's Breath Plain.

Name: Karis
Text:
I often pack winter supplies and food to take with me,
and today happens to be that day...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(When I agreed, Karis' face lit up.)</>

Name: Karis
Text: Once you step outside the shelter, you'll find a path leading to the snowfield.

Name: Karis
Text:
If you keep heading up, you'll eventually see someone.
Please deliver this to them.
ItemDesc: It looks like a single bite would be enough to fill you up.

Name: Calm Voice
Text: Hmm... They should be here by now. That's strange.

Name: Calm Voice
Text: They're usually here around this time...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let's go check if this is the person Karis mentioned.)</>

Name: Calm Voice
Text: I don't think we've met... What brings you here?
I calmed her down by explaining that I came at Karis's request.

Name: Beatrice
Text:
That could have been a disaster.
I am <Orange>Beatrice</>.

Name: Beatrice
Text: I guide travelers heading to the Alabaster Encampment.

Name: Beatrice
Text: Oh, by the way, do you know much about ancient artifacts?

Name: Beatrice
Text:
Have you ever seen this?
The Witch of the Snowfield gave it to me, but I have no idea how to use it.
ItemDesc: A broken Visual Recording Device.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Is this a Visual Recording Device?
Let's hear what Beatrice has to say first.)</>

Name: Beatrice
Text: She gave me the instructions, but I think it's too much for me to handle alone...
ItemDesc:
1. Wash the monster bone in cold ice water.
2. Place the heart on top of the monster hide.
3. You can use the artifact after completing the purification process above.
4. The object will activate when placed on ice water.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She doesn't seem to know anything about the Visual Recording Device. Let's help her.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It doesn't sound legitimate, but
let's purify it as instructed for now.)</>

Name: Beatrice
Text: I see something shining inside...! How did you do that?
ItemDesc: An intact Visual Recording Device.

Name: Beatrice
Text: I had almost given up, but you gave me courage.

Name: Beatrice
Text: The Witch of the Snowfield told me to use it when I feel I’m ready to handle it.

Name: Beatrice
Text: She also said I would see something, but told me not to be afraid.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Just what kind of record is in here for her to say that?)</>

Name: Beatrice
Text:
...I've actually asked passing adventurers for help before,
but it always ended in failure.

Name: Beatrice
Text:
I lied earlier because I was afraid you wouldn't help me,
but seeing it shine like this makes me feel so guilty...

Name: Beatrice
Text:
I know it's a lot to ask, but could you stay with me?
I don't think I can do this alone.

Name: Beatrice
Text: To be honest, I'm nervous. But more than that, I'm afraid.

Name: Beatrice
Text:
I'm also worried you might get hurt because of this.
...Phew, should we just stop here?

Name: Beatrice
Text:
...Alright, I'll try.
I have to believe in myself, and believe in you, Adventurer!

Upon activating the Visual Recording Device near the frozen water,
a familiar face appeared.

Name: Celine
Text: I didn't expect to see you again.

Name: Witch of the Snowfield
Text:
It would be in your best interest to see me more often.
If you want to live to see another day.

Name: Celine
Text: ...I don't really have the desire to live that badly.

Name: Witch of the Snowfield
Text:
Liar.
We are waiting for the same person.

Name: Beatrice
Text: <Orange>Celine</>! How are you feeling?

Name: Celine
Text: Same as always.

Name: Beatrice
Text:
They sent up some meat from the shelter below.
Let's eat this first.

Name: Celine
Text:
I'm fine, so take care of yourself first.
You have to guide people to the camp.

Name: Beatrice
Text: And when are you leaving?

Name: Celine
Text:
In a few more days.
There's something I need to hear.

Name: Celine
Text:
...I should have listened to Beatrice.
Why did this have to happen now of all times, when no one is around?

Name: Celine
Text: Wherever my father is, I hope it’s a paradise...

Name: Witch of the Snowfield
Text: You've endured a lot, Celine.

Name: Witch of the Snowfield
Text:
Rest easy now.
I will take care of the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Witch of the Snowfield
Text: Your paradise will be built upon their deaths.

The Form Recording Device shattered the moment the Witch of the Snowfield buried Celine.
Her eyes brimming with tears, Beatrice ran away as if fleeing.
I should go after her and comfort her...

Name: Beatrice
Text:
...I resented Celine.
Because she suddenly disappeared without a word.

Name: Beatrice
Text: We had promised to guide people to the camp together once she got better.

Name: Beatrice
Text:
And then, once we saved up enough money, we were going to go to <Blue>Babylon</>.
Because it's warm there.

Name: Beatrice
Text:
We only ever lived in bitterly cold places,
so we wanted to go somewhere that was warm day and night.

I explained to Beatrice how I helped Celine escape the Paradise Advent Society,
and how I fulfilled her final request.

Name: Beatrice
Text:
You were the adventurer Celine talked about!
I never dreamed we would meet like this...

Name: Beatrice
Text: Adventurer, please promise me this.

Name: Beatrice
Text:
Let's go pay our respects to Celine together.
I will ask the Witch of the Snowfield for the exact location.

Name: Beatrice
Text: Thank you. I'm sure Celine will be happy, too.

Name: Beatrice
Text: If you don't have a destination in mind, how about visiting the Alabaster Encampment up ahead?

Name: Beatrice
Text: There are rumors that a real big shot is staying there right now.

Name: Beatrice
Text: I just thought it might pique your interest, Adventurer.

Name: Beatrice
Text:
Since they arrived, the atmosphere at the camp has gotten a lot better,
and my tips have gone up too!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I gave her a look asking what that had to do with me, but
Beatrice wouldn't stop trying to convince me.)</>

Name: Beatrice
Text: They'll treat you well if you tell them I sent you.

Name: Beatrice
Text:
So don't worry, just go meet Mr. Ingmar first.
He looks intimidating, but he's actually a really good person.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It is exactly as Beatrice said.
Still, I shouldn't let my guard down.)</>

Name: Ingmar
Text: I haven't seen your face around here. What's your business?

Name: Ingmar
Text: Looks like the kid found someone useful.

Name: Ingmar
Text:
Then again, the guys who came before you had absolutely no guts.
So, do you know how to fight?

Name: Ingmar
Text:
That's good.
My liege is here to recuperate, but we haven't had anyone suitable to attend to them.

Name: Ingmar
Text: Now, hold on. You must first prove you're worthy of serving my liege.

Name: Ingmar
Text: Bring back monster blood and venomous fangs from the Whispering Wind Plains.

Name: Ingmar
Text: I thought you'd get scared and run off, but you've got some grit.

Name: Ingmar
Text:
Alright, I will tell you who the liege I serve is.
Her esteemed name is... <Red>Astrid</>!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Why is that name coming up now?)</>

Name: Ingmar
Text: Haha, you must be speechless from the sheer honor!

Name: Ingmar
Text: Now then, let's begin your special training to serve Astrid.

Name: Ingmar
Text: We need to make something with what you brought, rookie.

Name: Ingmar
Text:
Don’t talk back, rookie!
Keep in mind that questions are only permitted after you complete your mission.

Name: Ingmar
Text: Now, go to <Orange>Barag</> immediately.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I looked at him as if asking who Barag is,
and Ingmar awkwardly scratched his head.)</>

Name: Ingmar
Text:
Barag is a highly knowledgeable Naruru.
He has exceptional medical skills and is very handy.

Name: Ingmar
Text: He is an honored guest of ours, so treat him with respect.

Name: Barag
Text:
Oho, a human.
What have you brought me?

Name: Barag
Text:
It looks like you're in need of some medicine!
Then I must make it, of course!

Name: Barag
Text:
Hah, it's perfect! Absolutely perfect!
But I can't just give it to you for free!
ItemDesc: A medicine crafted using Barag's special recipe.

Name: Barag
Text: I said I’d make the medicine, not give it to you.

Name: Barag
Text: If you want to take this, you must run, run an errand for me.

Name: Barag
Text:
Stop frowning, and bring me the heart and blood, blood of the monster over there!
It all has a use, you see!

Name: Barag
Text:
I thought my tail was going to freeze off waiting for you.
But you did the best out of any human I've seen.

Name: Barag
Text: I don't normally do this, but human, I'll make an exception for you.

Name: Barag
Text: I made two, so take one for yourself and give the other to the bearded fellow.

Name: Barag
Text:
It's Ice Snake Liquor.
It is very, very cold here, so your body heat drops rapidly.
ItemDesc:
Barag's favorite liquor.
It's excellent for raising body temperature.

Name: Barag
Text:
As you should know, staying out in the cold saps your strength, strength to fight.
The chill seeps right into your bones.

Name: Barag
Text:
Health, once lost, does not return, so take good care of it.
You may head back now.

Name: Ingmar
Text:
You're back, tenacious rookie!
I believe you have something for me?
I handed over the medicine from Barag and Ingmar's share of the Ice Snake Liquor.

Name: Ingmar
Text:
Isn't this Ice Snake Liquor?
I didn't think you'd win Barag's approval so quickly...

Name: Ingmar
Text: Haha, thanks to you, I can enjoy a drink for the first time in a while.

Name: Ingmar
Text:
I have one more job for you, rookie.
Gather monster hides and deliver them to Haildi.

Name: Ingmar
Text:
The Whispering Wind Plain is crawling with monsters,
so it shouldn't take you long.

Name: Ingmar
Text:
<Orange>Haildi</> is on the path leading to the edge of the Forsaken Land,
so go to her as soon as you have them.

Name: Haildi
Text:
We haven't met.
Were you dragged all the way here by Ingmar, perhaps?

Name: Haildi
Text:
I wonder how many days you'll last.
For now, I'll just call you 'rookie candidate'.

Name: Haildi
Text: Even if you're unhappy about it, don't let it show, got it?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What's with all these Northerners?)</>

Name: Haildi
Text: We're making armaments.

Name: Haildi
Text:
Oh, you ask questions too. You're a smart one.
I suppose it's better to know what you're doing than to work blindly.

Name: Haildi
Text:
If you head down there, you'll find a holy ground of the Paradise Advent Society.
And beyond the ice wall in the back lies <Blue>Stormkel</>.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(When I asked if she was worried Stormkel might be in danger because of the Paradise Advent Society,
Haildi remained silent for a moment.)</>

Name: Haildi
Text: It’s just that I hate seeing our honor tarnished.

Name: Haildi
Text:
A few of the once honorable warriors following the god of war
joined hands with those wicked creatures.

Name: Haildi
Text:
And they pointed their blades at their own kin.
Completely forgetting the reason we even came here.

Name: Haildi
Text:
I'll allow that once you bring the rest of the armament materials.
Bring me monster hides and bones.

Name: Haildi
Text:
It's been a while since we had someone useful.
Well then, it's time I kept my promise.

Haildi explained that Astrid sought out the Forsaken Land 
in order to exile herself.

Because her very existence is a threat to the chieftain who rules Stormkel,
she led her subordinates here to live in seclusion in the Forsaken Land.

Name: Haildi
Text: She was practically driven out to protect those who follow her.

Name: Haildi
Text:
You'd think she would resent the people of her homeland, but Astrid even took in deserters
and allowed them to live in the citadel.

Name: Haildi
Text:
But more people means more chances of trouble.
People crave power and want to become the leader.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Does this mean both Ragnar and I misunderstood Astrid...?)</>

Name: Haildi
Text:
It's water under the bridge now.
From now on, we need to focus on restoring our honor.

Name: Haildi
Text: Astrid will be here soon.

Name: Haildi
Text: There is no need to be afraid. She is a good person.

Name: Haildi
Text:
First, we need to set up a training ground as soon as the armaments are finished.
The Alabaster Encampment alone isn't enough.

Name: Haildi
Text:
To swiftly deal with the <Red>Paradise Advent Society</> in case they act up,
this entire area must be converted into an outpost.

Name: Haildi
Text: And to do that, we need to clear out the monsters prowling nearby, right?

Name: Haildi
Text:
This is enough.
Great work, rookie candidate.

Name: Haildi
Text: If we can hold back the Paradise Advent Society here, it would mean less trouble for the gate and Verzard.

Name: Haildi
Text:
Even if all the misunderstandings regarding Astrid are not resolved,
we will protect our kin.

Name: Haildi
Text: Now, it's time for you to meet Astrid.

Name: Haildi
Text:
I hope you earn our liege's recognition so that we may all know your name,
rookie.

Name: Haildi
Text:
Head toward the bridge.
Don't be too nervous, alright?
Even though I know the person crossing the bridge, my tension doesn't fade.

Name: Astrid
Text:
It's been a long time since I've had such a closely matched duel, not since Ragnar.
What is your name?

Name: Astrid
Text: Do you have any interest in serving under me? I don't mind if you refuse.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I glance at the tower, mentioning that I have things to do.)</>

Name: Astrid
Text:
...Then you must go.
I have no interest in standing in someone's way.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(When I carefully asked about what happened with Ragnar,
Astrid laughed heartily.)</>

Name: Astrid
Text: What could you possibly reason with someone who chooses to misunderstand everything?

Name: Astrid
Text:
Just as he walks his path, I simply walk mine.
Proving myself suits me far better than offering excuses.

Name: Astrid
Text: People always part ways, even blood relatives and comrades bound by trust.

Name: Astrid
Text:
But the moments we shared do not disappear.
And I am someone who carries those moments as I move forward.

Name: Astrid
Text:
I wish you the best of luck in your battles as well.
Lastly, go to Haildi and let her know it will be difficult for us to join forces.

Astrid was a person who truly lived up to the title of god of war.
Leaving her retreating figure behind, I made my way to Haildi.

Name: Haildi
Text: So, what's the verdict?

Name: Haildi
Text: ...I thought I'd finally found a rookie that thinks like me. That's a shame.

Name: Haildi
Text:
I have no intention of giving up easily, so come find me if you ever change your mind.
Because we'll be right here.

Name: Haildi
Text: Someone has to protect people from these threats, even if no one gives us credit.

Name: Haildi
Text: Leave the Paradise Advent Society to us until we meet again, prospective rookie.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Hey, I remember our last battle being rather boring.
Seeing as how you came back, you must have felt the same.

Name: Ranon
Text:
This time, I’ll show you what bounty hunting is truly all about.
If you ask me, you've got real talent.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Don’t be so shy.
If you needed some time to warm up, all you had to do was say so.

Name: Ranon
Text: I will let you hunt until you feel that you’ve warmed up enough.

Name: Ranon
Text: Meanwhile I will organize my thoughts on ‘Collecting Trophies’,

Name: Ranon
Text:
which is the core and essence of bounty hunting.
That’s the whole point of the training, so look forward to it!

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(He's got way too much energy. Maybe if I go up against him properly, he won’t bother me later.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(I should start warming up.)</>

Name: Ranon
Text:
It took longer than anticipated… Hmm.
Are you sure you’ve prepared yourself? Well, I like your attitude.

Name: Ranon
Text: Listen close, what I’m doing is the Krea-style bounty hunting.

Name: Ranon
Text:
This method has been lost for decades,
but I pursue it with pride.

Name: Ranon
Text: Think about it. How do you collect a bounty?

Name: Ranon
Text:
Correct, you must have proof to show the client.
In a whole and recognizable form.

Name: Ranon
Text: To do taht, you can’t just fight nilly-willy.

Name: Ranon
Text:
You have to find the prey, erase your presence, and when it is completely vulnerable,
strike the vital point at once with meticulously calculated strength.

Name: Ranon
Text: Do you understand how noble bounty hunting is?

Name: Ranon
Text:
It’s not like taking mindless lives in war,
or dealing in dirty money.

Name: Ranon
Text: Now, I assume you understand the feeling of how you’re supposed to prepare yourself for our battle.

Name: Ranon
Text: Great. Keep what I said to you in mind when hunting!

Name: Ranon
Text: I thought I was going to have some fun, but an uninvited guest is getting on my nerves.

Name: Ranon
Text:
I can feel a presence nearby.
I think someone is secretly watching our fight.

Name: Ranon
Text: Follow me. Let’s continue our battle after we’ve gotten rid of him.

Name: Ranon
Text: I’m certain he is inside.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Seeing as how he didn’t come down even though he could hear our conversation,
he is expecting us to find him.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Is he not willing to come out on his own…? 
It was rude enough watching us in secret, but he is also arrogant.

Name: Ranon
Text:
It means he’s underestimating us.
Shall we take a look at what he looks like?

Name: Seta
Text: You… You’re the one who the guild master appointed as his heir!

Name: Seta
Text:
You stink of monster blood.
Were you hunting?

Name: Ranon
Text:
How dare you act like you know me?
This one and I have an important battle to fight, so get lost.

Name: Seta
Text: G-Get lost? You arrogant fool!

Name: Ranon
Text:
You talk big, for someone who’s been just creeping around us!
I’m going to make an official complaint to your guild.

Name: Ranon
Text: Which group are you part of? Identify yourself.

Name: Seta
Text: I am Seta of the Hunters Guild!

Name: Seta
Text:
I’m famous for leaving no prey behind after my hunt.
It proves that I got the best skills.

Name: Seta
Text:
I am completely different from those talking about innovation or romance.
[player] should be familiar with my fame.

Name: Ranon
Text:
I see. Guess the Hunters Guild skips character tests these days.
They really should watch who they let in.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Is Lady Kian still in charge?
I should pay her a visit and offer some encouragement.

Name: Ranon
Text: Seeing as how much of a hard time she must be having due to one ignorant hunter named Seta.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Do you know she’s been trying really hard to revive all factions?
You probably don’t. That’s why you belittle others’ efforts.

Name: Seta
Text:
Associating with a fake hunter tells me all about you…
I knew you cheated to win the hunting contest!

Name: Seta
Text:
Watching you, thinking there must be some tactics behind your moves… it was a waste of my time.
I can’t believe you call that money hoarding of yours as a form of hunting.

Name: Seta
Text:
Killing dangerous and powerful enemies is the true hunt!
You shouldn’t worry about anything else.

Name: Seta
Text:
Tch, I should tell the guild master to cleanse the guild,
so the likes of you won’t be allowed in the headquarter.

Name: Ranon
Text: Sigh, are you insulting your very own Hunters Guild and its members?

Name: Seta
Text:
You blabber too much.
Even so there is only one type of orthodox hunter I recognize.

Name: Seta
Text: The up-and-coming hunters of Krea learn the exact same method as mine.

Name: Seta
Text:
The empire considers training in martial arts as a virtue.
Everything in the nation is optimized for that.

Name: Seta
Text:
It means those who were not accepted are useless.
Prove me wrong, I dare you!

Name: Ranon
Text:
The world has revolved around the “Forsaken Land” for ages now.
But are you still whining about the homeland?

Name: Ranon
Text:
You are more uptight than Krea’s elders.
It might as well speak to a boulder.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Even if the rapid-fire bow hunting method became the standard,
could that be a good reason for criticizing others?

Name: Seta
Text: Hmph, what’s the use of only targeting profitable prey?

Name: Seta
Text: At least, people are not killed by monsters in my territory.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(It doesn’t look like they’re going to stop fighting any time soon. I should give them someroom.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(I think a lot of time has gone by.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Are they still fighting? I should return and see.)</>

Name: Ranon
Text: Hehe... I know just the thing for someone like you.

Name: Ranon
Text:
I’ll beat you down with pure skill and shatter that smug arrogance of yours.
You'll learn that your way of hunting isn't the only way.

Name: Seta
Text: Hmph, do you think you’ll be able to defeat me with petty tricks?

Name: Seta
Text:
Let me take this chance to show you what’s real.
I won’t need that many arrows.

Name: Ranon
Text:
But before that…
Let’s make sure everything is clear so there are no excuses afterwards.

Name: Ranon
Text: You’re wounded from your left shoulder to your right side.

Name: Ranon
Text:
I don’t think you’re in the best shape.
Are you sure those injuries will not affect the battle?

Name: Seta
Text:
Such wounds are common for a great warrior.
I don’t plan on making a scene for getting scratched by monsters.

Name: Ranon
Text:
No, I want a fair battle.
Your pride won’t be able to take it if I unconsciously let you win, will it?

Name: Ranon
Text: Get me some herbs and clean water from nearby, [player].

Name: Seta
Text: Trying to help your enemy. That will be the last of your confidence.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(There is nowhere to get water.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Do I have to go all the way down there for water?
Knowing Seta... she won’t even drink it anyway.)</>

Name: Ranon
Text:
Does your great orthodox hunting method include preventing injuries?
I’m starting to feel sympathy for my opponent.

Name: Ranon
Text: No wonder you get hurt, chasing after every oversized beast you see.

Name: Seta
Text:
Without such disadvantage…
you will never be able to face me on an equal footing.

Name: Seta
Text: Did you bring it? Give it here.

Seta rubbed the herbs I brought on her wound
and threw the rest on the ground.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Haha! Unbelievably reckless.
You'll be a sorry sight if you catch some foul plague.

Name: Seta
Text:
Let’s stop dragging this out and get moving.
I can’t wait to see you on your knees!

Name: Ranon
Text:
There is only one rule.
The one who hunts the most monsters in the area wins.

Name: Ranon
Text: This is the standard hunting contest rules. You don’t have a problem with it, right?

Name: Seta
Text:
You’re putting yourself at a disadvantage.
I’ll make you regret underestimating me.

Name: Ranon
Text: Just get ready to acknowledge your defeat.

Name: Ranon
Text:
[player], you can take care of the monsters gathering near the contest grounds.
Nothing can bother us.

Name: Ranon
Text: Hahaha! You think you can beat me in that shape?

Name: Ranon
Text:
Forget about hunting, you don’t even have the fundamental qualities of a warrior.
Did you not learn how to take care of your body in Krea?

Name: Seta
Text: Stop bragging over catching a few petty monsters.

Name: Seta
Text:
Did you challenge me without even bringing proper prey?
This is no battle.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Complaining now? You didn’t say a word when we started.
Hunting everything in sight is your way, isn't it?

Name: Ranon
Text:
I prepared it like this to suit you, considering your injury.
If you don’t like this, what do you want to do?

Name: Seta
Text:
Those that secure their own nests grow safely
and expand their power and influence to become the best prey.

Name: Seta
Text:
Wiping them all out is where the real fun begins.
Tracking them to their den is part of the hunt, too.

Name: Ranon
Text: Oh, are you trying to tell me you can use that brain of yours?

Name: Ranon
Text:
You act and speak so ignorantly…
I never thought you would have tactics.

Name: Seta
Text:
Funny, my way of hunting is superior in all respects.
Try to insult me with useless words.

Name: Ranon
Text: It just so happens that there is a great spot to scout for an ambush site.

Name: Seta
Text: Where is it?

Name: Ranon
Text:
Up there, we can spot every prey in the area at a glance.
If you’re so clever, why don’t you prove it this time?

Name: Ranon
Text: I intend to make my way up using those protruding objects as footholds.

Name: Ranon
Text:
It might seem like I’m at a disadvantage considering the distance,
but I can follow a path that is certain.

Name: Ranon
Text: We just need to cross the finish line. It will be better than getting lost on the way.

Name: Seta
Text: Come on, it’s a no-brainer!

Name: Seta
Text:
It's simple.
Heading straight up is the fastest way.

Name: Seta
Text:
The surface might be rocky and harsh, but it is of no concern to me.
I should quickly go up and prepare for the ‘real’ hunt.

Name: Seta
Text: H, how… How can you be faster than me…?!

Name: Seta
Text: I surpasss you in physique and strength!

Name: Ranon
Text: What a remarkably simple and transparent plot.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Who told you to climb the cliff so recklessly?
You do not pay heed to your surroundings.

Name: Ranon
Text: Was that not a part of the hunt…? Heh.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Even if there is no pain, a wound is bound to slow you down.
That’s how the human body works.

Name: Seta
Text:
This was not a proper path!
Where is the mind game in all of this?!

Name: Seta
Text:
We didn’t use tools or searched for cover.
What does that have to do with your hunting skills?

Name: Seta
Text:
Everything is nothing but ridiculous tricks.
You didn’t care about having a fair battle from the start!

Seta pointed angrily at Ranon, yelling.
She leaped down from the structure and disappeared.

Name: Ranon
Text: Oh dear, she seems quite frustrated.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Apparently, she can’t accept the fact that she lost.
I clearly set up the environment exactly as she said.

Name: Ranon
Text: Look around, she took down every monster in her path as she pleased.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Monsters have turned quite hostile thanks to her.
At this rate, the passing villagers will be in danger.

Name: Ranon
Text: I’ll go after her and calm her down.

Name: Ranon
Text:
I mean, you have to make up your mind.
Is it difficult to accept that you lost? I understand how you feel.

Name: Ranon
Text:
But if you hadn’t belittled the other factions in the first place,
you wouldn’t have had to go through such embarrassing… Pfft.

Name: Seta
Text: Are you kidding me?! You’re nothing but a fake!

Name: Seta
Text:
Why don’t we have a real battle instead of hunting?
According to you, isn’t ‘manhunt’ the same as hunting?!

Name: Ranon
Text: How dare you say that? Watch your mouth, you piece of unburnable trash!

Name: Seta
Text: What guarantees that you'll be fair in your judgment?

Name: Seta
Text:
Why don’t you go play house with Guild Master Kian?
Don’t even think about getting in the way and get lost!

Name: Seta
Text:
Follow me, loser.
I will show you what hunting truly means these days!

Name: Ranon
Text: Fine, I’ll put a bounty on your head this time!

The two hunters bolted forward before anyone could stop them.
They were fighting monsters, and now they are pointing their weapons at each other…

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Ranon certainly looked relaxed even when Seta was throing a tantrum…)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Did he finally snap because she talked about hunting humans?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(This won’t be the end of it. I should stop them by force…)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
I didn’t want to punish them,
but kids sometimes need a good smack in the head.

Name: Seta
Text:
Darn… Why did you get in the way?
I was just about to win!

Name: Seta
Text: Did you jump in just to save this loser's skin?

Name: Ranon
Text: If that was the case, the Adventurer wouldn’t have attacked both of us.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Look… My body is covered with injuries.
Seems your skills surpass ours, Adventurer.

Name: Ranon
Text:
I admit things got too heated between us…
If you hadn’t stepped in, I would have really hunted this fool.

Name: Seta
Text: Ugh… Since the hunting contest…

Name: Seta
Text: You’ve improved… No… Were you just hiding it...?

Name: Ranon
Text: In any case, I will accept that I was utterly crushed by you, [player].

Name: Ranon
Text:
One of the few rules of the Hunters Guild:
You listen to the stronger hunter.

Name: Ranon
Text:
Although this rule often leads to struggle for power,
one usually stays quiet until the next challenge if they lose.

Name: Seta
Text:
…I will take back what I said here for now.
But it’s only temporary!

Name: Seta
Text:
I’m going to return and defeat the other factions…
And come for you next.

Name: Seta
Text: Then even the Guild Master can't say a darn thing! Bwahaha!

The two of them went their ways after agreeing to meet for another hunting battle.
I think I need to beat sense into them every now and then…

Name: Hakan
Text:
Mmm, are you the one sent from Babylon?
I’m ‘Hakan’, the one who requested the dispatch.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Oh, excuse me…
Members of the Hunters Guild come here quite often.

Name: Hakan
Text:
This is the perfect place for monster ambushes.
That’s why I asked for more guards.

Name: Hakan
Text: I can’t just stand by and watch when the path to my homnetown is so poorly guarded!

Name: Hakan
Text:
I hear hunters pave their own paths one by one these days.
Still, I hope they don't forget about this Elysium.

Name: Hakan
Text: Just like me, who returned to this place in my final years… Cough…!

Name: Hakan
Text:
*sigh…* This darn cough is killing me… cough cough...
C-Could you fetch the medicine from my pack over there? Please.

Name: Hakan
Text: You’ve brought the right one… Thank you.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(It looks like he’s struggling even after taking the meds…
He will need some time for the medicine to take effect.)</>

Name: Hakan
Text:
Phew… I was trying to guard this place until new recruits got here.
But my body isn’t what it used to be.

Name: Hakan
Text: Medicine is hard to come by, so I’ve only been taking it when symptoms got worse.

Name: Hakan
Text: I can endure the pain, but there are times when I have trouble breathing like just now.

Name: Hakan
Text:
I don’t want to die before I get to the Star Forest.
I should take a rest for now, cough.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Then I will leave it to you.
The medicine is strong and will need some time to kick in. Please take your time.

Name: Hakan
Text: You’re quite skilled. I almost want to write a recommendation to the Hunters Guild.

Name: Hakan
Text: I will contact them if you want. What do you think?

Name: Hakan
Text: Are you sure you don’t want to? You'd walk right in without so much as a test.

Name: Hakan
Text:
I practically raised the Guild Master as if she was my youngest sister.
She will let you in if I ask.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Many were orphaned in the war back then… Just as she was.
Even though it was decades ago, I still remember her crying and whining.

Name: Hakan
Text:
I won’t insist anymore.
Your posture, skills… I was hoping you would take the role of an instructor.

Name: Hakan
Text:
You’re quite skilled in fighting monsters.
It looks as if all you do is hunt all day.

Name: Hakan
Text: It is a great quality if you want to survive in the Forsaken Land.

Name: Hakan
Text:
It doesn’t matter if you’re young, old or what gender you are.
Everyone has to figure out a way to protect themselves.

Name: Hakan
Text:
That’s one thing I made sure to teach anyone who joins the guild.
Although Kian should have made new rules by now.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Incursions can break out in front of my house when you wake up,
or on your way to get some water.

Name: Hakan
Text:
That’s why I’ve spent my whole life teaching others how to hunt beasts.
It’s a tragedy to watch lives waste away so easily.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(He’s not wrong. He is an adult who truly cares for everyone around him.)</>

Name: Hakan
Text:
Fate brought us together, didn't it?
So let me see what you’re made of.

Name: Hakan
Text:
You're better than most warriors, but there’s room for improvement.
Keep this in mind, and it’ll help you someday.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Now that I’m up close, it clearly shows.
You didn’t receive proper training.

Name: Hakan
Text:
It is a raw stance that has not been refined at all.
But that seems to be better for most adventurers,

Name: Hakan
Text: because they will encounter unexpected situations other than Incursions.

Name: Hakan
Text: There is no need to interfere while you are building your own unique style.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Since my training is mostly about dealing with incursions,
I don’t think you need my insights.

Name: Hakan
Text: Now, why don’t we go somewhere with a great view to ease the tension?

Name: Hakan
Text:
This is my favorite place near the outpost.
It’s dangerous, but there is no better place to rest alone.

Name: Hakan
Text: When I’m feeling better, I cast a fishing rod here.

Name: Hakan
Text:
What do I catch? Hahaha! Nothing, of course.
I'm just reliving the old days with my comrades.

Name: Hakan
Text:
We were always short on food when we were constantly fighting,
and we would catch fish like this where there’s no monster.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Looks silly, doesn't it? But you’ll see it differently once you try it.
It really sets the mood, you know?
With his fishing done, Hakan returned to the waypoint.

Name: Hakan
Text: It happened long ago… But I’m constantly reminded that I survived alone.

Name: Hakan
Text:
It happened when we were crossing over to the Elysium from Krea.
An Incursion occurred at the end of a narrow path.

Name: Hakan
Text:
The advance party only consisted of me and three of my comrades.
We had to make sure at least one of us survived to deliver the news.

Name: Hakan
Text:
My comrades made me fall back.
Only because I was the youngest.

Name: Hakan
Text:
That’s why I also want to make sure new generations live to see the future.
This is also the reason why I stayed in the Hunters Guild for so long.

Name: Hakan
Text:
I should call Kian and catch up.
Hearing her voice makes me feel quite warm and comfortable.

Name: Hakan
Text:
When did Kian become the Guild Master?
Well… She’s still as energetic as ever.

Name: Hakan
Text:
She my successor.
She complains a lot, but she’s a tournament winner, so I passed down my position.

Name: Hakan
Text:
The Hunters Guild regularly hosts hunting contests.
It’s for bringing the guild together, but it also has other purposes.

Name: Hakan
Text: After I’ve gotten much older, I handed over my position through the contest.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Everyone in the guild is so competitive.
I thought it was best to hand the position over to the most skilled one of them all.

Name: Hakan
Text: In hindsight, I think the guild turned out better than when I was the leader.

Name: Hakan
Text:
New hunters keep emerging because
they have clear ideas on what kind of life they want.

Name: Hakan
Text:
The essence has not changed. They hunt for the future generations.
These new hunters are better than us old ones.

Name: Hakan
Text:
I spent my youth merely ‘surviving.’
Survive today, then maybe tomorrow.

Name: Hakan
Text: I hunted constantly to see another day.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Even now, people are dying from monsters everyday…
Were things even more dire back then?)</>

Name: Hakan
Text:
Looks like my words aren’t quite sinking in.
Follow me. I’ll let you see for yourself.

Name: Hakan
Text: Do you think you will get room to breathe if you stop an onslught somehow?

Name: Hakan
Text:
Things will calm down for a while once you stop the monsters?… Those are human standards.
Monsters don’t have plans.

Name: Hakan
Text:
They are like a breached levee.
Water keeps pouring out until there is no more left.

Name: Hakan
Text: Then how do you think we dealt with them?

Name: Hakan
Text:
Good guess.
Keep going until things settle down.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(No matter how many I take down, there is no end to them. It also feels like they are much more persistent today…)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Is it because I already hunted once before?
But I was still able to do at least this much when requested.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Of course… Those were tasks that took a long time.
No wonder I’m so exhausted.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(But I can still hold on.
I endured through bigger threats than this.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(…But ordinary townsfolk couldn’t pull this off.
Let’s head back and talk.)</>

Name: Hakan
Text:
Let us say that by some miracle the onslaught has subsided.
What is the first thing we should do after surviving?

Name: Hakan
Text:
Preparing for the next battle.
You should tend to the injured and recover as quickly as you can.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Supply lines were lost, and I had no idea where I was.
I had to eat anything I could get my hands on.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Bring back some pebbles, barks, and grass.
I want to show you how I cooked these.

Name: Hakan
Text: Just bring them. You’ll see.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Mmm, you got a knack for this.
You managed to pick the ones with minimal side effects.

Name: Hakan
Text:
You just have to clean the pebbles and boil them in water.
Then put the pebbles in the food while eating.

Name: Hakan
Text: The pebbles will instantly release its hot temperature.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Cold food tend to make injuries worse.
We used this method because everything cooled down so fast outside.

Name: Hakan
Text: We had to eat rough barks and bitter grass.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Of course, there was no spice.
Go and boil it thoroughly.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Then we just wait an hour or two.
If nothing goes wrong, it’ll fill a starving belly.

Name: Hakan
Text:
While waiting for it to cook, we tore our clothes to stop bleeding,
and restock on arrows by collecting the ones stuck in the monsters.

Name: Hakan
Text: Only then did we assign guard duties and catch some sleep. It was an endless cycle.

Name: Hakan
Text: What do you think? Would you like to try?

Name: Hakan
Text:
Haha, some tastes are simply best left a mystery.
Just consider it a survival recipe for emergencies.

Name: Hakan
Text:
You should be able to picture what comes next by now.
Injured and starving hunters have only two options…

Name: Hakan
Text: Eventually, we had to continue fighting until we reached a safe house or a big village.

Name: Hakan
Text:
There was no nation-wide security system back then,
and the native wildlife in the Forsaken Land was more violent than ever.

Name: Hakan
Text: Even without Incursion, crises continued one after another.

Name: Hakan
Text:
You might be thinking that I’m giving you a hard time.
But you are keeping up better than I expected.

Name: Hakan
Text: Maybe you find this old one’s past interesting. Haha.

Name: Hakan
Text:
But you must be exhausted from all the fighting.
You can’t tell if you’re walking or sleeping.

Name: Hakan
Text:
The hardest part was the lack of sleep.
Even when we found a spot to sleep, we had to take turns keeping watch.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Suppose we had to sleep right here, right now.
We’d have to scout for the safest spot.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Hmm… The ground is flat, but the cliff makes it dangerous at night.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(There’s no cover, but we can quickly get into a defensive formation if we’re on a hill.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(We should be able to buy some time since the path is narrow.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(This looks like the best place around here. Let’s try set up a camp here.)</>

Name: Hakan
Text: That place… Hmm… Yes, you did your best.

Name: Hakan
Text:
If it was up to me, I would have set up a camp on top of the structure.
It would have been difficult to think that after all I’ve put you through.

Name: Hakan
Text:
It seems like you’re not all that familiar with the Elysium…
I won’t say that this decision alone got you killed.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Whether they came from Krea or were born and raised here—
this place is crawling with hunters.

Name: Hakan
Text:
That’s why it’s difficult for ordinary adventurers to walk around freely.
It’s not safe to travel with all the fighting.

Name: Hakan
Text:
So make sure you take everything in about this place.
The experience will come in handy in the future.

Name: Hakan
Text: Lastly… Can you show me how you ‘hunt’ with all your might?

Name: Hakan
Text:
Since I’m going to the Hunters Guild anyway,
I was thinking writing a combat guide using you as a reference.

Name: Hakan
Text:
That should be enough.
I hope they realize how hard you and I have worked.

Name: Hakan
Text: There are the Adventurers Alliance and other manors in Babylon, so I’m not worried that much…

Name: Hakan
Text:
But it might cost the Hunters Guild its vigilance.
They may get too comfortable, thinking there are many others to fight monsters.

Name: Hakan
Text: That’s why Kian decided to watch over the other factions.

Name: Hakan
Text:
The ones known as the Bounty Hunters or Romantic Hunters.
Anyways, it means they feel they belong to their group.

Name: Hakan
Text: Even if they work separately, they will rush to take credit as soon as trouble starts.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Isn’t it a fitting approach for these times?
Regardless, I’m glad to see that the guild is doing fine.

Name: Hakan
Text:
It was so refreshing when I stepped down as the Guild Master.
I felt myself getting older by the day with all kinds of trouble.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Right? Somehow it’s just a whole bunch of troublemakers gathered together.
Kian must have a lot on her mind, because she has to pick one to become the next Guild Master.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(That’s why he asked me to do all of this. Seeing as how even the previous Guild Master is worried, everyone in the guild must be utterly out of control.)</>

Name: Hakan
Text:
Well, whoever it is, the winner will be granted the title,
I don’t really feel any guilt toward Kian.

Name: Hakan
Text:
…Of course, I would appreciate it if you kept this a secret.
Because I still visit to help out from time to time.

Name: Hakan
Text:
Let’s meet again if fate allows it.
Let’s try real fishing then.

Name: Narim
Text:
Hello! Are you interested in farming by any chance?
Please help Narim, this novice farmer.

Name: Narim
Text:
I paid a fortune to rent this field…
but monsters came and stepped all over my field.

Name: Narim
Text:
The seeds died out as soon as they sprouted…
It was so painful to watch.

Name: Narim
Text:
Please wipe out the monsters,
so my chidlren can see the sunlight once again!

Name: Narim
Text: Phew, trespassers have finally dwindled.

Name: Narim
Text:
I can’t guard the fields day and night, you know.
Seeing it all rooted up just makes me want to quit.

Name: Narim
Text:
Oh, farming is actually my side-job.
I’m originally affiliated with the gate garrison.

Name: Narim
Text:
But my sword skill is terrible.
With such terrible skills, there was no chance for promotion.

Name: Narim
Text:
People of Krea are obsessed with becoming stronger…
The whle culture is built around praising strength.

Name: Narim
Text:
There was not much I could do in such environment.
I had to quickly look for a different calling!

Name: Narim
Text:
When elite warriors go to war,
the rest who stay behind have to prepare food and armor.

Name: Narim
Text:
I just need to be one of them.
I'm only staying with the army to scrape some coin together.

Name: Narim
Text:
Just twenty more danger pays to go... Heh.
Now, let’s go plant those seeds.

Name: Narim
Text: First, bring us plenty of water!

Name: Narim
Text:
You’ve brought enough.
This should last us until tomorrow.

Name: Narim
Text:
Do you see the small field right behind you?
You can spray some water and plant the seeds.

Name: Narim
Text: I will go weed the field on the other side.

Name: Narim
Text:
Have you ever heard of a kingdom named ‘Susia’?
It was once a wealthy nation with massive arable lands.

Name: Narim
Text:
But it was annexed by the Krea Empire. No wonder you haven’t heard of it.
It was the first kingdom to disappear in the conquest war.

Name: Narim
Text:
It is said that the soil was rich anywhere and it received plenty of sunlight.
Enough to harvest crops all year round.

Name: Narim
Text:
That is probably why it was the first nation
the empire stuck after declaring the war?

Name: Narim
Text:
They needed endless supply of food to train warriors.
It was impossible for them to produce that much food on their own!

Name: Narim
Text:
Of course, this is just a guess from studying old farming history,
so keep it to yourself.

Name: Narim
Text:
After all, history is always rewritten to favor the victors, isn't it?
One wrong word and you might get dragged back to the homeland.

Name: Narim
Text:
Even now, the children of the empire are taught
that the war back then was a “justified acquisition of territory’.

Name: Narim
Text:
But it’s hard to dig deeper when you receive money from the empire.
It’s my dream to live a quiet life tending to a large farm.

Name: Narim
Text:
I'm content with sneaking a few extra hours onto the timesheet,
and deliberately coming in on my days off to pocket a little more money.

Name: Narim
Text: Phew… Enough with old stories. Let’s get to the rest of the task.

Name: Narim
Text:
We need to supply nutrients to the soil…
I prefer processing monster corpses.

Name: Narim
Text:
Horns, leathers, and even their muscles and tendons are useful.
Then I’ll leave it to you.

Name: Narim
Text:
According to the farming manual, you’re supposed to grind the monster carapace to find powder,
And boil it in clean water for three days.

Name: Narim
Text:
Then dry it thoroughly under the sun for a fortnight,
and mix in the finely crushed Starfish Flower roots…

Name: Narim
Text: It gives the soil the ability to purify monster toxins all on its own.

Name: Narim
Text:
To serve as a “field” around here, it has to be at least that much—hehe.
There's still plenty of hard work ahead, but I'm already proud.

Name: Narim
Text:
Thank you for your help, Adventurer.
I’ll repay you with my first harvest someday.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Excuse me, just a moment. If you have some time to spare how about taking on a quick task?
It’s the kind of task that gets you paid a lot for little to no work.

Name: Ozge
Text:
I am Ozge, sent here from the Krea homeland.
An archaeologist, an ecologist, an aetherologist… gah!

Name: Ozge
Text:
I am in charge of anything that needs to be researched.
I need some help because I have no colleague or supply.

Name: Ozge
Text:
It’s because this place knows nothing other than fighting!
In this great nation of mighty warriors, us non-warriors are nothing more than nobodies.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Sigh, the most urgent thing is retrieving the ‘relic particles’.
You know how to ride a Glider, right?

Name: Ozge
Text:
The land around here is highly elevated.
That’s why I was trying to assess the flow of Aether waves.

Name: Ozge
Text: But I realized that if I wanted to move between stone pillars, I have to fold and unfold the Glider constantly.

Name: Ozge
Text:
I think my research materials fell out of my pocket during one of those flights.
Since I have to observe the research progress, I’ll leave it up to you.

Name: Ozge
Text:
It should be floating around since it’s lighter than air.
You just have to go up real high and start gliding! Easy, right?

Name: Ozge
Text:
Phew! You brought them back fast.
These aren't cheap, you know. I wanted to salvage every last one.

Name: Ozge
Text:
It tends to decompose into smaller bits when exposed to the outside.
I won’t be able to use it for research if it becomes so small that it’s invisible to the naked eye.

Name: Ozge
Text: The homeland won't fund my research, so I have to be frugal.

Name: Ozge
Text:
I was hoping you could help me with a few more things.
I'll pay you out of my own pocket if I must, so don’t worry.

Name: Ozge
Text: Sometimes… I find myself asking why I’m doing this research with no support.

Name: Ozge
Text:
But there’s something about this research that moves my heart.
Like proving a largely neglected field of study.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Even if Krea only praises warriors,
they still need people with other occupations.

Name: Ozge
Text:
We need administrators to keep the country running,
and priests to treat those injured by war.

Name: Ozge
Text:
People to reconstruct the lands gained from the empire’s imperialization project, whatever that means.
Even people to research and deal with anomalies like the Incursions!

Name: Ozge
Text:
I’m saying, we need minds just as much as we need blades.
That's why I haven't quit.

Name: Ozge
Text: You get it, right? Every research project underwa have to produce results.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Stretch your hands and feet and follow me.
Let’s go to get new measurements.

Name: [player]
Text:
(The detector hummed and vibrated,
absorbing Aether for quite some time.)

Name: Ozge
Text:
Phew. I can't believe I have to gather control samples one by one like this.
Honestly, there’s really nothing in Krea.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Reference material on the area around the Giant’s Tower?
What I’m writing right now is probably all there is.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Every land around that tower feels so strange.
Not to mention all those strange phenomena.

Name: Ozge
Text:
We have to identify the potential threats to keep the land safe.
Yet they ignore the most basic fundamentals.

Name: Ozge
Text: I have no idea how the empire hasn’t fallen apart.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Suppose we conquer the entire eastern lands
at the end of the imperialization project.

Name: Ozge
Text: What do you think will be next? It’s naturally going to head into our direction.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Ages ago, when monsters first poured out of the towers—
they just panicked and threw up walls.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Now, these days, everyone with any skills are hunting for treasures in the tower,
even cooking monster meat.

Name: Ozge
Text:
So what would the higher-ups think?
They think, “We don’t have to fear the tower or monsters. We can just send more troops!”

Name: Ozge
Text: You can’t just march soldiers in without surveying the environment first!

Name: Ozge
Text:
Not to mention the scientific progress,
this is a vital step even in a military point of view!

Name: Ozge
Text:
To think no one gives a damn about such vital data…
And that my research will be the very first.

Name: Ozge
Text: Ah, should I just join Babylon instead?

Name: Ozge
Text:
Phew… It’s going to take some time for the device to take the measurements.
In the mean time, please make sure those monsters don’t get in the way.

Name: Ozge
Text: Return to the Hunter’s Village when things calm down.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Thanks to you, the samples are clean,
with margin of error.

Name: Ozge
Text:
I should enter this in the analyzer to compare the results with the data from a few days ago.
What was my next task?

Name: Ozge
Text:
I’m certain I wrote my to-do list right here.
Did those village brats steal them again? Ugh.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Wait a moment.
I’m sure… I pushed back some dangerous tasks…

Name: Ozge
Text:
Oh! The Tesseract.
The things half-buried in the ground when an Incursion appears.

Name: Ozge
Text: I’ll give you an Aether Collector. Please move it around a Tesseract.

Name: Ozge
Text:
That sounds about right.
I’m curious about authentic ones found in nature.

Name: Ozge
Text:
It’s not so hard for you anway, is it?
I know you’ve got the skills, so quit playing weak.

Name: Ozge
Text: Researchers like me are not equipped for battle.

Name: Ozge
Text:
If I tagged along and got myself hurt…
your reward might end up paying your medical bills, you know?

Name: Ozge
Text:
Let’s see... I think you’ve gathered plenty…
Now I can finally do some in-depth research on the Tower’s Aether.

Name: Ozge
Text:
But if I gather samples from the inside, the numbers will change, right?
Ah, it finally feels like I’m out on a real expedition.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Why didn’t you ask the Krea warriors to do it?
I can see why you would ask that question.

Name: Ozge
Text:
But as I keep telling you,
all they ever want to is fight.

Name: Ozge
Text:
That’s just how the folks around here are!
Every child in Krea wants to be either a hunter or a warrior.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Coming back to the Incursion…
This is by far the most troubling one among my research topics.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Does the Incursion change the nature of living creatures?
Or do they stimulate their nervous system?

Name: Ozge
Text:
The accepted theory is that monsters from within the tower is summoned outside.
Then we can rule out the hypothesis that native creatures are mixed in.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Do you think the Incursion monsters you just saw
are the same as the monsters from the tower?

Name: Ozge
Text: That’s right! Why do their traits change when they pop out?!

Name: Ozge
Text:
The types of monsters attacking you when you enter the tower are limited, right?
But the Incursion is completely different.

Name: Ozge
Text:
No archives in the homeland, and I have no connections with the local scholars here.
And talking to you isn't getting me anywhere

Name: Ozge
Text:
Do you honestly think they’d answer an outsider’s questions?
I heard the struggle over who owns those ancient relics is pretty vicious.

Name: Ozge
Text: Intellectuals might act all noble, but they are much more thorough with this kind of behind-the-scenes work.

Name: Ozge
Text: I should get started on a live experiment with what you were able to gather.

Name: Ozge
Text:
If this Aether causes meaningful changes in monsters,
we can focus on the anomalies, that is, Incursions.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Let’s go over there.
All you have to do is cause a little scene and draw their attention.

Name: Ozge
Text: The hypothesis we made was wrong.

Name: Ozge
Text:
The Aether’s density might be the problem,
but we would have gotten rid of the Incursion if the answer had been that easy.

Name: Ozge
Text: Maybe they are changing bodies when they cross over?

Name: Ozge
Text:
Long before Krea became an empire, there was an old kingdom here.
They called it “Bruheria,” a place infamous for its sorcery.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Sorcery is basically the modern day mind magic.
Most countries forbid it.

Name: Ozge
Text:
