In any case, some mages tried to use a very unconventional spell
to transfer their mind to another body.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Thanks to that inhumane try, Krea was able to invade those lands ‘lawfully.’
They said they had to rescue potential victims.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Of course, there aren’t any official records.
It’s just a story shared amongst biologists.

Name: Ozge
Text:
But whether it’s true or not, it is an interesting topic.
Does a body obey the new owner’s will?

Name: Ozge
Text: What if the monsters go through a similar process when they cross over throug the Incursion?

Name: Ozge
Text:
The consciousness of each being is jumbled together, and as soon as they land on the Forsaken Land…
Each of them ends up in a random body.

Name: Ozge
Text: Maybe that’s why everything is chaotic for them, which results in them attacking anything in sight.

Name: Ozge
Text:
They say you follow Babylon law when you’re in Babylon,
Likewise, the incursion might have done what it needed to do to spill the monsters here!

Name: Ozge
Text: Then we should assume that the traits of environmental Aethers are mutually incompatible, right?

Name: Ozge
Text:
Great, I just thought of an experiment.
I will go ahead to get started, so join me when you can.

Ozge bolted out without looking back.
I followed after getting a well deserved rest…

Name: Ozge
Text:
Ugh… Help! The monsters are too out of control!
I-I can’t run away anymore… Huff… Huff…

Name: Ozge
Text: I’ll explain later, so please do something about them!

Name: Ozge
Text: …It hurts, but nothing I can’t… handle…

Name: Ozge
Text:
So, ugh, let’s head to the village.
It might get dangerous again because of the experiment…

Name: Ozge
Text:
…I skipped verification and went straight to the experiment.
I overlooked that the stored sample was ruined.

Name: Ozge
Text:
I amplified the environmental Aether I brought from the capital
and what I had left of the sample you brought.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Then an explosive reaction occurred…
and the sound was louder than I expected.

Name: Ozge
Text:
I finally had someone helping me and tried to do something, but it all turned into a mess.
I was too impatient.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Still, I managed to collect plenty of basic data thanks to you.
From now on, I’ll tackle it one step at a time.

Name: Ozge
Text:
To expand footholds for people like me, I must show tangible results.
I’m going to meet with the scholars here and do things the right way.

Name: Ozge
Text:
I’ll get proper treatment too, I hate being injured.
I don’t know how the warriors put up with this.

Name: Ozge
Text:
Here, your payment as promised.
Stay safe.

Name: Passionate Woman
Text: I-I will capture you with a single arrow!

Name: Passionate Woman
Text:
When the searing wedge pierces my chest
and the shackles chain up my legs!

Name: Passionate Woman
Text: When the wind blows through the snowfield, your eyes would have been closed!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Ah! You startled me! W-Who are you?!
Do not disturb Shahnaz’s hunting preparation!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
There isn’t much time until the next evaluation,
I don’t have time to be bothered by an outsider… Wait.

Name: Shahnaz
Text: I was having a hard time asking since everyone was looking at me strangely… This is good.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Are you familiar with the latest trends in art?
Something dynamic would be better.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Oh! Then can you show me what you’ve got?
I hope it’s striking enough to steal a monster's attention.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I will be watching you nearby.
The monsters should be looking at you and you alone…

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(They aren’t looking me at all. Why am I dancing in front of monsters in the first place…?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(I thought she mentioned hunting. Does she research a hunting style that uses dance?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(I thought she was going to watch, but where did she go…? Should I return to the village?)</>

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I’m over here… Of course, you won’t be able to see me!
I was able to join the Hunters Guild with this stealth technique.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Let’s head right to the next stage!
Come follow the river down!

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(This is embarrassing… I should stop!)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(My dance isn’t all that mesmerizing,
and if dancing could calm monsters, we would be living in a time of peace.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(What will the other adventurers say if they see me?
If I end up running into someone like Koon, I’m going to be laughed at for eternity.)</>

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
My score is… Perfection!
Your moves showed not a single hint of hesitation!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I have much to learn.
I can see why Uran rejected me…

Name: Shahnaz
Text: I must keep training! Thank you for the wonderful inspiration!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Actually… The thing I asked you to do…
I tried it a few days ago, though I failed miserably.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I want to learn how to hunt with romance.
I’m trying everything Uran told me.

Name: Shahnaz
Text: Do you guys know each other? No wonder your moves were oozing with romance.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
You see, Uran told me that she could dance with monsters.
She said it was the deepest way of communication.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Since the Romantic Hunt is about capturing the opponent’s heart.
She said you could do anything with the right dance…

Shahnaz looked around,
took a deep breath, and started to dance.
Passersby whispered as they passed her and some looked at her with pity.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
This is the way it’s supposed to be, right?
She said she will only let me join the Romantic faction if I figure it out by myself.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I want to hurry up and join a decent faction
and officially start hunting.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(There were many factions within the Hunters Guild.
But the Romantic faction isn’t a major faction…)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(She must have been tricked by Uran’s fancy words.
I have to let her know so she doesn’t misunderstand.)</>

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
N-No wonder!
Hunters should be hunting monsters instead of d-dancing!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Seriously…! She said romance was the best!
How dare he deceive me with his looks?!

Name: Shahnaz
Text: Seriously… Only if I didn’t like the way she slooked!

Name: Shahnaz
Text: I thought it was a famous faction after seeing you dance like that.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
So you’re just someone who doesn’t say no to favors.
Sorry for making you do something weird like that.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
…I can’t even show my face.
I’m sorry, but can you give me a minute?

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(She’s quite embarrassed. I should go for a hunt and come back.)</>

Name: Shahnaz
Text: …I’m fine now. I’m going to brush this off and find a different job.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
With what you said before, are you saying there are people called treasure hunters?
Are you sure they exist?

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
There are treasure hunters in Krea.
They just have a bad reputation for avoiding battles.

Name: Shahnaz
Text: Maybe it’s because this is a land of opportunities, but are they recognized here?

Name: Shahnaz
Text: A treasure is a prey, in some way.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Whether it’s hidden deep within somewhere or you have to put your life on the line,
it’s valuable because it’s dangerous.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
You'll run into tons of monsters on the way to treasure!
Naturally, I'll do my job as a hunter.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Ohh?! You’re making it sound cooler by the second.
Let’s get to a treasure hunt already.

Name: Shahnaz
Text: Wow… That was no fun.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
We weren’t looking  for real treasure… 
but searching for things isn’t my cup of tea.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Come on, everyone does it.
Even mages and battle priests take down monsters these days.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
But I became a hunter because I like handling the bow.
If I’m going to pick an occupation, I want to leave my mark.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I thought if I find the hunting method best suited for me and try really hard…
it would decide my future path.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
What should I do? What’s left?
Hey! You! Those Reformers have no manners at all!

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(It’s not like the other factions existed from the start.
It is said that factions were made by people who shared a vision.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(I told her that she doesn’t have to follow in other people’s footsteps.)</>

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Then I guess its not like some factions with a long history and rich tradition
look down on the other factions, right?!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
The Guild Master told me that I could do whatever I want, as long I don’t cause any trouble.
That what she must have meant!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Actually, what I really wanted was a great title.
I just have to create my own faction!

Name: Shahnaz
Text: Let’s go! I will show you what hunting for your dreams is all about!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Haha, there is a reason I specially picked this place.
Please call me Shahnaz the ‘Moonlight Hunter’ from now on.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I-I’m not going to literally hunt for the moonlight or anything.
It’s just like, I will shine as softly as the moonlight…!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
W-Why are you looking at me like that?
It’s not like you’re going to wait with me until the sun sets.

Name: Shahnaz
Text: Moonlight hunters, who use their keen senses

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
to corner the target into somewhere with faint light,
approach them with our superior stealth ability…

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Taking down the prey in a heartbeat! Ha!
Perfect indeed. What a fitting name.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Now, this isn’t the time to be impressed.
Let’s get started on training our senses as the Moonlight Hunters!

Name: Shahnaz
Text: What do you think? Doesn’t it feel like your body is getting lighter as if you’re swimming?

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
That means you’ve become one with the moonlight!
Like a predator at night or a silent blade.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Oh… I might still have a bit of a sentimental side left in me, haha.
Anyway, you and I are the night’s greatest hunter.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Afternoon… Oh, when the sun is up?
O-Oh?

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
If you want to be active at night… you have to…
sleep during the day.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
There are a lot of difficult preys at night.
They tend to have better vision and hearing than humans.

Name: Shahnaz
Text: That’s why we have to recover as much as we can, and get good sleep.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Of course, for the Moonlight Hunters,
there is a way to sleep well under the sunlight.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Brewing Moonfall Flowers and drinking it.
It’s a famous medicine in Krea, have you heard of it?

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Healers say that all the time:
eat well, take your medicine, and get good sleep!

Name: Shahnaz
Text: That’s why I heard they include Moonfall Flowers in their medicine.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
That’s why the Moonlight Hunters use the same concept.
Hey? Do not doubt me!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Hmph, what if I make it and show you?
Bring the flowers back to the village!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
That’s right, that’s the Moonfall Flowers.
They look the same as the ones that bloom in Krea.

Name: Shahnaz
Text: If you wait a moment… Haha… I’ll surprise you.

A moment later, Shahnaz gave me whitish drink.
I was forced to drink it under the pressure of her gaze and, after that… I have no memory.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
See? Puts you right to sleep, doesn't it?
I'm telling you, you'll sleep like a baby.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I used a little bit more than usual since you didn’t believe me… Heh.
In any case, the life of a Moonlight Hunter is ready!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I knew this wasn’t enough.
We need some more appealing traits.

Name: Shahnaz
Text: Since the modifiers naturally attracts attention, it might seem a bit abstract.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
If peole start asking what the difference is between Moonlight and Romance… Ugh…
I should give them a visual shock!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Just like a predator instantly biting down on the prey’s throat!
I prefer such stealthy and quick hunt.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I happen to look after a cat around here, you see.
I'm gonna ask for her help!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
They are apex predators!
On top of the food chain.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I haven't seen her in the village for ages, so I should head back to the cave.
That cave is one of her usual haunts.

Name: Shahnaz
Text: Did you find her? I didn’t see her at all in the passage.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Phew, did she go down there again?
I told her to stay away because massive beasts crawl out of there sometimes!

Name: Shahnaz
Text: There is a small empty space on the other side, and there is a legend that a real live dragon used to live there.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Maybe that’s why we often see monster types that might have been
dragons, only degenerated over time..

Name: Shahnaz
Text: Cats are naturally stealthy… but danger is still danger.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I’m going to go down and look for her,
so please buy me some time!

Name: Shahnaz
Text: Ah… She’s all scratched up…

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I barely managed to lure her out with her favorite snack.
The wound on my arm…? It’s an honor!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Do you know how hard it is to catch her?
We should quickly go on when she’s staying calm.

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Mmm, I keep looking at her and she’s so cute.
This wasn’t what I was expecting.

Name: Shahnaz
Text: “I’m a predator with ferocious hunting instincts! I’m a predator!”

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
I guess we need that kind of vibe and that sort of direction.
But it’s just so cute, ahem.

Name: Shahnaz
Text: If she gets bigger, and I put some rough and think fur on her…

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Great! My plans are all set.
Could you fetch some materials from monsters as a quick fix?

Name: Shahnaz
Text: I’m going to cheer her up and play with her to make sure she doesn’t go anywhere else.

Name: Shahnaz
Text: P-Please hurry! She’s losing focus…!

The camouflage uniform Shahnaz made fit perfectly on the cat.
But when we were about to put it on, she hissed and ran away!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Huh…? I guess water isn’t the only thing she doesn’t like.
You’re not even going to put on the uniform?!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
It would have made her look like the greatest hunter…
She usually hunts at night, which makes her a Moonlight Hunter!

Name: Shahnaz
Text:
Phew… I’ll go and try to convince her again…
I can’t give up like this…

Name: Bau
Text:
Young one, please spare some time for children in need.
It won’t take long.

Name: Bau
Text:
The youngsters get cold easily.
Even snow falls in a peaceful like this at night.

Name: Bau
Text:
That’s why… I ordered a few winter magic tools,
I would like to open up the road so the merchant caravan can enter.

Name: Bau
Text:
It passes through this path, but it often gets ambushed by monsters.
It will be most unfortunate if it arrives late… Could you please help?

Name: Bau
Text: Where did she get her hands on some snacks this time?

Name: Bau
Text:
Everyone adores her, so she often disappears.
I see she’s had some fishy treats again today.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(That’s the cat from before.
I had such a hard time looking for her…)</>

Name: Bau
Text:
But snacks are great, but you still need a well-balanced meal with proper nutrients.
It would be great if she came in time for meals.

Name: Bau
Text:
I’m worried about how she loves to go around
with all these monsters nearby.

Name: Bau
Text:
She returns with injuries all the time.
I’m afraid she might actually get killed one of these days.

Name: Bau
Text:
I should put a bell on her.
I’ve been delaying it because I was never successful, but I don’t think I can delay it any longer.

Name: Bau
Text:
Fortunately, she’s interested in people.
She’s probably curious about you, too.

Name: Bau
Text: Now, act like nothing is going on and give it a try.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(She’s calmer than I expected… If I just give her time to adjust…)</>

The cat scratched its neck with her forepaw, got up, and ran out to the street.
The sound of the bell rang out…

After clicking his tonuge as if he knew this was going to happen, Bau
asked me to get rid of the danger while he goes looking for her…

Name: Bau
Text:
She doesn’t care about the people worrying about her, tch.
Then again, cats are known for not caring…

Name: Bau
Text:
Fortunately, she safely found her way to a nearby neighborhood.
The villagers there said they will take care of her tonight.

Name: Bau
Text:
I don’t mean she has to be by my side at all times
or she’s under my care…

Name: Bau
Text:
But I’m a bit disappointed that she just eats the food I provide
and leaves without spending any time with me…

Name: Bau
Text: I’m planning to put up some decorations, what do you think?

Name: Bau
Text:
Those people from before had all kinds of weird toys.
They tied a rope at the end of a stick.

Name: Bau
Text:
You roll a tiny ball that drops treats,
and throw a toy mouse, and she’s completely hooked.

Name: Bau
Text: In comparison, all I did was make sure she was well fed…

Name: Bau
Text:
That’s why I’m planning on planting some grass nearby.
There’s a kind that she likes so much she rubs her body on it.

Name: Bau
Text: I just need to put a handful here, here, and here.

Name: Bau
Text:
The merchants told me there was a grass cats go crazy about.
I planted them all over the place out of curiosity.

Name: Bau
Text:
They can easily be found outside,
but I don’t know why I didn’t think to plant them here.

Name: Bau
Text: That little rascal… Even getting outsiders involved, she’s quite a handful.

Name: Bau
Text:
Other cats also come and go through here often,
but only this one gets into dangerous situations…

Name: Bau
Text:
Even though I said I will decorate this place like this,
I hope she’s having fun playing without worrying about food.

Name: Bau
Text:
I just want a safe life for the ones that I’m taking care of.
As a being with greater power, I’m going to do what’s right.

Name: Bau
Text:
Haha… Thank you for everything.
I’ll replant them myself. You should go get some rest.

Name: Duren
Text: Ahhh… W-Who are you…?!

Name: Duren
Text:
I thought you were a monster pretending to be a human…
There are always people who are just impossible to detect… Ugh.

Name: Duren
Text:
I-I’m sorry for screaming all of a sudden…
I’ve been suffering from hallucinations for some time.

Name: Duren
Text:
I-I’ve been mixing a bunch of different magic to figure something out…
To find a way to weaken monster bodies…

Name: Duren
Text:
But I mistakenly cast the spell on me by accident…
I have to wait until the effect wears off…

Name: Duren
Text:
I’m sorry, but could you deal with the monsters in the meantime…?
I mainly came here to eliminate them anyway…

Name: Duren
Text: If you help me, I will make sure to repay you! I mean it…!

Name: Duren
Text: T-Thank you… Honestly… I was worried that you wouldn’t believe me…

Name: Duren
Text: E-Everyone tells me that I-I’m poor at speaking, and c-clumsy…

Name: Duren
Text:
But I’m still officially affiliated with
the Frantia Arcanist Alliance…!

Name: Duren
Text:
I came here on a mission…
but those people keep looking at me!

Name: Duren
Text:
People from Frantia dislike me. They say I’m gloomy.
They’re scared of me because they think I’m using forbidden magic…

Name: Duren
Text: But not here… Mmm…

Name: Duren
Text:
S-Still! I’m going to return after helping with this one task.
I’m going to give them a little more daily supplies… I-I am.

Name: Duren
Text: They said they needed dried leather… So, after I get them some…

Name: Duren
Text: T-This is bad! While I was gone, m-monsters came to the village…

Name: Duren
Text:
There are injured people in the forest too…
A-Also, a kid is missing!

Name: Duren
Text:
I’m sure he is stranded on top of the tower…
That’s where he usually runs off to when he’s scared the adults will scold him…

Name: Duren
Text:
From what I’ve seen, the people here…
were really good at climbing trees.

Name: Duren
Text:
Y-You know how children grow up watching the adults…
So, the children were easily able to copy them…

Name: Duren
Text:
I will take care of things within the village…
P-Please save them! I beg you…!
The children safely descended.

Name: Duren
Text: That’s so good to hear… We’re almost finished thanks to your help.

Name: Duren
Text:
I-I kept telling them to reinforce their defenses…
With these kind of accidents, I can’t help but worry…

Name: Duren
Text:
I-I could help them with my magic until now…
B-But I have to return to Frantia soon.

Name: Duren
Text: The monsters are one thing, but there are also strange people w-walking around…

Name: Duren
Text:
I heard they were from The Ashen Crows…
T-They are going around convincing others to join their cause…

Name: Duren
Text: T-They look even stranger than me!

Name: Duren
Text:
They speak clearly enough, but their eyes look a bit distant—
Like... they’re fixated on something, desperately...

Name: Duren
Text:
T-They say we have to be together if we are the descendants of Tan.
They kept telling me that we have to everything we can for Tan…

Name: Duren
Text:
But when I told them I was fron Frantia, they went and found someone else.
I was so scared because they clenched my shoulders and kept yelling at me…

Name: Duren
Text:
B-But a rumor broke out after they left.
A rumor about seeing dead people or corpses running around!

Name: Duren
Text:
This is why I’m having a hard time leaving this place.
T-There must be something I can do!

Name: Duren
Text:
Then I will think of a plan regarding the Ashen Crows…
I-It might be related with the corpses…

Name: Duren
Text: I heard an adventurer saw the Ashen Crows setting up an altar in the woods.

Name: Duren
Text:
Then when he had to pass by it again a few days later…
he rescued a resident near the same altar.

Name: Duren
Text:
The resident couldn’t remember…
why he was lying there…

Name: Duren
Text:
The adventurer just thought it was the Elysium’s s-special culture
and didn’t think to tell the people here…

Name: Duren
Text: T-Then, he said he had to go to the Giant's Tower with his friends and left…

Name: Duren
Text:
I-It would be better to get rid of the altar, right…?
They said they spotted it at the outskirts of the woods…

Name: Duren
Text: O-Okay!
I took care of the Ashen Crows.

Name: Duren
Text:
A-Are you saying they were near the altar?
They appeared when we tried to touch it…!

Name: Duren
Text:
I-I have a bad feeling about this… Aether is flowing through the altar…
But it’s completely distorted…

Name: Duren
Text:
If they aren’t used to handling Aether…
It would have had a negative effect on them… That’s why the civilians…

Name: Duren
Text: I-I got some samples. Let’s return for now…

Name: Duren
Text:
I-I took apart the magic circuit… B-But could this be real…?
This is amplication magic…

Name: Duren
Text:
It's a forbidden art from ages ago...
The kind that clouds your mind, leaving you to act on pure instinct...

Name: Duren
Text:
This isn’t the kind of magic you use for private matters…
I-It might completely ruin the ritual…

Name: Duren
Text:
This must be the reason why the monsters were running wild!
Coming all the way up here like this…

Name: Duren
Text:
I can’t just leave the monsters that have already been affected by this magic…
T-They are going to try to hurt the villagers soon…

Name: Duren
Text: W-We should take care of all the altars…

Name: Duren
Text:
Thank you for all your support…
E-Even listening to me until the end even though it must have been very frustrating…

Name: Duren
Text: I have decided! I’m going to leave after I’ve helped these people live safely on their own…

Name: Duren
Text:
I-I can’t fight well like you b-but…
there should be a way if I use my knowledge of magic.

Name: Duren
Text: As someone who is also part of the Arcanist Alliance… I-I have to protect the weak…

Name: Duren
Text:
L-Leave this place to me!
I-I won’t let them continue using forbidden magic like this!

Name: Tion
Text:
Hey, where is the dragon?
I heard I could capture a dragon if I came here.

Name: Tion
Text:
This is a chance to bring glory to my name.
I will take their horn and scale as trophy.

Name: Tion
Text:
You! I will give you a chance to be my assistant.
Tell me where the dragon is!

Name: Tion
Text:
What? Are you lying to me right now?!
Are you telling me I crossed the broder for nothing?!

Name: Tion
Text:
Even though there is no dragon in Krea, there are some beyond its borders.
That’s what I heard.

Name: Tion
Text:
If the dragons really are extinct…
How can I quench my thirst to become the greatest warrior?

Name: Tion
Text: I need mystical creatures like the dragon to truly test my skills!

Name: Tion
Text:
My body is itching for a fight!
Hey, is there anything to hunt around here?

Name: Tion
Text:
Haha! Now that I take a better look, you have quite the presence.
Someone of your caliber surely wouldn’t speak so lightly, right?

Name: Tion
Text:
Hmm… Great!
You’ve piqued my interest, so I will hear you out.

Name: Tion
Text: Go forth and show me what kind of warrior you are!

Name: Tion
Text:
Oh, yes, I can see you have quite the refined way of using your strength.
I seem to have much experience.

Name: Tion
Text:
I’m beginning to think I can cross swords with you in a serious battle.
I’m sure you’ll make it entertaining.

Name: Tion
Text: Still, it weights on my mind that I haven’t slain a dragon yet.

Name: Tion
Text:
I asked around, but everyone gave me the same answer.
Dragons have been extinct for a long time.

Name: Tion
Text: But I have a different opinion! Since there are similiar creatures still in existence!

Name: Tion
Text:
I’m sure they are just waiting for the right moment.
They are hiding because mankind is in power right now!

Name: Tion
Text:
If I can’t find them, I’ll make them come out on their own.
If I put some treasures out in the open, I’m sure they won’t be able to resist.

Name: Tion
Text:
I went through every ledger in the capital because I wanted to capture a dragon.
I read that they like shiny things!

Name: Tion
Text:
The strategy is to place some gold and silver treasures on high ground.
Let’s wait until it stops flapping its wings and shows its greedy side!

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(I piled up some gold with Taon.
It might look like a feast to a dragon.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(But how did Taon get his hands on all this gold?
It’s too much for a common folk…)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(He might be from a wealthy family.
But would a dragon really show up?)</>

Even after a long and boring while,
nothing appeared in the sky.

Name: Tion
Text:
Haha! It’s not easy!
A warrior’s path is riddled with challenges!

Name: Tion
Text:
However, the disappointment is also very real.
I spent days working countless jobs for this journey.

Name: Tion
Text:
I spent everything I had, but it turns out to be a failure.
This might put a stain on my legacy.

Name: Tion
Text: Hmm! I guess written words alone are not enough to find a dragon.

Name: Tion
Text:
I heard there are countless opportunities near the Giant's Tower,
I haven’t been able to show my skills for a fortnight!

Name: Tion
Text:
You think so too, right?
My unused limbs are crying out.

Name: Tion
Text:
A true warrior does not brood over concerns.
I should go down and cut down some monsters!

Name: Tion
Text:
Nothing is better at curing boredom than this.
These are different from the ones from the capital, so this too is a small pleasure.

Name: Tion
Text:
I should take a quick rest and plan the next move,
while cooling off my head!

Name: Tion
Text:
I met many people from Krea who came over here,
but none walk the same path as me.

Name: Tion
Text:
I like killing monsters, but I’m not a hunter.
Because my objective isn’t in the hunt!

Name: Tion
Text:
I’m just training my body and chasing after the experience.
Sometimes, I found hidden masters and challenged them to a duel.

Name: Tion
Text:
That’s how I can protect myself and those around me!
That is where Krea’s pride resides!

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Although the modern Krea is quite,
I heard it used to declare war for several reason in the past…)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Is what he is saying be the true meaning of Krea?
They worship combat skills, but they don’t seem like a war-hungry nation.)</>

Name: Tion
Text:
Ah! I heard there were villains roaming around these parts!
I suddenly remembered while I was warming up!

Name: Tion
Text:
I heard the burnt ravens or something like that were causing trouble.
I heard they even had a physical clash with the residents.

Name: Tion
Text:
It does not matter who they are!
The important thing is not fighting amongst each other!

Name: Tion
Text:
If the residents were strong enough to take care of themselves,
they would have been able to skillfully handle something like this.

Name: Tion
Text:
I can’t believe they would disrupt their unity in a place where a dragon might appear.
A truly foolish thing to do.

Name: Tion
Text:
That’s right! How about we show them how to fight?
Let’s stage a fierce battle of life and death.

Name: Tion
Text: Don’t you think it will bring them right to their senses? Haha!

Name: Tion
Text: Oh, no! I overlooked the fact that people here are living day to day.

Name: Tion
Text:
For them to be this quiet despite all our efforts…
It could only mean that public safety here is a complete mess!

Name: Tion
Text:
Even a small neighborhood requires a proper system!
Such indifference will hinder their advancement as a community!

Name: Tion
Text:
I should find out the reason why they have no interest in combat.
If we remove the cause, they should be able to move onwards!

Name: Groggy Villager
Text:
What…? A security guard? But this is the best we have…
We don’t have any supplies.

Name: Groggy Villager
Text:
It’s not like there is a Krea manor in Babylon,
and there isn’t any notable faction protecting us either.

Name: Groggy Villager
Text: The ones who came here to escape trouble in the homeland has to stick together to survive on our own…

Name: Groggy Villager
Text:
Oh! The Hunters Guild helps us from time to time.
There is a hunter village north of here.

Name: Groggy Villager
Text:
But it’s not like we can pay them or anything…
How can we ask them to come every time?

Name: Groggy Villager
Text:
Sigh… I also used to be a soldier in the Krea army.
Of course I want to go out and fight!

Name: Groggy Villager
Text:
This burning will to fight and the will to destroy everything getting in my way…
I still have it branded on my chest…

Name: Groggy Villager
Text:
But we don’t have enough weapons or armor.
It would be a blessing to have enough food.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(The situation seems worse than I thought.
Since they aren’t receiving any help from the capital, I should help them out…)</>

Name: Tion
Text: Oh, no… I now understand what you’re going through.

Name: Tion
Text:
The strength of a warrior comes from a healthy body.
That’s why high-quality meals are absolutely necessary!

Name: Tion
Text:
I should get some that are easy to come by.
Let’s catch some fish floundering around in the stream.

Name: Groggy Villager
Text: How did you get so many?!

Name: Groggy Villager
Text:
I wasn’t able to get any food because of the monsters…
There are several people who have been starving for days.

Name: Groggy Villager
Text:
On top of that, someone who looked like a Krea warrior
gave us his spare gears.

Name: Groggy Villager
Text:
He carried a dagger, a spear, a shield… all types of gears.
He even took off all of his armors…

Name: Groggy Villager
Text:
Are you two working together?
Thank you so much! I can finally stretch my legs!

Name: Tion
Text: Haha! Doing a good deed fills me up with energy!

Name: Tion
Text:
I put weapons in the hands and food in their mouths.
They should be able to get back on their feet.

Name: Tion
Text:
They should have no choice but to watch our demonstration.
It’s not like they’re going to draw blood fighting for daily necessities.

Name: Tion
Text: So let’s show them what a real battle is about! Ha!

Name: Tion
Text:
As expected, a few residents showed interest.
They were impressed by the high quality.

Name: Tion
Text:
They said they wanted to learn basic swordsmanship,
and I decided to stay for a bit as their instructor!

Name: Tion
Text:
Haha, I never expected to become a teacher on my journey to find a dragon.
But this is also a part of the training.

Name: Tion
Text: I can perfect my skills even further while teaching others.

Name: Tion
Text:
I hope you too bear this in mind as you move onward.
It was a great time!

Name: Devora
Text: Hmm, does it make sense for a frontier researcher to have this much work?

Name: Devora
Text:
Will you stop staring and give me a hand?
My youth is dissolving away like snow.

Name: Devora
Text:
I have to measure something, but there are just too many monsters over there.
It would be bad if I went by myself and got hurt…

Name: Devora
Text:
I really hate danger, even more than not getting paid.
What’s the point if you die… Don’t you think so?

Name: Devora
Text:
I don’t want to be rude to someone I just met…
But my friend is completely trapped♥

Name: Devora
Text:
I don’t know, he was insisting on using an old device and caused an explosion.
I was left alone to write a report.

Name: Devora
Text:
Vedat can be so stubborn.
I told him he’s going to get in trouble if the manager found out, but he didn’t listen.

Name: Devora
Text: Since I told you everything… Will you please do me a favor, honey?

Name: Devora
Text:
I will give you all of my hazard pay.
Oh, but don’t expect a big pay.

Name: Devora
Text: Oh… Thank you for your hard work, but we have a small problem.

Name: Devora
Text:
I’m using a new device I received from the expedition.
I can do many fun things with this.

Name: Devora
Text:
It’s fast, and armed with many functions.
The downside is that it’s big, heavy, and difficult to use.

Name: Devora
Text:
I must have made some mistake while using it…
I ended up getting way too many values that should have been filtered out.

Name: Devora
Text:
Speaking of which, I think I will use this one too.
In a rush, you’re bound to use what you’re used to♥

Name: Devora
Text:
The old device Chedar confiscated.
I secretly brought it here! It would have been lonely if I left it alone.

Name: Devora
Text: I’m going to take good care of it and return it to Vedat when he’s done writing the report.

Name: Devora
Text:
There is so much clutter on Chedar’s desk anyway…
No one will notice if this little thing goes missing, haha.

Name: Devora
Text: Now, please do me another favor.

Name: Devora
Text: How fast can you run, honey?

Name: Devora
Text:
I hope you can run fast while carrying me on your back!
It should be fine because I’m light.

Name: Devora
Text:
Unless Chedar brings his Glider,
he will never catch us on our romantic getaway.

Name: Devora
Text:
He said he was worried that I was doing the research the two of us were doing by myself.
He said he’s coming to see me, hmm.

Name: Devora
Text:
But the old device I showed you before,
every single one was banned from use.

Name: Devora
Text:
This one is fine because I fixed it after I secretly took it…
I set it up over there for long term measurement.

Name: Devora
Text:
But I have to run away if I get caught by Chedar, which is why I asked.
I don’t like to be nagged at.

Name: Devora
Text:
You want to make it as if nothing happened, right?
I knew I liked you♥

Name: Devora
Text: Then… Hurry up and retrieve it while I draw Chedar’s attention.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Phew… Finished. The manager isn’t nearby, is he?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Looks like she bought enough time. He wouldn’t have seen it at that speed.
I should act like nothing happened.)</>

Name: Chedar
Text:
Oh, we meet here again.
You must be the one who’s been helping Devora.

Name: Chedar
Text:
A look like her requires a lot of attention.
She has such a sneaky personality, it’s difficult to figure her out.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I even sent Vedat to show her the ropes,
but she ended up causing trouble trying to do something with that old device… Ahem.

Name: Chedar
Text:
You already know how short-handed we are at our waypoint, right?
Bardad does not send many people here.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I barely made the time to come here to see how things are.
Thank you for keeping this place safe…

Name: Chedar
Text:
…Did you expect me to say something like this?
I watched everything before coming down here.

Name: Chedar
Text:
How can you help here when you knew she was going to cause trouble?!
I know how crafty Devora can be with her words… But still!

Name: Chedar
Text:
You can’t just accept every request for some payment
and ignore the consequences.

Name: Chedar
Text:
If she gets in an accident and ends up getting hurt,
I’m the only one left to do all the work around here.

Name: Chedar
Text: I told Vedat to write a report only because he hurt his leg.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I wanted him to sit still and recover. That’s why I locked him… I mean,
made sure he stayed inside.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Sigh, but what’s done is done. I guess I’ll use some of your time as well.
I need a skilled adventurer or a mercenary.

Name: Chedar
Text:
This is a phenomenon that I haven’t seen before,
I need advices from people that has been to many places.

Name: Chedar
Text:
If you go to this location, the device reacts to something. 
But I cannot interact with that thing.

Name: Chedar
Text:
The issue might be that there is not nearly enough Aether…
but the expedition members can’t resolve it on their own.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I have a better chance than the two of them…
But I think it might react to you.
Opening the entrance revealed the Trial.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Are you done checking?
Was there a reaction?

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(The space itself was distorted. I’ll just tell her what I saw.)</>

Name: Chedar
Text:
Mmm… It’s all within the boundaries of my assumption.
I found something useful in this big pile of ancient document.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Something very similar was drawn on it.
The writer’s conclusion was… ‘I don’t know’.

Name: Chedar
Text:
The writer added a cautionary note:
If you don’t disturb it first, nothing will appear.

Name: Chedar
Text: Still, if what you say is true, it’s not completely out of our hands.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Objects or strange phenomena that transport you to a distorted space.
These are found quite often these days.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Which is why, instead of studying their origin,
I’m focusing more on what happens when someone comes into contact with it.

Name: Chedar
Text:
If you want to start from the roots,
you can just bury yourself in old papers like I did.

Name: Chedar
Text:
The most credible one among them is
the hypothesis that it was made by the ancient elite.

Name: Chedar
Text:
First, it is impossible with our modern technology.
Second, you need time to make something like this.

Name: Chedar
Text: It means you have to be a noblety with a lot time and money, right?

Name: Chedar
Text:
What’s certain is that a massive amount of the creator’s Aether went into this.
It’s impossible for humans today…

Name: Chedar
Text:
Its simliar to the way not everyone can use the Warp Anchors, right?
Your ability to use it is determined by the Aether you are born with.

Name: Chedar
Text:
In any case, I should seek an advice from the Liberators of Knowledge.
To do that, we will need more data to show them.

Name: Chedar
Text: Please deal with the monsters nearby while I work on it.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Our past expedition mentors couldn't even touch the thing,
but our methods have come a long way since then, right?

Name: Chedar
Text: Thanks to the new devices that we recently acquired, we are able to get plenty of measurements.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Interpreting and predicting those results is up to us,
but there is something that I figured out using the recent measurements.

Name: Chedar
Text:
It holds no meaningful relevance to the Giant’s Tower!
It only has a unique Aether wavelength!

Name: Chedar
Text:
What does it mean?
This isn’t the great discovery that will reveal the secrets of the ancient civilization.

Name: Chedar
Text:
It has the function to change the surrounding environment,
but I haven’t detected any wavelength that can cause any other phenomena.

Name: Chedar
Text: Of course, living organisms could get swept up in the process of the change.

Name: Chedar
Text:
For now, let’s wait for an answer from the Liberators.
Since we’ve started dealing with the monsters, shall we clean up the whole place?

Name: Chedar
Text:
This forward waypoint.
It was hated by monsters since it was created for people to travel.

Name: Chedar
Text:
One of the floating debris that should have been orbiting the upper part of the tower
fell and dug its way into the ground on this side.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Back then, the Aether pouring from it was just too intense.
A barrier had formed around it, even without magic.

Name: Chedar
Text:
It flung away anything that touched it, keeping everyone at bay,
but for some reason, that shield vanished in an instant…

Name: Chedar
Text:
From that day on, we vowed to set up a camp here, no matter what.
We had to stay close if we wanted to truly unravel its secrets.

Name: Chedar
Text: Of course, I got the materials needed for construction from monsters…

Name: Chedar
Text:
They attack our members the second they spot us!
I should’ve just hired mercenaries instead of doing this myself.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Ah… I probably wouldn’t have had the money.
Anyway, given these circumstances, I have to ask for your help.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Everything that I’ve requested from you has had great results.
If I had enough budget, I would have paid you double what I owe you.

Name: Chedar
Text: You even saved the locals here last time.

Name: Chedar
Text:
You took care the problem before anyone got badly hurt.
Thanks to you, everyone is healing quickly.

Name: Chedar
Text: Oh, some people were saying they couldn’t leave before meeting their savior.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Some were pleading to meet you
saying Cave Owls always repay their debts.

Name: Chedar
Text:
While you’re staying here, why don’t you go meet them?
Please convince them to return home because it’s dangerous here.

Name: Chedar
Text: I even packed a bag full of rescue supplies… Sigh.

Name: Joyful Cave Owl Elder
Text:
Our savior… You’ve returned!
I wanted to show you how grateful I am!

The elderly bowed and expressed his gratitude many times.
Each word was mixed with tears that could not be concealed.

Name: Joyful Cave Owl Elder
Text:
You just disappeared, so I thought I would never be able to see you again.
Now I can finally die in peace…

Name: Joyful Cave Owl Elder
Text:
It’s difficult to even walk in my age.
My injuries have healed… But I still can’t run.

Name: Joyful Cave Owl Elder
Text:
There are too many monsters on the way between my honetown and the lake…
I can’t avoid them all, can I…?

Name: Joyful Cave Owl Elder
Text: It would be better for others to just return without me.

Name: Joyful Cave Owl Elder
Text:
Oh, no, I’m fine with the way things are…
I faced a certain death, but you saved my life.

Name: Joyful Cave Owl Elder
Text:
I’m sorry to keep you during your busy times.
Go and do what you need to do…

Name: Frail Cave Owl Elder
Text: Oh, it’s you! You’re alive…!

Name: Frail Cave Owl Elder
Text:
I was worried something happened to you while saving us.
We all owe you our lives.

Name: Frail Cave Owl Elder
Text: I couldn’t bear to leave before, but now… we can finally go home.

Name: Frail Cave Owl Elder
Text:
To think such horror would strike the Lake of Spirits…
It’s a sacred place where we Cave Owls honor Tan.

Name: Frail Cave Owl Elder
Text:
We had hunters’ help on our way here.
We shared the same paths until halfway through the journey…

Name: Frail Cave Owl Elder
Text:
Those hunters roam all over the Elysium,
but they couldn't have known a fiend like that would ruin our holy ground…

Name: Frail Cave Owl Elder
Text:
Without you, it would have been a massacre.
It shames me that I have nothing  to repay you with…

Name: Frail Cave Owl Elder
Text: My remaining days may be few, but I’ll cherish every single one.

Name: Frail Cave Owl Elder
Text:
Bless you… Bless you…
Let’s see, the folks here packed some supplies for me earlier.

Name: Frail Cave Owl Elder
Text:
I insisted on staying until I saw you.
I set them down somewhere. Now my old mind can't recall where.

Name: Frail Cave Owl Elder
Text: Thank you… I must tell the others to get ready.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I see. You’ll be heading out soon, then?
Everything they need is packed, and they are fully recovered.

Name: Chedar
Text:
As the person in charge, I’ve done all I can.
I even made sure they got to see you, so there’s nothing left to—

Name: Chedar
Text: Oh, wait. There is one thing.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Their caravan has no real defense.
They're mostly non-combatants..

Name: Chedar
Text: Perhaps it’s the aftermath of the lake incident, monsters are still incredibly agitated.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I can’t escort them all the way home,
but to let them face danger the moment they leave…

Name: Chedar
Text:
I simply wouldn't feel right about it.
We should clear out as many monsters as possible around here.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Ugh, fighting after all this time makes my whole body ache…
I can already feel the muscle soreness kicking in.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I only learned magic for self-defense. I never imagined using it like this.
I can’t believe I attacked living creatures unprovoked…

Name: Chedar
Text:
At leastthe path is finally cleared, right?
I should let them know it’s safe to start their journey.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Great! Everyone is finally leaving the waypoint.
Once they make it through the Holy Beast Forest, it’ll be much safer.

Name: Chedar
Text:
I suppose it’s time to let you go as well.
I’ve worked you so hard my budget is about to burst…

Name: Chedar
Text:
If I want to keep Vedat and Devora’s shares untouched,
I’ll have to take it out of my own base pay.

Name: Chedar
Text: We just need to send off villagers waiting underground now.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Moving everyone at once would draw too much attention,
so I split them into two groups to leave separately.

Name: Chedar
Text: Once I confirm they’ve left in an hour or two, I'll have your payment—

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(At that moment, the makeshift transceiver sitting near Chedar
crackled with static.)</>

Name: Chedar
Text: What?! A horde is coming?!

Name: Chedar
Text:
The Cave Owls just left!
Gather everyone who can fight and go there now!

Name: Chedar
Text:
…This is the absolute last time I'll bother you.
Just buy us some time, and I'll handle the evacuation. Please, hurry!

Name: Chedar
Text: It’s over. For real this time.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Originally, I was planning to put them on Gliders,
and drop them off in another region.

Name: Chedar
Text:
The elders said that is the least we can do to settle here…
We were scrambling to prepare for a drop-off—

Name: Chedar
Text: But thankfully, we ran into some hunters on patrol.

Name: Chedar
Text:
They said they were heading to the Nameless Village anyway.
So, they offered to escort them there.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Turns out they already knew a few of the villagers.
That put my mind at ease.

Name: Chedar
Text:
The second group will return the same way.
Thanks to you buying us enough time.

Name: Chedar
Text:
…So, I'm going to make sure you are more than suitably rewarded.
Take a good rest and feel free to leave whenever you're ready.

Name: Chedar
Text: Well, I'll head out first to look after the remaining folks.

Name: Vedat
Text:
…It’s been a while.
I heard it was pure chaos with the Cave Owls.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Meanwhile, I had my own urgent matter.
Something incredibly tedious and annoying, but necessary to prevent potential disasters…

Name: Vedat
Text:
Like… installing these detonators.
They claim we need this because the monsters are swarming the outpost.

Name: Vedat
Text:
I know it’s essential for our defense,
but sending me out all by myself is just wrong.

Name: Vedat
Text:
How could they send a researcher out without a guard?
Chedar has absolutely no idea what's out there…

Name: Vedat
Text:
I can barely look after myself.
I’ve never even held a weapon before.

Name: Vedat
Text:
If we’re short on manpower, they can at least hire some mercenaries…
But of course, it’s always about money.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Just tag along with me for a bit…
Let’s get this over with quickly so I can go back to my actual job.

Name: Vedat
Text: …I buried them at every nook and cranny.

Name: Vedat
Text:
If monsters get agitated or go wild, the detonators will trip…
That should save us a lot of fights.

Name: Vedat
Text: Too bad they’re single-use and need replacing every time.

Name: Vedat
Text:
I was actually investigating the lake environment.
Trying to see if it’s been affected by the Monolith…

Name: Vedat
Text: Oh… right. Most people call it the Divine Stone.

Name: Vedat
Text:
There’s a theory that ancients built it as an ‘terraforming’ tool.
And there’s plenty of evidence to back it up…

Name: Vedat
Text:
Geographically speaking,
it makes no sense for neighboring areas to have such completely different weather.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Right next to a barren wasteland, you have a lush, vibrant garden.
Pass through that, and you find yourself in a ridge that looks like it took a meteor strike.

Name: Vedat
Text: The area has a mild cliamte. But the area right next to it?

Name: Vedat
Text:
Yeah… Cross one small hill, and it’s a completely different season there.
You can’t tell me there isn’t some supernatural force at play…

Name: Vedat
Text: And look at this place.

Name: Vedat
Text:
They call it Elysium because it’s always spring,
yet a short ride up the Rappie brings you to a snowfield

Name: Vedat
Text: So, people figure some ancient artifact must be behind it.

Name: Vedat
Text:
First off, this artifact would need to be massive,
built to store enough Aether to alter an entire region.

Name: Vedat
Text:
That is way beyond our modern technologies…
so it must be ancient imperial craft.

Name: Vedat
Text:
The Monolith best fits the description.
That’s why we’re building a replica for our experiment…

Name: Vedat
Text: …It’s a hassle, but I gotta do what I’m paid to do…

Name: Vedat
Text:
I'll need several raw materials to craft the artifact.
While I get things ready… could you handle the monsters for me?

Name: Vedat
Text:
We need to clear this place before heading into the lake…
There’s only one way in and out.

Name: Vedat
Text: Nobody at the headquarters knows how to fight, let alone here.

Name: Vedat
Text:
But something about that Lomon Gate is bothering me…
I have a bad feeling about the garrison there.

Name: Vedat
Text: Sure, they're good, but owing them a favor is just asking for trouble.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Krea’s internal conflicts are pretty nasty…
It’d be better not to get involved.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Well… when an Incursion breaks out or monsters get out of hand,
they show up in time to help the villagers, but still…

Name: Vedat
Text:
*sigh* I'd much rather ask an adventurer or a mercenary like you.
You're easy to talk to, and there are no strict rules to follow.

Name: Vedat
Text: So, now that you are here, I might as well clear my backlogs.

Name: Vedat
Text:
I need to see if I can extract Aether from tower debris,
and transfer it to the replica Monolith… all in one go.

Name: Vedat
Text:
But the good stuff is at the headquarters,
and the underground stash here is strictly off-limits.

Name: Vedat
Text:
It means I have to go out and gather the debris myself.
They'll be hard to spot, so I'm going to use a little trick.

Name: Vedat
Text:
I will use a resonance generator to track down anything that reacts.
My eyes can't pick up subtle traces of Aether…

Name: Vedat
Text:
I heard some people can actually see Aether entanglement in nature.
It’s incredibly rare, like some kind of a special trait.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Anyway, start searching once I give the signal.
This artifact is tricky to use… Just give me a second.

Name: Vedat
Text:
I had no idea tiny fragments like this were still left…
No wonder they couldn’t find them.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Did anything strange happen when you picked it up?
Like a tingle… or something bursting out?

Name: Vedat
Text:
Never mind how small it is…
Look, it’s glowing right now. I think it’s because you touched it.

Name: Vedat
Text:
It fell from the sky ages ago, but it still has power left?
Ah… more data for my report…

Name: Vedat
Text:
This is exactly why I asked for more hands… Tsk.
Captain Bardad is just way too stingy…

Name: Vedat
Text:
There are so many variables out in the field.
When work piles up like this, I just want to stop and put off verything

Name: Vedat
Text:
Hand over what you found so far…
I need to preserve it so this state lasts.

Name: Vedat
Text: Next, we’re heading into the lake, so please go clear the path ahead…

Name: Vedat
Text:
By the way, do you know why the Cave Owls keep coming here?
Did anyone ever tell you why?

Name: Vedat
Text:
They're descendants of Tan… like, generations down.
The kingdom fell a long time ago.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Yet they definitely inherited the spirit of Tan.
Enough to come all the way to this lake just to pray.

Name: Vedat
Text: Just like how the Naruru follow the god Ea.

Name: Vedat
Text:
They say there’s some kind of… natural energy here.
Lay folks don't know about the Aether, so that’s probably how they see it.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Hmm, perhaps it’s connected to the Giant's Tower under the water?
The Aether levels here are unusually high…

Name: Vedat
Text:
Ugh… I really don't want to dig any deeper…
Feels like I’m just making more work for myself…

Name: Vedat
Text:
I imagined this place being terraformed,
and now I can't stop thinking about it…

Name: Vedat
Text:
I wanted to secure control samples first before starting.
But I guess I’ll have to go straight to the point…

Name: Vedat
Text:
We should analyze the nature of the Aether first…
Scout around the lake and gather some Aether for me.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Your high Aether sensitivity will mess up the flow
the second you touch it.

Name: Vedat
Text:
We need to repliace the same conditions for the results to mean anything.
If you get it, get moving…

Vedat operated the Aether collector and tested a few items.
Some were not artifacts at all,
but one particular piece of junk reacted violently.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Luckily, the test progressed far enough to draw a conclusion…
This place must be linked to the Tan Kingdom…

Name: Vedat
Text:
This old necklace here…
An elderly Cave Owl gave it to me as a gift.

Name: Vedat
Text:
I saved him from a monster once.
He said it was a lifelong treasure he always kept close…

Name: Vedat
Text:
There are plenty of cases where human Aether rubs off on objects.
Over a long period, they sort of assimilate with each other.

Name: Vedat
Text:
So, the Tan people’s unique traits are linked to this lake…
Yeah, let’s leave it at that for now. Ugh, I'm exhausted…

Name: Vedat
Text:
….Come to think of it, the founding myth of Tan mentioned something like this.
"An artifact from the Tower laid the foundation of the Tan Kingdom."

Name: Vedat
Text:
"Responding to the owner's wish, the earth provided a place to rest, 
and the sky lit the path forward…" or so it goes.

Name: Vedat
Text:
If the artifact had the power to build a kingdom, it must have held some mystical force.
Though I’m not sure if it was meant for altering the environment like the Monolith.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Anyway, if the Tan people used the artifact a lot,
it makes sense that its traces show up in their descendants.

Name: Vedat
Text:
And this place happens to border the old Tan territory …
the artifact's power might have affected the lake.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Anyway, those people called this place the second ‘Star Forest.’
They said it's like a home for their hearts.

Name: Vedat
Text:
I couldn’t be bothered to pry into what the Star Forest actually is…
but everyone needs something to lean on, right?

Name: Vedat
Text: They can't go back to their homeland, and they feel a bit empty inside.

Name: Vedat
Text:
They're instinctively drawn here, so they come here often…
Never imagining it's because of the artifact their ancestors used.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Should I tell them the next time I see them?
That it's actually all because of an ancient artifact?… Hmm.

Name: Vedat
Text:
But if they get curious and ask about other things…
I'd have to tell them about the special artifacts… no, the Tower itself…

Name: Vedat
Text:
Oh great, just talking about it scrambled my brain!
Just give me a second, let me sort my thoughts out…

Name: Vedat
Text:
Phew… I can’t handle the next part alone.
I’ll need to talk to Chedar or Devora before moving forward…

Name: Vedat
Text: Let’s wrap this up and head back to the forward waypoint—

Name: Vedat
Text:
Ah, looks like it's time for my daily path clearing again.
Barely stayed here and monsters are already swarming.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Well, I'm just a poor, exploited, low-ranking researcher—
but I repay my debts, always.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Thanks for going along with me without complaining…
Now hurry back before the boss spots you.

Name: Vedat
Text:
Get back safely.
Go on, get moving!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
…Human, move along. No hanging around here.
Sahinia is trying to rest. Don't ruin it.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Sahinia needs to clear my head to keep things fair and square.
Sahinia has got to rest up well to protect my people. Every single Naruru.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Human! How do you know about Bristly-Hair? How?
Do you know any Bristly-Hair?

Name: Sahinia
Text:
I can't believe they'd hang out with this human. You look so dazed and soft.
Bristly-Hair Naruru are fierce and tough!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Hmph. Human, you're saying the Naruru in the Giant's Garden…
asked you for favors? Gave you food? Things like that?!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Naruru folk do not like humans!
How dare you throw such nonsense at my face. It's all fake!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
I've been away from the Giant's Garden for a long time.
But that doesn't mean I forgot everything.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
You will be punished for trying to trick me, Sahinia, an Angry-Tail!
I'll take you down right here, right now!

Name: Sahinia
Text: The merciful Ea might let it slide… this once.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Show me you're strong and fast…
strong enough to hang out with Bristly-Hair!

Name: Sahinia
Text: Only then, I'll hear you out!

Name: Sahinia
Text: Ha! Good! You know how to swing a weapon, human!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
If Bristly-Hairs are busy and really short on hands…
Only then, when there’s no other choice, they'd consider asking for help.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
But you said you visited Aburu Village and even visited  the festival?
No one can, unless you're a real friend to the Naruru!

Name: Sahinia
Text: That means you're a true friend, chosen by Sturdy Whisker himself…

Name: Sahinia
Text:
How did you win them over?
If you know every single thing we like…

Name: Sahinia
Text: No, no! Aburu Village would never be that careless!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Then show me! Do something to make us happy!
If you're a real friend, it should be a piece of cake.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(They treasure Goddess Ea.
They said living here is her blessing.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(I should show her I cherish Ea's gifts.)</>

Name: Sahinia
Text:
You watched over it with care… with diligence, human.
To think you looked after the greatest gift from Ea.

Name: Sahinia
Text: …Wait while I render my decision.

The Naruru sank deep into thought with a serious look,
as stern as any human commander…

Name: Sahinia
Text: Good! I can't just turn away a human who does their best for Ea.

Name: Sahinia
Text: But! You must show your skill in front of my warriors, not just me.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
They're waiting nearby, fresh out of training.
You must be able to hold your own even when others are watching!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Your form stays sharp, no matter who is looking.
I see a bit of Bristly-Hair in you!

Name: Sahinia
Text: You remind me of them, always staying dedicated to your duty.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
If you had felt pressured by us…
you would've lost your form instead of fighting like that.

Name: Sahinia
Text: Fine. I'll believe that you've fought alongside Bristly-Hair.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
But I don't know if the others feel the same way.
We need to gather and talk.

Name: Sahinia
Text: Go. Bring the Angry Tail members to me yourself!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Including me, there are four Angry Tails.
So you must get the other three. Run along!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
No one came.
They don't trust you!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
I chose to believe your words,
but the rest of the Angry Tails don't!

Name: Sahinia
Text: They'll see you as a dangerous human, and they'll come for you!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
I am the judge, but I am no different from them.
We are just kin, doing Sturdy Whisker's tasks.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
We want to see more of your skill.
We only saw a part of it. It is not enough!

Name: Sahinia
Text: Go. Slay more monsters!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Look, your head is still on your shoulders.
They decided not to kill you just yet!

Name: Sahinia
Text: Every Angry Tail has a job.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
I am the judge of the Angry Tails.
I am the weakest of the four, but the smartest.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
I find the strong and fierce Naruru.
I train them again and again to see if they become brave Naruru.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Like you humans, all Naruru are different.
They take tasks that fit them.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Naruru of Wind, Naruru of Sunlight, Naruru of Steel.
Their names tell you what kind of Angry Tail they are.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
If you want to live, convince them you are not a bad human.
The other three are very careful, so you must do well!

Name: Sahinia
Text: They must be watching us talk right now.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Train more before you look for the other Angry Tails.
Then you will look like a human who does what I say.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Zabiya, the Naruru of Wind, is the scout of the Angry Tails!
He’s faster than anyone. He sees every move of the enemy.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
If you do not show him you can move as fast...
He will not believe you are friends with Bristly-Hair.

Name: Zabiya
Text:
...Your footsteps are loud.
I can tell you are a human with no proper training.

Name: Zabiya
Text: Bristly-Hair always, always runs at top speed to protect the Naruru.

Name: Zabiya
Text: How can I believe you kept up with our warriors?

Name: Zabiya
Text:
Then let your movement kick up a wind.
See if you can even make my tail twitch.

Name: Zabiya
Text:
Not as fast as a Naruru swims...
but for a human, you are quite fast.

Name: Zabiya
Text:
At least you can keep up with us.
I believe you fought alongside Bristly-Hair.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Shamashak, the Naruru of Sunlight, is the vanguard of the Angry Tail.
He is stronger and fights better than anyone.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
He charges at the enemy no matter what!
You must show him that kind of bravery.

Name: Shamashak
Text:
Everything is a trial from Ea.
Do not be afraid. Move forward, always forward!

Name: Shamashak
Text:
Even when the sun burns hot and dries our fur!
Even when our eyes sting and our throats are dry, we fight to the end.

Name: Shamashak
Text:
This is the training ground given by Ea.
Stand brave and fight!

Name: Shamashak
Text:
I watched you. You have bravery.
That is what Bristly-Hair and Angry Tail share!

Name: Shamashak
Text:
You are good enough to fight by my side. A true comrade, yes!
I believe you helped the Naruru in danger.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Only Balih, the Angry Tail of Steel, is left.
She is the most serious Angry Tail among us.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Show her you never fall to any enemy.
Show her you can protect the Naruru.

Name: Balih
Text:
Protecting everyone is a duty of defense given by Ea.
You must hold your ground until it is safe.

Name: Balih
Text:
If you truly protected Aburu Village,
show me that you never fall, even after you fight and fight.

Name: Balih
Text:
Bristly-Hair and Angry Tail protect everyone.
We promised Ea, so we keep it to the end.

Name: Balih
Text:
So do not speak lightly of being friends.
That is like trying to deceive Ea!

Name: Balih
Text:
I saw you are as tough as I am, so I believe you.
You do not seem like a bad human.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
You passed all the tests of the Angry Tail.
I judge that your words are true.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
You did nothing Ea would hate.
You did everything you were asked to do.

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Aburu Village is friends with humans...
I still, still cannot believe it!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
Hmph, the Angry Tail is already heading back from our task anyway!
If your words are all lies, we will come for you!

Name: Sahinia
Text:
I know almost every Bristly-Hair.
When I go back, I will check again and again if you are really a friend.

Name: Sahinia
Text: Human, go on your way now!

Name: Stig
Text:
The name’s Stig, Explorers Guild.
Work for me, and I’ll make it well worth your while.

Name: Stig
Text:
Southern Elysium is a complete enigma.
Honestly, it’s a bit too big of a bite for me to take alone.

Name: Stig
Text:
You know—stuffing my head with lore, or lining my pockets with relics.
Finders keepers, right? The ultimate perk of being an explorer.

Name: Stig
Text:
Word is those Bardad rats have already set up camp up north.
We need to get in and get out before they start creeping down here. Cah-hah!

Name: Stig
Text:
Right now, we need to know what's wrong with the monsters.
They're prowling about out there like they've been hexed.

Name: Stig
Text:
Lesser beasts rarely leave their territories.
Yet these things are all migrating toward the exact same spot.

Name: Stig
Text:
Bad meat, maybe.
Or someone's pulling their strings from the shadows.

Name: Stig
Text:
Check their stomach for anything unusual.
If you're not sure, just bring me whatever you can harvest.

Name: Stig
Text:
You certainly brought back a haul.
Give me a moment. Let me have a look.

Name: Stig
Text:
My gear is down by the lower bridge.
Head on over. I’ll wrap things up here and meet you there.

Name: Stig
Text:
There were tiny spores inside the tissue.
You wouldn’t even spot them without a special lens.

Name: Stig
Text:
Well, plenty of fools poison themselves on wild mushrooms.
Maybe these beasts have been starving lately?

Name: Stig
Text:
Now, I need to know what these spores are.
Watch my back while I examine them.

Name: Stig
Text:
Some rogue alchemists are selling illegal stuff nearby, or what?
I’ve found traces of an artificial stimulant in these spores.

Name: Stig
Text:
A dangerous sort, no doubt.
It drives the beasts into a frenzy.

Name: Stig
Text:
Banned everywhere outside of military drills.
They’d throw you in the dungeons for this... Unbelievable.

Name: Stig
Text: Some idiot’s going to tear this entire forest apart.

Name: Stig
Text:
They might have scattered these spores on purpose.
We should put down any monsters already infected.

Name: Stig
Text:
Huh, since when do soldiers get deployed for chemical experiments?
Take a look at these sketches I made.
ItemDesc:
It resembles a human footprint.
Distinct, evenly spaced grooves are visible.

Name: Stig
Text:
There were boot prints here and there.
Suspicious as hell...

Name: Stig
Text:
No regular garrison patrols this area.
The Crea lot are stationed way up north.

Name: Stig
Text:
So, what does that leave us with?
Uninvited guests. Slipping through the shadows.

Name: Stig
Text:
The strides were uniform, but the sizes varied.
A well-trained unit passed through here.

Name: Stig
Text: Creeping through the back just to rile up the beasts... Fascinating.

Name: Stig
Text:
We need to scout the whole area, starting right from this spot.
You just keep doing your thing.

Name: Stig
Text:
They moved along a fixed path without a single moment of hesitation.
There’s no mistaking their destination or their intent.

Name: Stig
Text: The tracks cross over to the other side. Clear the path a little.

Name: Stig
Text: The footprints started right here.

Name: Stig
Text:
Dropped down from this sheer cliff...
Then used a Glider to land right here.

Name: Stig
Text: It makes perfect sense if they followed the forest edge straight down from the Crea Barrier.

Name: Stig
Text:
I’ll need to update the map with this.
A treacherous route, but a non-issue for assassins.

Name: Stig
Text:
What? It’s an open secret.
The Crea Imperial Court keeps its own hounds.

Name: Stig
Text:
Supposedly hunting down the royal bloodlines of fallen kingdoms.
Just their way of stamping out any loose ends.

Name: Stig
Text:
I’m not planning to pick a fight with assassins.
As an explorer, it's my job to keep a neutral record.

Name: Stig
Text:
Like those "maps" you adventurers rely on.
All managed by our guild, mind you.

Name: Stig
Text:
Maybe I’ll scribble in a "Beware of Assassins" warning for you.
Once I’m completely done with this investigation, that is.

Name: Stig
Text:
I found some of their gear.
Looks like they camped out for a day or two after crossing over.
ItemDesc:
Powder discovered by Stig.
The color alone screams danger.

Name: Stig
Text: They had some spore powder on them. Kept it in a black pouch.

Name: Stig
Text:
What a way to handle assassinations these days.
Putting a blade through someone is cleaner and faster.

Name: Stig
Text:
Then again... why should I care how they do things?
Not when we still have so much ground to cover.

Name: Stig
Text:
No use wasting time! I'm heading out to map the terrain first.
You stay here and look for tracks left by those hounds.

Name: Stig
Text:
Need to see what else they're up to besides these cheap tricks.
Let's meet up near the Soul's Repose when you're done.

Name: [player]
Text: (Torn apart by a beast’s fangs...?)

Name: [player]
Text: (Did they target the locals? Because of the spore powder...?)

Name: [player]
Text: (I should head down and check on them.)

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text: Th-there are... too many of them…

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
I can't run anywhere, even if you patch me up.
Clear them out first! Please!

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
Thank you... Thank the gods…
Almost died just digging for herbs.

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
It’s not even an Incursion…
But the beasts have gone mad.

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
Usually, they leave you alone.
Unless you get too close.

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
Anyway, I won't forget this.
Please, take this. For your trouble.

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text: I hate to ask, but... could you walk with me a bit?

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
Just need one more herb…
But I'm terrified the beasts over there might be just as rabid…

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text: Thank you... Truly.

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
This is the place.
Look at them all...

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text: Draw their attention. I’ll be quick!

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
This will buy some bread tonight.
My kids are depending on me. Can’t take off a single day.

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
I have to keep risking it.
No one knows the cause... so I'll just have to be careful.

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
It’s been about a fortnight since the beasts turned like this.
Woke up one morning to complete chaos.

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
But there was no Incursion in the dead of night...
And no signs of a fight either.

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
With no explanation, we're just helpless.
Guess we'll just have to wait for it to blow over…

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
The northern hunters should be down for patrol soon.
I'll bring it up with them then.

Name: Forgotten Crest Villager
Text:
I can't thank you enough for saving me.
Safe travels.

Name: Stig
Text:
Took you long enough.
What kept you out there?

Name: [player]
Text: (After hearing what happened, Stig’s eyes narrowed.)

Name: Stig
Text: So even the locals are in the dark.

Name: Stig
Text:
Come on, it’s not that hard to piece together.
The culprit pulled this off under the cover of night.

Name: Stig
Text:
Still not getting it, are you?
Then go sift through the kills, like before.

Name: Stig
Text:
While I was waiting,
my gut told me exactly where to look.

Name: Stig
Text:
Aha! See what this is?
I pulled a piece of steel right out of that beast's gut!
ItemDesc:
A dagger Stig pulled from the beast's carcass.
Simple in design, but lethal enough.

Name: Stig
Text:
The beast went into such a frenzy, it swallowed the enemy whole.
Well, it happens more often than you'd think.

Name: Stig
Text:
Didn't they anticipate this when using that spore powder?
They should’ve known they’d get caught in their own trap.

Name: Stig
Text:
Judging by the number of dagger shards, it’s definitely theirs.
Assassins sent by the Emperor of Crea.

Name: Stig
Text:
Scoff... Talk about a coward.
Spending this much effort on the bloodline of a fallen kingdom.

Name: Stig
Text:
There was even poison on the blade. You know what that means?
They were ordered to finish the job by any means necessary.

Name: Stig
Text:
Idiots.
Why stick to such a clumsy method anyway?

Name: Stig
Text:
It’s not like anyone deployed troops here.
This place is just full of civilians who don't even know how to fight.

Name: Stig
Text:
If I were the Emperor, I’d have just sent a whole army.
Raze this Elysium and wipe out those hiding descendants.

Name: Stig
Text:
That’s what war is.
Buildings crumble, forests and mountains burn away into nothing.

Name: Stig
Text:
Once things get that loud—
A few people dying in the middle of it won't even register.

Name: Stig
Text:
Still, there must be a reason they’re being so petty.
I have a feeling I know why... but I need a closer look.

Name: Stig
Text:
Go down and clear out those beasts first.
I don't feel like slipping while climbing and becoming monster food.

Name: Stig
Text:
Groan... My shoulders and legs are aching all over.
Since when is climbing this hard? Must be getting old.

Name: Stig
Text: But what can you do? I only do this because it’s fun.

Name: Stig
Text:
Alright, before my muscles lock up, let's check the other side.
Watch my back while I examine the structure, just like before.

Name: Stig
Text:
Now I see.
It’s because of this stonework that they’re sending assassins in small trickles.
ItemDesc:
Filled with phrases that are barely legible.
There are some unfamiliar words, but it’s mostly due to Stig’s atrocious handwriting.

Name: Stig
Text:
The analysis shows this wasn't made by modern humans.
It doesn't even exist in the geological layers of this planet.

Name: Stig
Text:
But it's not like humanity only exists here!
Think of how many lifeforms thrive beyond Elsetia.

Name: Stig
Text:
They could have stopped by here at some point in the past.
Building structures like this with their own technology.

Name: Stig
Text:
Look behind you. It doesn't burn, and it doesn't rot in water.
Even a massive impact would barely leave a scratch.

Name: Stig
Text:
Isn't there something similar near Babylon? The Beggar's—no, the Giant’s Tower.
Yes! The composition is almost identical to that....

Name: Stig
Text:
Aha! No wonder Crea couldn't play their usual game.
Because they couldn't just cover up the horrors of war with fire.

Name: Stig
Text:
Damn... it's been a while since my heart pounded like this.
Scaling that wall at forty was worth the misery after all.

Name: Stig
Text:
I need to verify this with the wave analyzer.
Let's see, the notes I took last time... Ah, right here.

Name: Stig
Text: Let's move for a grand discovery, rookie.

Name: Stig
Text:
Oh, Ea has finally shown us the path.
Was all that humiliation just leading up to this very moment?

Name: Stig
Text:
What of it?
It’s not like they can do anything to me.

Name: Stig
Text:
Ea is the deity governing all lands in Elsetia.
And my job is to venture into every corner I can set foot on, right?

Name: Stig
Text: Plummeting to your death off a cliff, poisoning yourself while foraging, getting trapped in an avalanche and freezing...

Name: Stig
Text:
Do you have any idea how easy it is for an explorer to die? Do you?
I'm just praying for protection while I do my job, for pity's sake.

Name: Stig
Text:
You know how small our guild is.
Ever thought about why that is? Scoff... Because they’re all dead!

Name: Stig
Text:
Shh, quiet.
The deity is sending me a sign.

Name: Stig
Text:
What you face... is a new material...
The properties of the stone... have been altered through Aethercraft...!

Name: [player]
Text: (...Quite the character, isn't he?)

Name: Stig
Text:
The deity knows all.
You’ve got to observe a single subject in various environments.

Name: Stig
Text:
I’ve been noticing this for a bit, but the air is exceptionally damp here.
The beasts' venom is heavily condensed, too.

Name: Stig
Text:
Preventing corrosion from venom requires a pretty advanced craft.
Let's see what they’ve done here.

Name: Stig
Text: Ah, I need to look into the venom composition, so go grab a fang or something, alright?

(Just as things finished up, I turned to look for Stig—
only for a massive explosion to rock the area.)

Name: Stig
Text: What's this? Rushing over to find me just because of a little noise?

Name: Stig
Text:
Worried the old man would blow himself up in an experiment? Bwahaha!
Look at you, a total scaredy-cat.

Name: Stig
Text: See this? I set off explosives right against the wall, and it doesn't have a single scratch.

Name: Stig
Text:
What did I tell you earlier?
Unburnable, unrottable, and practically immune to physical force.

Name: Stig
Text: That's all thanks to the magic circuits engraved throughout the structure.

Name: Stig
Text:
It means all three protective wards are active.
Impressive that it’s held up for this long.

Name: Stig
Text: Once I finish analyzing the poison with the sample you brought…

Name: Stig
Text:
We'll have proof it was designed with specific environments in mind.
Damn, I really am a genius.

Name: Stig
Text:
What are you staring at?
Hand over what you gathered and back away.

Name: Stig
Text: The noise from the blast might draw some unwelcome guests.

Name: Stig
Text:
There’s a distinct difference from the structures back in the fields.
This one has one more magic circuit engraved on it.

Name: Stig
Text:
They call this place the Valley of Death, or something.
Means the venom here must be incredibly potent.

Name: Stig
Text:
Whether it formed naturally, I couldn't tell you.
But since they prepared for it, it means someone survived.

Name: Stig
Text:
Someone in the past, like I said earlier.
Whoever they were... they brought in some truly enviable craft.

Name: Stig
Text:
It spans across the entire Elysium.
From one structure to another, linking everything with sky bridges.

Name: Stig
Text:
This might actually be a thoroughly customized, planned city!
Everything is part of a grand design!

Name: Stig
Text:
Aha! A dead land where mere refugees hide away?
We shouldn't judge it on such simple terms.

Name: Stig
Text:
Brilliant, isn't it? Hmm?
This brilliant mind of mine will uncover every last secret!

Name: Stig
Text:
Bwahaha! I need to tell Orica right away.
To bring everyone and get over here right now.

Name: Stig
Text: Take a breather for now! I'll call you again soon.

Name: Orica
Text: Someone’s in a good mood. Heard some good news?

Name: Orica
Text: Always impatient. Well, I suppose that’s what I like about you.

Name: Orica
Text: I should head to the Tower.
