Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(…So extreme, this one.)</>

Name: Orica
Text: Now, let’s cut the small talk and get straight to the point.

Name: Orica
Text: Have you ever heard of <Blue>Ninkar</>?

Name: Orica
Text: …Maybe you should look back on your social life for a change.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Probably no use mentioning I’ve been busy chasing mercenaries, right?)</>

Name: Orica
Text:
Lately, Ninkar has been spreading among adventurers.
They say it’s a secret formula for becoming stronger.

Name: Orica
Text:
I got my hands on some to see if the rumors were true, but it didn't really have any effect.
I knew something was off.

Name: Orica
Text:
So, I tracked down the recipe, and you know what I found?
I figured out the compounding formula used in the Ancient Empire.
ItemDesc:
Following extensive research to accelerate the manifestation of the Gudua Factor, we have successfully developed the following stimulant.

This stimulant is made from a Monster's Heart, a Monster's Spinal Cord, and the Minion's Grace.
The Imperial Laboratory shall not be held liable for any side effects resulting from a failure to comply with the prescribed formula.

[Product No.] ACN-07
[Product Name] Ninkar
[Formula]
Monster's Heart
 * Use a fresh heart within one hour of extraction.
 * Fresh hearts are more susceptible to damage. Handle with extreme care.

Monster's Spinal Cord
 * The recipe requires a spinal cord with minimal damage.
 * Even a single crack in the spinal cord may lead to contamination.

Minion's Grace
 * Apply the Minion's Grace over the aforementioned ingredients.

[Result Verification]
1. Success: A golden, glowing liquid is produced.
2. Failure: A green, viscous liquid is produced.
3. Unknown: If white, glowing liquid is produced, there is a 30% chance of gaining the intended effects of a successful concoction.

※ Precautions
When ingesting Ninkar in the "Unknown" state, the following symptoms occur with a 70% probability:
 * Some users did not display ay symptoms, though they are rare.

<Main Symptoms>
1. Vomiting, diarrhea, and fever – lasts for 48 hours.
2. Poisoning – lasts for 36 hours.
3. Paralysis – lasts for 24 hours. 
4. Death – ocurred in a small number of cases (1–2% probability).

Name: Orica
Text:
My request is simple.
<Yellow>Craft Ninkar according to the formula.</>

Name: Orica
Text:
I wouldn't recommend drinking it yourself.
There are others far better suited for that sort of thing.

Name: Orica
Text: You'll find the materials in the Tower. Simple, right?

Name: Orica
Text: Ha, you think the Explorers Guild would try to stiff you?

Name: Orica
Text:
Of course, I’ve got something ready for you.
Something so fresh it hasn't even hit the Codexs yet.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I gave in and agreed to go.)</>

Name: Orica
Text: You won't regret it. You trust me, right?

Name: Orica
Text: Alright, to the Tower it is.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...So this is the Giant's Tower.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It’s more massive than I thought. I shouldn’t let my guard down.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The communicator’s been acting strange since I got here.
Better take a break and check it.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The scenery has changed again.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It’s unnerving, but stay calm and move.
Can't let myself look weak, just like Orica said.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(That strange voice again... it’s coming from the communicator.)</>

<Yellow>H... Help me!
Is-is anyone there?!</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(This voice... It's the voice from the communicator.
I need to get there, now.)</>
I'm alive... Thank you.
...Is that so?

Then I’ve been quite rude. I apologize.
I only meant to contact my comrades...
But it's strange. Why did the signal go to you…?

Give me your communicator.
Let me take a look.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I stares in disbelief at the sudden demand.)</>

What, afraid I'll break it?
Ah... maybe it’s because I haven't introduced myself yet.

Name: Elin
Text:
I am <Orange>Elin.</>
An explorer, here on her Majesty's orders.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A Queen’s Explorer? I think I've heard that somewhere before...)</>

Name: Elin
Text:
There's no need to be on guard.
<Yellow>I have absolutely no intention of doing you wrong.</>

Name: Elin
Text:
So, aren't you going to tell me your name?
I want to know who my savior is!

Name: Elin
Text: [player]... That’s a fine name.

Name: Elin
Text:
Now, anyone who saves the Queen’s Sword and Staff
deserves a good reward.

Name: Elin
Text: First, let me fix that communicator.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I handed it over with a look of clear warning against any foul play.)</>

Name: Elin
Text: If there’s anything you need, just say the word.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Should I ask about the Ninkar recipe?)
...If this fails, I’ll have to gather all the materials all over again.)</>

Name: Elin
Text: Or not, if you’ve got nothing.

Name: Elin
Text:
<Blue>Minion’s Grace</>...
So you have the Ninkar recipe.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I thought only the Explorers Guild held that information?)</>

Name: Elin
Text:
Of course I know. I’m an explorer, after all.
First, the term ‘Minion’ refers to the <Orange>Lagar</>.

Name: Elin
Text:
They’re a race that can be traced back to the days of the Ancient Empire.
...Also, the ancestors of the <Blue>Enkia</>.

Name: Elin
Text:
Most dismiss it as an old folk tale,
but explorers like me, serving under Her Majesty...

Name: Elin
Text:
we accept it as established fact.
Though, more research is still required.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It reminds me of what Rada said about the Lagar.)</>

Name: Elin
Text:
As for the other half—the Grace...
It appears to be a magical process, but I have no way to prove it.

Name: Elin
Text: DId that answer your questio?

Name: Elin
Text: Then, would you mind picking some purple flowers from the garden over there?

Name: Elin
Text:
<Yellow>Because I want to have something that you game me.
I’ll leave it to you, then?</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(They call this place a 'garden'? Hard to believe.
It looks like a ruin, no matter how I look at it...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Anyway, let's just go grab those flowers.)</>

Name: Elin
Text:
Coming from you, the flowers seem all the more special.
They were certainly worth the wait.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She could’ve just picked them herself. Why on earth...)</>

Name: Elin
Text:
I’m in a good mood now, so I'll indulge a whim.
First, take the communicator.

Name: Elin
Text:
As an explorer, there's something I’ve been wanting to try...
Will you help me?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let's hear it first.)</>

Name: Elin
Text: <Yellow>…The proof of the hypothesis—that the Lagar are the ancestors of the Enkia.</>

Name: Elin
Text: I have a feeling we can verify it using Minion’s Grace.

Name: Elin
Text: So, it’s not entirely impossible...

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Doesn’t seem as erratic as before.
Maybe there's a serious side when it comes to this kind of work.)</>

Name: Elin
Text:
There’s one more thing we can test.
I think we can use the mechanism of Aether.

Name: Elin
Text: <Yellow>Giving up is not a virtue of an explorer.</>

Name: Elin
Text: Besides, [player], you'll come out ahead if this works.

Name: Elin
Text:
It's just a legend, but there is something created by replicating the Aether mechanism of the 'Ragar'...
It’s <Blue>Gishkal's core</>.

Name: Elin
Text: How about we craft Ninkar with it?

Name: Elin
Text:
Gishkal happens to be right up there.
They call this <Yellow>'fate'</>, don’t they?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Their eyes show no sign of giving up. I should just accept.)</>

When I mentioned what happened at the tower, Orica's eyes widened in surprise, 
and she began to hastily search through the Codex.

Name: Orica
Text: ...I can't believe it.

Name: Orica
Text: They made Ninkar with the core of the Guardian Gishkal,

Name: Orica
Text: not tomention finding the Queen's Explorer so easily...

Name: Orica
Text:
Hmm? Did I not mention it earlier?
Well, it's not like I’ll hurt my mouth explaining it again.

Name: Orica
Text: <Yellow>'Meet the Queen's Explorer.'</>

Name: Orica
Text:
<Yellow>'Whether you pass the trial he gives, or dispose of him,
you only need to gain the authority to access other floors.'</>

Name: Orica
Text: … said every single person who went for the tower.

Name: Orica
Text:
Meaning, if you want to go to a floor other than that one, you have to find the Explorer.
They say it usually takes six or seven trips just to meet him...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She is looking at me with a puzzled expression.)</>

Name: Orica
Text: I guess it's better to see it for yourself.

Name: Orica
Text:
This record was reported quite a long ago, but
I thought you might need it.
ItemDesc:
Please be advised that this Codex cannot be submitted as an official record.

[Queen’s Explorer]
- An individual referring to themselves as the Queen's Explorer, disguised as an Enkian, although presumed otherwise.
 * Some say they are of the Ragar tribe, a claim that has yet to be ascertained.
- Most of what they say is false, but some has been proved to be true.

<Reasons>
1. Enkians are inherently isolationist and rarely venture outside their borders.
 * Most Enkians dispatched sent to the Forsaken Land were either exiled for political reasons or deemed unfit according to Enkian standards.
2. The Enkian Queen has, both officially and unofficially, denied sending the Explorer to the tower multiple times. There are letters that support her claim.
 * Evidence can be found in all of the Queen's letters since the initial discovery.

- Other Information
1. There are records of casualties upon refusing or failing the Explorer's request.
 * Some records state that the Explorer has been disposed of, but they are unconfirmed.
2. It has been confirmed that the Explorer can only be found within the tower.
3. Relics found where the Explorer disappeared: a dagger and feathers.
4. Testimonies regarding appearance
 * How could they go that far? It was a completely different person. (Omitted) It was truly horrible. That was just too much. To look exactly the same and do that...

Name: Orica
Text: If it's alright, I'd like you to investigate the <Orange>Queen's Explorer</>...

Name: Orica
Text:
I didn’t mean right now.
Later. You can do it later.

Name: Orica
Text: Alright, now it's time to do what you promised, right?
ItemDesc:
An ornately crafted dagger.
It looks exactly like the one found where Elin disappeared.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It's identical to the dagger left behind where Elin, the 'Queen's Explorer,' disappeared.)</>

Name: Orica
Text: I'll see you later then.

Name: Mueena
Text: I knew you would be here.

Name: Mueena
Text: ...Disappointed, are we?

Name: Mueena
Text:
That's right.
We are not exactly on greeting terms.

Name: Mueena
Text: My business is simple, [player].

Name: Mueena
Text: You just need to accept a job as a mercenary.

Name: Mueena
Text: ...You will accept, of course?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I don't want to get involved with the lieutenant. But there will be trouble if I refuse.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I’ll just say yes for now.)</>

Name: Mueena
Text: I will ensure you are amply compensated.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Good.
Then find <Orange>Nasser</> on the hill leading up to the Magobi Encampment.

Name: Mueena
Text: He will brief you on the details.

Name: Nasser
Text:
You must be the mercenary Lady Muina mentioned.
What do I call you?

Name: Nasser
Text:
[player]?
Sounds familiar... Did I hear it from Aman?

Name: Nasser
Text: Well, it doesn’t matter.

Name: Nasser
Text:
I'm Nasser. An information broker working for the Merchants Guild.
I do a bit of everything besides that, though.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...He talks a lot for an information broker.)</>

Name: Nasser
Text: Then, let’s get on with it, [player].

Name: Nasser
Text:
If I asked you to get in the same boat, you'd refuse, right?
...Hmm, maybe I should tell you anyway.

Name: Nasser
Text: ...Impatient, aren't we?

Name: Nasser
Text: We are not trying to rebuild a ruined kingdom.

Name: Nasser
Text:
...We just want to return to where we used to live, where our roots are,
and continue with our lives.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Right here.
With those who fled to survive and those who were exiled, never to return.

Name: Nasser
Text: I know. It has nothing to do with you.

Name: Nasser
Text: But why else would we hire a <Yellow>'mercenary'</> like you?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...He lays out these stories that make it hard to say no, and then smoothly turns it into a threat.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is this guy saying he will me loose if things go wrong...?)</>

Name: Nasser
Text: You know what's expected of you, right?

Name: Nasser
Text:
Don't take it personally.
As long as you complete the job successfully, you won't get killed.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Well, isn’t that comforting.)</>

Name: Nasser
Text:
We'll use a communicator to give you orders.
You just need to go where I tell you, and take them out.

Name: Nasser
Text: You know the <Red>Wolf Clan</>, right?

Name: Nasser
Text: I'm talking about the ones whose hideout you and Azlan smashed.

Name: Nasser
Text:
I thought they'd naturally disband without their boss,
but I still see them around time to time.

Name: Nasser
Text:
...I think I know why, but I only have suspicions right now,
and I'd like you to take care of it.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Go to the <Blue>Mirage Gorge</>.
Let's start from there.

Name: Nasser
Text: There's something you need to find.

Name: Nasser
Text:
A <Yellow>secret letter</>... of some sort?
Bandits writing secret letters… What a joke.

Name: Nasser
Text: Grab anything that looks suspicious.

Name: Nasser
Text: Oh? It's specially treated parchment.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Give it here.
There's a specific way to read this.

Name: Nasser
Text: Let's take a look, shall we?
ItemName: Secret Letter of the Shadow Wolves
ItemDesc:
To oust Aman and Muina,
to rebuild the Shadow Wolf Clan,
to get Babylon into our hands,
this hunt must succeed.

-Fahad-

Name: Nasser
Text: Haa... How awful.

Name: Nasser
Text: They’re not even trying to hide it.

Name: Nasser
Text: Fahad is Shah's right-hand man.

Name: Nasser
Text: There's only one reason he made Fahad a Consul.

Name: Nasser
Text:
<Yellow>He wants to dismantle the Adventurers Alliance led by Aman,
and strengthen his control over Babylon.</>

Name: Nasser
Text: ...Though I didn't expect them to use the Wolves for that.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I didn't want to get involved because I feared this would happen, but I guess I am now.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Maybe I can slip away pretending I didn't see or hear anything...)</>

Name: Nasser
Text: Let's report this first and move on to the next step.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...or not.)</>

Name: Nasser
Text: Our current strategy won't work.

After reporting via the communicator, Nasser told me there was one more thing he needed me to do.
...It seems it's too late to back out now.

Name: Nasser
Text:
A piece of intel just came in. 
This job is better done by two than one.

Name: Nasser
Text:
It’s simple, [player].
Just find more of those parchments from earlier.

Name: Nasser
Text: I'm asking you to use a bit more of that luck.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(As if I can control luck?)</>

Name: Nasser
Text:
You go to the Gorge of Perdition.
I'll check the Valley of Beasts.

Name: Nasser
Text:
And take this.
It will help you decipher the parchments.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I don’t see anything related to the Shadow Wolf Clan here. Let's go deeper.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I should use what Nasser gave me.)</>
ItemName: Secret Letter of the Shadow Wolves
ItemDesc:
Block the path to Taima Oasis.
To cut off Aman’s limbs, there's no better way than this.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Are they targeting the Taima Pioneer Village?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let's see if there's anything else.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I should use what Nasser gave me.)</>
ItemName: Secret Letter of the Shadow Wolves
ItemDesc:
On a night of the dark moon, capture Muina alive and bring her to the hideout.
We will report to Shah that she fled in the night. You may do as you please.

Name: Nasser
Text: Looking at your expression, I'm curious what it says.

Name: Nasser
Text: Let's see what's written here.

Name: Nasser
Text: ...Today must be my lucky day.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Let's go to the Jade Valley.
You should get paid for your trouble, right?

Name: Nasser
Text:
Get it directly from Lady Muina.
She's been waiting there for a while.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Something feels off, but I guess I have no choice?)</>

Name: Nasser
Text: Aren't you going?

Name: Mueena
Text: I’ve been expecting you.

Name: Mueena
Text: I hear you have been a tremendous help once more?

Name: Mueena
Text: Your work has been outstanding, I can’t help but ask even more of you.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Usually, when someone says things like this... something bad happens.)</>

Name: Mueena
Text: I'd like to continue this conversation, but it seems we have a more urgent matter to attend to.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Adventurer.
I know you must be busy, but please go across the bridge and gather some herbs.

Name: Mueena
Text: You just need to bring me the ones with red flowers.

Name: Mueena
Text: Thank you, Adventurer.

Name: Mueena
Text: I was just about to verify the information I secured.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(They are wearing Shadow Wolf uniforms? What’s going on here?)</>

Name: Nasser
Text: Then I will begin, Lady Muina.

Name: Nasser
Text: [player], feed this to him.
After feeding him what Nasser gave me, his tightly sealed mouth opened.

Name: Mueena
Text:
You don’t need your limbs to talk.
Which should I cut first?

Name: Shadow Wolf Clan Member
Text:
P... Please spare me.
I... I'll tell you everything, absolutely everything, so please...!

Name: Shadow Wolf Clan Member
Text: <Red>Fahad... Fahad made me do it!</>

Name: Shadow Wolf Clan Member
Text: I had no choice if I wanted to survive...!
Muina swung his sword, and the Shadow Wolf’s head flew off.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Keep the head, Nasser.
I will send it to Fahad as a <Yellow>gift</>.

Name: Nasser
Text: Understood, Lady Muina.

Name: Mueena
Text: In times like these, there is no silence greater than death.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Wait, by payment, did he mean the money for a coffin?)</>

Name: Mueena
Text:
Being loyal might mean...
having to handle things like this as well.

Name: Mueena
Text: Thank you for your service, Adventurer.

Name: Mueena
Text: <Yellow>Now that it's come to this, people are bound to think we’re on the same boat.</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Wasn’t that the whole point of this job in the first place...?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...They even made veiled threats. Starting with Nasser!)</>

Name: Mueena
Text: You will be rewarded as promised.

Name: Mueena
Text:
I suppose this will sound like a threat no matter how I put it, but
we’ve reached a point where we can't just let it slide...

Name: Mueena
Text: or do you need some time to think about it?

Name: Mueena
Text: Think nothing of it.

Name: Mueena
Text: Have you gathered your thoughts?

Name: Mueena
Text:
Did you hear from Nasser?
About what Aman and I are trying to do.

Name: Mueena
Text: Aman is an idealist.

Name: Mueena
Text: He believes that by building a self-sufficient village,

Name: Mueena
Text: and monopolizing the Aetherium mines for profit, we can earn our autonomy.

Name: Mueena
Text:
...Even knowing about Fahad's assassination attempts, he insists on walking the righteous path.
Solely for the sake of his goal.

Name: Mueena
Text: <Yellow>Trading Babylon's resources for the descendants of Qaradia living in Asientet.</>

Name: Mueena
Text:
...It's a textbook political move.
Hopelessly idealistic, even.

Name: Mueena
Text: But sadly, that simply won't work.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She intends to take a different path from Aman. In that case, Muina is...)</>

Name: Mueena
Text: That's why I need someone like you.

Name: Mueena
Text: Someone whose loyalty can be bought. Nothing more, nothing less.

Name: Mueena
Text: Worry not. I won't burden you with unreasonable demands.

Name: Mueena
Text: Willl you accept?

Name: Mueena
Text: ...Then our contract is sealed.

Name: Mueena
Text: Here. It’s <Blue>medicinal liquor</>.
ItemDesc:
A liquor radiating a golden hue, as rich as honey.
Would it taste as sweet as it looks?

Name: Mueena
Text: In <Blue>Qaradia</>, sharing a drink forges an unbreakable oath.

Name: Mueena
Text: Although I never expected to share it with you, Adventurer.

Name: Mueena
Text: ...Our fates are now intertwined, [player].

After drinking Muina's liquor, I awoke in a makeshift infirmary,
clutching a letter that instructed me to find a note.

Name: Mueena
Text: Is it because of the mercenaries?

Name: Mueena
Text: I expected you to be a bit more tactful. What a pity.

Name: Mueena
Text: It's a shame to part ways like this. Let's at least share a drink.
ItemDesc:
It's been some time since I've seen such a vivid emerald hue.
...It looks incredibly potent.

Name: Mueena
Text: In <Blue>Qaradia</>, it is customary to share a drink as a toast to the good health of an esteemed mercenary.

Name: Mueena
Text: <Yellow>It is an honor to share this with you, Adventurer.</>

After drinking Muina's liquor, I awoke in a makeshift infirmary,
clutching a letter that instructed me to find a note.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It's Muina. I need to meet her right now.)</>

Name: Mueena
Text:
I knew you were no ordinary adventurer,
and you have lived up to my expectations.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Most would have fled by now.
...or perished before we could even meet.

Name: Mueena
Text:
As you can see, this is how I operate.
I do not rely on half-baked trust.

Name: Mueena
Text:
To test your skills,
I would not hesitate to cast you into the jaws of death.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Yet, if you are still willing to work with me,
<Yellow>I intend to claim the title of Consul.</>

Name: Mueena
Text: ...And you are the one who will make it happen.

Name: Mueena
Text: Let us dispense with trivial matters like coins.

Name: Mueena
Text: ...For I will aid you in ways only a <Yellow>person of power</> can.

Name: Mueena
Text: When you need me, my aid shall find you.

Name: Mueena
Text:
I will contact you again soon.
Until then, may fortune favor you, [player].

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I hear you've been through much recently.
Come to think of it, I haven't properly thanked you.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
No need to look so surprised about how I know.
The Divines have already informed the Legations across the realm.

Name: Lorraine
Text: I heard you confronted the <Orange>Incursion Fixer</>. I'm glad to see you're still in one piece.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I hope we'll be seeing each other for a long time.
<Yellow>Ultimately, those who survive the longest are the strongest, wouldn't you agree?</>

Name: Lorraine
Text:
In that regard, you've earned my respect.
And I am quite eager to entrust you with tasks.

Name: Lorraine
Text: That easygoing nature of yours is exactly what it takes to be a champion of the people.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
One needs a generous heart to wield one’s power righteously.
If only your companion would see that.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Doesn't the <Orange>Holy Beretta</> keep all her brilliance to herself?
Tell her to share some of that wisdom with the rest of us.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Aren’t you two quite close?
It looked like you made some secret pact up on the ridges.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I mean, back when she was asking me about the Stormkel Legation.
I didn't realize you were planning your future together.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
I’m jesting, haha!
Teasing you youngsters never gets old.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Don't be a stranger. You ought to visit her more often.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
The Divine must be up to her neck investigating the <Blue>Tower</>.
Lately, she's been using that as an excuse to skip our councils.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Go check in on her.
I believe she returned to catch her breath for a moment.

Name: Lorraine
Text: While you're at it, deliver this report to her.
ItemDesc:
Field Agents: Frantia Legation Investigation Team
Findings: No anomaly detected at 'Chepurbo Sub'.
Note: Resistance meter malfunctioned; exploration halted.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Just tell her it's a <Yellow>'follow-up'</> from the last mission. She'll understand.
Though I doubt she'll be entirely pleased with the report.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Better a friend than an old man like me to deliver the news.
And tell her to take it easy.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I've reached the West Gate. Is Beretha really here?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Consul Lorraine said he saw her. I should look around.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The area is bustling with people deep in conversation.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Beretta probably hates noisy places...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(There she is. I should approach quietly. She won’t like it if I yell out.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Took you long enough.
Do you know how long I've been waiting?

Name: Beretta
Text: Your aura is so distinct, it's actually harder to ignore it.

Name: Beretta
Text:
My senses are far sharper than ordinary humans.
When you carelessly broadcast your presence like that, it's overwhelming.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Furthermore.
You should have sought me out the moment you returned from the Tower.

Name: Beretta
Text: <Yellow>We had a deal, didn't we? To decide whether you'd help me or not.</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Never mind, don't answer.
It's obvious you had completely forgotten until now.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Hand over whatever it is you brought.
I only stopped by Babylon for that report, so let's get this over with.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Hah. Another fruitless investigation?
The exact same results, five times in a row.

Name: Beretta
Text: I'll have to alter my plans, and I'm out of reliable agents.

Name: Beretta
Text:
You could say that.
We have much to discuss. Let's move.

Name: Beretta
Text: Taima Pioneer Village... A good place to grab a few drinks. Follow me.

Name: Beretta
Text: Here. Let’s drink to your safe return.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Take it before my arm gets tired.
<Yellow>If you forgot about our pact, shouldn't you face a fitting penalty?</>

Beretta downed her drink glass after glass,
with no sign of intoxication.
She eventually caught me trying to pour my drink on the floor...

Name: Beretta
Text:
...That’s fine. Just drink what you can handle.
I've yet to meet a mortal who can outdrink me anyway.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Do you think we came all the way here to be miserable?
Wipe that pity off your face.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Look. You have a clear view of the Tower from here.
It's a perfect vantage point.

Name: Beretta
Text:
All sorts of things happen in the Tower.
The Arbiter snatching you up and fleeing there is certainly one of them.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Consider it a miracle that you made it back alive.
After all, the <Orange>Arbiter of the Tower</> barely managed to keep you breathing.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Who would dare... to cross blades with Xeros?
He is far more formidable than you realize.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Even with ancient blood in my veins, I wouldn't bet on winning a head-on fight.
That guy is absolutely overflowing with the <Blue>Gudua Factor</> too.

Name: Beretta
Text: I’m a descendant of a race called the <Orange>Lugalians</>.

Name: Beretta
Text:
They weren't the indigenous humans of <Blue>Elsetia</>.
Even biologically, so many things are different.

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Yellow>There’s a high chance they crossed over from a star in the outside world.
Gudua probably shares the same origin.</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Anyway, a new life was born between the Lugalians and Elsetians.
One of my distant ancestors was likely one of them.

Name: Beretta
Text:
That’s why we intentionally make the distinction.
By my standards, humans are just weak and stupid.

Name: Beretta
Text: Well, not that it matters.

Name: Beretta
Text:
How can you not know the basics?
You’d figure this out with just a tiny bit of research.

Name: Beretta
Text: Enough with this theories. You’re killing the mood.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Go down and grab more drinks.
Staring at that tower all day is driving me crazy.

Name: Beretta
Text: You know the ones who are unusually handy with a blade or just naturally gifted in magic?

Name: Beretta
Text:
The Ancients called that the “Gudua Factor.”
The better you were at tapping into that power, the higher your status.

Name: Beretta
Text: That’s why they dubbed the elite class <Orange>“Gudua.”</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Ugh, I don't know why they had to make such a difficult word.
What a pain.

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Yellow>You’ve either got the potential or you don’t.</>
They could’ve put it simply like that.

Name: Beretta
Text:
So many ancients liked to show off.
Maybe that rubbed off on Xeros too.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I knew he was sharp and good at fighting, but...
Something about him was annoying.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Wait, you look like you’ve never heard this before.
Did they not even teach you about Gudua or anything like that?

Name: Beretta
Text:
How can you not even know the basics…?
You’d figure this out with just a tiny bit of research.

Name: Beretta
Text: Enough with this theories. You’re killing the mood.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Go down and grab more drinks.
Staring at that tower all day is driving me crazy.

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
The rising star to challenge Baba Liquor!
We’re serving Taima Liquor, brewed with water straight from the oasis!

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text: None of that harsh, bitter sting—just a crisp, refreshing coolness in every sip!

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
Buy two bottles and get one free!
So, how many bottles shall it be, traveler?

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
Wait, all of them?
Let me see how many I have left...

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
Hmm, I only have six bottles ready right now.
But if you lend me a hand, I can whip up about four more.

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
You just fetch some water while I pack these up,
and I can mix in the ingredients.

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text: I'll give you a discount for the trouble. What do you say?

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
Haha, you must really love alcohol!
<Yellow>I have a friend just like you...</>

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
Oh, right! You can fetch water from the oasis.
I'll be waiting!

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
You have incredible strength!
That must’ve been heavy, but you're not even breaking a sweat.

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
All right, the rest will be ready in just a moment.
Just a second, please.

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
There we go! All done, my guest.
Once you settle the bill, I'll help you carry these myself.
ItemDesc:
A spirit crafted exclusively from the crystal-clear waters of the oasis.
It contains Pinar the Merchant’s own secret ingredients.
The stunning craftsmanship of the glass bottle…
…hints at the presence of a skilled artisan in this region.

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text: So, where are we heading?

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text: No, no! I’m just doing my job as a merchant.

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text: You bought me out—uh, I mean, sold me out completely! This is the least I can do.

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
Rest assured, I’m capable enough to handle a teleport device.
Babylon or anywhere else, just name it!

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
Now... ooh, the suspense!
Where is your destination, traveler?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You point to where Beretta is.)</>

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text: On top of that building? Right, we’re off then!

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text: By the way, do you plan on opening the Taima right away?

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
In that case, keep it soaked in water and take it out as you go.
Taima tastes much better when it's ice-cold.

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
If you’re up for it, coming down here and having a party would be great too.
The oasis looks truly beautiful from this angle.

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text: Wait a second! Let me pull a few bottles out of the crate first.

Name: Beretta
Text: I sent you for the drink, and you brought back a person?

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text: Ahem! Well, I’ve finished the delivery, so I’ll be on my way now.

Name: Liquor Merchant
Text:
Enjoy your time, valued customer.
And just so you know, the Taima liquor will be discontinued soon.

Name: Beretta
Text: You’d better put those goods down nice and easy before you go, wouldn't you? <Orange>Pinar.</>

Name: Pinar
Text: Y-Yikes?!

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Red>Don't even think about running.</>
So this is where you’ve been hiding? In a wasteland of all places?

Name: Pinar
Text: N-Now, listen. Business... business knows no borders, you see...

Name: Beretta
Text: Shut it! You have no idea what I’ve been through looking for you!

Name: Beretta
Text:
I’ve searched the entire Forsaken Land… Do you know how many times I went around?
Not a single trace of you anywhere, and here you were...

Name: Beretta
Text:
Playing shopkeep in a tiny little settlement like this…
I swear, I’m gonna—!

Name: Pinar
Text:
Stooop!
I was wrong, okay? Just... just calm down!

Name: Pinar
Text: You're scarier than the Apostles who came to hunt me down! *sob…*

Name: Beretta
Text: What? You’re still being hunted?

Name: Pinar
Text: Until not long ago, I was busy hiding from that maniac, <Red>Valbas</>!

Name: Pinar
Text:
He says I sound funny when I'm crying! Ugh!
So I searched and searched for a very noisy place…

Name: Pinar
Text:
People are always so busy here,
so a merchant like me doesn’t exactly stand out…

Name: Beretta
Text: <Yellow>One way or another, Xeros is determined to destroy the Tower.</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
I assumed that’s why he’s leaving those close to the “Truth” alone.
He’s not the type to go around dealing with every single one of them.

Name: Beretta
Text:
But you’re saying Valbas actually tried to kill you?
What on earth is he up to?

Name: Pinar
Text: H-Huh? Can you slow down and explain that again?

Name: Pinar
Text:
Xeros? Why are you bringing up that Incursion Specialist?
And what do you mean about destroying the Tower...?

Name: Beretta
Text:
Wait. Valbas was always impulsive.
There's a possibility he just acted on a whim.

Name: Beretta
Text: In that case, the only remaining variables are...

Name: Pinar
Text:
Hmm... My guest.
I think we should give Beretta some time to think.

Name: Pinar
Text:
Since it’ll take her a while, why don't we take a stroll?
We can enjoy the oasis view while she's at it.

Name: Pinar
Text:
We’ve both grown up there since we were just wailing infants.
We fought a lot, but we were always inseparable.

Name: Pinar
Text:
I still remember some of her habits...
She’d often say, <Yellow>“I need to think. Leave me be.”</>

Name: Pinar
Text: Whenever she did, I’d help her immerse herself in her thoughts.

Name: Pinar
Text:
And every single time, it brought incredible results.
She’d devise a brand new theory or a spell just like that!

Name: Pinar
Text: She’ll come up with a great plan again, won’t she?

Name: Pinar
Text:
We should clear the area so she can focus.
And take care of the monsters’ howls.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(A commotion is stirring near the building. 
You’d better see if it's the drunkard Pinar mentioned.)</>

Name: Tipsy Denizen
Text: Wh-what in the blazes?! Drenching me all of a sudden!

Name: Pinar
Text: <Yellow>Tell me, what is the first rule of the Taima Pioneer Village?</>

Name: Tipsy Denizen
Text: He who... does not work... shall not... play...

Name: Pinar
Text:
It’s time to go back to your day job.
I will keep this a secret from Kamiya!

Name: Tipsy Denizen
Text: Hmph! Ptoo! Consider yourself lucky!

Name: Pinar
Text:
It was all for Beretta’s sake, heh-heh!
Shall we go take a breather as well?

Name: Pinar
Text: Beretta absolutely loves alcohol, but she usually drinks alone.

Name: Pinar
Text:
But she shares a glass with you.
You must be a reliable ally to her, aren’t you?

Name: Pinar
Text: ...I want to be her reliable ally.

Name: Pinar
Text:
But I guess that’s too big a dream for someone who ran away, right? Ha-ha.
She was so furious the moment she saw me... A foolish dream, I suppose.

Name: Pinar
Text: Beretta and I... were with the <Red>Paradise Advent</> for a very long time.

Name: Pinar
Text:
Want to see this drawing?
My heart was pounding the whole time I drew this in secret.
ItemDesc:
A sketch drawn with unskilled hands.
The corners of the paper are worn down, as if it has been carried for a long time.
The young Beretta in the drawing lacks the sharp edge she carries now.

Name: Pinar
Text:
We were attached at the hip throughout our younger years.
Friends... yes, we were close friends.

Name: Pinar
Text:
She was so brilliant, she quickly caught the eye of the higher-ups.
Her magical talent was peerless.

Name: Pinar
Text: Then, one day—just as she was being groomed for the Apostles...

Name: Pinar
Text:
Beretta told me, <Yellow>“There is no such thing as paradise.”</>
She said the Paradise Advent, the “warm cradle” we believed in, was all a fraud.

Name: Pinar
Text:
I was led by her hand, escaping that place in a blur.
I only heard the truth after we were out.

Name: Pinar
Text:
But... I was consumed by the terror of being hunted.
So, without a word to her, I left for somewhere far away.

Name: Pinar
Text: I figured that having me by her side would only cause trouble and put her in more danger...

Name: Pinar
Text:
I never imagined she’d hate me this much,
but I’m glad she’s been doing well.

Name: Pinar
Text:
Haha... enough about me. Shall we head back?
I’d rather not get scolded again.

Name: Beretta
Text:
It’s too long to explain.
You're better off reading this yourself.
ItemDesc:
A document handed to Pinar by Beretta.
It briefly details the Giant’s Tower and the Incursion Specialist.
It appears to be a joint report compiled by the Manors and the Divine in Babylon.

Name: Pinar
Text: ...So the High Master is dead, and the Paradise Advent has been disbanded.

Name: Beretta
Text:
But the <Red>Apostles</> are still at large.
They possess overwhelming power, so keep your guard up.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Except for that free spirit, Valbas... there are four others.
We have no idea what they're planning.

Name: Pinar
Text: Weren't there six Apostles in total? Who else are you leaving out?

Name: Beretta
Text: …Master.

Name: Pinar
Text:
Master <Orange>Ugula</>?
Master Ugula... would surely choose peace.

Name: Pinar
Text:
But what if the Master believes the Tower should be destroyed?
What if Master Ugula decides that is the true path to peace...?

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Red>We can never that happen.</>
So, we must find the Master and change her mind.

Name: Beretta
Text:
There's a mountain of work to do, Pinar.
Are you going to help me or not?

Name: Pinar
Text:
Of course I will!
Th-That is... if you can forgive me...

Name: Beretta
Text:
When I think about the years of misery I went through trying to find you... *sigh.*
I should keep you tied up and scold you for days.

Name: Beretta
Text:
But I’m letting it slide because your liquor is good.
Just make sure you have it ready every time I come by. Got it?

Name: Pinar
Text:
Yes, I promise!
I'm not running away ever again, so just say the word!

Name: Beretta
Text:
Since we're on the subject, let's finish off what we started.
Go on, bring out the rest!

Name: Beretta
Text: First, I have a request.

Name: Beretta
Text:
You held off answering last time, didn’t you?
Had I known you’d end up crossing paths with the High Master and Xeros, I would have tagged along.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Anyway, it was just personal matters between the two back then.
And now, I understand how you feel about it.

Name: Beretta
Text:
But everything has been turned upside down.
Especially Xeros—that one is now a threat to this entire world.

Name: Beretta
Text: <Yellow>Do you understand what it means to destroy the Tower?</>

Name: Beretta
Text: You mustn't think of it as a mere structure.

Name: Beretta
Text:
No one knows exactly when it was built,
but over the ages, it has become one with the earth itself.

Name: Beretta
Text: It has absorbed the Aetheric Ley Lines into itself, and Gudua’s power is intricately woven within.

Name: Beretta
Text:
If one were to destroy the <Blue>“Giant’s Tower”</> through physical force alone...
…the fallout would reach across the entire Forsaken Land…

Name: Beretta
Text: —no, it would breach the Barrier and strike at the very heart of every nation.

Name: Pinar
Text: …The Incursion Specialist might bring about this world’s destruction.

Name: Beretta
Text: Pinar, do you remember what I said when we left the Paradise Advent?

Name: Pinar
Text:
<Yellow>You said you’d thwart their ambition to seize the world through the Tower.
That Paradise was nothing more than a veil.</>

Name: Pinar
Text: And that you’d turn the Tower into a hollow shell... Wait!

Name: Pinar
Text: If it’s just a hollow shell, its impact would be far less devastating even if it were to fall!

Name: Beretta
Text: Exactly. My plan remains unchanged.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Originally, I sought to stop the Paradise Advent,
but now I can just change the target to Xeros.

Name: Beretta
Text: Head to the Sunset Brewery. Our ally is there.

Name: Beretta
Text: I’ll follow once I have made my preparations.

Name: Schulak
Text: I’m <Orange>Schulak</>. I’ll just assume you’re here because you already know the story.

Name: Schulak
Text:
We share much wisdom with your world.
Even Ea—God Ea—wants it that way.

Name: Schulak
Text: That includes that fearsome stone over there.

Name: Schulak
Text: No matter what’s inside, I won't let it ruin the Naruru's land. Never.

Name: Schulak
Text:
I am the <Orange>“Shiny-Head”</> of the Naruru.
I'll find a way to save everyone.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Beretta is very knowledgable.
A rare human who actually makes a bit of sense.

Name: Schulak
Text:
<Yellow>You—come with me to a quiet spot.
Now, for the matter at hand.</>

Name: Schulak
Text: Take this. Beretta insisted that you see it.
ItemDesc:
A letter prepared in case I can’t join you in person.
Don’t contact me through the communicator from now on.
I must move in shadows, so I intend to leave it behind.

If you are reading this, you will know that I am working on a grand task.
Do you remember the artifacts I sought to hinder the Paradise Advent Society? 
There is a reason they revered them as sacred relics.
They were essential to make the Tower move.

Most vital among them is the "Key"…
…the instrument that controls the Tower’s functions.

Hear the rest from Schulak.
He can be prickly, but he is as dependable as they come.
Dispose of this as you see fit.

Name: Schulak
Text: Done reading? Keep those words locked tight in your head.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Even if you drink all day and pass out,
you should still be able to recite it by heart!

Name: Schulak
Text: <Yellow>Ale is the source of all creation! How could you not know that?</>

Name: Schulak
Text:
Now, hurry up and memorize it.
I have no use for a human who can't even remember a short letter like this.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Then tear it to shreds and cast it into the water.
This is the secret of secrets, after all.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(A narrow waterfall rushes with great force.
Anything thrown in will be swept downstream in an instant.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Destroy the record to prevent leaks of the secret operation.)</>

Name: Schulak
Text:
Beretta said the human she sent could be trusted.
That you’ll be helpful.

Name: Schulak
Text: So, it’s time we begin the mission of our <Orange>“Baba Liquor Alliance”</>, but...

Name: Schulak
Text:
<Red>I cannot accept it just yet.</>
It’s only Beretta’s opinion that you’re a helpful human.

Name: Schulak
Text: I’ll see for myself just how clever you truly are.

Name: Schulak
Text:
We were sharing a bottle of Baba Liquor.
And oh, we vowed to join our paths for a greater cause

Name: Schulak
Text: —to stop that stone, that hunk of rock, and save this world!

Name: Schulak
Text:
Now, go and solve the riddle on the hill across from us.
Do that, and I shall welcome you into our alliance.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(There's the hill… and an updraft leading straight to it.)</>

Name: Schulak
Text:
Well... fine.
A little later than I expected, but I’ll let it slide.

Name: Schulak
Text: The test of the “Shiny-Head” Naruru is over.

Name: Schulak
Text: Now, let’s see if you’re truly fit to be a member of the Baba Liquor Alliance.

Name: Schulak
Text:
What is the most vital thing needed to save this world given by Ea?
Answer me.

Name: Schulak
Text: <Red>Wrong! Absolutely wrong!</> None of that matters if you're wounded and broken!

Name: Schulak
Text:
The path of the Baba Liquor Alliance will be fraught with cuts and scars.
You might have to endure pain until the very brink of death.

Name: Schulak
Text:
That is why a sturdy body is what matters most!
A sharp mind only works in a healthy body, you know.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(That actually sounds quite convincing…)</>

Name: Schulak
Text:
You didn't get it right, but...
For Beretta’s sake, I’ll give you one more chance.

Name: Schulak
Text: Guess the core ingredient of the <Blue>“Scorching Salve.”</>

Name: Schulak
Text:
The Baba Liquor Alliance developed a new medicine to protect our bodies.
We’ve poured all our wisdom—Beretta’s and mine—into this.

Name: Schulak
Text:
I’ll give you a glimpse of how it’s made,
So try to figure it out for yourself.

Name: Schulak
Text:
You can find something called Verbena around here.
It grows long like an ear of grain, with flowers blooming at the tip of the stem.

Name: Schulak
Text:
The color is just like a bright night sky.
It plays a vital role, so bring back as much as you can.

Name: Schulak
Text:
See that massive tree walking on two legs?
Pluck the leaves that grow from its hands.

Name: Schulak
Text:
They’re brimming with Aether,
so mixing them into the medicine heals wounds in a flash.

Name: Schulak
Text: Just bring enough to fill your hands.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Beretta gathered medicinal herbs around here.
They were the key to curing the Aetherium poisoning.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Maybe this new medicine is something similar.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It was made by those two members of the Baba Liquor Alliance…
...and it’s pretty clear they both love to drink.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Wait... they grow Baba at the Sunset Brewery, don't they?)</>

Name: Schulak
Text: Judging by that confident stride, you must be feeling pretty sure of yourself, eh?

Name: Schulak
Text:
Let’s see how much wisdom Ea has bestowed upon you.
Now, the answer—give me the answer!

Name: Schulak
Text:
Wh-what? How did you figure that out?
I expected some sappy answer like “the sincere will to heal!”

Name: Schulak
Text: So, Beretta didn't send a fool after all... did she?

Name: Schulak
Text:
Baba is usually used for brewing Baba Liquor, but
we ground it up finely to use in our medicine.

Name: Schulak
Text:
It gives a tingling, burning sensation...
But since it's an ingredient for liquor, that's to be expected, right?

Name: Schulak
Text:
It's highly effective for washing away the filth from wounds!
That's what matters.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(No need to say that came to mind just because you knew they both like liquor.)</>

Name: Schulak
Text: Hmm, you’re quick-witted indeed. I suppose I can trust you a little.

Name: Schulak
Text:
From now on, you're part of the Baba Liquor Alliance, too.
Let's stop that hunk of stone together.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Beretta and I have always been drinking, drinking buddies.
Ishinu dragged me in to meet her, saying drinking alone’s no fun.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Eventually, we got close over a few drinks of Baba Liquor.
Now, we fight so very often we can’t stand each other at times but...

Name: Schulak
Text:
There’s one thing we do agree with.
That's why we formed an alliance.

Name: Schulak
Text:
That thing you call a Tower.
I've thought it was strange for a long time, too.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Shiny-hair Naruru watches the sky, the sea, and the mountains every single day.
It's my job to keep watch for great dangers.

Name: Schulak
Text:
So, when I noticed the <Yellow>“lively scent”</> drifting over there,
I realized the Tower was absorbing something.

Name: Schulak
Text:
How dare they, how dare they?! It was stealing the blessing given by Ea.
If we leave it be, everything will wither away.

Name: Schulak
Text: Beretta heard me out and agreed we should stop that Tower together.

Name: Schulak
Text: That's why we must stop the Tower—we can’t leave it as is.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Since I'm a quick-witted Naruru, I know what I’m talking about.
It is utterly dangerous. It really is.

Name: Schulak
Text:
<Yellow>Like how it literally smells fishy when you get close to the Tower...
Or how the wind blows towards it during an Incursion.</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She relies on her senses to figure things out.)</>

Name: Schulak
Text: Someday, you must know everything—absolutely everything.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Ask me whenever there's something you don't understand.
Because we don’t have time to talk about every little thing—our priority is to find the relic!

Name: Schulak
Text: You know about the <Blue>Prophecy</> from those Paradise whatever humans, right?

Name: Schulak
Text:
I hid it in that liquor barrel over there, so go fetch it.
It will tell us what we need to do.

Name: Schulak
Text:
You found it properly.
I heard you helped find this, too?

Name: Schulak
Text:
That's when Beretta started talking about you a lot.
She said she found a useful human.
ItemDesc:
A book obtained from the Prophet of the Paradise Advent Society.
It reads like a revelation, full of ambiguous and abstract expressions.
It appears to require an expert's interpretation.

Name: Schulak
Text: Why is this in a liquor barrel?

Name: Schulak
Text:
Because humans are too busy biting each other’s head off.
It was an operation aimed right at their blind spot.

Name: Schulak
Text:
They just assume we're making liquor here.
They'd never imagine a relic would be here!

Name: Schulak
Text: So Beretta decided to hide the relic, relic right here.

Name: Schulak
Text:
While I lived like an ordinary brewer Naruru,
I protected it to keep it from falling into the wrong hands.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Now! Open the book.
Beretta has already interpreted the squiggly drawings.
ItemDesc:
* The Aether Receptors extending from the Tower are closely connected throughout the Forsaken Land.
* The Receptors also exist inside the Tower—especially in the lower floors.
* The absorbed Aether is converted into the Tower's power source.
* It targets all organisms, encompassing both flora and fauna.
* If completely drained of Aether, the organism's vital functions will cease.

Name: Schulak
Text:
<Yellow>...It's absolutely terrifying!
Ea would punish us severely if she found out.</>

Name: Schulak
Text:
She’ll stop at nothing... Huh?
I smell Beretta!

Name: Beretta
Text:
Hmm, maybe I should have taken my time getting here.
You two look awfully busy.

Name: Schulak
Text:
I was just filling them in on a few things.
The human you sent didn’t know much… I expected more.

Name: Beretta
Text:
They’re sturdy, quick-witted, and good at fights. What more do you need?
We can handle the brainwork ourselves, right?

Name: Beretta
Text:
They're the most useful human I've met so far.
Just trust them and let them handle it.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Hmph, I'll let it slide since we're in a hurry.
But they're still far, far from being worthy of joining the Baba Liquor Alliance.

Name: Beretta
Text: You were the one who needed a quiet errand runner. Stop playing hard to get.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Even with you backing them up, wrong is wrong!
I'll kick them out immediately if they mess up.

Name: Schulak
Text: Don't forget that everyone in the Baba Liquor Alliance stands on equal footing.

Name: Beretta
Text:
*sigh* Let's stop wasting time and get on with the operation.
We need to find the <Blue>Key</> first.

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Yellow>An item repeatedly emphasized in the prophecy.
Simply put, it's a tool used to control the Tower.</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
It’s kind of like a machine.
It'll stop on its own if its power source is cut off.

Name: Beretta
Text:
And that's exactly our goal.
<Yellow>To disable the Tower's functions…</>

Name: Schulak
Text: …is much, much safer than trying to destroy it by force.

Name: Beretta
Text: Xeros is probably looking for a way to breach its defense system.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Normal methods won't even leave a scratch.
Even that great Incursion Fixer can't do anything about it right now.

Name: Beretta
Text: However, if we keep dawdling, he'll eventually just try to smash the Tower to pieces.

Name: Schulak
Text:
We have to find the key, the key quickly.
The only place left to look is the hills.

Name: Beretta
Text: [player], there are suspicious locations scattered all across the hills.

Name: Beretta
Text: It's obvious that Aether is condensed there, but nothing is visible to the naked eye.

Name: Beretta
Text:
The first one is near the Hesperia Defense Force's guard post.
Let's check them one by one, starting there.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The floor of the ruins is glowing faintly. I should take a closer look.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I can feel a faint power radiating from below.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Look, a massive amount of Aether has gathered here.
An adventurer of your caliber should be able to feel it immediately.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Right? This isn't a rare phenomenon.
There are tens—no, hundreds of Aether leylines running beneath the ground.

Name: Beretta
Text: It's natural for Aether leylines to intertwine like this. It’s natural, but...

Name: Beretta
Text:
If you possess a unique power like we do,
you can unravel this much easily.

Name: Beretta
Text:
That’s why I had no problem doing the research on my own.
My power is on the stronger side, too.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Even so, there were a few spots that simply wouldn't react.
That's why I brought you along.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Imagine connecting with this Aether.
You need a synesthetic approach.

Name: Beretta
Text:
...I wasn't expecting it to take this form.
It almost looks as though space itself was forcibly torn apart.

Name: Beretta
Text: Look at the concentration fading. It'll probably dissipate on its own if we leave it be.

Name: Beretta
Text:
It's not like something is popping out of it like an Incursion...
Does it have no function at all?

Name: Beretta
Text:
Did someone mess with it? This is annoying.
Let's just keep going.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I'll have to ask Shulack to look into it later.
He might be able to spot a singularity from a Naruru's perspective.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Let's head up to the Frantia Gate.
There's another one of these on the opposite hill.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The building looks similar to the ruins I checked earlier. Let's get a closer look.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: We're almost there. You see the similar structure, right?

Name: Beretta
Text: Those darn Frantians don't care what we do.

Name: Beretta
Text:
They left the abnormaly right under their noses unattended.
Why would they care about outsiders?

Name: Beretta
Text:
So pay them no mind.
<Yellow>The fate of Elsetia rests in our hands.</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Ugh, did I misinterpret the prophecy...?
The location is definitely correct.

Name: Beretta
Text:
It's hard to find an answer just by the rift’s appearance.
What could the purpose of this rift possibly be?

Name: Beretta
Text:
The prophecy kept repeating the phrase—<Yellow>“the door will open.”</>
And it told us to find the <Yellow>“key.”</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Honestly, I'm not thrilled about this.
Do you know how much time I spent interpreting that thing?

Name: Beretta
Text:
I spent years just narrowing the possible locations down to three,
and we've already struck out on two of them.

Name: Beretta
Text: I can't believe I'm going through all this trouble because of those stupid idealists.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Let's head to the final location.
Once we check there, I'm calling it a day and getting a drink.

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Orange>Consul Lorraine</>... you said there was nothing out here.
What brings you here?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
You're full of anger again today, I see.
I take it the information I provided wasn't to your satisfaction?

Name: Beretta
Text: I was a fool to pin my hopes on Frantia's Magitech.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Your investigation squad... I highly recommend replacing the lot of them.
It's a complete waste of time and money.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Your standards are simply too high.
Not everyone is a genius.

Name: Lorraine
Text: Even sensing these subtle anomalies is only possible for the highly skilled.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
So there's no need to get so worked up over my investigation squad.
Besides, I am here now, am I not?

Name: Beretta
Text: ...True, you're the type to take matters into your own hands.

Name: Lorraine
Text: I couldn’t ignore the report that the <Blue>Resistance Detector</> was malfunctioning.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It was provided by the <Orange>Liberators of Knowledge</>,
And the devices they craft don't usually break down so easily.

Name: Lorraine
Text: I came out to scout, just in case some dangerous monster might pop out.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
This is the site of the ancient <Blue>Kingdom of Karadia</>, after all.
All sorts of riffraff are bound to gather in the remnants of a fallen kingdom.

Name: Beretta
Text: So you're in contact with those eccentric historians, too?

Name: Lorraine
Text:
They're brilliant and passionate.
They may be eccentric, but at least they aren't criminals.

Name: Beretta
Text:
They're too obsessed with the core essence of things.
That's why I've never cooperated with them.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Even at this very moment, we are drawing closer to ruin,
yet they go around scavenging for toys.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
Haha, why don't you hear me out before you pass judgment?
This little gadget is quite something, you see.
ItemDesc:
A tool that detects foreign auras.
Crafted by the Liberators of Knowledge.
It vibrates intensely to warn the user of danger.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
It ignores natural aether,
but is remarkably accurate at detecting monsters of unknown origin.

Name: Lorraine
Text: So it's incredibly useful for gauging the scale of an Incursion.

Name: Lorraine
Text:
As it happens, I have a spare one of these “toys.”
I'll lend it to you, so have fun playing around with it.

Name: Beretta
Text: Hah! The same result again?

Name: Beretta
Text:
The Master was the one who wrote the prophecy...
There's no way there could be an error.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The resistance detector is vibrating...)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: That thing you got from the Consul—it reacts to monsters-

Name: Beretta
Text: Darn it, watch out!

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Yellow>This... was inside the rift?
I'm not seeing things, am I?</>
ItemName: An artifact retrieved from the rift.
ItemDesc:
The key indicated by the prophecy.
It doesn't appear to fit any existing lock.
Where am I supposed to insert it?

Name: Beretta
Text: ...To think it was hidden within the lands of a fallen nation.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Across the bridge was the southernmost territory of Karadia.
It's been abandoned for a long time now,

Name: Beretta
Text:
but it was once of the great powers of the ancient world.
They fell, failing to stop the monsters popping out of the Tower.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Yet, before that, their national strength was developed using the Tower's byproducts...
So, that was the “key.”

Name: Beretta
Text:
Hmm. When, how, and where am I supposed to use this?
Honestly, it looks more like a toy.

Name: Beretta
Text:
We need more information.
And we need to hear Shulack's opinion, too.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Let's return to the brewery.
I'll have to pull out all the record disks and inspect them again.
You tell Shulack about finding the rift and retrieving the key.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Hmm... I'm getting a mixture of scents.
But when I try to sniff deeply, it suddenly vanishes.

Name: Schulak
Text:
It wasn’t provided by Ea.
I can say that for sure!

Name: Beretta
Text: <Yellow>Strange. Why can't I feel any aura from it?</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Both the record disks and the prophecy possess a distinct aether.
They were quite similar to the ancient artifacts that frequently get excavated.

Name: Beretta
Text: The kind of things the Bardad Expedition or the Liberators of Knowledge search for.

Name: Beretta
Text: Those types of items always retain a strong trace of their creator's aura.

Name: Beretta
Text:
The ancients were so strong…
…their influence doesn’t fade over time.

Name: Schulak
Text:
Right, right.
It doesn't have the scent of the ancient humans I've smelled so far.

Name: Beretta
Text: We’ll have to hope Finar manages to bring the “Master” here.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I have a lot to ask them.
The Master knows a great deal about the Paradise Advent Society and the Tower.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Thanks to the Master, we were able to get this far to the truth.
They also helped us escape the Paradise Advent Society.

Name: Schulak
Text:
For now, you just need to wait quietly for your friend.
<Yellow>If it's exposed, it won't be a secret, secret operation anymore.</>

Name: Schulak
Text:
Beretta, you're a star among humans, so it's even more dangerous.
Everywhere you go, everyone, absolutely everyone recognizes you.

Name: Beretta
Text: You're actually saying the right thing for once.

Name: Beretta
Text:
*sigh...* It's because I'm needlessly famous.
Anyone can spot my movements a mile away.

Name: Schulak
Text:
If you know that, be careful, careful!
Just pretend to rest while enjoying a drink.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Yeah, I'll be busy investigating the key for a while anyway.
I'll contact you as soon as I locate the Master, so wait for my signal.

Name: Beretta
Text: I'll leave the matters outside to you in the meantime, [player].

Name: Azran
Text:
It's been a while, [player].
I believe this is the first time we've met since <Blue>Aburu Village</>.

Name: Azran
Text: Has everything been well?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Tell them things are proceeding as usual.)</>

Name: Azran
Text: Until I receive a request for cooperation regarding the <Red>Paradise Advent Society</>, I plan to continue hunting the wolves.

Name: Azran
Text:
Aside from dealing with their leader,
their underlings are still roaming about all over the place.

Name: Azran
Text:
But thanks to taking out their boss,
I can now proceed with my next plan.

Name: Azran
Text:
I'd like to express my gratitude once again for your help the other day.
I say this as an <Orange>Avenger</>.

Name: Azran
Text:
Have you heard of the <Orange>“White Lion”</> household of Asientet?
I was born as their heir.

Name: Azran
Text:
At the time, the king resorted to all sorts of ruthless methods to solidify his power.
He tried to eliminate anyone who got in his way.

Name: Azran
Text:
Our household was a core pillar of the nation's strength,
and highly prestigious in our own right.

Name: Azran
Text:
In the end, we were falsely accused of treason and wiped out...
But fortunately, a few of us survived.

Name: Azran
Text:
To eliminate the true culprit behind the incident,
the survivors formed a group known as the <Orange>“Sublime Avengers.”</>

Name: Azran
Text:
I unexpectedly gained the moniker of “Divine,”
but the others are still moving covertly even now.

Name: Azran
Text:
<Yellow>The Wolf Clan were hired to harm our household members.
Thus, they were our first targets.</>

Name: Azran
Text: Yes. The one pulling the strings behind the Shadow Wolf Clan is our second target.

Name: Azran
Text: That’s why I'm here—to gather clues from their remnants.

Name: Azran
Text:
I heard the fleeing wolves are disguising themselves as members of the <Red>Ironblood Brigade</>.
So I intend to weed them out, one by one.

Name: Azran
Text:
If you've fought them before, you should be able to tell the difference.
There's no need to leave them alive once we extract the information.

Name: Azran
Text:
Deal with them appropriately, and we'll regroup here.
Let's depart for the Hill of Sorrow now.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Huh? It looks like they dropped a small note.)</>
ItemName: A note carried by the fake brigade member.
ItemDesc:
Waiting for the descendants of the wolf.
Negotiations with the Brigade have already concluded,
so come to Hesperia in the southeast.

Name: Azran
Text:
...As expected, we've detected some suspicious movements.
We need to act quickly.

Name: Azran
Text:
It seems someone is trying to rally their remnants.
Won’t be long before they grow in number and start plundering.

Name: Azran
Text:
I have a comrade stationed in Hesperia.
Could you go and ask for his opinion on the matter?

Name: Azran
Text: He has excellent judgment, so he's sure to come up with a good plan.

Name: Azran
Text:
Look for <Orange>“Quista</>.” He has red hair.
Just tell him the Sublime Avenger sent you.

Name: Azran
Text: I'll stay here and keep an eye on their movements.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(There seem to be more visitors than actual residents. Was it like this before?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(If it's Azran's comrade, he must be the quiet and reserved type.
I’ll search from the outskirts of the village.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I don't see anyone with red hair around here.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I can’t go on like this. It’ll take all day.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let's try observing from a higher vantage point.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Maybe I should check somewhere more crowded...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Sometimes it's harder to spot people when they blend right into the crowd.)</>

Name: Secretive Voice
Text: Who are you looking for so intently?

Name: Quaista
Text:
My name is Quista.
I'm a Defense Guard in Hesperia.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(W-When did he sneak up like that...? I had no idea he was behind me.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Wait, this guy is Quista?)</>

Name: Quaista
Text:
When an outsider wanders around like this,
they end up getting investigated by security personnel.

Name: Quaista
Text: You weren't planning on causing any trouble in our village, were you?

Name: Quaista
Text: How do you know that name?

Name: Quaista
Text:
Tell me exactly who sent you, and for what reason.
<Red>Because if you're an imposter, I'll slit your throat right here and now.</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You relay your conversation with Azran word for word.)</>

Name: Quaista
Text:
Understood.
So you're a collaborator sent by the Young Master?

Name: Quaista
Text:
Let me properly introduce myself.
I am <Orange>Quista the Sublime Avenger</>.

Name: Quaista
Text:
The Defense Guard role is just a temporary disguise.
I need to blend in as a resident here, you see.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Sneaking up behind you was simply a natural course of action.
It's only natural to tail a suspicious person, isn't it?

Name: Quaista
Text:
I am an assassin.
There is nothing easier than masking my presence.

Name: Quaista
Text: Hmm, the wolves are slowly starting to pick up the scent.

Name: Quaista
Text: We've had a sudden influx of outsiders lately.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Travelers chasing flower glides.
People trying to secure commercial rights in a developing village.

Name: Quaista
Text:
We need to find the ones slipping in among them.
We need to act naturally, especially at times like this.

Name: Quaista
Text: People are more careless than you'd think.

Name: Quaista
Text:
They treat workers like they're invisible and talk about all sorts of things.
We just need to lay low.

Name: Quaista
Text: Could you head to the garden and pretend to be a worker?

Name: Quaista
Text:
They'll stay away from the guards on their own,
so I'll subtly try to push them your way.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...I don't think this is the place. I should look elsewhere.)</>

Name: Fierce Voice
Text: Tch, the guards sure are busy.

Name: Snickering Voice
Text:
If we hide in a corner, how will our comrades find us?
Let's just kill some time around here.

Name: Fierce Voice
Text: We stay put until the new boss appears, just like we planned.

Name: Fierce Voice
Text:
They asked us to secure the paths around the Hallowed Obsidian Mountain.
In exchange, they’ll provide us a hideout in the snowfield.

Name: Snickering Voice
Text: They must know there's a bounty on my head, right? *chuckle*

Name: Fierce Voice
Text: With that old fox from Frantia sniffing around himself, we’d better keep a low profile.

Name: Snickering Voice
Text:
They've been rounding up those darn Barigade on sight.
Exactly. Too much business attracts bugs, don’t you think?

Name: Snickering Voice
Text:
As for our Shadow Wolves? We survived.
The boss might have lost his head, but the rest of us evaded pursuit well enough.

Name: Snickering Voice
Text: And now, it’s a fresh start-

Name: Fierce Voice
Text:
...Keep your voice down.
It’s no big deal.

Name: Fierce Voice
Text: <Yellow>Just act like normal workers until all wolves are assembled.</>

Name: Snickering Voice
Text: You're acting like a coward, gahaha!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The plan worked. Let's return to Quaista.)</>

Name: Quaista
Text:
They've completely let their guard down.
We'll leave them be for now.

Name: Quaista
Text: Azran hates it, but my methods aren't half bad either.

Name: Quaista
Text:
You know the saying, <Yellow>Keep your enemies close</>?
Just sit back and watch. Let them think everything’s going their way.

Name: Quaista
Text:
The moment they rise again...
We'll take them all out at once.

Name: Quaista
Text: Besides, if you just hide yourself, they're bound to get suspicious.

Name: Quaista
Text: They've probably gathered plenty of information through the locals.

Name: Quaista
Text:
<Yellow>The person who recently wiped out the Ironblood Brigade
is here in Hesperia.</> They must know that much.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Since it's impossible to keep all the residents quiet, 
it's better to just act brazenly.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Act like the brigade will never dare show its face in the village again.
Put on a very arrogant and confident attitude.

Name: Quaista
Text: Like you never even knew that the Shadow Wolves exist.

Name: Quaista
Text: Then they'll think you're the one who's let your guard down.

Name: Quaista
Text:
We should give them a reason to move; that’s when they’ll make a mistake.
Understood?

Name: Xavyer
Text:
If it isn't the adventurer from before!
Seeing you safe and sound finally puts my mind at ease.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
The <Orange>Knights of the Biting Wind</> did bring us news, but...
I had to see it with my own eyes to believe it.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
I heard you led the vanguard and wiped out those wretched rascals.
Is it true?

Name: Xavyer
Text:
We weren't able to fight alongside you until the end.
That's been weighing heavily on my mind.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
You are the savior of Hesperia.
Thanks to you, we can focus on reclaiming the land without worrying about the Ironblood Brigade.

Name: Xavyer
Text: How long do you plan to stay in the village this time?

Name: Xavyer
Text:
We don't have much, but we'd like to treat you as best we can.
The villagers will gladly bring you food, so please don't worry.

Name: Xavyer
Text: The guards have been quite busy with the sudden influx of people anyway.

Name: Xavyer
Text:
With you here, we can finally put our minds at ease.
Please rest for as long as you'd like.
The adventurer stayed in Hesperia, helping out with small chores.

Name: Remy
Text: Wow! Not a wound, right? That's so cool!

Name: Gerald
Text: Remy, you should first greet the savior of our village.

Name: Gerald
Text:
I apologize, adventurer.
It's my fault for failing to teach her proper manners.

Name: Gerald
Text:
We were out repairing the Reconnaissance Outpost
and ended up staying there for a few days.

Name: Gerald
Text:
We hurried back as soon as we heard you were here...
Seeing you well makes me wish we’d returned sooner.

Name: Remy
Text: Here, take this! It's a gift from us.
ItemDesc:
A small, cute pouch sits here.
It hardly weighs a thing... What could be inside?

Name: Remy
Text: This was made with something I dug up myself!

Name: Gerald
Text:
We harvested our first crops from the fields just the other day.
It's a task everyone helps out with, regardless of age.

Name: Gerald
Text: It's freshly baked bread, so you don't need to worry about it going bad.

Name: Remy
Text:
It's super, super delicious!
I already gobbled down three of them earlier.

Name: Gerald
Text: Is it to your liking?

Name: Gerald
Text:
I'm glad to hear that.
I guess this little rascal didn't mess with the dough after all.

Name: Remy
Text: Hmph, you're not even my dad! But you're always nagging me.

Name: Remy
Text:
<Yellow>You know, I'm gonna beat up all the bad guys just like you, adventurer...
And I'll grow up to be an adult who never scolds anyone!</>

Name: Gerald
Text:
If you want to do that, you'll need to fix your habit of ,ischief.
Lying is a very shameful thing to do.

Name: Gerald
Text:
No matter how fast you bring news,
what good is it if no one believes you?

Name: Gerald
Text:
We got lucky this time, but...
If it happens again, a lot of people could get hurt.

Name: Gerald
Text: Understood, Remy?

Name: Remy
Text:
A-All right, I get it...
Grandpa and you, you both just pick on me! Hmph.

Name: Remy
Text:
Um, adventurer.
I want to learn how to fight as cool as you do.

Name: Remy
Text:
You defeated the Ironblood Brigade like, swoosh, swoosh!
I really wanna learn too!

Name: Gerald
Text:
He's being especially needy today.
I'm sorry to ask, but could you please spare him a little time?

Name: Gerald
Text:
The area behind the village should be suitable for a warm-up.
It's a low-risk area, so it'll be safe enough to bring the boy along.

Name: Gerald
Text: Just watch over him so he can try catching some small prey himself.

Name: Remy
Text: Now you're gonna knock them all down like swoosh, swoosh, right, adventurer?

Name: Remy
Text:
I'll be watching closely!
I'm gonna remember every move and copy it right away!

Name: Remy
Text:
I wanna try doing it like you, adventurer.
I’ll grip my weapon tight and stare straight ahead!

Name: Remy
Text: I-If a weak one shows up, I'll finish it off myself! Mmhmm!

Name: Remy
Text:
You just stay right here.
I'm gonna succeed for sure and brag to Mr. Gerald.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Remy is looking around, carefully picking his prey.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Even little kids grow up tough here in Hesperia...
All the settlers are doing whatever it takes to survive.)</>

Name: Quaista
Text:
Such natural acting, and even your movements were convincing.
You did a great job.

Name: Quaista
Text: Just as we expected, the Wolves have no idea they're being tailed.

Name: Quaista
Text:
They'll probably wait here for the rest of the Wolves for a while...
Once their numbers are up, they'll likely slip away by blending in with the merchants.

Name: Quaista
Text: That's when we'll follow them.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Since they don't suspect you at all,
let's keep up the act for now.

Name: Quaista
Text: If you manage to pick up any special intel, let me know immediately.

Name: Quaista
Text:
I'll keep tightening the surveillance net on my end,
and stay prepared for any unexpected situations.

Name: Remy
Text:
Look! I caught a toad!
It's a little small, but... it’ll do.

Name: Remy
Text: The grown-ups told me their skin is super useful for all sorts of things.

Name: Remy
Text:
Grandpa Xavier and Mr. Gerald are gonna be so proud of me, right?!
I'm a great guard, too!

Name: Remy
Text: Yeah! Let's head back to the village!

Name: Remy
Text: But... I'm not sure if I can hang it up right here.

Name: Remy
Text:
Leather is flat, you know.
But the toad I caught is so chubby... Hmm...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Shadow Wolves I spotted earlier are nearby.)</>

Name: Remy
Text:
I know, I'll just go ask Mr. Gerald!
I'll go get him. Don't go anywhere, okay?!

Name: Snickering Voice
Text:
I was worried when I heard the guy who smashed the Brigade was here,
but he's nothing but hot air.

Name: Snickering Voice
Text:
They were all babbling about him being some great savior or lifesaver.
It won't matter once we take this village for ourselves anyway. *snicker*

Name: Fierce Voice
Text: Forget him. Just ignore the fool and let's get on with our own work.

Name: Fierce Voice
Text:
The area around the Hallowed Obsidian Mountain is clear enough to traverse.
We just need to find a good spot to hide from those darn Frantians.

Name: Snickering Voice
Text: Judging by how quiet the Brigade guts are, it seems they've infiltrated without a hitch.

Name: Snickering Voice
Text:
I should give them the signal to move out.
Was disguising them as <Red>“new Brigade recruits”</> even a viable plan in the first place?

Name: Fierce Voice
Text: A wolf can hardly stay cooped up in a mere human's nest.

Name: Fierce Voice
Text:
But we might as well gladly accept this gift the Ironblood Brigade is offering.
The wrapping paper would be perfect for the old fox.

Name: Snickering Voice
Text: Kyahaha! Come on, let's go pack our gear!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(They'll be making their move soon. You need to tell Quaista.)</>

Name: Gerald
Text: Remy wouldn't stop pestering me to prep that toad for him.

Name: Gerald
Text:
I guess the hunting wore him out.
He yawned, so I sent him inside before I came here.

Name: Gerald
Text:
If it's something urgent, I'd be happy to help.
Just say the word.

Name: Gerald
Text:
You must be in a rush.
I'll be sure to pass the message along to Remy.

Name: Gerald
Text: Thank you for everything, adventurer.

Name: Quaista
Text:
It feels like we just parted ways.
Is the play over already?

Name: Quaista
Text:
You look quite out of breath...
Just how passionate was your act?

Name: Quaista
Text: ...Understood. We'd better get ready too.

Name: Quaista
Text:
The idea of thieves working together was hilarious to begin with.
But as expected, they were planning to stab each other in the back.

Name: Quaista
Text:
First, head to the <Blue>Starfall Plateau</>.
You will find <Orange>“Lamine,”</> the avenger there.

Name: Quaista
Text:
I will sever the Wolf Clan reinforcements from behind,
and bring the Young Master safely.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Are they planning to wait for reinforcements here? I should hide.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I can’t see them, but I should be able to hear them.)</>

Name: Fierce Voice
Text:
Are the others not here yet?
Just how badly did the Ironblood Brigade spoil them for them to be this sluggish?

Name: Snickering Voice
Text: They are hopeless. As soon as we arrive at the new hideout, I’m going to teach them a…

Name: A cheerful voice
Text: You guys must be wolf pups.

Name: Snickering Voice
Text:
Who are you?
Who dares stand in the way of a wolf… C-Cough!

Name: Fierce Voice
Text: You bastard! I will rip you to shreds!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What is going on in there?)</>

Name: Fierce Voice
Text: <Red>A-Ahhh!</>

Name: A cheerful voice
Text: I was going to go up! Did you come all the way down for me instead?

Name: A cheerful voice
Text:
You hid your presence so well, and I became curious.
I had to fight so hard to stay focused during the mission.

Name: Ramynn
