Text: I’m <Orange>Lamine</>. I’m from Asientet.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Oh, look… The pretty snowfield is painted with blood.
It must be hard to look at for a civilian, right? I’m sorry.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Oh, how do you know Quaista?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You carefully explain about your friendship with Azran. At that, Lamine’s eyes widen.)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
So you were the one who took care of the Young Master and the Shadow Wolf Commander.
I really wanted to meet you.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
You took my prey while I was stalking this place out.
How do you plan to make up for that, huh?

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Ah, I should have followed you in secret.
Young Master gets way too decisive when he is in his divine form.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Anyway, I wonder why Quaista sent you to me.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Huh? Are you talking about them?
I killed them all.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
It’s obvious.
I live to take revenge on them.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Hmm, I should just say you were late and there was nothing I could do.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Wiping out the Wolf Clan on sight goes without saying.
Why did he suddenly come up with a plan like that?

Name: Ramynn
Text:
We have to kill them anyway, so I don’t think the Young Master is going to punish us.
The same goes for Quaista.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Mmm! With this kind of thing, I'll just insist that I'm right.
We should get going.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Do you want to come with me for a bit?
My temporary hideout is just ahead.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Being an assassin… sure requires a lot to keep track of.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Traveling alone in secret means no one else is there to take care of you.

Name: Ramynn
Text: From spare weapons, emergency rations, to first-aid kits…

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Oh, right! Almost forgot the most important part.
Could you please go and get my diary from up there?

Name: Ramynn
Text: You can read it if you’re curious.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This must be the diary Lamine mentioned.)</>
ItemDesc:
An item Lamine holds dear
Though lined with smooth leather on the outside,
the worn inner pages reveal its long years of use.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is it really OK to read someone else’s diary…? Hmm.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(But curiosity is hard to resist. 
She allowed it, so let’s just take a sneak peak.)</>
ItemDesc:
Day 1.

Starting from today, I decided I’m going to write a diary!
My master told me to keep writing until I grow up.

All I can remember is my parents leaving me in the desert…
But when I woke up, I was here. The bed is really soft and nice.

Name: [player]
ItemDesc:
Day 9.

I was told that the strongest person in the kingdom found me.
He said that my new home was the White Lion’s Castle and that I must remember that.
I must not forget that.

The food here is amazing!!!
And the people here are awesome.
I should ask them to teach me swordsmanship.

Name: [player]
ItemDesc:
Day 26.

Would I get in trouble if I just ran away in secret?
They said they'd go easy on me because I’m just an apprentice, but it hurts so much!!!
Hmph… Starting tomorrow, I’m going to eat a bunch.
I’m going to grow taller and pay back those guys who made fun of me for tripping.

Name: [player]
ItemDesc:
Day 78.

I finally got one over on them! It feels so good!!!
They said I would be able to spar with the Young Master starting tomorrow…
But they say the Young Master is really strong…
How curious! I should hurry up and get some sleep.

Name: [player]
ItemDesc:
Day 153.

Young Master is too strong…
I wasn’t able to land a single hit. He’s faster than an eagle flying towards the castle.

He’s five years older than me, so I probably can’t beat him, right?
Still, I might have a chance… I can even beat grown-ups…

Name: [player]
ItemDesc:
Day 189. 

This is probably the only place where they feed and shelter orphans like me.
I really love the White Lion Household!!!

The other kids say life here is way better than outside too.
I want to stay here forever and ever.

They said I could join the Assassin Guild once I get bigger.
I don’t know anything about assassination. But the members look cool, so I want to join.

Name: [player]
ItemDesc:
Day 221.

The Commander told me to go on a mission with the Young Master.
It’s not allowed for apprentices, but he said he’s making an exception.
Other apprentices besides me will also be going.
I can even ride a horse now, so I’m confident.

Even the Young Master turned away, but I saw him smile a little.
I can’t sleep! I should pack some snacks from the kitchen.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
I said you could read it because those are stories from when I was little.
I was about 13 or 14…

Name: Ramynn
Text:
I was a bit slow to grow.
I often thought that might be the reason why I was abandoned.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Look, it’s obviously written by a child.
You can clearly see how carefree my life was.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Of course, everything after that is in a different diary.
But I’ll keep it to myself. It’s way too embarrassing.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
It wasn’t even that difficult.
It was a recon mission that took about 15 days.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Although it was Young Master’s first time leading a mission,
that was just an excuse to send the children out of the castle.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
<Red>In the end, everyone died while we were gone!</>
We could have fought too… Hmm.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Sniff, ugh…

Name: Ramynn
Text:
The Great Lord already knew…
…that they were hatching a dirty scheme.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
The ones who set the fires and slaughtered everyone were the <Red>Shadow Wolf Clan.</>
It was the <Red>“Yellow Snake”</> who was pulling the strings.

Name: Ramynn
Text: And the one who gained the most out of it is the King of Asientet.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
We, the survivors, are the only ones who can prove it.
Everyone is staying silent because they are terrified of what might happen afterward.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(How could he kill innocent people to gain power…?)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
The truth will always find a way to reveal itself, right?
I’m going to make them pay for what happened that day, no matter what.

Name: Ramynn
Text: I’m going to find the ones who framed us and take their lives.

Name: Ramynn
Text: If they are already dead, I’m going to drag their souls back out and tear them apart…

Name: Ramynn
Text:
And make them feel the pain that I felt.
Once I sink my teeth into their throats, I won't let go.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A sudden chill runs down your spine.)</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Now! Shall we wrap up and get going?
The Young Master will be waiting for me.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Mmm, I can’t catch a single whiff of any prey.
When are those reinforcements getting here?

Name: Ramynn
Text:
I thought Quaista was going to release them and wait.
Didn’t she mention anything about an ambush?

Name: Ramynn
Text:
If they are going to gather in Hesperia…
They will probably avoid the main path and head towards the gorge.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Because the town guard and the soldiers deployed by the archon are constantly patrolling the area.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Then they'll probably gather near the Ember-Choke Grove.
It should be faster to take a different route from Hesperia.

After heading to Hesperia with Lamine,
they stopped in front of the western bridge.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
These woods are crawling with dangerous creatures.
If it were just me, maybe, but the two of us will stand out like a sore thumb.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Halfway through, we’ll take a side path to the left.
It’ll help cover our scent too.

Name: Ramynn
Text: There is a perfect spot to gather before going over the gorge.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
I’m sure Quaista is also there.
Let’s hurry up before we lose our prey!

After the two watched a few Wolf Clan members flee, 
they wiped away all traces of their presence.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Young Master Azran left to Babylon.
There was an urgent report from <Orange>Chahim</>.

Name: Quaista
Text: You didn’t come all this way even after hearing everything from this adventurer, did you?

Name: Ramynn
Text:
I already devoured the wolf that you asked to keep alive.
It doesn’t matter since I kept one alive, right?

Name: Quaista
Text:
They were the ones who were in direct contact with the Ironblood Brigade.
These grunts know nothing.

Name: Quaista
Text:
What are you going to do if a few already arrived at the promised new hideout?
That’s why I gave orders to go after them.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Hmm, then can we hunt the brigade?

Name: Quaista
Text:
No, we have to discuss it with the Young Master.
If he asks us to search again, I’m not going.

Name: Quaista
Text:
It’s too cold there to be wandering around! Ugh!
You’re the one who ruined the plan, so you deal with it!

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Still, you were quite something…
I can see why the Young Master likes you.

Name: Ramynn
Text: <Yellow>It’s very rare to involve outsiders into our “revenge.”</>

Name: Quaista
Text: Killing the Alpha Wolf was very sudden.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Since he couldn’t delay public affairs as a divine entity,
I can also understand why the Young Master couldn’t wait for us.

Name: Quaista
Text:
It’s still disappointing.
<Yellow>This was the moment the avengers have been longing for decades.</>

Name: Ramynn
Text:
There are still plenty of throats to rip out.
The ones holding the wolf’s leash are the real ones.

Name: Quaista
Text: Let’s go. The Young Master must be waiting.

Name: Azran
Text:
You arrived earlier than expected.
Did you find their new hideout already?

Name: Ramynn
Text:
I’m sorry, Young Master.
I gulped down their head first.

Name: Azran
Text: But the plan was to go with Quaista after she severed their lines…

Name: Quaista
Text:
Yeah, I guess he lost control again.
But we left a few of the reinforcements alive, so we should be able to track them.

Name: Quaista
Text: Lamine, how can an assassin act so recklessly?

Name: Ramynn
Text: But <Yellow>it’s still an assassination if there are no witnesses</>, isn’t it?

Name: Quaista
Text:
Ah, whatever.
Please deal with him, Young Master.

Name: Azran
Text:
Stop it, both of you.
There is no time to bicker.

Name: Azran
Text:
As I said before,
dealing with the stragglers can wait.

Name: Azran
Text: With Frantia’s archon, they won’t be able to increase their numbers right away.

Name: Azran
Text:
With the lackeys out of the way, we have to choke out the real culprit…
…to corner them once and for all.

Name: Quaista
Text:
What about Chahim…?
Did you get some concrete intel?

Name: Quaista
Text:
Even after the Young Master captured the Wolf Clan Commander,
he still remains in Asientet.

Name: Azran
Text:
Take a look at this.
It’s a note he left for me.
ItemDesc:
- Confirmed: Yellow Snake embezzled a massive sum under the guise of war funds.
- No traces of supplies being purchased.
- The courier transporting the funds was eliminated near the gate.

Name: Azran
Text:
Chahim slipped this in my hand and left in a hurry.
But after reading the note, I understood why.

Name: Azran
Text:
<Yellow>I heard the “Yellow Snake” spent a fortune recently.</>
Chahim is investigating where the money went.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Yellow Snake… I heard that name somewhere.

Name: Azran
Text:
<Yellow>Fahad, he leads the Yellow Snake Household.
I’m sure he is the one who moved the funds.</>

Name: Quaista
Text: Is it just me or does this feel similar to what happened last time?

Name: Quaista
Text:
Unfortunately… Very much so…
I’m getting a strange sense of deja vu.

Name: Azran
Text:
This is a chance to link all the evidence we’ve gathered so far.
Do not let impatience get the better of you.

Name: Ramynn
Text:
Where should I wait in the meantime?
Young Master never gives me any complicated missions anyways.

Name: Azran
Text:
<Yellow>Lamine, do not forget that we're still in the stage of distinguishing friend from foe.
Stay here for the time being and keep a close eye on Yellow Snake.</>

Name: Azran
Text:
Find the perfect spot to slit their throat.
But do not go for the throat without my permission.

Name: Quaista
Text:
I’m still full from the wolf meat we just ate.
Why don’t you behave like the Young Master told you to?

Name: Quaista
Text: We just caught scent of our second prey. Let’s let them drop their guard.

Name: Azran
Text: <Yellow>Identify everyone going in and out of the Asientet Legation.</>

Name: Azran
Text:
From the merchants to the servants, do not miss anyone.
Record anything suspicious.

Name: Azran
Text:
I've become too visible to move quietly.
Your roles are vital.

Name: Ramynn
Text: Are you taking this one, Young Master?

Name: Azran
Text: The adventurer will accompany me and go get Chahim.

Name: Quaista
Text:
Mmm, Okay.
I’ll tend to this lion cub while I’m in Babylon.

Name: Ramynn
Text: But Young Master, he’s soo boring…

Name: Azran
Text:
That concludes our briefing.
Go and carry out your duties.

Name: Azran
Text: Chahim, did you retrieve everything you needed?

Name: Chahim
Text:
I’m sorry that you had to come all this way.
I was delayed because I had to lose my tail.

Name: Chahim
Text: Here are the materials regarding the circumstances I previously reported in writing.

Name: Chahim
Text:
Is the adventurer beside you the associate you spoke of?
The one who hunted the wolves with you.

Name: Azran
Text: That's correct. We faced the Commander of the Shadow Wolf Clan together.

Name: Azran
Text:
He agreed to aid us in our vengeance without hesitation.
We gained a skilled and powerful ally with tight lips.

Name: Chahim
Text:
I completely trust your decision, Azran.
I know you don’t allow just anyone to stand at your side.

Name: Chahim
Text: I look forward to working with you.

Name: Azran
Text:
This isn’t the best place for handling secrets.
Let’s head to the other side.

Name: Chahim
Text:
To summarize, “Yellow Snake”…
…is showing the same movements as before.

Name: Chahim
Text: It looks like the royal courts are keeping a watchful eye on the situation.

Name: Chahim
Text:
He personally audited the books of the major households,
and many are calling it a targeted attack against them.

Name: Azran
Text: How utterly absurd.

Name: Azran
Text: Once, they stood side-by-side to eradicate the White Lions, and now they have turned on each other.

Name: Chahim
Text:
There is no such thing as a lasting alliance among scoundrels.
In fact, they are leaving themselves wide open for us to exploit.

Name: Chahim
Text: I received this from someone who recently left the Yellow Snake Household.

Name: Chahim
Text:
<Yellow>It shows the flow of money…
…when the White Lion’s castle was ambushed.</>
ItemDesc:
At the time, the head of the households abruptly disposed of the family’s heirlooms.
They claimed the money was for the royal courts, but the annual tribute for that year had already been offered.

He then spent the remainder of the fortune somewhere,
and told me that it was an investment on a new business.
Only later did I realize that the business actually referred to a mercenary group.

At some point, my Master started complaining about how expensive it was to feed the “Wolves,”
and didn’t seem to be bothered at all to mention them.
The servants who had any doubts disappeared.

We had no choice but to turn a blind eye…
…to the inappropriate connection with the royal courts and the illegal embezzlement and tax evasion.
I, too, feared the consequences and didn’t dare speak a word of it.

Please do not forgive me for helping bring about the downfall of the White Lion Household.
I leave the ledger from then, hoping that it would be of some use.

Name: Azran
Text: It all makes sense…

Name: Azran
Text:
<Yellow>The moment our house fell, the Yellow Snake immediately rose to become the King’s closest confidant.</>
Anyone would have found those circumstances suspicious.

Name: Chahim
Text: Every noble avenger searched for concrete evidence.

Name: Chahim
Text: However, we weren’t able to do anything because the area was kept under tight surveillance…

Name: Chahim
Text:
The mansion’s caretaker handed these materials over.
We could finally investigate with certainty.

Name: Azran
Text: But how did he deliver it?

Name: Azran
Text:
We've been watching for years,
he has never strayed too far from the Snake’s territory.

Name: Chahim
Text: Even I never expected him to appear at the <Blue>“White Lion’s castle”</>.

Name: Chahim
Text:
<Yellow>That doesn’t mean our hometown is gone.
I visit often to sharpen my resolve.</>

Name: Azran
Text: Chahim…

Name: Chahim
Text:
Do not worry, Lord Azran.
I’m the only one who ever visits the abandoned wasteland.

Name: Chahim
Text: That’s why I was barely able to identify the figure… who left these behind.

Name: Azran
Text:
Not even the Yellow Snake’s sentinels anticipated that move.
We would have been in serious trouble if you were followed.

Name: Chahim
Text:
The caretaker did not return to the mansion.
Without him, the place has fallen into chaos.

Name: Azran
Text: I'll have to scrap the plan to infiltrate it myself.

Name: Azran
Text:
With the one who knows all the secrets gone,
they must have deployed people inside and out to keep everyone quiet.

Name: Chahim
Text: We need to find the courier while we still can to cut off the Archon's funding.

Name: Azran
Text: Understood. I'll head out immediately.

Name: Chahim
Text: We’ve got him detained, Azlan.

Name: Funds Courier
Text:
<Red>Do you have any idea who I am?!
How dare you treat me, an attendant of Fahad, like—</>

Name: Azran
Text:
The inventory is packed with gold coins.
It’s enough to hire dozens of mercenaries.

Name: Chahim
Text: Shall I conduct the interrogation?

Name: Funds Courier
Text: I-interrogation? H-hey... let's talk this out!

Name: Azran
Text:
No, I'll do it myself.
Stay to the side and record everything.

Name: Azran
Text:
[player], this won't be pretty, so step back.
I'll make it quick.

The two pressed him relentlessly for information.
At times, it sounded like someone was sobbing...

Name: Azran
Text:
Chahim, lock this guy up somewhere secure.
We need to present him before the Archon, so make sure he doesn't die.

Name: Chahim
Text:
It was for the same reason again, after all.
<Yellow>Since hiring the Wolf Clan is out of the picture, they're trying to contract a different mercenary group.</>

Name: Azran
Text: Now we need to figure out what they plan to use those troops for.

Name: Chahim
Text:
It would be ideal to stop them before they make a move,
but for now, it's more efficient to observe the situation.

Name: Azran
Text:
<Orange>Quaista</> and <Orange>Lamine</> are also on standby in Babylon.
Let's regroup and discuss this further.

Name: Azran
Text: [player], thank you for your immense help in tracking our second prey.

Name: Azran
Text:
I'll contact you once we've formed a plan.
Rest and save your strength until then.

Name: Aman
Text:
You look like a true local now.
Are you still chasing that mercenary group?

Name: Aman
Text:
This is a secret missive that came in a while ago.
<Orange>Nasser</> found it.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Sverd Mercenaries' crest is stamped into the torn wax seal.)</>

Name: Aman
Text:
I asked around thinking it was the Shadow Wolves,
but they say it belongs to the <Orange>“Sverd Mercenaries.”</>

Name: Aman
Text:
That's why I sought you out.
We don't have the means to decode it ourselves, anyway.

Name: Aman
Text: I figured as much.

Name: Aman
Text:
Hmm... It's a shame to just hand it over for free,
but since I have no favors to ask of you right now, I'll make an exception this time.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What is he plotting? What's he going to demand later...?)</>

Name: Aman
Text: Wait! I just thought of something good.

Name: Aman
Text: I'd like to know how your mercenary group's cipher works.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I knew he wouldn't just let me go.)</>

Name: Aman
Text:
As you know, we deal in information as well.
The more you know, the more profitable it is, right?

Name: Aman
Text:
Consider this my price for the missive.
You won't refuse, will you?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This is tricky. I'll just make something up.)</>
I explained it, weaving in a few lies.

Name: Aman
Text: So locations are drawn as pictures, and items are written with words.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It's actually the other way around, though.)</>

Name: Aman
Text: Then does this missive mean, <Yellow>”The snake is on the main road?”</>Is that it?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(No. It means the Visual Recording Device was left in the Gorge of Perdition.)</>

Name: Aman
Text: It almost sounds like it's referring to a place with a flowing river...

Name: Aman
Text: It's quite the riddle. I like it.

Name: Aman
Text: You're free to go now, [player].

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(These kinds of letters were always from Simon.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Gorge of Perdition, huh. Looks like I'm almost there.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I think this is it. Let's take a look.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The Visual Recording Device isn't turning on.
It seems to be broken.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: I was worried you might get the wrong idea, but judging by your face, it was just needless anxiety.

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Yellow>I had no idea the leader of the Paradise Advent Society was “Ingel,” either.</>
Playing mercenary commander must have just been a side gig for him.

Name: Beretta
Text: Well, I was never curious about the High Master's name anyway.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Who knew the rumor about that mercenary group's boss disappearing…
…would tie into this?

Name: Beretta
Text:
...I know it sounds like an excuse to someone who's been searching for their commander.
But I wanted to explain myself at least once.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Hah, it's been a while since something bothered me this much.
Have I been hanging around humans too long?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She speaks as if she isn't human herself.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
What were you up to?
Seeing as you came right away, you can’t have been that busy.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(After a moment of hesitation, you show her the Visual Recording Device.)</>
ItemDesc:
A means of delivering commissions often used by mercenaries.
It's currently broken and unusable.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Hmm, didn't expect to see one of these here.
Where did you get it?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She gives you a look that asks, "Why do you want to know?")</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
It's one of the ancient relics.
It has a special function similar to a communicator.

Name: Beretta
Text:
It's tricky to get your hands on, and even trickier to use.
So it's fascinating how familiar you seem with it.

Name: Beretta
Text:
To think it was used like some ordinary tool...
Did no one find it strange?

Name: Beretta
Text: Whatever. Hand it over since it's broken.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(When  you ask her to be careful with it, her expression sours.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
What's with that tone? Dont’ you trust me?
Just stand back and watch.
Beretta fixed the Visual Recording Device in an instant using magic.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Ah, take this too.
If it breaks again, use that in a pinch.

Name: Beretta
Text:
A repair kit.
I can't give you many. I don't have time to craft spares.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You thank her and nod.
She's a bit blunt, but she's actually quite thoughtful.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Are you just going to stand there?

Name: Beretta
Text: What are you waiting for? Activate the device.

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Yellow>Do you really think you can figure out...
…the connection between the Paradise Advent Society and the mercenary group on your own?</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
I said I'll stay with you, just in case something happens.
Just do as I say.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Let's not argue with her.
Beretta seems to have already made up her mind.)</>
As you turn on the Visual Recording Device, you see Simon.

Name: Symon
Text:
Going around like that will obviously draw suspicion.
Even I would be suspicious.

Name: Davin
Text:
Right? I knew it.
Even if I... hic... drink a lot, my memory is razor-sharp!

Name: Symon
Text:
After a Hunters Guild member showed up,
the <Red>Shadow Wolves</> started snooping around too...

Name: Symon
Text:
Since they'd already claimed that area as their turf,
it probably looked like their usual banditry.

Name: Davin
Text:
Exactly! That's it!
Burp, but after that, it was pure chaos. Hic... the Incursion...

Name: Symon
Text: An Incursion?! Did you tell Kamiya, the head of the Pioneer Team?

Name: Davin
Text: What's the point of telling someone… hic... obsessed with clearing land?

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Looks like you've already finished the job you were given.
Are you here for a new assignment?

Name: Symon
Text:
No, the Wolf Clan is more pressing than work right now.
They're moving a bit too actively. Should I look into it?

Name: Kamiya
Text:
I'd really appreciate that.
I'll assign one of our people to go with you.

Name: Symon
Text:
You always catch on fast, Kamiya!
But will you be able to handle the Incursion with the remaining personnel?

Name: Kamiya
Text:
We'll just have to make do with what we have.
Besides, we have an Incursion Specialist.

Name: Symon
Text: An Incursion Specialist? Who's that?

Name: Kamiya
Text: I heard he's a mercenary. His name is...

Name: Shadow Wolf Clan
Text:
Hah, when is he actually going to show up?
For a hunter, he's incredibly slow.

Name: Shadow Wolf Clan
Text:
Calm down.
You can't even wait this long?

Name: Shadow Wolf Clan
Text:
It's just frustrating that we always have to grovel.
What’s the big deal about <Orange>Xeros</> or whatever his name is?

Name: Shadow Wolf Clan
Text:
Yeah! Why don't we just trigger an <Red>Incursion</> ourselves?
No one said we couldn't use it when we're bored.

Name: Shadow Wolf Clan
Text:
A promise is a promise!
Mitchell, have you forgotten our deal with that hunter?

Name: Symon
Text: Xeros...?

Name: Quick-footed Pioneer Corps Member
Text: Hmm...? What's wrong?

Name: Symon
Text:
Ah... It's nothing.
It just strikes me as odd.

Name: Quick-footed Pioneer Corps Member
Text:
It's weird to think a band of thieves is walking on eggshells around someone.
I mean, they're called outlaws.

Name: Symon
Text:
Y-yeah... Maybe they're just afraid they'll lose if they pick a fight.
By the way, who is <Orange>Mitchell</>? Have you ever heard of him?

Name: Quick-footed Pioneer Corps Member
Text:
It's my first time hearing the name, too.
We should ask around the <Orange>Hunters Guild</>.

Name: Symon
Text: ...Xeros hasn't been in contact with the Wolf Clan, has he?

Name: Symon
Text:
No, we can decide once we’re sure.
Lets’ not jump to conclusions.

Name: Symon
Text:
<Yellow>Let's meet with Xeros first.
If we compare notes, the truth will come out.</>

Name: Symon
Text:
Besides, it seems this Mitchell guy has been using Xeros's name.
How tangled is this going to get?

Name: Symon
Text:
Phew... [player].
It'd be great if they could come along. I wonder where they are.

Name: Symon
Text: I hope they get to Taima Pioneer Village soon.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The shock leaves you speechless.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
It seems he was trying to tell you something.
So, where is this friend of yours now?

Name: Beretta
Text:
Oh, I shouldn't have brought that up... Um... I'm sorry.
This is when you say you're sorry, right?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Beretta looks flustered, and you say, “It’s okay.
Thanks to your help, I was able to see this anyway.”)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: What are your plans now?

Name: Beretta
Text: All right. I'll wait for you here, so go on ahead.

Name: Beretta
Text:
...Usually, in times like this, someone is supposed to stay by your side.
Less talking, more going.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She doesn’t look considerate, but she is, surprisingly.)</>

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Look who it is!
What brings you all the way out here?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain everything that had happened and ask about Simon.)</>

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Ah, I feel terrible about this.
I already told you everything I know back then.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Still, to think even Simon has passed away... It breaks my heart.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
He was the most entertaining person to talk to.
You know how Simon was like.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
You never really get used to losing people you know, do you?
Even so, thank you for letting me know, [player].

Name: Davin
Text: Are you back... hic... to get exploited again?

Name: Davin
Text:
Obviously...! We were drinking buddies, you hear me?
But why are you looking for me?

Name: Davin
Text: W-wait, now that I think about it... burp, Simon asked me to do something...

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(After you tell him that you were in the same mercenary group,
you ask him to tell you what Simon had requested.)</>

Name: Davin
Text:
What? You were in the Sverd Mercenaries, too?
P-proof... Show me some proof! Right now!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You reveal the crest of the Sverd Mercenaries.)</>
ItemDesc: Shown to prove your membership in the Sverd Mercenaries.

Name: Davin
Text:
This isn't nearly enough!
Hic, you have to prove your skills! Your skills!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Looks like he's trying to make me do his work again.)</>

Name: Davin
Text: Seriously, nothing in this world... hic... is free, you know?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...You should've known.)</>

Name: Davin
Text:
Go clear out the monsters first. Burp... They're ruining my research.
Do that, and I'll... hic... tell you.

Name: Davin
Text: You seem to be in a rush, hic...

Name: Davin
Text:
I'd love to make you do more, but for Simon's sake...
Hic, I'll let you go.

Name: Davin
Text:
Go up to the building... hic... behind you.
There should be a letter... by the door.

Name: Davin
Text: Sva... No, Sverd... Mercenaries... Stay strong!

Name: Beretta
Text: All right, tell me what you found out.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You relay your conversations with the villagers and bring up the new Visual Recording Device.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
I bet it contains another <Yellow>”shocking”</> revelation.
But we still have to go look, don't we, [player]?

Name: Beretta
Text: Let's go to the Ancient Tree Bower shelter.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Phew, just the thought of dealing with that device again makes me want a drink.
I have no choice but to wet my whistle.

Name: Beretta
Text: Find the <Blue>Visual Recording Device</> while I make a quick trip to the brewery.

Name: Beretta
Text: If it's broken, use the tools I gave you.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Why did she follow you all the way out here?
This is exactly what you'd expect from a heavy drinker.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What was Simon trying to show you?)</>
ItemDesc: An intact Visual Recording Device left behind by Simon.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You’re terrified, yet dying to know.)</>
As you activate the Visual Recording Device, Ingel and the mercenaries appear.

Name: Yngel
Text: Thank you for answering my call.

Name: Yngel
Text:
You are all the <Orange>Sverd Mercenaries</>,
and are also my children.

Name: Yngel
Text: I can’t describe the joy whenever I scoured the continent to bring you in, one by one...

Name: Yngel
Text:
I'm sure you have many questions.
About why I summoned you, why I chose this place... About everything.

Name: Yngel
Text: But you all remember how I operate.

Name: Mercenary Member
Text: <Yellow>Stay with me, and you will understand.</>

Name: Libi
Text: <Yellow>The journey will reveal the truth.</>

Name: Yngel
Text:
The choice is yours.
I will not force your hand.

Name: Libi
Text: We will follow you as always, Commander.

Name: Mercenary Member
Text: Commander, I'm with you, too!

Name: Mercenary Member
Text:
Without a doubt!
It is an honor just to be called upon!

Name: Mercenary Member
Text: We will complete this mission for you, Commander.

Name: Mercenary Member
Text: To our success! For the Sverd Mercenaries!

Name: Yngel
Text:
Haha, "Commander" is far too formal.
I prefer it when you call me "Father."

Name: Yngel
Text: Now then, let me issue your first mission.

Name: Yngel
Text: <Red>Slaughter those who refuse to follow “us,” right here and now.</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The mercenary group wasn't disbanded... they were massacred?
How did Simon ever find this?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(And that last voice... belonged to Mitchell.
He wasn't even a part of the Sverd Mercenaries, but why...?)</>
You tell Beretta what you saw on the Visual Recording Device.

Name: Beretta
Text: ...Hah, he still treats people like tools.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I'd tell you more about Ingel, but now isn't the time.
If you take on too much shock at once, your mind will break.

Name: Beretta
Text: I'll fill you in when you've calmed down a bit.

Name: Beretta
Text: No, I'll be the judge of that.

Name: Beretta
Text:
The human psyche is as fragile as glass.
Your brain will shatter into a million pieces.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You glare at her for being so blunt, but Beretta ignores you.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
One step at a time. Patiently.
Understand?

Name: Beretta
Text:
Whose voice did you say you heard at the end of that recording?
Some guy named Mitchell, right?

Name: Beretta
Text:
We should start by tracking him down.
Where should we head to?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You suggest heading to the Great Arbor Domain, where Sharaf is stationed.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Let's hope we aren't chasing after another dead person this time.

Name: Beretta
Text:
...Hah, well, we have to check it out regardless.
If he witnessed that massacre, he definitely knows more.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She acts like she's helping, but also like she couldn't care less...)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: What are you waiting for? Lead the way.

Name: Beretta
Text: Who exactly are we going to see?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain the atmosphere of the place and tell her about Sharaf.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(When you say that Sharaf is deeply distrustful of humans,
Beretta furrows her brow.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Is there really a need for me to talk to him and ruin his mood?
You can handle the talking.

Name: Beretta
Text: Just let me know as soon as you find the device.

Name: Beretta
Text:
We should watch it together this time.
It's hard to make a judgment just from hearing about it.

Name: Beretta
Text: This Mitchell guy... he reeks of suspicion.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Why would you chase after a guy like that alone? Do you have a death wish?
Don't be stubborn. Just do as I say.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
It has been a long time.
What brings you here?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You should ask how he's doing before abruptly bringing up Mitchell.)</>

Name: Sharaf
Text: Things here are no different from usual.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
As <Orange>Bristly-Fur</> Naruru, I stand guard over this place,
and the human hunters take shifts to lend their strength.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
You have grown stronger than before.
I can smell it on you.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Now, it is your turn.
Please tell me why you have returned to this place.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You make up an excuse, saying you wanted to find Mitchell's belongings and mourn him in your own way.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Because Sharaf remembers Mitchell as a rather decent human.)</>

Name: Sharaf
Text:
We cleared all of those things away last time.
But knowing Mitchell... there might still be something left.

Name: Sharaf
Text: He was always dropping things, and the Kuduru Tribe often stole from him.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
Something might still be lying around in their territory.
They meticulously hide whatever they steal.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
...Still, thank you for not forgetting him and coming back.
Mitchell would be happy, too.

Name: Sharaf
Text: Incursions happen frequently around here, so be very careful.

Name: Sharaf
Text:
<Yellow>And... please give my regards to your friend.
Tell him that I am doing well.</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Your face is asking why I'm already here.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Was it really that obvious?)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
I've learned a thing or two, you see.
We can't have another disaster because you contacted me too late like last time, right?

Name: Beretta
Text: Well then, shall we take a look at this record?

Name: Mitchell
Text: So that's the long and short of it, Xeros.

Name: Xeros
Text: He played the father figure, and only now reveals his true colors.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Thanks to you, I narrowly dodged a bullet.
I owe it all to you, Xeros.

Name: Xeros
Text:
…Xeros? As if.
Do what you always do.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Then I won’t hold back.
All right, so what do I do?

Name: Xeros
Text: <Yellow>Ingel orders you to push forward with the Paradise Advent Society’s "Grand Cause."</>

Name: Xeros
Text:
It’s not the right time to rebel yet.
So, I need you to move in my name.

Name: Mitchell
Text: …To keep your plan on track, I take it?

Name: Xeros
Text:
There are still a few things I need to confirm.
We have to finish it flawlessly.

Name: Mitchell
Text: What are the odds Ingel put a tail on you?

Name: Xeros
Text:
<Yellow>What he needs most is a "sturdy test subject."</>
He won't risk getting on our bad side.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Ha! Is he still obsessed with that Gudua thing, or whatever it's called?
Talk about persistent.

Name: Xeros
Text: That’s exactly why I need your help, Mitchell.

Name: Xeros
Text:
<Yellow>While I stir things up for the Society from the outside,
you’ll be infiltrating them from within.</>

Name: Mitchell
Text:
But wait, doesn’t the Paradise Advent Society do good things too?
I see plenty of folks in need turning to them.

Name: Xeros
Text:
It’s just a flashy front to hide their filthy work. 
Word is, they’ve recently started experimenting with triggering the Incursion themselves.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Oho, now I see what I should do.
Get close to them, play the loyal ally, and worm my way in.

Name: Xeros
Text: If things get out of hands, feel free to use my name.

Name: Xeros
Text:
A few of our members didn't show up for the latest muster.
Let them misunderstand the situation, and lure them out.

Name: Xeros
Text:
We won't be able to win all of them over, though.
If they choose to stand with Ingel until the very end…

Name: Mitchell
Text:
<Yellow>No matter what we choose, sacrifices are bound to happen.</>
Better that than letting their numbers grow.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Oh, but I do have one favor to ask.
<Yellow>If unforeseen dangers arise, promise you'll kill me yourself...</>

Name: Mitchell
Text:
What if the Society tortures me?
You said Ingel has absolute control over them.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Besides, it's not like I'm gonna live forever anyway.
Just let me settle my debt to you while I can.

Name: Xeros
Text:
…All right.
Someday, the others will understand why we did this. And [player], too.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Phew, what a shame.
Guess I won't even get to show it.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Right, by the way—I should hand this over to ■■■■, correct?

Name: Xeros
Text:
Please.
I’ll check in on you from time to time, so let me know the second you spot anything suspicious.

Name: Symon
Text: So, you’re the one who’s been throwing Xeros's name around?

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Do I know you?
Throwing accusations like this makes me uncomfortable.

Name: Symon
Text: …I won't tolerate anyone tarnishing the Sverd Mercenaries' name.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Oh? Talk about an easy catch.

The screen crackles with static, and Simon and Mitchell begin discussing a different topic.
They appear to be quite familiar with one another.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Wouldn't that be dangerous?
Why not just wait at the pioneer village?

Name: Symon
Text: How could I? I can’t just sit back and do nothing.

Name: Symon
Text:
I still can't believe…
…that Ingel would actually pull something like that.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
It’s always the good ones who suffer most.
Anyway, where did you put the thing I gave you?

Name: Symon
Text:
The visual recording device?
It’s hidden somewhere you'll never find.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
<Yellow>You cannot lose that under any circumstances.
I risked my neck to get it.</>

Name: Mitchell
Text:
By the way, you really can't mind your own business.
Chasing me all this way just to meet the Wolves.

Name: Symon
Text:
I'm not here to "meet" them.
I've got my own investigation to run.

Name: Symon
Text:
Before I dig deeper into the Paradise Advent Society,
there are a few things I need to figure out regarding the Shadow Wolves.

Name: Mitchell
Text: Is this because of the pioneer village?

Name: Symon
Text:
I must repay my debts.
One of their people saved my life.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
Yes, yes, indeed.
Like I told you before, I’m on Xeros’s side, not yours.

Name: Mitchell
Text:
What happens to you matters little to me—
So look to your own survival, informant.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(So Mitchell was helping Xeros behind the scenes, allowing him to investigate Ingel and the Paradise Advent Society in secret.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Simon must have crossed paths with him during that time,
and he was trying to let me in on this, too.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(What Simon wanted to tell me back at the Wolves' hideout…
…might have been to go find Xeros.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: …Damn it. I can't believe he actually went ahead with that plan.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Beretta clenches and unclenches her fists, frustration written all over her face.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
I’ll need to dig into this a bit more, but…
[player], the disbandment of the mercenaries was bound to happen sooner or later.

Name: Beretta
Text: You were brought together merely to serve as useful instruments.

Name: Beretta
Text: You saw the word “Gudua” mentioned too.

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Yellow>The high master—no, Ingel…
He was recruiting people who showed a high probability of manifesting the Gudua factor.</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
And once he gathered enough people,
he headed straight for the Forsaken Land.

Name: Beretta
Text:
His destination? <Blue>Giant’s Tower</>, where else?
If you want to bring the world to its knees, the power of that tower is exactly what you need.

Name: Beretta
Text: *sigh...* I guess we should consider ourselves lucky we weren’t used as his tools.

Name: Beretta
Text: And juding by this record, Xeros is not entirely devoid of reason.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I get it now. I see why you want to try persuading him.
All right, it's my turn to step up.

Name: Beretta
Text: I’ll contact you soon. When I call, you better come running.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Welcome, [player].
I called you quickly because I thought this was news you'd been waiting for.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
A clan member operating near the <Blue>Verzard Outpost</>…
…heard intelligence regarding your mercenary group.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Word is, a figure known as <Orange>The Snowfield Mage</> recently surfaced around the Starfall Plateau.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Apparently, they're highly skilled and relentlessly hunting the Paradise Advent.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Supposedly from the Sverd Mercenaries. Care to look?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Well, nothing to lose.
I have no idea why show up now, but let’s find out.)</>

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Great. Head over to Verzard, then.
You'll find one of my clan members disguised as a regular soldier.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Her name is Sonya.
Red hair, strong build.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(That's strange. Someone of Ragnar's stature…
…shouldn’t need to be this cautious and disguise someone.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(When you look at him with a puzzled look, Ragnar gives an awkward smile.)</>

Name: Ragnar
Text: …Many still feel uneasy about <Red>Astrid</>.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Let's just say it’s a precaution

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Hmm, you might have to poke around the outpost.
They’ve been rotating the guards a lot lately.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Last I heard, she was near the main entrance.
Anything else you want to know?

Name: Ragnar
Text:
…Things aren't exactly perfect, but the folks there won't shut you out either.
There are too many favors to count.

Name: Ragnar
Text: So stop overthinking, and just get going.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(There's no sign of anyone looking like Sonya near the entrance.
I'll have to ask the sentry.)</>

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
Oh! Aren't you the famous adventurer?
It's me, remember?!

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text: …H-How could you forget me?!

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
*sigh...* Well, I can't really blame you.
It was my own blunder after all.

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text: I should've at least given you my name back then, just so you'd remember me...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Seriously, when on earth did we actually meet?)</>

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text: I guess that’s just what happens to a clumsy recruit who goes around losing his own weapon.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Ah, now I remember.
This is the same soldier who was shaking like a leaf, terrified he’d fail his entry trials.)</>

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text: I mean, I still have nightmares about losing my sword from time to time.

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
But look at me now—I've become a proper soldier!
And it's all thanks to you.

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
Anyway, what brings you all the way out here?
Is there some major trouble I don't know about...?

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
Ah... you just missed her.
Sonya's station was reassigned just yesterday.

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
She's over at the hot springs now.
Honestly, she deserved a break after pulling guard duty at the entrance for a whole month.

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
It gets incredibly hectic around here.
Ugh, I'm so jealous. I absolutely hate the cold, too...

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
Oh, it's really nothing!
Next time we cross paths, drinks are on me!

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
I knew you'd recognize me!
Thanks to you, I passed the new recruit test without a hitch.

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text: I mean, I still have nightmares about losing my sword from time to time.

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
But look at me now—I've become a proper soldier!
And it's all thanks to you.

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
Anyway, what brings you all the way out here?
Is there some major trouble I don't know about...?

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
Ah... you just missed her.
Sonya's station was reassigned just yesterday.

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
She's over at the hot springs now.
Honestly, she deserved a break after pulling guard duty at the entrance for a whole month.

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
It gets incredibly hectic around here.
Ugh, I'm so jealous. I absolutely hate the cold, too...

Name: Outpost Soldier
Text:
Oh, it's really nothing!
Next time we cross paths, drinks are on me!

Name: Schulmann
Text:
Answer my question.
And maybe I’ll tell you!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Just like that?
You give him a completely baffled look, but Schulmann doesn't budge an inch.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(No way around it, I guess.
You give him a nod to show you understand.)</>

Name: Schulmann
Text: You. You came for Sonya, right?

Name: Schulmann
Text: The human who told you to find Sonya... Who? Who?!

Name: Schulmann
Text: Ragnar? What's a Ragnar?! What kind of human is he?!

Name: Schulmann
Text: Bzzz! Wrong! Not that! Sonya! S-Sonya... something like Sonya!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You have no idea why you’re doing this, but you answer: The Polaris Clan.)</>

Name: Schulmann
Text:
Oh, nice!
That's good enough!

Name: Schulmann
Text:
Hey, adventurer!
Sonya had some urgent business and went off somewhere.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
She told me if a human came during her absence, I should do this.
Well? Pretty tough quiz, huh?

Name: Schulmann
Text:
O-oh, really? But I didn't make the questions.
It’s Sonya. I just did exactly what Sonya told me to do.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
Anyway, you got them all right, so head over to the Geyser Field.
Under the rock over there—what you're looking for is right there.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let's read this right away.)</>
ItemDesc:
<Report>
1. The individual known as “The Snowfield Mage” operates primarily around the Starfall Plateau.
2. They say this mage is no stranger to the Tower.
3. Known for eliminating the Paradise Advent Society, the mage was last seen moving toward Stormkel Gate.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The Snowfield Mage, huh...
Come to think of it, the mercenaries had plenty of high-caliber mages.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(In fact, there are too many options to even guess who it might be.)</>

Name: Schulmann
Text: Welcome back! Did you find the thing Sonya talked about?

Name: Schulmann
Text:
Nice! Then I did my part!
Make sure you tell Sonya I did a good job later!

Name: Schulmann
Text: So, where are you heading next?

Name: Schulmann
Text:
Of course!
I have to confirm it, or Sonya won't pay me!

Name: Schulmann
Text: I must leave no loose ends. For the honor of Goddess Ea.

Name: Schulmann
Text: I see. When Sonya gets back, I'll be sure to tell her!

Name: Schulmann
Text:
Before you go, warm yourself up first.
The gatekeepers despise those who appear unkempt.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You try to give him a look that says you’re fine, but it's no use.)</>
Warming up in this cozy spot, I felt a sense of peace wash over me.

Name: Schulmann
Text:
What did I tell you?
Come visit again sometime.

Name: Schulmann
Text: And feel free to spread the word to those gatekeepers, too!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Who should I ask?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow> (Ah, that person will do.
I doubt he'll turn down my request.)</>

Name: Gale
Text:
Oh? Aren’t you the adventurer?
What brings you all the way out here?

Name: Gale
Text:
…Look, I’m just a low-ranking administrator.
All I can do is stamp seals, you know?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(As you stare at him as if to ask how that was low-ranking, he immediately straightens up politely.)</>

Name: Gale
Text:
Hah... To be honest, our Gate Captain has been on edge lately.
Just tell me what you need before someone notices us.

Name: Gale
Text:
Oh? You two actually know each other?
Quite famous lately for smashing the Paradise Advent Society, you know.

Name: Gale
Text: We didn't even post a bounty, but the sheer amount of hunting is almost terrifying.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...So does that mean he knows them or not?)</>

Name: Gale
Text: Geez! Don't give me that look, just hear me out first!

Name: Gale
Text: So, as a little token of appreciation, we always hand out a courtesy gift ahead of time.

Name: Gale
Text: Today just happens to be the day, so go talk to the supply depot administrator.

Name: Gale
Text:
This settles what we owe each other, right?
That's how I'll take it, adventurer!

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
It’s been a while, adventurer!
How have you been keeping?

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
It's truly an honor to see you again.
There's been something I’ve been dying to tell you.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: Do you remember the dishes made from monsters?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(As you nod, the supply depot administrator's face lights up.)</>

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: A few like-minded folks and I have been occasionally delivering those meals over to the Sanctuary.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: The Gate Captain isn't exactly thrilled about it, but he doesn't strictly forbid it either.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(...So he tacitly allows it.
He's not as closed-minded as I thought.)</>

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: Ever since we started bringing food and medicine, the number of addicts at the Sanctuary has dropped drastically.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
It’s a massive relief.
And really, we owe it all to you, adventurer!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(When you tell him they did all the work, he looks incredibly proud.)
Time to get to the point.)</>

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
Oh, absolutely!
Since you work so hard for us, we’re paying special attention to supplies.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
Wait, you're friends?
Well, an elite adventurer like you would definitely know them, right?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Best to pretend that you do.)</>

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: Then I’ll leave this delivery to you, adventurer!

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: Before you go, we're low on supplies. Could you fetch us some ingredients?

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text: You should go to the <Blue>Hoarfrost Snowfield Crossroads</>.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
You're back already?
I say this every time, but your skills are unmatched.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
Just give me a brief moment.
I’ll have it ready in no time!

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
Thank you for waiting!
When it comes to boosting your stamina, nothing beats this!
ItemDesc: A hearty, stamina-boosting dish made with the administrator’s secret touch.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
The Snowfield Mage should be resting at the Crossroads Shelter.
That's usually where we meet up.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
It’s a pleasure to cook for you two!
Maybe I should learn cooking properly.

Name: Supply Depot Administrator
Text:
Phew, look at me rambling on.
Go on, adventurer!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(As you draw closer to the Crossroads Shelter, a familiar silhouette comes into view.)</>

It’s been a while, [player].
I wondered when you’d finally show up… and here we are.

Name: Nova
Text:
Yeah, it’s really me.
<Yellow>Another survivor of the Sverd Mercenaries, just like you.</>

Name: Nova
Text:
Let’s skip the pleasantries.
It’s not like they ever fit us anyway.

Name: Nova
Text:
I’m sure you’ve got a million questions, and so do I.
But let’s take it one thing at a time, shall we?

Name: Nova
Text:
First, take a look at this.
<Orange>Libi</> left it behind.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Nova is usually so laid back, but not right now.
…Does she already know about Libi’s death?)</>

Name: Nova
Text: I’ve always noticed this about you, but you’ve always been a bit too soft.

Name: Nova
Text:
Don't look so tense—I already know what about Libi.
It was Xeros's doing.

Name: Nova
Text:
But there’s something else I need to know from you.
First, just watch this, [player].

Name: Libi
Text: Why are you going this far?

Name: Libi
Text:
…Everyone followed you like a father!
We thought it was only right to risk our lives for you!

Name: Libi
Text: And you’re telling me all this was just for one person?!

Name: Yngel
Text: I don't understand why you're angry, Libi.

Name: Yngel
Text:
Without me, you all would have been nothing. I…
I give you a proper life, didn’t I?

Name: Yngel
Text:
I had high hopes since you supposedly carry the Gudua bloodline.
But frankly, you have been nothing but a massive disappointment.

Name: Libi
Text: …Gudua? What are you talking about?!

Name: Yngel
Text: No need for you to know. You were unqualified anyway.

Name: Libi
Text: Commander!

Name: Yngel
Text:
So you won't even call me “Father” anymore?
And I mistook you as the obedient type…
The screen flickers with heavy static. Ingel and Logos are standing right next to Libi's collapsed body.

Name: Yngel
Text: Any progress on the assignment, Logos?

Name: Logos
Text:
Proceeding perfectly.
Xeros appears to be moving as you intended.

Name: Yngel
Text:
Haha, I knew it.
He acts all stubborn, but he eventually does as I wish.

Name: Yngel
Text:
Still, keep a close eye on him.
After all... he did postpone his choice.

Name: Yngel
Text:
My, it has been quite a while since we’ve had a proper chase.
I can't wait to see who's faster—him or me.

Name: Logos
Text:
Won't Xeros become a nuisance if he turns into an outright enemy?
It might be wiser to eliminate him now...

Name: Yngel
Text:
[player]… and Xeros.
It doesn't hurt to keep both as candidates.

Name: Yngel
Text:
That way… losing one won't matter.
Ah... it's been a long time since my blood has boiled like this.

Name: Logos
Text:
What should we do with this one?
Would disposal be best?

Name: Yngel
Text:
Suit yourself.
Throw her into the <Blue>Etherium experiment</> if you like.

Name: Logos
Text:
Understood, High Master!
<Red>Let’s see just how different an unqualified specimen is from a regular human.</>

Name: Libi
Text:
Don’t… forget.
You must meet my sister... and tell her...

Name: Libi
Text: <Yellow>Every single mercenary... carries the Gudua bloodline…</>

Name: Libi
Text: <Yellow>The stronger manifestation... the... closer... one can access the Tower’s control room…</>

Name: Logos
Text:
The Tower’s Administrator thinks the same.
…Though the goal is different.

Name: Libi
Text:
The Tower… something is wrong about it, right?
That’s why the Paradise Advent Society... you all are after it...

Name: Logos
Text:
That’s just Ingel’s idea.
<Yellow>…Not an Apostle like me.</>

Name: Libi
Text: What...?

Name: Logos
Text:
I wish that Tower would just vanish.
Now it’s nothing but a massive hive spewing out monsters.

Name: Logos
Text: Stupid humans… they have absolutely no idea they're marching straight to their deaths.

Name: Logos
Text:
I waited my entire life to play with you all,
And you got distracted by something as boring as a Tower.

Name: Libi
Text: If you're just going to spout nonsense, just kill me! I mean it!

Name: Logos
Text: ...Why bother? You're going to die anyway.

Name: Logos
Text:
Ah, then how about this?
I'll take you somewhere full of people just like you.

Name: Logos
Text: A place like that should be right up your alley, don't you think?

Name: Nova
Text: This is my conclusion, [player].

Name: Nova
Text:
<Yellow>The Brigade Commander gathered those with the Gudua bloodline.
And he valued you and Xeros the most.</>

Name: Nova
Text:
I don't think it was Logos or whatever, but...
<Yellow>The Brigade Commander and the Paradise Advent Society wanted the Tower.</>

Name: Nova
Text: That's why they tried to bring you and Xeros into the fold.

Name: Nova
Text:
They probably thought a few sacrifices were inevitable along the way.
Because that's just the kind of people they are.

Name: Nova
Text:
So, what I'm curious about is...
Is Xeros on Ingel's side?

Name: Nova
Text: Why?

Name: Nova
Text: ...I was supposed to kill him, but Xeros beat me to it. It pisses me off.

Name: Nova
Text:
I wouldn't have believed it if anyone else told me, but...
[player]... Coming from you, it's a different story.
You explain the circumstances of Libi's death, along with the Brigade Commander's demise.

Name: Nova
Text:
I see...
It's fine. I already knew that addicts never meet a good end.

Name: Nova
Text: Besides, Libi would have chosen death over living like that.

Name: Nova
Text:
Still, it's a shame.
I was planning to get a hit in on the Brigade Commander myself.

Name: Nova
Text:
What about you, [player]?
Did you take out enough of your anger on the Brigade Commander and the Paradise Advent Society?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You took a moment to think about Nova's sudden question.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Looking back, the Brigade Commander you worked so hard to find ended up dead,
and the Paradise Advent Society is still active.)</>

Name: Nova
Text: I'm going to be waiting all day, seriously.

Name: Nova
Text:
Right, that's the normal reaction.
Look at me! I'm absolutely slaughtering the Paradise Advent Society, aren't I?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(That seems a bit extreme, but it's probably best to stay quiet for now.)</>

Name: Nova
Text: Anyway, tell me how to get into their sanctuary.

Name: Nova
Text: If there are any traces of Libi left, I need to retrieve them. As her only family.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You recall the method Xeros told you, then ask Nova to wait a moment.)</>

Name: Nova
Text:
...Understood.
I'll grab a quick bite to eat while I wait.

Name: Nova
Text: The food from the Gate is pretty good.

Name: Nova
Text:
You're back already.
Let's head out right away, then.

Name: Nova
Text: Damn it, why won't it work for me?

Name: Nova
Text:
...Will you be okay?
Isn't this your first time going alone?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(No, you’re not okay, but you try your best to look like you are.)</>

Name: Nova
Text:
Well, it can’t be helped.
Come to the Crossroads Shelter as soon as you're back.

Name: Nova
Text:
I'll be waiting for you, [player].
So make sure you make it back alive.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You never thought you'd come back here...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You really hope you can find Libi's belongings.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Is popping out of nowhere a specialty of yours?
I was just trying to enjoy some peace and quiet for once.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Why are you here?
Do you still have unfinished business with the Paradise Advent Society?

Name: Beretta
Text:
If you're thinking of getting revenge right now, drop it.
This isn't something one person can take on alone.

Name: Beretta
Text: Is that so...? Let's hear what this favor is first.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain that you came to find traces of Libi at Nova's request.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
I'm glad you're not here to do something stupid.
Let's stay out of each other's way.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Why else would I be here?
Obviously, I’m looking for clues about the Leader and the Mercenary Group.

Name: Beretta
Text:
I was planning to contact you once I had a solid lead.
Running into you wasn't part of my plan.
You also tell Beretta about the contents of the visual record device you saw with Nova.

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Yellow>He gathered those with the Gudua bloodline to form a mercenary group.
His intentions are crystal clear.</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
It's just as you suspect.
But what I want to know is more like “why.”

Name: Beretta
Text:
Just because of that?
I don't think so, [player].

Name: Beretta
Text:
Fighting for supremacy in the Tower is just child's play.
They have to be hiding some far uglier desires.

Name: Beretta
Text: *sigh* I wonder where the teacher is and what he's up to...

Name: Beretta
Text:
...Pretend you didn't hear that.
Anyway, since it's come to this, we should stick together. No objections, right?

Name: Beretta
Text: Good work, [player].

Name: Beretta
Text: Even with the Leader dead, his followers haven’t changed.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Nothing has changed.
The Paradise Advent Society is still standing strong.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Let's go, before more of them show up.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Let's split up here.
I'll take the left, you take the right.

Name: Beretta
Text: Most of the facilities where they experimented on abducted people were over there.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I'm curious how Beretta knows that,
but I'll ask later.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Where else would they neatly store their test subjects?

Name: Beretta
Text:
If they brought them to the plateau, it had to be here.
Besides, I've been here before.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Come on... it's written all over your face, so just ask if you're curious.
Stop hesitating. Just spit it out.

Name: Beretta
Text: We both know each other's dirty secrets, so there's no point in hiding anything.

Name: Beretta
Text:
First, let's take get done with our own tasks.
We can regroup after that.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(That's definitely a torture device. Does that mean Libi was here...?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You inform Beretta of your current location.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text: Empty-handed. Guess you didn't find anything.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Still, you made it here safely.
We're almost outside, so you might find what you're looking for around here.

Name: Beretta
Text: First, let's deal with the guys who get in our way.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Stepping outside, the first thing that catches your eye is the Vagrant's Repose.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
Unbelievable, isn't it, [player]?
I had the exact same reaction when I first saw this.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Not even realizing the root of the problem was right under their noses,
they just flailed around before dropping dead.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Humans are so fragile...
Anyway, did you find what you were looking for?

Name: Beretta
Text: I found a clue, too.

Name: Beretta
Text: <Yellow>The one who advised gathering kids like you... was the “Teacher.”</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
The Commander agreed with him.
After that, he formed the mercenary group to give them a sense of belonging.

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Yellow>That's right, you were all raised to be perfectly compliant pawns.
It was a very deliberate upbringing.</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
...Fooled by the mask of a fatherly Commander,
only those who blindly followed the Leader became victims.

Name: Beretta
Text:
<Red>Even if painstakingly raised, they're disposed of once they lose their usefulness.</>
That was his way of nurturing people.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Beretta fell deep in thought for a moment before looking at you.)</>

Name: Beretta
Text:
We'll have to get the rest of the answers from the “Teacher.”
Reach out if you ever need my help.

After parting ways with Beretta, you head to the Crossroads Shelter.
Nova was waiting at the Crossroads Shelter, looking incredibly anxious.

Name: Nova
Text:
[player]... You made it back safely!
Are you hurt anywhere?

Name: Nova
Text: So... did you find any trace of Libi?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You show her Libi's Bandana, which you found in the Paradise Advent Society sanctuary.)</>
ItemDesc: A keepsake of Libi found in the Paradise Advent Society sanctuary.

Name: Nova
Text:
...Thank you, [player].
For going out of your way for Libi.

Name: Nova
Text:
I need to go to where Libi met her end.
...I wasn’t able to say a proper goodbye yet.

Name: Nova
Text:
[player], you should come with me.
As a fellow surviving mercenary.

Name: Nova
Text:
If you don't want to, I won't force you.
It's just that I don't know when I'll ever see you again.

Name: Nova
Text:
You never know.
The Paradise Advent Society might just wipe us out without a trace.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You can’t say anything to what Nova said.)</>

Name: Nova
Text:
So, I'd really prefer if we went together.
The end for mercenaries like us is usually all the same.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You nod quietly.
Just as she said, there might be no tomorrow for us.)</>

Name: Nova
Text: Phew... Just a little later, and I would've been cleaning up your corpse, [player].

You explain the whole story to Helena and Nova.
It seemed Helena had mistaken Nova for Libi.

Name: Helena
Text:
So that's what happened.
Things have changed a lot here, too.

Name: Helena
Text: We're keeping the Paradise Advent Society far away from here.

Name: Helena
Text: We're doing our best to make this a true sanctuary where people can actually rest.

Name: Helena
Text: ...At some point, they started bringing us food and medicine from the Gate.

Name: Helena
Text: Thanks to that, fewer people are seeking out Aetherium Candy.

Name: Helena
Text: ...Of course, I know there are still some who take it.

Name: Helena
Text:
But I've seen a glimmer of hope that things can change,
and that's enough for me.

Name: Helena
Text: I know it's a lot to ask... but could you help me make some basic medicine?

Name: Helena
Text: We often have several sick people arriving all at once, you see.

Name: Helena
Text:
You should be able to find the ingredients at Sere-Moss Heights.
Just some Monster's Blood and a few bundles of herbs, please.

Name: Nova
Text: I'll help. It's not exactly a difficult task, anyway.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(...Did Nova just volunteer to help?
You stared at her in sheer shock. At that, she shoots you a smirk.)</>

Name: Nova
Text: It beats dealing with corpses. Right, [player]?

Name: Nova
Text:
*sigh* This is why the ones who actually do things properly end up getting screwed over.
They die first and don't even get to reap the benefits.

Name: Nova
Text:
<Yellow>Working diligently and following orders faithfully.
Yet all that waits for them is death.</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(As expected, Nova isn't the type to just let things slide.
Let's get out of here before the mood gets any worse.)</>

Name: Nova
Text:
I'm going to make a few more basic medicines based on the existing recipes.
The effects will probably be similar.

Name: Nova
Text: Why does that even matter? Libi is already dead and gone anyway.

Name: Nova
Text:
I didn't have any grand reason for helping out.
I just did it because it's exactly what Libi would have done.

Name: Nova
Text:
...Knowing her, do you think she would have just stood by and watched?
She would have offered to help, saying she needed the medicine too.

Name: Nova
Text: ...I guess that's why she said she wanted to be <Yellow>a sword that could protect someone</>.

Name: Nova
Text:
That's that... but I don't want to stay here a second longer,
so hurry up and make the medicine.

Name: Nova
Text: Looks like it turned out well.

Name: Nova
Text: I don't have it in me to look at that shameless face again, so you deliver it.

Name: Helena
Text:
Thank you for your hard work.
I will put this medicine to very good use.

Name: Helena
Text:
No... she's right.
It's late, but I'm just playing the hypocrite now.

Name: Helena
Text:
The dead will never return,
but I can at least seek forgiveness from the living.

Name: Helena
Text:
...I've been rambling.
Anyway, thank you for not forgetting about me and visiting.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Nova is standing in front of Libi's resting place.
In the silence, her final moments keeps replaying in your mind.)</>

Name: Nova
Text:
...So you were here all along, Libi.
I was really late, wasn't I?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>You tell her you have one more thing to give her and carefully hand over Libi's Journal.)</>

Name: Nova
Text: This is Libi's...
ItemDesc:
Something she held onto for the future.
It seems it's finally found its rightful owner.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A profound melancholiness washed over Nova's face as she opened the Journal.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It couldn’t be helped.
The journal detailed everything she had been through.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(And under the name of the Sverd Mercenaries,
you felt the exact same way.)</>

Name: Nova
Text: …Thank you, [player].

Name: Nova
Text:
Well.
It is a bit disappointing that my target for revenge is gone.

Name: Nova
Text: Not that I have any intention of seeing Xeros ever again, either.

Name: Nova
Text:
I only found out about Libi's death because I met him.
I told you I knew it was Xeros's doing.

Name: Nova
Text: And traveling with you confirmed that he wasn't lying.

Name: Nova
Text:
Whatever happened between the two of you,
I don't want to be any part of it.

Name: Nova
Text:
So don't ask where or how I met him.
We'll cross paths again when the time is right.

Name: Nova
Text: That's all I can say.

Name: Nova
Text:
And if I were to add one more thing,
<Yellow>I will... continue to hunt down the Paradise Advent Society.</>

Name: Nova
Text: If we share the same goal, I suppose we'll run into Xeros again someday.

Name: Nova
Text: ...Things seemed pretty chaotic over there, too.

Name: Nova
Text: Then let's hope we meet again by chance, [player].
After bidding Nova farewell, you travel to Babylon and head to the Polaris Clan Hideout.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
You've returned.
Was the Mage of the Snowfield really a Sverd Mercenary?

Name: Ragnar
Text: That's a massive relief.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
When you first came here,
it always weighed on me that I couldn't be of help.

Name: Ragnar
Text: If you want to thank me, how about joining our Clan?

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Haha, just a joke.
Though I wouldn't mind if you took it seriously.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Anyway, [player], you did well traveling all that way.

A strange noise is coming from the communicator.
...It can’t be broken, is it?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(...Did Rada always talk like this?
You want to ignore it, but you should probably go check just in case.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(If it really is Rada, maybe she ate something bad...)</>

Name: Noisy Object
Text:
<Yellow>What are you looking at?
Are you awestruck by this pinnacle of great ancient technology?</>

Name: Noisy Object
Text: Stop staring at me with that dumb look on your face and help me while I'm asking nicely.

Name: Noisy Object
Text:
Suffering from a lack of sleep? If so, the Professor has just the thing...
Ah, wait. No, that's not right!

Name: Noisy Object
Text:
<Yellow>I'm saying, since I called you over, do me a favor!</>
If you walk away now, you'll forever...

Name: Noisy Object
Text:
...Hey, aren't you curious about what comes next?
I'll tell you if you come back, so seriously, help me out here, human!

Name: Weifel
Text:
I am <Orange>Weifel!</>
A fragment of knowledge forged by the Empire itself.

Name: Weifel
Text:
You were chosen for one reason!
My lowly servant, the Professor, has fallen ill.

Name: Weifel
Text: So I need you to go gather some ingredients to brew up some medicine.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Hmm... Monster blood, a few bones, and some herbs ought to do the trick!
My formula is absolutely flawless, of course.

Name: Weifel
Text: Did you really think I'd make you do it for free? Do you doubt me?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(If this conversation goes on, you might lose your patience...
Let's just go hunting for a change of pace.)</>

Name: Weifel
Text:
Wow, you're really fast!
It's been a long time since I've seen a human so skilled!

Name: Weifel
Text:
Huh? Where do you think you're going?
We still have to brew the medicine together.

Name: Weifel
Text:
You humans are supposed to have sympathy, right?
Can't you help me out a little?
ItemDesc:
It’s a forsaken land with no one left to trust...
But to you, who still offered a helping hand, I shall impart the knowledge of a special recovery medicine.

<Ingredients>
Monster Blood, Herbs
* Monster blood provides an immediate burst of vitality. The stronger the monster, the better.
* Herbs neutralize the deadly toxins found in monster blood.

The optimal mixing ratio varies case by case.
But fret not. Weifel will teach you everything you need to know.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(...I guess I have no choice.
You nod to show you’ll help.)</>

Name: Weifel
Text:
Excellent!
Now, for the ratio... It's 8.3 parts blood to 1.7 parts herbs.

Name: Weifel
Text: I'm counting on you, human!
I fed the medicine to the man Weifel pointed out, and the near-corpse managed to stand up.

Name: Near-Dead Man
Text: ...How did I end up here?

Name: Near-Dead Man
Text: Weifel, please explain what is going on here.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Isn't it obvious?
You collapsed, Professor, so I sent out a distress signal.

Name: Weifel
Text: And as you can see, the result is the human standing right in front of you!

Name: Zisen
Text:
...Please forgive my manners, adventurer.
I-I am... <Orange>Zisen</>.

Name: Zisen
Text:
...Allow me to thank you on Weifel's behalf.
Thanks to you, I'm... still breathing. Phew...

Name: Zisen
Text:
Er... I don't believe we have much left to discuss,
so perhaps you should... be on your way?

Name: Zisen
Text: W-Well...

Name: Weifel
Text:
Excellent question, human!
I shall honor you with a truly magnificent answer.

Name: Weifel
Text: The device you humans call a "communicator" was created by the so-called founder of magitech engineering—

Name: Zisen
Text: Weifel is one of the ancient relics.

Name: Zisen
Text:
If your communicator is a tool for communication,
then Weifel possesses the ability to interfere with it.

Name: Zisen
Text: ...Well, simply put, that is.

Name: Weifel
Text: <Yellow>I merely mimicked a recorded voice!</>

Name: Weifel
Text:
Why wouldn't I have?!
A little bit of divinity is enough to entice anyone, you know.

Name: Zisen
Text:
I-I sincerely apologize.
Could you please be on your way now?

Name: Zisen
Text: You look like quite a busy person, and keeping you here any longer would be...

Name: Weifel
Text: You're going to regret letting them go, Professor.

Name: Weifel
Text: I have a strong feeling this human is very close to being a <Orange>"Chosen One."</>

Name: Zisen
Text: ...A "Chosen One?”

You walk away from their incomprehensible babble,
but Zisen grabs your arm with a desperate look on his face.

Name: Zisen
Text:
I-I know this might be asking too much, but...
Please don’t leave. I need you.

Name: Zisen
Text:
I-I am a <Orange>Liberator of Knowledge</>.
The Second Liberator, to be precise.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(A Liberator of Knowledge...
It reminds you of Hekima, who you met alongside Xeros.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Since he helped you climb the tower, you suppose you should hear him out.)</>

Name: Zisen
Text: As you can see, my body is not in good condition, so I struggle with a lot more than the other Liberators.

Name: Zisen
Text:
Even with Weifel's assistance,
the harsh reality is that there are simply too many problems the two of us can't solve alone.

Name: Zisen
Text:
...So, would I dare be able to ask for your help?
It's n-nothing too difficult, I promise.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Ugh, this is going to take all day.
Hey, "Chosen” candidate. Go to the Ethereal Sanctum for us.

Name: Weifel
Text: That’s the place we marked out.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Go and fetch us a "Record Disc."
No guarantee you’ll be allowed inside, though.
ItemDesc:
A relic found throughout the Forsaken Land.
It contains various records concerning the Ancients.

Name: Zisen
Text:
You've returned!
I had my hopes up the moment you were granted entry, but...

Name: Zisen
Text: Did you manage to find the Record Disc?

Name: Zisen
Text:
Hah... To think I'd live to see a day like this.
All those arduous years I spent waiting...
ItemDesc:
The Record Disc I retrieved at Zisen's request.
On the surface, you don't see anything particularly special about it.

Name: Zisen
Text: P-Please, I'd appreciate it if you could describe what it looked like inside.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You recount your experience inside the Ethereal Sanctum.)</>

Name: Zisen
Text: <Yellow>From the scope of permitted entrants down to the experimental aspects known as trials...!</>

Name: Zisen
Text: <Yellow>Ah, it's all so incredibly beautiful and perfect!</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Just as you wonder what Zisen's so excited about, Weifel cuts in.)</>

Name: Weifel
Text: It's basically the first time a specimen suitable for his field of research has ever turned up.

Name: Weifel
Text: Ugh, what if he collapses again like that?

Name: Weifel
Text: So with that in mind, head to the Giant's Garden and fetch me some wasp stingers.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Woodland of Elder Gods
The ones there are highly venomous, so they work like a charm.

Name: Weifel
Text: Thanks, "Chosen" candidate!

Name: Weifel
Text: I'll take care of the Professor!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Is this Liberator named Jisen really all right?)</>

Name: Weifel
Text:
He'll be fine, just fine!
The Professor will snap out of it in no time.

Name: Weifel
Text:
...On second thought, maybe not. He might actually die at this rate.
This is actually a huge problem, isn't it?

Name: Weifel
Text:
..."Chosen" candidate.
It looks like the Professor's going to be out cold for a while.

Name: Weifel
Text: I need you to do me another favor in the meantime.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Go back to the Ethereal Sanctum once more.
This time, hmm... The one over by the Rappie Training Ground should do!

Name: Weifel
Text:
You'll find another Record Disc inside.
Don’t forget to bring it to us, "Chosen" candidate!

Name: Zisen
Text:
...I've been waiting for you!
Ah, please f-forget my disgraceful display from earlier.

Name: Zisen
Text: I am c-completely calm now.

Name: Zisen
