Text: I must know what kind of trial you faced this time.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain your journey in the Ethereal Sanctum and hand him the Record Disc.)</>

Name: Zisen
Text: How very romantic.

Name: Zisen
Text:
Come to think of it, humans have always sought to climb higher.
...As if they’re so sure they’d never fall.

Name: Zisen
Text:
I imagine the giants who built the tower harbored a similar desire.
The same goes for the Gliders...

Name: Zisen
Text: Doesn't it make you wonder what the world looked like through the eyes of the ancients?

Name: Zisen
Text: Hmm... Since you're a "Chosen" candidate, maybe you'd find it all quite trivial.

Name: Zisen
Text: Ah, it's just a term we Liberators use. There's no need to pay it any mind.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Judging by his expression, he has no intention of telling you.)</>

Name: Zisen
Text:
At any rate, we've secured more than enough data on the Ethereal Sanctum,
so allow me to share a fraction of this knowledge with you.

Name: Zisen
Text: Analyzing the Record Disc will take some time. In the meantime, I have a few more favors to ask—

Name: Weifel
Text:
I suppose it's time for me to step in!
Hey, "Chosen" candidate! Get to work for me.

Name: Zisen
Text:
*sigh...* How many times must I tell you not to do that, Weifel?
That’s no way to ask for a favor.

Name: Zisen
Text:
When requesting something of someone,
you must ask politely and with sincerity!

Name: Weifel
Text: Thought we could communicate, so I let it slide, but your attitude is lacking, Professor.

Name: Weifel
Text: We will need to have a serious discussion later.

Name: Weifel
Text: And you, “Chosen candidate,” go make yourself useful.

Name: Zisen
Text: Phew, allow me to explain.

Name: Zisen
Text: Weifel is an ancient artifact, so it requires regular maintenance.

Name: Zisen
Text: If I left it to the Appraisers’ Guild, it would obviously be dismantled, so I handle the repairs myself.

Name: Zisen
Text:
Well... the materials are actually quite difficult to procure.
You will need to search around the ancient ruins.

Name: Zisen
Text: F-For a nearby location... the Adamant Ascent would be best.

Name: Zisen
Text: Because <Blue>“Aether”</> is the most stable energy composing this world.

Name: Zisen
Text:
Just a moment.
Th-This is an <Blue>Aether Collector</>.
ItemDesc: An ancient object received from Zisen, used for extracting Aether.

Name: Zisen
Text:
It can extract Aether from recently deceased living beings.
B-But it does not work on humans.

Name: Zisen
Text:
There is an abundance of Ae-Aetherium around the ancient ruins, so...
It is easy for monsters to absorb Aether there.

Name: Zisen
Text: S-So it is an efficient place to collect Aether.

Name: Weifel
Text:
And pick up anything that could serve as spare parts.
Even loose stones will do.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Faintly in the distance, you see a stone statue like the one at the tower.
Clear out the surrounding monsters and investigate it thoroughly.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Head to the ruins over there. They look significantly larger.)</>

Name: Zisen
Text:
Oh... thank you.
At this point, I am beginning to hope you truly are the “Chosen One.”

Name: Zisen
Text:
<Red>Usually, they were so obsessed with “something” that it was quite dreadful.</>
Well, that is beside the point.

Name: Zisen
Text: Let's inspect Weifel first, and then we can talk.

Name: Zisen
Text: It will remain quiet while the Aether is charging.

Name: Zisen
Text: The record disk you found contains information regarding the creators of the Ethereal Sanctum.

Name: Zisen
Text: Have you ever heard the name <Orange>“Maharugalian?”</>

Name: Zisen
Text: The Maharugalians are known to have been the ruling class of the ancient empire.

Name: Zisen
Text:
They were said to be a noble family that served the imperial family at close quarters.
They were active in a wide variety of fields.

Name: Zisen
Text:
Among them, I...
I admire <Orange>“Zaigarka,”</> the father of Magitech.

Name: Zisen
Text:
To share their brilliant talents with the world,
they created <Blue>Magitech</>.

Name: Zisen
Text: <Yellow>...That is also why I became a Liberator of Knowledge.</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You ask if the Zaigarka family created the Ethereal Sanctum,
and Zisen shakes his head.)</>

Name: Zisen
Text: ...”Chosen” candidate…

Name: Zisen
Text: Didn't you recognize and retrieve the Record Disc from the Ethereal Sanctum?

Name: Zisen
Text:
Most cannot even pass the trials of the Ethereal Sanctum.
And then there is the Record Disc.

Name: Zisen
Text:
Without even asking what it was,
you instinctively tracked it down.

Name: Zisen
Text:
No, the appearance of the Record Disc is left entirely to chance.
Yet you managed to retrieve it twice.

Name: Zisen
Text: That alone makes you an excellent candidate—the Chosen One.

Name: Zisen
Text: It is a bit late, but may I ask your name?

Name: Zisen
Text:
[player]... I will remember that.
If Weifel ever interferes, please know that it's me.

Name: Weifel
Text:
It's been a while, Chosen candidate!
Aren't you glad I called?

Name: Weifel
Text: As you can see, the Professor is in this state again.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Plus, the Liberators are scattered doing their own thing.
So you came to mind.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Are you really going to be that cold?
I wouldn't have reached out if it wasn't urgent!

Name: Weifel
Text:
The Narurus here can only gather herbs.
They mumbled something about not having enough <Orange>Angry Tails</>.

Name: Weifel
Text:
So, Chosen candidate, help us out a little.
We're on good terms, aren't we?!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You can't just walk away after seeing that. Say you’ll help.)</>

Name: Weifel
Text: I knew… I could depend on you, Chosen candidate!

Name: Weifel
Text:
As you know, we need monster blood as an ingredient.
Head towards the hill.

Name: Sullen Naruru
Text:
Wh-what! A human!
If you move, I-I'll attack!

Name: Sullen Naruru
Text:
H-Herbs? That st-stone chunk can’t be an acquaintance of yours… is it?!
<Red>You're wicked. A very wicked human!</>
You calm the Naruru down and explain the situation.

Name: Sullen Naruru
Text:
That was very disgraceful, disgraceful.
Talking about ancients this and that... has nothing to do with me.

Name: Sullen Naruru
Text:
I even gathered herbs, feeling sorry for the sick human,
and then they just abandoned me here!

Name: Sullen Naruru
Text:
...You are a good, good human!
I must absolutely get re-revenge on that mean stone chunk.

Name: Sullen Naruru
Text:
I'll do it even if you try to stop me, so don't get in my way!
If you stop me, then we're e-enemies, enemies!

Name: Appeased Naruru
Text: Thank you, good human!

Name: Appeased Naruru
Text:
Here, take this!
I sneaked it out without Sarabi knowing!
ItemDesc:
You received it from the Naruru.
But I feel like I'll be in big trouble if Sarabi finds out...

Name: Appeased Naruru
Text:
It doesn't matter as long as I don't get caught!
Now, pretend you're empty-handed and go, go!

Name: Weifel
Text:
Did you almost die on the way here or something?
You're late, Chosen candidate!

Name: Weifel
Text:
...Fair enough.
Well, it's not like the Professor is going to drop dead this second.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Then shall we brew the medicine?
The ratio is 8.7 parts blood to 1.3 parts herbs.

When I administered the medicine, Zisen gasped and opened his eyes,
and apologized profusely for having to rely on you once again.

Name: Zisen
Text:
I-I'm s-sorry... I truly apologize.
I ran out of my regular medicine...

Name: Weifel
Text:
I'll say.
It's the Professor's fault for wandering around when he knew it was too much!

Name: Zisen
Text:
I'll have to be more c-careful from now on.
W-Weifel... you should apologize too!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Are they on good terms or bad terms...?)</>

Name: Zisen
Text: A-Actually, I was going to contact you soon, so this worked out perfectly.

Name: Zisen
Text: Since we've met again, I would like to ask for your help.

Name: Zisen
Text:
It's not a particularly difficult request.
But it will certainly pique your interest.

Name: Zisen
Text: For there is no one in the Forsaken Land who does not seek power.

Name: Zisen
Text:
Hmm... let's approach this more fundamentally.
I don't mean trivial matters like physical strength or politics.

Name: Zisen
Text: I'm talking about exploring the very essence that shapes our world.

Name: Weifel
Text:
...Why are you lecturing like we're in a classroom?
They clearly didn't get a word of that, Professor!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You tried to look like you understood, but he saw right through you.)</>

Name: Weifel
Text: Let me summarize it for you, Chosen candidate!

Name: Weifel
Text:
<Yellow>The fundamental energy driving all creation is Aether.
When it solidifies, it becomes Aetherium.</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(People who consumed Aetherium Candy felt that they became stronger.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Side effects aside, they definitely felt a surge of power.)</>

Name: Weifel
Text:
Though you shouldn't consume it recklessly, of course.
It’s not meant to be edible in the first place.

Name: Zisen
Text: Th-That’s why I need you to investigate the <Red>Ironblood Brigade</>.

Name: Zisen
Text: Weifel will explain the details while accompanying you.

Name: Zisen
Text: And I'll chime in if things get off track.

Name: Zisen
Text: ...I didn't mean I would go in person. I meant I will speak through Weifel.

Name: Zisen
Text: Weifel is a highly advanced artifact capable of multi-channel transmission.

Name: Zisen
Text:
Then, let's head to the War Drum Ridge.
You can start your search there.

Name: Ironblood Brigade
Text: Do we really have to go as far as this?

Name: Ironblood Brigade
Text:
The noble lords have grown bored of it.
It's time to bring them something fresh.

Name: Ironblood Brigade
Text: They should just pay us more instead.

Name: Weifel
Text: What do you think? It's suspicious, isn't it?

Name: Weifel
Text:
Let's pick up the pace a bit.
We need to figure out what they're plotting, and fast.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Security seems tighter than before.)</>

A Kiguru, a Naruru, and a human are depicted here.
There is some hastily scribbled text.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You show the report to Weifel.)</>

Name: Weifel
Text:
Oh, great. This is plenty.
The Professor will be satisfied too.
ItemDesc:
A report detailing the Ironblood Brigade's experiments.
It is filled with technical jargon.

Name: Weifel
Text: Then let's return to the Rappie Training Ground.

Name: Zisen
Text:
I knew you'd return safely.
Now, let's take a look, shall we?

Zisen furrowed his brow as he checked the report and let out a heavy sigh.
Then he began to sketch something.

Name: Zisen
Text: Hah, they're working on something far more intriguing than I anticipated.

Name: Zisen
Text:
Hmm... where should I even begin?
Perhaps with this?

Name: Weifel
Text: Gah... I want to explain it, but I'll let you handle this one, Professor!

Name: Zisen
Text: It's said that the Ancient Empire enjoyed various forms of entertainment.

Name: Zisen
Text:
The most popular among them was the arena.
It was managed by the <Orange>“Angvargidea”</> household.

Name: Zisen
Text:
They would toss humans and monsters into a pit together,
and bet on who would survive.

Name: Zisen
Text: I heard a fighting pit imitating this has become openly popular in Frantia...

Name: Zisen
Text: It seems they've been abducting people from around here for it.

Name: Zisen
Text:
In the Forsaken Land, people go missing all the time.
Still, it is certainly fascinating.

Name: Zisen
Text: <Yellow>...To think they'd attempt to fuse a human with a Kiguru.</>

Name: Zisen
Text:
<Yellow>Based on the report, the Ironblood Brigade's ultimate goal is...
…to transplant human heads onto the Kiguru Tribe.</>
ItemDesc: A sketch drafted to simplify the explanation of the Ironblood Brigade's experiments.

Name: Zisen
Text: That way, they could constantly swap out bodies or heads and throw them right back into the arena.

Name: Zisen
Text:
But that is only a hypothesis.
...We need more concrete evidence.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Don't get any funny ideas, Chosen candidate!
There are some things that even divine power cannot solve.

Name: Zisen
Text:
Y-You're not wrong...
I-It might be connected to something m-much bigger.

Name: Zisen
Text:
L-Like... the royal household.
Anyway, that's how it is.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(As you fall silent in shock, Zisen studies your expression and continues talking.)</>

Name: Zisen
Text:
Th-That's why we need your help.
Wh-What will you do?

Name: Zisen
Text:
If you would just help us, the L-Liberators will also do our best.
B-Because this isn't p-proper knowledge.

Name: Zisen
Text: First, it would be best if you headed to the... Hallowed Obsidian Mountain.

Name: Zisen
Text: If they're drafting reports like this, there m-must be some movement among the Kiguru Tribe as well.

Name: Zisen
Text: Even though they're demi-humans with lower intelligence than the Naruru, they possess incredible physical strength.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Humans are so weird.
If they're going to run experiments anyway, why not just use the Naruru?

Name: Zisen
Text: <Red>N-No! That is absolutely out of the question!</>

Name: Weifel
Text:
Wh-Why not?! They're just the same idiots anyway!
They're dumber than me, and I'm an artifact of antiquity!

Name: Zisen
Text:
N... A soft and cute furball like a Naruru…
…offers a certain... aesthetic appeal!

Name: Zisen
Text: They make you realize just how adorable they are... it's absolutely not the same!

Name: Zisen
Text:
...Is there anyone who dislikes the Naruru?
M-Maybe Weifel does, but not me.

Flustered, Zisen inspected Weifel from top to bottom,
and suddenly began explaining how to operate it.

Name: Zisen
Text:
It is n-not difficult at all.
Go to the location that needs saving and p-pet Weifel.

Name: Zisen
Text:
Weifel will take care of the rest.
He's more delicate than it looks.

Name: Zisen
Text: I-I've put Weifel in sleep mode for a moment, so you should be able to hear m-my voice.

Name: Zisen
Text:
T, Take him with you to the Hallowed Obsidian Mountain.
You absolutely m-must not break him.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Just what is the Ironblood Brigade trying to pull off with the Kiguru Tribe?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is the experiment Zisen mentioned really happening?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You use the communicator to relay the situation at the hills to Zisen.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Nothing seems out of the ordinary.
Let's get a little closer.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You use the communicator to inform Zisen of the state of the residential area.)</>

Name: Zisen's Voice
Text: It seems the I-Ironblood Brigade has infiltrated quite deeply.

Name: Zisen's Voice
Text: I'm afraid the chieftain might start a war over this.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(There are no signs of anything suspicious.
Still, it's best to be careful.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You use the communicator to inform Zisen of the state of the sanctuary.)</>

Name: Zisen's Voice
Text: Hmm... The situation seems far more serious than I thought.

Name: Zisen's Voice
Text: I keep imagining the worst-case scenarios. Th-This is a huge problem.

Name: Zisen
Text:
Phew, my hands are all sweaty.
I didn't know waiting around would be this nerve-wracking...

Zisen began tweaking Weifel with quick hand movements.
Before long, you hear Weifel's voice.

Name: Weifel
Text:
I thought I was going to die of suffocation in there!
I'm only letting you off the hook this once, Professor!

Name: Weifel
Text:
Now, listen closely as I reveal the results of our investigation!
Listen closely, Professor, and you too, Chosen candidate!

Name: Weifel
Text: <Yellow>It appears the Ironblood Brigade has been making regular visits to the Kiguru Tribe's habitat.</>

Name: Weifel
Text: <Yellow>It seems the Kiguru Tribe was holding a ritual for their missing kin.</>

Name: Weifel
Text: How's that! A neat and tidy conclusion based purely on facts!

Name: Zisen
Text:
It's n-not great that my hypothesis turned out to be correct.
To be doing th... this kind of thing just for some arena.

Name: Zisen
Text: Experiments like this are bound to f... fail in the end.

Name: Zisen
Text:
A <Blue>Homunculus</> could only be created back in the Empire,
a place like F-Frantia could never pull it off.

Name: Zisen
Text:
I'll explain later...
Right now, I think we need to track down the other Liberators first.

Name: Zisen
Text: I'll be in touch.

Name: Hekima
Text: I’ve been expecting you.

Name: Hekima
Text:
I would like you to pay the price for the <Blue>Phase Converter</>.
You do have the information for payment, correct?

Name: Hekima
Text: Information on any entity or bizarre anomaly. Anything will do.

Name: Hekima
Text: I anticipated you would make your way here.

Name: Hekima
Text: <Orange>“Chosen Ones”</> like you tend to follow certain predictable patterns.

Name: Hekima
Text:
For example... being unable to ignore trivial curiosities.
Or making choices that yield neither honor nor power.

Name: Hekima
Text:
I mean that I came here having predicted all of this.
Now, why don't you tell me?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You tell them about the hidden floor and the authority.)</>

Name: Hekima
Text:
It seems no new variables were derived from this.
I had high expectations for you...

Name: Hekima
Text:
That is quite alright.
You've only visited the lower floors, after all.

Name: Hekima
Text: <Yellow>Moving forward, we must cultivate this relationship much more actively.</>

Name: Hekima
Text:
I harbor no ulterior motives.
Everything I do... is to fulfill the will of the Liberators.

Name: Hekima
Text: We are a collective that seeks out the traces of the <Blue>“Ancient Empire.”</>

Name: Hekima
Text:
<Yellow>Our mission is to unearth the knowledge buried in the abyss alongside the Empire's fall,
and bring it to light for the current generation.</>

Name: Hekima
Text:
To achieve this end, we are willing to cooperate with anyone...
Maintaining an open-minded approach is our rule.

Name: Hekima
Text: Yes, you could say that.

Name: Hekima
Text:
You must be familiar with the Tower's “Access Authority.”
Specifically, those who hold authority over the deeper floors are known as “Chosen Ones.”

Name: Hekima
Text: Even among them, you are exceptionally unique in many regards, adventurer.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Follow me.
I will help you understand.
You accompany Hekima to the location of the Monolith.

Name: Hekima
Text: Modern humanity refers to this as a <Blue>Monolith</>.

Name: Hekima
Text: In ancient times, it was called a <Blue>“Monolith,”</> and it served as a tool for environmental modification.

Name: Hekima
Text: Would you care to give it a try?
The decisive battle with Xeros flashes through my mind...

Name: Hekima
Text: Which timeline did you just witness?

Name: Hekima
Text: ...I see.

Name: Hekima
Text: <Yellow>Most Chosen Ones report experiencing the “Emperor's” memories like a fleeting illusion.</>

Name: Hekima
Text:
I fully expected the same for you, but...
It seems a new hypothesis is required to account for this variable.

Name: Hekima
Text: Have you, by any chance, experienced anything unusual in this area recently?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You give a brief account of the confrontation with Xeros.)</>

Name: Hekima
Text: It appears the aftermath of that incident still lingers.

Name: Hekima
Text: Could you provide me with the exact location?

Name: Hekima
Text: Since this is the first case of its kind, adventurer, a thorough analysis is necessary.

Name: Hekima
Text: After that, I'll share a rather fascinating story with you.

Name: Hekima
Text:
About you, as a Chosen One.
And your connection to the Empire.

Name: Stormkel Legation Assigned Soldier
Text: In accordance with the treaty issued by the Archons of each nation and the Divines of Babylon, civilians are—

Name: Hekima
Text:
Excuse me for a moment. We need to conduct a field investigation.
It shouldn't take long.

Name: Hekima
Text: Please put us down as the <Orange>“Liberators of Knowledge”</> on the entry ledger.

Name: Stormkel Legation Assigned Soldier
Text: Liberators of Knowledge... Are you affiliated with them?

Name: Stormkel Legation Assigned Soldier
Text:
Please wait a moment.
I'll check to see if you're on the exception list.

Name: Stormkel Legation Assigned Soldier
Text: Entry permit confirmed.

Name: Stormkel Legation Assigned Soldier
Text: However, being a non-profit organization doesn't grant you immunity.

Name: Stormkel Legation Assigned Soldier
Text: Don't cause any trouble, and keep your visit quiet.

Name: Hekima
Text:
<Yellow>We can access most “official” restricted zones…
…without any sanctions whatsoever.</>

Name: Hekima
Text: We've long since brokered deals with those in power.

Name: Hekima
Text:
In exchange for immediately sharing any information…
…that could determine the fate of this world, Elsetia.

Name: Hekima
Text:
As a result, situations like the one just now are quite commonplace for us.
It's easy for people to mistakenly believe we're enjoying special privileges.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Don't let it bother you.
I'm eager to examine these remnants right in front of us immediately.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Since you left them behind, you should be able to recover them perfectly.
Please secure as much as possible.

Name: Hekima
Text: Since we've cleared out most of it, the impact on the Monolith should have decreased slightly.

Name: Hekima
Text: But... you said the battle took place at the Paradise Advent Society's base.

Name: Hekima
Text: There must be even more remnants left inside.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Please clear them out just like you did just now.
I'll wait here.

Name: Hekima
Text: Ah—wait a moment.

Name: Hekima
Text:
The chances of followers still guarding the area...
...are expected to be quite high.

Name: Hekima
Text: If they get in the way, it'd be best to eliminate them.

Name: Hekima
Text: Fights between “Chosen Ones” like yourself sometimes leave traces.

Name: Hekima
Text:
That is because the bloodline passed down from the ancient empire...
...is faintly mixed within you.

Name: Hekima
Text:
According to the Liberators' information,
the ancients placed great importance on something called the <Blue>“Gudua Factor.”</>

Name: Hekima
Text:
They judged people by their ability to harness this factor,
and divided their social classes based on it.

Name: Hekima
Text:
There are records of magic that could move buildings or people with a single gesture,
or even evaporate lakes.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Since Chosen Ones wield comparable power,
it's only natural that they send ripples in their surroundings.

Name: Hekima
Text: However, our current focus is the unusual reaction of the Monolith you encountered just a moment ago.

Name: Hekima
Text:
<Yellow>It is an object crafted using the power of the Ancients.
It must contain energy rooted in the Gudua Factor.</>

Name: Hekima
Text:
Modern humanity is not born with the power to control it.
That includes the Chosen Ones who came before you.

Name: Hekima
Text: But you... managed to bring forth your own memories.

Name: Hekima
Text:
One could say you exerted a greater influence than the Monolith's creator.
Even if it was only a temporary phenomenon.

Name: Hekima
Text: Now, we need to see how the Monolith operates.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Since we've been continuously recovering your remnants,
we might see a different outcome.

Name: Hekima
Text: Let's head back the way we came.

Name: Hekima
Text: We should be seen leaving to avoid raising unnecessary suspicion.

Name: Stormkel Legation Assigned Soldier
Text: Are you finished with your business?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You shrug as if nothing happened.)</>

Name: Stormkel Legation Assigned Soldier
Text:
We let you in for now because of your <Yellow>”special status,”</>
But we need to check what you've been up to.

Name: Stormkel Legation Assigned Soldier
Text: If anything suspicious is reported, you'll have to submit to an investigation.
The soldiers stared suspiciously even after returning from checking beyond the bridge.

Name: Stormkel Legation Assigned Soldier
Text: ...I was told they were a bunch of weirdos.

Name: Stormkel Legation Assigned Soldier
Text:
Anyway, the inside was clean.
You may leave now.

Name: Hekima
Text: As I mentioned, the Monolith was designed to reconstruct the environment.

Name: Hekima
Text: But its creator vanished along with the ancient empire.

Name: Hekima
Text: So, only the function that responds to those authorized to issue commands remains.

Name: Hekima
Text:
The fact that it shows certain memories to the Chosen Ones…
…is a phenomenon where it reacts to their bloodline.

Name: Hekima
Text: Does that make sense to you?

Name: Hekima
Text: <Yellow>If my prediction is correct, it will show the memories of the “Emperor.”</>

Name: Hekima
Text: Because you cleared out most of the traces left from your battle with Xeros.

Name: Hekima
Text: Please make contact with the divine stone... wait, I mean the Monolith again.

Name: Hekima
Text:
Are you awake?
It was only for a split second, but you lost consciousness.

Name: Hekima
Text: It seems you were affected by the Monolith... Did you see something?

Name: Hekima
Text:
Just a moment.
Speak slowly, and I will record it.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You try your best to explain what flashed through your mind.)</>

Name: Hekima
Text: ...Hmm.

Name: Hekima
Text:
I jotted it down focusing on the fragmented details.
Please review it.
ItemName: Monolith #2 Contact Reaction: Chosen One No. NNN
ItemDesc:
- Stimulates the subject with a blue flash, causing mental interference.
- Presumed to stem from a collision between Aether and the Gudua Factor.
- The subject experiences a dream-like illusion triggered by the Monolith.
- A summary based on the testimony of No. NNN is as follows:

A figure appearing to be an emperor or a king issues a command to someone named “Amartu” in an audience chamber.
Amartu was kneeling at a distance, with their head bowed.

The command was as follows: “Cross over to the satellite and construct the tower immediately.”

The atmosphere was intensely oppressive, and they were too overwhelmed by the absolute power gap, incapable of taking any action.
The Chosen One described the sensation as feeling crushed by inherent anxiety or learned helplessness.

Name: Hekima
Text:
This is truly groundbreaking.
To think the Monolith holds such memories...

Name: Hekima
Text:
Those who frequent an audience chamber are typically close aides to those in power.
To receive a command directly, one must be at least a noble.

Name: Hekima
Text: But the name <Orange>“Amartu”</> doesn't appear anywhere in Elsetian history.

Name: Hekima
Text:
If the person you synchronized with…
…is neither a royal nor a noble known to us...

Name: Hekima
Text:
<Yellow>"There is another race of humanity that refers to this place as a satellite."</>
We cannot rule out that possibility.

Name: Hekima
Text:
While I discuss this with the other Liberators,
would you care to visit the Appraisers Guild?

Name: Hekima
Text: You might hear a different perspective on the Monolith.

Name: Babylon Guard
Text: Do you need something from me?

Name: Babylon Guard
Text: Oh... Are you looking for someone specific in the guild?

Name: Babylon Guard
Text:
Like the one infamous for having a terrible personality?
Or the one who fires off insults indiscriminately?

Name: Babylon Guard
Text: Or maybe that Guild Master who constantly roams around because she can't control her own temper!

Name: Babylon Guard
Text:
Ahem, ahem!
Please keep my description of her a secret.

Name: Babylon Guard
Text: Anyway, if you're heading to the Appraisers Guild... Hrmph...

Name: Babylon Guard
Text:
Brace yourself!
You're about to get an earful of all the bitter criticism you'd ever hear in a lifetime, adventurer.

Name: Babylon Guard
Text:
Head southwest.
Take a turn off the central boulevard.

Name: Babylon Guard
Text: <Yellow>Be extremely careful around the sharp-tongued Guild Master!</>

Name: Adelaide
Text: Welcome to the <Orange>Appraisers Guild</>.

Name: Adelaide
Text:
I am the Deputy Guild Master, <Orange>“Adelaide.”</>
Feel free to call me Adel.

Name: Adel
Text: Sharp-tongued? Are you talking about me?

Name: Adel
Text: Oh my—I've never earned a nickname like that.

Name: Adel
Text:
You must have heard rumors about our Guild Master.
She certainly is quite a character.

Name: Adel
Text:
Try bringing up your business when she isn't looking directly at you.
You might get treated much worse than the rumors suggest! Hehe.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain that Hekima sent you.)</>

Name: Adel
Text: It's been a while since a Liberator sent us a guest.

Name: Adel
Text:
You're here because you're curious about ancient relics, right?
Hekima probably referred to them as objects.

Name: Adel
Text: On our end, we consider them relics condensed with “Aether.”

Name: Adel
Text:
Your guess is spot on.
It's the exact same Aether used to power the transmission towers!

Name: Adel
Text:
Some Monoliths even had the function of transporting their users.
Of course, the effect wasn't permanent.

Name: Adel
Text: But whenever new power was supplied, they would regain their functionality.

Name: Adel
Text: Provided it was Aether, or a similarly high-grade energy, of course.

Name: Adel
Text:
The Liberators of Knowledge called that the <Blue>”Gudua Factor.”</>
Quite bizarre, isn't it?

Name: Adel
Text:
Seeing your curiosity makes me want to let you experience it firsthand.
Would you like to try activating that device?

Name: Adel
Text:
This is a relic we picked up near the Giant's Tower.
Looks like a miniature Monolith, doesn't it?

Name: Adel
Text:
It seemed to be an ancient relic, so Hekima and I inspected it together...
And they modified it like this.

Name: Adel
Text: <Yellow>The Liberators’ main focus is peering into “memories” through the Monolith, right?</>

Name: Adel
Text:
Since we interpret the exact same relic differently...
Collaboration is always a joy.

Name: Adel
Text:
That look of understanding... It makes me feel proud.
Shall we take a breather and talk about something else?

Name: Adel
Text: The Liberators of Knowledge don't harbor any political ambitions.

Name: Adel
Text:
But since you've investigated the Monolith
you must have sensed their subtle obsession.

Name: Adel
Text:
Even so, they've never tried to monopolize them.
I've observed them for a long time, so I can vouch for that.

Name: Adel
Text:
They likely acted in haste because they discovered something important.
They left without giving you a proper explanation, didn't they?

Name: Adel
Text:
So, if you have any questions, feel free to ask me.
I happen to be quite fond of them.

Name: Adel
Text: I understand your concerns.

Name: Adel
Text: However, the Liberators aren't trying to return to the days of the empire.

Name: Adel
Text:
They simply want to recreate the brilliant civilization, technology, and science…
…that are hard to even fathom...

Name: Adel
Text:
For the sake of humanity living in the present era.
It's an incredible sense of duty, isn't it? Hehe.

Name: Adel
Text:
A group of people tightly bound by pure passion...
That's how you can think of them.

Name: Adel
Text: Have your doubts been somewhat cleared up?

Name: Adel
Text:
Even if they seem like they're just rummaging around everywhere,
they are genuinely altruistic people.

Name: Adel
Text: And I'm incredibly interested in the relics they unearth, too.

Name: Adel
Text:
Let's meet again from time to time.
Enthusiastic “Chosen One” guests like you are quite rare.

Name: Adel
Text: Now, you should head over to the Asientet Gate.

Name: Adel
Text:
Actually, I received a message while you were inspecting the <Blue>Replica Monolith</>.
Someone will be waiting for you.

Name: Adel
Text:
They consist of five members in total,
and the Liberator I entrusted my request to is “Hekima.”

Name: Adel
Text:
I don't know much else, but it doesn't bother me.
Because we don't pry into each other's affairs.

Name: Adel
Text: Isn't that why the Liberators wear masks, even among themselves?

Someone will be waiting for you.

Name: Adel
Text: I've heard there's a crucial biometric trait called the Gudua Factor.

Name: Adel
Text: Rumor has it some adventurers are born with an unusually high amount of this factor.

Name: Adel
Text:
Come to think of it, there's one thing all the people Hekima sent had in common.
They are all referred to as “Chosen Ones.”

Name: Adel
Text: Perhaps they call those who possess a high Gudua Factor the Chosen Ones?

Name: Adel
Text:
And the Liberators are seeking their assistance.
That would explain everything perfectly.

they are genuinely altruistic people.

Someone will be waiting for you.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You arrive near the gate, but Hekima is nowhere to be seen.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...I don't even know what they look like. Should I just look for someone in a mask?)</>

Name: Playful Voice
Text: Ah—so you're this cycle’s “Chosen One.”

Name: Blockio
Text: I am <Orange>Blockio</>, the Third Liberator.

Name: Blockio
Text:
I've already heard all about you.
From the Fifth Liberator.

Name: Blockio
Text: <Yellow>They said you showed the most promise.</>

Name: Blockio
Text:
Hmm?
The “Gudua Factor” this and that... Aren't you sick of hearing about it?

Name: Blockio
Text: I'll break it down for you simply.

Name: Blockio
Text:
We frequently find objects that emit wavelengths but lack physical form,
or objects we can't lay a finger on due to their security systems.

Name: Blockio
Text:
However, some Chosen Ones can interact with them effortlessly.
That's because they were born with the “Gudua Factor.”

Name: Blockio
Text:
You could say the objects recognize them as their rightful masters.
That's why we desperately need the Chosen Ones.

Name: Blockio
Text: No, I shouldn't word it like that.

Name: Blockio
Text: That doesn't do justice to a Chosen One who literally broke our measuring device.

Name: Blockio
Text:
We designate those with high factor values as “Chosen Ones.”
It means you are worthy of joining our pursuit of knowledge.

Name: Blockio
Text:
We've never seen readings like yours before.
I absolutely do not want to lose you.

Name: Blockio
Text:
You probably think I'm making a fuss, but you must be curious yourself.
"Am I really that special?" You're likely wondering.

Name: Blockio
Text:
You don't look convinced.
Allow me to prove I'm not just blowing hot air.

Name: Blockio
Text: There's somewhere we need to go. This way.

Name: Blockio
Text: This place is a realm known as the <Blue>”Labyrinth.”</>

Name: Blockio
Text: It overflows with a strange energy, but we haven't pinpointed its source.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It feels similar to the sensation of touching the Monolith...)</>

Name: Blockio
Text: Finding phenomena or artifacts linked to the ancient empire isn't the hard part.

Name: Blockio
Text:
The problem is what comes next.
When grasping their true nature proves impossible.

Name: Blockio
Text: That is exactly why we enlist the aid of the Chosen Ones.

Name: Blockio
Text:
Merely touching the objects activates them...
And can even stabilize anomalies.

Name: Blockio
Text: <Yellow>Even now, you must be sensing something intense. Right?</>

Name: Blockio
Text:
Yes! That's exactly the answer I was hoping for!
Hurry up and lead the way!

Name: Blockio
Text: Chosen One... are you a reincarnation of the ancients or something?

Name: Blockio
Text:
You managed to distinguish that amidst all this dense energy?
Hah... Unbelievable.

Name: Blockio
Text: Hand it over, I need to get a proper reading.

Name: Blockio
Text: Whoa, it's real.

Name: Blockio
Text: It's completely off the charts!

Name: Blockio
Text: It's reacting far more violently than it did to you earlier! Ah... Ahahaha!!!

Name: Blockio
Text: <Yellow>Finally, a proper analysis is possible! You have no idea how long I've waited for this moment...!</>

Name: Blockio
Text: Draw upon the power of your bloodline! You can do it, right?

Name: Blockio
Text: Just like you did with Hekima and the Monolith... hurry!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Blockio's eyes seem to gleam with a touch of madness...)</>

Name: Blockio
Text: Now, tell me the results.

Name: Blockio
Text: This blindingly radiant object... when, where, and from whom did it originate?!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(As you explain about Saikarad, Blockio looks completely stunned.)</>

Name: Blockio
Text: <Orange>Saikarad, Saikarad.</>

Name: Blockio
Text:
What an astonishingly unfamiliar name.
I've memorized all the records... but I don't recognize it at all.

Name: Blockio
Text:
Wait, no!
Have we finally found the one assigned to “that role?”

Name: Blockio
Text: There is a being who manages the Giant's Tower.

Name: Blockio
Text:
The tower was built so long ago it defies estimation,
yet its interior and exterior remain in absolute pristine condition.

Name: Blockio
Text:
<Yellow>While the tower isn't the empire's only legacy,
the theory that it served as a central hub is highly plausible.</>

Name: Blockio
Text:
Therefore... we absolutely must meet this being!
We have enough questions to blanket this entire world and still have more to ask.

Name: Blockio
Text: Chosen One, how much exactly did this being reveal to you?

Name: Blockio
Text: ...Ah, it's all true.

Name: Blockio
Text:
This is exactly why I hunt for the empire's traces!
The sheer euphoria of solving a mystery is unmatched!

Name: Blockio
Text:
The other Chosen Ones found absolutely nothing in the Labyrinth.
They possessed merely passable skills, nothing more.

Name: Blockio
Text:
To them, this would look like nothing more than a stray bird feather.
Would they have ever dreamed it was an ancient remnant?

Name: Blockio
Text: Having never met the tower's manager, they wouldn't connect the dots anyway.

Name: Blockio
Text: Hah... Ahaha...! I feel fantastic! It's almost too much to bear!

Name: Blockio
Text: Chosen One, we must speak with Hekima immediately!

Name: Blockio
Text:
O Fifth Liberator!
Is there a reason you've kept this person's existence a secret until now?

Name: Blockio
Text: I almost was... very disappointed in you.

Name: Blockio
Text: Hogging all the fun violates our tenets, does it not?

Name: Blockio
Text: <Yellow>"Liberated knowledge is for all."</> Right?

Name: Hekima
Text: ...It's true that I knew from the start that this person was special.

Name: Hekima
Text:
That is precisely why I evaluated them with utmost care,
and ultimately guided them to the Third Liberator.

Name: Hekima
Text: I trust the results were to your satisfaction?

Name: Blockio
Text: Absolutely, without a doubt!

Name: Blockio
Text:
They demonstrated a presence that shattered the critical threshold from the get-go.
How could I be anything but satisfied?

Name: Blockio
Text:
Thanks to them, figuring out how to repair the busted <Blue>”Uncertainty Module 2”</>...
...is no longer even a concern.

Name: Blockio
Text: <Yellow>Moreover, they perfectly validated the hypothesis regarding the Tower's Manager in the Labyrinth.</>

Name: Hekima
Text: ...My intuition was correct.

Name: Hekima
Text: It is highly probable that this individual possesses significant authority over the artifacts.

Name: Hekima
Text: The Monoliths in the Giant's Garden and Starfall Plateau have already been verified.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The two exchanged information using terminology only they understood...)</>

Name: Blockio
Text: Shall we reassess the objects we've made no progress on?

Name: Hekima
Text: ...There are still some unopened ones left in the nearby ancient ruins.

Name: Blockio
Text:
The Chosen One will surely open up new horizons for us!
We no longer have any reason to hesitate in the face of knowledge.

Name: Blockio
Text: I'll lead the way. Let's go.

Name: Monas
Text: Huh? Look who it is!

Name: Monas
Text: It’s been a while. Haven’st seen you since the Giant’s Garden, right?

Name: Monas
Text: Anyway, what brings you all the way out here?

Name: Monas
Text: And these two with you, are they your friends?

Name: Hekima
Text: Are you the keeper of these ruins?

Name: Hekima
Text: There is an object we need to see. Please excuse us.

Name: Monas
Text: What? An object?

Name: Monas
Text: I’ve been looking over this area under Captain Bardad’s order…

Name: Monas
Text: But how can anyone claim ownership over anything that belongs to nature?

Name: Monas
Text: Unless something goes wrong inside, he won’t mind you going in.

Name: Blockio
Text: Then, if you don’t mind.

Name: Blockio
Text: If your superiors ask, tell them the ‘Liberators of Knowledge’ are conducting an investigation.

Name: Monas
Text: Wait, you can’t just barge in like that!

Name: Monas
Text: You don’t know how dangerous it is inside… I’m not worried about you, though…

Name: Monas
Text:
<Yellow>But I will be in so much trouble if there were any casualties.
Please don’t do anything that will put me trouble.</>

Name: Hekima
Text: What do you want us to do?

Name: Monas
Text: Prove me that you can hold your own in a place like this.

Name: Monas
Text:
However, it will be difficult to figure it out with the Adventurer accompanying us.
So, I will be accompanying you.

Name: Blockio
Text: What an interesting way to prove ourselves.

Name: Blockio
Text: We are not so weak, you know… It might get quite boring throughout.

Name: Hekima
Text: We will do as you say.

Name: Hekima
Text: Because the Bardad Expedition is walking a similar path as the Liberators.

Name: Hekima
Text: It would be wise to refrain from actions that would be mutually undesirable.

Name: Blockio
Text: I say, the Fifth Liberator can be too blunt.

Name: Blockio
Text: Fine, let’s all go in together.

Name: Monas
Text: Oh, you’re so quick on your feet.

Name: Monas
Text: The Liberators of Knowledge already went downstairs.

Name: Monas
Text: … Now that we are alone, are they telling the truth?

Name: Monas
Text: They are not entirely unknown to us.

Name: Monas
Text:
We study everything about the Forsaken Land,
but I heard they only focus on certain things…

Name: Monas
Text: Things from ages past like the Ancients and the Empire.

Name: Monas
Text:
They also carry around all sorts of weird things
thanks to their advanced science and technology.

Name: Blockio
Text:
Chosen One! Fifth and I are not even that close! This is so awkward!
Can’t you get down here and keep us company?

Name: Monas
Text:
Mmm… I also heard they can be quite eccentric.
I will let you warm up.

Name: Monas
Text: Phew, I get scraped every time I come down here…

Name: Monas
Text: I just can’t get used to ruins.

Name: Hekima
Text: How did it go? I think I gave you more than enough time…

Name: Blockio
Text: I’d like to call it a day. I don’t like to get all sweaty.

Name: Blockio
Text: Although, whatever you say, I have no intentions to consider it.

Name: Blockio
Text: I only allowed this because it looked like you were close with the Chosen One.

Name: Monas
Text:
You mean, you were only trying to get on his good side!
Oh, of course. I understand.

Name: Monas
Text:
Looks like you can hold your own here.
I’ll come up with a good story for the folks outside.

Name: Monas
Text: Just… let me watch you work!

Name: Monas
Text: You guys are conducting some kind of experiment here, right? It will be a valuable experience for me.

Name: Hekima
Text: … I don’t see why not.

Name: Hekima
Text: In the end, everything is for Elsetian.

Name: Blockio
Text:
I agree.
We have waited long. Let’s get to work right away.

Name: Monas
Text: Are you sure this is the place?

Name: Monas
Text:
I don’t see any unique vegetation.
All I see is a giant boulder.

Name: Hekima
Text: That is to be expected.

Name: Hekima
Text:
The Liberators only sensed some energy here.
They haven’t found anything unusual just yet.

Name: Monas
Text: Is there something on the inside instead of the surface?

Name: Hekima
Text:
Applying external force might be dangerous.
We can’t guarantee that it will remain intact.

Name: Blockio
Text: That’s why we brought the Chosen One.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I’m starting to feel nauseous…)</>

Name: Blockio
Text: Just imagine unleashing your inner power.

Name: Blockio
Text:
It’s not that difficult.
Your instincts will guide you.

Name: Monas
Text: D-Did you really do this, Adventurer?!

Name: Monas
Text:
<Yellow>Look at the light coming out from the surface!
I’ve never seen anything like as an ecologist.</>

Name: Blockio
Text: Fifth Liberator, I think I see a pattern here.

Name: Hekima
Text: It will take some time to decipher… But I’m certain this is a <Blue>’Talim Script’</>.

Name: Monas
Text:
Do you mean the language of the Ancients?
I can’t believe this is real…

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I think I can read it if I concentrate…)</>
ItemDesc:
… Avoid the watch… the Emperor…
orders from the castle… swith to intercept stance…

Amartu must… …convince Elsetia.
Gudua… Monolith…

Name: Monas
Text:
You’ve deciphered it already!
Some of the letters are missing…

Name: Hekima
Text:
It was enough.
We can fill in the rest ourselves.

Name: Blockio
Text: Then I’ll head to the lab. Can I?

Name: Blockio
Text:
Ideas are flooding into my head so fast, it’s difficult to keep it together.
Aah, I’m going to reach to the new frontier!

Name: Hekima
Text: <Yellow>It seems that the script is mentions the world beyond Elsetia.</>

Name: Hekima
Text: Please excuse me while I fetch the character reference table.

Name: Monas
Text:
What’s the rush?
Take a closer look!

Name: Hekima
Text: I want to deliver the full translation to the Chosen One as soon as possible.

Name: Hekima
Text: I will be in touch in the near future.
Hekima and Blockio used a Phase Shift Device and disappeared to somewhere .

Name: Monas
Text: I don’t know if I should report this to the Captain.

Name: Monas
Text:
I should, as a member of the expedition,
but I also have you to think of, Adventurer.

Name: Monas
Text:
I, I mean, we’re talking about someone’s secret. 
I don’t want to say something that I shouldn’t…

Name: Monas
Text: Phew… I have decided!

Name: Monas
Text:
I can’t betray your trust.
I will keep my mouth shut until the end.

Name: Monas
Text: I heard the Liberators appear here from time to time.

Name: Monas
Text:
How about checking the records left behind by other members in the meantime?
They should be scattered around here.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is this it? They are scattered much wider than I expected… Let’s take a look.)</>
ItemDesc:
<Ruin Excavation Log, Day 131>

There is nothing.
I don’t know why the Captain labelled this place as ruins.
All I’ve found are some useless Tesseract Shards.

We can no longer dig up a random spot and expect to find something.
Even if we find something, the Appraisers Guild will try to claim it as their own.

We’re so close to Babylon, but we’ve camping outside for months. It’s driving me crazy.
I really think we got it wrong this time…

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It looks like someone else’s writing.
I wonder if there is anything related to what I’ve read?)</>
ItemDesc:
♥Observation Diary♥

It was a great idea to come along on the expedition today.
He looked so brilliant, even when covered in dirt.

When we went together to get water… I almost confessed my feelings.
He said he was from the Giant’s Garden. I wish he would stay here forever.

These ruins are so exposed. I must have been picked clean by now.
I told the Captain that I feel something in the ruins, but he didn’t look convinced.

Maybe it was just my heart pounding.
I don’t care how the excavation goes. All I want is to see him.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The expedition members do not seem to think much of the ruins…)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Did I pick a wrong page to read? Let’s ask Monas again.)</>

Name: Monas
Text:
What do you think
Our expedition is filled with experts.

Name: Monas
Text: Oh… What if they get caught by the Captain…?

Name: Monas
Text:
Oh, right! I heard <Orange>’Beretta’</> stopped by.
She said she left her belongings.

Name: Monas
Text:
When I offered to take it to Babylon,
she declined.

Name: Monas
Text:
It belongs to a ‘Divine,’ after all…
So they left it there because they didn’t feel comfortable throwing it away.

Name: Monas
Text:
She must have been carrying books of high scholarly value.
Let’s sneak a peak!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This was where I first met Beretta.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She was complaining about coming back empty-handed then, too…)</>

Name: Monas
Text:
Phew, so much dust.
If they couldn’t throw it away, they could have at least stored it better.

Name: Monas
Text: Y-You’re not close to Beretta by any chance, are you?

Name: Monas
Text:
Hmm… I’ll keep these safe.
Just don’t talk too much about our dirt.

Name: Monas
Text:
Even after a lifetime of studying, there are still books I’ve never heard of.
I’ve never seen anything like it!

Name: Monas
Text:
At a glance, it looks like it’s about history.
I see words like the Ancient, Empire, and more.

Name: Monas
Text:
Wow, Beretta must have read all of this already.
Do you see the underlined sentences?

Name: Monas
Text:
Why don’t you ask Beretta, Adventurer?
I think this is way out of my skillset.

Name: Monas
Text:
Everyone knows the Divines are really busy,
but they still work from Babylon, right?

Name: Monas
Text: I will put in a good word if Liberators happen to come this way.

Name: Monas
Text: Please be safe, Adventurer!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I arrived at where the Divines gather…)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is Beretta here? I don’t know where her office is.)</>

Name: Rada
Text: Oh? What brings you here?

Name: Rada
Text: You can’t get past here because the place is off limits…

Name: Rada
Text:
I mean, off limits to everyone but the Divines!
What do you want to do? Hehe,

Name: Rada
Text: come on, you’re no fun! You can’t take a joke.

Name: Rada
Text:
Who are you looking for?
I stopped by to give something to Beretta.

Name: Rada
Text: I have a ‘masterpiece’ that is difficult to obtain.

Name: Rada
Text:
<Yellow>It is none other than Enkia’s traditional liquor, aged for twenty years!
I’m sure she won’t decline.</>

Name: Rada
Text:
After that, I’m going to ask her to decipher this stone tablet.
Gotta be prepared if you want a deal with Beretta.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Explain that I came here for similar reasons.)</>

Name: Rada
Text: What? What a coincidence!

Name: Rada
Text:
Then why don’t you get a bottle of wine and come with me?
I wonder whose wish Beretta will grant.

Name: Rada
Text: Puhaha! You’re so fun, I always say.

Name: Rada
Text:
Who are you looking for?
I stopped by to give something to Beretta.

Name: Rada
Text: I have a ‘masterpiece’ that is difficult to obtain.

Name: Rada
Text:
<Yellow>It is none other than Enkia’s traditional liquor, aged for twenty years!
I’m sure she won’t decline.</>

Name: Rada
Text:
After that, I’m going to ask her to decipher this stone tablet.
Gotta be prepared if you want a deal with Beretta.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Explain that I came here for similar reasons.)</>

Name: Rada
Text: What? What a coincidence!

Name: Rada
Text:
Then why don’t you get a bottle of wine and come with me?
She might not see us if we go separately.

Name: Rada
Text: I’m only helping because you played along. Hehe.

Name: Rada
Text: What should we do? We’ve brought these bribes for nothing!

Name: Rada
Text:
It’s quite rare for Ragnar to leave his post like this! 
He’s always here.

Name: Rada
Text:
I didn’t let him know in advance because I wanted to surprise him…
Maybe I should have asked where he is over the communicator.

Name: Rada
Text: No, I would have gotten an earful if I did that.

Name: Rada
Text:
<Yellow>”Divines are just a nickname, not an official title.
Don’t try to dump annoying tasks on me.”</>

Name: Rada
Text:
I remember Beretta saying it. She was so angry.
After that, I don’t use the communicator unless it’s an emergency.

Name: Rada
Text:
I don’t know about that.
She seems to leave her stuff behind everywhere…

Name: Rada
Text:
Let’s put what we’ve brought down over there.
My arms are hurting from carrying the heavy bottle.

Name: Rada
Text: I remember seeing Beretta lose herself into this book.

Name: Rada
Text:
She must have left notes here and there.
She probably wrote those in the common tongue.

Name: Rada
Text:
If you read the text, I’ll try and explain it like Beretta.
Let’s start with this sentence!
ItemDesc:
The book left behind, no, abandoned at the Scything Barrens ruins by Beretta.
Fortunately, most of it is written in the common tongue.
I notice Beretta’s crude handwriting in the margins.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>『The ones who discovered the ruins reported various anomalies without exception.』</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>『Surprisingly, most of them were skilled adventurers, 
and experienced temporal reversion, dimensional rifts, synchronization of egos, and more…』</>

Name: Rada
Text: Hmm, hmm!

Name: Rada
Text: <Yellow>”If you’re going to write it like this, just forget about it.”</>

Name: Rada
Text: <Yellow>”People with manifested Factors are highly likely to experience them.”</>

Name: Rada
Text: <Yellow>”I don’t know if it’s such an important discovery to write a book about. Such a cliche.”</>

Name: Rada
Text:
Right?! I think I have potential!
Here, let me try to decipher the folded part.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>『…The artifacts found within and outside the Giant’s Tower
hint at connections to the Ancient Empire…』</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>『This supports the claim that the empire’s supreme power
strongly influenced the tower’s construction.』</>

Name: Rada
Text:
<Yellow>”I’m sure the Emperor was the one who ordered the tower’s construction.
Dear author, are you that unimaginative?”</>

Name: Rada
Text: <Yellow>”It’s clear as day. Physical evidence is unnecessary.”</>

Name: Rada
Text: Considering the time we’ve spent together, this is nothing.

Name: Rada
Text:
Wait, wait!
Come to think of it, this is actually massive!

Name: Rada
Text:
Of course, Beretta has known all along.
She really knows everything!

Name: Rada
Text: Hmm, this complicates things.

Name: Rada
Text:
Even though this tablet was forced on me…
It seemed to hide a secret. And I wanted to uncover it.

Name: Rada
Text:
You see, Beretta is smart.
What if she gets angry? Like, “how do you not know that!”

Name: Rada
Text: Until now, I thought it was okay to ask something like this because we are friends…

Name: Rada
Text:
But you have to be nicer to those close to you, right?
I don’t want to take up Beretta’s time.

Name: Rada
Text: All right! Here me out.

Name: Rada
Text: Tell me how mysterious this is, if it will picque Beretta’s curiosity.

Name: Rada
Text:
I know your instincts are pretty sharp!
I’m going to ask someone else if you don’t think so.

Name: Rada
Text: You’ll help, right? Right?

Name: Rada
Text: Thank you! We got a long road ahead, so let’s get going.

Name: Rada
Text:
<Orange>Kima!</> Were you waiting for me?
I’m here for the stone tablet.

Name: Kima
Text: Rada, Rada, Rada is here.

Name: Kima
Text: It’s been a while. Right? It has been a while!

Name: Rada
Text:
Yes, it’s been a while!
You can give me the stone tablet now.

Name: Rada
Text:
You told me take it because you didn’t need it.
I was going to put it up in my room!

Name: Kima
Text: Rada, tablet, tablet, Rada… Tablet!

Name: Kima
Text:
I left it outside.
Twirl, I went out on a stroll because I was dizzy and hot.

Name: Kima
Text:
I picked some flowers on the way.
Do you like flowers, Rada?

Name: Kima
Text:
You have to watch those colorful grasses.
If you don’t, you will go ouchie!

Name: Rada
Text:
You don’t have the stone tablets, do you?!
Then I’ll just have to find it.

Name: Kima
Text: Think, think.

Name: Kima
Text: I played where ground was bumpy and there was no white powder!

Name: Kima
Text: Then I became cold, so went back inside.

Name: Rada
Text: I got it! It’s cold outside, so stay here and don’t come outside.

Name: Kima
Text: I’m waiting for Rada, Rada!

Name: Rada
Text: Kima is a very old Naruru.

Name: Rada
Text:
That’s why she forgets things from time to time.
But if you ask slowly, she answers everything.

Name: Rada
Text:
Last time I met Kima, she told me 
she brought the tablet from deep within, where the hot spring flows.

Name: Rada
Text: She received it when she was a baby, but she must have forgot she put it away.

Name: Rada
Text: The Naruru tribe might have a habit of hiding important things underwater.

Name: Rada
Text: You remember the festival at the Aburu village, right?

Name: Rada
Text: Back then, she said she had brought the grains for the festival from <Blue>’Ea’s Navel’</>.

Name: Rada
Text: And we ate so many delicious food.

Name: Rada
Text:
There was some dish with fish heads skewered upright
as a prayer, a symbol of infinite gratitude.
ItemDesc:
Rada’s favorite festival dish.
Very famous even among the Narurus.
Thinking about it again makes me nauseous.

Name: Rada
Text:
…You’re listening to me, right?
Anyway, what I’m saying is, the two have something in common.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Maybe that’s why outsiders weren’t able to find it until now.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(If that is the case, even the Liberators would not have known about it,
when the one who hid it only remembered it recently…)</>

Name: Rada
Text:
About the tablets, I don’t think someone took it.
It’s quite heavy.

Name: Rada
Text: I told them to keep it safe because I was going to take it when I returned.

Name: Rada
Text: Hmm! Enough about Kima, let’s go get the stone tablet.

Name: Rada
Text: I recalled what Kima said.

Name: Rada
Text: <Yellow>Colorful grasses, white flour, bumpy ground.</>

Name: Rada
Text:
I think we just have to find the place with these three traits.
Then, let’s go!

Name: Rada
Text: You found it! That’s the stone tablet.

Name: Rada
Text: It certainly looks like it wouldn’t mean much to the Narurus, right?

Name: Rada
Text:
Humans are curious about all sorts of things, but
the Naruru are very pragmatic.

Name: Rada
Text:
They are also incredibly thorough when it comes to trading.
That’s why I doubt they'd care about a rock like this.

Name: Rada
Text: To us, it looks like it has a 'picture' drawn on it.
ItemName: The Stone Tablet Owned by Kima
ItemDesc:
A flat stone with rounded edges.
It depicts people kneeling.
The back is just covered in scratches and dents.

Name: Rada
Text:
Aside from the people, I can't tell what else is.
The painting must have been largely erased because it’s been submerged for so long.

Name: Rada
Text: What about you? Do you see a different thing or something?

Name: Rada
Text:
Hmm, you're the same.
Let's head back to Kima for now.

Name: Kima
Text: Rada is here with the stone tablet! Rada is here!

Name: Kima
Text:
I don't need a scratchy rock.
<Yellow>I'll give it to Rada. Rada will be happy!</>

Name: Rada
Text:
Can I really keep it?
It was originally yours, Kima.

Name: Kima
Text: Yeah, but I don't even know who gave it to me.

Name: Kima
Text:
I will just use this to sit on.
I will take it to the fishing spot and just leave it there.

Name: Rada
Text:
H-huh? If that's the case, I'll take it!
I really, really like the picture on it.

Name: Kima
Text: Picture? There's a picture on it? Naruru doesn’t know.

Name: Kima
Text:
You said you’ll take it, so it's Rada's from now on!
Stone, stone, Rada's stone.

Name: Rada
Text:
Thank you, Kima.
Now don't forget, make sure to take good care of Kima's things, okay?

Name: Kima
Text: Yeah! I won't forget. Sturdy Whiskers Naruru never forgets.

Name: Rada
Text: Now I need to decide what to do with the stone tablet.

Name: Rada
Text:
<Yellow>It definitely feels strange, doesn't it?
It almost feels like it's pulling me in.</>

Name: Rada
Text: I thought about using magic... but we can't risk breaking it.

Name: Rada
Text: Then I guess we should go find Beretta as planned...?

Name: Rada
Text:
That’s the plan... but still! 
I'm hesitating because she might find it annoying...

Name: Rada
Text:
That's it! It's probably best to do as you said.
We're heading to the Babylon market.

Name: Blockio
Text:
Chosen One, you really aren't the type to stay in one place.
You weren't at the ruins, nor in Babylon.

Name: Blockio
Text:
You said you'd be right back, but you didn't even wait for me...
Please understand how dissapointed I was.

Name: Rada
Text: Do you guys know each other? That's a very unique outfit.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(As I briefly explain about the Liberators of Knowledge,
Rada can't hide her intrigued expression.)</>

Name: Rada
Text: Ah! The treaty they mentioned, they must have been talking about you guys.

Name: Rada
Text:
I've heard about it from the other Divines.
They said to just leave you be if possible.

Name: Blockio
Text: That's right. We aren't pests, you know.

Name: Blockio
Text:
Do you know how much has happened between this person and me recently?
We have a very tight bond.

Name: Rada
Text: ...H-huh?

Name: Blockio
Text:
The Fifth Liberator could not restrain his thirst for knowledge.
So I came looking for the Chosen One on my own.

Name: Blockio
Text: Could you read the translation and tell me your thoughts?

Name: Blockio
Text: <Yellow>Insights based on your experience... That's exactly what we need.</>

Name: Rada
Text:
It's fine to chat with your friend.
The stone tablet isn't going anywhere.

Name: Rada
Text:
Should I give you two some privacy?
If it bothers you, I'll wait at the Hot Springs.

Name: Blockio
Text:
Ho, I thought I felt a mysterious resonance...
Do you possess an artifact?

Name: Rada
Text: An artifact...?

Name: Blockio
Text: I mean the relics left behind by the ancients, or forged during the Imperial era.

Name: Blockio
Text:
Chosen One, you haven't done anything to it yet, have you?
Try making direct contact with the tablet.

Name: Blockio
Text:
<Yellow>Just as you did with the Monolith.
Envision yourself awakening the stone tablet as you do so.</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(A scene similar to the carving on the stone tablet.
Countless people being treated like slaves.)</>

Name: Blockio
Text:
Ah, it's truly marvelous!
Hekima witnessed this all by himself.

Name: Blockio
Text: If this is why... he took so long to introduce the Chosen One, I suppose I'll have to forgive him.

Name: Rada
Text:
Are you okay?!
The stone tablet started shaking, and you stumbled right along with it.

Name: Rada
Text:
I can use healing magic if you need it.
Let me know if you're hurting anywhere.

Name: Rada
Text: That's a relief then... I thought something terrible had happened.

Name: Blockio
Text:
If you just saw a 'vision' a moment ago,
it might be related to this translation.

Name: Blockio
Text:
Let's continue with what we were doing.
Here you go.
ItemDesc:
I escaped the Tower, evading Ragar's surveillance.
The Emperor has made a drastic decision.
To defy the order from the castle and switch the Tower to an intercept stance.

Amartu will destroy Elsetia.
We must persuade him to revoke the order.

Gudua's power is not absolute.
Haven't we already experienced it through the Monolith?

Name: Blockio
Text: Well... Was there any connection to what you saw?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The Tower built upon countless sacrifices...
And I explain the 'Emperor's' misguided choices.)</>

Name: Blockio
Text: In that case, did you feel that they were the same person?

Name: Blockio
Text:
<Yellow>The one receiving orders and the one ordering the slaves.</>
I mean those two individuals.

Name: Blockio
Text:
The Tower's power must be quite formidable.
There must be a reason for the atrocities committed by the one called Emperor.

Name: Blockio
Text:
<Yellow>I'm more concerned about the phrase about 'destroying' Elsetia.
It could be still happening.</>

Name: Rada
Text:
To think it could have continued from ancient times until now...
I've never heard of such magic even in Enkia.

Name: Rada
Text:
Besides, Xeros has been quiet too.
So I assumed we wouldn't have to worry about the Tower...

Name: Blockio
Text:
It seems an in-depth discussion is in order.
We've hit a wall, so I'll need to procure a new sample.

Name: Rada
Text: Ugh, I can't stand complicated talk.

Name: Rada
Text: But since I don't need to show the stone tablet to Beretta anymore, I'll make time.

Name: Blockio
Text:
For now, having the Chosen One present is sufficient.
I will remember the goodwill of Divine Rada.

Name: Rada
Text: Alright. They did told me to let the Liberators do what they do.

Name: Blockio
Text:
Please return to Babylon and wait.
I will join you there as soon as Hekima's work is finished.

Name: Orica
Text: Hmm, you don't strike me as a swindler...

Name: Orica
Text: Did you borrow money and forget to pay it back? Or maybe...

Name: Orica
Text:
Have you made a lot of enemies lately?
Hmm... That's entirely possible.

Name: Orica
Text: These days, it'd be harder to find someone in the Forsaken Land who doesn't know your name.

Name: Orica
Text: Letters are coming into the Explorers’ Guild looking for you.

Name: Orica
Text:
At first I thought it was a prank,
but as time passed, it didn’t seem that way.

Name: Orica
Text: I have the letters right here. Take a look.
ItemDesc:
Waiting is a terrible thing, especially as the day of meeting draws near.
Do you remember me... no, us? 
You really should remember, for many reasons.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You open another letter.)</>
ItemDesc:
You said you'd c■me to the tower. You said you'd co■e to the tower. You said you'd com■ to the tower. 
You said you'd come t■ the tower. You said you'd come to t■e tower. You said you'd come to th■ tower.
You said you'd come to the towe■. Y■u said you'd come to the tower. You sa■d you'd come to the tower. 
You sai■ you'd come to the tower. You said y■u'd come to the tower. You said you'■ come to the tower...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You open another letter.)</>
ItemDesc:
We will not give up. We must execute the orders given to us.
However, our courtesy ends here.
I am sick and tired of your absolute indifference.

Text: You read the letters Orica gave you, but you still have absolutely no idea who sent them.

Name: Orica
Text:
You should probably look at this too, [player].
It came tumbling in with the letters.
ItemDesc:
A means of delivering commissions often used by mercenaries.
You certainly didn't expect to find one here.

Name: Orica
Text: Good thing there's only one. Could you imagine if there was one for every letter?

Name: Orica
Text:
The entire guild was in an uproar because of this,
so if you find the culprit, be sure to let me know. Promise me.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Since you don't know who sent it, you decide to head to a secluded spot to check it.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Someplace nearby... the Valley of Beasts would work.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Visual Recording Device isn't working. It doesn't seem broken, but...)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(In a situation like this... Simon’s method is the only way.
You pull out the memo he gave you.)</>
ItemDesc:
If an intact Visual Recording Device fails to operate, try the following methods.

- Charge it near Ancient Ruins.
 ※ The Visual Recording Device charges by reacting with Aether in or around the ruins.
 ※ When properly charged, the Aether will become visible as light.

- Activate it where the light is concentrated.
 ※ This method is recommended, as the device can continue charging while in use.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(First, let’s investigate the collapsed pillars and statues.
The Visual Recording Device might start working.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(There's a reaction. A streak of light is extending toward the water.
Let's check the statue on the opposite side too.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(There's a reaction here as well.
This should be enough to charge the Visual Recording Device, right?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It shouldn't die in the middle of playback, so let's turn it on over there.)</>
As you activate the Visual Recording Device, you see a familiar face.

Name: Beretta
Text: Aren't you a little too oblivious?

Name: Beretta
Text: How long do I have to keep watching your back, [player]?

Name: Beretta
Text: Seeing as there’s more than just one or two of these dolls, it means they've been constantly tracking you...

Name: Beretta
Text: Hah... Stop staring at those damn scraps of paper and head to the tower right now.

Name: Beretta
Text:
Yeah, the 2nd floor is a good place to start.
There's only one person capable of doing something like this.

Name: Zisen
Text: Hello, I am <Orange>Zisen</>.

Name: Weifel
Text:
Professor, whoever introduces themselves like that?
You should say you are one of the <Orange>Liberators of Knowledge</>, the second Liberator to be exact!

Name: Zisen
Text:
Th-That's not important.
We need to talk about what's n-necessary, <Orange>Weifel!</>

Name: Zisen
Text:
...Well, it seems I was dragged into this as well.
It's a long story, but I'll save that for later...

Name: Zisen
Text:
While conducting a secret investigation at the behest of <Orange>Beretta</>,
sightings of the Queen's Explorer have been repeatedly confirmed.

Name: Zisen
Text: I suspect it's because you're close to being the “Chosen One.”

Name: Zisen
Text: According to adventurers' records, there is a Queen's Explorer on each floor—

Name: Weifel
Text:
The one in charge of the 2nd gloor is the strangest of them all.
They practically beg you to enter the Tower!

Name: Weifel
Text:
Just a warning—don't stare at the letter for too long.
It drives some people mad just reading it.

Name: Weifel
Text: You should be grateful I'm telling you this, chosen candidate!

Name: Hekima
Text: I will now share the results of the mutual verification among the Liberators.

Name: Hekima
Text: The culprit behind this incident is presumed to be the <Blue>“Queen's Explorer”</> residing on the 2nd floor of the Tower.

Name: Hekima
Text: Rumor has it they will relentlessly torment you until you find them, so be on your guard.

Name: Hekima
Text:
You should be able to find a clue... through this.
Weifel will help you locate the object.
ItemDesc: An ancient artifact containing clues to resolve all of this.

Name: Hekima
Text: The communicator will be noisy, but it should give you a relatively accurate location.

Name: Hekima
Text:
First, head to the 2nd floor of the Tower.
You should start by looking around the lower section.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I never expected to be searching for a Visual Recording Device inside the Tower.
I hope I can find the clue quickly...)</>

Name: Weifel
Text: Aren't you glad I showed up, chosen candidate?!

Name: Weifel
Text:
Normally, I'd just leave you as fodder for the Tower,
but I'll give you a piece of advice!

Name: Weifel
Text: <Yellow>First, never disobey an Explorer.</>

Name: Weifel
Text:
Don't ask why.
You'll understand once you meet them.

Name: Weifel
Text: <Yellow>Second, search around the purple flowers to find the Visual Recording Device.</>

Name: Weifel
Text:
Lastly...
Actually, never mind. You should experience this one for yourself.
You activate the Visual Recording Device and see a stranger standing.

Name: Queen's Explorer
Text: You should be grateful for the opportunity to meet me.

Name: Silla
Text:
I am <Orange>“Silla,”</> the Queen's faithful Explorer.
I reside here, sifting out what is useful.

Name: Silla
Text:
To ensure the massive ark does not go hungry,
I must feed it regularly.

Name: Silla
Text:
<Yellow>Since you have answered my call, you can either become a lump of meat,
or prove yourself worthy as a candidate. The choice is yours.</>

Name: Silla
Text: While you remain here, you will hear my voice everywhere,

Name: Silla
Text: and you must answer to my calls at any time.

Name: Silla
Text: Now, shall we begin?
As soon as Silla finishes speaking, your body begins to ache as if being torn apart.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Where am I now...?)</>

Name: Silla
Text:
Was that too easy?
But then again, if you caught the Queen's eye, you must be someone special.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Her face looks like the Explorer from the 1st floor,
but her hair, tone, and personality are completely different.)</>

Name: Silla
Text:
Are you the type to wear your thoughts on your face?
It's nice that you don't overthink things.

Name: Silla
Text: You want to learn more about me, no… the Explorers, right?

Name: Silla
Text:
...A more interesting specimen than the <Orange>“Emperor.”</>
Neither dull nor arrogant.

Name: Silla
Text: <Yellow>He considered himself the source of all things.</>

Name: Silla
Text:
Head over to the stone statues.
Let's see how many secrets you can uncover.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Didn't she say I'd die if I refused or failed the Explorer's request?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I don't know what I'll see, but I have no choice but to try...)</>

Name: Elin
Text: <Yellow>My duty is to send as many people as possible up to the next floor.</>

Name: Elin
Text: If there's even the slightest chance, I will see it through unconditionally.

Name: Silla
Text:
<Yellow>The sorting is my duty.
The strong ascend, and the weak become fuel.</>

Name: Elin
Text: What if fewer humans come seeking the Tower?

Name: Silla
Text: They climbed the Tower searching for relics, even after surviving the Grand Incursion.

Name: Silla
Text: As long as their greed remains, the Tower will endure forever.

Name: Elin
Text: I bet <Orange>Jeda</> would love that.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Are the Explorers taking orders from Saikarad? And who is the Emperor...?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(For now, I should return to Sila and tell her what I saw..)</>

Name: Silla
Text: What did you see?

You say you saw Saikarad giving a mission to the Explorer,
and Elin conversing with Silla.

Name: Silla
Text: Oh... you peered quite far into the past, didn't you?

Name: Silla
Text:
That is a question I will never be able to answer.
I'll overlook it this time, assuming it was just a mistake.

Name: Silla
Text:
Don't even think about asking another Explorer.
That is if you want to live.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...There's definitely some connection to Saikarad.)</>

Name: Silla
Text: Our duty is to find beings like you, test you, and provoke them to think.

Name: Silla
Text: So, your task now is…

Name: Silla
Text: Good. Shall we move on to the next step?

Name: Silla
Text: I'll make you a proposal to judge your usefulness.

Name: Silla
Text: Halpasiam will be waiting if you take the stairs up to the center.

Name: Silla
Text: I took special care of that one, so I hope you don’t disappoint me.

Name: Silla
Text:
Crush it completely and utterly, enough to make me feel sorry for them.
Only then will I acknowledge your true worth.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She seemed to be nearby just a moment ago...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Hmm... There's something here I didn't see on the way up.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I should check it out before going back to Silla.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I found a dagger on the way down, and here lies a feather. 
Are these traces left only by the Queen's Explorers?)</>

Standing there in a daze, I belatedly recalled Orica's words.
I should report back to the Explorers’ Guild regarding the letter's sender.

Name: Orica
Text: What happened? Did you find the culprit?

Since you can’t explain everything that happened in the Tower,
you come up with a plausible story about Silla, the Queen's Explorer.

Name: Orica
Text: That means something like this might happen again...

Name: Orica
Text: A clear answer is great, but that alone isn’t enough, is it?

Name: Orica
Text:
<Yellow>Going to the Tower should be a challenge, not a death sentence.</>
Isn't that right, [player]?

Name: Orica
Text: Speaking of which, can I ask you a favor?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You ask if she’d make you do it even after you declined.
Orica replies, “Why ask the obvious?”)</>

Name: Orica
Text:
Unfair, huh? Well, life isn’t fair.
There's simply no adventurer as skilled as you.

Name: Orica
Text:
Do you remember what I mentioned earlier?
I wanted you to investigate the <Blue>“Queen's Explorer</>.”

Name: Orica
Text: As the Guild Master of the Explorers’ Guild, I'd like to make an official request...

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(There’s no decent excuse to decline.
Let's accept for now and only share what's necessary.)</>

Name: Orica
Text: Great. I'll leave the confidential Codex in your hands.
ItemDesc:
An Codex containing information about the Queen's Explorer.
It includes information the Explorers’ Guild couldn't leave as official records.

Name: Orica
Text:
Keep the investigation strictly confidential, and use the communicator if anything important comes up.
See you around, adventurer.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I see someone under the tree over there. Is it Bailiegh?)</>

Name: Bailey
Text: I was just about to burn this if you didn’t show up. Good thing you did.

Name: Bailey
Text:
It's a confidentiality agreement.
Sign here first.

Name: Bailey
Text:
It's strictly a precaution.
You don't honestly think I'd kill you, do you?
ItemDesc:
No matter how I look at it, it's riddled with unfair clauses. 
But I feel like I'll be in serious trouble if I refuse.
The warning that refusal or breach of the oath could result in death is highlighted in glaring red. 
...Why on earth is the Explorers Guild, or rather Bailiegh, handing this out?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He definitely seems more than capable of dong it, but let's keep that thought to myself.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It's full of warnings instead of actual mission details...
Just what kind of commission makes him go to such lengths?)</>

Name: Bailey
Text: Alright, signature verified...

Name: Bailey
Text:
Let's head inside then.
It'll make more sense to explain while you see it for yourself.

Name: Bailey
Text:
I noticed one of the Liberators of Knowledge lugging something like this around, so I reached out.
And they recommended you.

Name: Bailey
Text: First things first, that hunk of junk needs to wake up.
ItemDesc: An ancient artifact capable of collecting Aether. To think I'd come across this again...

Name: Bailey
Text:
Fill the collector with Aether.
Monsters are everywhere, so it shouldn't be too hard.

Name: Bailey
Text: I'll save you the trouble of asking. Aetherium didn't work at all.

Name: Bailey
Text:
I figured solidified Aether would work,
but it didn't trigger a single reaction.

Name: Bailey
Text: Looks like it only draws power from raw, unrefined Aether.

Name: Bailey
Text: Enough with the explanation. Now get moving.

Name: Bailey
Text:
...Not really?
You can decide whether to fix it after hearing whatever nonsense it spouts.

Name: Bailey
Text: So stop asking questions and just get the Aether.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(What happened?
I don't think I've ever seen him so anxious.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let's gather the Aether first, then ask him what's going on.)</>

Name: Bailey
Text: You sure work fast.

Name: Bailey
Text: Hang tight while I inject the Aether,[player].

Name: Bailey
Text:
I dragged you back from certain death, so you'd better start talking.
You damn piece of junk.

Name: Ancient Artifact
Text: Ozkan. Floor 3. Ozkan. Floor 3. Ozkan. Floor 3...

Name: Bailey
Text:
Hah, so you're playing the malfunction card?
They say a little force works wonders on a stubborn machine, right?

Bailiegh proceeded to beat the ancient artifact mercilessly.
