It happened so fast I didn't even have a chance to stop him...

Name: Ancient Artifact
Text: Bzz, bzzt...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...He didn't break it completely, did he?)</>

Name: Bailey
Text: Don't let its appearance fool you, [player].

Name: Bailey
Text: Thanks to this thing, members of the Springwater Raven Society are still wandering lost on Floor 3 of the Tower.

Name: Bailey
Text:
You’re coming with me to Floor 3 to find someone.
We have to do it as discreetly as possible.

Name: Bailey
Text:
If by some chance we fail to crack this disappearance case,
we're both dead meat.

Name: Bailey
Text: An exiled magitech engineer from Frantia.

Name: Bailey
Text:
I'll brief you on the details once we reach the Tower.
First, grab that junk.
I packed away the ancient artifact just as Bailiegh ordered.

Name: Bailey
Text:
Meet me at the Floor 3 lobby in the Tower.
I'll head up first using the Phase Converter.

Name: Bailey
Text: This artifact is surprisingly amusing every time I use it.

Name: Bailey
Text:
Word is, if you're unlucky, only a part of your body arrives,
or you wind up at a completely different destination...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A shiver runs down my spine as I recall my trip to the Tower's underground.)</>

Name: Bailey
Text: Anyway, we're both in one piece. That's what counts.

Name: Bailey
Text: Guess I should tell you about the person we're looking for now?

Name: Bailey
Text: Ever heard of the nine ruling families of magic?

Name: Bailey
Text: Well... you don't need a lesson in politics, so I'll skip that part.

Name: Bailey
Text: A scion from a prominent Frantia family—one that rivals royalty—crossed over to Stormkel.

Name: Bailey
Text: Supposedly, he got sick of human experiments and pivoted to something more practical.

Name: Bailey
Text: So he sought out the Springwater Raven Society in Stormkel and became a special member.

Name: Bailey
Text:
Up to this point... it's just an ordinary story.
The real problem started after this special member arrived in the Forsaken Land.

Name: Bailey
Text: They said you'd recognize this face. Is that right?
ItemName: A Portrait of a Familiar Face
ItemDesc: It's a face I couldn't forget even if I tried. It's tied to my memories of the very first day I entered the Forsaken Land.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The hairstyle and clothes are different, but the face is unmistakable.)</>

Name: Bailey
Text:
They mentioned the Chosen Ones would know...
Hmm, the Second Liberator certainly doesn't tell lies.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Thoughts of Zisen and Weifel cross my mind, and I find myself nodding instinctively.)</>

Name: Bailey
Text: Now that we've confirmed our target, let's split up and search.

Name: Bailey
Text: Oh, and I have zero intention of lugging that junk around, so you hold onto it.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Didn't he say the society members vanished because of this thing?)</>

Name: Bailey
Text:
...If you’re not comfortable with it, just dump it somewhere.
I'm heading out first.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Hmm... other adventurers might get caught up in this, so let's hide it out of sight.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(That wooden structure up ahead should do the trick for hiding the artifact.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I'd love to just ditch it, but if that ends up causing problems for me later, I'll get in trouble.
My life is literally on the line, after all.)</>

Name: Ancient Artifact
Text:
I'm begging, begging you!
I want no fistfight!

Name: Ancient Artifact
Text:
Good sir, have some basic human decency!
I'm not scary or weird at all!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He looks incredibly suspicious, but let's hear him out.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I can always contact Bailiegh with the communicator if things go wrong.)</>

Name: Ancient Artifact
Text: Inhale, exhale.

Name: Ozcan
Text:
I am the great Ozkan!
The trusted guide of Floor 3!

Name: Ozcan
Text: I thought I was a goner, but good deeds do pay off!

Name: Ozcan
Text:
When I opened my eyes, I was outside the Tower!
I was completely lost, my head was spinning, and I couldn't even speak!

Name: Ozcan
Text: And the humans who swore they'd help vanished into thin air!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Is he implying the missing people aren't his fault?
Still, I shouldn't drop my guard. I’m still inside the Tower.)</>

Name: Ozcan
Text:
Hmm, hmmm.
What will it take for you to believe me!

Name: Ozcan
Text: I know! I'll let you meet the Queen's Explorer!

Name: Ozcan
Text:
A human traversing the Tower...!
You'll have to pass the Explorer's test to proceed to the next floor, you see?

Name: Ozcan
Text: Let me prove my trustworthiness to you!

Name: Ozcan
Text:
H, hey!
Come on, it’s not a scam!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I demand to know why I should trust him, warning him to
spit out the location of the missing people while I ask nicely.)</>

Name: Ozcan
Text: I suppose actions speak louder than words, eh?

Name: Ozcan
Text:
Now, follow my lead!
I will escort you straight to the Queen's Explorer!
The moment Ozkan stopped talking, a brilliant beam of light engulfed my body.

Name: Ozcan
Text:
Y-you actually believe me?
I promise, you won't regret this!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(If he's going this far, I might as well trust him on this once.)</>

Name: Ozcan
Text: I suppose actions speak louder than words, eh?

Name: Ozcan
Text:
Now, follow my lead!
I will escort you straight to the Queen's Explorer!
The moment Ozkan stopped talking, a brilliant beam of light engulfed my body.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Where the hell am I...?)</>

Name: Ozcan
Text: Hey, are you alright?

Name: Ozcan
Text: I've successfully transported you to the middle section of the Tower!

Name: Ozcan
Text: If you still don't trust m-

Name: Ozcan
Text:
U-uh...?
Why is the Queen's Explorer acting like that?

Name: Ozcan
Text:
This is madness... Y-you human!
Stay right behind me!

Name: Ozcan
Text:
You there-! You scoundrel!
How could you! You’re not even human!

Name: Bored voice
Text: I should be the one asking that, Mr. Ozkan.

Name: Bored voice
Text: Shouldn't you have at least warned me that the Queen's Explorer on Floor 3 has completely lost it?

Name: Bored voice
Text:
The Explorer lunged at me with a drawn sword without any provocation...
I merely struck back as a warning.

Name: Bored voice
Text:
And take another look.
Not dead. Just unconscious.

Name: Ozcan
Text:
You impudent brute! You call that a excuse?
The Explorer would never do such a thing!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Is this the guy from the portrait Bailiegh showed me?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(She reminds me of the girl from the Asientet Gate,
but I don't think they're the same person.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Well, the commission seems complete at least, so I should break these two up.)</>
Realizing they wouldn't stop berating each other, I suggested we wake up the 'Queen's Explorer' first.

Name: Bored voice
Text:
That sounds perfectly logical.
That should also clear my name.

Name: Ozcan
Text:
Look who's talking!
I will go check on the Explorer's condition myself!

Name: Cyril
Text:
Please forgive my manners.
I am Cyril, Special Member of the Springwater Raven Society.

Name: Cyril
Text: I traveled here specifically to take the test administered by the Queen's Explorer.

Name: Cyril
Text:
Special Member Bailiegh has certainly pulled some strings.
I will ensure you are handsomely rewarded once this is successfully resolved.

Name: Cyril
Text:
Let's head over to the Queen's Explorer for now.
Since my presence probably won't be much help anyway.

Name: Ozcan
Text:
Ah, there you are!
Sigh, what am I going to do? She won't wake up even when I call her name.

Name: Ozcan
Text:
She usually wakes up if you say 'Jeda' three times, regardless of the situation,
but it's just not working this time.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Waking up to her name... That's quite a basic failsafe.)</>

Name: Ozcan
Text: Hmm, I suppose there's only one option left.

Name: Ozcan
Text: We need a monster's core.
ItemDesc: The ancient artifact Ozkan presented. I've never seen a design like this. How exactly does it work?

Name: Ozcan
Text:
I lack the proper materials to fire this up!
So hurry up and retrieve one.

Name: Ozcan
Text: If we wait much longer, we might lose our chance to wake Jeda altogether.

Name: Ozcan
Text:
Welcome back!
I was starting to think you'd never return!

Name: Cyril
Text:
Hmm, I am quite curious to hear what the Queen's Explorer has to say for herself.
A proper apology for her hostility would be a nice start.

Name: Ozcan
Text:
Ugh, my head hurts just listening to you.
You're all talk for someone who hasn't contributed a single useful thing!

Name: Cyril
Text: The Explorer will clarify who exactly is at fault the moment she opens her eyes.

Name: Ozcan
Text: Argh, you are completely insufferable!
ItemDesc: An ancient artifact powered by a monster's core.

Name: Ozcan
Text: While I calibrate the 'Biometric Tuner', I need you to keep a close eye on the Explorer's—I mean, 'Jeda's'—vitals!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(What is going on?
Why is Xeros with the apostles of the Paradise Advent Society...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(And Cyril and Ozkan are nowhere to be found.)</>

Name: Mysterious Voice
Text:
You seem quite startled.
But I'm obligated to deliver this message, you see.

Name: Zeda
Text:
Greetings.
I am Jeda, the Explorer who oversees Floor 3.

Name: Zeda
Text:
You look like you have quite a few questions?
Hmm, where to begin...

Name: Zeda
Text:
Oh, right. How did you like my little gift?
Was it to your liking?

Name: Zeda
Text:
An altruistic soul?
Well, that's not the worst trait to have.

Name: Zeda
Text:
Cyril actually bet his own crew just to play with me.
But you? You don’t seem the type.

Name: Zeda
Text:
And what was his name? Nicola?
Saying the useless should be tossed out... he's the spitting image of Silla.

Name: Zeda
Text:
You remember her, right? That one on the second floor.
Always looking for a fight.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(She’s nothing like the Queen’s Explorers I’ve seen before.
One wrong move and I might get in trouble.)</>

Name: Zeda
Text:
Ah, you also need to reach the next floor, don't you?
Well, you'll have to pass a trial for that...

Name: Zeda
Text:
But guess what.
I've always preferred a good wager over a dull trial.

Name: Zeda
Text: Heh, I’ll be generous and give you some time to think.

Name: Zeda
Text: Ponder closely on what you’re willing to stake.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Staying here any longer is just asking for trouble.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Yet, I cannot simply escape alone.
Bailey, Cyril, and Nicola are all still here.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I don't know if she'll take it, but I should propose a bet,
on the condition that we all leave together.)</>

Name: Zeda
Text:
It seems you've made up your mind.
Let’s hear your terms.

Name: Zeda
Text:
Oh... I didn't expect to hear Bailey's name from you.
Was it that obvious?

Name: Zeda
Text:
I had her running in circles all over the third floor,
specifically avoiding wherever you and Cyril were.

Name: Zeda
Text:
She would have either collapsed from exhaustion
or remained trapped here until she died...

Name: Zeda
Text:
Yet, thanks to you, her life was spared.
Such a pity. She's quite an eyesore, so I thought I'd finally rid myself of her.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What on earth could have happened between the two?)</>

Name: Zeda
Text: Now then, let's get on with the wager.

Name: Zeda
Text: Hold on... why don't we leave this to fate as well?

Name: Zeda
Text:
The choice is entirely yours.
Of course, that includes walking away from the wager.

Name: Zeda
Text: Have you... decided?

Name: Zeda
Text: No regrets, I presume?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I know the Phase Shift Device works. I've seen it enough.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Right now, playing it safe is the only way.)</>

I feel a tremendous force pulling me away.
When I open my eyes, only Zeda and I are standing in a place I’ve never seen before.

Name: Zeda
Text: You truly have no regrets, then?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What's familiar might be a trap.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Times like this call for a gamble.)</>

I feel a tremendous force pulling me away.
When I open my eyes, only Zeda and I are standing in a place I’ve never seen before.

Name: Zeda
Text: Humans truly never cease to amaze me.

Name: Zeda
Text: Wagering with someone who threatened kill your friends? Talk about ignoring your own safety.

Name: Zeda
Text:
Escape, forfeit... You could’ve had it easy.
Yet you choose self-sacrifice?

Name: Zeda
Text: Heh, Queen’s Explorers always keep their word.

Name: Zeda
Text: Let’s hope this isn't a meaningless sacrifice.

Name: Zeda
Text: Now, go vanquish Drugamu.

Name: Zeda
Text: Win, and I'll send Bailey, Cyril, and Nicola out of the tower. As promised.

Name: Zeda
Text:
....So, you won after all.
I’ll keep my word.

Name: Zeda
Text: Take this token.
ItemDesc: The monocle once worn by Zeda, the Queen’s Explorer of the third floor.

Name: Zeda
Text:
It's a monocle, yes, but also a part of Ozkan.
It’ll help you track the other Explorers.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Why give me this? Another trap?)</>

Name: Zeda
Text:
I refuse to be the only loser here.
Besides, I've never lost the first bet.

Name: Zeda
Text:
Hmm... leave quickly,
before I change my mind.

Name: Zeda
Text: The ones you're looking for should be at the Ancient Imperial Institute Ruins.

Name: Bailey
Text:
How did you even find this place?
Don’t mind those two. I’ll deal with them.

I explained how I found Cyril in the tower, 
and the wager I made with the Queen’s Explorer.

Name: Bailey
Text:
...You never change, do you?
But what's the point of catching the Queen’s Explorer on her good side?

Name: Bailey
Text:
I can't give you the details right now.
Let’s talk about it later.

Name: Bailey
Text:
For now, hand over that monocle.
Who knows what she did to it?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Swept up in her pace, I handed over the monocle without a word.)</>

Name: Bailey
Text:
And [player].
…thank you for surviving and finishing the job.

Name: Bailey
Text: The Springwater Raven Society will handle your reward.

Name: Disgruntled Girl
Text: Sigh... what should I do…

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Looks like she’s lost in thought...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She might be in some kind of trouble. Let's wait a bit.)</>

Name: Disgruntled Girl
Text:
Hey, who are you?
Why are you roaming around there?

Name: Disgruntled Girl
Text: Oh, right! Sekien told me to speak nicely—ahem.

Name: Disgruntled Girl
Text:
Might I ask who you are, you loiterer?
You see, I'm terribly shy, so I'd appreciate it if you'd leave me alone.

Name: [player]
Text: (She clearly has no idea what speaking nicely means...)

Name: Disgruntled Girl
Text:
Sigh... seriously, not this again.
Read this before you pry.
ItemDesc:
<To those wishing to help Naie>

Greetings, kind stranger.

This child travels of her own free will.
Please do not take her to any abbey or shelter.
She can live on her own just fine. 

However, an accident has caused some confusion in her memories.
Since proving her identity is difficult, I leave this note.

Should she ever be completely incapacitated,
please contact the Liberators of Knowledge through the nearest manor.

- Sekien, Liberator of Knowledge

Name: Naie
Text:
There, happy now?
Don't try to protect me just because I look little.

Name: Naie
Text: Huh? How did you even know that?

Name: Naie
Text:
Ah, you must be that errand-runner they call the 'Chosen One.'
Perfect. You can do a task for me too.

Name: Naie
Text:
I need you to look for fairy tales, legends, things like that.
Books, rumors, anything!

Name: Naie
Text:
...I barely remember a thing,
but my homeland is one of them.

Name: Naie
Text: I know I lived in a nation called Tan, but they say it's already fallen.

Name: Naie
Text:
It's been swallowed by the Krea Empire now,
so officially, Tan doesn't even exist.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(History written by victors, erased on purpose.)</>

Name: Naie
Text: So the only way left is to listen to the stories people pass down.

Name: Naie
Text:
Sekien saved me when I was on the brink of death.
She watched over me for over a dozen full moons.

Name: Naie
Text:
I don't want to worry her anymore... and she’s already incredibly busy.
That's why I’m doing this on my own.

Name: Naie
Text:
You get it, right? Let’s head to the village first.
I heard some folks from the East are there.

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text: What brings you here? Looking for something from a poor old soul like me…?

Name: Naie
Text:
Do you know anything about a kingdom called Tan?
It’s where I used to live, but they say it’s gone..

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(I step in to explain that her circumstances leave her a bit lacking in etiquette...)</>

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
Heh, why wonder about a fallen kingdom?
You're a bold one, but quite a strange little thing.

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
It was swallowed by Krea ages ago!
It happened long before I was even born.

Name: Naie
Text: Just how old are you, Granny? Has it really been that long?

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
I’ve lived three or four times longer than you, little lady.
Even a century-old veteran like me didn't see it happen.

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
It's been well over a century.
You're better off checking Krea's records.

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
Hmm... I heard from an old neighbor when I was a little girl,
that Tan fell because the Sentinel of the Deep Woods vanished.

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
I don’t know the details.
Oh, but there was a storybook he used to read to me quite often...

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
‘When the Sentinel's hair fluttered in the wind like a starlit milky way,
the wicked monsters were struck down.'

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
There was definitely a verse like that.
He handed it to me, saying it was the favorite of the kids in his hometown.

Name: Naie
Text:
A storybook? Let me see it too!
I want to know!

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
Oh? Hm, child, you look a bit like them.
Perhaps you're of Sentinel blood? Hehehe...

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
Go look over in that corner.
I bought those books for my grandkids, so it should be among them.

Name: Naie
Text:
It’s not here!
I want to know what the Sentinel has to do with Tan!

Name: Naie
Text: You just made it up because I look like a kid, didn't you? You're a mean old woman!

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
My, what a fierce little temper you've got.
Hold on a moment... now where did I put it...

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text: Ah, right! I gave it as collateral to borrow some coin from the pawnshop.

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
The owner there collects antiques…
Since I haven't paid him back yet, it should still be there.

Name: Naie
Text: If you’re lying to me again, you’d better watch out!

Name: Naie
Text: ...I mean, please watch out! Hmph.

Name: Kind-Looking Old Man
Text:
Hehehe. Go look for a man named Netan over there.
I hope he’s still around.

Name: Naie
Text:
Mister! You have that book about the Sentinel of the Deep Woods, right?
I need it, so hand it ov... please give it to me!

Name: Netan
Text:
I don’t have to give you anything.
What is this insolent brat doing here?

Name: Netan
Text:
Are you this child's guardian?
She has no manners at all. Teach her properly.

Name: Netan
Text:
And I am no ordinary merchant!
I am the master of this pawnshop, third generation!

Name: Netan
Text:
So... lending coin is fine,
but giving back a collateral for free goes against my rules.

Name: Naie
Text:
But it's a storybook about Tan!
I need it to find my memories!

Name: Netan
Text:
You might have your reasons, but do you think I'll just give it away?
If you want something, pay the price.

Name: Netan
Text:
Besides, what you're asking for is a very rare ancient book!
It might be the last copy left in the world!

Name: Netan
Text:
Do you even know that the Krea Empire beyond the barrier
conquered every kingdom out in the east?

Name: Netan
Text:
Krea erased the records of any country that resisted.
The last fallen kingdom, Tan, was no exception.

Name: Netan
Text:
The Empire destroyed every culture and language,
all for their grand ambition of building a unified empire.

Name: Netan
Text:
This book survived all that ruin...
Do you understand its value now, brat?

Name: Naie
Text:
I don't care about any of that!
Can't you just let me read it... please?

Name: Naie
Text: All I know is Tan is my home!

Name: Netan
Text:
Ha! You look like a teenager at most,
and you want me to believe you were born a century ago?

Name: Netan
Text:
That face belongs to someone who’s a hundred years old?
Don't make me laugh!

Name: Naie
Text: I don’t care! I don’t know! I can't remember either, so how should I know?

Name: Naie
Text:
Is it really that hard to just let me read it?!
Just lend it to me for a second... please!

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Things are getting too heated. I should explain the situation to the master.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I quietly let him know that her memory is not good because of an accident.)</>

Name: Netan
Text:
Sigh... Count yourself lucky that I’m a generous man.
Bring me coin or a collateral, and I'll reconsider.

Name: Naie
Text: …Just you wait! I'll be back in a heartbeat!

Name: Naie
Text:
I might be small, but I can dual-wield blades.
I can take down monsters in no time.

Name: Naie
Text:
Most adults wouldn't stand a chance against me.
I'll use my skills to find something to use as collateral.

Name: Naie
Text:
Think about it. Sekien let me travel alone even knowing my condition.
It's because there’s nothing to worry about.

Name: Naie
Text:
Even though I've forgotten almost everything...
my body remembers how to fight.

Name: Naie
Text:
That's why since I left my sickbed, I've been Sekien's escort.
They didn’t let me join the Liberators of Knowledge for nothing.

Name: Naie
Text:
I’m the best fighter among all the Liberators.
Way better than those fools who just sit and study all day.

Name: Naie
Text: I overheard some kids talking. They said if you head southeast from here—

Name: Naie
Text:
There’s a place called the Dragon's Hoard!
If we ransack the place, we might find something valuable there.

Name: Naie
Text: Let’s hurry before that pawnshop master changes his mind.

Name: Naie
Text: Follow this path into the cavern, and that's the Dragon's Hoard.

Name: Naie
Text:
Old stories from the East talk about dragons all the time.
It’s even in the history books of Krea and Tan.

Name: Naie
Text:
They say dragons love shiny things and hoard them in their nests.
A place like that is perfect for stashing treasure.

Name: Naie
Text:
Honestly, I used to hunt for caves myself, wondering if it was true.
I gave up after finding just a few gold coins, but... wait.

Name: Naie
Text:
What's going on? How do I even know this?
Did I see it in a dream? I don't remember reading any books that—

Name: Naie
Text:
Ugh... everything is turning into a total mess inside my head...
I don't know what's what anymore...

Name: Naie
Text: Pant, gasp... Whew... Huff...

Name: Naie
Text: ...... Whew, ha!

Name: Naie
Text:
I think I can move now.
Wow, that headache was so bad, I thought I was going to pass out.

Name: Naie
Text:
I'll have to ask Sekien for a checkup later.
Hey, Chosen One, I'm fine now, so just forget what happened.

Name: Naie
Text: Every second counts! Let's get inside.

Name: Naie
Text:
Well, we cleared them out anyway—now let's hunt for something valuable.
Things that look like they'd fetch a good price.

Name: Naie
Text:
Let's grab everything that glitters or looks ancient.
We’ll make up for quality with quantity, hehe.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Are these children from that Twisted Elysium?
They're staring at Naie like she's a rare animal.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Sounds like they're singing a song...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Twinkle, twinkle... little white star... how you dance so beautifully...)</>

Name: Cheerful Kid
Text:
Big sister! Were you in the Star Forest too? Were you?
That’s why your hair looks just like the milky way!

Name: Cheerful Kid
Text:
My granny told meee—
her granny, and her grandpa, they all went to the Star Forest!

Name: Cheery Kid
Text:
Uh.. Uh? I'm not supposed to talk about the Star Forest!
If I do, a Sentinel will catch me!

Name: Cheery Kid
Text: Even the forest itself is a secret. We're supposed to keep it to ourselves.

Name: Naie
Text: Look... stop whining and just step aside, please...

Name: Naie
Text: Do something about them! I told you, I'm terrible with strangers...!

Name: Naie
Text:
Ugh, why don't kids these days ever listen?!
They're so tiny, I'll hurt them if I push them away.

Name: Cheery Kid
Text:
She’s not a Sentinel.
If the Sentinels were still alive, they’d be over a hundred years old.

Name: Cheery Kid
Text:
But she’s barely any taller than us.
If she were a Sentinel, her face would be super wrinkly!

Name: Cheerful Kid
Text:
Nuh-uh! I know she is!
It’s right there in our song.

Name: Cheerful Kid
Text:
Big sister! Hurry, show us your swords!
The Sentinels fight with a blade in each hand!

Name: Cheery Kid
Text: Dummy. How can you tell someone from a song?!

Name: Cheery Kid
Text: Besides, the grown-ups told us to forget about the Star Forest because it's gone.

Name: Cheerful Kid
Text:
Hmph! You memorized everything about the Star Forest yourself...
I know you want to meet a Sentinel too.

Name: Naie
Text:
You kids are way too close!
Take a step... no, three steps back.

Name: Naie
Text: Move back, and I'll listen to your story about the Star Forest or the Sentinel.

Only then did the children step back, their eyes gleaming.
However, Naie quickly scared them off, warning them that monsters would come out...

Name: Naie
Text: The kids had no manners!

Name: Naie
Text:
Babbling about things only they know,
saying I look like someone, and calling me a hundred-year-old.

Name: Naie
Text: I should've sent them away from the start, but talking to them was... a bit hard.

Name: Naie
Text:
Hey, it's not like I heartlessly shoved them away!
This place is crawling with monsters!

Name: Naie
Text: Though... I did want to hear a tiny bit more of their story.

Name: Naie
Text:
The Star Forest and the Sentinels? Those words sound familiar for some reason.
I know I haven’t heard them before. It’s really weird.

Name: Naie
Text: Anyway, I found this ancient dagger. What about you?

Name: Naie
Text: Hmm, looks decent. Let’s use these to bargain.

Name: Naie
Text:
If he says no... yes!
We’ll just tell everyone he's a fake merchant who sells garbage.

Name: Naie
Text:
Then he'll be run out of town for sure!
Hehehe, that storybook is already mine!

Name: Netan
Text: Ha! Judging by that smug look, you must have brought back something good.

Name: Netan
Text: It better be worth as much as that book you want so badly.

Name: Naie
Text:
Hmph! Do you have any idea where I’ve been?
You couldn’t even imagine it, Mister Master!

Name: Naie
Text: This was 'unearthed' from a dragon's nest, so handle it with care!

Name: Netan
Text:
What? You actually went into a dragon's nest?!
Even mercenaries avoid that place to save their own skins.

Name: Netan
Text:
Never mind the dragon’s treasure…
I hear everyone's getting wiped out by the monsters at the entrance.

Name: Netan
Text:
Sounds like your friend has some serious skills.
Assuming, of course... your friend actually went there!

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(I held out the dagger Naie picked up and the gold coin I found.)</>

Name: Netan
Text: Hmmmm...

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Netan, the pawnshop owner, furrowed his brow as if racking his brain.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(He looked back and forth between the dagger's hilt and the crest on the back of the gold coin,
took out a magnifying glass to inspect them, then spoke with his jaw dropped.)</>

Name: Netan
Text:
Here you go! The storybook you asked for.
Handle it with care.

Name: Netan
Text:
You brought me some quite valuable items,
so I'll consider the loan you took out against this book paid in full.

Name: Naie
Text:
Heh! I knew it.
I fought through monsters to get them, so of course they are good stuff.

Name: Netan
Text:
It might be treasures from a kingdom annexed by the Crea Empire.
The style’s Eastern, but it's definitely not from Crea.

Name: Netan
Text:
Tan's style is usually softer...
Could this technique be from the Bruheria Kingdom? Hmm...

Name: Netan
Text:
Anyway, don't just start reading it. Go give Granny Kuren the good news first.
Tell her she doesn't need to pay back the loan.

Name: Naie
Text:
W-Wait a minute…
I'm feeling dizzy... Is this book cursed with magic or something...?

Name: Naie
Text: The moment I looked at this illustration, I thought it was going to jump right out at me.

Name: Naie
Text: It hasn't even been that long since Sekien treated me, phew.

Name: Naie
Text:
It happens sometimes. I'll just have to push through until I get used to it.
See? I'm already feeling better.

Name: Naie
Text: It feels a bit sketchy. I'll let Granny know before I read it again.

Name: Granny Kuren
Text:
Oh my... it seems my time has finally come...
The Sentinel has come to escort me in person!

Name: Granny Kuren
Text:
Wait... you’re a bit shorter than I imagined...?
My failing eyes can't quite tell.

Name: Granny Kuren
Text:
And what happened to the daggers you always kept in your hands?
When did your hair turn so white?

Name: Naie
Text:
Granny? Granny Kuren!?
Here we are again with the Sentinel talk.

Name: Naie
Text:
I brought your storybook back.
Do you mind if I read it a bit before you give it to your grandkids?

Name: Granny Kuren
Text:
...Oh dear, oh dear! I must have been rambling again.
But no matter how much I look, you two look so alike.

Name: Granny Kuren
Text:
You should ask your elders about it whenever you return to your hometown.
Who knows? You might just be of the Sentinel's bloodline...

Name: Granny Kuren
Text:
Now... where were we in the story.
What were you saying just a moment ago? Something about the book?

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(When I calmly explained the situation at the pawnshop to the old woman,
she breathed a sigh of relief and rejoiced.)</>

Name: Granny Kuren
Text:
Thank goodness, what a relief.
I was worried because I had no way to get the money right away.

Name: Granny Kuren
Text:
You can keep the book.
I'll be heading to the Star Forest soon. Wwhat use do I have for worldly possessions?

Name: Granny Kuren
Text: I still have plenty of other stories to tell my grandchildren, so please take it.

Name: Naie
Text:
No taking it back now... okay?
I thought I might have memorize it, so this works out just perfectly, heh.

Name: Naie
Text:
There isn't a single accurate thing in here.
They made such a fuss about it being the last copy. I actually had high hopes.

Name: Naie
Text:
For starters, they shouldn't have described the Sentinel’s hair as "resembling the Milky Way."
The role of the Sentinel wasn't held by just one person.

Name: Naie
Text:
The last Sentinel had brown hair.
The one before had hair like a bright wheat field.

Name: Naie
Text:
You'd have to go back several generations to find a silver-haired Sentinel.
Hmph! Why does hair color even matter for someone guarding the Star Forest...?

Name: Naie
Text: Huh?! How do I know this?

Name: Naie
Text:
No, no, the words just slipped out!
I was focusing so hard for the words "Tan Kingdom" to show up.

Name: Naie
Text: Ugh... So weird... My head is starting to pound...

Name: Naie
Text:
Something might be wrong with the body.
I haven't run out of power already, have I?

Name: Naie
Text:
I think... we need to head back to Sekien.
She should be around here by now.
ItemDesc:
A rough map of the entire Snowfield is displayed.
I see a small dot in the northeast side, with the name 'Sekien' written next to it.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(...Isn't that near the building the Paradise Advent Society used?
Are the Liberators still interested in that place?)</>

Name: Naie
Text:
We have to get going.
If my body suddenly shuts down, I'll need you to carry me.

Name: Naie
Text: I need to save my energy. I'll explain when we arrive, so just follow me.

Naie, who had remained silent, collapsed the moment we arrived.
The girl who appeared to be 'Sekien' simply gazed at me calmly.

Name: Kind-Looking Girl
Text:
Ah, don't worry.
She ran low on Aether and entered a dormant state.

Name: Kind-Looking Girl
Text:
You can come closer and inspect her.
Though you won't find anything particularly strange.

Name: Sekien
Text:
You thought she didn't look like a living creature, right?
You'd be correct.

Name: Sekien
Text:
That's not a human body. It shuts down when power runs out.
It's completely normal.

Name: Sekien
Text: When I first found her, her original body had reached the end of its lifespan.

Name: Sekien
Text:
To transfer her consciousness before it completely faded out...
I had to take certain measures.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Have you ever met the warden of the Tower? Hehe.
Similar bodies.

Name: Sekien
Text:
The Lagar Tribe-
Think of it as a high-performance doll designed to look human.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Naie is sustaining her life within that doll-like shell.
She had died, but I gave her a new body.

Name: Sekien
Text: Don't... interrupt me. I'm talking here.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Want me to put it in simpler terms?
I gave Naie the same type of body used to create the Lagar Tribe.

Name: Sekien
Text:
I transfered this child's consciousness directly, instead of going through the protocol. 
Thanks to the model’s excellent default specs, there were few compatibility issues.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Meaning she wouldn't lose to that Manager in close combat... Phew.
Do you understand?

Name: Sekien
Text:
Take your time.
It's not too late to handle matters on this end first.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Because I, the First Liberator, arrived after you did.
To think those Elsetia worms had the book of prophecy.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Not to mention, they also hold the key to the control room...
It makes investigating extremely inconvenient.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Still, you're on good terms with the other Liberators.
I just need the information.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Let's head inside together.
Since we're working together, it's best not to hide anything, right?

Name: Sekien
Text:
The Ancient Empire wouldn't have used the Ark just for casual sailing.
They must have packed it with special functions, much like the Giant's Tower.

Name: Sekien
Text: So, I wondered if the Ark might be mentioned in the prophecy.

Name: Sekien
Text:
But securing the prophecy through you would not be simple.
The Divine, the Legation... those people would refuse.

Name: Sekien
Text:
That's why I came here, hoping to find a transcript.
Since it's an important item, it must belong to a high-ranking worm...

Name: Sekien
Text:
This podium must have been used by their leader, right?
Then there might be a chance, however small.

Name: Sekien
Text: Let's check for any hidden drawers or mechanisms.

Name: Sekien
Text:
I let Naie roam around in that body...
because of a small expectation I had.

Name: Sekien
Text:
I had no reason to stop her from trying to recover her memories, and
I hoped she might bring back some clues in the process.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Interrogations are tedious and time-consuming.
Crucially, you have to deal with far too many humans.

Name: Sekien
Text:
It must be a tall order for a shy one like her,
but she'd still do a better job than I would with my temper.

Name: Sekien
Text:
If Naie picked up on anything while wandering around Elysium,
I was planning to analyze it.

Name: Sekien
Text: Hehe, I suppose it's time to reboot my friend's body.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Since I came up empty here, 
I want to see if Naie managed to stumble upon something.

Name: Sekien
Text:
I'll meet you in the southwest part of the plateau.
I'll bring Naie along, so don't worry.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Touching this will take you to my subspace.
That's where I plan to collect Aether.

Name: Sekien
Text:
I've prepared plenty of power sources,
so I can draw upon it whenever needed.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Aether is what powers Naie's body.
It's typically found highly concentrated in living organisms.

Name: Sekien
Text:
I'll lend you the 'Aether Collector'.
Just activate it wherever you sense Aether.

Name: Sekien
Text:
I'll explain the rest after we relocate.
Follow me.

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(It's so quiet... and chilly. Actually, it's as freezing as the Snowfield.
It feels similar to the place where I met the Tower Warden...)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(She uses a space like this for herself?
Moving freely is impressive enough... Does she use magic?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(Even a brilliant mage like Beretta never demonstrated a feat like this.
If it works on a similar principle to Valbas's teleportation magic...)</>

Name: Sekien
Text: It might feel a bit chilly, but please bear with it.

Name: Sekien
Text:
I always move her here whenever she shuts down.
So I decided to keep the temperature down at all times.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Naie's body requires low temperatures for preservation.
It's highly sensitive to environmental parameters.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Anyway... this is where I keep my collection of special artifacts and organisms.
Sometimes I unleash monsters in here to run experiments.

Name: Sekien
Text:
That’s right. It’s an environment incredibly rich in Aether.
If we're pressed for time, we can always extract it directly from the monsters here.

Name: Sekien
Text: Lately, I've neglected this place while searching for the Ark...

Name: Sekien
Text: Even with the collector, detecting the Aether has to come first, right?

Name: Sekien
Text:
But it's quite a strenuous task for me...
It takes up a lot of time.

Name: Sekien
Text:
But since your 'Gudua Manifestation Rate' is exceptionally high,
it will be so much easier for you.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Mmm... I suppose that covers all the explanations.
Now, let's get moving for Naie's sake.
Shortly after I finished extracting Aether from the fallen monsters, Sekien approached me.

Name: Sekien
Text:
You've certainly gathered much more than I could have.
This should keep her running for at least half a month.

Name: Sekien
Text:
A warm place would be better for thawing you out, right, Naie?
Yeah... I'm sure you'd agree if you were awake.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Alright then, Chosen One.
I'm going to teleport all three of us at once, so keep your eyes shut tight.

Name: Sekien
Text: Naie is rather shy around new people.

Name: Sekien
Text:
She claims to have a daily quota for conversations or something.
She says talking too much drains her, and she needs to rest somewhere secluded.

Name: Sekien
Text:
In that regard, this is the perfect spot.
Besides, a height like this is no big deal for you, is it?

Name: Sekien
Text:
Aether is an essential element, not just for humans, flora, and fauna,
but for artificial lifeforms as well.

Name: Sekien
Text:
When Naie’s system shuts down from Aether deficiency,
she thinks she faints because her body hasn't fully recovered.

Name: Sekien
Text: I have no intention of telling her the truth.

Name: Sekien
Text:
It started out of a bit of sympathy.
But now, I genuinely want Naie to live a long life.

Name: Sekien
Text: Forging her own path in her new life.

Name: Sekien
Text: Her desire to recover her memories is instinctive, so it's not my place to interfere.

Name: Sekien
Text:
More importantly, I have nothing I could tell her anyway.
Finding and saving Naie was purely a coincidence.

Name: Sekien
Text:
How she ended up covered in so many wounds-
and lay collapsed on the grounds of the old Tan Kingdom, I have no idea.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Does Sekien truly know nothing? Either way, it's not my place to pry...)</>

Name: Sekien
Text: Enough chitchat. Shall we wake our sleeping princess?

As I carefully pulled out the artifact Sekien had given me-
Aether began flowing into Naie.
Before long, Naie sat up as if she had just woken from a deep sleep.

Name: Naie
Text: Ugh... Did I... pass out again...?

Name: Sekien
Text:
You're okay now, Naie.
I applied the usual measures, so you should be good to move.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Still, I'm just glad you managed to pass out in front of me this time.
I told you not to push yourself so hard.

Name: Naie
Text:
I let my errand runner handle all the fighting!
Plus, this time I actually remembered something that might be from my past.

Name: Naie
Text:
Though I can't really tell if it's from an old dream, my imagination, or an actual memory.
Anyway, there was progress.

Name: Sekien
Text: You've been so unstable since the accident, you never know when or where you'll shut down.

Name: Sekien
Text:
Besides, we Liberators travel to the most remote places.
If you suddenly collapse... there's a high chance nobody would even notice...!

Name: Sekien
Text:
Just like when I first found you... If you fall into a coma...
To the Giant's Tower... Spare parts... to preserve you again...

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Does that mean if Naie's body is damaged... she has to go to the Tower?)</>

Name: Naie
Text:
What? Why did you trail off?
What about the Tower?

Name: Sekien
Text:
...H-How about I threaten to send you on a mission to the Tower?
It really worries me when my dear friend won't listen to a word I say.

Name: Naie
Text:
Eek! So that’s how you want to play it?
You know how much I hate the Giant's Tower!

Name: Naie
Text:
Ugh, I’ll be extra careful, okay?
I'll be traveling with the Chosen One for a while, so just tell this one to keep an eye on me!

Name: Sekien
Text:
Hehe, if you get severely injured, you'll have no choice but to visit the Tower anyway.
You understand what I said, right?

Name: Naie
Text:
Bullying me with that smile... I should make a run for it.
Shall I go back to snooping around Dowonhyang?

Name: Naie
Text:
Ah! Sekien, since you're here, let's chat for a second.
Aren't you curious about what I've dug up so far?

Name: Sekien
Text: Alright, you might just have what I'm looking for.

Name: Naie
Text:
Chosen One, head over to the Elysium central hub first.
I'll be right behind you.

Name: Naie
Text: Word is that people called the 'Descendants of Tahn' frequently pass through here.

Name: Naie
Text:
They live in a nameless village,
and use this place as a middle ground for trading with hunters.

Name: Naie
Text:
If they're the Descendants of Tan, they have to know something!
There's no other reason they'd use that name, right?

Name: Naie
Text:
First up, that man and that woman over there,
and maybe that person who looks like having quite a story to tell!

Name: Naie
Text:
All three look like they're from the East, so they might know a thing or two.
I'll, um... try talking to the elders.

Name: Naie
Text: You have to be older to know all the ancient tales, right?

Name: Naie
Text:
They might just spill all their secrets since they see me as a kid.
That's my plan, so you go check out that side.

Name: Passionate Man
Text: Oh, an outsider? Pleased to meet you.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Ask about Tan.)</>

Name: Passionate Man
Text: Are you also joining our grand cause to restore Tan?!

Name: Passionate Man
Text:
Excellent... but we must tread very carefully,
if we are to revive the beautiful Tan Kingdom.

Name: Passionate Man
Text:
Crea completely erased all of our records, but-
but there is still one thing they could never touch.

Name: Passionate Man
Text: The tales passed down from our ancestors... are very much alive!

Name: Passionate Man
Text:
Picture it: returning to the rightful territory of Tan.
Basking in the glory of the stolen Star Forest and radiant dawns!

Name: Passionate Man
Text: The very sanctuary where the people of the Tan Kingdom lay to rest.

Name: Passionate Man
Text:
Dying in this forsaken wasteland has absolutely no meaning!
The Descendants of Tan can only find true rest within the Star Forest.

Name: Passionate Man
Text:
To achieve this, we must reclaim the lands stolen by Crea.
I am overjoyed that you're lending us your strength!

Name: Passionate Man
Text:
Let's not stand here chatting; let's go discuss this in detail.
My comrades are right over-

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text:
You've got quite the face.
I like it. Won't you blossom as a night flower with me?

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text: Oh my!Bellamor's way of greeting must be unfamiliar to you.

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text:
Makes sense if you've been living out in these abandoned lands.
You definitely look like a seasoned mercenary.

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text:
In Bellamor, the land of love and poetry-
we often weave in sweet words to express our affection.

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text:
Oh my, is it true the ancestors of the residents here hail from Tan?
Do you share those same roots?

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text:
Come on, tell me everything about Tan's culture.
I'm a playwright who traveled all this way to study it.

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text: Yes, it's a place that deeply values art and culture.

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text:
I only say this because we are outside the Crea Empire,
but we firmly believe that grand unity can be achieved through love.

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text:
Pointing swords and spears at one another is just so barbaric!
I would never script tales of war into my plays.

Name: [player]
Text: (Are there other countries to the east beside Krea? I should ask.)

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text:
You really don't know anything, do you?
Krea has already swallowed up several countries as vassal states.

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text:
When their 'imperialization' project began,
Bellamor surrendered immediately and became a vassal state as well.

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text:
Well, I suppose that's better than turning into an Ember-Choke Grove like the Kingdom of Tan did?
At least our cultural heritage survived.

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text:
I heard the final battleground was some sort of forest...
They say a fire started there and spread across the entire country.

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text: If Tahn had only given up sooner, things wouldn't have gone that far.

Name: Fair-Looking Woman
Text:
Hmph! That was probably too dark for our first meeting.
Let's spend a more romantic time together next time.

Name: Hollow-Looking Woman
Text:
All things in the world shall cease to exist.
Those who sleep in oblivion, and those who revel in screams, shall all be submerged together...

Name: Hollow-Looking Woman
Text:
Bruheria shall be its messenger, the wayfarer who shall appear once more-
Repent, pray, and meditate.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(...Looks mentally unstable… A religious fanatic, perhaps.)</>

Name: Hollow-Looking Woman
Text:
The cycle has already begun...
Behold the proof of the blessing bestowed upon our 'Tan'.

Name: Hollow-Looking Woman
Text: It has paved the way to walk alongside the dead.

Name: Hollow-Looking Woman
Text:
To sever causalities and constraints, to reach Naunet.
It was Bruheria that pushed Tahn over the edge!

Name: Hollow-Looking Woman
Text:
Our magic shall stir those who lie beneath the earth-
and  finally guide all beings.

Name: Hollow-Looking Woman
Text: Hehe... Hahaha...

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(...Lying beneath the earth... It means corpses.
It can’t be about raising the dead, is it...?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(I don't understand it, but let's go tell Naie.
She can interpret it herself.)</>

Name: Naie
Text:
Your timing’s spot on.
I did an errand here and received a storybook.

Name: Naie
Text:
It's not a rare antique. Just something you can find if you ask around.
Ah, it’s from Krea, beyond the barrier.

Name: Naie
Text:
Did you find out anything? It doesn't have to be a legend or a myth.
Rumors, children's songs... anything works.

Name: Naie
Text:
You need some time to gather your thoughts, right?
Let's read this first then.

Name: Naie
Text: "There once lived a very greedy dragon, who loved gold and jewels so much that it hoarded them in a cave and made it its home."

Name: Naie
ItemDesc:
"The dragon tormented people and destroyed their homes for even more treasure.
But no one could stop the terrifying dragon."

Name: Naie
ItemDesc:
"Then one day, a penniless human entered the cave.
The human ran away with sparkling treasure while the dragon was asleep."

Name: Naie
ItemDesc:
"The dragon woke up furious to find its precious treasure gone.
The dragon chased the poor human and breathed fire on their village."

Name: Naie
ItemDesc:
"But the dragon didn't even realize it had burned everything down,
and went back home because it got hungry while searching for treasure."

Name: Naie
ItemDesc:
"Then, something astonishing happened!
A warrior named Orpu appeared, vowing revenge against the dragon."

Name: Naie
ItemDesc:
"Armed with courage and anger, Orpu charged at the dragon.
The dragon underestimated the warrior and got stabbed in the back of the neck!"

Name: Naie
Text:
"The dragon fled far away, never to beseen again.
The brave warrior became known as the 'Guardian' and lived happily ever after."

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(A story of a hero who defeated an evil dragon...
It's a fairy tale teaching that the greedy will be punished.)</>

Name: Naie
Text:
This is a book for kids? The story is way too complicated.
How are they supposed to understand the concept of covering your blind spots?

Name: Naie
Text:
The bigger you are compared to your opponent, the more you need to cover your weaknesses!
Of course the warrior went for the weak spot. Why did this stupid dragon let its guard down?

Name: Naie
Text:
And this Guardian, too.
He should have hunted down the enemy. That's his duty and responsibility.

Name: Naie
Text:
Besides, the Guardian I know wasn't happy, and definitely didn't live forever.
Always suffering... Ugh, my head again...

Name: Naie
Text:
I felt like I was about to remember something, but then it got blurry again...
I'd better listen to your story first...

When I shared the conversations with the three people who gave completely different answers,
Naie nodded as if she realized something.

Name: Naie
Text:
This imperialization project must be a war of conquest, right?
And Bruheria sounds like a cult of lunatics.

Name: Naie
Text:
And those guys granted a blessing? Some blessing that is.
Maybe they sent the dead to cause chaos...

Name: Naie
Text:
Ugh, I should have listened when Sekien offered to teach me the basics.
I would have figured this out so much faster!
<yellow>(It seems like insight born from experience, but is this also part of the memory?)</>

Name: Naie
Text: But... I wonder if it’s still just ashes?

Name: Naie
Text:
It would feel terrible if my hometown burned down.
Although, I'm with the Liberators of Knowledge now...

Name: Naie
Text:
Phew, should we wrap things up here and head to the Bardad Expedition?
They are a smart bunch. I should be able to get some high-quality information.

Name: Tired Man
Text: Who is it?... Phew... I hope you weren't sent by Advisor Chedar...

Name: Tired Man
Text:
No... I'm just a member of the Explorers Guild...
We're currently closed, so I'd appreciate it if you left me alone...

Name: Tired Man
Text:
...Just a moment.
You brought a kid, with so many monsters around?!

Name: Dan
Text:
I am 'Dan' from the Explorers Guild.
I'll stake my title on ensuring the kid’s safety, so leave her here.

Name: Naie
Text: W-what, are you talking about me?

Name: Naie
Text:
Hey- I’m a grown up inside.
I just lost my memory! I might actually be an adult who's just short!

Name: Naie
Text:
I don't need anyone's protection… sir.
Just tell me if you're with the expedition or not… sir.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Not trying to hide her disdain with the current situation, Naie politely explained things to Dan.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Dan apologized, saying she reminded him of his younger sister,
but Naie grumbled at him not to judge based on appearance.)</>

Name: Dan
Text:
I'm sorry if I offended you...
Truth is, I haven't been sleeping well because I've been working day and night.

Name: Dan
Text:
I have to handle orders from the guild, and paint some drawings...
I need to earn money for my sister's medicine... Yawn...

Name: Dan
Text:
I'm staying here on the condition that I help Chedar, who’s in charge.
But we are severely short-handed here.

Name: Dan
Text:
At this rate, I won't have time for my guild work while I'm stuck running errands for Chedar...
I also need to finish a new storybook for my sister.

Name: Naie
Text: A storybook? Are the drawings for the storybook?

Name: Naie
Text:
Then do you know this one?
It's a book called the Tale of Orpu.

Name: Dan
Text:
Ah, I wrote that.
I wrote it to read to my sister when she was sick in bed.

Name: Dan
Text:
But somehow, word of mouth spread.
So I ended up donating quite a few copies for people in need.

Name: Dan
Text:
It looks like you have one of those copies.
While working on that, I only slept once every three or four days... Phew.

Name: Dan
Text: It's not easy finding sources for stories that kids would actually like.

Name: Dan
Text:
I got this story while helping an elder who's well over a hundred years old,
W, wait! It's a story I heard when his memories briefly returned.

Name: Dan
Text:
Still, it makes me proud to meet a reader other than my sister.
It feels like it relieved my fatigue somewhat, at least for a moment.

Name: Naie
Text:
Then it’s true, isn’t it?
The Tale of Orpu is based on a true story, right? Right?

Name: Dan
Text:
I believe the original legend of the 'Dragonslayer' is highly credible.
The elder explained it in great detail.

Name: Dan
Text:
I'd love to tell you all about it right now, 
but could you wait until I finish working on the drawings?

Name: Dan
Text:
Considering the time it takes for the dye to dry, I need to wrap this up quickly.
That's the only way I can meet my deadline.

Name: Naie
Text: Got it. I'll be nearby. Call me when you're done!

Name: Dan
Text:
The story in the book is a heavily adapted version. I wrote down the original story here.
Of course, details probably got embellished as it was passed down through generations... So keep that in mind.
ItemDesc:
A huge and greedy dragon lived in the Kingdom of Tan.
- The narrator emphasized its wings and claws three times.

The dragon nested in something called an 'Ark' that was even larger than itself, hoarding gold and silver stolen from humans.
- Ark: WIll investigate further. Should I leave this out of the fairy tale? I guess I’ll sleep on it…

A notorious debtor from a village near the Star Forest stole the dragon's prized golden chalice and fled. The enraged dragon massacred the villagers... Everyone died except Orpu, who had been working in the neighboring village (Orpu's family died as well).
- The story also mentions that people began to name their newborns Orpu to wish them a long life. 

Orpu fought the dragon for a fortnight and emerged victorious, plucking a dragon scale to decorate his sword as proof. He became known as the Dragonslayer and the Guardian of the Kingdom of Tan, and melted down all the treasures inside the Ark.
- The narrator explains that the sword has changed hands, passed down through generations as a family heirloom, and claims to have heard the same story from several treasure hunters.

Name: Dan
Text: Ah, there's also something I couldn't write down because I ran out of space.

Name: Dan
Text:
When Orpu shouted, 'I will set the entire Ark ablaze and take my revenge!'...
the dragon apparently got scared and couldn't fight properly.

Name: Dan
Text:
Supposedly because it loved its treasure too much...
But I left it out, because It felt too exaggerated.

Name: Naie
Text:
This Orpu guy is incredible.
If he had just taken that whole Ark for himself, he could have lived in absolute luxury.

Name: Naie
Text:
If it were me, I would have gladly accepted the title of Guardian!
I would have distributed the treasure to the people and saved them from starvation.

Name: Dan
Text:
Even so, his descendants likely upheld the spirit of the Dragonslayer.
After all, they’ve been praised as an honorable family generation after generation.

Name: Dan
Text:
Phew... Now I really should go handle my Explorers Guild duties.
I need to get them over with and catch a quick nap.

Name: Dan
Text:
There are no other handwritten copies of this... but I'll give it to you as a gift for being a fan.
I’ve got the whole story memorized, so it's fine.

Name: Dan
Text:
And I don’t know much about the sword and dragon scale.
If you're curious, you should go see Chedar.

Name: Naie
Text: I was already curious about the sword, because I'm an ambidextrous swordsman!

Name: Naie
Text:
Got it, Storybook Writer.
Tell your sister I hope she feels better soon!

Name: Dan
Text: Thank you... Please just don't come back with even more errands from there---!

Name: Chedar
Text: Aallowance request form, official cooperation request form for night search operations...

Name: Chedar
Text:
Ah, where did I put it? It’s so hectic in here.
Why are there so many things to stamp!

Name: Chedar
Text: What do you want? Do you need an overtime request form or something?

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(When I showed her the storybook and asked about the sword and scale,
Chedar smiled in amusement.)</>

Name: Chedar
Text: It's been a while since someone brought up something other than ancient civilization relics.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Special materials discovered in nature or left behind by creatures...
Around here, we call those Artifacts.

Name: Chedar
Text:
You said it's a book containing a story of the Kingdom of Tan?
The story ends with the hero driving the dragon away, an end fitting for a kingdom of hunters.

Name: Naie
Text:
Can a human really take a real dragon's scale?
And decorate a sword with it?

Name: Naie
Text:
How come this Ark can fit so much treasure?
Is it near the Star Forest in the Kingdom of Tan? Are you sure?

Name: Naie
Text:
Do you happen to know about the Star Forest too?
From what I found, it seems to have burned down a long time ago...

Name: Chedar
Text:
Calm down and listen carefully, kiddo.
I'll take note of everything you're curious about for now.

Name: Chedar
Text: There might be some relevant information in the archives I keep here.

Name: Naie
Text: ...You're just brushing me off because I look like a kid.

Name: Naie
Text:
I can't take this anymore!
If I’d known, I would've just played sick and stayed in bed.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Oh my, no! It's just I have an urgent matter to attend to.
Sorry for calling you a kid—I'm just incredibly busy.

Name: Chedar
Text:
If you help me with one annoying task,
I'll find what you're looking for.

Name: Chedar
Text:
You have no idea how well I treat people with similar interests.
There's a lot you can learn if you stay here.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(..She’s not trying to secure a new worker for the outpost, is she?)</>

Name: Naie
Text: What do you need help with?
ItemDesc:
A device so large that an adult can barely lift it with two hands.
It seems about the size of Naie's head... but let's ignore that for now.

Name: Chedar
Text:
It's a wavelength amplification device.
It's a tool built to warn us when monsters come. You just need to install it at the entrance.

Name: Chedar
Text: The ground here is weak, and we have a lot of vital research data.

Name: Naie
Text:
I noticed on my way in that most people here are non-combatants.
To protect them... Hmm...

Name: Chedar
Text:
Exactly, so we need to reinforce the security system whenever we have the time.
Anyway, I'll assume you understand the goal of this task! Good luck!

Name: Chedar
Text: Great, we’re getting a good signal. Everything is properly installed.

Name: Chedar
Text:
And! In this massive mountain of paperwork,
I managed to find a research report on the Kingdom of Tahn.

Name: Chedar
Text: It's highly technical, so don't expect any fairy tales, legends, or myths.

Name: Naie
Text:
I'll read it and decide for myself.
Hurry up and give it to me... Please.

Name: Chedar
Text: Arrogant one second, polite the next. You're a funny one, hehe.
ItemName: <Survey Results of Old Kingdoms Near Elysium - For 1st Report>
ItemDesc:
Target Area: Former territories of Tahn and Bruheria (Currently forming the southwestern part of the Krea Empire)
Objective: Secure unidentified objects and Warp Anchor installation points

Summary of Results:
- No dragon species or subspecies were discovered in the 'Star Forest' cited in the natives’ testimonies.
However, delivered five scales of a creature presumed to be a root species to the expedition headquarters.
- Discovered ground severely gouged by a massive structure.
- Failed to discover the entity that left the tracks.
- Numerous metal lumps found nearby.
- Secured heavily rusted and burned fragments; currently measuring Aether wavelengths.
- Estimated to be of similar size to the Giant's Tower, toppled vertically.
… …

Please check the details below on the scheduled reporting date.

Name: Naie
Text:
A scale from a creature that might be a dragon.
It could be similar to the one on Orpu's sword.

Name: Chedar
Text:
From what I saw before they were shipped to headquarters,
they were hard and sharp, and emitted intense light.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Almost like... Hmm... Ah! It looks almost exactly like the one on your bracelet.
What a coincidence.

Name: Naie
Text:
A friend of mine gave me this.
And it doesn't even look like a scale.

Name: Chedar
Text: Even if it was carved into the shape of a feather, you can't hide its texture.

Name: Chedar
Text:
Well, wouldn't it be better to ask their descendants in person?
Though we'd have to figure out if they're even alive first.

Name: Naie
Text: I just assumed it was some sort of protective charm since that's what I was told.

Name: Naie
Text:
I got it from Sekien... He explicitly told me not to lose it.
I never really examined it closely after putting it on.

Name: Naie
Text:
I still have plenty of energy left.
Shouldn't we head to this 'Star Forest' zone mentioned here?

Name: Naie
Text:
I can ask about the bracelet anytime.
It's going to stay on my wrist regardless.

Name: Naie
Text:
It’s not like it has some kind of hidden secret.
When I touch it like this, I don't even feel... Huh...?

Naie, who was staring intently at the bracelet and focusing her mind,
was suddenly engulfed in a burst of Aether and collapsed right then and there.

You considered moving her to the outpost with Chedar, but
Naie woke up shortly after and suggested going somewhere quiet.

Name: Naie
Text: My head won't stop ringing... It’s like someone’s banging on a bell right in my ear... Ugh...

Name: Naie
Text:
I can’t show weakness in front of people I barely know...
They'll keep trying to help me... It's uncomfortable...

Name: Naie
Text:
Fortunately, it doesn't hurt, I'm just a bit dizzy.
Anyway, I keep getting a weird feeling from the bracelet...

Name: Naie
Text:
If I focus my mind like earlier, I feel like I might remember something.
...Though I might pass out again.

Name: Naie
Text:
Actually, I saw something in my mind earlier.
Blue cobwebs were stretching out like branches on a tall tree...

Name: Naie
Text:
I'm not familiar with this place, so I don't know any names.
But it might be connected to the bracelet, so... I want to go there.

Name: Naie
Text:
If there's a chance it's a memory from my past, ugh... I can handle it.
The Aether this thing is emitting... I'll try to suppress it, so let's hurry.

Name: Valbas
Text: Did someone hang candy over this lake or something? It keeps attracting little kids.

Name: Naie
Text:
Disparaging me the moment we meet... you're clearly not so grown up yourself.
Who are you anyway, acting all familiar with my Chosen One?

Name: Naie
Text:
Sigh... Never mind. I don’t have time for this, so out of my way.
I need to get a closer look at that tree.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Where did you find such a fierce little thing?
Would a treat stop her from being snappy, I wonder?

Name: Valbas
Text:
Ah, [player]... I should have asked what you like first.
My mistake. Let me make it up to you by giving you what you want.

Name: Valbas
Text:
It’s no fun giving away answers, but I hate to be disliked.
I'm only saying this once, so listen closely.

Name: Valbas
Text:
That bracelet is enchanted with a protective ward.
Try to tinker with it, and it will reflect that power right back at you.

Name: Valbas
Text:
This little thing doesn’t seem weak…
But there's only so much a fake body can do against that ward.

Name: Naie
Text: What...? This—this isn't my real body?

Name: Naie
Text:
I have no memories before Sekien saved me, but...
What does that have to do with my body?

Name: Valbas
Text: What a shame. It seems your savior kept you completely in the dark.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Well, I'm sure there was a reason.
Like you being so gravely wounded that the original body could no longer function.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Tell me, the one who moved your consciousness to that Lagar vessel...
Is that the same person who gave you the bracelet?

Name: Naie
Text: Ugh... Why do you... even care...

Name: Valbas
Text:
Look at you—your head must feel like it's turning inside out.
The ward was likely placed to keep you from breaking down completely.

Name: Valbas
Text:
You are hurting because of your shoddy attempt to tinker with it.
You'd be better off destroying it completely.

Name: Valbas
Text:
[player], release your Aether.
That should stop it from causing her any more pain.

Name: Naie
Text: Chosen One... if it's you... I can take it.

Naie confessed that all her old memories had rushed back,
revealing that she was a Sentinel and a descendant of the Dragonslayer.
She even shared how she lost her life trying to stop the civil war.

Name: Valbas
Text:
An act of a traitor who brought in enemy forces... What a mediocre ending.
Is that why the forest was burned to nothing?

Name: Valbas
Text:
To think my sanctuary was destroyed over a human squabble.
I should demand compensation from you. You were the Sentinel at the time, after all.

Name: Naie
Text:
I have no intention of listening to a creepy old man.
My regret is reserved only for the citizens of the Tan Kingdom.

Name: Naie
Text:
All those things that randomly slipped out of my mouth as if I knew them well...
It was because I actually lived them.

Name: Valbas
Text: Heh... You certainly keep interesting companies. Even your companion cat is so talented.

Name: Valbas
Text: I too know of the Silver Sentinel of the Tan Kingdom.

Name: Valbas
Text:
You were driven all the way to the edge of the Star Forest, fighting pathetically...
until you ran out of your strength and died. Am I right?

Name: Valbas
Text:
Since your heroic exploits now live on in fairy tales, 
life trapped in that vessel might not be so bad after all.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Oh... What a ferocious glare.
Fortunately, losing your lands to Krea wasn't your fault.

Name: Valbas
Text:
You were locked in a long war with the Bruheria Kingdom as well, weren't you?
Those pests who wield forgotten magic.

Name: Valbas
Text: You died fighting a legion of corpses, but somehow, the civil war eventually stopped.

Name: Valbas
Text: However, the kingdom could not withstand the imperialization project that came a few years later.

Name: Valbas
Text:
In fact, with the wars dragging on since before that,
it was a miracle your homeland didn't collapse sooner.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Krea artfully exploited that weakness.
One needs that kind of cunning to keep an empire afloat.

Name: Naie
Text:
Don't dismiss our past so carelessly…
The pride of Tan lives on, in tales passed down through generations!

Name: Naie
Text:
Sigh... Thanks for helping, Chosen One.
I’m going to find Sekien.

Name: Naie
Text:
I need to ask why she saved me...
and why she called me a friend while watching over me.

Name: Naie
Text:
I'll contact you when the time is right.
Oh, and don't hang around this guy for too long.

Name: Valbas
Text:
This is exactly why I stay out of human affairs.
Always stirring up trouble, trying to achieve something grand.

Name: Valbas
Text:
If things go wrong, they'll just use you as a shield—touting you as the Chosen One or whatever.
I'd like to put off our little squabble to a later date.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Ah, but I must admit, this whole thing was quite fascinating.
To think someone would use a Lagar vessel as a consciousness receptacle.

Name: Valbas
Text: Your savior… Sekien, was it? She must be someone who has been around since the days of the Ancient Empire.

Name: Valbas
Text:
She’s either of my own kind, or someone of a similar caliber.
I could tell by her use of that forgotten magic.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Perhaps she simply wanted to play house?
It certainly looks like she's going out of her way to keep the girl close.

Name: Valbas
Text:
The ward on that bracelet is a trick from the Ancient Empire.
It would be nearly impossible to break by force—unless it's someone as powerful as you.

Name: Valbas
Text:
It's normally used for shielding, but she went as far as linking the girl’s consciousness to it.
All of that to make sure she wouldn't perceive anything related to her past.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Humans are fragile creatures—they often bury horrific memories deep down.
Believing that it's their way of protecting themselves.

Name: Valbas
Text: But you see, while fiddling with that bracelet, one might end up recalling every single old memory.

Name: Valbas
Text:
If the memories burst out at once, the body might not be able to take it and just shut down.
The Lagar vessel is inherently vulnerable to mental trauma.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Well, I believe I've explained everything.
Since I didn't even touch your little companion, I believe we can part ways on good terms.

Name: Valbas
Text: I am being extremely careful here—going out of my way to humor you.

Name: Valbas
Text:
I'd hate for Xeros to smash all my toys to pieces.
I must thwart his little game—that means you and I need to be on neutral terms for now.

Name: Valbas
Text:
Now, shall we part ways before we start boring each other?
I’m on a long vacation, so don’t bother looking for me either.

Name: Maureen
Text:
Hello.
Have we met before?

Name: Maureen
Text: Of course we haven’t. I know. You're new around here.

Name: Maureen
Text: I was calling out to see if anyone would help... and you happened to look right this way.

Name: Maureen
Text:
I'm the artisan, <Orange>Maureen.</>
I'm in charge of the guild's welfare, budget, policies, chores, and so on.

Name: Maureen
Text:
<Red>Judging by what I do, I seem like the Guild Leader, right? Hahaha!</>
If I were, I'd at least be less angry.

Name: Maureen
Text: What's really surprising is that I don't even have the time to get mad.

Name: Maureen
Text:
Even now, I'm feeling dizzy just thinking about the fees we have to pay to the <Orange>Merchants’ Guild</>.
Our guild's coffers are completely dry.

Name: Maureen
Text:
First, we need to catch the “thief” and collect the outstanding debt.
If we do that, we can at least handle things for now.

Name: Maureen
Text: A pottery merchant took the goods on credit, then left.

Name: Maureen
Text:
I trusted him because he swore he'd sell them in no time, but ugh.
It's been over a month, and still no word.

Name: Maureen
Text:
Whenever I went to collect the money myself,
he's always away. It's ridiculous.

Name: Maureen
Text: He definitely told the people around him to warn him whenever I show up.

Name: Maureen
Text: So, adventurer, please pretend to be a customer and feel him out.

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text:
<Yellow>Come on now—today is the last day!
Get them at unprecedented prices!</>

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text: Smooth and sturdy pottery! Get your pottery.

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text:
Oh my, lookie here.
I didn't even realize we had a customer—

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text: I specially sourced these beauties myself.

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text:
They are authentic goods fired by the Artisans’ Guild.
I begged and pleaded to get them at a low price.

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text: I'm selling them at cost, so take your pick, all right?

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text:
I'll let them go for 30,000 Gold each, how about that?
I’m telling you, I'm really giving these to you without making any profit.

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text:
This is a strictly today-only deal.
Because tomorrow I'll be moving on to another village.

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text: Don't overthink it. If it's from the <Orange>Artisans’ Guild</>, the quality is guaranteed. Right?

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text:
Oh, come on. You won't find them cheaper anywhere else.
You must come back, promise?

Name: Maureen
Text: Was that scumbag doing just fine running his business?

Name: Maureen
Text:
What?
He took them from me for 10,000 Gold each.

Name: Maureen
Text:
And he's marking them up several times over to sell?
He's making that much profit and still hasn't paid off his debt!

Name: Maureen
Text: <Yellow>I will take this… as a challenge against me.</>

Name: Maureen
Text: <Yellow>And I never back down from a fight!</>

Name: Maureen
Text:
You said he's in the market right now, so let's go immediately.
I'm going to flip his whole operation.

Name: Maureen
Text: Ugh, grrr...! He disappeared again!

Name: Maureen
Text:
Still, he couldn't have gone far.
I won't let him get away.

Name: Maureen
Text:
I'll search inside the market.
Adventurer, please check if he went outside.

Name: Suspicious Presence
Text: Rustle... rustle...

Name: Maureen
Text: Hand over the money you owe.

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text: Money doesn’t just fall out of the sky because you want it to, does it?

Name: Maureen
Text: Then we'll have to settle things by the book.

Name: Maureen
Text: You must have gotten a permit to do business in Babylon.

Name: Maureen
Text: I'll go to the Merchants’ Guild and report this heated chase.

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text: Ms. Maureen, don't be like that. Let's talk this out—

Name: Maureen
Text: Since it's an urgent matter, maybe I should ask to see Guild Master Arman.

Name: Maureen
Text:
I heard trust is life itself for merchants...
Perhaps you might get expelled from the guild right away.

Name: Maureen
Text: Because you're about to make an enemy of the Artisans’ Guild!

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text: P-Please, anything but that, ah—please!

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text: I'll pay you back right now! Okay?

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text: It’s not that I wasn’t going to pay. I was just going to give it to you once I sold everything, I swear!

Name: Pottery Merchant
Text: If I get kicked out of the Merchants’ Guild... Please! Anything but that...

Name: Maureen
Text:
Now... then.
Let's have a nice, long chat about the interest that’s piled up.

Name: Maureen
Text: We meet again, adventurer.

Name: Maureen
Text: Haaaaaah...

Name: Maureen
Text: A problem?

Name: Maureen
Text: I don't even know if I can call this a problem.

Name: Maureen
Text: How could a mere artisan dare to say anything about the Guild Master...?

Name: Maureen
Text:
No, I have to.
I'm going to die at this rate!

Name: Maureen
Text: You see him next to me, right? That is <Orange>Fabrice, the Artisans’ Guild Master</>.

Name: Maureen
Text: Would you like to exchange greetings with him?

Name: Maureen
Text: He isn't a zombie, and he isn't in a vegetative state.

Name: Maureen
Text: He's simply swimming in a VAST ocean.

Name: Maureen
Text:
<Yellow>Whenever he prepares a new piece, he always enters the “ocean of inspiration” like that.
And he stays there—until something comes to mind.</>

Name: Maureen
Text: OK. I'm fine with all of that.

Name: Maureen
Text:
Even though what he mostly crafts is accessories.
Anyway, the Artisans’ Guild is a place where people who want to create gather.

Name: Maureen
Text: But that man is the guild master!

Name: Maureen
Text: He abandons the guild's internal affairs and does that every single day. So, is that frustrating or what?

Name: Maureen
Text: Ugh, it drives me insane! I swear my lifespan is shortening.

Name: Maureen
Text:
We already have external requests waiting for approval as it is.
He might as well drown while he's at it.

Name: Maureen
Text:
It won't work with just any ordinary method.
You have to use an “uncreative” method.

Name: Maureen
Text: If you shove a really ugly piece of work right in front of his eyes, he'll jump right up.

Name: Maureen
Text:
But my skills have gotten pretty good too, ahem.
I can’t produce stuff that bad anymore.

Name: Maureen
Text: Would you like to give it a try, adventurer?

Name: Maureen
Text: Since the Guild Master is a sculptor, it'll be more effective if you try with the same thing.

Name: Maureen
Text: Now, show off your skills.

Name: Maureen
Text: Who knows? Maybe you've got some hidden artistic talent.

Name: Maureen
Text: It's about time for him to react.

Name: Fabrice
Text: ...What a waste.

Name: Maureen
Text: <Red>"What a waste! What is the meaning of this?"</>

Name: Fabrice
Text: <Red>Wasting this precious stone... What a wicked fellow.</>

Name: Fabrice
Text:
You there, did you craft this?
You have very useless hands.

Name: Fabrice
Text:
I can't find a single trace of beauty in this whatsoever.
This is just a lump of stone!

Name: Maureen
Text:
Mission accomplished.
I expected it from the moment you made such a horrific statue.

Name: Fabrice
Text: <Red>Never even set foot in the field of art.</>

Name: Maureen
Text: Master Fabrice, please stop and look at me.

Name: Fabrice
Text:
Ah, Maureen.
Was this the guest you brought?

Name: Fabrice
Text:
I’m sorry, child.
I saw something ugly and inadvertently lost my temper again.

Name: Maureen
Text:
Do you know how many years you’ve been saying you would stop that?
That's why everyone in the guild runs away.

Name: Maureen
Text:
I'll tell you right now while we're at it.
I do not agree with your philosophy, Guild Master.

Name: Maureen
Text:
The days when crafts were treated as luxury goods are long gone.
Now they have to be practical to sell!

Name: Fabrice
Text: <Red>But how can you call something art if it is not beautiful?!</>

Name: Fabrice
Text: True craft requires novel inspiration and meticulous completion...

Name: Maureen
Text:
Ah, forget it! I'm sick of this!
Always going on about beauty this and that while criticizing others.

Name: Maureen
Text: How long are you going to keep forcing your opinions, Guild Master?

Name: Maureen
Text:
You neglect the guild just to make those “beautiful” things.
Do you know how hard it is for me?

Name: Maureen
Text:
I can't take this anymore.
Let the guild crash and burn for all I care... Hmph!

Name: Fabrice
Text: Maureen, where are you going?!

Name: Fabrice
Text: Oh my, how did the guild end up like this...?

Name: Fabrice
Text:
Ah, you’re the adventurer from before.
Are you still staying in Babylon?

Name: Fabrice
Text:
By any chance, have you seen Maureen?
She still hasn't returned.

Name: Fabrice
Text: I didn't realize there were so many tasks she was handling all this time.

Name: Fabrice
Text:
I want to apologize to her in person.
I call myself a guild master, but I failed to look after even our youngest member…

Name: Fabrice
Text:
Getting tunnel vision when creating a piece is my chronic flaw.
I know that, but I've lived my whole life like this.

Name: Fabrice
Text:
Even after gathering people saying we’d make this work,
there were moments this position felt like a chore.

Name: Fabrice
Text: It's no wonder Maureen—that child—got tired of me.

Name: Fabrice
Text: Until she comes back, I should make sure the guild runs properly.

Name: Fabrice
Text: I'm sorry, but please lend me a hand.
