Name: Fabrice
Text: Keeping track of others' activities is... a part of a guild master's duty.

Name: Fabrice
Text: It's been quite a while since <Orange>“Rene”</> stormed out of the headquarters.

Name: Fabrice
Text:
...I'd appreciate it if you could bring her back.
She always liked the Naruru, so she probably went to the Aburu Village.

Name: Lamasu
Text: Long time no see, human!

Name: Lamasu
Text: What brings you to our village?

Name: Lamasu
Text: Are you talking about the Cloud Human?

Name: Lamasu
Text:
She’s over there.
Yesterday, today, and probably tomorrow too—you’ll see her like that!

Name: Lamasu
Text: She does nothing and couldn't care less whether the sun or moon sets.

Name: Lamasu
Text:
She just stares blankly at the sky like she’s drifting in the clouds.
That’s how she got her nickname—Cloud Human.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She must’ve looked like a total slacker.)</>

Name: Lamasu
Text: The water here is shallow, so you can just walk across!

Name: Rene
Text: It's so peaceful and perfect... It would be even better if no one disturbed me...

Name: Rene
Text: Let's just pretend we didn't see each other and pass by. It's better for both of us.

Name: Rene
Text:
Phew... That stubborn old man.
I'm not going. No way... Aburu Village is the best place for me.

Name: Rene
Text: The Guild Master and I have completely different artistic values.

Name: Rene
Text:
Abstract beauty? What the heck is that...?
Why can't I make crafts out of things I like?

Name: Rene
Text: Just look at how small and cute this village is.

Name: Rene
Text:
Inspiration is striking me even now.
The adorable Naruru and the tiny Rappies beside them.

Name: Rene
Text:
Yes, I should make <Blue>Rappie</> my theme this time.
I'll think about going back after that.

Name: Rene
Text: <Yellow>Just look at those lovely little ones.</>

Name: Rene
Text:
I want to capture every sensation in my fingertips.
I can run over to them right now, right?

Name: Rene
Text: Fine, fine, everything's fine with me!

Name: Zamamark
Text: Hmm! Two human tourists at once!

Name: Zamamark
Text: Are you here for the ranch experience?

Name: Zamamark
Text: So you want to see the Rappies up close?

Name: Zamamark
Text:
Alright, but be careful not to startle them.
And show them what you're making, too.

Name: Zamamark
Text: I just had an idea myself.

Name: Rene
Text:
Thank you, Mr. Zamamak.
I feel like I've fully experienced the Rappies thanks to you!

Name: Rene
Text: Could there be another creature as perfect as this?

Name: Rene
Text:
Ah... Inspiration is overflowing...!
I shall create a perfect masterpiece based on realism!

Name: Zamamark
Text: I don't understand a word. But I take it you're in a good mood, right?

Name: Rene
Text:
If our values differ!
I'll push through with overwhelming quality!

Name: Rene
Text: Behold, my magnum opus...!

Name: Zamamark
Text:
Ooh... It looks exactly like our little ones.
You've made this incredibly well!

Name: Zamamark
Text: Wait a second, is this our Rappies' fur—

Name: Rene
Text:
I—I just picked up what was on the ground.
I'd never do anything to hurt them.

Name: Zamamark
Text: Really? If that's the case, I like it!

Name: Zamamark
Text:
You, human.
Won't you make a promise with me?

Name: Zamamark
Text:
About this Rappie mask.
Make lots of them and give them to our ranch.

Name: Zamamark
Text:
We'll sell them and split the profit.
This will definitely be a hit!

Name: Rene
Text: ...Hmm.

Name: Rene
Text:
All right! It's actually a very tempting offer.
I knew my work was competitive.

Name: Rene
Text:
<Yellow>I'm not going back to the guild.
I prefer where my art is appreciated.</>

Name: Rene
Text: Please tell him that, adventurer.

Name: Fabrice
Text: I understand Rene's story.

Name: Fabrice
Text: That child is stubborn, so leave them be for now and check if <Orange>Priya</> is doing well.

Name: Fabrice
Text:
She bid farewell and left, saying she was going to Taima Pioneer Village,
but I'm worried since there's been no news at all.

Name: Fabrice
Text:
It's a barren place in many ways...
If she's having a hard time, tell her to come back soon.

Name: Kamiya
Text: What brings you here?

Name: Kamiya
Text: You know this isn't just a place for a casual visit.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Aha! Are you looking for someone again?

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Oh, Priya!
She's a precious worker in our village.

Name: Kamiya
Text: You wouldn't believe how diligent she is.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
She must be working hard on pioneering even now!
It's peak work hours.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Go that way.

Name: Priya
Text: W—Whoa! You startled me!

Name: Priya
Text:
W—Who are you?
Are you here to see me...?

Name: Priya
Text: Oh, the Guild Master sent you...

Name: Priya
Text:
As you can see, I—I'm doing well.
Though I haven't been able to promote my crafts yet...

Name: Priya
Text:
There's something one must do to stay here...
Once you finish th—that...

Name: Priya
Text:
But Kamiya has been very understanding of my situation!
Since I do metalwork...

Name: Priya
Text:
she reassigned me to crafting ornaments like these...
I w—was originally in charge of woodwork, so it worked out great!

Name: Priya
Text: Hehe... I'm so happy that I can be helpful in some way...

Name: Priya
Text: O—Oh... right... Could I ask a f—favor?

Name: Priya
Text:
I need to give an interim report to Kamiya...
B—But I’m too scared to show it to her myself…!

Name: Priya
Text: What if she doesn’t like it?!

Name: Priya
Text: I still have a lot more to make... I'll be waiting.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Wow, this is excellent craftsmanship!
She certainly has the potential to be a great worker.

Name: Kamiya
Text: I had high hopes since she handles metal! I'm satisfied.

Name: Kamiya
Text: I know she wants to work as an artisan.

Name: Kamiya
Text: As you saw before, this is a frontier village.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
So!
Everyone here must finish their assigned tasks for the community.

Name: Kamiya
Text: I won't say a thing once she finishes her tasks. And she can go back to her main job.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Her focus on detail seems to slow her pace.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
But she's never missed a deadline.
She'll adapt eventually.

Name: Kamiya
Text: Isn't she admirable?

Name: Kamiya
Text:
She must have been raised very preciously in her family.
Yet she's trying to do her part in a wasteland like this.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
They're very famous for being a wealthy household for generations.
I heard money comes in just by breathing.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
She could live comfortably her whole life without doing a thing.
And yet, she chose to have a job and doesn't shy away from such hard work.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
I should throw her a welcome party soon.
I wish she could stay with us in our village for a long, long time!

Name: Priya
Text: She liked them…?

Name: Priya
Text:
I was so nervous she wouldn’t.
Oh my, I'm so happy...

Name: Priya
Text: Then do you think she’ll like my other works too...?

Name: Priya
Text:
It's my dream to open a small shop here.
Hehe...

Name: Priya
Text:
Since I'm also a member of the Artisans’ Guild,
I want to show my hard-earned work to many people...

Name: Priya
Text: And it would be even better if I could s—sell them!

Name: Priya
Text: Then I'll need wood and metal...

Name: Priya
Text:
Because I need to make the stall and n—new accessories.
I'm sorry, but... could I ask you for a little bit of each?

Name: Priya
Text: P—Please be careful on your way!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Let's go to the Woodland of Elder Gods.</>
<Yellow>The wood there should be sturdy enough to build a stall.)</>

Name: Priya
Text: Thank you, this should be enough.

Name: Priya
Text: Shall we begin now...?

Name: Kamiya
Text:
Did you make all of this?
Oh, your craftsmanship is superb.

Name: Kamiya
Text: I originally intended for what I requested to be used as weapons.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
It feels fresh seeing them in such a small size.
These could even be used as decorations inside a house.

Name: Priya
Text: Thank you... I've never received such praise before...

Name: Kamiya
Text: What? You're so talented.

Name: Kamiya
Text:
I'll take good care of you, so live in our village!
Don't go back to the guild.

Name: Priya
Text: ...Would that be all right?

Name: Kamiya
Text: Of course, and you should also consider joining the pioneer group.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Priya looks exhilarated...)</>

Name: Fabrice
Text: I see... As long as she's healthy and doing well, that's enough.

Name: Fabrice
Text: It's my fault for being so stubborn that things ended up like this.

Name: Fabrice
Text:
Since other guild members drop by once in a while,
I should at least guard this place well.

Name: Fabrice
Text:
Be careful.
My back hurts, so I couldn't finish cleaning it all...

Name: Fabrice
Text: It seems I've been punished so that I’ll take better care of the guild from now on.

Name: Fabrice
Text:
As it happens, there's a fellow who snapped me back to my senses.
It's a beast, though...

Name: Fabrice
Text:
Phew, I tried to hold it in, but I can't.
That—that blasted cat...!

Name: Fabrice
Text:
It made such a mess all of a sudden.
And it even broke all these precious works!

Name: Fabrice
Text:
Oh, my head.
My blood pressure...

Name: Fabrice
Text: I must teach it a lesson! Bring it before me.

Name: Maureen
Text: Phew, I thought it would be wandering around hungry by now.

Name: Maureen
Text:
I fed it every now and then.
Sometimes it even comes to the Artisans’ Guild headquarters for food.

Name: Maureen
Text: You threw a tantrum because I wasn't there, didn't you, little one?

Name: Maureen
Text:
I just went out for some fresh air.
Now, let's stop being angry!

Name: Maureen
Text:
Excuse me, adventurer.
It loves meat and barely eats anything else.

Name: Maureen
Text:
They sell some at the market, so could you get a little for me?
Just mention my name.

Name: Maureen
Text: Since it caused trouble, I'll go ahead and start cleaning up.

Name: Fabrice
Text: Maureen, my child...

Name: Maureen
Text: Phew, these are sharp. Why were you picking them up by hand?

Name: Maureen
Text:
You always say an artisan's hands are their life, and now you're bleeding!
Just stay still.

Name: Fabrice
Text: I... am so sorry for everyone...

Name: Fabrice
Text: I've been... too lost in my own world all this time.

Name: Maureen
Text:
Hmph, you finally realized?
I couldn't tell if this was a guild or your private workshop, Fabrice.

Name: Fabrice
Text:
I won't scold other artisans,
and I'll take good care of the guild, so please forgive me.

Name: Maureen
Text: And please acknowledge everyday crafts too.

Name: Maureen
Text: <Yellow>That abstract beauty whatever-it-is!</> Ban that too.

Name: Fabrice
Text:
Y—Yes.
I'll do as you say.

Name: Maureen
Text: And stop losing track of everything while daydreaming for days!

Name: Maureen
Text: No matter how skilled you are, you have to do what's necessary. I’m right, aren’t I?

Name: Maureen
Text:
I'll come back if you promise all of that.
I just dropped by because the cat came to mind.

Name: Fabrice
Text: All right, all right... Don't be so hasty.

Name: Maureen
Text:
No taking back your words.
I'll call everyone in the guild and make an announcement!

Name: Fabrice
Text: It's going to be crowded for the first time in a while... Haha...

Name: Henrik
Text: Where are you looking? I'm over here.

Name: Henrik
Text: You're here for the <Orange>Blacksmiths’ Guild</>, right?

Name: Henrik
Text:
I’m <Orange>Henrik</>.
As you can see, I handle the guild's practical affairs.

Name: Henrik
Text:
Practically speaking, I may as well be the guild master.
I'm not saying you need to suck up to me, though.

Name: Henrik
Text:
Not that it’s good to be on my bad side either.
Mercenaries need armor and weapons, don't they?

Name: Henrik
Text:
Correct.
You're a sharp one, which is rare these days.

Name: Henrik
Text:
We happen to be short on <Blue>Istarium</>,
so please go fetch some from the Gale Ravine.

Name: Henrik
Text: It won't be hard. All you have to do is defeat monsters.

Name: A fierce-looking man
Text:
You came here of your own accord, carrying Istarium?
Haa... Is my long-held dream finally coming true?!

Name: Thorstein
Text:
Call me <Orange>Thorstein</>—no, Guild Master...
No, that's too formal.

Name: Thorstein
Text:
Yes, friend! Call me friend!
Since you've come all the way here with the materials, you are my frien—
Henrik suddenly cut in, smacking Thorstein on the back of his head.

Name: Henrik
Text: Mercenary, stay right there for a second.

Name: Thorstein
Text: Brother, what's the problem with the Guild Master welcoming a new member?!

Name: Henrik
Text: ...This. Exactly this.

Name: Henrik
Text:
Mistakenly assuming they're a new member, acting all friendly,
and suddenly forcing friend on them.

Name: Henrik
Text: This is why the Blacksmiths' Guild is so empty!

Name: Henrik
Text: Brother, please look in a mirror.

Name: Henrik
Text:
When someone who looks like a criminal suddenly tells you we’re family,
wouldn't you be scared?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Tell them they seem to need some time alone and stealthily slip away.</>

Name: Henrik
Text:
What are you talking about? You stay right there.
Because we need to wrap up the commission.

Name: Thorstein
Text:
Brother! How can you say that to my friend?
How can you do this to someone who came here of their own accord...

Name: Henrik
Text: They didn't come here willingly. They were carrying out my commission, OK...?

Name: Henrik
Text:
Anyway, please step aside for a moment, brother.
I have things to say to this “Mercenary!”

With a weary face, Henrik said that Thorstein is the Guild Master,
but he is the one actually running the guild, and then he returned to his seat.

Name: Henrik
Text:
One shouldn't judge a book by its cover,
but there’s many who backed away after seeing you.

Name: Henrik
Text: Our finances are already tight, so why can't you just stay in the forge?

Name: Henrik
Text:
I can only say this because he's my brother.
Who else would do it if not me?

Name: Henrik
Text: Anyway, I'll give you points for not running away, mercenary.

Name: Henrik
Text:
I'd like to assign you our tasks more easily from now on...
You know the <Blue>Commission House</>, right?

Name: Henrik
Text: Usually, we send tasks to the Commission House to prevent situations like this.

Name: Henrik
Text:
It would be good for you to familiarize yourself with it.
Go check it out.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is this the Commission House that receives tasks from the guilds?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Judging by the crowd, they must never run out of quests. Not bad at all.)</>

Name: Henrik
Text:
You're back already.
I'm sure you'll have many quests from other guilds, but don't forget about us.

Name: Henrik
Text: You didn’t come all the way here just to be bothered by my brother.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You say that the sight of Thorstein wasn't that unpleasant
or uncomfortable.)</>

Name: Henrik
Text:
...You're an unusual one.
But don't act friendly whenever my brother calls you.

Name: Henrik
Text: It’ll be annoying. And I already warned you, OK?

Name: Thorstein
Text:
<Yellow>My friend! Are you avoiding me...?
Are you're scared...? Or do I make you uncomfortable?</>

Name: Thorstein
Text:
Ah...! I was right about you after all!
I can't find a single trace of prejudice in you.

Name: Thorstein
Text:
I guess sincerity really does pay off.
My friend... I'd like to clear up any misunderstandings about me.

Name: Thorstein
Text: You're a living witness that I'm not scary!

Name: Thorstein
Text:
So, could you please put in a good word for me to others?
Otherwise, Henrik will collapse from overworking.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Honestly, you don't know what would happen if you refused.
Say yes, even you’re not thrilled about the idea.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It would be better to go somewhere crowded.)</>

Name: Tired Adventurer
Text: <Red>If you're a peddler, get lost. I have no intention of talking to you.</>

Name: Tired Adventurer
Text: Ugh... How do I know what he did before coming to the Forsaken Land?

Name: Tired Adventurer
Text: It's best to avoid anyone who seems off.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It seems the persuasion failed here.)</>

Name: Shrewd Merchant
Text:
Are you a new guild member?
You're working really hard on promotion.

Name: Shrewd Merchant
Text:
Oh my, so that's what happened!
That man isn't too bad.

Name: Shrewd Merchant
Text:
With that face, he should rather show some Passion and Spirit!
It would be great if he did things like that, right?

Name: Shrewd Merchant
Text: Despite how he looks, the fellow just wants to make friends.

Name: Shrewd Merchant
Text: Since I feel bad for your situation, I'll explain it nicely to others.

Name: Thorstein
Text:
Oh, are you back?
I'm curious to hear the people's reactions.

You say that while some people were scared,
others were favorable.

Name: Thorstein
Text:
To think there are more people like you, my friend...
Ah, I shouldn't have stayed cooped up in the forge.

Name: Thorstein
Text: Perhaps it’s a good idea for me to step out personally!

Name: Thorstein
Text:
I'll recruit guild members and request commissions myself.
Haha, my heart is racing.

Name: Thorstein
Text: Here, this is the <Blue>Weapon Enhancement Stone Crafting Recipe</>.

Name: Thorstein
Text: The monsters here are different from those outside, so you'll struggle if you don't enhance in time.

Name: Thorstein
Text: It’s no big deal. Go ahead and take it, my friend!

Name: Thorstein
Text:
Yes, best to strike while the iron is hot.
Why don't you start by crafting a weapon?

Name: Thorstein
Text: Enhancement stones are fine, but a weapon to use them on comes first, of course!

Name: Thorstein
Text:
But it's good to make some <Blue>Weapon Enhancement Stones</> in advance when you have time.
I'm only telling you because you're my friend.

Name: Thorstein
Text:
You're a fast learner, my friend!
Why don't you join the Blacksmiths' Guild... Haha, just kidding!

Name: Thorstein
Text:
But I can't give up so easily.
You'll change your mind once you meet my star pupil!

Name: Thorstein
Text:
Go to the Bardad Expedition Garrison
There should be a Naruru near the teleportation device.

Name: Thorstein
Text:
Name is <Orange>Armia</>.
You can tell them I sent you.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Ah, I should head that way.)</>

Name: Armia
Text:
Whoa! You startled me!
Human, what's your b—business?

Name: Armia
Text:
<Red>That baldly is causing trouble again.
I told him not to disturb my research!</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(From her way of speech, she doesn’t seem like a star pupil...)</>

Name: Armia
Text: But I'm still b—better than that bald head.

Name: Armia
Text: Hooman! Go to the Ancient Ruins Diggings and dig up shiny things! Lots and lots of them!

Name: Armia
Text: I also need the sticky liquid you get from ANTS! Lots and lots of it!

Name: Armia
Text:
Hello? I’m a star pupil! Am I a joke to you...?
You want to take a SAUNA in the furnace?

Name: Armia
Text: Go while I'm still being nice, hooman.

Name: Armia
Text:
You're not just all talk, human!
You have what it takes to forge armor and weapons.

Name: Armia
Text:
But there's something you must do before that.
It's very, very important.

Name: Armia
Text: Go to the blue fur… that blue furball at the Ancient Ruins Diggings.

Name: Armia
Text: Go there and get on your knees and beg! You have to, no matter what!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(That must be the blue furball, right?
...I’m not thrilled about this, but maybe I should at least say hello?)</>

The blue furball that was staring at me intently—no,
the unidentified creature spat out something like a bright blue seaweed stem and went away.

Name: Armia
Text:
Hehe. All preparations are complete!
Now, you make armor and weapons! I'm going to search for God Ea!

Name: Armia
Text: Baldy, you sent a decent human this time, didn’t you?

Name: Armia
Text:
All right, I've made up my mind!
<Yellow>From now on, you! You’re my star pupil!</>

Name: Armia
Text:
<Yellow>I must pass on the star, star pupil position to be free!
So long to you! And to Baldy too!</>

Name: Thorstein
Text: Welcome! How was it with the star pupil?

Name: Thorstein
Text: Haha, is this the 108th attempt?

Name: Thorstein
Text:
I considered playing along, but I just don't feel like it.
So, this time you should-

Name: Thorstein
Text:
Ah... my friend, I'll leave a corner of my heart empty for you.
Forever, that is.

Name: Thorstein
Text:
I feel empty inside, my friend!
In times like this, <Blue>Enhancement </>is good.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Why is the conversation leading to this...?)</>

Name: Thorstein
Text:
Help me feel better by<Blue>enhancing a weapon</>.
I feel like a single enhancement will give me the strength to find Armia.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You wonder if you should let Armia know about this situation...
but you already have too much on your plate. Sorry, Armia.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
After finishing the enhancement, you feel like you can't take it anymore.
If you don’t inform Henrik about this situation immediately, you'll...

Name: Henrik
Text: Ah, you startled me. I thought a corpse was walking over.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain what has happened so far, and say it's time to leave.)</>

Name: Henrik
Text: ...I couldn’t blame you even if you declined our commission.

Name: Henrik
Text:
I'll soothe the boss, so slip away quietly.
Leave Armia to me too.

Name: Aman
Text:
It's good to see you again, [player].
I was just about to contact you.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(What is he trying to make you do now...?
A chill goes down your spine for no reason.)</>

Name: Aman
Text:
Haha, no need to be tense.
I called you because there's something I forgot to mention the other day.

Name: Aman
Text: As an adventurer, it'd be troubling if you didn't know about the alliance.

Name: Aman
Text: The seven guilds stationed in Babylon are called the <Orange>“Adventurers’ Alliance.”</>

Name: Aman
Text:
I happen to be serving as the Alliance Leader as well,
but my main job is the head of the merchant group and the Merchants’ Guild Master.

Name: Aman
Text: That's why I value human relationships.

Name: Aman
Text: <Yellow>Meet Zariya at the General Store and Storage Keeper Imad.</>

Name: Aman
Text: Tell them I sent you, and they'll understand.

Name: Zariya
Text: I see you so often I’ve practically memorized your face.

Name: Zariya
Text: What brings you here today?

Name: Zariya
Text:
Hehe, it seems you've gotten close to Master Aman already,
seeing as you came alone.

Name: Zariya
Text:
Usually, people come in pairs,
accompanied by<Orange>Nasser</>.

Name: Zariya
Text:
Well, it's not important, so never mind...
There's a notebook on the table in front of the fountain, so take it.

Name: Imad
Text: What is your business?

Name: Imad
Text:
...He isn't the type to send someone alone.
Well... he must have something else in mind.

Imad asks for the notebook, writes something down,
and hands it back to you.

Name: Imad
Text: Give it to Master Aman without touching a thing. Got it?

Name: Aman
Text:
I've been waiting.
Your face is full of questions.

Name: Aman
Text:
It's nothing serious, so there’s no need to be tense.
I'll explain everything slowly.

Aman said the guild members assisting him usually move in pairs.
He also added that they usually drop by the store or storage to avoid suspicion.

Name: Aman
Text:
What you’ve brought is data from informants.
The Merchants’ Guild receives it periodically.

Name: Aman
Text:
Let's just say I wanted you to look like one of our people.
It won't be a loss for you.

Name: Aman
Text: As the Adventurers’ Alliance Leader, I'd like to introduce you to each Guild Master...

Name: Aman
Text:
I'm not asking you to meet all six of them, so rest assured.
There are some familiar faces, right?

Name: Aman
Text: Showing them this will help.
ItemDesc: A token indicating affiliation with the Merchants Guild.

Name: Aman
Text:
First, go meet <Orange>Orica</> of the <Orange>Explorers’ Guild</>.
She's has a lot of useful information.

Name: Aman
Text: And it'd be good to see <Orange>Monica</> from the <Orange>Appraisers’ Guild </>too...

Name: Aman
Text: But her personality is quite something, so if it doesn't seem like a good time to talk, feel free to come back.

Name: Orica
Text: A new face, right? What's your name?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Tell her your name and show her the token Aman gave you.)</>

Name: Orica
Text:
Oh. So you're the one everyone's talking about?
I was looking for an excuse to meet you anyway, so this is great.

Name: Orica
Text: No need to be humble. Word gets around fast here.

Name: Orica
Text:
Our job is to dig through the forsaken land.
We scrape everything together, regardless of its use.

Name: Orica
Text: We also run the local <Blue>Commission House</>, so come and visit us often.

Name: Orica
Text:
Oh, right. I should connect the communicator while we're at it.
Don't be surprised if I contact you out of the blue, okay?

Orica continued talking without giving you a chance to answer.
Having lost the energy to reply, you just wait for her to finish.

Name: Orica
Text:
Ah, looking at you reminds me of something I forgot.
It's a request from Aman. Can you do it for me?

Name: Orica
Text:
Go to Kuduru's Domain and get rid of some monsters.
He said they're interfering with trade or something. This should be easy for you, right?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You accept immediately.
Hunting is much better than staying here any longer.)</>

Name: Orica
Text:
It’d be a waste to let your skills go unused.
If it comes to it, you could consider joining our guild...

Name: Orica
Text:
Hey, I was just making a joke...!
I'll see you around!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Even from afar, it doesn't look good.
Going to the Appraisers’ Guild is out of the question.)</>

Name: Aman
Text:
You look quite harassed.
I can tell. You don’t need to tell me.

Name: Aman
Text:
Haha, if you’d gone there, you probably wouldn't have made it back until tomorrow.
Try again next time.

Name: Aman
Text:
Each guild has its specialties.
We primarily handle <Blue>Sacred Relics </>.

Name: Aman
Text: <Yellow>Scholars say they're crafted from highly refined Aether cores and magic circuits.</>

Name: Aman
Text:
They also say all you need to keep own, and it works like a charm.
You could say they’re perfect for those who desire to gain strength.

Name: Aman
Text: I recommend buying one from the<Blue>Alliance Shop</>.

Name: Aman
Text:
A good choice.
Take a look around the other guilds' shops when you have time.

Name: Aman
Text:
Hmm... do you have a flair for mediation?
No need to mention your combat skills.

Name: Aman
Text:
I hope it's a suitable situation.
Because it seems you're the only one who can go.

Name: Aman
Text:
Naturally, I don't expect goodwill without compensation.
A reward is only fair.

Name: Aman
Text:
Right now, a merchant group is stranded in the <Blue>Giant's Corridor</>.
They're unable to cross over to Aburu Village.

Name: Aman
Text:
Go and assess the situation for me.
Contact me via the communicator.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(He said a merchant group, but it's just one merchant and a Naruru.
But why is he groveling before the Naruru?)</>

Name: Shadow Wolf Member
Text:
We'll be up all night waiting.
I'll just kill you both.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(To think I'd run into the Shadow Wolves. Let's take them out first.)</>

Name: Zamira
Text:
Phew, I survived thanks to you, human!
I am <Orange>Zamira</>! I suffered because of the idiot, the idiot next to me.

Name: Bruno
Text:
I am <Orange>Bruno</>.
I'm currently apprenticing under Zamira, the head of the merchant group.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(When you widen your eyes in surprise, Zamira lets out a short sigh.)</>

Name: Zamira
Text: I hate teaching humans, but I'm doing it for Amang—I mean, A-man's—sake, but he's too slow!

Name: Zamira
Text:
You're here to beat! Beat up those dark things—
You're completely useless!

Name: Bruno
Text: I-I only have one life too, Zamira.

You try to persuade both of them, but it doesn’t work.
Zamira vents out her anger for a while and suddenly disappears.

Name: Bruno
Text:
Phew...
Thanks to you, we made it out alive, but the next one won’t be an easy one.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You show him the Merchants Guild Token you received earlier.)</>

Name: Bruno
Text: So Master Aman really did send you!

Name: Bruno
Text:
Of all groups, we had to run into the <Red>Shadow Wolves</>...
I was stalling for time, pretending to look for something expensive.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(If they actually believed that and waited, they must not be that smart.)</>

Name: Bruno
Text:
Thank goodness.
If you had been just a little later. Ugh... I don’t even want to imagine it...

Name: Bruno
Text:
Anyway, I'll have to calm Zamira down,
but it’s going to be tough.

Name: Bruno
Text:
I mean, she is quite a stubborn Naruru—I mean—merchant group leader.
If this ends up causing trouble for the Merchants’ Guild...

Name: Bruno
Text: Well... Zamira is the most outstanding <Orange>Rappie Appraiser</> alive right now...

Name: Bruno
Text: An average Naruru is satisfied with just raising Rappies on a ranch, you know?

Name: Bruno
Text:
<Yellow>But Zamira seeks out promising Rappies herself!
And she even tames them.</>

Name: Bruno
Text:
Phew... When we set out from Babylon,
she was so confident and said we would bring back some fine ones...

Name: Bruno
Text: Well, there is a way, but it's not something I can do.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(His eyes are screaming for help.
...OK, let's just help her. Aman will pay the reward anyway.)</>

Name: Bruno
Text:
The ability to see exactly what the other person wants...!
Aman truly sent someone extraordinary.

Name: Bruno
Text: <Yellow>We need to turn Zamira's attention back to the Rappies, and fast.</>

Name: Bruno
Text:
First, we need to make a snack that Rappies like.
If you go just a little further from here, you'll find the Woodland of Elder Gods.

Name: Bruno
Text: Please go there and bring back some herbs and monster hides.

Name: Bruno
Text:
It's a similar principle as garnishing food with flowers.
Come on, hurry!

Name: Bruno
Text: All right! Let's make it right away.

Name: Bruno
Text:
Here, please take this to Zamira.
She is behind the pillar trying to calm her anger.
ItemDesc: A handmade Rappie Snack.

Name: Bruno
Text:
...If I go, there will definitely be trouble.
Since you already started this, please see it through to the end.

Name: Zamira
Text:
Hmm? Hmm?
Did you make this? Did you really make it?

Name: Zamira
Text:
<Yellow>The color, the smell, the shape... they are all perfect!
Even wild Rappies... Rappies will love this!</>

Name: Zamira
Text:
What?! Th-that's a lie!
He still... still has a lot to learn. A long way to go.

Name: Zamira
Text:
<Yellow>Don’t…. don’t tell him about my compliment.</>
Instead, go see if this is actually useful.

Name: Zamira
Text: Check the wild Rappies' re-reaction and let me know!

Name: Zamira
Text:
If you leave this out, they will definitely come!
Ma-make sure to try it!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A wild Rappie? In a place like this...?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Just looking at its bright fur cheers you up.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You might scare that Rappie away, so let’s leave the snack and watch it from a bit behind.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You weren’t sure about this when you are making it…)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(But the Rappie likes it more than you expected. It seems to be in a good mood too.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It’s no big deal, but you feel good. Should you watch a little longer?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It disappeared in the blink of an eye...!)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(But why is it staring at you? No... that can't be it. You’re empty-handed.)</>

The look in the wild Rappie's eyes have changed.
But even if you look at me like that, I can't give you any more snacks!

You almost got seriously hurt because the wild Rappie suddenly turned aggressive and lunged at you.
I only taught it a little lesson… It’ll be no problem, right? Let's head back for now.

Name: Zamira
Text: Tell me! Tell me how the Rappie was!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Tell her it gave you a hard time and lunged at the snack.)</>

Name: Zamira
Text:
Hehe, my secret recipe is the best—the absolute best!
Tell that foolish human, hooman over there that I'll let it slide.

Name: Zamira
Text: Next time, he needs to do it very, very well!

Name: Bruno
Text:
So, what did Zamira say?
Has her anger subsided a bit?

Name: Bruno
Text:
Of course.
I really owe you one.

Name: Bruno
Text: Oh right, I reported the situation to Aman while you were away.

Name: Bruno
Text:
There's no need to go through the trouble of returning to Babylon.
He said it would be fine if we gave you the reward instead.

Name: Bruno
Text: It's not much, but please accept it.

Name: Kian
Text:
Hey there, do you have a moment?
It's because you’re exactly the kind of person I was looking for.

Name: Kian
Text:
You’re good-natured and well-respected. It’s written all over your face.
Let's talk for a second.

Name: Kian
Text:
Phew, that's not it...
Did I say something wrong again?

Name: Kian
Text:
Don't misunderstand.
I'm neither a peddler nor a fatalist, so don’t look at me like that.

Name: Kian
Text: I am <Orange>“Kian,”</> the head of the Hunters’ Guild.

Name: Kian
Text:
At a glance, you look like an adventurer who enjoys traveling freely...
And it seems you've built up quite a bit of experience.

Name: Kian
Text:
Listen, but don’t be pressured.
<Yellow>I want to entrust the future of the Hunters’ Guild to you!</>

Name: Kian
Text:
I left out the most important part.
Please understand. I have a lot on my mind.

Name: Kian
Text:
Ahem... I need you to pretend to be the <Orange>“Next Guild Master” for a while</>.
Just puff out your chest, and act stoic and dignified.

Name: Kian
Text:
Since the person who cleans up after them will be gone,
there will certainly be talk.

Name: Kian
Text:
Because I clean up all their mess,
they run amok without looking ahead.

Name: Kian
Text:
But if a stranger takes the seat of Guild Master,
wouldn’t that create a strong sense of belonging?

Name: Kian
Text:
That is precisely my goal.
<Yellow>To put pressure on them to behave themselves.</>

Name: Kian
Text:
I'll compensate you handsomely, so just put on a little act.
So, will you accept?

Name: Kian
Text: First, let's have you sign the invitation for the <Blue>“Solidarity Tournament.”</>
ItemName: [ Notice of Hosting the ■■th Hunting Tournament ]
ItemDesc:
To the esteemed members of the Hunters’ Guild,
Once again this year, we will be holding a hunting tournament to foster solidarity among you ruffians.
Various perks for the winner? Of course there are. 
The best one can take them.

Also, I plan to retire after this tournament.
Anyone who has a problem with that can complain about it after winning.

For your information, I have already handpicked the next Guild Master.
They are cold-blooded and ruthless, so consider yourselves finished.

- Date: Same as last year
- Rules: Same as last year
- Location: Same as last year

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Judging by how he treats me, he seems rather polite...)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Just how eccentric are the people in the Hunters’ Guild
to make this kind gentleman write like this?)</>

Name: Kian
Text: Now your first greeting is done.

Name: Kian
Text:
Giant's Garden or Starfall Plateau.
I will handle sending the invitations to those areas.

Name: Kian
Text: The problem is the guild members staying in the Barrens.

Name: Kian
Text:
Since Babylon is right around the corner, they don't have a specific base.
It means they wander around here and there.

Name: Kian
Text:
Sometimes they sleep in the open with their comrades,
or set up temporary camps.

Name: Kian
Text:
<Orange>Seta, Uran, and Xenia.</>
Those three each lead a small group.

Name: Kian
Text:
If we just assemble them, the rest will naturally follow.
Will you go to the <Blue>“Predator's Hunting Ground”</>first?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It seems there only ordinary adventurers like me are around here...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I should ask the security officer or the guards here.)</>

Name: Chika
Text:
Sturdy adventurers are always welcome.
Even those just passing by.

Name: Chika
Text: <Red>However, members of the Hunters’ Guild are strictly prohibited!</>

Name: Chika
Text: Do you happen to know those rascals? Go on and say yes!

Name: Chika
Text:
<Yellow>Oh, a savior has finally appeared!
There's definitely an Absolute Being in this world.</>

Name: Chika
Text:
My prayers have been answered!
I'm finally free!

Name: Chika
Text:
Please take that ecosystem destroyer away quickly.
At this rate, the barrens will turn into a wasteland.

Name: Chika
Text: I'm telling you, the hunters are committing a massacre, not a hunt!

Name: Chika
Text:
I know they are skilled,
but they shouldn't just recklessly wipe everything out like this.

Name: Chika
Text:
There's even a limit to hunting.
Overdoing it ruins nature.

Name: Chika
Text:
The balance between predator and prey depends heavily on the population,
but they're completely wiping out the upper tier.

Name: Chika
Text:
Go and stop them!
They say a hunter only speaks through skill or something like that.

Name: Chika
Text:
Phew! You showed up! How did you know?
Hurry up and go talk to them.

Name: Large-Bodied Hunter
Text: What, a newbie adventurer?

Name: Seta
Text:
It's our first time meeting, so why don't you lighten up?
How dare you scowl in front of the legendary hunter, “Seta?”

Name: Seta
Text: If you have no business here, move! This is my territory.

Name: Seta
Text: What? The Guild Master?

Name: Seta
Text:
Geez, he should've come himself. Why did he send someone?
Anyway, he worries too much.

Name: Seta
Text: What is it? Will he finally expel me this time?

Name: Seta
Text: Ahahaha! You should've just told me right away that the hunting tournament is being held.

Name: Seta
Text:
I know the barrens like the back of my hand.
The victory is obviously mine.

Name: Seta
Text:
But wait... the Guild Master is changing?
Tsk, that's troublesome.

Name: Seta
Text:
It's a name I haven't even heard of in the first place.
Doesn't even seem like a hunter-

Name: Seta
Text: Don't tell me this is your signature, is it?

Name: Seta
Text: Hmph, no wonder you had such an arrogant look in your eyes.

Name: Seta
Text:
<Yellow>The Guild Master might nag a lot,
but among us, he's the best hunter.</>

Name: Seta
Text: That's why everyone trusts and follows him... But who are you?

Name: Seta
Text:
Looks like you underestimated the Hunters' Guild.
I only care about raw skill.

Name: Seta
Text: I'll make sure you don’t even qualify for the competition.

Name: Seta
Text: A hunt! Whoever brings back the most trophies wins.

Name: Seta
Text:
I don't know how you charmed the Guild Master, but I'm not falling for it.
You and me—let's settle this with a duel.

Name: Seta
Text:
The loser must follow the winner's orders, no matter what.
No complaints, right?

Name: Seta
Text:
To keep things fair, we should leave the refereeing to an outsider.
For instance, that caretaker over there.

Name: Seta
Text:
My friend will deliver the message to him.
As for us, let's head out immediately!

Name: Chika
Text:
You have the advantage in both quantity and variety, adventurer.
Plus, you arrived much faster.

Name: Seta
Text: What? I... I lost?

Name: Seta
Text:
I handpicked only the strongest and most imposing ones!
Look at these massive claws and teeth!

Name: Seta
Text:
You must have picked off only the small fries...
Do you have no pride as a hunter?

Name: Chika
Text: <Red>What you're doing isn't hunting!</>

Name: Chika
Text:
It might be honorable to you, but...
In my eyes, it's nothing but a slaughter.

Name: Chika
Text:
What about the creatures who call this place home...?
How are they supposed to survive now?!

Name: Seta
Text:
I caught the dangerous ones. That's enough.
What's the problem?

Name: Chika
Text:
If the food chain collapses, the vegetation and water will dry up.
Not to mention the surge of pests that carry diseases!

Name: Chika
Text: Have you even thought about that? Of course not.

Name: Seta
Text: What? Why you...!

Name: Chika
Text:
<Yellow>Just accept the results.
Do as the adventurer says.</>

Name: Seta
Text: What is it you want...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You tell him to go back to the guild and stay quiet until the hunting competition.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Seta's face turns beet red, practically snorting steam from his nose.)</>

Name: Seta
Text: I-I'll see you at the competition!!!

Name: Chika
Text:
Thank you...
You have no idea how much I've suffered because of that man these past few months.

Name: Chika
Text:
Since he had a plausible excuse like <Blue>Monster Hunting</>,
it was difficult to make a formal complaint.

Name: Chika
Text:
I know Guild Master Kian personally,
but I didn't want to add to his worries.

Name: Chika
Text: I know he's already busy cleaning up after the guild members.

Name: Chika
Text:
I'm just glad it's been resolved somehow.
Is there anything I can do for you? Information or otherwise?

Name: Chika
Text: I know the troublemakers of the wasteland that Kian often mentions.

Name: Chika
Text:
One was Seta, whom you just met.
The others are Uran and Xenia.

Name: Chika
Text: However, while I've heard of Uran, I don't know much about Xenia.

Name: Chika
Text:
<Yellow>Go to the White-Bone Expanse.
Word is that Uran is in the middle of a "job" there.</>

Name: Chika
Text:
There's no way you could miss him... *sigh*
Anyway, he stands out, so you'll recognize him immediately.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I can't believe someone is whispering about love in the middle of a wasteland.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Could that be “Uran”...?)</>

Name: Elegant-looking Man
Text: Oh... Oh my!

Name: Elegant-looking Man
Text:
Darling, haven't we met somewhere before?
I feel like I've just been struck by a bolt from the blue.

Name: Uran
Text:
You even know my name?
I think I'm going to be moved to tears...

Name: Uran
Text: And how did you know I'm the <Orange>Romantic Hunter?</>

Name: Uran
Text:
Won't you... compose a poem of love with me?
Let us journey to a place far, far away together.

Name: Uran
Text: You shall be the source of my inspiration.

Name: Uran
Text:
Hmm, magical beasts, demonic creatures, monsters.
There are many names for them, but to harm them is...

Name: Uran
Text: Honestly, it's not a job I enjoy doing often.

Name: Uran
Text:
To hunt means to capture a target.
For me, that target is your “heart.”

Name: Uran
Text:
I am not the only one walking this path.
You might meet others when the competition takes place.

Name: Uran
Text: You understand my feelings now, right? Come with me!
Without waiting for an answer, Uran skipped toward the stream.
He was remarkably fast, as expected of a hunter.
Strangely, it felt as if a floral breeze followed in his wake...

Name: Uran
Text: Sooo—are you ready to embark on a romantic journey with me?

Name: Uran
Text: Ah, is it already time for the hunting competition?

Name: Uran
Text:
Lovely—it'll be nice to see some familiar faces.
And share the deep scent of nostalgia.

Name: Uran
Text: But I like it here. And I haven't finished my hunt yet.

Name: Uran
Text:
<Yellow>My romance parameters are low.
If I return like this, I’ll be too heartsick to even move.</>

Name: Uran
Text: Unless, of course, you're willing to take responsibility for my broken heart.

Name: Uran
Text:
Mmm—how sweet of you, darling.
How did someone so perfectly my type appear before me?

Name: Uran
Text:
Let's go over there.
I just had a sudden burst of inspiration.

Name: Uran
Text: Darling, come up here!

Name: Uran
Text: We've made romance bloom even in this desolate and barren land.

Name: Uran
Text: Love is... a fantastic emotion that allows one to overcome any hardship.

Name: Uran
Text:
<Yellow>"All I desire is a single star to light my way.
For you shall quench my parched throat."</>

Name: Uran
Text: <Yellow>"Even if a dry thirst overcomes me, a single word from you is all I need to endure."</>

Name: Uran
Text:
My falling for you at first sight was an instinctive pull.
You possess such artistic soul, darling.

Name: Uran
Text:
Now... would you bring me that flower blooming on the hill?
It shall be the token of our romance!

Name: Uran
Text:
I think I can finally finish the poem I wrote for you.
I'll be waiting at the place where we first met.

Name: Uran
Text: I... I could die happy now.

Name: Uran
Text:
Risking death for your soulmate,
and plucking a flower from a cliff!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He really loves his romantic expressions...)</>

Name: Uran
Text:
Please read this.
I poured my heart into it while you were away...
ItemDesc:
Love makes the soul gaze upon the heavens.

The sandstorms cannot tear us apart,
And the steep cliffs forge our bond into steel.

O, beautiful flower, bind these two as one.

Two from different worlds reach for each other's hands,
And now, they fear nothing at all.

Name: Uran
Text: Ah... Ugh!

Name: Uran
Text:
<Yellow>The romance between us... Ugh, it's reached a lethal dose...
My heart aches as if it's being torn apart.</>

Name: Uran
Text: You are so radiant that I-I can't even open my eyes.

Name: Uran
Text:
We'll meet again at the competition, won't we, my dear?
I'm not going anywhere. I'll wait for you forever.

Name: Uran
Text:
...Oh right, Xenia will be at the competition too, won't she?
I must convey my feelings to her once more.

Name: Uran
Text:
I wonder if she's still in Taima Pioneer Village.
O, my love, who departed to follow her convictions...
Uran wiped away a tear and strolled lightly toward Babylon...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Uran mentioned Taima Pioneer Village.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Is that the last place he saw “Xenia?”
Since there are no other clues, let's head there.)</>

Name: Flustered Person
Text: Whoa! Who are you to barge in like this?

Name: Flustered Person
Text:
Can't you see we're in the middle of a deep discussion?
If you're an adventurer, just mind your own business and keep moving.

Name: Sharp-eyed Person
Text:
...A hunter? Which hunter?
We do belong to the Hunters' Guild.

Name: Sharp-eyed Person
Text: I hope the Guild Master didn't send you. I told him to stay out of it.

Name: Xenia
Text:
That's me. I'm Xenia.
Why is an adventurer who isn't even in the Hunters' Guild looking for me?

Name: Xenia
Text:
I figured it was about time,
and it’s already here.

Name: Xenia
Text: So, are you the next Guild Master since you're delivering this?

Name: Xenia
Text:
Since you were handpicked, I won't doubt your skills, but...
Don't even think about getting in the way of the "Reformers."

Name: Xenia
Text: We've already crushed those who criticized us with pure “skill.”

Name: Xenia
Text:
If you're planning to pick a fight with me too...
Fine, I'll take on that challenge.

Name: Xenia
Text:
Not an old-timer? Hmph, listen well.
Hunting with nothing but a bow is an outdated concept.

Name: Xenia
Text:
My comrades and I use a variety of weapons.
We can crush a monster's skull with a staff just as easily as with a sword.

Name: Xenia
Text: <Yellow>Transformation is necessary for the guild's development.</>

Name: Xenia
Text:
You look like you don't understand...
I will test if you’re someone who can embrace the Reformers.

Name: Xenia
Text:
If not, I'll run you out of here before the competition even starts.
Prove yourself by defeating monsters.

Name: Xenia
Text:
Follow me.
I will watch with my own eyes.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She looks like she's daring you to try...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Prove yourself by hunting the monsters here.)</>

Name: Xenia
Text:
I see... Well, you seem to know what hunting is.
Though we'll have to see if you're fit to lead.

Name: Xenia
Text: There are many oddballs in the Hunters' Guild.

Name: Xenia
Text:
Do we look strange to you for using all sorts of weapons?
Heh, this is nothing much.

Name: Xenia
Text:
Some only care about bounties,
while others just hunt for treasure

Name: Xenia
Text:
Either way, the place is full of weirdos.
Most have almost no sense of belonging to the guild...

Name: Xenia
Text:
<Yellow>But they hold the act of “hunting” in high regard.</>
That's why the competition turnout is so high.

Name: Xenia
Text:
I'll have to head back to the guild to see how your story ends.
See you soon.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Does no one care who becomes the Guild Master...
How can they be so laid back?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let's report to Kian first...)</>

Name: Kian
Text:
You work remarkably fast.
We should have recruited a talent like you to the guild a long time ago...

Name: Kian
Text:
I managed to soothe those rascals and keep them in line.
They were quite excited to head off for the preliminaries.

Name: Kian
Text: Those in other realms are also caught up in the heat of the hunt.

Name: Kian
Text:
I truly hope this is the last time.
To begin with, the guild was meant for "that person."

Name: Kian
Text:
Now that he's earned the nickname "The Divine,"
it's become even harder to ask him to take the Guild Master seat.

Name: Kian
Text:
He clearly said he'd consider even an honorary position,
but how can I manage this massive guild all by myself..?

Name: Kian
Text:
Technically, this isn't even supposed to be my position.
There are some internal circumstances, but I'll tell you about that later.

Name: Kian
Text:
What I need from you is to make a big splash this time.
Give them something to be shocked about.

Name: Kian
Text:
Those who never even show their faces normally,
go absolutely wild once a competition is held.

Name: Kian
Text: Anyway, I plan to announce you as the next Guild Master.

Name: Kian
Text:
I'll set a condition that anyone with an objection must win the competition.
I'll say I'll "at least listen" to what they have to say.

Name: Kian
Text:
Most of them have gathered, so let's proceed with the plan.
You can start straight from the finals.

Name: Kian
Text:
Shouldn't you have at least that much privilege with the Guild Master backing you?
Let's talk about the rest downstairs.

Name: Kian
Text: I'll see you at the hunting grounds behind First-Step Village.

Name: Kian
Text:
Long time no see! My, look at all your bright faces!
Please gather like this more often, you rascals.

Name: Kian
Text:
You've all read the notice, right?
I'm sick of this, so I'm quitting as Guild Master.

Name: Kian
Text:
Those who failed the preliminaries, stop jeering and just watch.
The finals begin now.

Name: Kian
Text: Now, let's hear the aspirations of my successor.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You declare that anyone who tarnishes the guild's honor or causes internal strife
will be expelled immediately upon the occurrence of such incidents.)</>

Name: Kian
Text:
Whether you're unhappy about me quitting,
or you hate having a stranger as your Guild Master.

Name: Kian
Text:
As always! Only the voice of a true hunter will carry weight!
If you understand, head out!

Name: Kian
Text: Anyone who brings back trophies later than the next Guild Master is disqualified!

Name: Kian
Text:
Are you anxious now that the person who cleans up after you is leaving?
You're finally putting in some effort.

Name: Xenia
Text:
Watch your throat, Guild Master.
You won't be able to call my name at the award ceremony at this rate.

Name: Uran
Text: Mmm, Xenia... How sweet of you.

Name: Xenia
Text: Don't be so clingy! You didn't even pass the preliminaries, so why are you here?

Name: Uran
Text:
I came to see your face after such a long time.
Don't be so cold, darling.

Name: Xenia
Text: Just go find your "romance" or whatever. I'm so sick of this.

Name: Kian
Text: Where did Seta go? He couldn't even wait for a moment.

Name: Seta
Text:
Hahaha! There is no set order in hunting!
This one is mine!

Name: Kian
Text:
<Yellow>Now, the final target is an “Anteater.”
The one who delivers the fatal blow wins. Begin!</>
After a fierce competition, you finally succeed in delivering the finishing blow.

Name: Seta
Text: Hah! I can't believe I lost the finishing blow! What kind of trickery did you use?

Name: Xenia
Text:
This person fought honorably.
Do not insult the hunting competition, Seta.

Name: Seta
Text:
Tsk, you're lecturing me when you don't even carry a bow?
This sharp arrowhead is the very identity of a hunter.

Name: Xenia
Text: You pick a fight at every competition. Don't you ever get tired of it?

Name: Xenia
Text:
Hey, everyone saw clearly that you killed it.
Ignore him and head back.

Name: Seta
Text: Hey! You! Those Reformers have no manners at all!

Name: Kian
Text:
Congratulations.
The best hunter of the year is you, [player]!

Name: Kian
Text:
As expected of the person I chose.
I can step down with peace of mind now!

Name: Kian
Text:
The rest of you, reflect on your performance and hone your skills further.
It’s pathetic to see guild members in such a state.

Name: Kian
Text:
Go have an after-party or whatever and disperse!
I'm off to handle the handover.

Name: Seta
Text:
It's a bit much to decide everything with just one competition.
Especially since you two just decided it on your own!

Name: Seta
Text:
Since when do hunters stick to rules?
Demand a real display of skill, Guild Master!

Name: Seta
Text: We can't just hand our guild over to anyone.

Name: Xenia
Text:
How about bringing back a monster from the Incursion?
It's a hunt just as honorable as the competition.

Name: Kian
Text:
Hmm... That would certainly be definitive proof.
However, it would mean touching upon the guild's unwritten rules.

Name: Kian
Text:
Even though you're the ones who advocated for pure meritocracy...
Stop being so persistent.

Name: Seta
Text:
The competition is held with safe and docile prey.
Hunting in the wild is the real deal.

Name: Xenia
Text: A flexible decision is needed in a special situation like an Incursion.

Name: Xenia
Text:
We'll be able to tell for sure...
…whether they fit with the Reformists.

Name: Kian
Text:
Hmph, I wish you'd show this much interest in the guild normally.
There's no way my successor will fail.

Name: Kian
Text:
Will it be enough to display the trophies at the guild?
From then on, all of you had better stay quiet.

Name: Kian
Text:
You, come back to the guild with me.
I have something to request before you leave for the Incursion site.

Name: Kian
Text:
...They're being more stubborn than I expected.
My apologies.

Name: Kian
Text: I thought I was the only one actually living the guild life... *sigh*

Name: Kian
Text:
Guild members skilled in stealth will follow you secretly.
They'll probably talk amongst themselves about what they saw.

Name: Kian
Text: So, just do your best.

You hung the trophies obtained from the monsters in the Incursion in the Hunters' Guild.
The guild members seemed to be questioning the authenticity, but...

Eventually, they acknowledged it and started pestering Kian.
It seemed there had been many accidents and incidents caused by them.

Name: Kian
Text: It seems they've realized you're not someone to be trifled with.

Name: Kian
Text:
<Yellow>From now on, they won't put on the guild’s tab,
and they won't cover up botched commissions.</>

Name: Kian
Text:
<Yellow>Furthermore, they won't start brawls with adventurers over prey,
and they won't secretly hunt protected species.</>

Name: Kian
Text:
I've got them to make several promises.
It's all thanks to your excellent performance!

Name: Kian
Text:
I wonder how I ended up being the Guild Master for so long.
Once everything is ready, I'll step down, for sure.

Name: Kian
Text: Well, the guild doesn't have much money, but I've made sure your reward is as generous as possible.

Name: Kian
Text:
Next time, I'll welcome you as a guest of the guild.
Take care on your way back.

Name: Evrin
Text:
It's been a while, adventurer.
I was wondering if you've grown accustomed to life here.

Name: Evrin
Text: You must be quick to adapt, huh?

Name: Evrin
Text: At this rate, you’ll get used to the <Blue>Tower</> in no time.

Name: Evrin
Text: Enough small talk. Let me explain why I was looking for you.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Supporting adventurers visiting the Forsaken Land for the first time…
…is, as you likely know, our primary duty.

Name: Evrin
Text:
We usually provide a prepared <Blue>Guidebook</>,
but I'm not sure if that would be enough.

Name: Evrin
Text:
How was the <Blue>Survival Bag</>?
I created it incorporating a fair amount of Rada's feedback.

Name: Evrin
Text:
That's a relief.
Is there anything else you think should be included?

Name: Evrin
Text:
If you can't answer right away, why not visit the General Store,
look through the items, and let me know?

Name: Evrin
Text: Better than being bored, don’t you agree?

Name: Evrin
Text: Enough small talk. Let me explain why I was looking for you.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Supporting adventurers visiting the Forsaken Land for the first time…
…is, as you likely know, our primary duty.

Name: Evrin
Text:
We usually provide a prepared <Blue>Guidebook</>,
but I'm not sure if that would be enough.

Name: Evrin
Text:
How was the <Blue>Survival Bag</>?
I created it incorporating a fair amount of Rada's feedback.

Name: Evrin
Text:
That's a relief.
Is there anything else you think should be included?

Name: Evrin
Text:
If you can't answer right away, why not visit the General Store,
look through the items, and let me know?

Name: Zariya
Text:
Look who it is!
We meet again! What brings you here?

Name: Zariya
Text:
Don't feel pressured. Just take your time and pick what you need.
We've got plenty of time!
After some thought, you decided to purchase an Elixir of Attack.

Name: Evrin
Text: Well then, let's see what you've brought back.

Name: Evrin
Text:
<Yellow>So, you’ve chosen useful items for both emergencies and combat...
A wise choice.</>

Name: Evrin
Text: I’m glad I asked for your opinion.

Name: Evrin
Text: While we’re at it, it might be a good idea to check your finances...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It won’t help even if stare at her like “Why do you care about my finances…?”)</>

Name: Evrin
Text:
You can never have too much of gold.
If you’re going to cry, wouldn’t you rather do it in Babylon than on the streets?

Name: Evrin
Text:
As it happens, <Orange>Kanber</> is stationed at the camp, so why don’t you go meet him?
He’ll have some lucrative work for you.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Oh, no need to thank me.
Helping adventurers become self-sufficient is our duty.

Name: Kanber
Text:
I’m Kanber, the dispatcher from the Wayfinders’ Guild.
What is your business here?

Name: Kanber
Text: ...She’s not usually the type to worry about a mere guild member. Interesting.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You’d better change the subject.
You say you’re looking for work because you need gold.)</>

Name: Kanber
Text: Ah, so you were looking for work.

Name: Kanber
Text:
Indeed, for those new to the Forsaken Land, there’s no better place than the Wayfinders’ Guild.
At the very least, we’ll keep you from becoming a living corpse.

Name: Kanber
Text:
Since you’re here, please take care of the monsters in the Gorge of Perdition.
It seems the soldiers alone aren’t enough.

Name: Kanber
Text: With this level of skill, looks like you'll be swimming in gold, won’t you?

Name: Kanber
Text: I’d like to commission you again, so please return anytime.

Name: Evrin
Text:
You’ve returned.
Is your coin purse a bit heavier now?

Name: Evrin
Text:
Kanber actually paid generously for once.
I suppose that’s thanks to your capability?

Name: Evrin
Text: When I first saw Rahda helping you and never leaving your side, I thought you might be naive, but I’m glad to see I was wrong.

Name: Evrin
Text: Have you heard of the <Blue>“Arbiter’s Ordeal?”</>

Name: Evrin
Text:
Not surprising.
Most people are preoccupied with conquering the Tower or hunting for artifacts.

Name: Evrin
Text: But didn’t you say… you were tracking a mercenary group?

Name: Evrin
Text:
To uncover information about a mercenary group,
you’ll need plenty of resources—whether that’s money or power.

Name: Evrin
Text: Last time you were after money, so this time, let’s focus on power.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Just like gold, the more power the better, so off you go…
…to the place where you can obtain <Blue>Stardust</>.

Name: Evrin
Text: From your expression, it seems you’ve obtained enough.

Evrin went on and on about the Arbiter’s Ordeal, and you didn’t even ask about it.
By the time you’re on the verge of running away, the only phrase you can remember…
…is the “Treasury of the Ancients.”

Name: Evrin
Text: If you need something in the future, look for the Arbiter’s Ordeal.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Since you’ve got some Stardust, let’s use it right away.
What’s the point of just letting it sit there?

Name: Evrin
Text: Isn’t it a great opportunity to feel the Power of the Stars immediately?

Name: Evrin
Text:
It’s one of the ancient legends.
It’s a long story. It’ll take all day.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(When you look at Evrin with a tense face, her eyes widen.)</>

Name: Evrin
Text:
You don’t think I’d talk about that right now, did you?
Why would I do something bothersome like that...?

Name: Evrin
Text: But to put it simply, we are <Yellow>beings capable of borrowing the Power of the Stars</>.

Name: Evrin
Text:
That’s the biggest difference between us and the Ancients.
It could also be seen as an aftermath of the Great Cataclysm.

Name: Evrin
Text: Now, use the Stardust to upgrade your <Blue>Grace of the constellations Card</>.

Name: Evrin
Text: Can you feel the difference?

Name: Evrin
Text:
It’s probably because it’s your first time.
The Alliance Shop also carries the Grace of the constellations Cards, so come back anytime.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Let’s check one last thing.
Are you active in a <Orange>Clan</>?

Name: Evrin
Text:
No need to check, then.
I didn’t expect you to be active in one already.
After a moment of silence, Evrin says she has a good idea.

Name: Evrin
Text: ...Speaking of clans, you’d better meet <Orange>Ragnar</>.

Name: Evrin
Text:
There are countless clans, but none are quite like his.
If you’re lucky, he might even invite you to join.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Now, hurry along.
He might actually welcome someone like you.

Name: Evrin
Text: Being alone is fine, but it might be better to find some reliable comrades.

Name: Evrin
Text: If you’re tracking a mercenary group, won’t you end up at the Tower eventually?
After a moment of silence, Evrin says she has a good idea.

Name: Evrin
Text: ...Speaking of clans, you’d better meet <Orange>Ragnar</>.

Name: Evrin
Text:
There are countless clans, but none are quite like his.
If you’re lucky, he might even invite you to join.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Now, hurry along.
He might actually welcome someone like you.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You’re nervous for some reason.)</>

Name: Ragnar
Text: What brings you here?

Name: Ragnar
Text:
If you’re talking about the <Orange>Polaris Clan</>, we’re not currently accepting new members...
...but for you, it’s a different story.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You subtly slip away, saying you’re not at that level yet.)</>

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Haha, no need to be modest.
I owe you one myself.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
A clan is much the same, [player].
Since you’re a mercenary, you might find it easier to understand.

Name: Ragnar
Text: <Yellow>Clans are generally formed by those who share the same purpose.</>

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Among them, the Polaris Clan that I lead aims for the Tower.
We’ve already reached the first floor.

Name: Ragnar
Text: There are many other clans besides Polaris aiming for the Tower. Too many to count.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
And that’s not all.
There are also those who hunt giant monsters or seek to occupy the Monolith.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
I don’t know who you’ll join forces with,
But it’s certain that you can’t just stay as you are.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A chill runs down your spine, and a feeling of unease settles in.)</>

Name: Ragnar
Text: Instead of standing around, you should actively make a name for yourself.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Go to the Valley of Beasts and take down a Golem.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Make yourself known to the people!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Up there should be a good spot.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Simply finishing the hunt won’t draw attention.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...I guess Rada’s method is the only way.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: (Have people finally started taking notice...?)

Name: [player]
Text:
If I keep dancing, there’ll be no turning back.
I should stop before people get the wrong idea.

Name: Passer-by Naruru
Text: Here, over here!

Name: Passer-by Naruru
Text:
<Yellow>Me, interested. In you!
You! Be my co-com-compa-nion!</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I almost fell for that for a second. Snap out of it.)</>

Name: Passer-by Naruru
Text:
Fi-fishy, I’ll give you endless fishy!
I’ll tell you the rest when you’re an angry, angry, tail!

Name: Passer-by Naruru
Text:
Promise, you must promise!
It’s a pinky swear, OK?!

Name: Kishiga
Text: Me, <Orange>Kishiga!</> I’ll wait for the day we meet!

Name: Monica
Text:
What do you think you’re doing?
Why are you appearing out of nowhere and blocking the way?

Name: Monica
Text: I need to place a large object there, so move it—

Name: Monica
Text:
Wait... you’re that adventurer who’s been called upon by the <Orange>Divines</> lately.
A useful tool has rolled right in.

Name: Monica
Text: Hey, let’s work on something together.

Name: Monica
Text:
This is the <Orange>Appraisers’ Guild</>,
We might be understaffed but we have plenty of money!

Name: Monica
Text:
All the guild members have quit, so we’re shorthanded.
Not that they were useful to begin with, being so dim-witted.

Name: Monica
Text:
Since becoming Guild Master, I’ve introduced a new system.
Many ran away because they couldn’t accept it.

Name: Monica
Text:
Sitting at a desk to appraise artifacts handed over by others...
...and just taking commission is far too passive.

Name: Monica
Text:
I believe an appraiser should step in...
...from the very moment an artifact is discovered.

Name: Monica
Text:
Why was it there? What were the surroundings like?
Was it damaged during transport?

Name: Monica
Text: <Yellow>One must consider every detail to recognize its true value.</>

Name: Monica
Text:
You’re quicker on the uptake than I expected.
I suppose there’s a reason the Divines are keeping an eye on you.

Name: Monica
Text:
I’ll make you an offer. 
I’ll buy some of that surplus stamina of yours.

Name: Monica
Text:
The pay will be fair, so you won’t have any complaints, right?
Well then, let’s get moving.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What a statement. I’d better charge a high price.)</>

Name: Monica
Text: If you go to the west exit of Babylon, there’ll be a shipment addressed to the Guild.

Name: Monica
Text:
Bring it here, and don’t you dare break it.
Whether an Incursion breaks out or the Divines call for you, this comes first.

Name: Monica
Text:
It’s dozens of times more valuable than you are.
Understood? Then get going.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Just how important is this object...?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Ah, is that it? The packaging looks a bit flimsy for something so expensive.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let’s go and ask.)</>

Name: Courier
Text:
*Pant*, *gasp*... *wheeze*...
This is exhausting...

Name: Courier
Text: Are you by chance from the Appraisers' Guild?

Name: Courier
Text: First, please sign the delivery receipt here.
ItemDesc:
A document handed over by the courier.
It reads like a contract with dozens of clauses.
The phrase “Handle with Care, Same-Day Delivery” stands out.

Name: Courier
Text:
Payment was made in advance by Monica,
proxy recipient... signature complete...

Name: Courier
Text: The delivery destination is Babylon, not the Appraisers' Guild.

Name: Courier
Text: Everything is fulfilled, so I’ll be on my way.

Name: Courier
Text:
Ugh... why, why are there so many things to deliver?
I-I need to get to the next destination quickly!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The weight is manageable, but the bulk makes it troublesome...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She might get angry if I’m late, so let’s head straight to the Appraisers' Guild.)</>

Name: Monica
Text:
Is this all?
I clearly told them to send it in three separate boxes.

Name: Monica
Text:
There are only two.
Did you actually check before bringing them?

Name: Monica
Text: Hand over the receipt.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Monica snatches the receipt you signed and frowns angrily.)</>

Name: Monica
Text:
Does that head of yours actually do anything?
I was supposed to receive three, but you only brought two!

Name: Monica
Text:
Look, it’s written right here in the special clauses:
Each box shall contain a single artifact.

Name: Monica
Text: I didn’t realize you were a fool who couldn’t even read the common tongue.

Name: Monica
Text: <Yellow>Do I have to tell you every little thing? Can’t you think on your own?</>

Name: Monica
Text:
Hah, forget it.
It’s better to find a solution than to waste time bickering.

Name: Monica
Text: Go after that courier right now and get the last item.

Name: Monica
Text:
Whether he dropped it in the water or pocketed it himself...
...tell him to bring it before me at once.

Name: Monica
Text: I hope you’re not such an idiot as to make me abuse my authority over something like this.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He seemed to be leaving Babylon in a hurry...)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Did he run away on purpose, knowing something was missing?
He didn’t seem like a bad person.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I should ask if anyone saw him.)</>

Name: Babylon Resident
Text: Do you have any idea how many people pass through Babylon?

Name: Babylon Resident
Text:
Since it’s the hub for all supplies in the Forsaken Land,
dozens of couriers come and go every single day.

Name: Babylon Resident
Text: You’d be better off asking a guard.

Name: Babylon Resident
Text:
Compared to an ordinary person like me,
they’re far more observant.

Name: Gatekeeper
Text: A courier dealing with the Appraisers’ Guild... is it?

Name: Gatekeeper
Text: I recall their guild master being quite unique... what was her name again?

Name: Gatekeeper
Text: Ah, you mean Guild Master Monica.

Name: Gatekeeper
Text:
You’ll already know if you’ve spoken with her.
She’s got quite a fiery personality.

Name: Gatekeeper
Text: Most people cut ties with her pretty quickly, so it’s hard to pinpoint one courier.

Name: Gatekeeper
Text: However, couriers usually pass through the “Magobi Encampment.”

Name: Gatekeeper
Text:
Since carts or wagons aren’t allowed inside Babylon,
they park them there and just bring the items in.

Name: Gatekeeper
Text: Captain Zeyhan manages the entry logs very strictly.

Name: Gatekeeper
Text:
If the person you’re looking for stopped by the camp,
there will definitely be a record of it.

Name: Jeihan
Text: What is it?

Name: Jeihan
Text: Just like last time, you seem to spend a lot of time looking for people.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
If you remember his face, tell me.
I remember most of those who have passed through recently.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
Better to check the log, then.
I’ll show it to you briefly, so take a look.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Information about the people who passed through the camp is recorded by date.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Many people visited for various reasons.
There seems to be many merchants and transporters in particular.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Most are headed for the Babylon Market.
The person who went to the Appraisers’ Guild is...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Oh, this one?)</>
ItemDesc:
<Omitted>
■ Name: Yoar
■ Purpose of Visit: Transit
■ Expected Duration: Up to 10 days
■ Destination: Appraisers’ Guild in Babylon

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Let’s ask about this person.)</>

Name: Jeihan
Text: Yoar... Yes, I remember him.

Name: Jeihan
Text: He was carrying a large box all by himself, without a cart or a Rappie.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
He had a box tucked under each arm,
...and another one secured to his head with a strap when he arrived.

Name: Jeihan
Text: He even refused help from others, saying they were expensive items.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
He mentioned he had some time before the deadline,
...and seemed to be taking a good rest for a few days.

Name: Jeihan
Text: Then he left for Babylon the day before yesterday, only to return with a troubled look.

Name: Jeihan
Text: I wondered if something happened, but I didn’t ask.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
Come to think of it...
...I don’t think I saw that box he was carrying on his head.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
I’m not sure if that’s the reason,
...but he headed toward the Giant’s Garden, saying he had to find something.

Name: Jeihan
Text: You’ll be able to catch him if you hurry.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
Since he’s not traveling with a Rappie,
he’d at most have reached Aburu Village by now.

Name: Jeihan
Text:
It’s the least I can do, considering the help you’ve given this camp.
Don’t worry about it and get going.

Name: Yoar
Text: Y-You’re the adventurer who came instead of Lady Monica back then, right?

Name: Yoar
Text:
I’ll explain everything, so please help me...
I’m certain those darn Shadow Wolves stole it!

Name: Shrill Voice
Text:
The weak gets robbed.
I’ll take everything else you’ve got too, hehehe.

Name: Yoar
Text: I don’t want to get in the way, so I’ll hide in the corner!

Name: Yoar
Text: Thank you! Thank you so much…

Name: Yoar
Text:
Thanks to you, I can finish the delivery commission.
This is the final item that was supposed to be delivered to Guild Master Monica.
ItemDesc:
An item that failed to be delivered to Monica.
Even at a glance, it doesn’t look like it was made in this era.
Strange. It’s like déjà vu... have I seen this somewhere?

Name: Yoar
Text: Now that we’ve found it, we should take it back to Monica.

Name: Yoar
Text:
Could you... deliver it for me instead?
You signed for it anyway, so there’s no legal issues.

Name: Yoar
Text: No, no! I want to live longer...

Name: Yoar
Text:
<Yellow>“She killed dozens of guild members with a single word”…</>
...is what everyone says!

Name: Yoar
Text: Imagine how much she’d look down on someone like me. I’m just a porter...

Name: Yoar
Text:
*Sigh* All right...
It’ll only be a headache for me if she starts throwing her weight around.

Name: Yoar
Text: If I get banned from Babylon or something... *shivers*.

Name: Monica
Text:
You’re slower than a shriveled dragonfish.
How do you expect to stay alive like that?

Name: Yoar
Text: I’m sorry...

Name: Monica
Text: So, what happened to what I told you to bring?

Name: Monica
Text:
The contents are intact.
If there had been so much as a scratch, I would have charged you for damages.

Name: Monica
Text:
You can leave now.
I need to analyze this immediately.

Name: Yoar
Text: Really? Are you certain?

Name: Monica
Text: Why? Do you have something else to say?

Name: Yoar
Text:
<Yellow>Quit your job. I’ll report you to the Adventurers’ Alliance.</>
<Yellow>I’ll make sure you never set foot in Babylon again.</>

Name: Yoar
Text: Aren’t you going to say something like that?

Name: Monica
Text:
The deadline in the contract was today.
Since the day isn’t over, it’s not a breach of contract.

Name: Monica
Text:
If you had just been honest from the start that an accident happened,
I wouldn’t be this annoyed.

Name: Yoar
Text:
I apologize for that.
It’s just that I was afraid of you, Monica...

Name: Monica
Text:
Enough. I get that all the time.
Is there anything else we need to discuss?

Name: Yoar
Text:
O-of course not! Please call on me again next time.
Please excuse me.

Yoar gave a deep bow to Monica,
and bolted in the opposite direction.

Name: Monica
Text:
This is one of the recording devices used in ancient times.
They’re rarely found throughout the Forsaken Land.

Name: Monica
Text: If interpreted correctly, it could lead to a discovery that shakes <Blue>Elsetia</> to its core.

Name: Monica
Text: <Yellow>The origin of the Ancients, the Giant’s Tower, the world outside Elsetia...</>

Name: Monica
Text: Scholars of this era have so much to research, don’t they?

Name: Monica
Text:
For that purpose, I’ll get my hands on any artifact I can.
Appraisers are always in search of new specimens.

Name: Monica
Text: If you use a teleportation device, there’s a high chance the artifact will be affected.

Name: Monica
Text:
Even if our guild manages the device,
it’s not like we can just remodel it for safe delivery.

Name: Monica
Text:
They can be shattered or cracked by Aether waves,
and sometimes they even lose their original form.

Name: Monica
Text:
The worst-case scenario is the artifact’s unique energy being neutralized.
Once that happens, it’ll be nothing more than “expensive” trash.

Name: Monica
Text: Artifacts randomly found by ordinary people usually end up on the black market.

Name: Monica
Text: It’s obvious, isn’t it? Winning a bid in the underworld costs a fortune.

Name: Monica
Text:
After finally securing ownership,
we can’t let it be ruined just because of a teleportation device.

Name: Monica
Text:
Now that you understand, get ready to go to the heart of the Giant’s Garden...
...the “Navel of Ea.”

Name: Monica
Text: Let’s find something before others get their hands on it.

Name: Monica
Text: I set up a few flags during my preliminary investigation.

Name: Monica
Text:
I've carefully pinpointed locations where “artifiacts” are likely to be found.
Oh, is it your first time hearing that term?

Name: Monica
Text: You can think of them as ancient relics that possess special functions.

Name: Monica
Text: Well, I'll explain later.

Name: Monica
Text:
Go and channel your power.
If you detect anything, let me know immediately.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You discovered an object with fluctuating Aether.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I feel like I could discover something if I commune with it a bit more...
But first, I’ll head back and talk more.)</>

Name: Monica
Text:
So, you're saying you felt something creeping out from it?
I guess we really are built differently.

Name: Monica
Text: Right now, visually, all I can say is <Yellow>"I've never seen anything like this before."</>

Name: Monica
Text:
You’ve seen the floating debris in the Incursion Realms, right?
They're called <Blue>Tesseracts</>.

Name: Monica
Text:
It definitely looks like one.
But ancient relics often look alike, so I can't say for sure.

Name: Monica
Text:
Still, it's a good thing my assistant is so capable.
This could end up being the discovery of the century!

Name: Monica
Text:
No faction has ever announced anything like this.
Hehe... shall we start by examining its appearance?

Name: Monica
Text:
Let's head somewhere quieter first.
The waterfall is too loud for a proper conversation.

Name: Monica
Text:
Where was I...?
Ah, did I mention there are many competing factions?

Name: Monica
Text: Do you have any idea how many organizations are after these things?

Name: Monica
Text:
The one with as much influence as our guild is the <Orange>Bardad Expedition.</>
You've probably encountered them.

Name: Monica
Text:
They absolutely refuse to yield anything they find during their expeditions.
They don't even have any real results... it's purely out of greed.

Name: Monica
Text: Plus, there are the oddballs from the Hunters’ Guild.

Name: Monica
Text:
There are folks who operate under the alias <Orange>“Treasure Hunters.”</>
