Their only goal is to sell relics off to the highest bidder.

Name: Monica
Text: And the most troublesome of all are the <Orange>“Liberators of Knowledge.”</>

Name: Monica
Text:
Their goal is pure: they want to restore ancient technology
for the sake of all beings in Elsetia.

Name: Monica
Text: Since their public justification sounds the noblest on paper, many findings get handed over to them.

Name: Monica
Text:
From my perspective, it's incredibly frustrating.
You can't just buy your way out of that kind of influence.

Name: Monica
Text: Still, they provide us with a lot of tools, so it's not like we're outright enemies.

Name: Monica
Text:
Now, “appraise” the artifiact and let me know the results.
I'll finish recording its physical traits.

Name: Yoar
Text: *gasp...!* Monsters suddenly appeared out of thin air from the bare ground, didn't they?!

Name: Yoar
Text:
At least Incursions give some sort of warning from the sky...
I was truly shocked because I've never seen anything like this ever before.

Name: Yoar
Text:
Fortunately, you took cleared them out in a flash.
You're amazing, as always!

Name: Yoar
Text:
Actually, I asked the Appraisers’ Guild...
They told me you two went to the Giant's Garden, so I barely managed to track you down.

Name: Yoar
Text: It was my first time using a Warp Conduit, and it felt so strange.

Name: Yoar
Text:
It felt like it was sucking me in,
swallowed me whole... Ugh!

Name: Yoar
Text:
Besides, I heard that you need…
a high level of Aether or whatever it’s called.

Name: Yoar
Text:
Out of curiosity, I once touched the Warp Conduit at the hot springs.
I didn't even realize that was part of the “registration” process.

Name: Yoar
Text: I have something to tell you!

Name: Yoar
Text:
I stumbled upon this while doing a task a colleague dumped on me.
I thought it might be of use to Monica.

Name: Yoar
Text: Holding it tightly gives me this weird feeling.

Name: Yoar
Text:
It feels like my heart is squirming,
and sometimes it gives me a throbbing headache.

Name: Yoar
Text: Monica is the Appraisers’ Guild Master, so she'd definitely know about it, right?

Name: Yoar
Text: Ugh, I just hope she doesn't chew me out.

Name: Monica
Text:
Hmm? Was there an issue with our last contract?
I paid the fee in full.

Name: Monica
Text: Why did you seek me out? And who tipped you off about my location?

Name: Yoar
Text: I asked Adelaide...

Name: Monica
Text:
Adel?
Hmm... All right, wait right there.

Name: Monica
Text:
I need to hear the report on the artifiact from my assistant first.
We'll handle your business after that.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You explain that monsters poured out when the artifiact was activated,
and that it vanished without a trace once they were defeated.)</>

Name: Monica
Text: ...That sounds similar to the item mentioned during the <Red>“Shadow Wolves”</> incident.

Name: Monica
Text:
The Divines haven't made an official announcement,
but I heard a disaster similar to an Incursion took place.

Name: Monica
Text:
With absolutely no warning signs,
monsters you'd normally only see in the Giant's Tower suddenly appeared.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You explain that it looks practically identical to the tool
used by the leader of the Wolves at that scene.)</>

Name: Monica
Text:
So it's an artifiact designed to artificially trigger an Incursion.
And since it vanished so quickly, it's likely single-use.

Name: Yoar
Text:
That sounds incredibly dangerous...
If misused, there wouldn't even be time to react.

Name: Yoar
Text:
Oh, or maybe not?
It might actually be useful for those who go in and out of the Tower.

Name: Yoar
Text:
Many go there seeking treasures and gold coins, right?
It's like getting the same loot opportunities without the hassle of going to the Tower.

Name: Monica
Text:
That's exactly why the guild needs to make it public and manage them properly.
We need to mandate that any <Blue>Tesseract replicas</> be brought straight to us.

Name: Monica
Text:
For now, let's go recover the remaining ones.
I have a few other locations in mind besides this one.

Name: Monica
Text: So, why exactly did Adel send you?

Name: Yoar
Text: Because I practically begged her, saying I absolutely had to see Monica again.

Name: Yoar
Text:
B-but she didn't do anything wrong!
She was just fulfilling her duties as the Vice Guild Master...

Name: Monica
Text: ...Why are you so intimidated?

Name: Monica
Text:
It's not like I’ll bite your head off.
Why would I criticize someone for doing their job properly?

Name: Monica
Text:
I was just asking to make sure you weren't being followed.
I've ruffled the feathers of some big shots in the black market.

Name: Monica
Text:
I ignored their warnings to stop outbidding them,
and now they’re threatening that they’ll make me pay.

Name: Yoar
Text:
Isn't that dangerous?
Going as far as the underworld to get relics...

Name: Monica
Text: What else can I do? I don't possess any special powers.

Name: Monica
Text:
I can't even detect artifiacts on my own.
I'm just an ordinary person who can barely use Warp Conduits.

Name: Monica
Text:
Even if I scour the field myself, I’d get nothing.
So I have to be willing to take certain risks.

Name: Monica
Text:
Specifically, no profession is better of worse than another.
But if you lack potential, life’s going to be uncomfortable.

Name: Yoar
Text: Then... could something like this be considered potential?

Yoar pulled something from his pocket and placed it on his palm.
It was the same type as the Tesseract replica.

As he squinted as if trying to focus,
a faint blue light pulsed from it before fading away.

Monica's eyes widened as she asked what was happening,
and Yoar slowly replied with an explanation.

Name: Monica
Text:
You... quit your job as a deliveryman this instant.
It's the duty of the gifted not to let their talents go to waste.

Name: Yoar
Text: H-huh? I was just trying to hand over this stone fragment...

Name: Monica
Text: Hey, temp assistant? Could you give us a moment?

Name: Monica
Text:
I have a feeling this conversation is going to take a while.
I'll entrust the follow-up investigation to you in the meantime.

Name: Monica
Text: I've set up markers, so just proceed like you did in the garden.

Name: Monica
Text:
If you happen to find more of the same kind,
don't activate them this time and just bring them back as they are.

Name: Monica
Text:
If we managed to find this many just in the Giant's Garden...
they must be scattered extensively across other realms as well.

Name: Monica
Text:
Yoar and I tinkered around with it a bit,
and it's well under our guild's control.

Name: Monica
Text: It means we can trigger “safe incursions” intentionally.

Name: Monica
Text:
I never imagined we'd end up utilizing such a lethal disaster in this manner.
It's quite an ironic process.

Name: Monica
Text:
Well... things are playing out exactly the way I wanted, so it’s not bad.
Having Yoar's help will make things much smoother, too.

Name: Yoar
Text:
Haha, somehow I ended up joining the Appraisers’ Guild.
She insisted my true talent lies here...

Name: Monica
Text:
If anyone could recognize the true value of rare artifacts,
we wouldn’t need appraisers, would we?

Name: Monica
Text:
No wonder I felt such a strong sense of trust when we signed the contract.
Were you drawn to your kind?

Name: Yoar
Text: Not at all... I'm just lucky enough to spot the anomalies.

Name: Monica
Text:
You're going to go far.
Once you get some experience under your belt, you'll surpass me in no time.

Name: Yoar
Text:
You flatter me... hehe.
Still, I've always wanted to prove my worth, so I guess things worked out, right?

Name: Yoar
Text:
Since I get terrible motion sickness on Mounts,
making a living as a porter strictly on foot was really taking its toll...

Name: Monica
Text:
I plan on training this guy personally.
Unearthing hidden talent is part of a guild master's job, after all.

Name: Monica
Text: With most of the guild gone, I can't afford to let a promising colleague slip away.

Name: Monica
Text:
From now on, you’re no longer an assistant.
Thanks for all your help until now.

Name: Monica
Text:
Hehe... Yoar.
Welcome to the world of appraisers.

Name: Yoar
Text:
Yes! Thank you for recognizing me.
I won't let you down!

Name: Orica
Text:
Hehe, welcome.
You have no idea how long I've been waiting for you!

Name: Orica
Text: Hey, it’s not just the Merchants’ Guild that trades information.

Name: Orica
Text: We make our living through the eyes and ears we've planted all over, you know?

Name: Orica
Text:
I'm Orica.
As you can see, I run the Explorers’ Guild.

Name: Orica
Text:
Oh, and no need to introduce yourself, [player].
Your reputation precedes you.

Name: Orica
Text: <Yellow>The adventurer favored by the Divine, the hero who halted the Barrens Incursion, the one who eradicated the Shadow Wolves...</>

Name: [Player]
Text: <Yellow>(You wave your hands awkwardly, feeling embarrassed.)</>

Name: Orica
Text: Haha, this is where you say, <Yellow>"Yes, that would be me!"</>

Orica bursts into a fit of manic laughter the moment the words leave your mouth, and then,
suddenly begins communicating with someone over a communicator.

Name: [Player]
Text:
<Yellow>(...This seems like the perfect chance to slip away,
but who knows what she might do if I actually try it. I’ll just wait.)</>

Name: Orica
Text:
*sigh...* I was hoping to kill some time listening to your grand tales of heroism,
but I guess today isn't the day.

Name: Orica
Text:
Word is an ancient artifiact is stirring up trouble.
Think you could lend a hand? I'll compensate you handsomely, of course.

Name: Orica
Text:
That goes without saying.
We're the quickest to catch wind of rumors spreading among adventurers and mercenaries.

Name: [Player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Lending the Explorers’ Guild a hand might lead to clues about the mercenaries.
I’ll agree to help.)</>

Name: Orica
Text:
Excellent! Now that's the spirit of “the renowned adventurer!”
Head to the Magobi Encampment and seek out Bailiegh.

Name: Orica
Text:
Oh, and take this with you.
Just do as you're told, and you'll be fine. Don't sweat it!
ItemName: Consent Form for Explorers’ Guild Research
ItemDesc: A consent form stating participation in research conducted by the Explorers’ Guild. The name and date fields are left blank. ...But why does this not feel right?

Name: [Player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Hmm... Nobody around here looks like a Bailiegh.
I should go ask Jeihan.)</>

Name: Jeihan
Text:
It's been a while, adventurer.
What brings you all the way here?

Name: [Player]
Text:
<Yellow>(When you say you were looking for Bailiegh from the Explorers’ Guild,
Jeihan frowns slightly.)</>

Name: Jeihan
Text: You'll likely find him if you head toward the Gorge of Perdition.

Name: [Player]
Text: <Yellow>(I think I hear something from over there.)</>

Name: Bailey
Text: ...You're so weak, pathetic, and utterly useless.

Name: Bailey
Text: Don't test my patience and get lost while I'm still asking nicely.

Name: Frightened Guild Member
Text: I-I'm so sorry! Vice Guild Master Bailiegh!

Name: [Player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Hmm. Feels like this will get me in trouble too, but I guess I have no choice.)</>

Name: Bailey
Text: Who the heck are you?

Name: Bailey
Text:
Ah... the “renowned adventurer,” right?
Perfect timing. I was just getting sick of dealing with these deadweights.

Name: Bailey
Text:
I'm Bailiegh,
Vice Guild Master of the Explorers’ Guild, and Special Member of the <Orange>Springwater Raven Society</>.

Name: Bailey
Text:
I utterly despise incompetence and stupidity, so keep that in mind.
Now hand over whatever Orica gave you.

Name: Bailey
Text: Sigh, why do they keep swapping the Death Waiver for a Research Consent Form?

Name: [Player]
Text: <Yellow>(...? He says the word “Death Waiver” like it’s nothing...)</>

Name: Bailey
Text:
What's with the shocked look?
You should be grateful we warn you in advance.

Name: Bailey
Text:
Stop gaping like an idiot and just sign the darn paper.
And fill in your name correctly.

Name: Bailey
Text: From now on, [player], you are officially participating in the <Blue>“Replica Seed”</> research.

Name: Bailey
Text: Before we dive in, let me go over a few ground rules.

Name: Bailey
Text: I don’t like speaking lengthily, so just read this.
ItemDesc:
1. Participants waive the right to file claims regarding unavoidable accidents (including injury and death) that occur during the research.
2. Participants must accompany Bailiegh to ensure the safe handling of the Replica Seed.
3. This research is conducted under a joint pact between the Liberators of Knowledge and the Explorers’ Guild; therefore, strict confidentiality is mandatory.

Name: [Player]
Text: <Yellow>(What kind of lunatic drafted these clauses...? Not even mercenary contracts are like this.)</>

Name: Bailey
Text: Follow me. I'll brief you on the details as we walk.

Name: Bailey
Text: You see that up ahead?

Name: [Player]
Text:
<Yellow>(A distorted mass of light... 
You mention that it clearly looks different from Aether.)</>

Name: Bailey
Text: Oh! You don’t disappoint me.

Name: Bailey
Text:
That's organic matter harboring the biological data of a Karugura.
You could consider it a type of <Blue>“Factor</>.”

Name: Bailey
Text:
Certain monsters leave traces like that and disappear.
Though from a distance, it's indistinguishable from normal dust.

Name: Bailey
Text:
Your task is simple, [player].
Find those deposits and scoop them into this.
ItemDesc: An ancient artifact entrusted to the Explorers’ Guild by the Liberators of Knowledge.

Name: Bailey
Text:
Replica Seed.
It's an ancient artifact given to us by the <Orange>Liberators of Knowledge</>.

Name: Bailey
Text:
It's a fascinating little device that reacts to the biological data of specific monsters,
but hardly anyone uses it properly.

Name: Bailey
Text: I don't expect much from you either, but I'll at least give you a shot at it.

Name: Bailey
Text: Once you're confident you've gathered enough Factors, meet me at the waterfall ruins.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(There are Factors up there as well.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Will this be enough?)</>

Name: Frightened Guild Member
Text:
*sob...* I really, really gave it my all.
Just how much more do I have to dooo?!

Name: Frightened Guild Member
Text: Bailiegh constantly berates me for being useless! *sob*

Name: Frightened Guild Member
Text:
Ugh, b-back off! Get away from me!
You can't... You can’t take this!

Name: Frightened Guild Member
Text: The Replica Seed...! Do you... have any idea how precious this is?!

Guess you can't just walk away from this.
Better talk to the frightened guild member, find out what happened, and help them.

Name: Frightened Guild Member
Text: Phew, I genuinely thought I was a goner this time. Thank you for stepping in.

Name: Nicola
Text:
I am Nicola.
I'm a researcher for the Explorers’ Guild, and an As-Associate Member of the Springwater Raven Society.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You ask him why he was wandering around alone when it's swarming with monsters.)</>

Name: Nicola
Text: W, well..!

After rambling for a good while, Nicola finally confessed that he was pushing his luck,
wandering around in a desperate bid to deliver the Replica Seed to Bailiegh.

Name: Nicola
Text: This is the least I can do. Otherwise, I’ll be disqualified from assisting Bailiegh.

Name: Nicola
Text:
O-Of course, he has a bad personality and treats people like tools.
And he looks down on ordinary folk, but…

Name: Nicola
Text:
He’s not that bad of a person.
At the very least, he gives everyone a fair chance.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is that supposed to be a compliment, or an insult...?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Advise him to head back to the Encampment for his own safety.)</>

Name: Nicola
Text:
Th-That would be the smart move, wouldn't it?
If I suffer an injury out here, I'll be stripped of my assistant title anyway...

Name: Nicola
Text:
And if that happens, I'll be forced into servitude under that bearded muscle-bound grandpa...
Ugh, the mere thought is terrifying.

Name: Nicola
Text: Th-Then, please deliver this to Bailiegh for me!
ItemDesc:
The Replica Seed gathered by Nicola.
It's laden with Karugura's Factor, so you’d better handle it with care.

Name: Nicola
Text:
I scraped together every single trace of Karugura Factor I could find nearby,
so I-I'm positive it will be useful.

Name: Nicola
Text:
Adventurer! I spotted more Factors further down the slope,
So perhaps you should search that way?

Name: Nicola
Text:
I-I won't try anything stupid. I'll use a Warp Scroll to head straight back.
You have my word!

Name: Bailey
Text: The ink on that consent form hasn’t even dried yet, and I was already bracing myself to clean up your corpse.

Name: Bailey
Text: Now, let's see what you managed to gather.

Bailiegh clicked his tongue as he inspected the Replica Seeds,
then plucked one out and tossed it back to me.

Name: Bailey
Text: Barely any of this is usable... You didn’t try that hard, did you?

Name: Bailey
Text:
Equally worthless.
Tsk, he can't even protect himself, yet he does tasks I didn’t even ask for...

Name: Bailey
Text: Whatever, just verify if this one operates properly.
ItemDesc: The Replica Seed handed over by Bailiegh.

Name: Bailey
Text:
Focus. Imagine you're unlocking a sealed door.
Visualizing your journey home works as well.

Name: Bailey
Text: Follow me. This spot should serve our purposes.

Name: Bailey
Text: *sigh* I thought things would work out for once...

Name: Bailey
Text:
Isn't it obvious?
The biological data is either insufficient, tainted, or both.

Name: Bailey
Text: Karugura data clearly won't cut it. We'd better relocate to the Giant's Garden.

Name: Bailey
Text: Make your way to the Great Arbor Domain.

Name: Bailey
Text: I was half a second away from tearing up your consent form, but you arrived right on cue.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I didn’t keep him waiting that long... )</>

Name: Bailey
Text:
Our mark this time is Tagar.
I don't need to spell out the rest, right?

Name: Bailey
Text: Circle back to the Ancient Ruins once you've amassed a sufficient amount.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Unlike the Gorge of Perdition, the area is teeming with Factors.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Hold on. Why is that person out here?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I should suggest heading back to Babylon before things get too dangerous.)</>

Name: Nicola
Text:
Wha—?! You scared me!
What... What are you doing all the way out here?!

Name: Nicola
Text:
Me? I’m just doing my part as an assistant!
We need to collect Tagar's Factors, don't we?

Name: Nicola
Text:
See those Narurus over there?
Money can buy anything, and this place is no exception.

After explaining the agreement between Sharaf and the Hunters’ Guild to Nicola,
you try to persuade her to stop.
However, Nicola remains stubborn, and you have no choice but to use force.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Hmm... Just a light KO. She’ll be fine, right?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(First, let's find the Narurus and send them back to the camp,
then look for Tagar's Factors.)</>

Name: Sniffling Naruru
Text: I should’ve listened... Sharaf told me, never, never trust humans…

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You explain it clearly to the Naruru, then you apologize once more.)</>

Name: Aerymia
Text: Ung! I... I’ll believe you… I will!

Name: Aerymia
Text: Huu, I should’ve listened to Sharaf... It’s my bad…

Name: Aerymia
Text:
But I need to buy a gift for my little brother... for Kishiga…
I need the gol-d... gold that humans use.

Name: Aerymia
Text: But if I get hurt because of gold, he will be sad—so, so sad.

Name: Aerymia
Text: Ah, what should I dooo?<Yellow>Narurus always keep their deals… always!</>

Name: Aerymia
Text: I have to collect those sparkly, fluffy, float-floaty things!
ItemDesc: To help Aerymia keep her promise to her little brother…

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(After telling Aerymia that you’d collect the Tagar Factors and give them to Nicola,
you hand the gold to Aerymia.)</>

Name: Aerymia
Text:
Thank you... thank you, human!
I’ll repay your kindness. I really will!

Name: Aerymia
Text:
The sparkly, float-floaty things are there by the water... the water’s edge!
You have to look near the water!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(This should do it. I’d better get back to Bailiegh now.)</>

Name: Aerymia
Text:
<Red>Bad... bad humans need to be punished!</>
I-I’m here to help!

Name: Aerymia
Text:
Angry Tail! Protect—protect the adventurer!
Bailiegh, this clears our debt. Our debt, right?

Name: Nicola
Text: Wh... What?! That otter and the witch actually knew each other?!

Name: Bailey
Text:
What a fool... 
A Naruru without armor stands in Kuduru’s Domain, and you don’t even find it strange!

Name: Nicola
Text:
Y-you... you heartless monster!
You’re the one who pushed a helpless undergrad like me into this death trap!

Name: Bailey
Text:
Tsk, what an absolute embarrassment.
How am I supposed to face the Hunters’ Guild?

Name: Bailey
Text:
And you—get your story straight.
It wasn’t enough to lie about being my assistant, but you had to go and smuggle artifacts too?

Name: Bailey
Text: This is exactly why I say we should never let laymen in.
After Aerymia and Angry Tail gave Nicola a taste of justice, the two returned to Aburu Village...

Name: Bailey
Text:
Thanks, adventurer.
Thanks to you, I managed to take out the trash.

Bailiegh explains that after Nicola joined the Explorers’ Guild,
artifacts had started disappearing one by one.

To catch the thief red-handed, Bailiegh kept Nicola close under constant watch.
Then you came along, volunteering for the Replica Seed experiment...

Bailiegh saw it as the perfect opportunity and waited patiently…
…until there was a decisive piece of evidence.

Name: Bailey
Text: On top of that, it turned out the disappearance of previous volunteers…

Name: Bailey
Text: …and the fact that the Clans didn't show the slightest bit of interest—was all that rat’s doing.

Name: Bailey
Text: And here I was, knowing nothing, complaining, <Yellow>“For Divinity folks, their butts sure are heavy, glued to their fancy cushions!”</> Hah!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...What a biting choice of words.)</>

Name: Bailey
Text: Anyway, I’ve already sent word to Orica. The Guild members will be here soon to haul him away.

Name: Bailey
Text:
What on earth are you talking about?
Nicola is like removing uncertainty for a perfect experiment.

Name: Bailey
Text: <Yellow>Now, you and I just need to finish this Replica Seed research together.</>

Name: Bailey
Text: All right, let’s get this experiment started.

Name: Bailey
Text: Ready, adventurer?

Name: Bailey
Text: All right, let’s head over there.

Name: Bailey
Text: Oh, before we go, I have a confession to make.

Name: Bailey
Text: <Yellow>That thing I gave you... it's not the real Replica Seed.</>

Name: Bailey
Text:
It’s an ancient artifact that clones and summons monsters,
using their factor information they left behind.

Name: Bailey
Text:
I couldn't just hand something like that to anyone.
That sly Nicola alone was already thinking of smuggling it…

Name: Bailey
Text: So, I made a duplicate of the Replica Seed.

Name: Bailey
Text:
It looks identical, but its function is less than half of the original.
All it can do is collect factors, nothing more.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(When you ask whether Karugura failed because the Seed was a fake,
Bailiegh nods.)</>

Name: Bailey
Text:
I could feel that rat lurking nearby.
Even if I wanted to give you the real one, the situation wasn’t exactly ideal.

Name: Bailey
Text: But in the end, my acting fooled both of you, so I'd call that a success.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Getting tricked stings, but given the situation, the reason makes sense.)</>

Name: Bailey
Text:
Now, let’s get the point.
Now, this... is the real <Blue>Replica Seed</>.
ItemDesc:
It looks almost identical to the fake one Bailiegh gave you before.
Unless you look closely, they are practically indistinguishable.

Name: Bailey
Text:
For now, it only reacts to specific monsters.
But someday, we might be able to use it on humans as well.

Name: Bailey
Text: …Well, it’s just a possibility for now, of course.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She’s smiling so brightly, but why do I have chills down my spine?!)</>

Name: Bailey
Text: Now, let’s go conduct the real experiment, adventurer.

Name: Bailey
Text: <Yellow>No risk of contamination during transport, immediate factor activation...</>

Name: Bailey
Text: With these conditions, the failure rate should be near zero.

Name: Bailey
Text:
Use the Replica Seed while thinking:
wake it, create it or something like that…

Name: Bailey
Text: Don’t worry, I’ll be right there with you.

Name: Bailey
Text: ...? Even if it's a replica, its combat style and power are the same. You thought you'd handle that alone?

Name: Bailey
Text: I have no interest in cleaning up corpses, so stop grumbling and just follow my lead.

Name: Bailey
Text: *sigh...* Guess it’s a good thing the death waiver became useless.

Name: Bailey
Text: How does it feel meeting a Tagar manifested from factors?

Name: Bailey
Text:
Exactly. And considering the safety of distribution... 
it’d be better to trade at the clan level.

Name: Bailey
Text:
Thanks to you, I think we pulled off a proper experiment.
Thanks, adventurer.

Name: Bailey
Text: You can collect your reward from Orica for participating in the research.

Name: Bailey
Text:
Babylon.
Ah, and before you leave, let me see your communicator. Let's get you registered.

Name: Bailey
Text:
I'll find you if any high-risk, high-paying jobs come up.
See you later.

Name: Orica
Text: Wait, stop. Don't give me that look.

Name: Orica
Text:
All right, all right. I get it.
You didn’t think I’d show up empty-handed, did you?

Name: Orica
Text:
First, take the premium-grade Baba Liquor.
I managed to sneak it out of the brewery's private stash!

Name: Orica
Text: And this... this is the information you were looking for, right?
ItemDesc: It contains information gathered by the Explorers’ Guild regarding the Sverd Mercenaries.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A report detailing the mercenaries' movements.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(They sweep through every corner of the Forsaken Lands to hold back the Incursion.
...But those who headed for the Tower have vanished without a trace.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(A few stragglers are still searching for their Captain.
Xeros, Simon...)</>

Name: Orica
Text: …Sorry to disappoint you.

Name: Orica
Text: I’ll contact you if any new artifacts or interesting news come in.

Name: Orica
Text: It’ll be before the Appraisers’ Guild or Merchants’ Guild hear of it. …Deal, [player]?

Name: Orica
Text:
Great…!
Then let’s hope we talk again soon.

Name: Evrin
Text: I appreciate your quick cooperation.

Name: Evrin
Text:
That will depend on your answer.
But first, would you mind checking this?
ItemDesc: It asks to describe any unusual phenomena observed while exploring the Forsaken Land recently.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Hmm… I guess there was no need to be so nervous after all.)</>

Name: Evrin
Text: I wonder what you wrote, adventurer.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The look on Evrine’s face while reading the questionnaire keeps bothering you.
You filled out every line, but…)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(…Should I have written more detail? What should I do?)</>

Name: Evrin
Text:
<Blue>The Labyrinth, Incursion, Trial Gates, Ethereal Sanctum…</>
Everything is exactly as I expected.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Since you now seem more than capable of holding your own,
I’d like you to lend your strength to the new adventurers.

Name: Evrin
Text: I need you to verify if the alleged rumors are true.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(She's doesn’t seem the type to call me in for something like this...
You stared at her with a look of disbelief.)</>

Name: Evrin
Text:
Word is that adventurers are vanishing.
To be precise, they <Yellow>“disappear for a moment and then return.”</>

Name: Evrin
Text:
That’s what I thought at first.
But I was wrong.

Name: Evrin
Text: Have you ever heard of the <Blue>Infinite Corridor</>?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You look at the paper Evrin gave you, but nothing comes to mind right away.)</>
ItemDesc:
You stare at it, but you don’t understand a thing.
Could this be related to the Infinite Corridor?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It looks like entangled Aether,
or perhaps a concentrated mass of something...)</>

Name: Evrin
Text: ...All right, you clearly have no idea, so I need you to do this job.

Name: Evrin
Text: Then who exactly is it that treats Trial Gates and Ethereal Sanctums like their own backyard?

Name: Evrin
Text:
Don’t tell me the Explorers’ Guild Master lied to me!
That would be a problem.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Then let's start with the bustling spots.
There might be a useful clue or two out there.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(If I just start asking out of nowhere, I'll only look suspicious.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You listen in on what they’re saying.)</>

Name: Drunkard
Text: If I only had the gold, I wouldn’t be drinking this swill!

Name: Drunkard
Text: I’d be drinking... uh... that Baba Liquor Naruru makes!

Name: Calm Resident
Text: Well, you could’ve had it if you hadn't wasted all your coins.

Name: Drunkard
Text: Forget it! Pour another! Drink up! Let’s drink and die happy, my friend!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The ultimate Baba Liquor... is really popular, isn’t it?)</>

Name: Boastful Naruru
Text: If you want to be a top-tier adventurer, adventurer, you must follow me, me!

Name: Twisted Adventurer
Text: Ha! How dare an otter say such arrogant things?!

Name: Stoic Adventurer
Text:
Ignore that loudmouth and focus on me.
So, where's our next target?

Name: Boastful Naruru
Text:
This isn't the place to talk, it’s not!
I’ll tell you in a secret, a very secret place.

Name: Boastful Naruru
Text: But let’s finish, finish off this eyesore first!

Name: Twisted Adventurer
Text: Wh-What?! <Red>No violence! No violence!</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I knew he looked like an Angry Tail. He should've been more careful.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Nothing useful here. Let’s check the other side.)</>

Name: Exhausted Adventurer
Text:
Is that all you have to say, Kayla?
After everything I went through?

Name: Kayla
Text:
But you’re back!
That’s all that matters, Sadi!

Name: Sadi
Text:
Hah... Never again. I am never doing that Infinite Corridor thing again.
I mean, I went in just ten minutes ago, right?

Name: Kayla
Text:
It’s been three days since you entered.
Don't get it twisted, please.

Name: Sadi
Text:
What? Quit messing around! I wrote down the exact date I entered the corridor!
Let me just... wait, what...?

Name: Kayla
Text:
*sigh...* Who else would put up with you if not me?
Even Master Evrin only accepted you because of me.

Name: Kayla
Text:
At least you didn't come back empty-handed.
Well then, ready to go again?

Name: Sadi
Text: No! No way! I just want to rest for at least one day!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(All right, let's go talk to them.)</>

Name: Sadi
Text:
Don’t approach this person.
Not over my dead body—!

Name: Sadi
Text: Revenge... revenge will be mine—!

Before I could even stop her, Kayla dragged Sadi away.
He lied sprawled under the table, completely unconscious.

Name: Kayla
Text: He’s just asleep, not dead, so don't you worry.

Name: Kayla
Text: I noticed you’ve been lingering around for a while. Do you have business with us?

Name: Kayla
Text:
Just so you know, Sadi’s debts were paid off a long time ago.
So don't even think about bringing that up.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I told her I overheard their talk about the Infinite Corridor,
and explained that I'm here to investigate it.)</>

Name: Kayla
Text:
*sigh...* Master Evrin, really.
Her own guild members are working so hard, and yet she drags in some random adventurer...

Name: Kayla
Text: Oh my, I’m not done! Hear me out!

Name: Kayla
Text:
Since my partner ended up in that state, you’ll have to take responsibility.
In exchange, I’ll give you information on the Infinite Corridor.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It’s not even my fault...
You frown, wondering what she's really up to.)</>

Name: Kayla
Text:
Go to the Infinite Corridor in Sadi’s place.
I’ll tell you how, so don’t worry.

Name: Kayla
Text:
I’m not taking “no” for an answer.
If Master Evrin entrusted this to you, she must have a good reason, don’t you think?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You suggest each person investigate in their own way, but she doesn't look like she's listening at all.)</>

Name: Kayla
Text:
*sigh...* I guess she didn't expect much from us in the first place.
Not from amateurs like us, anyway...

Name: Kayla
Text: After all the trouble we went through to find this out... She could have at least given us a word of encouragement...!
Rather than listening to any more of Kayla’s complaints, you decide to go to the Infinite Corridor.

Name: Kayla
Text:
Take this first.
You'll need it to get to the Infinite Corridor.

Name: Kayla
Text: Oh, a former mercenary, maybe?

Name: Kayla
Text:
I knew we’d speak the same language!
Working for free? That doesn't exist in my dictionary.

Name: Kayla
Text: <Red>Irresponsible pleasure</> is the kind of thing the guild master would do.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(That's incredibly harsh. I wonder how much they usually have to put up with...)</>

Name: Kayla
Text: They think investigations are done in a snap because someone orders it. It's the absolute worst.
Rather than listening to any more of Kayla’s complaints, you decide to go to the Infinite Corridor.

Name: Kayla
Text:
Take this first.
You'll need it to get to the Infinite Corridor.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What is this now...?)</>
ItemDesc:
A paper with disorganized information about the Infinite Corridor.
The liquid inside the bottle looks somewhat suspicious.

Name: Kayla
Text:
It was nice when we could reach it from the wasteland before,
but this time it appeared near Ea's Navel...

Name: Kayla
Text:
Well, we can't exactly ignore the Naruru Tribe.
Sigh, I'm dying of anxiety not knowing how long it'll stay open.

Name: Kayla
Text:
It won't be too late to explain after we get back, so let's just hurry up and go!
Hey, I'm telling you it's urgent, seriously!

Name: Kayla
Text:
Etana will be waiting in front of Aburu Village.
She’s young but a sharp Naruru.

Name: Kayla
Text: If you just give her the <Yellow>“Potion,”</> she'll take you right to the entrance of the Infinite Corridor.

Name: Kayla
Text:
It's my livelihood, so don't ask questions.
Still, it's not toxic, so don't worry.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is that the Naruru Kaila mentioned? Let's get closer.)</>

Name: Etana
Text:
W-what...? Not two, but one... Just one!
I shall uncover your true identity!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You earnestly explain that Kaila had matters to attend to, so you came in her stead.)</>

Name: Etana
Text:
Ahem, I suppose I'll believe you!
The item... did you bring the item properly?

Name: Etana
Text:
Good, good!
They said this is only given to... to trust, trust-worthy people!

Name: Etana
Text: For Kai-la's sake, I'll allow you to go see... see the great God Ea!

Name: Etana
Text: Before that, you have to prepare a gift... a gift for God Ea.

Name: Etana
Text:
Pick lots and lots of flowers... pretty flowers at Sunrise Slope...
And we'll meet... meet at Ea's Navel!

Name: Etana
Text:
Well done, well done!
Then let's go to God Ea... God Ea now!

Name: Etana
Text: Just follow me closely!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Follow Etana down the stairs.)</>

Name: Etana
Text: This way, this way! Hoo-man!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Just how far do we have to go down?)</>

Name: Etana
Text: <Yellow>The flowers can't be ruined, absolutely not!</>

Name: Etana
Text: Because God Ea considers sincerity... sincerity very important...!

Name: Etana
Text: You have to come down carefully, very carefully!

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(How did they know I almost dropped the flowers?
The Naruru tribe truly has keen senses.)</>

Name: Etana
Text:
Hehe, we're almost there, hoo-man!
Just push a little harder!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(She crosses this long bridge on those short legs without even breaking a sweat...)</>

Name: Etana
Text: Is everyone ready? Ready?!

Name: Narurus
Text: Of course, of course!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I have to do this too...?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(This is a place the Naruru Tribe considers sacred.
Let's set down the flowers and show respect with a greeting.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(What looked like an entrance has disappeared without a trace.
...Considering what's inside, is that actually a good thing?)</>

Name: Etana
Text:
Hehe, you received plenty... plenty of God Ea's love!
We can only look at it from out here.

Name: Etana
Text: God Ea must have gladly received our gift and been delighted!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Ah... the Naruru Tribe considers this a tribute offered to God Ea.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(So that's why Kaila said we had to be mindful of the Naruru Tribe.)</>

Name: Etana
Text: Hoo-man, I'm jealous! So jealous!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It probably wouldn't be a good idea to honestly tell them what I saw inside, so I should just make something up.)</>

Name: Etana
Text:
I need more... more of this!
Will you put in a good word with Kai-la? Because it's for God Ea... God Ea!
ItemDesc: It contains a suspicious-looking liquid, though she said it wasn't toxic.

Name: Etana
Text: It didn't work out well last time, but this time it seems effective, which is great!

Name: Etana
Text: Our sincerity must have surely reached God Ea!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What happened? Kaila and Sadi are nowhere to be seen.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Wait... something dropped under the table. Let's go check it out.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It's a letter Kyla left behind.)</>
ItemDesc:
I told Evrin that you went to investigate the Infinite Corridor in our place, you see?
I thought I'd get criticized for passing the buck all of a sudden,
but she actually thanked me for being honest!
Thinking this was my chance, I begged to take on a different mission, and she willingly accepted it.
Thanks to that, I'll be going my own way too!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(What in the...? You should go to Evrin and learn the full story.)</>

Name: Evrin
Text:
I didn't expect you back so soon.
It seems the investigation into the Infinite Corridor wrapped up quickly.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(After reporting that you returned safely,
you ask about the whereabouts of Kaila and Sadi.)</>

Name: Evrin
Text:
You must have missed them.
The two of them headed toward Pulsing Ridge ten minutes ago.

Name: Evrin
Text:
At this point, I suppose luck is also a part of skill?
Because of frequent dispatch duties, they don't usually come to Babylon...

Name: Evrin
Text:
I had them conduct a preliminary investigation for the safety of our adventurers.
Hehe, to think you'd catch Kaila's eye.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(...Wait, was she watching the whole time?
You look at Evrin in surprise.)</>

Name: Evrin
Text: For matters related to the Ancient Empire, it's better for us or the <Orange>“Liberators of Knowledge”</> to handle them.

Name: Evrin
Text: For artifacts or that sort, the Appraisers’ Guild would be suitable, but this isn't that kind of thing.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Although it was your first time there, it would’ve seemed familiar.
It might have reminded you of the Trial Gates.

Name: Evrin
Text:
And the more you looked, the stronger the sense of déjà vu must have become.
“Why is this here?” “What exactly is this place?”

Name: Evrin
Text: Enkia calls the <Blue>Infinite Corridor</> the <Yellow>“Riddle of the Rabbit Hole</>.”

Name: Evrin
Text: It earned that name because you can go in but no one knows when you’ll come out.

Name: Evrin
Text: Moreover, it isn't easily discovered, and the times and places of appearance are rather unusual.

Name: Evrin
Text: <Yellow>Still, they say anyone who steps inside once can continuously come and go whenever the Infinite Corridor opens.</>

Name: Evrin
Text:
I used to think it was just a place where apprentice priests or trainees who hated communal life…
…often ran away to.

Name: Evrin
Text: The Liberators of Knowledge presumed it to be a place where the Ancient Empire conducted <Orange>“some kind of experiment</>.”

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You sent me and the guild members to a place like that?
You are too shocked to say anything.)</>

Name: Evrin
Text: So, we established a few criteria and requested an investigation.

Name: Evrin
Text: You, Kaila, and Sadi all met those specific conditions.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Plus, since their investigation was making slow progress,
it’s only natural that I needed someone new.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Tell her what you discovered in the Infinite Corridor and warn her that it could be dangerous.)</>

Name: Evrin
Text:
...Well, isn't it also fate that you were the one to discover it?
Usually, it just ends with people saying it was a place they'd never seen before.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Anyway, I will keep in mind that it could be dangerous.
I will also relay this news to the Adventurer's Alliance.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Then, please drop by the <Blue>Infinite Corridor</> whenever you have the time.
Because you seem perfectly suited for this kind of work.

Name: Claude
Text:
<Yellow>Gather around, gather around!</>
<Yellow>Aburu's Bounty Festival! Tickets are now on discount!</>

Name: Claude
Text:
My, my, a new customer!
Welcome! You have arrived at the perfect time. We have some grand entertainment waiting for you.

Name: Claude
Text:
I am Claude of <Orange>the Star of the West</> Merchants,
and I am in charge of this festival.

Name: Claude
Text:
Care to accompany me to a place of pure delight? Feast, drink, and make merry! What do you say?
I guarantee you a time you will not regret.

Name: Claude
Text:
You see, the Naruru tribe has a long tradition of honoring the Goddess Ea,
It’s filled with grand feasts and sacred prayers.

Name: Claude
Text:
<Yellow>BUT!</>
Is joy not meant to be shared? The more, the merrier!

Name: Claude
Text:
I was certain that expanding this festival would bring a massive fortune—
ahem, I mean, a wonderful opportunity for everyone.

Name: Claude
Text:
So, I personally presented the business proposal to our Merchant Master,
and that is how this grand new festival came to be, heheh.

Name: Claude
Text:
My dear customer, your timing is absolutely perfect.
If you buy a ticket right now, I will give it to you at half price!

Name: Claude
Text: Well... if you were to do me a small favor, I might even hand it over for free.

Name: Claude
Text:
Haha! Quick on the uptake, aren't we?
Here, take this.
ItemDesc:
A document handed over by Claude.
The faint scent of fresh ink still lingers on the high-quality parchment.
It is just the right size to be posted on a town notice board.

Name: Claude
Text:
It’s a promotional flyer for the festival. Just pin them up on notice boards.
One in front of the Frantia Manor, and another in front of the Stormkel Manor!
ItemName: Come and enjoy Aburu's Bounty Festival!
ItemDesc:
A grand celebration of harmony, brought to you by two peoples.
Aburu's Bounty Festival finally raises its curtains!
The Naruru tribe and the Star of the West Merchants cordially invite you all.

Savor a magnificent array of delicacies at Aburu Village.
This is your exclusive chance to taste the unique, exquisite cuisine crafted by Naruru chefs.

Have you ever wondered what it would be like to live in the Giant’s Garden?
As a special bonus, we have prepared a one-day trial experience for those who have secretly harbored this curiosity!

Furthermore, grand prizes await our most enthusiastic participants.
Visit the bounty festival and test your luck!

- This event runs exclusively during the Naruru autumn harvest season.
- Prizes may run out early depending on the number of participants.
- The organizers is not liable for any personal accidents or injuries occurring between participants.

Name: Claude
Text: I will take care of the other spots, so let us meet back here once you are finished.

Name: Frantia Manor Guard
Text:
Halt. You cannot post a notice without prior authorization.
Let me verify it first.

Name: Frantia Manor Guard
Text:
Oh... I see, it is for Aburu's Bounty Festival.
This has already been approved, so you may go ahead and post it.

Name: Frantia Manor Guard
Text:
By the way... are you with the event organizers?
I have a question.

Name: Frantia Manor Guard
Text:
It has been several years since I was stationed here,
yet this is the first time I have seen something like this.

Name: Frantia Manor Guard
Text: If I go to the festival... will there be a whole crowd of the Naruru?

Name: Frantia Manor Guard
Text: Sigh... Where else would a manor guard be stationed but here?

Name: Frantia Manor Guard
Text:
Aside from Babylon, the furthest I can travel is back to the homeland on occasion...
so I have never actually seen a Naruru myself.

Name: Frantia Manor Guard
Text:
Their graceful silhouettes, and tails with soft and plush fur…
I heard they are truly beautiful, almost like something out of a legend.

Name: Frantia Manor Guard
Text:
This time, I am absolutely taking some time off!
I shall see the Naruru with my own two eyes!

Name: Frantia Manor Guard
Text: Right, keep up the good work!

Name: Trim-Looking Guard
Text: Who gave you permission to post a notice on the manor’s notice board?

Name: Trim-Looking Guard
Text:
You’re in the territory of the great Stormkel—ahem!
Do not do anything that might offend the Archon!

Name: Trim-Looking Guard
Text:
If you do not speak the truth this instant, according to military law,
Article... Paragraph... wait, which one was it again?

Name: Trim-Looking Guard
Text:
Whatever! You shall be severely punished.
I will give you a taste of the Stormkel Manor’s power!

Name: Trim-Looking Guard
Text: Ha! You doubt me at the risk of defying the authority of the manor itself.

Name: Trim-Looking Guard
Text:
In the name of the Archon, I shall pass a summary judgment upon you.
Therefore, this illegal post is hereby confiscated!

The guard violently tears down the promotional flyer
and vanishes in the direction of central Babylon...

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(I can’t get a free ticket from Claude at this rate!)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(He had a rather striking appearance for a mere guard... Something is fishy.
I need to go after him and demand to know why.)</>

Name: Claude
Text:
Ah, I knew my eye for talent never fails.
I had a feeling you would be back in no time.

Name: Claude
Text:
And here I am, too terrified of the guards to even go near there.
You truly possess an extraordinary spirit, heheh.

Name: Nasser
Text:
What is this? I thought you were chasing me down to pick a fight.
Do you two actually know each other?

Name: Nasser
Text:
Apologies for my earlier behavior!
Given the nature of my work, I had to act a bit prickly.

Name: Claude
Text:
Brother Nasser... now that I look at you,
what on earth is that outfit?

Name: Claude
Text:
Don’t tell me... if you’re leaving the Merchants Guild,
it would bring nothing but sorrow to my heart!

Name: Nasser
Text:
It’s called <Yellow>undercover</>.
I had no choice but to blend in to keep an eye on the Stormkel Manor.

Name: Nasser
Text:
You see, the Archon of Stormkel is quite the drunkard, right?
He has been complaining that the festival will laffect his own liquor supply.

Name: Nasser
Text: After all, once the festival begins, all the liquor will flow straight into Aburu Village.

Name: Nasser
Text:
This festival is a joint venture between the Star of the West Merchants and the Naruru tribe.
Do you have any idea how massive our budget is?

Name: Nasser
Text:
So, there is absolutely no way we can let him sabotage this
simply because his own drink might run short!

Name: Nasser
Text:
Which reminds me, [player]
since you have already lent us a hand, how about helping us out until the very end?

Name: Claude
Text:
Oh, that is a splendid suggestion, Brother.
As for your compensation, a <Blue>Vending Machine Ticket</> should suffice, yes?

Name: Claude
Text:
We have set up a very special vending machine for the festival.
Let me tell you, it is packed to the brim with incredible rewards!

Name: Nasser
Text:
You will likely gather a fair share of tickets just by enjoying the festival.
But we are offering even more.

Name: Nasser
Text:
You will be able to try your hand at that vending machine several times more than anyone else.
Come now, no objections, right?

Name: Nasser
Text:
Then could you head over to the entrance to the Aburu Village?
Go meet <Orange>Tirashu</>, the festival envoy from the Naruru side.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
Waaah! Those wicked Kuduru! They are ruining everything for us again!
What do I do... I must think, think of a solution quickly!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
So... you will help me, right? You came here to help, yes?
I will give you tickets, lots of tickets!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
The Kuduru smashed our supply cart filled with fish...
We need them, need them for the festival dishes!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
If we do not make up for what’s lost...
our <Orange>Jabar Merchants</> will get a terrible reputation.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
On top of that, if the festival is ruined...
No one will ever trade with us again…!!!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
Go to Cactus Nest, right in front of it.
Fishing rod or using net, anything is fine! As long as you bring freshly caught fish!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
We are short, so short on supplies!
But we will manage until the next supply cart arrives.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
Bristly-Hair and Angry Tail say they are far too busy defending the festival.
So if they appear out of nowhere, it will be a major, major disaster!

Name: Tirashu
Text: Phew... still, I am so glad you are here to help.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
What did your people call it... an envoy?
Go to <Orange>Claude</> and tell him we got the fish!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
I must hurry to the Naruru chefs!
But... Claude is too hard to talk to.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
I have so much to do, I need to keep it short...
But we are partners now, and I’d feel bad if I cut him off!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Well, Claude certainly has... a unique way of speaking.)</>

Name: Tirashu
Text: So I am counting on you! I must be off now!

Name: Claude
Text:
Ah, my dear customer—you truly radiate brilliance wherever you go.
I caught sight of you carrying a bounty of fresh fish.

Name: Claude
Text:
And look at me! Am I not the envoy and manager of this entire festival?
With promotions done, I am here to inspect the venue!
ItemDesc:
To: Manager Claude.
First of all, the opening ceremony was a success.

At present, no major internal issues have been reported.
However, those troublesome Kuduru have been sighted throughout the vicinity,
causing distress to some visitors.

Since Bristly-Hair appears to have no additional forces left to deploy,
we kindly request to consider hiring additional mercenaries to...

··· ···
··· ··· ··· ···

Please review and advise.

Name: Claude
Text:
Thanks to you, we have bought ourselves some time,
but it will be a real headache if the Kuduru keep this up.

Name: Claude
Text:
Wallets—ah, I mean, visitors from all over will be here.
We cannot just launch a massive hunt against them.

Name: Claude
Text:
So, it would be simply perfect if our beloved <Yellow>CUSTOMER</>
could give those <Red>Kuduru</> a good thrashing whenever they show up.

Name: Claude
Text:
They are not the brightest bunch, so they tend to attack right out in the open.
Much like… right now!

Name: Claude
Text:
Good heavens! It looks like they are heading straight for the village!
My dear customer, please, do something!

Name: Claude
Text:
My, I knew I had absolutely nothing to worry about.
Just keep doing exactly what you did just now.

Name: Claude
Text:
You get to stretch your muscles and gather some loot, too.
Not a bad deal for you, is it?

Name: Claude
Text:
Well, the goods they plundered belong to the festival…
but I will <Yellow>SPECIALLY</> look the other way if you keep a few.

Name: Claude
Text:
Now that the urgent matters have been sorted...
it is high time you went out and enjoyed yourself!

Name: Claude
Text:
Feel free to admire our beautifully decorated village first,
and then take part in the events our merchants have prepared.

Name: Claude
Text:
And whenever you feel like you have run out of things to do—
well, you can always lend us a hand again, just like today.

Name: Claude
Text:
I will make sure you get your rewards, just as I promised at the start.
Until we meet again, shall we? Heheh.

Name: Claude
Text:
Dear customer! You have arrived at the perfect moment.
I have an urgent favor to ask.

Name: Claude
Text:
Today’s supplies need to be transported to Aburu Village,
but the handlers assigned to the brewery have not shown up yet.

Name: Claude
Text:
After I explicitly told them not to be late!
A festival without liquor would be an absolute disaster.

Name: Claude
Text:
I must stay here to wait for the other merchants,
so please head inside the brewery and see what is wrong.

Name: Anxious Merchant
Text:
Wh-who goes there?
Do you have business with us...?

Name: Anxious Merchant
Text: The manager sent you...? Eek!

Name: Anxious Merchant
Text:
Oh, what do we do now! He must have realized something is amiss.
He said he’d cut our pay if we miss the deadline!

Name: Ambitious Merchant
Text:
Think of it as a venture within a venture.
You are a merchant. Why are you so scared?

Name: Ambitious Merchant
Text:
It is true we agreed to transport the Naruru liquor,
but we just need some extra time! That’s all!

Name: Anxious Merchant
Text:
To get the Rappie to pull the carts, you have to play a special musical instrument.
That is the only way they will reliably follow orders...

Name: Anxious Merchant
Text:
However, they let us climb onto the saddle…
but no matter how much we play, they will not budge an inch...!

Name: Anxious Merchant
Text:
Sigh... It's because we're terrible at it.
We should have trained more at the Rappie Training Ground.

Name: Ambitious Merchant
Text:
Look, we're already late, so we might as well make up for the losses, right?
We could set up a 'Rappie-back Ride Experience' or something.

Name: Ambitious Merchant
Text:
It's a quick way to make a profit!
If we're late because we were busy making extra coin, Manager Claude will definitely let it slide!

Name: Ambitious Merchant
Text:
You agree with me, right?
When money's on the line, only the result matters.

Name: Anxious Merchant
Text:
N-no, no, absolutely not!
Just ignore him and please, give us a hand.

Name: Anxious Merchant
Text:
Here, I will hand the instrument over to you...
Just take the lead and guide the Rappies out of the brewery.

Name: Anxious Merchant
Text:
The two of us are just terribly untalented...
An average player would have no problem making Rappies follow them around.

Name: Anxious Merchant
Text: They are over that way! We are counting on you.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Rappies moved past the merchants, heading straight toward the brewery exit.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(So, I am communicating with them through music.
What a fascinating way to bond... Rappies are truly mysterious creatures.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Now, let's guide them completely out of the brewery.
The merchants can take it from there.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(They are following along pretty well.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It seems they have been well-trained.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Good creatures. Maybe I should give them a pat.)</>

Name: Claude
Text: Ah, seeing you bring the Rappies out yourself... mmm.

Name: Claude
Text:
No, no!
Please, my dear customer, no need to explain it to me.

Name: Claude
Text:
You already have far too little time to enjoy the festival as it is.
Sorry that my workers troubled you.

Name: Claude
Text:
You’re lending us a hand right now,
but I’ll make sure to remind them you are our precious customer.

Name: Claude
Text:
Come now, take this and cheer up.
You will not hold a grudge against us, right?

Name: Shtu
Text:
A human guest.
Did you come to see the Rappies?

Name: Shtu
Text:
The festival is held in Aburu Village,
but the ranch and the brewery are also packed with people!

Name: Shtu
Text:
Heheh... exactly as I predicted.
<Yellow>It’s time to rake in the coin!</>

Name: Shtu
Text: Festivals like this don't come often, so make a profit while you can!

Name: Shtu
Text:
No need to look so astonished by my brilliance.
Anyone educated man can think that.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A Naruru fascinated by his own wisdom...)</>

Name: Shtu
Text: Business starts with setting up shop where the crowds are.

Name: Shtu
Text:
This place is full of guests who came to enjoy the festival, such as yourself.
And I’m going to make money off those humans!

Name: Shtu
Text:
The pride of our ranch.
The beautiful, cute Rappies! I will show everyone how charming they are.

Name: Shtu
Text:
Once I change their coat colors
and decorate them with ornaments, they will look irresistible!

Name: Shtu
Text:
Humans love dressing up, don't they?
The flashier it is, the more money they hand over!

Name: Shtu
Text:
I’ve known it for a long time.
I also know you're going to help me.

Name: Shtu
Text: You adventurers will run any errand as long as the pay's right.

Name: Shtu
Text:
To my highly educated nose—
you smell exactly like the rest of them!

Name: Shtu
Text:
First, look for the small pouches just outside the ranch.
Clear them all away.

Name: Shtu
Text:
It's a medicine of my own creation.
I picked the ingredients carefully, so it only has things the Rappies love.
ItemDesc:
A delicious snack prepared by Shutu.
Mixing this with hay and feeding it to the Rappie is said to fill them with boundless energy.

Name: Shtu
Text:
Then just mix this into the hay and leave it there.
I'll explain the rest when you get back!

Name: Shtu
Text:
No one stood in your way, right?
Cowards, absolute cowards! They ran away in terror.

Name: Shtu
Text:
There were some wicked humans trying to steal the Rappies.
They pretended to be guests and left behind those pouches with treats.

Name: Shtu
Text:
They are way too sweet!
Those poor Rappies ate them and fell fast asleep.

Name: Shtu
Text:
And the moment the Narurus stepped away,
those thieves tried to take the sleeping Rappies!

Name: Shtu
Text:
Of course, not a single Rappie has been stolen yet.
The ranch Narurus gave them a good lesson!

Name: Shtu
Text:
But we can't just<Yellow>keep watching the guests all day,</>
wondering if there are still bad humans around.

Name: Shtu
Text:
That's why I crafted a medicine that wakes them up instantly.
Because I'm one clever Naruru.

Name: Shtu
Text:
I asked you to check just in case they snuck back in.
And indeed they hadn't left yet... exactly as I predicted!

Name: Shtu
Text:
Once Bristly-Hairs arrive in a little bit, I'll have them deal with them.
They're getting in the way of my profits.

Name: Shtu
Text:
Now, head over to the opposite side of the ranch
and clear out those webbed-foot creatures.

Name: Shtu
Text:
The Rappies get so scared every time they go outside.
When they're frightened, they won't look their best.

Name: Shtu
Text:
We can't have the guests seeing them like that.
Rappies look the best when they're happy, happy!

Name: Shtu
Text:
My, adventurers are truly great at running errands.
Now, it's finally time to go dress up the Rappies!

Name: Shtu
Text:
I've already brought the ornaments over.
Open up the chest and pick a few out.

Name: Shtu
Text: I’m going to gather some berries, so you go on ahead!

Name: Shtu
Text:
I crushed the berries and collected the juice.
If you apply it to the Rappies' fur, their coats turn into a vibrant color.

Name: Shtu
Text: And then, we drape the wide cloth you chose... fasten the saddle... and add a few more trinkets…

The Rappies let out a faint, slightly annoyed bleat.
Soon, under Shutu's deft fingertips, they are reborn with a splendid new look...

Name: Shtu
Text:
Hmph... this is magnificent.
Quite natural, of course, done with my own hands!

Name: Shtu
Text:
Now, the guests will pour in just to see the Rappies.
Everything is according to my plan! Huhuhu!

Name: Shtu
Text:
Here, take this, adventuring human.
The Naruru always, always keep their promises.

Name: Shtu
Text:
Enjoy the festival, and come back if you run out of things to do.
<Yellow>We have so much work to do here at the ranch.</>

Name: Tirashu
Text:
The bounty festival, how is the festival?
You are having fun, right?

Name: Nasser
Text:
Well, it is a joint venture between <Orange>the Star of the West Merchants</> and the <Orange>Jabar Merchants</>.
It is only natural that it is a success.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Claude has certainly come a long way.
To think he would pitch a proposal like this to Master Aman.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Thanks to him, my only role here is to look around the place.
Ah—maybe I should scout out some new business partners...

Name: Tirashu
Text:
Claude? Busy, so very busy!
But don't humans help each other out?

Name: Nasser
Text:
A manager is meant to be busy.
He has to handle things on his own to prove his worth.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
Hmm... but I really need to tell him something.
We keep missing each other, and it’s so frustrating!

Name: Nasser
Text: Why? Do you need him for something?

Name: Tirashu
Text: Too many customers! We're completely out of <Yellow>air bubbles</>.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
You sew thin leather into a ball,
and then you puff-puff it up, until it's full of air!

Name: Nasser
Text:
Out of stock already?
We bought up every piece of leather around to make those.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Processing raw hides from scratch would take way too long.
If we need even a small amount... we’ll have to head to <Orange>Hesperia</>.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
But isn't that too, too far away?
We won't have a single air bubble left by tomorrow...

Name: Nasser
Text:
Let's head north for now.
I heard the locals there cross the mountains to barter.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Then we'd better get something to trade, right?
Raiding the <Red>Shadow Wolves</> will do nicely.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Word is, plenty of them are quitting and running away lately.
Catch one and "persuade" them nicely.

Name: Nasser
Text:
We can keep watch for them and get all sorts of things in return!
They’re only human anyway. So, they wear clothes and shoes.

Name: Nasser
Text:
They’re starved for basic supplies out in Hesperia,
so they probably won’t refuse.

Name: Tirashu
Text: Mmmh! Yeah, you’re right! Right!

Name: Nasser
Text:
I'll go look for other suppliers.
Let's meet back here when you're done.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(There really is a lone bandit here.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The way he keeps looking around... is he on the run?
Let's go corner him.)</>

Name: Shadow Wolf Junior
Text:
W-who's that?!
This is the Wolves' territory, so b-begone...!

Name: Shadow Wolf Junior
Text: Think you can just wander into our territory?! I-I'll teach you a lesson!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Such a sloppy bandit... Not threatening at all.)</>

Name: Shadow Wolf Junior
Text:
Darn it, I was making a clean getaway...
Out of my way! I need to get out of here right now.

Name: Shadow Wolf Junior
Text:
Gasp! W-what am I even saying—
This is all your fault!

Name: Shadow Wolf Junior
Text: What? How did you…? Are you seriously going to help me?

Name: Shadow Wolf Junior
Text:
...Fine, I'll trust you just this once.
I've wanted to quit this stupid bandit life for ages anyway.

Name: Shadow Wolf Junior
Text:
I only joined because they promised to feed me!
I've never even hurt anyone.

Name: Shadow Wolf Junior
Text:
All I did was stand here, play lookout, and idle about.
Or just pretend to look tough, and that was only for a few days!

Name: Shadow Wolf Junior
Text:
You'd better not back out.
You're no match for me, greenhorn.

Name: Shadow Wolf Junior
Text:
What? I knew it!
You're trying to strip me of the only thing I have left?!

Name: Shadow Wolf Junior
Text: <Red>Emergency! Emergency! We've got an intruder here!</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(So much for negotiations... Better move before I get surrounded.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Got everything to trade. Time to head north now.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Wait... what's this?)</>
ItemDesc:
- Individual action is strictly prohibited until reinforcements arrive.
··· ···
··· ···

- Anyone capable of manufacturing cactus–based medicine must report to command.
- Or anyone who recruits someone with equivalent skills will be heavily rewarded.

··· ···

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Huh, so people use cacti for medicine.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Nasser said Hesperia is short on basic supplies... Let's bring some too.)</>

Name: Hesperia Merchant
Text: Ooh... An outsider?

Name: Hesperia Merchant
Text:
I’m from Hesperia, a settler village.
I buy and sell all sorts of useful goods.

Name: Hesperia Merchant
Text:
My top recommendation is Hesperian leather!
Everyone in our village is a master-level artisan.

Name: Hesperia Merchant
Text: I accept gold, or we can barter with equivalent goods.

Name: Hesperia Merchant
Text:
Oh! These are exactly what we've been short on.
What are you looking for? Want to see the rest of my stock?

Name: Hesperia Merchant
Text:
Just the right amount for both of us.
For this much, you can take all the leather.

Name: Hesperia Merchant
Text:
We were actually completely out of ointment for wounds.
Everyone in the village was worried sick.

Name: Hesperia Merchant
Text:
A pleasure doing business with you.
Safe travels back.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
Back at last! Really back!
Now we can make the air bubbles!

Name: Nasser
Text:
Wow, you're pretty good at this!
Makes me want to trust you with bigger jobs.

Name: Nasser
Text: I like what you brought back, too.

Name: Nasser
Text:
We should look into a regular supply line.
It’s a small village, but the quality is top-notch.

Name: Tirashu
Text: Souvenirs! We need to make the souvenirs right now!

Name: Nasser
Text:
Haha, all right. Friends help each other out, right?
Just make sure you put in a good word with Claude for me.

Name: Tirashu
Text: Yeah, yeah! We're all friends! What are friends for?!

Name: Tiglath
Text: So we do that... and if it doesn't work out, we try this and that... huh?

Name: Tiglath
Text:
Ahem! A human visiting our village, I see.
Did you see? Did you see all our decorations?

Name: Tiglath
Text:
That, that right there is from me helping Tirashu.
Pretty impressive even to a human, isn’t it?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You talk to him, and he tries to sound like an elderly person. How cute.)</>

Name: Tiglath
Text:
I'm still a little Naruru, but...
<Yellow>I know a lot, and there’s lots I want to do!</>

Name: Tiglath
Text: That's why I decided to be the next Tribute Keeper.

Name: Tiglath
Text:
The adult Narurus gave me their full, full permission.
So I'm going to study this festival very closely.

Name: Tiglath
Text:
Hmm... quite a thoughtful human, aren't you?
Let us discuss important matters together.

Name: Tiglath
Text: A Tribute Keeper's duty is, of course, to craft and tend to the tribute.

Name: Tiglath
Text:
<Yellow>I want to make a big tribute to symbolize this Bounty Festival...</>
<Yellow>But I'm stuck on what materials to use!</>

Name: Tiglath
Text:
Straw, wood, and stone.
The old Tribute Keepers used those three things.

Name: Tiglath
Text: I'm thinking of an offering that’s both sturdy and beautiful...

Name: Tiglath
Text: I've got it! Bring them to me one by one, and I'll craft it.

Name: Tiglath
Text: Wait, wait just a moment.

The Naruru kneaded the pile of straw with its tiny hands.
Mixing water made a decent-looking paste,
but it remained too mushy to form a sturdy shape...

Name: Tiglath
Text: I like the color, but it takes too long to harden...

Name: Tiglath
Text:
The tribute must be hidden below Ea's navel.
But a tribute like this will wash away right away!

Name: Tiglath
Text:
Can you get the next, next material?
I'd rather try stone now.

Name: Tiglath
Text:
It takes time to carve it.
Wait just like before!

Tiglath crushed the pebbles into powder and mixed up a paste.
The rainbow mixture then was left to harden…
But it was so hard to carve. It took a long time to shape it into a Naruru.

Name: Tiglath
Text:
A little Naruru's hands lack strength, strength!
Gripping and carving it isn't easy.

Name: Tiglath
Text: That rainbow paste was great. What a waste.

Name: Tiglath
Text:
Only wood, wood left at last.
It is the material Ishimu, the current Tribute Keeper, likes.

Name: Tiglath
Text:
Won't it just look rugged and dull?
Hmm... but we still have to try.

Name: Tiglath
Text:
There's a Naruru cart at the edge of the slope.
Go fetch twood from there!

Unlike before, Tiglath sets to work with a deft touch.
It’s clear he crafted offerings from wood many times before.
Is there a reason why the current Tribute Keeper favors this material?

Name: Tiglath
Text:
...Wood is definitely faster.
It's not too hard, even for my hands.

Name: Tiglath
Text: Straw is light but not sturdy, and pebbles are beautiful but way too hard.

Name: Tiglath
Text: But... one day, I am going to be the Tribute Keeper, Tribute Keeper!

Name: Tiglath
Text:
I need to be a smarter, more useful adult Naruru than now. 
Do you hear me?

Name: Tiglath
Text:
I'll figure out how to make tributes with the other two materials, too.
In fact, it’s time for me to go study, study them.

Name: Tiglath
Text:
Oh, right! I must give you your reward!
Narurus always keep our deals fair and square.

Name: Tiglath
Text:
Take this and go have more fun at the festival.
I'll be going, going now!

Name: Nasser
Text:
Oh, hey, we keep running into each other, don't we? I know, right?
Fellow merchants should always keep their bonds tight.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Honestly, I’d love nothing more than to clink mugs… of Naruru-brewed Baba liquor…
and chat and laugh with you!

Name: Nasser
Text:
But, ugh... a bit of a situation has come up.
Remember when I said I came to the Bounty Festival to find new clients?

Name: Nasser
Text:
Exactly! I’m technically here at this ranch on official business.
But all of my business items are gone.

Name: Nasser
Text:
With this festival bringing way too many crowds around this village,
guess the <Red>Kuduru</> are causing trouble again,

Name: Nasser
Text:
roaming around making these creepy noises!
Those poor Rappies got so spooked, they bolted right out of the ranch...

Name: Nasser
Text:
I feel a bit guilty talking business at a time like this.
After all, I am a proud Star of the West merchant.

Name: Nasser
Text:
So, let's lend a hand and score some favor.
Head out northwest of the ranch. I’ll cover the opposite side!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The rescued Rappies dashed straight back toward the ranch.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The rescued Rappies dashed straight back toward the ranch.)</>

Name: Nasser
Text:
Mmh, good!
Thanks to you, things are calming down fast.

Name: Nasser
Text:
The ranchers say about three of them are still missing.
They must have wandered too deep. No one can figure out where they are.

Name: Nasser
Text:
They need to call in the <Orange>Bristly-Hairs</> for a proper search…
But it looks like they've all been deployed for festival security.

Name: Nasser
Text:
This is the perfect chance to prove I'm reliable...
I could really use a decent mercenary right about now. Hehe.

Name: Nasser
Text:
If only a capable adventurer would just drop out of the sky…
You'd think so too, right [player]?

Name: Nasser
Text:
Hey, I knew we were on the same page!
All right then—watch your back out there!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The rescued Rappies dashed straight back toward the ranch.)</>

Name: Nasser
Text: That’s it! This bunch you brought back was the last of them.

Name: Nasser
Text:
You handled those <Red>Kudurus</>, right?
Thanks to you, the Narurus at the ranch absolutely love me now.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Don't you think we make a pretty good team?
It's a win-win for both of us!

Name: Nasser
Text:
What’s with that look?
I belong to the Merchants Guild! I’m not going to rip you off.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Come on, when did I ever treat you like an errand runner?
<Yellow>It was a fair deal between us, pure and simple.</>

Name: Nasser
Text:
The festival is wrapping up tomorrow anyway, so cheer up.
Next time, let’s meet with a smile, all right [player]?

Name: Tirashu
Text: Yeah, yeah! Next time, I'll bring you something interesting from the humans!

Name: Tiglath
Text:
But we can't let Mama Naruru find out.
I... I don't want to get in trouble!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
Don't worry, I'll hand it over in secret.
I’ve never been caught before!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
Seeing you like this...
Tiglath, you really are just a little Naruru after all!

Name: Tiglath
Text: Wait a second! I smell a human...

Name: Tirashu
Text: Huh? Someone's here?

Name: Tiglath
Text:
I-it’s you, human!
Looks like you came to see the end of the festival.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
It's good, good timing that we ran into you!
Right now, we’re… ...talking about something very important!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
The festival is almost over, right?
I want to make something so we can remember it.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
I'm good at trading, but I'm clueless about stuff like this...
What do you think we should do?

Name: Tirashu
Text: Oh, right! There's Claude! Claude would know.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
Could you go see him for me?
I’m waiting for our merchant guild friends here.

Name: Tiglath
Text:
Bring back a decent idea!
Tirashu is busy, very busy!

Name: Tirashu
Text: Please, you kind-hearted human!

Name: Claude
Text: Hmm... the Naruru envoy said that?

Name: Claude
Text:
I don't think we need any more decorations...
But I suppose a grand finale is important.

Name: Claude
Text: Hoooowever... I am terribly sorry, but I simply have no time!

Name: Claude
Text:
A major festival is always most chaotic at its start and finish.
I'm so overwhelmed, I can't think straight!

Name: Claude
Text:
I stayed up all night doing the final checks until dawn.
Just look at the bags under my eyes... Sob!

Name: Claude
Text:
<Yellow>Instead of asking me—who is fulfilling my duties as the person in charge—</>
<Yellow>you'd be better off consulting NASSER...</>

Name: Claude
Text: I'm definitely not saying he's lounging around like he's the only one on vacation. Not at all!

Name: Claude
Text:
He's got vast experience and broad knowledge,
so I'm sure he'll give you dazzling insight! Hahaha!

Name: Claude
Text:
Oh dear! Is that a drunkard picking a fight over there?
Then I must apologize, my valuuued customeeer!

Name: Nasser
Text:
Haha, that kid...
When did I ever lounge around? What a cute little prankster.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Ahem, well, I get the gist of it.
They want to leave something that catches the eye—very typical of the Naruru.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Look, there are statues all over the village,
and they even craft special offerings for their prayer rituals.

Name: Nasser
Text:
They clearly care a lot about visual elements.
So, we just need to make something that really stands out, right?

Name: Nasser
Text:
That's it! We'll build a colossal statue.
There just happens to be some empty space at the village entrance.

Name: Nasser
Text:
If you head west of Ea's Navel,
you'll see a shallow hill.

Name: Nasser
Text: There are many thick-trunked trees there. Let’s cut some down.

Name: Nasser
Text:
I'll send the guild workers over,
so go ahead and just mark the right trees first.

Name: Nasser
Text:
I'll join you right after I send word.
Don't worry. I'm not leaving you to do this alone.

Name: Nasser
Text: <Yellow>Looking for me? I’m already here!</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(He actually didn’t pass everything off this time.
Is he just saving face because it’s the grand finale...?)</>

Name: Nasser
Text:
Mmh, solid work today as well.
I’m almost tempted to lock you down as our Merchants Guild's exclusive mercenary.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Anyway, that's beside the point.
Leave this to me and go secure the next materials!

Name: Nasser
Text:
We can’t just stop at carving.
We need to dye it to give it that extra flair.

Name: Nasser
Text:
You know that vibrant forest north of the Giant's Garden, right?
Go scoop up an armful of flower petals.

Name: Nasser
Text:
While you're away,
I'll smooth things over with the festival envoys.

Name: Nasser
Text:
Oh, and I'll have the timber carted over there.
Let's meet up in Aburu Village once the work is done!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
I heard everything!
It’s a wonderful idea!

Name: Tiglath
Text:
A-ahem... I, I am going to help build that statue as well! 
You’re not going to refuse, right?

Name: Tirashu
Text:
I’m so excited! Excited!
A statue taller than a human! I can't wait to see it!

Name: Tiglath
Text: Just pay close attention and follow my lead. Ready your heart, are you prepared?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Speaking like an elder doesn't make him a full-grown Naruru...
But since the little guy is trying so hard to act tough, I'll let it slide.)</>

Name: Tiglath
Text:
Stop hesitating and march along. 
We must finish this before the festival draws to a close!

Tiglath showcased delicate skills, fully proving worthy of being the next Tribute Keeper.
Carving every corner meticulously and applying the vibrant dyes,
a magnificent statue finally stood complete!

Name: Tirashu
Text:
Wow, woooow!
It’s as big as Elder Brawny-Beard’s house!

Name: Tiglath
Text:
Ahem... I like it.
Anyone can see this is the image of a proud, adult Naruru!

Name: Claude
Text:
As expected of our valued client.
You poured your very soul into every brushstroke!

Name: Nasser
Text: It looks like the Narurus did all the actual wood carving...

Name: Nasser
Text:
Still, ending things like this with the whole crew is kind of fun.
All that hard work just washes away.

Name: Claude
Text:
Brother, I did all the grunt work!
You promised to help as my senior... <Red>I am so disappointed</>!

Name: Nasser
Text:
Hey, I told you I'd put in a good word with the higher-ups.
Why is everyone always nagging me?

Name: Nasser
Text:
Let’s all go have dinner tonight.
We can’t let the festival end without trying the Naruru’s special brew.

Name: Tirashu
Text:
<Yellow>Drinks! Baba Liquor! The pride of the Naruru!</>
I saved some in secret, just for us!

A lively gathering unfolded before the statue,
filled with warm words of compliments for one another—
after working so hard behind the scenes to fix everything.

Young Tiglath was completely out of energy after a long day of playing the stern leader.
With the little Naruru sent home first, the festivities slowly drew to a close,
and it was time to say goodbye and return to reality.

Name: Evrin
Text: I feel like I've been seeing you a lot lately. It's not just my imagination, right?

Name: Evrin
Text:
First of all, greetings.
<Orange>Asli</>, this is the adventurer I mentioned earlier.

Name: Asli
Text:
Nice to meet you, [player].
I am Asli. The Tower is basically my whole life.

Name: Asli
Text:
I avoided guilds and clans because I don’t like the idea of belonging somewhere,
but this person dragged me in...

Name: Evrin
Text:
But you don't regret it, right?
Because you know these things are best handled through me.

Name: Asli
Text:
Well, ultimately, yes.
But [player], I'm not sure if you're the right fit.

Name: Evrin
Text:
...Hmm, let me give you a piece of advice.
