Don't judge hastily until you've experienced it yourself.

Name: Evrin
Text:
This adventurer before you will surely...
help you find the answers you're looking for.

Name: Asli
Text: Hmm... if you're willing to say that much, I suppose I should at least pretend to believe you.

Name: Asli
Text:
It's an anomaly report.
Read it, and let me know immediately if you think you can't handle it.
ItemName: Ecological Report on the Giant's Tower
ItemDesc:
A booklet recording the anomalous phenomena of the Tower.
Most of the records are practically erased and cannot be read.
The contents that can still be made out are as follows.

...Aether waves have begun to fluctuate irregularly, centered around the Tower's underground repository, and the aftermath of these waves can also be detected above ground...  

The rest is smudged and is unintelligible.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The Paradise Advent Society said everything would be placed beneath the Tower.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(If the anomalies occurring in the Tower are also related to the Paradise Advent Society...)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(…you might discover a new clue through this task.)</>

After pausing for a moment to show that you’re cautious,
you say you would help Asli.

Name: Asli
Text: Oh... It's been a while since I've seen a human charge in fearlessly after seeing this.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Let's just call that courage.
The situation seems urgent, so explain the details once you get there.

Name: Asli
Text: ...That would be best. Come to the Great Echo Encampment, [player].

Name: Asli
Text: Oh, I didn't think you would actually show up?

Name: Asli
Text:
Usually, people are too blinded by what they can get from the Tower to care about this sort of thing.
You definitely have some peculiar traits, don't you?

Name: Asli
Text:
First, let's test your skills.
Head to Drums of War Hill and deal with the <Red>Kiguru Tribe</>.

Name: Asli
Text:
It's a procedure to verify if you are suitable as an assistant.
If you can't do it, return to Babylon right now.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(A tough one to build trust with.
I’d better prove myself through action.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The Kiguru Tribe are over there... Could it be because of the Aetherium Candy again?
Let's check from up close.)</>

Name: Asli
Text:
Your determination is impressive.
I apologize for underestimating you, [player].

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You say that you understand and show her what you found while defeating the Kiguru Tribe.)</>

Name: Asli
Text:
Hah, to think this would be here.
...It seems they've dug much deeper than I thought.

Name: Asli
Text: If you've found this, then there’s no reason to hold back, [player].

Name: Asli
Text: The source of power that moves the world is <Blue>Aether</>.

Name: Asli
Text:
Therefore, all living beings possess Aether, whether it's a lot or a little.
Regardless of the amount.

Name: Asli
Text: The same goes for the Tower.

Name: Asli
Text:
<Yellow>On the outside, it looks like a massive structure,
but in terms of possessing Aether, it is no different from a living organism.</>

Name: Asli
Text: That's why it is paramount that the Aether circulates stably.

Name: Asli
Text:
However, irregular waves have recently been observed emanating from the underground.
What you just found is proof of that.

Name: Asli
Text:
<Blue>Aether Collector.</>
...I heard the ancients called it the <Blue>“Eye of the Bedrock</>.”
ItemDesc: An ancient artifact capable of collecting Aether.

Name: Asli
Text:
According to records, it was used to regulate when the Tower's Aether was overflowing,
or when it was lacking.

Name: Asli
Text:
Thus, it's an artifact that rarely makes its way outside the Tower.
Unless there is deliberate intent behind it.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(This is definitely strange.
How can an artifact as rare as that just be rolling around?)</>

Name: Asli
Text:
I should check if there are more nearby.
It doesn't belong here, so let's recover them all.

Asli took out something resembling a compass and floated it in the air.
Then, a thin beam of light shot into the sky and stopped over the Hallowed Obsidian Mountain.

Name: Asli
Text:
It seems our destination has been decided.
Then, follow me carefully.

Name: Asli
Text:
The Aether Collector should be around here.
Broken or intact, bring them as you see them.

Name: Asli
Text:
Oh, and take this as well.
It will help you find the Aether Collector.

Name: Asli
Text:
…the <Blue>Wave Tracker.</>
It is excellent at pinpointing locations where Aether is concentrated.
ItemDesc: An ancient artifact capable of measuring Aether waves.

Name: Asli
Text: It's already activated, so you don't need to do anything else.

Name: Asli
Text: Just carry it with you, and it will automatically signal in response to Aether.

Name: Asli
Text: Let's split up and search.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(You hear a faint whistling sound.
Could this be the signal? Let's move a bit further ahead.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The whistling sound has gotten louder.
Is the Aether Collector over there?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Screams of the Kiguru Tribe and a human voice...?
I should get closer and see what's going on.)</>

Name: Suspicious Mage
Text:
After feeding them Aetherium Candy and bulking them up,
this is all they have?

Name: Kiguru Tribe
Text: Ugh... Uuugh, khhk...

Name: Suspicious Mage
Text:
I was looking forward to it since they said Aether was flowing out of the Tower...
Was it just another false rumor?

Name: Suspicious Mage
Text:
Sigh, they said it was an ancient artifact rolling around in the Tower's underground, but it's completely pathetic.
They could have at least given me a bigger one.

Name: Suspicious Mage
Text:
...Right, it'd be better if I just went there myself.
There's no need to waste any more time here.

The suspicious mage disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Suddenly, a deafening roar burst from the Wave Tracker.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...The Wave Tracker won’t stop making noise.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Just as you hesitate, not knowing what to do, 
you hear footsteps running from the opposite side. Is it Asli?)</>

Name: Asli
Text: *sigh* What in the world is going on?

Name: Asli
Text: ...This has become a troublesome situation.

Name: Asli
Text:
[player], do you remember what I said?
<Yellow>"All living beings possess Aether."</>

Name: Asli
Text: That person used magic to teleport to the Tower's underground.

Name: Asli
Text: For the device to react that strongly means...

Name: Asli
Text: …an unimaginably massive amount of Aether leaked out from him.

Name: Asli
Text: With this level of power, he must have affected the Tower in some way.

Name: Asli
Text: ...Because, just as he said, Aether continues to flow out of the Tower.

Name: Asli
Text:
That is why the Collector shouldn't be found in a place like this.
It's an important artifact that maintains the Tower's ecosystem...

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(So this was the urgent situation.
It seems more serious than I thought.)</>

Name: Asli
Text:
First, let's gather traces of that guy.
With this much... it might actually be of help to the Tower.

Name: Asli
Text: Do you see that, [player]?

Name: Asli
Text:
Hah, what a relief.
I'll give you an Aether Collector, so fill it up.
ItemDesc: An ancient artifact capable of collecting Aether.

Name: Asli
Text: As soon as you collect it all, we'll head to the Tower.

Name: Asli
Text: You're definitely far from a <Yellow>“typical adventurer</>.”

Name: Asli
Text: You’ll come to realize it yourself when the time comes.

Name: Asli
Text:
Let's head to the Tower for now.
There's something we need to find on the 1st floor.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(We made it to the Giant's Tower using the Phase Converter.
But I don't think I've ever come this far before... )</>

Name: Asli
Text:
Do you see the stone statue inside? There should be a Holy Stone beneath it.
Bring that to me.

Name: Asli
Text:
It is dangerous to blindly proceed into unstable waves like this.
So don't ask any more questions and just bring the Holy Stone.

Name: Asli
Text:
You look like you find it unfair.
But I haven't been resting either, so please don’t give me that look.

Name: Asli
Text: Besides, I did some something very “important” while waiting for you.

Name: Asli
Text: It's almost complete now, so hand over the Holy Stone.

Asli absorbed the Holy Stone she was given into the artifact.
To think she could handle an ancient artifact to this extent...
Your doubts about her true identity begin to grow.

Name: Asli
Text:
Take this.
With this, you shouldn't have any problem reaching the Tower's underground.
ItemDesc: The Phase Converter modified by Asli. It operates using the Holy Stone as a medium.

Name: Asli
Text: It is a Phase Converter I modified myself.

Name: Asli
Text: Let's use this and go underground together.

Asli explains that this should be used in a safe place free of monsters,
then suggests to meet at the Great Echo Encampment.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Ugh, to think I would see another new illusion... )</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Could this be... the Tower's underground?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Where in the world did Asli go?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(The mage I saw at the Black Sacred Mountain might be nearby.
I need to quickly regroup with Asli.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(These voices… Are they Symon and Mitchell?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The two of them are already dead, and I saw it with my own eyes.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(It might be a trap, but I can't just pass by like this.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(...Let's go for now. I can regret it later if necessary.)</>

Name: Familiar Voice
Text:
Oh? Are you an adventurer too?
Wow, good thing you made it this far.

Name: Familiar Voice
Text:
The <Blue>Legion</> was just in need of people.
Why don't you join our clan first?

Name: Nostalgic Voice
Text: It clearly looks like it’s their first time here. We shouldn’t…

Name: Familiar Voice
Text:
I mean, if we just leave them here, they might die even faster, don’t you think?
Haven’t you learned anything?

Name: Nostalgic Voice
Text: It's not like that…! I meant we should send them outside instead.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Their faces and voices are the same, but their tone and personalities are completely different.
H-how could this happen...?)</>

Name: Nostalgic Voice
Text:
Excuse me... you're an adventurer I haven't seen before.
It's dangerous... dangerous here, so please go back!

Name: Familiar Voice
Text: Hah, if only that darn Aether hadn't moved on its own...

Name: Familiar Voice
Text:
Why out of all places did the arrival point have to be here?!
Even without that, the timeline here flows in a mess.

Name: Nostalgic Voice
Text:
I-I'm sorry.
<Orange>Michael</> has a bit of a foul mouth.

Name: Symon
Text: I am <Orange>Symon</>.

Name: Symon
Text: I ended up coming here with Michael because the tower was running low on Aether.

Name: Michael
Text: You know that monsters reproduce faster than people, right?

Name: Michael
Text:
It makes sense to replenish our lacking Aether with them.
It's not like they're useful for anything else.

Name: Symon
Text: ...S-since there are no living creatures outside the Tower, I suppose it's to be expected.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Look at the two of them in disbelief.)</>

Name: Symon
Text: A-Adventurer, you definitely aren't from our <Yellow>'world'</>, are you?

Name: Michael
Text:
Hey, Simon. I know you have a lot of questions, but...
now really isn't the best time.

Name: Michael
Text:
Let's deal with the monsters first.
We only live once, after all.
I joined forces with the two to defeat the monsters.

Name: Michael
Text: Not bad at all. Good work, Adventurer.

Name: Symon
Text: Um... if you wouldn't mind, could you tell us your name?

Name: Symon
Text:
[player]...
It's actually been a while since I've been this curious about an Adventurer's name.

Name: Symon
Text: I don't usually ask about such things, but I wouldn’t mind making an exception for you.

Name: Michael
Text: It was only for a short while, but it was a pleasure fighting with you.

Name: Michael
Text:
Well then, farewell, [player].
We'll put your life to good use... for the Tower.

I lost consciousness from Michael's sudden strike.
When I opened my eyes, I was outside the Tower.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is this... Babylon?)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I remember being attacked underground in the Tower... 
and meeting those people who looked like Simon and Mitchell.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(But I couldn't find Asli.
I need to tell Evrin first)</>

Name: Evrin
Text: I feel like I've been seeing you a lot lately. It's not just my imagination, right?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(I'm getting a sense of déjà vu.
I think I heard this before greeting Asli...)</>

Name: Evrin
Text:
An anomaly has been discovered in the Tower's underground.
Abnormal Aether fluctuations have been detected.

Name: Evrin
Text: <Orange>The Divine, the Alliance, the Liberators of Knowledge, the Spring Crow Society...</>

Name: Evrin
Text: For now, we've sent out words everywhere we can.

Name: Evrin
Text:
And since the underground can be dangerous,
It'd be best for Clans to stick together when heading down there.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Ask if "abnormal fluctuations" means Aether is leaking outside the Tower.)</>

Name: Evrin
Text: How did you know...?

I explained to Evrin what happened with Asli and my experience in the Tower's underground.
She asked for a moment to think, then carefully broke the long silence.

Name: Evrin
Text:
One needs to be cautious when discussing what happens in the underground, but...
I think I can tell you about Asli.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Enkia is famous for its many legends.
And among them, 'Asli' is...

Name: Evrin
Text: <Yellow>said to be a Prophet who appears when a cataclismic event is about to unfold in this land.</>

Name: Evrin
Text: It's not easy to meet Asli, and even if you do...

Name: Evrin
Text: It's common knowledge that you won't remember it in most cases, just like in my case.

Name: Evrin
Text:
If it was Asli, there must be...
a reason why your memory remained intact, Adventurer.

Name: Evrin
Text: It might be dangerous, but... I must ask you to visit the Tower’s underground section frequently.

Name: Ragnar
Text: I know you’re busy, but I’d appreciate it if you could spare me a moment.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Haha, no need to be tense.
It’s not a difficult favor....

Name: Ragnar
Text: Have you ever heard of the <Blue>Halo Festival</>?

Name: Ragnar
Text:
Mmh, makes sense.
Most people have no reason to visit the Starfall Plateau.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Unless you're from Stormkel, there’s no reason to venture into such harsh lands.

Name: Ragnar
Text: But I figured it might pique your interest.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You look puzzled, wondering why Ragnar is giving such an unusually long introduction.)</>

Name: Ragnar
Text: Mmh, I knew this wasn't my style...

Name: Ragnar
Text: [player], please participate in the Halo Festival.

Name: Ragnar
Text:
I won't take no for an answer.
Think of the people who worry about you.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(A few familiar faces come to mind.
He probably wants me to take a break and clear my head for a bit.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You tell Ragnar that you will participate in the Halo Festival.)</>

Name: Ragnar
Text: Good. Take this and head to the Verzard Outpost.
ItemDesc: An application form to participate in the Halo Festival held at the Verzard Outpost.

Name: Ragnar
Text: Deliver this to the reception desk, and they will tell you how to join the festival.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It’s surprisingly lively here for an outpost.
There isn’t a shred of tension in the air.)</>

Name: Jovial Naruru
Text:
<Yellow>Halo, Halo Festival application form accepted!
Come on, hand them over quickly!</>

Name: Lively Clerk
Text:
Oh, Jiniru!
The more you rush, the slower you should go!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Is that the reception desk? Let's register the warp anchor first.)</>

Name: Mni
Text:
Welcome to the Halo Festival, adventurer!
I’m <Orange>Mni</>, your event guide, and this is—

Name: Jiniru
Text:
<Orange>Jiniru</>!
I chopped up my precious time to be here, so give me your application already!

Name: Mni
Text:
<Yellow>Don't say “give it already.”</> 
Say “please hand it over.” Got it?

Name: Mni
Text: I know you're dying to hit the hot springs, but we're still on the clock.

Name: Jiniru
Text:
Look at the line behind them, Mni!
At this rate, my fluffy fur is going to dry up completely!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You cautiously hold out the application between them.)</>

Name: Mni
Text: Hehe, let me take a quick look!

Name: Jiniru
Text:
<Red>No! N-no!</>
There’s no re, recommendation letter!

Name: Jiniru
Text:
To join the festival, you need a strong body and a strong mind.
I don’t like this. I DON’T!

Name: Mni
Text:
You see, you can't join the Halo Festival with just an application form.
This should help clear things up fast.

Name: Mni
Text:
Lots of first-timers are coming this year, so we made this in a hurry.
It's Jiniru’s handiwork, by the way.
ItemDesc:
The first step to becoming the ultimate warrior! Be sure to read this before joining!
1. Prepare three letters of recommendation.
2. Submit your application along with the recommendation letters at the reception desk.

Name: Mni
Text: You can get recommendations from the folks around the outpost.

Name: Mni
Text: We’re so short-handed, so even a little help will mean a lot to us.

Name: Mni
Text: Come back to the reception once you’ve gathered all three recommendations!

Name: Jiniru
Text:
This is where I, I step in!
Hoo-man! Let me tell you exactly where to go!

Name: Jiniru
Text:
Choose between dressing up Rappies—the Naruru's best buds— 
or decorating this dismal outpost, which wouldn't look pretty even if you tried hard!

Name: Jiniru
Text: ...Mmh, perfect! Hoo-man, where you need to go is—

Name: Mni
Text: Oh! A wonderful idea just crossed my mind!

Name: Mni
Text:
Since this festival is held at a military outpost,
how about proving your raw might?

Name: Mni
Text: Everyone welcomes a strong warrior, right?

Name: Mni
Text:
Oh, and there's someone over there who looks like they could use some help!
Head over to the blacksmith!

Name: Jiniru
Text: ...Mmh, perfect! Hoo-man, where you need to go is—

Name: Mni
Text: Oh! A wonderful idea just crossed my mind!

Name: Mni
Text:
Since this festival is held at a military outpost,
how about proving your raw might?

Name: Mni
Text: Everyone welcomes a strong warrior, right?

Name: Mni
Text:
Oh, and there's someone over there who looks like they could use some help!
Head over to the blacksmith!

Name: Weary Blacksmith
Text: …Do I look like someone who has time to take on more work?

Name: Weary Blacksmith
Text: Has everyone’s conscience around here frozen over right along with the ice walls?

Name: Weary Blacksmith
Text: Whether you have business or not, just beat it.

Name: Weary Blacksmith
Text: Wha... what? You'll help? Really? You're not lying, are you?

The blacksmith spent a good while venting to me about the outpost's harsh conditions,
before finally asking me to take over one of his tasks.

Name: Gareth
Text:
A-ah, excuse my manners from earlier.
I'm <Orange>Gareth</>.

Name: Gareth
Text:
Making festival supplies is already hard as it is, 
but hauling materials and setting them up too...? I’m seriously dying here!

Name: Gareth
Text:
If I end up ruining my arms—which are my entire livelihood—from overworking, who's going to take responsibility?
Don't you agree, adventurer?

Name: Gareth
Text:
So, please set this up next to the observatory for me.
It'll look great if placed somewhere high.
ItemDesc:
A brazier crafted with an artisan's dedication.
Its fine craftsmanship reveals a deep artistic flair in its maker, unexpected for a regular blacksmith.

Name: Gareth
Text:
Oh, and make sure you light the fire!
That's the most important part.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(It's heavier than expected...
Doing this alone could end in an injury.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Feels like all that hard work was worth it.)</>

Name: Gareth
Text:
You have the strength of a giant, don't you?
I didn't expect you back so soon…

Name: Gareth
Text:
Whew... making these things is tough,
but seeing the finished piece really cheers me up.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(He definitely seems in a much better mood than before.)</>

Name: Gareth
Text: The Halo Festival is all about breaking a sweat, after all.

Name: Gareth
Text:
<Yellow>We move our bodies while imagining who will become the greatest warrior.
</>At least, that's how it is for a blacksmith like me.

Name: Gareth
Text:
When I'm sitting by the furnace, tanning hides,
sometimes the sweat dripping down your brow looks just like a beam of light.

Name: Gareth
Text:
I like to think of it as a warrior's halo.
…Like a fragment of a great hero briefly paying me a visit.

Name: Gareth
Text: Haha, I'd better send you on your way before I bore you with more nonsense.

Name: Gareth
Text:
Here is your recommendation letter.
I hope it serves you well.
ItemDesc: A recommendation letter received after helping Gareth set up the festival braziers.

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(After thanking him, you explain that you need more recommendations,
and you ask if anyone else could use a hand.)</>

Name: Gareth
Text: Hmm... let me think who else is getting worked to the bone by these festival duties...

Name: Gareth
Text: Ah, the cook—the cook might need help, adventurer!

Name: Gareth
Text:
He’s supposed to be in the cookhouse, but last I checked, he was decorating Rappie lanterns.
I distinctly remember him looking utterly miserable.

Name: Gareth
Text:
It's the building next to the training grounds up there.
It's not far from here, so go give him a hand, adventurer!

Name: Focused Cook
Text:
Gasp! You scared me...!
Who, who are you?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You say you're an adventurer and explain that you're helping people around outpost to earn recommendation letters.)</>

Name: Focused Cook
Text: Phew... I thought the training instructor sent someone to drag me back.

Name: Jess
Text:
First things first, introductions.
I’m <Orange>Jess.</> I work as a cook here.

Name: Jess
Text:
But I'll be changing my post very soon.
Ah, and if you help me out, it might happen even faster!

Name: Jess
Text: See this absolutely adorable Rappie lantern right here?

Name: Jess
Text:
The thing is,
I want to trade this with the Fluffy-Hair.

Name: Jess
Text:
As you know, the Naruru absolutely lose their minds over anything Rappie-related.
If I just decorate this nicely and sell it—

Name: Jess
Text: I might finally be able to escape this kitchen and walk the path of a true artisan!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(A certain someone from the Artisans Guild comes to mind, but it's best to keep that to yourself.)</>

Name: Jess
Text: So, could you find some good decorations to finish this lantern?

Name: Jess
Text:
Anything you think would fit is fine!
I’ll trust your taste, okay?

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(There's a Rappie on the right.
Heading over there might give you some inspiration.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>(Would a horn make the Rappie look tougher?
There's something shiny and pretty in front of the statue, so let's grab that.)</>

Name: Jess
Text: I wonder what you brought back!

Name: Jess
Text:
We have similar tastes, I see!
Then, could you handle the decorating part too?

Name: Jess
Text: I figured it'd be nice to create a different vibe using similar materials!
You adorn the Rappie lantern with the horn and ribbon gathered from around the outpost.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Looking at the finished piece, you kind of want to have one for yourself.)</>

Name: Jess
Text: Hehe, isn't it gorgeous?

Name: Jess
Text:
Personally, I don't really care about becoming the greatest warrior or a hero.
It all feels like some faraway fairy tale.

Name: Jess
Text:
<Yellow>Chasing after a light you could never touch is just a waste of time.
I’d much rather spend my time filling the world with little lights like these.</>

Name: Jess
Text: Oh right, here’s your recommendation letter.
ItemDesc: A recommendation letter received after helping Jess decorate the Rappie lantern.

Name: Jess
Text: So you only have one more to go, right?

Name: Jess
Text:
Hmm... I think you can get it from the Naruru in the cookhouse.
They’re suffering right now because of me.

Name: Struggling Naruru
Text: Hold ooon—what is this smell...?

Name: Struggling Naruru
Text: It’s the scent of someone who looks very, very good at lending a hand!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You casually show the recommendation and suggest trading it for work.)</>

Name: Struggling Naruru
Text:
Ha! A hoo-man who actually knows how to strike a deal!
Fine! I, <Orange>Mamin</>, shall trade with you!

Name: Mamin
Text:
We have way too much of this left over!
But we’re short on meat, meat to marinate!
ItemDesc: A Naruru secret seasoning that looks strangely familiar—so much so that it triggers instant déjà vu, bringing the exact taste to mind.

Name: Mamin
Text: If we add this to Vahista's recipe, it’ll be the absolute BEST!

Name: Mamin
Text:
So go hunt some monsters and bring back meat!
Piles of it! Huge, huge piles!

Name: Mamin
Text:
Huh? A hoo-man this fast actually exists?
You're as amazing as the Angry Tails and the Bristly-Hairs!

Name: Mamin
Text: Hmm, I guess I have to keep my promise too, right?

Name: Mamin
Text: Here! Take this!
ItemDesc: A recommendation letter received after helping Mamin secure monster meat.

Name: Mamin
Text: The hoo-mans here are so hungry, you’re gonna be a huge help!

Name: Mamin
Text:
I felt a little… no, a lot guilty that only us Narurus were feasting and sharing only among ourselves, 
but now my mind is at ease!

Name: Mamin
Text:
<Yellow>My dark, gloomy mood got so much brighter!
I feel all sparkly!</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<Yellow>You didn't expect her to be this happy... 
You can't help but feel a little proud.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Now that all the recommendations are gathered, let's head to the reception desk.)</>

Name: Mni
Text:
You’re back this quickly?
Even the outpost locals aren't this fast!

Name: Jiniru
Text:
Hmph! You never leave this snowfield, Mni, so you don't know a thing!
No wonder! No wonder you think that!

Name: Jiniru
Text: There are so many. Many sparkling adventurers out there!

Name: Mni
Text: Hehe, I can't help but wonder why someone who knows so much is still stuck here?

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(You hand over your application and recommendations before the mood gets any worse.)</>

Name: Mni
Text:
Application name: [player].
Recommendation letters from Gareth, Jess, and Mamin—all verified!

Name: Mni
Text: Congratulations on joining the Halo Festival, adventurer!

Name: Mni
Text: <Yellow>This festival honors Stormkel's hero, Asbjorn, and crowns the ultimate warrior every single year!</>

Name: Jiniru
Text:
Becoming the ultimate warrior is simple, simple!
Your mind, your body! Just keep them tough!

Name: Mni
Text: Just like the great Asbjorn! Right, Jiniru?

Name: Jiniru
Text:
Of course, of course! 
That big, sparkly thing must have gotten even brighter thanks to you!

Name: Jiniru
Text:
Asbi. Asbi was the very first honorary member of the Bristly-Hairs,
and he was incredibly strong, just like that giant tree!

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(The very first honorary member of the Bristly-Hairs... For some reason, you feel a strange sense of kinship.)</>

Name: Jiniru
Text:
That’s why the Naruru come to help, so everyone can keep remembering him!
Because he is the ultimate warrior!...

Name: Mni
Text:
…Asbiorn taught the people of Stormkel that… 
…there is something just as important as combat prowess.

Name: Mni
Text:
That true strength means reaching out a helping hand to those in need.
That is why he holds a wooden branch instead of a weapon.

Name: Mni
Text: And that is exactly what you did today while gathering those recommendation letters, adventurer.

Name: [player]
Text: <Yellow>(Ah... helping the outpost folks and getting those recommendations was part of the festival all along.)</>

Name: Mni
Text: It's a beautiful sight, isn't it? All of everyone's little lights coming together to warm up the outpost.

Name: Mni
Text: Hehe... so, you'll join us again next time, right, adventurer?

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Hello.
I'm Eyvind from the Bardad Expedition.

Name: Eyvind
Text: Can I borrow you for a second?

Name: Eyvind
Text:
I need to resolve a small problem,
and it requires someone of exceptional skill.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Since there are no unpleasant rumors about you...
I figure you can keep a secret and get the job done right.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Seriously, this can't leak.
It’s a breakthrough research that’ll shake the world.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
If others find out, they’ll just stick their noses in.
Eventually, they’ll ruin everything!

Name: Eyvind
Text:
So, let's keep this quiet and move as cautiously as possible.
Don't worry, you'll be rewarded well!

Name: Eyvind
Text:
First, could you quietly bring the object to me?
I kept it separate so it wouldn't react to my other experiments.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
I often demonstrate my findings right in front of the captain,
so magical accidents happen quite often.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
I'll get everything else ready.
Just head up the hill behind the barracks...

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Wait… Did the magic not trigger at all?
Ugh… and I actually felt pretty confident about my skills.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Oh… I wasn't testing you, I swear!
I only just remembered I locked it down after you already got back.

Name: Eyvind
Text: Still, this actually opens up a whole new realm of possibilities.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Your Aether is clearly far denser than mine,
which means you should be able to go much deeper into the object.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Heh... just a moment, please.
I need to write down the hypothesis that just came to mind.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Even a little hiccup like this has its uses.
The more proof I have for a future academic paper, the better.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Thanks for waiting.
This type thing isn't recorded in any books, so there's quite a lot to prepare.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Essentially, we’re investigating an “anomaly.”
That includes everything tied to this object.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
I’ve already run a few tests,
and managed to observe the ambient Aether weaving together.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
But maybe my own Aether is just too weak...
No matter what I do, it won't react past that point.

Name: Eyvind
Text: That’s why I need you to come with me and look into it.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Oh, I like that confidence.
How about you show me what you've got then?

Name: Eyvind
Text: Try triggering the object yourself! Follow me.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Well, that’s disappointing. No noticeable change at all.
And here I thought the total amount of Aether was the key...

Name: Eyvind
Text:
If even your power can't budge it,
there might be a complex magic formula engraved inside.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
If that's the case, we’ll need advice from the Liberators of Knowledge or the Appraisers Guild.
But then the whole world would find out about this object... Hmm.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
I hadn't considered that possibility, so we're in a bit of a tight spot.
While I look for another way, why don't you take a quick—

Name: Eyvind
Text: L-Look over there! Right where you were standing!

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(What is that? Did the object trigger on a delay?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(What on earth is this? I can feel the Aether, but the shape...)</>

Name: Eyvind
Text:
We need visual data first,
so I’m going to sketch this down.

Name: Eyvind
Text: Could you check if there’s anything unusual? Please!

Name: Eyvind
Text: ...It almost looks like an entrance. Or maybe an exit.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
It's not like Aether entanglements or objects with those functions…
…aren't completely unheard of in the Forsaken Land.

Name: Eyvind
Text: But... I’ve never seen one that feels this massive and dangerous.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
At least the readings themselves are stable.
They're significantly lower than during an Incursion.

Name: Eyvind
Text: We shouldn't mess with it for now—just leave it as it is.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Let's head back and talk.
There are a few things I'd like to examine.

Name: Eyvind
Text: Scholars have come up with all sorts of names for this phenomenon.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
I’m sure you’ve heard a few of them yourself.
Some call it a barrier, while others call it a rift.

Name: Eyvind
Text: What they have in common is that a medium connect two different spaces and times.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Even if it's not a place in the Forsaken Land, as long as that medium is there,
it's possible to cross over—though with certain restrictions.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
You know, inconveniences like not being able to stay long,
or losing some of your spoils along the way.

Name: Eyvind
Text: Anyway, I look at this medium as a kind of “Crevice.”

Name: Eyvind
Text:
A gap through which we can reach the unknown world...
outside Elsetia, the star we live on.

Name: Eyvind
Text: In all academic history, there couldn't be a more groundbreaking anomaly to study!

Name: Eyvind
Text:
If we can just understand that outer world and harness its power...
Wouldn't we finally be able to wipe the threats from this land once and for all?

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Thanks to you, we now know a new crevice exists.
I’ll make sure this research is a success. I promise.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
The wave caught on the beacon has vanished.
That means it dissolved naturally.

Name: Eyvind
Text: It seems the duration depends on the variables at the exact moment the object triggers.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
To prove this, I’ll need to check the other test sites as well.
Could you head to Firststride Village right away?

Name: Eyvind
Text: Actually, I ran a few tests even before I asked for your help.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
I tried changing locations multiple times,
but no such crevice appeared back then.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
But now that we have proof that they can appear on a delay,
it’s best to re-examine those spots too.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Take this letter with you.
Just show it to the mercenaries there.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(A crevice has already formed here. How long has it been?)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Eyvind didn't know about this when you left, so it must have happened recently.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(At least nothing dangerous has broken out yet. There are guards posted, so you should get the details from them first.)</>

Name: Man Who Appears to be the Captain
Text:
What's your business here?
This area is under the watch of the Mali Mercenary Company.

Name: Man Who Appears to be the Captain
Text:
Monsters could pour out at any moment,
so go to a waypoint as far away as possible.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(You hand over Eyvind's letter.)</>
ItemDesc:
Greetings, Captain Gunter.
This is Eyvind, your client.

I'm thinking of revisiting the locations we investigated before.
That’s why I’ve sent someone who understands the situation to update you up on my progress.

- Object triggered; anomaly detected.
- Need to monitor environmental changes caused by the anomaly.
- Assign personnel based on the readings...

Name: Gunter
Text: Hmm. So he's heading alone to the sites that remained stable, is that it?

Name: Gunter
Text:
So you’re Eyvind’s stand-in.
Do you even know what’s going on here? Is this your first high-risk contract?

Name: Gunter
Text: Fine. Client must have had his reasons.

Name: Gunter
Text:
We’ve split into squads to monitor several locations.
Focusing mainly on the spots where the meters fluctuated wildly after the object was triggered.

Name: Gunter
Text: No visible changes despite the numbers, so we've just been on standby.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Well... at least we were, until you showed up.
But that darn thing suddenly popped up. I was actually just about to send word.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Looking at his letter, it seems he’s calling it a “Crevice.”
Do you know anything about it?

Name: Gunter
Text:
We were preparing for monsters pouring out,
or destructive magic erupting from it.

Name: Gunter
Text:
It’s a relief you didn't have to use brute force.
Still, we need to examine it closely.

Name: Gunter
Text: Client sent you here for that exact reason. Let’s go check out the Crevice.

Before we could even jump in surprise at the never-before-seen creature,
we barely escaped its relentless assault with our lives.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Thanks for fighting beside us.
Without you, we'd have lost a lot of people.

Name: Gunter
Text:
To think of a massive, humanoid creature bursting out of nowhere... Hmph.
Let’s just call it a “Giant” for now.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Did the client seriously mention nothing about this beforehand?
I didn't bargain on facing something like that.

Name: Gunter
Text:
It looked unreal from the start... 
Felt like fighting an illusion.

Name: Gunter
Text:
You saw it too, didn’t you? The way it dissolved into mist.
There isn't even a corpse left behind.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Still, we need to search the area.
It clearly stomped through here. It must've left something behind.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Wait... that hole, the Crevice.
Is it writhing?

Name: Gunter
Text: Don't bother looking back. It just shrunk and vanished.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Well, with that gone, no more Giants should be appearing.
The Crevice closing up is a good sign at least.

Name: Gunter
Text:
So, did you find anything?
A strand of hair, or a claw—anything would help.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Same on your end?
That’s troubling. All we have are footprints in the dirt as evidence.

Name: Gunter
Text: Are Giants like that? Vanish without a trace when they take fatal damage?

Name: Gunter
Text:
If we had even a drop of blood or a piece of flesh from its wounds,
we could’ve reported this to the Guard or the Manor.

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(...Eyvind did say he wanted this handled discreetly.)</>

Name: [player]
Text:
<yellow>(No one died or got hurt anyway.
If we can just close these Crevices, there’s no real need to report it.)</>

Name: Gunter
Text:
I’ll need to have a word with the client.
It’s going to be a real problem if more Giants show up.

Name: Gunter
Text:
We only conducted experiments in remote locations,
but what if a Crevice opens up later on, just like this one?

Name: Gunter
Text:
I need to dispatch more of our members to the other test sites.
If we’re not careful, Giants will attack civilians.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Breaking a contract just because it gets dangerous... 
would disgrace the Mali Mercenary Company.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Our company is much bigger than this, so don't worry.
Besides, the more dangerous the mission, the better for us.

Name: Gunter
Text: For now, you just wait until we hear from the client.

Name: Mueena
Text:
You’ve come at a crucial time.
I have an urgent matter for you.

Name: Mueena
Text: First, take a look at this data.
ItemDesc:
This sketch looks exactly like the creature we encountered recently.
Has someone outside the Maii Mercenary Company witnessed it?

Name: Mueena
Text: A report just came in around Hesperia, near the Pulsing Ridge.

Name: Mueena
Text:
A massive creature raided the reconnaissance outpost…
They say the fatalities are beyond count.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Fortunately, the Knights of the Biting Wind managed to take the beast down,
but the knights themselves are currently in critical condition.

Name: Mueena
Text:
That’s all the information I have for now,
given how sudden this was.

Name: Mueena
Text:
We've already requested assistance…
…from Babylon's leading anomaly experts.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Adelaide from the Appraisers Guild has already headed to the site.
She will contact us via transmission if she detects any unusual signs.

Name: Mueena
Text:
We’ll probably be a bit delayed preparing relief supplies,
so could you head out first and check the situation on the ground?

Name: Mueena
Text: I apologize for providing such sparse information.

Name: Mueena
Text:
They tried to get a statement from a resident who barely escaped,
but the survivor collapsed straight after finishing this sketch.

Name: Mueena
Text:
I’ll try to get back in touch with the Knights of the Biting Wind.
In the meantime, please see if you can find any other survivors or witnesses.

Name: Adel
Text:
Oh, my! It's been a while.
Too bad… we're meeting under these circumstances.

Name: Adel
Text:
You’re here at Muina's request, aren’t you?
Perfect, we can team up then.

Name: Adel
Text: I’ve just finished the environmental survey around this outpost.

Name: Adel
Text:
No artificial Tesseract or any similar objects have been installed here.
The nature remains perfectly untouched.

Name: Adel
Text:
So we can infer the creature just popped up out of thin air, right?
As of now, that’s our most likely hypothesis.

Name: Adel
Text:
If it were an Incursion, there would have been warning signs.
People usually have plenty of time to evacuate.

Name: Adel
Text: Besides, didn't it chase us too far for a monster from an Incursion?

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(Then… this place was attacked by one of those Giants.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(With that kind of destructive power, civilians wouldn't stand a chance. From a distance, they probably mistook it for a person.)</>

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(This tragedy happened even before Eyvind and the mercenaries got here... For now, let's focus on cleaning this up.)</>

Name: Adel
Text:
Hehe. You look adorable when you're serious.
As we investigate, we might find evidence that flips my theory.

Name: Adel
Text:
Shall we move out?
The attack site is just down the hill, so follow me.

Name: Adel
Text:
Mmm, there's a reason the locals won't even come near this place.
Anyone would be terrified by a sight this gruesome.

Name: Adel
Text:
People naturally become helpless before an overwhelmingly massive existence.
Even if it doesn't intend to kill them.

Name: Adel
Text:
And these aren't sword wounds.
See how the flesh is torn apart?

Name: Adel
Text: It was torn apart with teeth... just like how we eat a meal.

Name: Adel
Text:
Anyone who witnessed that would have lost their mind.
No wonder they couldn't get a proper statement.

Name: Adel
Text: I'll check if there's any magical residue left behind.

Name: Adel
Text:
Let's check the bodies first... Oh, look over there, isn't that a Naruru?
Just in case, you should go talk to them.

Name: Karadu
Text:
You! The human who fights well!
Finally, a human who isn't a scaredy-scaredy cat!

Name: Karadu
Text:
Everyone else is a coward. They won't come in here.
But me, Karadu! Brave Bristly-Hair saw it all!

Name: Karadu
Text: Sturdy Whiskers told me to look around here.

Name: Karadu
Text:
I lay down to sleep here, right here, so the Rappies could rest.
Bristly-Hair sleeps well outside!

Name: Karadu
Text:
But then I heard thump! thump! From far away.
It was way, way bigger than the monsters we see every day!

Name: Karadu
Text:
Bristly-Hair never backs down, so I was going to fight.
I sent the Rappies back and went forward. I went forward, but...!

Name: Karadu
Text: A human was eating up another human! It was definitely a big human!

Name: Karadu
Text:
So I went in fr-front of the big human to save them.
But the big human didn't even look at me.

Name: Karadu
Text:
It just kept, kept chasing the running humans.
It didn't even know me or the Rappies were there.

Name: Karadu
Text:
Then another human in iron armor showed up.
They fought the big human! Fought with sharp weapons!

Name: Karadu
Text:
They fought really well, though not as well as you.
Then the big human fell... and just disappeared! It was gone!

Name: Karadu
Text: The gray air when you make a fire... What do you humans call it?

Name: Karadu
Text:
Mist! Smoke! It disappeared just like that.
The big human is completely gone. I don’t know if they’re dead or hiding.

Name: Karadu
Text: The bodies here... they're the humans the big one spat back out.

Name: Karadu
Text: Everyone stopped breathing, so I couldn't save them!

Name: Karadu
Text: So, so sad. I hope they go safely back to Goddess Ea.

Name: Adel
Text:
Hmm. So the Giant completely ignored the Naruru and the Reppies?
To mercilessly target only humans...

Name: Adel
Text:
Well, I suppose that’s a slight relief.
At least it isn't slaughtering everything blindly.

Name: Adel
Text:
I’ll relay what you’ve shared to Muina.
For now, let’s go speak with them.

Name: Adel
Text:
What brings you here, of all places... Eyvind?
You aren't fooling around with another strange experiment, are you?

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Deputy Guild Master, it has been a while.
You still don't seem to trust me.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
I am simply surveying the area.
Trying to prevent the creature… …from returning.

Name: Adel
Text:
I remember when you were with our guild.
You were a little too passionate about your research.

Name: Adel
Text:
And you caused accidents daily.
How do you expect me to believe that you’re investigating without trouble this time?

Name: Eyvind
Text:
Haha, I was a bit impatient back then.
I was too obsessed with creating weapons to kill monsters.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
But now, I’ve even signed a formal contract with the Mali Mercenary Company.
It’s specifically to ensure my work doesn't cause any collateral damage.

Name: Mercenary Member
Text: Ahem. We are accompanying him at all times, outside of the expedition headquarters.

Name: Mercenary Member
Text:
While personal protection is the core of our contract,
our duties also include assisting with his research.

Name: Mercenary Member
Text:
We just secured this perimeter to ensure no more Giants appear,
and we have squads deployed in other regions as well.

Name: Brenner
Text: I guarantee this under my name as Vice Captain Brenner.

Name: Adel
Text:
…Well, Babylon is already dispatching troops near the civilian settlements.
And with you on the ground, we should be able to manage somehow.

Name: Adel
Text:
Right now, making a plan to fight back…
…is far more urgent than finding the root cause.

Name: Adel
Text:
I’m going back to discuss this phenomenon.
Stick with these two for now, and if another Giant shows up—

Name: Eyvind
Text:
You have nothing to worry about.
My desire to serve humanity hasn’t changed a bit.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
We’re heading up to the expedition garrison now to prepare for the worst.
You can trust me on this. Really.

Name: Adel
Text:
Hah... keep a close eye on things, [player].
I trust... you caught my drift.

Adel leaves after leaving a quiet word of caution.
Afterward, you head north alongside Eyvind and Brenner.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
There are more victims here too.
The Crevice is open, and there are footprints left behind.

Name: Eyvind
Text: Did these people lose their lives fighting the Giant…? *sigh.*

Name: Gunter
Text:
By the time we arrived, it was already over.
All we could do was take down one Giant heading further up.

Name: Gunter
Text:
We're currently investigating whether only one creature emerged from this Crevice,
or if others went the opposite way.

Name: Brenner
Text: Unlike ordinary creatures, the Giants didn't leave any corpses behind.

Name: Brenner
Text:
So we must assume they moved elsewhere.
There is a possibility they are still nearby.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Most importantly, we didn't find any weapons on them.
They never had a chance to fight back.

Name: Gunter
Text:
…Client.
You prioritized the test sites based on your calculations.

Name: Gunter
Text:
The probability of a Crevice forming where the object was tested.
And the probability of a Giant appearing from that Crevice.

Name: Gunter
Text:
I remember you saying it was a double calculation.
And that only a few locations fit all the criteria.

Name: Brenner
Text: We need to notify each nation’s manors immediately and change our plans.

Name: Brenner
Text:
The best move is to prevent the Crevices from forming at all.
If they form later on, we deploy troops until they naturally dissolve.

Name: Brenner
Text:
With unpredictable variables at play,
the client and our company alone can't respond fast enough.

Name: Eyvind
Text: ...You've already made up your mind, haven't you?

Name: Eyvind
Text:
I didn't think this object would mimic organic life from the outer world—
but most of the tests were conducted at the Giant's Tower anyway.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
There are barely any spots left in the Forsaken Land.
We only need to secure three more locations.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
If we just bury the Aether Focusers beneath the Crevices,
we can hold the Giants in place! We confirmed that together, didn't we?

Name: Gunter
Text: What if they just head into the woods or the mountains, hidden from our view?

Name: Gunter
Text:
For all we know, those things could be wandering lost and dazed from crossing worlds,
suddenly come charging down into the village.

Name: Gunter
Text:
We can't assume we've caught every Giant.
We must make a public warning and set up evacuation protocols.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
I am truly, deeply sorry for the lives lost...
But dozens are injured and killed every day from the Incursion alone.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
If this is reported as an accident caused by an unlicensed object,
it will be destroyed before we can even find its true utility.

Name: Eyvind
Text:
It might not be a Giant next time—a helpful, intelligent being could appear.
We could even use them to hunt down beasts—

Name: Gunter
Text:
I don't care how much you pay us. We're not risking innocent lives.
Take a moment to calm down. Let's talk this through again.

Name: Gunter
Text:
[player], can you check the perimeter?
It's dangerous, so don't wander off too far.

Perhaps sensing our presence,
Giants charged from every direction. We barely managed to take them down.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Waiting until a report goes through will be too late.
I’m sending the list of test sites to Babylon first.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Monsters give up if you break their line of sight,
but these bastards have no brains—they just keep coming at you to the end.

Name: Gunter
Text:
I told him to go cool his head at our base.
I put guards on him as an escort. He won't slip away.

Name: Gunter
Text: I ordered them to “watch” him closely. If he acts up, I'll know instantly.

Name: Gunter
Text:
I’ll go try to convince the client once we clean up the mess here.
You take the news to Babylon.

Name: Gunter
Text: Yeah, see you when this is all sorted out.

Name: Mueena
Text: Ah, you're back. I’m afraid I have more grim news for you.

Name: Mueena
Text:
We received a letter from Captain Gunter of the Mali Mercenary Company.
He explained the anomaly was caused by an unlicensed object.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Thanks to that, we’ve already finished deploying troops to the Barrens and the Ridge,
and we even managed to fend off a few raids.

Name: Mueena
Text:
I was worried sick to hear they were so massive their heads cleared the sky.
But it turns out they can be killed just like any other living creature.

Name: Mueena
Text:
For some reason, Giants rarely appear in the Giant's Garden,
so I’ve instructed the Naruru to stay in their village for now.

Name: Mueena
Text:
The only place left is the northern Highlands.
As you know, the Archon there is incredibly stubborn.

Name: Mueena
Text:
He wouldn't even listen, claiming we were just making up stories.
That’s why I need you to step in.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Stormkel Gate has plenty of soldiers,
so they’ll manage somehow even if a Giant shows up.

Name: Mueena
Text: But the other outposts don't have enough combat personnel.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Since the Archon of Stormkel refuses to officially acknowledge the anomalies,
we can't send Alliance troops or use our own personnel.

Name: Mueena
Text:
So, as a free adventurer, I need you to post a notice,
and clear out the remaining threats.

Name: Mueena
Text:
The locations match the “test sites” included in the letter—
specifically the ones the Mali Mercenary Company never reached.

Name: Mueena
Text:
I hear Vice Captain Brenner is already on standby there,
so please move quickly...

Name: Mueena
Text: And… ensure you secure the safety of “Eyvind” of the Bardad Expedition.

Name: Mueena
Text:
The mercenaries might have him in custody,
but it’ll be much better if we handle him ourselves.

Name: Mueena
Text:
We need him, whether it is to uncover the truth or prove his innocence.
Just bring him back in one piece.

Name: Brenner
Text:
...I came here alone.
The other guys aren't in any shape to come.

Name: Brenner
Text:
Seems Eyvind slipped something into their food last night.
The guards watching him have the worst case of stomach sickness.

Name: Brenner
Text: No wonder the reports said he was acting all quiet and defeated...

Name: Brenner
Text:
The Captain is fine, thankfully.
He went after our runaway client.

Name: Brenner
Text:
Apparently, the guy used a Warp Scroll and vanished in the blink of an eye.
So the Captain is retracing his steps throughout the test sites for now.

Name: Brenner
Text:
As for us, we have a job to do.
We check if any crevices have formed, and we deal with them.

Name: Brenner
Text:
It’s a fifty-fifty coin toss whether he’ll cause more trouble,
but the seeds of a disaster have alreadybeen planted here, haven’t they?

Name: [player]
Text: <yellow>(...He's not wrong.)</>

Name: Brenner
Text:
There’s an isolated hill northeast of the waypoint.
Let's move out.

Name: Brenner
Text: My magic tools aren't picking up any unusual readings.

Name: Brenner
Text:
Either the artifact failed to trigger properly,
or the crevice already disappeared naturally.

Name: Brenner
Text: If a Giant had shown up, this sanctuary would have been wiped out by now.

Name: Brenner
Text:
Remember I told you the client ran away?
He left this behind when he fled.

Name: Brenner
Text:
Seems it's rare for crevices to open,
and even rarer for Giants to appear from them.

Name: Brenner
Text: But a single attack caused so many casualties...

Name: Brenner
Text:
Sometimes I wonder if these creatures were built solely to slaughter humans.
Sigh. Let's move to the next spot.

Name: Brenner
Text:
This will be the last one.
Unless he ran any extra tests behind our backs.

Name: Brenner
Text:
Since he's on the run, it's hard not to keep doubting him.
He did say something suspicious back at the Ridge.

Name: Brenner
Text:
He wanted to find a new use for it, didn't he?
He must have found some other possibility.

Name: Brenner
Text: But with guards patrolling, he wouldn't dare trigger the artifact carelessly.

Name: Brenner
Text:
I watched him find the artifact and run his tests.
He seemed a bit eccentric, but he didn't have the guts for anything major.

Name: Brenner
Text:
He also said he wanted his research to help the world.
I don't think he's a bad person at heart.

Name: Brenner
Text:
There's a large, climbable rock on the side of the camp.
Let's move out immediately.

Name: Brenner
Text:
Wait, is that a letter?
Judging by its location, looks it appeared instead of a Giant.
ItemDesc:
Where do Giants come from?
If the wall collapses, this world is doomed.
Now, I’m the only one left. My brother, my sister... they were all eaten.
I’m going to die. We're all going to die.

Name: Brenner
Text:
If this came from the Giants' homeland,
things seem to be dire over there, bordering on total ruin.

Name: Brenner
Text:
...Forgive me, it was inconsiderate of me.
I’m sure the victims right here in Elsetia felt the same way.

Name: Brenner
Text:
Our job in the Forsaken Land is done.
Now, to catch our client—

Name: Brenner
Text: Hold on, a transmission from the Captain.

Name: Brenner
Text:
We should head to the Scything Barrens.
A Giant has been spotted in an unexpected area.

Name: Brenner
Text:
Most of our men went to clean up the test sites inside the Tower,
and used up all Aether Focusers.

Name: Brenner
Text: It’s the Mirage Gorge. Please get here as soon as you can.
This Incursion was different. A Giant was fighting alongside the monsters.

Name: Brenner
Text:
I don’t see any crevice.
It must have disappeared while we were fighting.

Name: Brenner
Text:
Facing monsters and Giants at the same time... it felt several times more deadly,
didn't it?

Name: Brenner
Text:
I almost felt lucky the client ran his tests
far from civilians.

Name: Brenner
Text:
What if a crevice opens where monsters gather?
If an Incursion and a Giant hit at the same time...

Name: Brenner
Text:
we'd have to pull every veteran adventurer like you out of the Tower.
An ordinary mercenary company wouldn't stand a chance.

Name: Brenner
Text:
For now, this is as far as Babylon and our Captain agreed to go.
You can head back and report.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Thank you for your hard work, [player].
It seems you've done all that could be done out there.

Name: Mueena
Text:
There were notable casualties among civilians and troops,
but thankfully, it didn't escalate to a Grand Incursion.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Seeing you’ve returned alone, I take it you couldn't catch him?
I even cleared out a dungeon cell for him.

Name: Mueena
Text:
It seems he fled in the meantime.
The pressure of being watched must have been too much.

Name: Mueena
Text:
We now have no choice but to issue an arrest warratn.
We cannot let someone so unpredictable wander around.

Name: Mueena
Text:
The man can even use warp scrolls.
I dread to think what havoc he plans to wreck next.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Captain Bardard has absolutely no idea either.
He says the man had eccentric ideas, but always followed orders.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Take some rest, and then head to the Appraisers Guild.
They might know something.

Name: Mueena
Text: I intend to map out an effective plan based on his usual habits.

Name: Mueena
Text:
What drove him, what he truly desired...
those will be our clues to predict his next move.

Name: Monica
Text:
Have been seeing a lot of you lately.
I assume you have a good reason for wasting my precious time?

Name: Monica
Text:
Adel gave me the gist of it.
Spare me the details and get straight to the point.

Name: Monica
Text:
He certainly had passion.
Deeply fascinated by ancient relics, always tinkering with something on his own.

Name: Monica
Text:
He wasn't entirely talentless. Just terribly unlucky.
He never could unearth anything truly extraordinary.

Name: Monica
Text:
He caused an explosion attempting a reckless modification,
and even wrecked a workshop while testing a standard magic tool.

Name: Monica
Text:
But he was good at heart, I suppose.
Always said he wanted to protect the people.

Name: Monica
Text: He was no fighter, but swore he’d help save others with his inventions.

Name: Monica
Text:
Anyway, his research cost me a fortune.
The guild funds weren’t enough, so I had to pay the rest myself.

Name: Monica
Text:
The losses kept piling up, so I let him go.
I am not a charity worker, after all.

Name: Monica
Text:
By the way, do you intend to keep digging into this matter?
If so, do me a quick favor while you are at it.

Name: Monica
Text:
This is a Cluster Detector.
It tracks magic circuits instead of raw Aether.
ItemDesc:
A magic device handed over by Monica.
Its exterior suggests it hails from an ancient civilization.

Name: Monica
Text:
Each artifact with special functions bears its own unique circuit.
It's a vital tool for appraising artifacts.

Name: Monica
Text:
I'm not sure if you can tell them apart,
but unless you're dealing with many artifacts at once, it’ll do the trick.

Name: Monica
Text: I will lend this to you, so bring back whatever those giants left behind.

Name: Monica
Text:
Well, even a blood sample would suffice.
I need to check the victims’ conditions, see if anything changed in their bodies.

Name: Monica
Text:
Now, go speak to Adel for the rest.
Adel was the one in charge of his training.

Name: Adel
Text:
Master Eyvind? Hmm.
Speaking ill of someone behind their back isn't really my style.

Name: Adel
Text:
Still, we can't just let a crime go on under our noses, can we?
Come to think of it, something does come to mind.

Name: Adel
Text:
Everyone in the Forsaken Land loathes the monsters
and wishes them wiped from existence.

Name: Adel
Text:
He often showed his anger as well.
He had his reasons. He lost his family to the Incursion.

Name: Adel
Text:
He seems carefree and outspoken on the surface,
but he always turned solemn whenever someone brought up the Incursion.

Name: Adel
Text:
aHe once said his sole wish was to stop the Incursion for good.
He practically lived at the tower, searching for an artifact to do just that.

Name: Adel
Text:
He never expected those monstrosities to crawl out.
Even I would not have predicted that.

Name: Adel
Text:
Regardless, he spent his whole life chasing that dream and finally unearhed an artifact...
He must have come up with some brilliant idea, right?

Name: Adel
Text:
Do you think he is trying to use the giants to do something about the Incursion?
Even if it did not go quite as he planned.

Name: Adel
Text:
But I doubt he has given up on the possibility yet.
He must make the experiment work somehow... to exact his revenge.

Name: Adel
Text:
Ahem—I was just sharing my thoughts.
Was that helpful enough?

Name: Adel
Text:
I am no criminal expert, but I will tag along.
If an old friend tries to reason with him, maybe he’ll actually listen.

Name: Adel
Text:
The Tenebrous Hollow is the most likely spot for the next Incursion.
Let's get going.

Name: Adel
Text:
Don't be alarmed! The giant here was taken care of yesterday.
We're just short-handed, so the bodies haven't been cleared away yet.

Name: Adel
Text:
Some say we should just leave them be,
They were like, “They are criminals. Why bother with a proper ritual?”

Name: Adel
Text:
Well, everyone sees things differently.
I'll take a look over here.

Name: Adel
Text: Did someone use it and just leave it here? It’s not desiged for one-time use.

Name: Adel
Text:
I hope the user didn’t try to put the Aether in here into something else.
If it was used on an artifact that creates crevices... Wait, what’s that?

Name: Adel
Text:
A crevice just opened there!
And behind it… that's Eyvind!

Adelaide and I went after Eyvind, but he slipped away.
I couldn't tell if it was by the artifact's power or magic.

Name: Adel
Text:
Pant… he's already gone. 
Since when did he get so fast? Sigh...

Name: Adel
Text:
Wait. The crevice suddenly closed…
What’s going on? Has this ever happened before?

Name: Adel
Text:
Look! It’s an Aether Collector.
The same thing we just saw.

Name: Adel
Text:
He probably wanted to activate the artifact near the Incursion,
but failed to make it work properly.

Name: Adel
Text:
Once that thing gains enough power…
he’ll probably keep tearing open more crevices.

Name: Adel
Text:
No readings on the Cluster Detector… Sigh...
We might as well head back to Babylon and sound the alarm.

Name: Monica
Text:
So Eyvind is on the move again.
Choosing the path of a criminal... What a shame.

Name: Adel
Text:
Fortunately, we still have some time before that artifact gains enough power.
We need to use this window to find out where the Incursion will hit next.

Name: Adel
Text:
Muina compiles the monthly reports on the Incursions, doesn't she?
She might be able to help... I'll go pay her a visit.

Name: Monica
Text:
This is a joint investigation, so don't try to do everything by yourself.
Besides, it's been ages since he left the guild.

Name: Adel
Text:
I know, but... maybe I can still stop him, before it's too late.
I just can't shake that thought off.

Name: Adel
Text:
For now, could you please pass the word along to Muina?
I'll head out to the usual Incursion areas in the Barrens.

I filled Muina in on everything that had happened.
A look of annoyance crossed Muina's face before the reply came.

Name: Mueena
Text: Just when we could catch our breath, that criminal succumbed to his desires.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Revenge or whatever, I don’t care what his motive is.
If he intends to trigger an Incursion-level disaster at his whim, he must be stopped.

Name: Mueena
Text:
He clearly intends to strike near Incursions.
There is no need to deploy our forces in all directions.

Name: Mueena
Text: Instead... we now face the increased risk of fighting both the Incursion monsters and the giants at once.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Still, we can gather one thing from the Appraisers Guild's report.
The man is not a bloodthirsty maniac.

Name: Mueena
Text:
He seems to harbor some desire to protect humanity,
which means he will likely avoid populated areas.

Name: Mueena
Text: I should use our past Incursion data to narrow down a few potential locations.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Give me a moment.
There won't be many places that meet all these criteria.

Name: Mueena
Text: We need you at the Gorge of Perdition.

Name: Mueena
Text:
The terrain there is rough and enclosed, so we need someone who can navigate it well.
The Alliance will handle the other locations.

Name: Mueena
Text: ...To be honest, it is also the most dangerous site.

Name: Mueena
Text:
An enclosed space like that would be the perfect testing ground for him.
There is a high probability he will make his move there.

Name: Mueena
Text:
It is rather ironic that a criminal worries about civilians—
but we cannot let him keep using an unsanctioned artifact.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Adel sent this along.
It's a Cluster Detector. She said you'd know how to use it.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Take it and rendezvous with the Mali Mercenaries.
They insisted on seeing this 'request' through to the end.

Name: Gunter
Text: You’re here. Look at you, all worn down—just like the rest of us.

Name: Gunter
Text:
You could practically switch careers to a giant hunter.
I started wondering if the Forsaken Land was always this vast.

Name: Brenner
Text:
The real problem is that we didn't clear out the Giant’s Tower properly.
We only went into secluded places.

Name: Brenner
Text:
It was not so long ago that he was the only one who knew about the place.
We’ll just have to hope the adventurers can handle the rest.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Well, he ran his experiments there when the artifact was at its peak,
so there's no denying it tore open far more crevices.

Name: Gunter
Text:
That’s why we have to catch our client and stop any more surprises.
Only then can we sweep the remaining giants from the tower.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Just like we planned this morning.
I'm glad to have you officially on board.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Brenner, tell the men to watch the perimeter around the gorge.
We’re heading straight for the center.

Name: Eyvind
Text: I will wipe out every last monster with these giants...!

Name: Eyvind
Text: Get out of my way, you pests...!

The moment the mercenaries and I rushed toward Eyvind,
one of the giants broke free from control and swung around wildly.
Eyvind was sent flying by a single sweep of the giant's hand…

The mercenaries immediately took care of the giant,
but Eyvind was nowhere to be found.

Name: Brenner
Text:
It’s over.
I'll assess the casualties and report back.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Head back to Babylon and deliver the news.
Leave the cleanup here to us.

Name: Gunter
Text:
You’d better take this artifact with you.
Whether they seal it or smash it to pieces, the higher-ups will handle it.

Name: Gunter
Text:
I suppose Eyvind... brought this upon himself through his own greed,
whether it came from scholarly obsession or some personal agenda.

Name: Gunter
Text:
Still, we failed to protect our client. In fact, we drove him to his death.
The Mali Mercenaries' reputation is going straight down the gutter.

Name: Brenner
Text: ...Captain.

Name: Gunter
Text:
We need to make plans to head into Asientet or Stormkel.
It’s going to be hard to operate in the Forsaken Land for a while.

Name: Gunter
Text:
You've done great work. Go on back, and don't you worry about us.
If fate allows, our paths will cross again someday.

Gunter, the mercenary captain, could not hide his bitterness.
He likely never imagined that a single job would end up posing such a threat to the world…

Name: Mueena
Text:
Something about this still feels off, but you handled it well.
You have the gratitude of Babylon.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Just because he’s dead doesn't mean the threat is gone.
There's still a chance the giants might appear.

Name: Mueena
Text:
The tower holds many hidden spaces unknown to the public.
I’m sure you can think of a few yourself.

Name: Mueena
Text: What if he went to the tower after slipping away from the mercenaries?

Name: Mueena
Text:
What if he activated the artifact again, and unfortunately, the crevices opened wide?
There could be way more giants than we think.

Name: Mueena
Text:
That means, alongside the monsters pouring out from the Incursion—
giants could be coming out as well.

Name: Mueena
Text:
In fact, the Appraisers Guild mentioned
that the Aether inside the tower has become unstable.

Name: Mueena
Text:
We might soon face our absolute worst-case scenario.
We need to start preparing for it right now.

Name: Mueena
Text:
While I send a team to clear out the crevices,
I’d like you to keep an eye on things here for a few more days.

Name: Mueena
Text: Unlike before, we are about to face a truly devastating Incursion.

Name: Mueena
Text:
Oh, and you should probably return the Cluster Detector.
Monica mentioned it’s... expensive.

Name: Monica
Text:
So, is this whole mess finally over?
I swear, you live long enough and you see everything.

Name: Monica
Text: I thought he was just a pathetic fool, forcing a smile to hide his grief.

Name: Adel
Text:
Perhaps he never truly gave up on revenge.
He always had that desire, which is why he took such radical action.

Name: Adel
Text: If he had shown up where I was waiting... I would have tried to persuade him.

Name: Adel
Text:
Although Eyvind won't be able to avoid imprisonment,
I plan to continue his research myself.

Name: Adel
Text:
I wanted to quell his madness and grant his wish.
Because we can conduct the experiments safely.

Name: Monica
Text:
Is this how it feels to have a misguided child?
Anyway, your problem is that you're too soft-hearted.

Name: Monica
Text:
I won't deny that his situation is tragic.
I still remember the day you took him in when he was starving to death.

Name: Monica
Text:
It's true that the kid’s had it rough, but we fight for the Alliance.
We have to stop anyone driven mad by revenge from hurting innocent people.

Name: Adel
Text:
It's just... if the people around him had taken better care of him,
I can't help but think none of this would have happened.

Name: Adel
Text:
Everyone thought Eyvind had admirably overcome his childhood trauma.
We mistakenly believed he had grown into an adult who wanted to contribute to society.

Name: Monica
Text:
Sometimes I think you're really amazing.
I could never be as forgiving as you, phew.

Name: Monica
Text:
[player], hand that over here.
Given the special circumstances, I'll seal it before conducting the appraisal.

Name: Monica
Text:
We won't be able to take it out again until this whole situation is over.
Well, if you get curious, drop by our guild.

Name: Adel
Text:
It's been a long time since Eyvind and I drifted apart, but...
I feel both bewildered and sad.

Name: Adel
Text:
But you stopped him before he committed more crimes.
For that, I am truly, truly grateful.

Name: Adel
Text:
Let's have a chat once everything is settled.
Thank you for all your hard work.

Name: Evrin
Text: You know why I called you, right?

Name: Evrin
Text: The price of fame is steep. You'll just have to deal with it, even if it feels unfair.

Name: Evrin
Text: I'm not in the habit of holding up busy people, so let's get straight to the point.

Name: Evrin
Text: It's Priest Eli's report.

Name: [player]
Text: (Read the report Evrin handed over.)
ItemDesc:
- The commotion caused by Eyvind of the Appraisers Guild appears to have been resolved, yet abnormal signs are still detected.
- Received reports of Giant appearances from Healer Priests in various regions.
- Adventurers have given differing accounts of the Giants' appearances, which warrants thorough investigation.

We hereby report the situation described above and request assistance.

Name: [player]
Text: (They destroyed the object to prevent more Giants from appearing, so why are they still...)

Name: Evrin
Text:
You look like you have a lot of questions.
Eli likely has the answers you seek.

Name: Evrin
Text:
Go to Aburu Village right now.
She is waiting for you.

Name: Evrin
Text: I didn't even consider the possibility of you refusing.

Name: Evrin
Text:
If you don’t hurry, Eli might start nagging.
Now, hurry along.

Name: [player]
Text: (Is that Eli? Let's get closer.)

Name: Serious-Looking Priest
Text: Mmm, hmm?

Name: [player]
Text: (Faced with her blatant staring, I can't think of anything to say.)

Name: Serious-Looking Priest
Text:
Hmm! Yep, yep.
Nice to meet you, Adventurer!

Name: Eli
Text:
I'm Eli.
I'm a priest of the Wayfinders Guild and a researcher of anomalies.

Name: Eli
Text:
I've heard the rumors, so I know all about you!
You specialize in handling troublesome matters, right?
I tried to explain that I'm not quite a specialist, but Eli didn't even pretend to listen.
I'm just explaining what's happened so far, so why am I the one feeling embarrassed...

Name: Eli
Text:
Ooh! So you're saying you're a top-notch fixer!
Just what I'd expect from someone sent by Evrin.

Name: [player]
Text: (She isn't listening to a word I say.)

Name: Eli
Text: As for what Eyvind did... You're well aware, right?

Name: Eli
Text: Sigh... The Appraisers Guild destroyed the object, yet Giants keep showing up. I don't get it.

Name: Eli
Text:
First, let's head toward the Sunrise Slope.
Rumor has it they're frequently spotted there.

Name: [player]
Text: (She doesn't look scared... she looks completely indifferent.)

Name: [player]
Text:
(The Giant's gaze is fixed solely on humans.
Hmm... It seems the expedition member was mistaken.)

Name: Eli
Text:
Tsk, this is why academics are useless.
Let's take down the Giant first!

We both dashed toward where the Giant had collapsed.
Upon arrival, we found a Naruru there.

Name: Serious Naruru
Text:
Waaah... Ugly, ugly things!
Leaving this gross, gross mess behind!

Name: [player]
Text: (A Naruru's voice...? Let's get closer.)

Name: Eli
Text: What brings a Naruru all the way out here?

Name: Serious Naruru
Text:
Hmph! You should be thanking me for showing up!
So rude, rude!

Name: Eli
Text: Do you seriously still believe Giants are scared of the Naruru, Chahinia?

Name: Chahinia
Text: When someone worries, worries about you, the first thing to do is say thank you!

Name: Eli
Text:
What are you t... you saw it too!
The Giant was only going after humans!

Name: Eli
Text: If anyone is in danger, it's me, not you!

Name: Chahinia
Text:
We don't want these bad, bad things in the land bestowed by Ea!
Naruru, Naruru works hard too!
Seeing no end to their bickering, I quickly intervened.

Name: Chahinia
Text:
First, we need to clean up that hunk, that hunk of mess!
They'll smell, smell that and come back!

Name: Eli
Text:
Chahinia is right.
So, could you lend me a hand, Adventurer?

Name: Eli
Text: I need to write a report first, so I should probably interrogate Chahinia a bit.

Name: Eli
Text:
Oh, and I need to bring samples back to the guild, you see?
You can just put them in here. Easy, right?
ItemDesc: The object used to collect scattered Aether traces at Aslin's request.

Name: [player]
Text: (Something serious is going on. Let's hurry over.)

Name: Chahinia
Text:
Get over here, human!
Here! Hurry, hurry up and hand it over!
Chahinia snatched the collected samples and began speaking urgently with Eli.

Name: Eli
Text: Bad news or worse news, which do you prefer?

Name: Eli
Text: The bad news is... the Giants have no interest in the Naruru tribe!

Name: Eli
Text: Hah, isn't that totally unfair to us humans?

Name: Chahinia
Text:
What, what are you talking about!
That's why you need us more, more!

Name: Chahinia
Text: I am destined to be a Shiny-Head, and I know full well that the Giant we just saw was stupid, stupid!

Name: Eli
Text:
Hmm, that's not a very academic.
It would be better to call them Mindless Giants instead.

Name: Eli
Text: Anyway, the bad news is... the Giants only target humans.

Name: Eli
Text: Looking at the samples we found, their energy wavelength has definitely changed.

Name: Eli
Text: I thought destroying the object would be a good thing…

Name: Chahinia
Text:
It's more dangerous, dangerous without it!
They'll appear all over the place, all over the place!

Name: Eli
Text: You could say their energy is more condensed because they're appearing in an unstable state.

Name: Eli
Text:
Once a dimension opens, it doesn’t close so easily!
Things will stay like this for a while.

Name: Eli
Text: S.o., we need your help more than ever, Adventurer!

Name: Eli
Text: Chahinia and I will report the details to Evrin, so you go meet Rada first, Adventurer!

Name: Eli
Text: She should be on the path leading to the Ironblood Brigade Hideout.

Name: Eli
Text:
Use this!
We can't even afford the time it takes to reach a Warp Anchor.
ItemDesc: An ancient object that transports the user to a specific location.

Name: Eli
Text:
I'll join you shortly!
Please go on ahead, Adventurer!

Name: Rada
Text: Huh? You're the fixer they sent to help me?!

Name: Rada
Text:
Hehe, this is why it pays to have good friends!
Let's go then, to where the Giant is!

Name: Rada
Text:
We can do that on the way!
First, let's take care of the Giant, [player]!

As soon as Rada and I stopped the Attack Incursion, Eli came running from afar.
We met a short distance away from where the Incursion occurred, just in case.

Name: Eli
Text: Phew, am I very late?

Name: Rada
Text: You just dumped the annoying stuff on me again!

Name: Eli
Text:
I was busy doing some veeeery complex calculations!
Chahinia and I racked our brains so hard!

Name: Rada
Text: So what's the conclusion?

Name: Eli
Text: It would take all day to explain, so just read this!

Name: [player]
ItemDesc:
- Dimensional Rifts are continuously appearing alongside Giants, even after the Appraisers Guild destroyed the object.
- By reverse-calculating the frequency of the Dimensional Rifts, we found that this phenomenon is likely to persist until the unstable Aether has completely dissipated.

Name: [player]
ItemDesc:
- Giants are broadly categorized into Intelligent Giants and Mindless Giants.
- Criteria 
 ▷Intelligent Giants: Exhibit behavior patterns such as reacting to human speech and actions, or using tools.
 ▷Mindless Giants: Obsessively target and attempt to consume only humans.

Name: [player]
ItemDesc:
- As Giants are appearing alongside Incursions, we will refer to this phenomenon as 'Attack Incursion'.
- Further investigation is needed into their appearance cycle.
 ▷We need to maintain our current strategy until all unbalanced energy wavelengths, scattered across the Forsaken Land when the object was destroyed, completely dissipate.

Name: Rada
Text: So you're saying everyone needs to step up and deal with these Incursions where Giants spawn?!

Name: Eli
Text:
That's right!
And we also need to... investigate them so we can fight them properly.

Name: [player]
Text: (Judging by how they're both staring at me, they must have more work for me.)

Name: Eli
Text: By the way, what was the Giant you saw earlier like?

Name: Eli
Text: Hmm... We needed a sample of an Intelligent Giant anyway, so this works out great!

Name: Eli
Text: Use this to gather samples just like before, and hurry!
ItemDesc: The object used to collect scattered Aether traces at Aslin's request.

Name: Rada
Text: Should I help out too, [player]?

Name: Eli
Text:
Not so fast! Where do you think you're going!
Rada has something else to do with me.

Name: [player]
Text: (I'd better run before they pile on more work.)

Name: Rada
Text: Welcome back, [player]!

Name: Eli
Text: Hah, you should've taken your time!

Name: Eli
Text: Alright, hand over the samples first!

Name: [player]
Text: (Handing over the samples, I mention the newly discovered traces.)

Name: Eli
Text: This is unheard of. A trace we've never seen before...

Name: Rada
Text:
It could just be someone who was running away.
Giants target humans, you know.

Name: Eli
Text: B-But... Since this is the first time we found a trace like this, I want to be careful.

Name: Eli
Text: So, Adventurer, do you think you could handle the Incursions yourself and find more of these samples...?

But Eli, insisting that she needed more data,
shamelessly began staring at Rada and me...

Name: Rada
Text: Hey, don't even try to dump more work on my friend! My friend’s busy!

Name: Eli
Text:
...Rada, you obviously have to help out too.
Where do you think you're going!

Name: Rada
Text:
Alright, alright already!
Then leave the Divine and the Alliance to me!

Name: Eli
Text: Hehe, I'll trust you with that part, Rada?!

Name: Eli
Text:
Oh right, Adventurer, just keep helping out like you have been!
The Wayfinders Guild will make sure you're properly compensated!
